# Australian survivor

## S01E20

1
00:00:00,000 --> 00:00:04,162
WWW.MY-SUBS.CO

1
00:00:02,160 --> 00:00:04,760
Welcome backstage
to Auckland's Civic Theatre.

2
00:00:04,800 --> 00:00:07,320
We are live
with the two-hour season final

3
00:00:07,360 --> 00:00:09,160
of Survivor New Zealand
and here they are,

4
00:00:09,200 --> 00:00:10,760
this season's players.

5
00:00:10,800 --> 00:00:13,560
Remember Lou, whose shock
departure from Mogoton

6
00:00:13,600 --> 00:00:16,840
caused a shakeup
that changed everything.

7
00:00:16,880 --> 00:00:18,960
Mikey here was de-throned,

8
00:00:19,000 --> 00:00:21,320
the game was turned on its head

9
00:00:21,360 --> 00:00:23,120
and it's not over yet.

10
00:00:23,160 --> 00:00:25,160
Later, I'll read the votes,

11
00:00:25,200 --> 00:00:26,720
announced the winner and open up

12
00:00:26,760 --> 00:00:28,360
the stage for a chat.

13
00:00:28,400 --> 00:00:30,960
Then, there's the GEM
People's Choice Award

14
00:00:31,000 --> 00:00:33,480
and all in front
of this epic crowd

15
00:00:33,520 --> 00:00:35,120
here at The Civic.

16
00:00:43,200 --> 00:00:47,120
So, here's where we're at.
Just three left in the game.

17
00:00:47,160 --> 00:00:49,360
Tom, who fought his way
to the top,

18
00:00:49,400 --> 00:00:51,000
amazing in challenges,

19
00:00:51,040 --> 00:00:53,840
Avi the best social player
of the season,

20
00:00:53,880 --> 00:00:56,400
and Barb
who made the biggest moves.

21
00:00:56,440 --> 00:00:58,800
Now, we head into day 39

22
00:00:58,840 --> 00:01:01,280
still uncertain
who will take the title

23
00:01:01,320 --> 00:01:02,680
of sole survivor

24
00:01:02,720 --> 00:01:05,240
and the one hundred
thousand dollars

25
00:01:05,280 --> 00:01:06,520
that goes with it.

26
00:01:06,560 --> 00:01:08,560
Here it is, the season final

27
00:01:08,600 --> 00:01:10,280
of Survivor New Zealand.

28
00:01:19,760 --> 00:01:22,800
Previously,
on Survivor New Zealand.

29
00:01:22,840 --> 00:01:26,680
Sixteen castaways
embarked on the adventure

30
00:01:26,720 --> 00:01:27,880
of a life-time.

31
00:01:27,920 --> 00:01:29,440
Welcome to Nicaragua,

32
00:01:29,480 --> 00:01:31,680
and New Zealand's
first ever Survivor.

33
00:01:31,720 --> 00:01:32,920
Wahoo.

34
00:01:32,960 --> 00:01:34,600
They split into two tribes,

35
00:01:34,640 --> 00:01:38,440
Mogoton and Hermosa.

36
00:01:38,480 --> 00:01:40,000
This is wicked!

37
00:01:40,040 --> 00:01:42,640
Set up camp in the jungle.

38
00:01:42,680 --> 00:01:44,240
Bring it all in here
then we'll see

39
00:01:44,280 --> 00:01:46,136
what we've got and figure out
what we're gonna build, aye?

40
00:01:46,160 --> 00:01:48,240
- Go team.
- Built alliances.

41
00:01:48,280 --> 00:01:49,840
As long as we know
we're a strong three.

42
00:01:49,880 --> 00:01:50,880
- Yeah.
- Yeah.

43
00:01:55,600 --> 00:01:57,160
And quickly turned on those

44
00:01:57,200 --> 00:01:58,800
they saw as the toughest.

45
00:01:58,840 --> 00:02:00,800
First person
voted out of Hermosa tribe,

46
00:02:00,840 --> 00:02:02,400
Dee.

47
00:02:02,440 --> 00:02:03,800
Or the weakest.

48
00:02:03,840 --> 00:02:06,040
Hannah, the tribe has spoken.

49
00:02:06,080 --> 00:02:08,600
I wanna be the good person
that does the decent thing,

50
00:02:08,640 --> 00:02:10,720
and then I want to be
a Survivor.

51
00:02:10,760 --> 00:02:13,360
So you almost can't play
the two at the same time.

52
00:02:13,400 --> 00:02:14,920
But just when they thought

53
00:02:14,960 --> 00:02:16,800
they had the game sussed,

54
00:02:16,840 --> 00:02:18,080
they were met with a twist,

55
00:02:18,120 --> 00:02:21,040
Redemption Island.

56
00:02:21,080 --> 00:02:22,360
Go Hannah!
Come on!

57
00:02:22,400 --> 00:02:24,240
Redemption Island
offers an opportunity

58
00:02:24,280 --> 00:02:27,120
for you to duel your way
back into this competition.

59
00:02:27,160 --> 00:02:28,760
Hannah is through the door

60
00:02:28,800 --> 00:02:31,160
and lives to fight another day.

61
00:02:31,200 --> 00:02:33,600
Dee, you are the first person
eliminated

62
00:02:33,640 --> 00:02:35,120
from Survivor New Zealand.

63
00:02:38,000 --> 00:02:39,720
At Mogoton, the tribe

64
00:02:39,760 --> 00:02:42,400
turned on their
self-appointed leader.

65
00:02:42,440 --> 00:02:44,200
Tony, the tribe has spoken.

66
00:02:45,800 --> 00:02:48,360
While at Hermosa,
it was generation

67
00:02:48,400 --> 00:02:50,400
against generation.

68
00:02:50,440 --> 00:02:51,680
We've got five young ones.

69
00:02:51,720 --> 00:02:54,120
- Yes, I am concerned.
- The old people

70
00:02:54,160 --> 00:02:56,000
were gonna target you two,
I heard.

71
00:02:56,040 --> 00:02:57,760
I think Nate's a massive threat.

72
00:02:57,800 --> 00:02:59,256
I don't know what Barb
would do though.

73
00:02:59,280 --> 00:03:01,960
She's the kind of person that
would just get tagged along,

74
00:03:02,000 --> 00:03:03,216
and then end up at the end
and everyone would be like,

75
00:03:03,240 --> 00:03:04,640
"How the hell did she get there?

76
00:03:04,680 --> 00:03:06,000
As Hermosa proved stronger

77
00:03:06,040 --> 00:03:07,720
in immunity challenges.

78
00:03:07,760 --> 00:03:10,680
- Louisa is gone.
- Hey bro.

79
00:03:10,720 --> 00:03:13,560
Shay campaigned
to take out arch-rival Tom.

80
00:03:16,480 --> 00:03:18,320
I want Tom out.
I know he's after me.

81
00:03:18,360 --> 00:03:20,480
I think we should carry Tom
a little bit.

82
00:03:20,520 --> 00:03:22,080
But with Avi's help...

83
00:03:23,400 --> 00:03:24,600
Tom survived.

84
00:03:24,640 --> 00:03:26,440
Third person
voted out of Mogoton...

85
00:03:26,480 --> 00:03:28,800
At Izzy's expense.

86
00:03:28,840 --> 00:03:30,360
It was a close call tonight.

87
00:03:30,400 --> 00:03:31,840
I don't feel safe.

88
00:03:31,880 --> 00:03:35,040
The medical evacuation
of Louisa stunned Mogoton.

89
00:03:35,080 --> 00:03:36,720
- Love you girl.
- She's a firecracker.

90
00:03:36,760 --> 00:03:39,720
She's gonna be missed.

91
00:03:39,760 --> 00:03:42,160
It's time to drop your buffs,

92
00:03:42,200 --> 00:03:44,400
we're redrawing for new tribes.

93
00:03:44,440 --> 00:03:46,520
And led to a tribal re-shuffle.

94
00:03:46,560 --> 00:03:49,200
- Ye.
- Yeah Lee!

95
00:03:49,240 --> 00:03:51,880
Bringing new hope
to Nate and Barb.

96
00:03:51,920 --> 00:03:54,160
Barb and I've been dead
in the water for days.

97
00:03:54,200 --> 00:03:56,040
Now the whole game's
been turned on its head.

98
00:03:56,080 --> 00:03:57,040
Go!

99
00:03:57,080 --> 00:03:59,520
A new stronger Mogoton emerged.

100
00:03:59,560 --> 00:04:01,480
Mogoton wins immunity!

101
00:04:01,520 --> 00:04:04,240
And gave Tom a fresh start.

102
00:04:04,280 --> 00:04:05,600
- Gallo!
- Pinto!

103
00:04:05,640 --> 00:04:07,280
It's kinda like a bachelor party

104
00:04:07,320 --> 00:04:10,880
- without the alcohol.
- Survivor Enchilada!

105
00:04:10,920 --> 00:04:14,240
Except one of them has brought
their angry missus.

106
00:04:14,280 --> 00:04:17,240
The new-look Hermosa
gave Nate and Barb the chance

107
00:04:17,280 --> 00:04:19,800
to eliminate
one of their young foes.

108
00:04:19,840 --> 00:04:21,760
- She's got to go.
- Georgia.

109
00:04:22,920 --> 00:04:25,000
While the Mogoton brotherhood...

110
00:04:25,040 --> 00:04:27,640
- Mogoton, struggling.
- Good, good, good.

111
00:04:27,680 --> 00:04:29,640
Threw a crucial
immunity challenge.

112
00:04:29,680 --> 00:04:32,480
- Hey!
- Hermosa win immunity!

113
00:04:32,520 --> 00:04:34,360
To move against their nemesis.

114
00:04:34,400 --> 00:04:36,960
First person voted out
of the new-look Mogoton tribe,

115
00:04:37,000 --> 00:04:38,240
Shay.

116
00:04:41,320 --> 00:04:42,960
Georgia, crumbling!

117
00:04:43,000 --> 00:04:45,080
But Shay played her way back in.

118
00:04:45,120 --> 00:04:47,720
Shay is back in this game!

119
00:04:47,760 --> 00:04:50,200
Right in time
for a massive shake-up.

120
00:04:50,240 --> 00:04:51,520
Everyone, drop your buffs.

121
00:04:53,320 --> 00:04:56,880
Congratulations guys,
you've made it to the merge.

122
00:04:56,920 --> 00:04:58,960
You are now the Casar tribe,

123
00:04:59,000 --> 00:05:02,080
which means "to marry"
in Spanish.

124
00:05:02,120 --> 00:05:04,840
- But the honey-moon...
- We thank you for this merge.

125
00:05:04,880 --> 00:05:06,840
Was short-lived,

126
00:05:06,880 --> 00:05:10,200
as two alliances
grappled for supremacy.

127
00:05:15,760 --> 00:05:19,280
With Tom trying
to get Avi to change sides.

128
00:05:19,320 --> 00:05:22,000
You know, with the five on our
side, none of us will flip.

129
00:05:22,040 --> 00:05:24,440
And Shannon
playing a double game.

130
00:05:24,480 --> 00:05:27,000
I am jumping
between both camps so fast.

131
00:05:27,040 --> 00:05:29,360
I've got lies
going all over the place.

132
00:05:29,400 --> 00:05:31,720
- I'm sorry.
- Lee.

133
00:05:31,760 --> 00:05:34,040
A surprise double elimination.

134
00:05:34,080 --> 00:05:37,000
- Michael.
- What the hell?

135
00:05:37,040 --> 00:05:39,200
Sent two
of the strongest players

136
00:05:39,240 --> 00:05:40,600
to Redemption Island.

137
00:05:40,640 --> 00:05:42,840
Both just wondering
how we went from hero

138
00:05:42,880 --> 00:05:44,240
to zero just now really.

139
00:05:44,280 --> 00:05:46,480
Destroying the boys' alliance.

140
00:05:47,720 --> 00:05:49,920
But a sleeping giant woke.

141
00:05:52,200 --> 00:05:53,520
And made her move.

142
00:05:53,560 --> 00:05:56,840
I can start manipulating people.

143
00:05:56,880 --> 00:05:59,480
And all of a sudden
she's like a mafia queen.

144
00:05:59,520 --> 00:06:00,680
We'll do Sala first.

145
00:06:00,720 --> 00:06:02,960
Busting
her alliance from within.

146
00:06:03,000 --> 00:06:04,920
Third person voted out
of Casar is...

147
00:06:04,960 --> 00:06:07,080
And blindsiding
one of its kingpins.

148
00:06:07,120 --> 00:06:08,560
Sala.

149
00:06:10,760 --> 00:06:12,440
Barb you are good.

150
00:06:12,480 --> 00:06:15,440
I know
everyone's underestimated me.

151
00:06:15,480 --> 00:06:18,000
I'm a hundred-percent
I'm the next to go.

152
00:06:18,040 --> 00:06:20,240
I do trust you and Barb, still.

153
00:06:20,280 --> 00:06:23,400
While Avi scrambled
to avoid elimination.

154
00:06:23,440 --> 00:06:26,200
Jak, the tribe has spoken.

155
00:06:26,240 --> 00:06:28,680
Jak bared more than his soul.

156
00:06:34,880 --> 00:06:36,600
Tom was still a target.

157
00:06:36,640 --> 00:06:39,840
We really need
to send Tom to Redemption.

158
00:06:39,880 --> 00:06:42,120
Again, Tom wins immunity!

159
00:06:42,160 --> 00:06:44,760
But as he clung
onto the immunity necklace,

160
00:06:44,800 --> 00:06:46,680
Shannon's days were numbered.

161
00:06:46,720 --> 00:06:48,560
The tribe has spoken.

162
00:06:48,600 --> 00:06:50,600
Then, loyalties were tested.

163
00:06:50,640 --> 00:06:52,880
You have to vote Shay as well.

164
00:06:52,920 --> 00:06:55,200
I promised her I'd never write
her name down.

165
00:06:55,240 --> 00:06:57,600
As the tribe went after Shay.

166
00:06:57,640 --> 00:06:59,920
I really wish I could have
saved you this time.

167
00:07:02,600 --> 00:07:04,400
Barb faced a tough choice

168
00:07:04,440 --> 00:07:06,720
between friend and alliance.

169
00:07:06,760 --> 00:07:08,880
I'm a bit emotional today.

170
00:07:08,920 --> 00:07:11,440
- Thank you very much.
- Nate.

171
00:07:12,960 --> 00:07:14,040
Yes I'm down on one knee,

172
00:07:14,080 --> 00:07:15,536
but I've got a fighting chance
haven't I?

173
00:07:15,560 --> 00:07:17,840
Over seventeen days.

174
00:07:17,880 --> 00:07:20,640
Michael is sweet
and stays alive in this game!

175
00:07:20,680 --> 00:07:23,360
Mike defeated his rivals
at Redemption.

176
00:07:23,400 --> 00:07:26,440
He's got a skull,
and another skull.

177
00:07:26,480 --> 00:07:27,920
That's five point for Michael.

178
00:07:27,960 --> 00:07:29,960
To stay in the game.

179
00:07:30,000 --> 00:07:34,200
And just like that,
Shannon is gone.

180
00:07:34,240 --> 00:07:37,120
Shay really struggling.
Shay is gone.

181
00:07:37,160 --> 00:07:40,040
Michael and Jak
are alive in this game.

182
00:07:40,080 --> 00:07:43,400
Cementing his reputation
as a massive threat.

183
00:07:43,440 --> 00:07:45,400
Love you guys. We'll see you
at tribal council.

184
00:07:45,440 --> 00:07:48,360
Michael's been a form
player all the way through.

185
00:07:48,400 --> 00:07:50,240
Can anyone beat Goliath?

186
00:07:50,280 --> 00:07:52,720
When Jak lost the final
Redemption battle...

187
00:07:52,760 --> 00:07:54,400
Jak has dropped.

188
00:07:54,440 --> 00:07:58,200
Michael and Nate
are still in this game.

189
00:07:58,240 --> 00:07:59,880
Mike and Nate lived to fight

190
00:07:59,920 --> 00:08:01,720
another day at Casar.

191
00:08:01,760 --> 00:08:03,440
It's either me or Mike.

192
00:08:03,480 --> 00:08:05,040
He is a force coming back
into the game.

193
00:08:05,080 --> 00:08:07,960
So for Mike
it was just the one day.

194
00:08:08,000 --> 00:08:09,360
Michael heading for his tenth.

195
00:08:09,400 --> 00:08:10,560
Michael drops.

196
00:08:10,600 --> 00:08:13,560
As Tom won his most
crucial challenge yet.

197
00:08:13,600 --> 00:08:15,800
Tom wins immunity!

198
00:08:15,840 --> 00:08:18,160
And the tribe took out Goliath.

199
00:08:18,200 --> 00:08:21,440
The eighth person
voted out of Casar is,

200
00:08:21,480 --> 00:08:22,960
Mike.

201
00:08:24,960 --> 00:08:27,080
- See ya later.
- Just four players

202
00:08:27,120 --> 00:08:30,720
remained in Casar,
and once again

203
00:08:30,760 --> 00:08:33,880
Barbs was confronted
with the tough decision.

204
00:08:33,920 --> 00:08:35,680
It's been an emotional
roller-coaster for me,

205
00:08:35,720 --> 00:08:37,200
- you know?
- Yeah.

206
00:08:37,240 --> 00:08:39,320
To vote out her friend Nate,

207
00:08:39,360 --> 00:08:41,960
or to bow out herself.

208
00:08:42,000 --> 00:08:43,960
- You okay?
- Not really.

209
00:08:45,360 --> 00:08:48,000
And provide a valuable jury vote

210
00:08:48,040 --> 00:08:49,960
for her favorite, Avi.

211
00:08:50,000 --> 00:08:51,600
Avi needs my vote.

212
00:08:51,640 --> 00:08:54,480
He's not going to beat you
without me.

213
00:08:54,520 --> 00:08:55,880
In the end...

214
00:08:55,920 --> 00:08:59,000
Ninth person voted out
of Casar is,

215
00:08:59,040 --> 00:09:00,240
Nate.

216
00:09:00,280 --> 00:09:01,640
She decided to back herself,

217
00:09:01,680 --> 00:09:04,240
and take a shot at the title.

218
00:09:04,280 --> 00:09:07,240
And now
just three players remain.

219
00:09:07,280 --> 00:09:09,480
Tom, the teacher from Tauranga

220
00:09:09,520 --> 00:09:11,600
who thwarted elimination

221
00:09:11,640 --> 00:09:13,880
and won immunity
when it mattered most.

222
00:09:13,920 --> 00:09:15,200
Yeah, I can definitely win.

223
00:09:15,240 --> 00:09:17,216
I've got a strategy in mind
that I think might work.

224
00:09:17,240 --> 00:09:19,160
Avi, the youth expedition leader

225
00:09:19,200 --> 00:09:21,480
from Wellington
who carefully navigated

226
00:09:21,520 --> 00:09:23,440
through conflicting loyalties

227
00:09:23,480 --> 00:09:26,000
and promises
to stay in the game.

228
00:09:26,040 --> 00:09:28,560
I feel proud and happy
with the game I've played,

229
00:09:28,600 --> 00:09:31,960
which is an amazing feeling
after thirty-seven days.

230
00:09:32,000 --> 00:09:33,840
Barbara, horse owner and mother

231
00:09:33,880 --> 00:09:36,640
from Auckland,
underestimated at first

232
00:09:36,680 --> 00:09:39,280
- but pulled some big moves.
- Yeah!

233
00:09:39,320 --> 00:09:41,240
To become a major player.

234
00:09:41,280 --> 00:09:43,640
I am really proud
that I'm the oldest woman,

235
00:09:43,680 --> 00:09:44,880
and I'm still here.

236
00:09:44,920 --> 00:09:46,960
And I think that's going
to be really cool.

237
00:09:47,000 --> 00:09:48,640
Really cool for my daughter.

238
00:09:51,120 --> 00:09:53,600
Tonight our three finalists

239
00:09:53,640 --> 00:09:55,640
put their case to the jury...

240
00:09:55,680 --> 00:09:58,000
I want to know if you feel

241
00:09:58,040 --> 00:10:00,800
you have been a kind person
in this game.

242
00:10:02,240 --> 00:10:04,760
Some things you did
were really, really selfish.

243
00:10:04,800 --> 00:10:06,640
I've never felt so belittled.

244
00:10:08,080 --> 00:10:09,880
On the respect of those

245
00:10:09,920 --> 00:10:12,440
that naturally respected you.

246
00:10:12,480 --> 00:10:14,496
There is actually nothing
you could say at this point

247
00:10:14,520 --> 00:10:16,760
which would make me
vote for you.

248
00:10:16,800 --> 00:10:18,320
Who will decide

249
00:10:18,360 --> 00:10:21,320
the one-hundred-thousand
dollar winner

250
00:10:21,360 --> 00:10:25,280
and New Zealand's
first ever sole Survivor.

251
00:11:36,760 --> 00:11:38,160
Wahoo.

252
00:11:38,200 --> 00:11:39,376
Home sweet home
for one more night.

253
00:11:39,400 --> 00:11:40,960
I know.

254
00:11:41,000 --> 00:11:42,880
- This is it.
- Oh, man.

255
00:11:42,920 --> 00:11:44,960
God. Final three.

256
00:11:45,000 --> 00:11:47,880
Who would have thought?
Not me. Nope.

257
00:11:47,920 --> 00:11:50,120
Congratulations you guys.

258
00:11:50,160 --> 00:11:52,440
Ohh.

259
00:11:52,480 --> 00:11:54,040
- Yeah.
- Bring it in.

260
00:11:55,600 --> 00:11:58,320
Final three. Man,
what a journey.

261
00:12:01,560 --> 00:12:03,320
- It's surreal.
- I know.

262
00:12:04,600 --> 00:12:05,680
I can't take it in.

263
00:12:10,600 --> 00:12:13,800
Oh my gosh,
what a crazy sort of...

264
00:12:13,840 --> 00:12:15,160
Nate was really good, wasn't he?

265
00:12:15,200 --> 00:12:18,280
- Ah yeah, of course.
- He's the man.

266
00:12:18,320 --> 00:12:19,440
Writing Nate's name down

267
00:12:19,480 --> 00:12:20,720
was really bittersweet for me,

268
00:12:20,760 --> 00:12:23,400
because my name was going
to be written down.

269
00:12:23,440 --> 00:12:26,200
And, honestly,
it was only half an hour

270
00:12:26,240 --> 00:12:29,200
before we went to tribal
that we all came

271
00:12:29,240 --> 00:12:33,240
to a mutual decision and it,
it was because of Nate.

272
00:12:33,280 --> 00:12:36,680
He was adamant
I had to go to the end

273
00:12:36,720 --> 00:12:38,720
and that I deserved it

274
00:12:38,760 --> 00:12:43,800
and not to give up and...

275
00:12:47,400 --> 00:12:49,120
and just think
what my eighteen-year-old

276
00:12:49,160 --> 00:12:50,400
would think, you know.

277
00:12:50,440 --> 00:12:53,400
So, I did, and he was right.

278
00:12:53,440 --> 00:12:55,336
And actually, I think,
you know when you have a jury

279
00:12:55,360 --> 00:12:57,800
you always have
the head juror. To me...

280
00:12:57,840 --> 00:13:00,600
He'd be the one, aye.

281
00:13:00,640 --> 00:13:03,120
So with Nate gone,
it means potentially

282
00:13:03,160 --> 00:13:04,960
one less vote for me
in the jury.

283
00:13:05,000 --> 00:13:06,536
I knew that Barb
was going to vote for me,

284
00:13:06,560 --> 00:13:08,360
I'm not sure about Nate.

285
00:13:08,400 --> 00:13:10,720
I know he got on
really well with Tom.

286
00:13:10,760 --> 00:13:13,480
I don't think the jury's
looking very positive for me.

287
00:13:13,520 --> 00:13:15,600
But hey, that's okay.

288
00:13:15,640 --> 00:13:17,760
I don't think
they'll smile at me.

289
00:13:17,800 --> 00:13:20,040
I feel
like there's a lot of room

290
00:13:20,080 --> 00:13:23,320
at the final tribal, you know?

291
00:13:23,360 --> 00:13:25,040
I feel like maybe
decisions are made

292
00:13:25,080 --> 00:13:26,800
and opinions are already formed,

293
00:13:26,840 --> 00:13:28,880
but I feel like on the night

294
00:13:28,920 --> 00:13:31,720
they'll be quite like, um,
malleable.

295
00:13:31,760 --> 00:13:33,040
- Yeah.
- Don't you reckon?

296
00:13:33,080 --> 00:13:34,920
I think so. Yeah.

297
00:13:34,960 --> 00:13:38,120
It's really good
to have a jury of your mates.

298
00:13:38,160 --> 00:13:40,560
However, this isn't
your friend wins.

299
00:13:40,600 --> 00:13:42,160
This is who's played
the best game,

300
00:13:42,200 --> 00:13:44,440
and I know a lot of, um,
the guys

301
00:13:44,480 --> 00:13:47,560
especially are going to be
looking at Tom's game

302
00:13:47,600 --> 00:13:49,680
and his multiple immunity wins.

303
00:13:49,720 --> 00:13:51,480
So it does make me nervous.

304
00:13:51,520 --> 00:13:53,960
Oh, my gosh.

305
00:13:54,000 --> 00:13:55,176
My feeling
it's going to be split

306
00:13:55,200 --> 00:13:56,720
between myself and Avi.

307
00:13:56,760 --> 00:13:58,056
I'm just going to have
to plead my case

308
00:13:58,080 --> 00:14:00,520
best I can
and see who snags at it.

309
00:14:00,560 --> 00:14:02,400
I can't believe
this is our last night!

310
00:14:02,440 --> 00:14:04,600
- Oh, my God.
- It's so crazy.

311
00:14:05,800 --> 00:14:08,080
-Honestly guys,
there's no one else I'd be...

312
00:14:08,120 --> 00:14:09,880
- No.
- Wanting to share

313
00:14:09,920 --> 00:14:11,696
- the final three with or...
- Really cool people.

314
00:14:11,720 --> 00:14:13,040
This last night with.

315
00:14:13,080 --> 00:14:15,600
I'm really happy to be sitting
beside my two friends

316
00:14:15,640 --> 00:14:18,040
who I think totally deserve
to be here,

317
00:14:18,080 --> 00:14:20,200
and will definitely give me
a run for the money.

318
00:14:20,240 --> 00:14:22,760
Um, so I think it's going
to come down to a fight.

319
00:14:22,800 --> 00:14:26,640
Good night
you legendary final three.

320
00:14:26,680 --> 00:14:29,200
Here's to our last night
in Survivor.

321
00:15:01,680 --> 00:15:03,400
Thirty-nine days is huge.

322
00:15:03,440 --> 00:15:05,920
It's almost six weeks
out here in the jungle

323
00:15:05,960 --> 00:15:07,600
on the beach,

324
00:15:07,640 --> 00:15:09,600
which makes it sound
like paradise, which it is.

325
00:15:09,640 --> 00:15:12,280
But it's been no easy stroll.

326
00:15:12,320 --> 00:15:14,200
It's been hard.
It's been really hard.

327
00:15:21,440 --> 00:15:24,400
Yeah, way better today.

328
00:15:27,560 --> 00:15:29,136
It'll be the last time
I'm looking at it.

329
00:15:29,160 --> 00:15:30,320
Yeah.

330
00:15:39,200 --> 00:15:41,680
I don't think I've
stepped out of the game once.

331
00:15:41,720 --> 00:15:45,360
I don't think I've stopped
thinking about the game once.

332
00:15:45,400 --> 00:15:49,320
So its relief knowing
that tonight it's over,

333
00:15:49,360 --> 00:15:51,160
and I've done
everything that I can do

334
00:15:51,200 --> 00:15:53,200
to get to this point.

335
00:15:53,240 --> 00:15:55,920
Day thirty-nine
and down to bones.

336
00:15:55,960 --> 00:15:57,240
Skin and bones, you know,

337
00:15:57,280 --> 00:16:00,000
just want to get
a good meal in me.

338
00:16:00,040 --> 00:16:01,256
This has been such a huge dream

339
00:16:01,280 --> 00:16:03,480
of mine for such a long time.

340
00:16:03,520 --> 00:16:06,280
I used to be obsessed with
Survivor through high school.

341
00:16:06,320 --> 00:16:08,440
I used to make my friends
do Survivor challenges.

342
00:16:08,480 --> 00:16:11,520
So to be here,
and to be in the final three,

343
00:16:11,560 --> 00:16:14,600
is honestly
a dream come true for me.

344
00:16:20,000 --> 00:16:23,040
I think a huge, huge step

345
00:16:23,080 --> 00:16:26,080
of winning this game
is tonight's tribal council.

346
00:16:28,280 --> 00:16:30,440
I know that there's
a lot of people on that jury

347
00:16:30,480 --> 00:16:31,816
who haven't made up
their mind at all,

348
00:16:31,840 --> 00:16:33,680
by any means.

349
00:16:33,720 --> 00:16:35,840
Tonight I'm really just
gonna have to prove to them

350
00:16:35,880 --> 00:16:37,400
how hard I've fought,

351
00:16:37,440 --> 00:16:39,800
and kind of the type of game
that I've played.

352
00:16:42,040 --> 00:16:43,880
And it's a game
that I'm proud of,

353
00:16:45,400 --> 00:16:48,280
and I'm proud of who
I've been in this game.

354
00:16:48,320 --> 00:16:50,080
I'm just going to
have to let them know that,

355
00:16:50,120 --> 00:16:51,560
and let them see it,

356
00:16:51,600 --> 00:16:53,640
and let them come to
the conclusion

357
00:16:53,680 --> 00:16:55,800
that I deserve
to be the sole Survivor.

358
00:16:57,160 --> 00:16:58,960
It's nerve-racking,
but I trust them.

359
00:16:59,000 --> 00:17:00,920
I trust them to make
the best decision they know.

360
00:17:02,400 --> 00:17:03,720
I definitely think
that I deserve

361
00:17:03,760 --> 00:17:05,320
to be the winner
of this competition.

362
00:17:10,360 --> 00:17:12,880
- Wa-yaho.
- Oh, nice mat.

363
00:17:12,920 --> 00:17:15,280
- Eh, what the...
- Pretty mat.

364
00:17:16,400 --> 00:17:18,200
- Ohh!
- Oh, yo!

365
00:17:18,240 --> 00:17:19,960
Ohh! Oh, bread.

366
00:17:20,000 --> 00:17:21,720
- Oh, my God.
- Bun. Look at these!

367
00:17:21,760 --> 00:17:24,840
- What is this?
- Oh, doughnuts!

368
00:17:26,200 --> 00:17:28,240
What is this going to be?

369
00:17:28,280 --> 00:17:29,880
Eggs. Bacon.

370
00:17:29,920 --> 00:17:31,920
Oh, my... Oh, my God.
They've given us a pan.

371
00:17:32,960 --> 00:17:34,720
Oh, my God, butter.

372
00:17:34,760 --> 00:17:36,840
Oh, my God, they're so fresh.

373
00:17:36,880 --> 00:17:39,040
- Ready? Cheers.
- Cheers guys.

374
00:17:39,680 --> 00:17:42,040
Final three.

375
00:17:43,400 --> 00:17:45,640
Mmm. Oh, my God.

376
00:17:45,680 --> 00:17:47,160
Something's happening
to my tummy.

377
00:17:48,520 --> 00:17:49,480
It's telling me something,

378
00:17:49,520 --> 00:17:50,920
but I'm just ignoring it.

379
00:17:52,040 --> 00:17:54,120
- It can leave me alone.
- Yeah.

380
00:17:54,160 --> 00:17:56,880
The stomachs just like,
"What are you doing? Again?"

381
00:17:56,920 --> 00:17:58,760
I thought we were sorted man.

382
00:17:58,800 --> 00:18:00,336
Yeah, "I thought we'd
been through this already."

383
00:18:00,360 --> 00:18:01,600
Rice and beans.

384
00:18:02,960 --> 00:18:04,840
I'm feeling
much better this morning,

385
00:18:04,880 --> 00:18:06,280
and feeling in a good place.

386
00:18:06,320 --> 00:18:08,600
And as long...

387
00:18:08,640 --> 00:18:10,240
as I don't think too much

388
00:18:10,280 --> 00:18:12,520
about my family I'll be fine.

389
00:18:12,560 --> 00:18:14,400
So, um, yeah.

390
00:18:14,440 --> 00:18:15,600
I'll be good.

391
00:18:16,200 --> 00:18:17,560
I hope.

392
00:18:17,600 --> 00:18:19,160
'Cause I don't
want to cry tonight.

393
00:18:19,200 --> 00:18:21,080
I'll be good.
I'll be fine. I'll be fine.

394
00:18:21,120 --> 00:18:22,920
Um, but I'm feeling
really good and I...

395
00:18:22,960 --> 00:18:24,160
Every so often I'll smile

396
00:18:24,200 --> 00:18:25,760
and think I can't believe
I'm here

397
00:18:25,800 --> 00:18:27,960
and, um,
it's going to be so cool.

398
00:18:28,000 --> 00:18:29,800
Because I won't tell the kids,
and they'll...

399
00:18:29,840 --> 00:18:31,176
I'll just let them
watch the episodes

400
00:18:31,200 --> 00:18:32,360
and it'll be really cool

401
00:18:32,400 --> 00:18:33,440
that they'll have no idea

402
00:18:33,480 --> 00:18:34,600
their mother got this far.

403
00:18:34,640 --> 00:18:35,920
And I think it's really neat.

404
00:18:38,040 --> 00:18:39,240
Oh, that's yummy.

405
00:18:40,640 --> 00:18:42,600
All I've done for 27 years

406
00:18:42,640 --> 00:18:44,600
is all been a girlfriend,
a wife, a mother,

407
00:18:44,640 --> 00:18:47,200
and I said this time I don't
want to think about anyone

408
00:18:47,240 --> 00:18:49,240
and I just want
to think about me.

409
00:18:49,280 --> 00:18:53,560
Ohh, yeah. Doughnut.
Doughnuts.

410
00:18:53,600 --> 00:18:57,360
It was a real selfish
kinda personal odyssey for me

411
00:18:57,400 --> 00:18:59,560
and that's why I looked at
Survivor differently

412
00:18:59,600 --> 00:19:01,680
to a lot of other players.

413
00:19:01,720 --> 00:19:03,600
They were just gunning
for the money in the end.

414
00:19:03,640 --> 00:19:07,640
I kinda was using this
as my eat-pray-love journey.

415
00:19:07,680 --> 00:19:11,160
I came to challenge myself
for myself.

416
00:19:14,320 --> 00:19:16,040
If I was watching this program,

417
00:19:16,080 --> 00:19:18,600
I know who I'd vote for,
and it would be me.

418
00:19:18,640 --> 00:19:20,000
And I'm not just saying that,

419
00:19:20,040 --> 00:19:21,520
I would just do it
from principle

420
00:19:21,560 --> 00:19:23,320
of seeing this woman

421
00:19:23,360 --> 00:19:26,680
who's 27 years older
and still holding her own.

422
00:19:26,720 --> 00:19:30,520
I've had my heat, exhaustion,
and I've worked through it.

423
00:19:31,680 --> 00:19:33,520
I'm not going for $100,000,

424
00:19:38,160 --> 00:19:40,600
I'm going as if
I want my children

425
00:19:40,640 --> 00:19:43,560
when they watch it
to be proud of what I say.

426
00:19:44,880 --> 00:19:46,520
So, that's how I see it.

427
00:19:50,480 --> 00:19:51,720
Sorry.

428
00:19:54,800 --> 00:19:56,160
I don't need to sell myself.

429
00:19:56,200 --> 00:19:58,240
I know what I am and my worth,

430
00:19:59,440 --> 00:20:01,880
and I don't need to do that
for anyone

431
00:20:01,920 --> 00:20:03,640
and if they can't
recognize my potential

432
00:20:03,680 --> 00:20:05,320
then that's their loss.

433
00:20:05,360 --> 00:20:08,280
My way of approaching it
is giving a life lesson

434
00:20:08,320 --> 00:20:10,200
to my children in how you...

435
00:20:10,240 --> 00:20:12,720
how you play a game
like this on TV.

436
00:20:36,600 --> 00:20:37,920
What a good last feast, aye?

437
00:20:37,960 --> 00:20:39,600
Yeah.

438
00:20:39,640 --> 00:20:41,080
Are you feeling anxious at all?

439
00:20:41,120 --> 00:20:42,880
- About tonight?
- Nah, yeah.

440
00:20:42,920 --> 00:20:44,680
- Oh, you are?
- Yeah.

441
00:20:44,720 --> 00:20:47,520
Oh, my gosh.

442
00:20:47,560 --> 00:20:50,080
- You guys.
- Did you smell the bacon?

443
00:20:50,120 --> 00:20:52,480
You could be like
the outdoor shed.

444
00:20:52,520 --> 00:20:54,320
The Survivor Outdoor,
you need to...

445
00:20:54,360 --> 00:20:55,800
you need to do yours cookbook.

446
00:20:55,840 --> 00:20:57,280
Survivor cook book.

447
00:20:58,400 --> 00:21:00,520
First meal on it,
rice and beans.

448
00:21:00,560 --> 00:21:01,680
Yeah, yeah. Yeah.

449
00:21:02,720 --> 00:21:03,840
"Thirty-nine days

450
00:21:03,880 --> 00:21:05,400
of how to cook rice and beans,

451
00:21:05,440 --> 00:21:07,440
thirty-nine different ways."
There you go.

452
00:21:07,480 --> 00:21:08,840
That could be your title.

453
00:21:10,200 --> 00:21:12,200
Thirty-nine days
out here is nuts.

454
00:21:12,240 --> 00:21:13,760
The thing that got me here,

455
00:21:13,800 --> 00:21:16,320
all the way to day 39,
was keeping head strong.

456
00:21:16,360 --> 00:21:18,840
Winning challenges was not
actually what was going on,

457
00:21:18,880 --> 00:21:21,040
it was what I had
going through my head and,

458
00:21:21,080 --> 00:21:23,160
you know, knowing that
it's not over till it's over

459
00:21:23,200 --> 00:21:25,680
and just really using
my brain a bit more.

460
00:21:25,720 --> 00:21:27,360
Hey guys, got to do the tree.

461
00:21:27,400 --> 00:21:29,960
Oh, yeah. Keep Nate's
little mark in there.

462
00:21:31,040 --> 00:21:33,000
- Use this one?
- Yeah.

463
00:21:34,760 --> 00:21:36,056
Oh, no, you can.
I'll just sit there.

464
00:21:36,080 --> 00:21:37,600
Where's the hammer?

465
00:21:37,640 --> 00:21:39,160
I watched the original Survivor

466
00:21:39,200 --> 00:21:41,400
when I was a boy
and loved it to pieces

467
00:21:41,440 --> 00:21:44,240
and to think that I'd even
get a shot at the show,

468
00:21:45,040 --> 00:21:46,840
let alone make it this far

469
00:21:46,880 --> 00:21:48,920
is just... something else.

470
00:21:50,600 --> 00:21:54,080
Final three as an achievement
is massive.

471
00:21:54,120 --> 00:21:56,600
Should do an A, a B, and a T.

472
00:21:56,640 --> 00:21:58,720
- Okay.
- Or B.A.T.

473
00:21:58,760 --> 00:22:00,080
- Bat?
- Bat.

474
00:22:00,120 --> 00:22:01,560
Now I've been thinking past it,

475
00:22:01,600 --> 00:22:03,600
and now I've been thinking
to sole Survivor

476
00:22:03,640 --> 00:22:05,440
and how I can plead my case.

477
00:22:05,480 --> 00:22:06,800
Bat was here.

478
00:22:06,840 --> 00:22:08,160
It's the Batrio.

479
00:22:09,000 --> 00:22:10,040
Yeah.

480
00:22:12,520 --> 00:22:14,840
I think the thing
that I'm worried about

481
00:22:14,880 --> 00:22:18,200
is that Avi may soak up
some votes

482
00:22:18,240 --> 00:22:19,760
from bringing me in,

483
00:22:19,800 --> 00:22:21,560
and people thinking that
he carried me

484
00:22:21,600 --> 00:22:23,560
those last few meters
over the line.

485
00:22:24,600 --> 00:22:26,400
All right. We made our...

486
00:22:27,440 --> 00:22:28,520
we made our mark.

487
00:22:29,080 --> 00:22:30,800
Bat. Bat ass.

488
00:22:30,840 --> 00:22:33,280
- All right.
- Oh, well, gotta pack.

489
00:22:33,320 --> 00:22:34,920
- Pack up.
- Yeah.

490
00:22:34,960 --> 00:22:36,760
I don't really wanna
destroy this place.

491
00:22:36,800 --> 00:22:38,576
- Nah, let's leave it.
- It's been home for too long.

492
00:22:38,600 --> 00:22:40,760
Yeah. Just get
our clothes out, aye?

493
00:22:40,800 --> 00:22:41,856
And we'll go and sit
and have a think.

494
00:22:41,880 --> 00:22:43,280
Yeah. Pack our bags.

495
00:22:43,320 --> 00:22:44,456
We'll leave that.
It'll be a cool thing

496
00:22:44,480 --> 00:22:46,120
for someone to stumble across.

497
00:22:46,760 --> 00:22:48,000
Be like, "What the?"

498
00:22:48,040 --> 00:22:49,296
Tonight at tribal
I'm just going to

499
00:22:49,320 --> 00:22:50,840
lay out my story.

500
00:22:50,880 --> 00:22:52,680
Tell them just
a few straight facts

501
00:22:52,720 --> 00:22:56,040
about how the game actually
was going on in my view

502
00:22:56,080 --> 00:22:58,120
and I think I've got
a few friends on the jury

503
00:22:58,160 --> 00:23:00,800
as well as people
who will respect the game

504
00:23:00,840 --> 00:23:02,880
- that I've played.
- All right.

505
00:23:04,240 --> 00:23:05,800
Let's get ready.

506
00:23:06,880 --> 00:23:07,880
Farewell camp.

507
00:23:07,920 --> 00:23:09,120
And just really hope

508
00:23:09,160 --> 00:23:11,000
that they take on me

509
00:23:11,040 --> 00:23:12,880
as the one
who's the most deserving.

510
00:23:12,920 --> 00:23:14,800
- Don't look back!
- Yeah.

511
00:23:17,760 --> 00:23:18,960
Yeah, I can definitely win.

512
00:24:12,320 --> 00:24:14,720
We'll now bring in
the members of our jury,

513
00:24:14,760 --> 00:24:16,680
Lee, Sala,

514
00:24:16,720 --> 00:24:18,440
Shannon, Shay,

515
00:24:18,480 --> 00:24:20,480
Jak, Michael,

516
00:24:20,520 --> 00:24:22,000
and Nate.

517
00:24:22,040 --> 00:24:23,040
Ohh.

518
00:24:29,840 --> 00:24:32,400
Tom, Avi, and Barbs,

519
00:24:32,440 --> 00:24:34,440
you have done
what thirteen others

520
00:24:34,480 --> 00:24:36,080
couldn't do in this game.

521
00:24:36,120 --> 00:24:38,600
You've made it to the end.

522
00:24:38,640 --> 00:24:41,920
Tonight though the power
shifts to the jury.

523
00:24:41,960 --> 00:24:44,520
The seven people
you've voted out

524
00:24:44,560 --> 00:24:47,080
will decide
who they think is worthy

525
00:24:47,120 --> 00:24:48,680
of the title of "Sole Survivor,"

526
00:24:48,720 --> 00:24:52,720
and the $100,000 prize.

527
00:24:56,360 --> 00:24:59,000
You will have the chance
to make an opening statement.

528
00:24:59,040 --> 00:25:01,600
It is your opportunity
to plead your case

529
00:25:01,640 --> 00:25:06,560
and say why you deserve to win.

530
00:25:06,600 --> 00:25:09,880
And then the jury
has a chance to address you,

531
00:25:09,920 --> 00:25:11,520
to get some information

532
00:25:11,560 --> 00:25:14,840
to make
a very important decision.

533
00:25:16,080 --> 00:25:18,280
We'll then go to the vote.

534
00:25:20,320 --> 00:25:22,840
Tom, you're up first.

535
00:25:27,040 --> 00:25:28,960
This is something
that a lot of us have had

536
00:25:29,000 --> 00:25:32,440
in our minds as something
we've been excited about

537
00:25:32,480 --> 00:25:35,200
for however long,
and I've been excited about

538
00:25:35,240 --> 00:25:38,240
the prospect since I was a kid.

539
00:25:39,120 --> 00:25:41,800
I built up stories of Survivor

540
00:25:41,840 --> 00:25:44,600
and I treated them
as these amazing people

541
00:25:44,640 --> 00:25:46,080
off in this wondrous land.

542
00:25:47,240 --> 00:25:50,840
I live my life as a role model

543
00:25:50,880 --> 00:25:52,920
for a group of young people,

544
00:25:52,960 --> 00:25:56,280
and so I could be
that person for them,

545
00:25:56,320 --> 00:25:57,880
and that's what
I've had in my mind

546
00:25:57,920 --> 00:25:58,920
through this whole game.

547
00:25:59,720 --> 00:26:01,320
I wanted to play it honorably

548
00:26:01,360 --> 00:26:03,440
and I wanted to go as hard
as I possibly could

549
00:26:03,480 --> 00:26:05,640
till it just sucked me dry.

550
00:26:05,680 --> 00:26:07,080
I wanted to get to that point,

551
00:26:07,120 --> 00:26:08,680
see how far I could push myself

552
00:26:08,720 --> 00:26:10,520
and I think
I've accomplished that.

553
00:26:10,560 --> 00:26:12,200
I wanted to get to the very end,

554
00:26:12,240 --> 00:26:13,520
and know that I earnt it.

555
00:26:14,400 --> 00:26:15,760
Give me your questions

556
00:26:15,800 --> 00:26:17,920
and I'll give you back
my honesty,

557
00:26:17,960 --> 00:26:19,240
and I'll just tell you my story

558
00:26:19,280 --> 00:26:21,480
and I hope you can respect me.

559
00:26:23,680 --> 00:26:24,720
Thanks, Tom.

560
00:26:24,760 --> 00:26:25,920
Avi, you're up.

561
00:26:28,440 --> 00:26:29,920
Hey guys.

562
00:26:29,960 --> 00:26:31,640
As most of you know
I'm a trip leader

563
00:26:31,680 --> 00:26:33,960
and an overseas educator,

564
00:26:34,000 --> 00:26:35,216
and before we head out
into the field

565
00:26:35,240 --> 00:26:36,520
I sit my students down

566
00:26:36,560 --> 00:26:39,320
and we write down
our intentions.

567
00:26:39,360 --> 00:26:42,200
So I did the same thing
before coming out here.

568
00:26:42,240 --> 00:26:43,800
And what were my intentions?

569
00:26:43,840 --> 00:26:47,880
Like Tom, it was
to leave nothing on the field.

570
00:26:47,920 --> 00:26:51,280
To give everything
that I had to this game.

571
00:26:51,320 --> 00:26:53,760
I wanted to keep
my integrity intact.

572
00:26:53,800 --> 00:26:57,400
I wanted to be honest.
I wanted to make connections.

573
00:26:57,440 --> 00:26:58,880
Today when I look back
on my journal

574
00:26:58,920 --> 00:27:00,440
I realize that

575
00:27:00,480 --> 00:27:02,120
I'd fulfilled my intentions,
I really had.

576
00:27:05,520 --> 00:27:08,600
You guys have the incredibly
daunting task of, uh,

577
00:27:08,640 --> 00:27:09,680
choosing a winner tonight,

578
00:27:10,680 --> 00:27:12,040
and I want you to know
I trust you.

579
00:27:12,960 --> 00:27:15,240
In this situation,
I trust you completely.

580
00:27:18,120 --> 00:27:21,040
Barbs. Your turn.

581
00:27:24,240 --> 00:27:27,720
I'd like to say, firstly,
that I have achieved

582
00:27:27,760 --> 00:27:29,640
my greatest challenge
in Survivor,

583
00:27:29,680 --> 00:27:31,640
and that is
to sit in front of you

584
00:27:31,680 --> 00:27:34,120
rather than sitting beside you.

585
00:27:34,160 --> 00:27:39,000
I was a lone Survivor
right from the start.

586
00:27:39,040 --> 00:27:41,840
I had some big egos
and big personalities

587
00:27:41,880 --> 00:27:43,640
in my Hermosa tribe.

588
00:27:46,240 --> 00:27:47,920
I had a bond with Nate

589
00:27:47,960 --> 00:27:50,280
because he was
a like-minded person

590
00:27:50,320 --> 00:27:53,640
going through
the same tribe as me.

591
00:27:53,680 --> 00:27:56,440
For twelve days
I felt like dead man walking,

592
00:27:56,480 --> 00:27:57,960
I had a noose around my neck.

593
00:27:59,400 --> 00:28:01,680
I wasn't prepared to just
suck up

594
00:28:01,720 --> 00:28:02,960
and sell myself to you guys

595
00:28:03,000 --> 00:28:05,080
just so you'd keep me around.

596
00:28:07,120 --> 00:28:09,480
I started playing on day 12

597
00:28:09,520 --> 00:28:11,160
when we blended the tribe,

598
00:28:11,200 --> 00:28:12,880
and suddenly
I sat up and thought,

599
00:28:12,920 --> 00:28:15,920
"Oh, I'm not just a lioness
waiting in the grass

600
00:28:15,960 --> 00:28:18,560
looking at a herd of people
all flock together.

601
00:28:18,600 --> 00:28:20,680
Now the people
I can start picking off

602
00:28:20,720 --> 00:28:22,720
because you're
moving out of the tribe."

603
00:28:24,920 --> 00:28:26,440
I made the biggest move,

604
00:28:26,480 --> 00:28:28,600
I feel, in Survivor,
taking out Sala.

605
00:28:28,640 --> 00:28:30,040
And that was all on me.

606
00:28:30,080 --> 00:28:31,440
Everyone jumped on board.

607
00:28:33,080 --> 00:28:35,760
I feel I played
with a velvet glove.

608
00:28:35,800 --> 00:28:37,480
I've been really
subtle with my play.

609
00:28:37,520 --> 00:28:40,640
You underestimated me,
you overlooked me

610
00:28:40,680 --> 00:28:42,560
and that suited
my purposes actually.

611
00:28:42,600 --> 00:28:44,800
I think I'm here
because you overlooked me.

612
00:28:44,840 --> 00:28:46,480
You were so busy
targeting each other

613
00:28:46,520 --> 00:28:48,720
and thinking
of the obvious threats,

614
00:28:48,760 --> 00:28:50,400
you just let me
come up the middle,

615
00:28:50,440 --> 00:28:52,200
pop up and go back down.

616
00:28:52,240 --> 00:28:54,760
I'm here
because of your inability

617
00:28:54,800 --> 00:28:56,640
to be perceptive enough to see

618
00:28:56,680 --> 00:28:59,320
that I actually
am quite strategic.

619
00:29:00,800 --> 00:29:03,600
I'm really wrapped that
I'm the last female here,

620
00:29:03,640 --> 00:29:05,440
and the oldest one in the game,

621
00:29:05,480 --> 00:29:08,080
and I think I will be
an inspiration

622
00:29:08,120 --> 00:29:09,120
to a lot of people.

623
00:29:12,640 --> 00:29:13,920
Thank you Barbs.

624
00:29:15,520 --> 00:29:18,040
The jury, finally,

625
00:29:18,080 --> 00:29:21,600
after 39 long days in this game,

626
00:29:21,640 --> 00:29:27,640
you now have a chance to
address Tom, Avi, and Barbs.

627
00:29:27,680 --> 00:29:32,960
You're looking for information
to make $100,000 decision.

628
00:29:33,800 --> 00:29:35,960
Shay, you're up first.

629
00:29:39,760 --> 00:29:41,880
- Hi, guys.
- Hey, Shay.

630
00:29:41,920 --> 00:29:43,480
I have a question
for each of you.

631
00:29:43,520 --> 00:29:45,480
Um, Barb,

632
00:29:45,520 --> 00:29:49,800
I want to know
if you feel you have been

633
00:29:49,840 --> 00:29:52,040
a kind person in this game.

634
00:29:55,120 --> 00:29:58,000
I don't think I've treated
anyone disrespectfully.

635
00:29:59,240 --> 00:30:00,840
If I don't have
anything nice to say

636
00:30:00,880 --> 00:30:02,200
I just don't say anything.

637
00:30:03,200 --> 00:30:05,080
Yeah, I would say
I've been kind.

638
00:30:08,280 --> 00:30:09,720
Okay. Cool. Thank you.

639
00:30:10,840 --> 00:30:13,160
- Avi. Hi.
- Hi.

640
00:30:14,080 --> 00:30:15,680
You know that I love you.

641
00:30:15,720 --> 00:30:18,640
My question Avi is,

642
00:30:18,680 --> 00:30:22,600
"What do you think
the youth of New Zealand

643
00:30:22,640 --> 00:30:26,120
can learn from the way
that you've played your game?"

644
00:30:27,480 --> 00:30:30,240
I think that
treating people well

645
00:30:30,280 --> 00:30:31,680
can get you far.

646
00:30:31,720 --> 00:30:35,080
Just by being respectful,
by being kind,

647
00:30:35,120 --> 00:30:36,960
I think can go
a really long way.

648
00:30:37,760 --> 00:30:39,680
Awesome, thank you.

649
00:30:39,720 --> 00:30:42,120
Hi, Tom. We have a bit

650
00:30:42,160 --> 00:30:44,600
of a head-butting history
in this game.

651
00:30:44,640 --> 00:30:47,760
I want to clear
the air between us.

652
00:30:53,080 --> 00:30:54,440
I feel like there was a point

653
00:30:54,480 --> 00:30:56,720
where a line had been crossed

654
00:30:56,760 --> 00:31:01,000
and I refuse to hear

655
00:31:01,040 --> 00:31:03,040
and see my name
be dragged through the mud.

656
00:31:04,360 --> 00:31:06,920
If you haven't said
a horrible thing about me

657
00:31:06,960 --> 00:31:08,720
then I sincerely apologize

658
00:31:08,760 --> 00:31:11,960
and there are some liars
in the jury.

659
00:31:12,000 --> 00:31:14,640
If you have anything
you'd like to say to me,

660
00:31:14,680 --> 00:31:16,960
I would love for you
to take that opportunity.

661
00:31:22,480 --> 00:31:23,880
When you talk about, you know,

662
00:31:23,920 --> 00:31:25,720
dragging someone's name
through the mud,

663
00:31:25,760 --> 00:31:27,800
I heard back to me stuff

664
00:31:27,840 --> 00:31:30,400
that I'd kind of
consider the same.

665
00:31:30,440 --> 00:31:32,440
But that's not the way
I feel about you.

666
00:31:32,480 --> 00:31:35,080
There is nothing personal
in this, no vengeance.

667
00:31:35,120 --> 00:31:37,960
Nothing against
your character as a person.

668
00:31:38,000 --> 00:31:42,040
I thought that your gameplay
was just intense,

669
00:31:42,080 --> 00:31:43,680
and a lot of it was
because it was,

670
00:31:43,720 --> 00:31:45,480
you know, coming at me.

671
00:31:46,760 --> 00:31:48,080
I really respect that.

672
00:31:48,120 --> 00:31:49,800
Thank you for clarifying
that for me.

673
00:31:51,520 --> 00:31:53,600
Jak. Come on up.

674
00:31:58,520 --> 00:32:00,280
I don't have
a question for any of you,

675
00:32:00,320 --> 00:32:01,880
I made my decision last night.

676
00:32:01,920 --> 00:32:03,136
What I have to say
to each of you

677
00:32:03,160 --> 00:32:04,520
is the honest truth.

678
00:32:04,560 --> 00:32:05,840
I'm going to start with you Avi.

679
00:32:06,960 --> 00:32:08,480
So I start out
the game thinking,

680
00:32:08,520 --> 00:32:10,320
"This guy is too nice
to be real.

681
00:32:10,360 --> 00:32:12,600
I cannot believe you,
this is just a fraud.

682
00:32:12,640 --> 00:32:13,640
This is a fake."

683
00:32:15,520 --> 00:32:19,000
But you proved to me
that you are as honest

684
00:32:19,040 --> 00:32:21,320
and as close to being perfect
as you can be,

685
00:32:21,360 --> 00:32:23,800
and I'm so stoked that
you've made it here bro.

686
00:32:23,840 --> 00:32:25,040
Ten out of ten.

687
00:32:27,040 --> 00:32:28,760
And Tom bro.

688
00:32:28,800 --> 00:32:30,200
I never thought I'd make

689
00:32:30,240 --> 00:32:31,720
such an awesome friend
out here bro.

690
00:32:31,760 --> 00:32:33,440
You helped me through a lot bro

691
00:32:33,480 --> 00:32:35,200
and I'm just real grateful.

692
00:32:36,720 --> 00:32:38,440
Barb,

693
00:32:38,480 --> 00:32:40,720
I respect that
you have come out here

694
00:32:40,760 --> 00:32:42,240
and you've given it
a good crack.

695
00:32:42,280 --> 00:32:44,080
You exceeded
my expectations of you.

696
00:32:44,120 --> 00:32:46,400
You did really, really well
at challenges,

697
00:32:46,440 --> 00:32:49,600
but that's as far
as it goes for me.

698
00:32:51,520 --> 00:32:54,240
We spoke a lot about
respect and maturity,

699
00:32:54,280 --> 00:32:59,120
and I don't know
if what you did for me

700
00:32:59,160 --> 00:33:00,160
could earn my respect.

701
00:33:05,160 --> 00:33:07,160
But I feel like
some things you did

702
00:33:07,200 --> 00:33:08,800
were really, really selfish

703
00:33:08,840 --> 00:33:10,200
and you felt
a little bit entitled,

704
00:33:10,240 --> 00:33:13,280
like you deserved our respect.

705
00:33:13,320 --> 00:33:14,800
And I don't know about that.

706
00:33:14,840 --> 00:33:16,800
And there was times
when it was raining,

707
00:33:16,840 --> 00:33:19,040
we needed the mats
to sleep on the ground.

708
00:33:19,080 --> 00:33:21,000
And it's a small thing,
and it might sound petty,

709
00:33:21,040 --> 00:33:23,520
but it felt like
you would rather

710
00:33:23,560 --> 00:33:25,080
us sleep on the dirt.

711
00:33:26,840 --> 00:33:29,560
It felt like just because
you were older than us,

712
00:33:29,600 --> 00:33:32,120
you had a sadder story
or a better story

713
00:33:32,160 --> 00:33:33,736
and, like, if that's not true
it's whatever,

714
00:33:33,760 --> 00:33:35,136
this is how I feel
and I'm telling you

715
00:33:35,160 --> 00:33:36,280
- how I feel.
- Its okay.

716
00:33:36,320 --> 00:33:37,760
So if you disagree
with it it's cool.

717
00:33:39,040 --> 00:33:40,760
I felt like you were
condescending at times,

718
00:33:40,800 --> 00:33:42,456
and that was sort of
the age thing as well.

719
00:33:42,480 --> 00:33:45,200
It's like you spoke
to us like we were children.

720
00:33:45,240 --> 00:33:46,800
I should have told you this
at the time,

721
00:33:46,840 --> 00:33:48,416
and I feel like a coward
for not doing that,

722
00:33:48,440 --> 00:33:50,640
but 'cause I'm speaking
from my heart

723
00:33:50,680 --> 00:33:52,056
and that's what
I want to do from now on.

724
00:33:52,080 --> 00:33:54,056
I've learnt that from Avi.
I've learnt that from Sala.

725
00:33:54,080 --> 00:33:56,216
I've learnt that from Shay.
I've learnt that from Nate.

726
00:33:56,240 --> 00:33:58,240
If we can all take something
from this game

727
00:33:58,280 --> 00:33:59,680
and become better people,

728
00:33:59,720 --> 00:34:02,040
for me that is a bit more
than $100,000.

729
00:34:02,080 --> 00:34:03,880
If you don't take
any of that on-board

730
00:34:03,920 --> 00:34:05,136
then I'm not sure
about how I can feel

731
00:34:05,160 --> 00:34:06,160
about you as a person.

732
00:34:11,120 --> 00:34:12,680
Thanks, Jak. Michael.

733
00:34:14,320 --> 00:34:15,440
No, no it's fine.

734
00:34:19,240 --> 00:34:20,440
Barbara...

735
00:34:24,400 --> 00:34:26,680
I agree with pretty much
everything Jak just said,

736
00:34:26,720 --> 00:34:30,320
so I'm not going to point out
any of those points again.

737
00:34:30,360 --> 00:34:33,520
All right, Avi,
I wanna vote for someone

738
00:34:33,560 --> 00:34:36,520
that truly deeply wants
to win this game,

739
00:34:36,560 --> 00:34:39,640
and I feel like Tom
wants to win this game

740
00:34:39,680 --> 00:34:40,680
a lot more than you.

741
00:34:42,720 --> 00:34:43,920
Convince me otherwise.

742
00:34:58,960 --> 00:35:01,480
All right, Avi,
I want to vote for someone

743
00:35:01,520 --> 00:35:04,480
that truly deeply wants
to win this game,

744
00:35:04,520 --> 00:35:07,600
and I feel like Tom
wants to win this game

745
00:35:07,640 --> 00:35:08,640
a lot more than you.

746
00:35:10,560 --> 00:35:12,120
Convince me otherwise.

747
00:35:19,920 --> 00:35:22,240
Every single day I wrote down,

748
00:35:22,280 --> 00:35:24,040
"You can do this,
you can do this."

749
00:35:24,080 --> 00:35:26,000
Like half of what I as writing
out on those rocks

750
00:35:26,040 --> 00:35:28,080
was a massive pep-talk to myself

751
00:35:28,120 --> 00:35:30,560
to make it to the end,
to keep fighting.

752
00:35:30,600 --> 00:35:31,920
I don't know if I've ever wanted

753
00:35:31,960 --> 00:35:33,960
something more in my life.

754
00:35:35,160 --> 00:35:36,160
Cheers, thanks.

755
00:35:37,760 --> 00:35:40,240
Tom, I want to vote for someone

756
00:35:40,280 --> 00:35:42,800
that has solid character,
good morals,

757
00:35:42,840 --> 00:35:44,480
and a winner that New Zealand
can look at

758
00:35:44,520 --> 00:35:46,760
and be like,
"They're an awesome person."

759
00:35:46,800 --> 00:35:49,200
Avi, he's easily got
all those qualities.

760
00:35:51,760 --> 00:35:54,640
Convince me that you've also
got those qualities as well.

761
00:35:56,440 --> 00:35:58,840
Every day I wake up ecstatic

762
00:35:58,880 --> 00:36:01,680
about changing the lives
of a group

763
00:36:01,720 --> 00:36:03,640
of what I call my own,

764
00:36:03,680 --> 00:36:06,560
and that's where
I want to make my major mark.

765
00:36:07,960 --> 00:36:10,000
You know, I have had
struggles in my life

766
00:36:10,040 --> 00:36:12,520
and there's been people
to help me through it

767
00:36:12,560 --> 00:36:15,640
and some of those people
were teachers

768
00:36:15,680 --> 00:36:20,240
and I want everyone to be
the best person they can be.

769
00:36:20,280 --> 00:36:23,680
That's all I'm trying to do
just in my day-to-day.

770
00:36:25,600 --> 00:36:26,800
Awesome, thanks.

771
00:36:30,720 --> 00:36:32,840
Nate, you're up.

772
00:36:42,680 --> 00:36:44,880
Congratulations. Well done,
I'm proud of you all.

773
00:36:45,760 --> 00:36:47,360
I've only got one question.

774
00:36:47,400 --> 00:36:49,120
Day 35, that's when

775
00:36:49,160 --> 00:36:50,600
I was voted out the first time.

776
00:36:52,760 --> 00:36:56,040
Avi, we talked a lot
about final three stuff

777
00:36:56,080 --> 00:36:58,640

you, and someone else.

778
00:36:58,680 --> 00:37:01,440
I want to know
when the plan changed

779
00:37:01,480 --> 00:37:02,800
and why you never had

780
00:37:02,840 --> 00:37:04,720
that courageous conversation
with me.

781
00:37:06,600 --> 00:37:10,560
Um, I feel like I kept
coming up and being like,

782
00:37:10,600 --> 00:37:12,840
"Nate how about final three?"

783
00:37:12,880 --> 00:37:15,480
But I guess I just didn't get
that commitment back.

784
00:37:16,680 --> 00:37:18,360
Yeah, but I tried.

785
00:37:21,920 --> 00:37:23,480
Okay. Thanks.

786
00:37:26,360 --> 00:37:28,360
Shannon, your turn.

787
00:37:31,680 --> 00:37:33,320
All righty.

788
00:37:33,360 --> 00:37:36,520
Barb, I don't have
a question for you tonight

789

because, to be honest,

790
00:37:39,320 --> 00:37:41,720

791
00:37:41,760 --> 00:37:43,480

792
00:37:46,320 --> 00:37:49,640
Avi, do you honestly believe

793
00:37:49,680 --> 00:37:53,040

794
00:37:53,080 --> 00:37:55,480

795

I have been kind of painted

796
00:38:00,520 --> 00:38:03,320

of just being the nice guy.

797
00:38:03,360 --> 00:38:04,960
But I worked so hard
to get here,

798
00:38:05,000 --> 00:38:07,480
and it definitely
wasn't just by being nice.

799
00:38:07,520 --> 00:38:09,680
I had to save myself
a number of times,

800
00:38:09,720 --> 00:38:12,240
you know, as Mogoton
was getting chipped away at,

801
00:38:12,280 --> 00:38:15,440
when Sala was voted out
and my entire game plan

802
00:38:15,480 --> 00:38:17,040
got smashed to the ground.

803
00:38:17,080 --> 00:38:18,840
I've worked really hard,
and I've had to play

804
00:38:18,880 --> 00:38:21,360
every single aspect
of this game to stay in it.

805
00:38:21,920 --> 00:38:23,360
Thanks Avi.

806
00:38:23,400 --> 00:38:26,240
And Tom, there have been
so many times

807
00:38:26,280 --> 00:38:28,800
where you were this close
to being voted out

808
00:38:28,840 --> 00:38:32,120

that you stayed in the game,

809
00:38:32,160 --> 00:38:34,640
I heard, was because Avi
has saved you.

810
00:38:36,800 --> 00:38:38,760
Do you think that you
would still be sitting there

811
00:38:38,800 --> 00:38:40,440
if it wasn't for Avi?

812
00:38:42,000 --> 00:38:45,120
Any alliance has
a two-way combo that you need

813
00:38:45,160 --> 00:38:46,720
as the need is wanted back.

814
00:38:46,760 --> 00:38:49,640
So if you're thinking
about it as I needed him,

815
00:38:49,680 --> 00:38:51,080
you've also got to turn it back

816
00:38:51,120 --> 00:38:53,360
and say how did Avi need me?

817
00:38:55,080 --> 00:38:56,520
Cool. Thank you.

818
00:38:58,880 --> 00:39:00,360
Thanks Shannon.

819
00:39:00,400 --> 00:39:02,360
Sala, you're up.

820
00:39:10,080 --> 00:39:12,920
Big ups, 39 days, final three.

821
00:39:12,960 --> 00:39:15,760
Mad props and respect,
uh, from me to you,

822
00:39:15,800 --> 00:39:17,160
so congratulations.

823
00:39:18,000 --> 00:39:21,040
Tom, I can honestly say my bro

824
00:39:21,080 --> 00:39:24,840
that your students,
your mum, your dad,

825
00:39:24,880 --> 00:39:26,760
your closest friends and family

826
00:39:26,800 --> 00:39:28,320
will be bloody proud
of you, bro,

827
00:39:28,360 --> 00:39:30,240
and how you've played the game.

828
00:39:30,280 --> 00:39:31,720
So well done.

829
00:39:33,880 --> 00:39:37,760
Avi, it's bloody great
to see that nice guys

830
00:39:37,800 --> 00:39:39,880

831
00:39:46,640 --> 00:39:49,800
Barbara, AKA Mumma B.

832
00:39:51,400 --> 00:39:55,280
Respect is reciprocated,
uh, when it's given.

833
00:39:56,800 --> 00:39:59,640
My observation of you, Barbara,

834

the opposite of respectful.

835

What I saw was disrespect.

836
00:40:10,560 --> 00:40:11,960
We had a shelter,

837
00:40:12,000 --> 00:40:14,240

was occupied by you.

838
00:40:14,280 --> 00:40:16,080
You did very little

839
00:40:16,120 --> 00:40:17,560
in camp life,

840
00:40:17,600 --> 00:40:19,840
camp environment, camp culture

841
00:40:19,880 --> 00:40:22,000
in my opinion, just observation.

842
00:40:22,040 --> 00:40:25,080
You complained a lot about,

843
00:40:25,120 --> 00:40:26,840
oh, everything and everyone.

844
00:40:29,040 --> 00:40:31,880
What really hurt me,
uh, Momma B was

845
00:40:31,920 --> 00:40:33,360
on the respect

846
00:40:33,400 --> 00:40:34,920

respected you.

847
00:40:37,280 --> 00:40:40,720
So my last Korero
to you Momma B is,

848
00:40:40,760 --> 00:40:41,960
"All the best."

849
00:40:45,160 --> 00:40:46,440
Lee.

850
00:40:46,480 --> 00:40:47,520
One more. One more.

851
00:40:47,560 --> 00:40:48,960
One more roasting.

852
00:40:52,520 --> 00:40:53,600
Hey guys.

853
00:40:54,440 --> 00:40:55,840
You know there's so many ways

854
00:40:55,880 --> 00:40:57,440
this game could have been
played out,

855
00:40:57,480 --> 00:40:59,880
and for me
I'd like to really entertain

856
00:40:59,920 --> 00:41:02,280
that a major contributor to,

857
00:41:02,320 --> 00:41:05,600
like, what's gotten you here
is luck, possibly.

858
00:41:08,480 --> 00:41:11,440
What I want to know,
just a simple yes-no answer,

859
00:41:11,480 --> 00:41:14,720
is, "if you had no good luck
laid upon you,

860
00:41:14,760 --> 00:41:17,280

sitting there right now?"

861
00:41:19,080 --> 00:41:20,520
Tom?

862
00:41:22,720 --> 00:41:23,760
Yes.

863
00:41:24,640 --> 00:41:26,560
Avi?

864
00:41:26,600 --> 00:41:27,800
Yes.

865
00:41:28,760 --> 00:41:30,080
Barb?

866
00:41:33,480 --> 00:41:34,480
No.

867
00:41:37,320 --> 00:41:40,160
Cool. Cheers 2.

868
00:41:42,480 --> 00:41:43,640
Good one to end on.

869
00:41:45,640 --> 00:41:47,680
All right guys,
you've had your opportunity

870
00:41:47,720 --> 00:41:49,560

871
00:41:49,600 --> 00:41:52,160

872
00:41:52,200 --> 00:41:54,600
It is now time to vote.

873
00:41:54,640 --> 00:41:56,960
Remember, tonight

874
00:41:57,000 --> 00:42:01,360

Survivor New Zealand.

875
00:42:01,400 --> 00:42:03,320
The person you want to see
take away

876
00:42:03,360 --> 00:42:08,080

877
00:42:08,120 --> 00:42:11,040
For the final time,
it is time to vote.

878
00:42:11,080 --> 00:42:13,080

879
00:42:47,960 --> 00:42:49,880
Bro, you're the best mate

880
00:42:49,920 --> 00:42:53,080
You absolutely deserve this

881
00:42:55,120 --> 00:42:58,800
I'm very proud to have journeyed

882
00:42:58,840 --> 00:43:01,520

883
00:43:12,640 --> 00:43:13,920

884
00:43:27,160 --> 00:43:30,360

885
00:43:30,400 --> 00:43:32,480

886
00:43:32,520 --> 00:43:37,160

00:43:37,200 --> 00:43:42,040

888
00:43:49,440 --> 00:43:51,520
See you back in New Zealand

00:43:51,560 --> 00:43:53,080

All right. Thank you everyone.

Good.

895
00:44:56,560 --> 00:44:57,560
Yeah!

896
00:44:57,600 --> 00:45:00,920

Lou, nice to see you back.

00:45:00,960 --> 00:45:02,280

899

00:45:06,240 --> 00:45:07,160
Oh, why thank you. You too!

Ah, Jak nice to see you

00:45:11,960 --> 00:45:13,600
Hey!

905

00:45:17,440 --> 00:45:19,480

908
00:45:20,800 --> 00:45:22,160

909
00:45:22,200 --> 00:45:23,560
Are you modeling yet or not?

910
00:45:23,600 --> 00:45:25,760
No. I need to wax first.
I'm still covered

911
00:45:28,400 --> 00:45:30,080

912
00:45:30,120 --> 00:45:32,640
So, for our first season
of Survivor New Zealand

913
00:45:32,680 --> 00:45:35,040

914
00:45:35,080 --> 00:45:39,320
You guys delivered in spades.

915
00:45:39,360 --> 00:45:42,360
We loved...

916
00:45:47,200 --> 00:45:48,800
We loved following your game,

917
00:45:48,840 --> 00:45:52,240

first season.

00:46:00,040 --> 00:46:03,000
But now, it all comes down

Mate!

00:46:22,840 --> 00:46:24,400
We've spent ages backstage

00:46:24,440 --> 00:46:27,200

And we're like,

00:46:31,360 --> 00:46:34,360
Barb, how excited are you about

00:46:34,400 --> 00:46:37,600

Ah, a little bit of trepidation.

930
00:46:39,760 --> 00:46:42,240
But, um, it's good.

931

932
00:46:44,080 --> 00:46:45,840
Avi, watching back now,

00:46:45,880 --> 00:46:50,840

00:46:50,880 --> 00:46:53,480
Oh, there were
so many elements of it

935
00:46:53,520 --> 00:46:55,800

which were difficult.

936

Um, I think it was just
kind of that, um,

937
00:46:59,400 --> 00:47:01,440

938
00:47:01,480 --> 00:47:03,440

939

you were never really sure

00:47:05,120 --> 00:47:08,800

941
00:47:08,840 --> 00:47:10,576
Um, so just kind of
being on edge the whole time,

942
00:47:10,600 --> 00:47:14,600

thing to spend 39 days doing.

943

well we're about to find out

944
00:47:16,680 --> 00:47:18,760

00:47:18,800 --> 00:47:21,800
After 39 days

00:47:21,840 --> 00:47:24,080

Have you put people

00:47:32,440 --> 00:47:34,480

951
00:47:34,520 --> 00:47:37,400

952
00:47:57,320 --> 00:47:58,680

00:48:01,720 --> 00:48:02,800

954
00:48:02,840 --> 00:48:04,240
First vote...

00:48:07,760 --> 00:48:08,760

00:48:16,120 --> 00:48:17,560
Second vote...

957
00:48:20,560 --> 00:48:21,560
Tom.

958
00:48:27,480 --> 00:48:30,520

959
00:48:30,560 --> 00:48:32,720

960
00:48:32,760 --> 00:48:34,440

961

962
00:48:36,640 --> 00:48:37,880
Third vote...

963

Two votes Avi,

965
00:48:49,560 --> 00:48:50,560

966

967
00:49:02,800 --> 00:49:04,040
Avi.

969
00:49:14,280 --> 00:49:15,480

00:49:23,880 --> 00:49:26,920

973
00:49:26,960 --> 00:49:32,000

974
00:49:41,600 --> 00:49:45,000
Avi, you did it!
You did it!

975
00:49:53,360 --> 00:49:56,120
I'm so proud of you.
I'm so proud of you.

976
00:49:59,320 --> 00:50:00,920
- I love you.
- I love you.

977
00:50:00,960 --> 00:50:02,600
Good job bro.
Well done, brother.

978
00:50:02,640 --> 00:50:04,560
- Avi, you did it!
- Righto guys.

979
00:50:05,600 --> 00:50:07,040
Hang on guys.

980
00:50:09,560 --> 00:50:11,680
- Take your seats please.
- You proved everyone wrong.

981
00:50:11,720 --> 00:50:13,600
Proud of you.

982
00:50:13,640 --> 00:50:15,160
Guys, please take your seats.

983
00:50:15,200 --> 00:50:16,576
Avi, well done.
I'm so happy for you.

984
00:50:16,600 --> 00:50:18,240
I've got to chat to this man.

985
00:50:19,280 --> 00:50:21,000
I've gotta chat to this man.

986
00:50:22,360 --> 00:50:23,920
Give me a hug.

987
00:50:23,960 --> 00:50:25,160
- Thank you.
- I know.

988
00:50:25,200 --> 00:50:27,480
- Thank you.
- I know.

989
00:50:30,040 --> 00:50:31,120
Shot brother.

990
00:50:31,160 --> 00:50:32,960
Are we sitting down here?

991
00:50:33,000 --> 00:50:34,400
Righto guys, let's go.

992
00:50:35,600 --> 00:50:40,040
Avi, how good
are you feeling brother?

993
00:50:40,080 --> 00:50:41,120
Oh

994
00:50:47,640 --> 00:50:49,560
Oh my God. Um...

995
00:50:50,920 --> 00:50:53,640
oh, this is... this is...

996
00:50:53,680 --> 00:50:56,280
this is a dream come true

997
00:50:57,560 --> 00:51:01,880
and, um, yeah, I just...
I'm so grateful.

998
00:51:01,920 --> 00:51:05,960
This is such a bizarre,
incredible experience

999
00:51:06,000 --> 00:51:07,720
and I love you all so much

1000
00:51:07,760 --> 00:51:09,480
and we're all just going to be

1001
00:51:09,520 --> 00:51:11,400
in each other's life forever,
you know.

1002
00:51:11,440 --> 00:51:12,880
This was amazing!

1003
00:51:12,920 --> 00:51:14,880
These guys are amazing!

1004
00:51:14,920 --> 00:51:16,320
Um...

1005
00:51:19,840 --> 00:51:21,480
Avi,

1006
00:51:22,880 --> 00:51:25,000
anyone you want to see
out in that crowd?

1007
00:51:25,040 --> 00:51:26,280
Uh, yeah!

1008
00:51:26,320 --> 00:51:27,680
Get down there brother!

1009
00:51:34,600 --> 00:51:35,960
Cheers cuzzies.

1010
00:51:36,000 --> 00:51:38,160
Cheers guys.

1011
00:51:38,200 --> 00:51:39,520
Cheers guys.

1012
00:51:50,360 --> 00:51:51,640
Mom.

1013
00:51:52,880 --> 00:51:54,080
Sophia's here.

1014
00:51:56,040 --> 00:51:57,680
Oh my God.

1015
00:52:02,200 --> 00:52:04,080
Sophia's here.

1016
00:52:04,120 --> 00:52:05,960
I know.
I just won Survivor.

1017
00:52:06,000 --> 00:52:07,720
Against...

1018
00:52:07,760 --> 00:52:09,296
Excuse me, I'm really
sorry to break you up.

1019
00:52:09,320 --> 00:52:10,360
Oh, that's fine.

1020
00:52:10,400 --> 00:52:11,680
You must be Mom?

1021
00:52:11,720 --> 00:52:13,200
I am Mom, yeah.
Yes, I am Mom.

1022
00:52:13,240 --> 00:52:15,160
How proud are you right now?

1023
00:52:15,200 --> 00:52:17,560
I am so proud of him.
He played with such integrity.

1024
00:52:17,600 --> 00:52:18,840
I was a little bit worried

1025

1026
00:52:20,000 --> 00:52:22,040

1027

Tell me, has...

1028
00:52:25,280 --> 00:52:28,440

1029
