- Oh yeah, obviously!

1030
00:52:30,440 --> 00:52:32,360
He just...
He was just who he was.

1031
00:52:32,400 --> 00:52:33,960
He was a hundred percent Avi.

1032
00:52:34,000 --> 00:52:35,200
- That's him?
- Yup!

1033
00:52:35,240 --> 00:52:36,440
Remarkable.

1034
00:52:36,480 --> 00:52:37,880
We saw that from
day one actually.

1035
00:52:37,920 --> 00:52:38,920
Yup, yup, yup.

1036
00:52:38,960 --> 00:52:39,840
Well, you should be very proud.

1037
00:52:39,880 --> 00:52:40,880
I am so proud!

1038
00:52:40,920 --> 00:52:42,400
Enjoy, enjoy, enjoy.

1039
00:52:42,440 --> 00:52:43,440
How are you feeling?

1040
00:52:46,960 --> 00:52:48,360
All right.

1041
00:52:48,400 --> 00:52:51,480
After the break,
she woke from her slumber

1042
00:52:51,520 --> 00:52:53,880
to take a serious shot
at the title,

1043
00:52:53,920 --> 00:52:55,640
we're talking to Barbs
then later,

1044
00:52:55,680 --> 00:52:57,640
the GEM People's Choice Award.

1045
00:52:57,680 --> 00:52:59,240
You don't want to miss it!

1046
00:53:03,160 --> 00:53:04,640
Thank you.

1047
00:53:05,760 --> 00:53:07,560
Smile! Smile!

1048
00:53:07,600 --> 00:53:09,000
Smile! Come on.

1049
00:53:09,040 --> 00:53:12,280
The winner
of Survivor New Zealand

1050
00:53:12,320 --> 00:53:16,960
and the $100,000 is Avi!

1051
00:53:27,880 --> 00:53:29,400
Welcome back

1052
00:53:29,440 --> 00:53:32,400
to the Survivor New Zealand
Live Final,

1053
00:53:32,440 --> 00:53:37,000
where Avi has just won $100,000.

1054
00:53:39,120 --> 00:53:40,840
Avi, again, congratulations.

1055
00:53:40,880 --> 00:53:42,840
Has it sunk in yet?

1056
00:53:42,880 --> 00:53:44,360
Um, no, no.

1057
00:53:44,400 --> 00:53:46,120
This is some weird dreamscape

1058
00:53:46,160 --> 00:53:48,320
that I'm just going to snap
out of at some stage.

1059
00:53:48,360 --> 00:53:51,240
Okay, well, we're going
to talk more to you later.

1060
00:53:51,280 --> 00:53:53,320
Now let's get back
to our final three

1061
00:53:53,360 --> 00:53:55,120
and one of the more
interesting aspects

1062
00:53:55,160 --> 00:53:56,720
of the season.

1063
00:53:56,760 --> 00:53:59,840
Sitting here is the best
physical player in Tom,

1064
00:53:59,880 --> 00:54:03,680
the best strategic player
in Barb

1065
00:54:03,720 --> 00:54:07,560
and the best social player
in Avi.

1066
00:54:07,600 --> 00:54:09,880
Take a look at this clip.

1067
00:54:13,320 --> 00:54:16,280
I think I can win
because I'm very perceptive

1068
00:54:16,320 --> 00:54:18,440
and I think socially I can
pick up on a lot of things.

1069
00:54:20,480 --> 00:54:22,920
I think I have
a little mantra in my head

1070
00:54:22,960 --> 00:54:26,960
and that will be, "Need must
as the devil drives".

1071
00:54:27,000 --> 00:54:29,720
Everyone, you know,
they have their principles

1072
00:54:29,760 --> 00:54:32,640
but sometimes circumstances
make you go against those.

1073
00:54:32,680 --> 00:54:35,720
So, that is what may happen.

1074
00:54:38,120 --> 00:54:40,080
Yeah, I think I can win Survivor.

1075
00:54:40,120 --> 00:54:41,840
I feel like I am an all-rounder

1076
00:54:41,880 --> 00:54:45,480
in terms of physical
and mental and being composed.

1077
00:54:47,080 --> 00:54:48,440
Welcome to Nikoragua.

1078
00:54:49,840 --> 00:54:51,960
What did you think
of Barbs idea?

1079
00:54:52,000 --> 00:54:53,520
- It's big.
- It's like a chess set

1080
00:54:53,560 --> 00:54:55,080
and I can just see

1081
00:54:55,120 --> 00:54:57,400
which way to move somebody
or say something.

1082
00:54:57,440 --> 00:54:59,040
I think she put up
a hit on my head.

1083
00:54:59,080 --> 00:55:00,840
Definitely behind
the hit on my head.

1084
00:55:00,880 --> 00:55:02,760
Queen me, darling.
Queen me!

1085
00:55:04,840 --> 00:55:06,560
The biggest threat is Avi.

1086
00:55:06,600 --> 00:55:08,920
He is one of the most liked
people in the game.

1087
00:55:08,960 --> 00:55:10,760
I feel good about
the relationships

1088
00:55:10,800 --> 00:55:12,520
that I've made with the jury.

1089
00:55:12,560 --> 00:55:14,880
I feel really close to
every single person up there.

1090
00:55:17,080 --> 00:55:19,280
Tom has won, again!

1091
00:55:19,320 --> 00:55:21,320
Tom wins immunity.

1092
00:55:21,360 --> 00:55:23,760
It is concerning for me
the more immunity's he wins.

1093
00:55:23,800 --> 00:55:26,480
His argument at the end
will be stronger.

1094
00:55:26,520 --> 00:55:28,520
Tom, you are unbeatable

1095
00:55:28,560 --> 00:55:31,600
and I'm sure for the others
that is unbearable.

1096
00:55:40,160 --> 00:55:41,680
Okay.

1097
00:55:41,720 --> 00:55:43,880
Avi, it was always
going to be interesting

1098
00:55:43,920 --> 00:55:46,560
watching Kiwis
and see how they played

1099
00:55:46,600 --> 00:55:48,400
and responded to the game.

1100
00:55:48,440 --> 00:55:51,760
The three of you had
different strengths

1101
00:55:51,800 --> 00:55:53,320
but essentially Avi you needed

1102
00:55:53,360 --> 00:55:55,400
all three game plays to win, eh?

1103
00:55:55,440 --> 00:55:57,640
Yeah, I was a bit nervous,

1104
00:55:57,680 --> 00:56:00,960
um, during the end
when I realized that,

1105
00:56:01,000 --> 00:56:03,840
you know,
I was the nice guy, you know?

1106
00:56:03,880 --> 00:56:06,200
I was like...
I feel like I have played

1107
00:56:06,240 --> 00:56:08,320
in all areas of the game
you know.

1108
00:56:08,360 --> 00:56:11,360
I was very, um,
present throughout

1109
00:56:11,400 --> 00:56:15,880
and, um, kind of, you know,
I really put it all out there.

1110
00:56:15,920 --> 00:56:18,640
But yeah, I think
you do need all facets,

1111
00:56:18,680 --> 00:56:20,760
um, to win I guess.

1112
00:56:20,800 --> 00:56:22,200
I think you're right.

1113
00:56:22,240 --> 00:56:24,640
Okay, well of the three
game plays,

1114
00:56:24,680 --> 00:56:28,120
the hardest for Kiwis
to stomach was strategy.

1115
00:56:28,160 --> 00:56:31,880
Barb went from dead man
walking to mafia queen.

1116
00:56:31,920 --> 00:56:33,160
Take a look.

1117
00:56:35,040 --> 00:56:37,560
Our tribe is divided.

1118
00:56:37,600 --> 00:56:39,080
We know that us five are solid.

1119
00:56:39,120 --> 00:56:41,400
We need to throw
the next immunity challenge.

1120
00:56:41,440 --> 00:56:43,480
That could come back
and bite us in the butt.

1121
00:56:43,520 --> 00:56:46,720
I was dead man walking
waiting for the axe to fall.

1122
00:56:46,760 --> 00:56:48,400
We're redrawing for new tribes.

1123
00:56:49,360 --> 00:56:50,600
The tide has turned.

1124
00:56:50,640 --> 00:56:51,960
Feeling like, oh, I think

1125
00:56:52,000 --> 00:56:54,600
I'm starting Survivor tomorrow.

1126
00:56:54,640 --> 00:56:57,000
What a great position
to be in though, eh?

1127
00:56:57,040 --> 00:56:58,800
As you sow, you shall reap.

1128
00:56:59,800 --> 00:57:00,960
Lee.

1129
00:57:01,000 --> 00:57:03,120
Michael. The tribe has spoken.

1130
00:57:04,120 --> 00:57:05,800
That was a double bonanza.

1131
00:57:05,840 --> 00:57:09,400
I now can start using
my powers of perception

1132
00:57:09,440 --> 00:57:13,000
to break up the Shay, Avi
and Sala threesome.

1133
00:57:13,040 --> 00:57:14,400
Way.

1134
00:57:14,440 --> 00:57:15,960
At one point,
she was the old Labrador

1135
00:57:16,000 --> 00:57:17,800
sitting on the porch
but now she's a little

1136
00:57:17,840 --> 00:57:19,960
pippy fox terrier
running around the front yard.

1137
00:57:20,000 --> 00:57:21,120
Sala.

1138
00:57:22,400 --> 00:57:24,000
You are underestimated.

1139
00:57:24,040 --> 00:57:27,680
I know everyone
has underestimated me.

1140
00:57:27,720 --> 00:57:30,080
Barbs is a definite
concern for me.

1141
00:57:30,120 --> 00:57:32,600
She started off zero threat.

1142
00:57:32,640 --> 00:57:34,400
Jak, the tribe has spoken.

1143
00:57:37,520 --> 00:57:38,640
Shannon.

1144
00:57:38,680 --> 00:57:39,720
Shay.

1145
00:57:39,760 --> 00:57:42,040
I'm like a lioness
looking at my prey.

1146
00:57:42,080 --> 00:57:43,760
If she goes with the two guys

1147
00:57:43,800 --> 00:57:45,800
that have been carrying her,
she'll get zero votes.

1148
00:57:45,840 --> 00:57:47,520
For somebody
that's being carried,

1149
00:57:47,560 --> 00:57:49,880
I seem to be a linch pin
a hell of a lot in this game.

1150
00:57:49,920 --> 00:57:51,440
Mike.

1151
00:57:51,480 --> 00:57:53,840
You need to bring me your torch.

1152
00:57:53,880 --> 00:57:55,600
Yeah, I think
I'm quite inspirational

1153
00:57:55,640 --> 00:57:57,120
for a lot of people.

1154
00:57:57,160 --> 00:57:59,416
Especially being totally kind
of isolated at the beginning.

1155
00:57:59,440 --> 00:58:00,880
So yeah, I'd be routing for me.

1156
00:58:00,920 --> 00:58:02,280
I deserve it.

1157
00:58:11,760 --> 00:58:15,400
Barb, brutal but beautiful.

1158
00:58:17,040 --> 00:58:18,560
Hermosa!

1159
00:58:18,600 --> 00:58:21,160
I want to talk to you
about that final tribal,

1160
00:58:21,200 --> 00:58:22,720
have you recovered?

1161
00:58:22,760 --> 00:58:25,640
Uh, to be honest,
I didn't watch it just then.

1162
00:58:25,680 --> 00:58:27,480
I thought once was enough
over there.

1163
00:58:27,520 --> 00:58:29,960
So, no need to see it again.

1164
00:58:30,000 --> 00:58:32,400
The six-pack mauling
that I received.

1165
00:58:32,440 --> 00:58:34,840
I would say they're really lucky

1166
00:58:34,880 --> 00:58:37,640
that it was edited
and condensed down

1167
00:58:37,680 --> 00:58:40,320
because it was far more brutal
than that

1168
00:58:40,360 --> 00:58:42,640
and far more was said.

1169
00:58:42,680 --> 00:58:48,480
Uh, and my decision
for going to final three,

1170
00:58:48,520 --> 00:58:50,000
I have to be honest,

1171
00:58:50,040 --> 00:58:52,000
I never considered
any of their votes.

1172
00:58:52,040 --> 00:58:53,960
They were irrelevant to me.

1173
00:58:54,000 --> 00:58:55,840
My strategy...
They were just pawns so...

1174
00:58:55,880 --> 00:58:58,360
- You did it for you!
- Yup. Basically.

1175
00:59:05,440 --> 00:59:11,240
Avi, in many ways Barb enabled
you and Tom to get to the end.

1176
00:59:11,280 --> 00:59:15,040
Are you comfortable
with the beating she took

1177
00:59:15,080 --> 00:59:16,440
as you guys sat by?

1178
00:59:16,480 --> 00:59:18,120
No, of course not.

1179
00:59:18,160 --> 00:59:22,600
It was... It was really rough
on that final tribal

1180
00:59:22,640 --> 00:59:26,120
and, you know, part of me does
beat myself up a little bit.

1181
00:59:26,160 --> 00:59:29,240
Um, I wish I could of
or would have said something.

1182
00:59:29,280 --> 00:59:32,400
Avi, why didn't you jump in?

1183
00:59:32,440 --> 00:59:34,960
I think we were kind of,
um, maneuvering

1184
00:59:35,000 --> 00:59:37,560
in that weird space
of self-preservation

1185
00:59:37,600 --> 00:59:40,000
and we're all terrified
to even be there, you know,

1186
00:59:40,040 --> 00:59:44,240
we're like, "I hope everyone
likes me", you know, like...

1187
00:59:44,280 --> 00:59:48,040
So, you know I was hearing
what was being said

1188
00:59:48,080 --> 00:59:50,080
and it was harsh. It was.

1189
00:59:50,120 --> 00:59:53,600
Um, but I think that kind of
self-preservation kicked in

1190
00:59:53,640 --> 00:59:56,440
and I do... I do regret
not kind of saying something

1191
00:59:56,480 --> 00:59:59,400
but also at the time
it seemed impossible.

1192
00:59:59,440 --> 01:00:03,720
Tom, do you think the jury
was fair to Barb?

1193
01:00:04,520 --> 01:00:06,160
I think that there was, uh...

1194
01:00:06,200 --> 01:00:09,320
There was a mixture
of fair and unfair comments

1195
01:00:09,360 --> 01:00:11,480
and, um, I think
the unfair comments

1196
01:00:11,520 --> 01:00:12,696
actually didn't get much light.

1197
01:00:12,720 --> 01:00:14,160
Um, no light.

1198
01:00:14,200 --> 01:00:15,960
I think the stuff
that came across

1199
01:00:16,000 --> 01:00:19,560
as people were treated,
like Jak said

1200
01:00:19,600 --> 01:00:21,320
that maybe the way
he was treated, you know.

1201
01:00:21,360 --> 01:00:24,320
I did actually... You know,
I saw cases like that.

1202
01:00:24,360 --> 01:00:27,240
Um, you know
but there were other cases

1203
01:00:27,280 --> 01:00:28,600
where it was personal,

1204
01:00:28,640 --> 01:00:30,680
it wasn't so much about
the game that she'd played.

1205
01:00:30,720 --> 01:00:33,560
It was really...
It was a dig at maybe,

1206
01:00:33,600 --> 01:00:35,560
you know, her personality
and who she was.

1207
01:00:35,600 --> 01:00:37,920
Do you want to shed
some more light on that?

1208
01:00:37,960 --> 01:00:40,080
- Yeah, okay, well...
- Let's do it.

1209
01:00:41,800 --> 01:00:43,680
- Now that we're here.
- Now that we're here.

1210
01:00:44,720 --> 01:00:46,360
Like... And...

1211
01:00:46,400 --> 01:00:47,456
I don't want it to be, you know,

1212
01:00:47,480 --> 01:00:49,200
I don't want this to be,

1213
01:00:49,240 --> 01:00:51,760
you know, me calling out
people in any bitter ways

1214
01:00:51,800 --> 01:00:55,480
it's like, we all just lost
to the guy

1215
01:00:55,520 --> 01:00:57,880
that was just as deserving
to anyone else here.

1216
01:00:57,920 --> 01:00:59,720
Yeah.

1217
01:00:59,760 --> 01:01:01,520
Um, but, you know
there was comments, like,

1218
01:01:01,560 --> 01:01:04,360
Sala you referred to Barb

1219
01:01:04,400 --> 01:01:06,560
as a... as a turd in the toilet
that wouldn't flush.

1220
01:01:07,720 --> 01:01:09,120
You know, and that's...

1221
01:01:09,160 --> 01:01:11,040
Some people take that
as really harsh.

1222
01:01:11,080 --> 01:01:14,680
There were other comments
like Shannon you said like...

1223
01:01:14,720 --> 01:01:17,000
- Go back to my knitting!
- Yeah.

1224
01:01:17,040 --> 01:01:19,240
- Shame on you!
- Sala.

1225
01:01:19,280 --> 01:01:22,000
Sala, you did say that.

1226
01:01:22,040 --> 01:01:26,280
What was shown was just
a snippet of what you said.

1227
01:01:26,320 --> 01:01:29,640
You've later said that you
respected Barb and her game.

1228
01:01:29,680 --> 01:01:31,520
Do you think
that you respected her

1229
01:01:31,560 --> 01:01:33,280
in that final tribal?

1230
01:01:33,320 --> 01:01:34,560
Um...

1231
01:01:35,920 --> 01:01:38,520
I still respect Barb.

1232
01:01:38,560 --> 01:01:41,360
Did you in that final tribal?

1233
01:01:41,400 --> 01:01:43,880
I think I needed to share

1234
01:01:43,920 --> 01:01:46,640
what was going on for me
at that time.

1235
01:01:46,680 --> 01:01:48,680
Um, at the end of the day,

1236
01:01:48,720 --> 01:01:51,640
people can choose
how to interpret what we say.

1237
01:01:51,680 --> 01:01:55,480
I mean, yup, I did say that,
um, she was a,

1238
01:01:55,520 --> 01:01:59,200
you know a turd that was
floating in the toilets

1239
01:01:59,240 --> 01:02:01,000
refused to be flushed

1240
01:02:01,040 --> 01:02:02,760
but at the end of the day,

1241
01:02:02,800 --> 01:02:04,960
you know, we all got flushed
and she was still there

1242
01:02:05,000 --> 01:02:08,240
and so...
In some kind of whacky way...

1243
01:02:08,280 --> 01:02:11,360
It was a...

1244
01:02:11,400 --> 01:02:13,320
It was a sign of respect say
that she...

1245
01:02:13,360 --> 01:02:15,440
These guys were still there
and I was flushed bro.

1246
01:02:15,480 --> 01:02:17,680
I was down the drain. Gone.

1247
01:02:17,720 --> 01:02:18,960
Somewhere over there.

1248
01:02:19,000 --> 01:02:20,000
Would you say that again,

1249
01:02:20,040 --> 01:02:21,120
given another chance?

1250
01:02:21,160 --> 01:02:25,880
I think... You know, you...

1251
01:02:25,920 --> 01:02:28,160
We were all under pressure,

1252
01:02:28,200 --> 01:02:30,480
um...

1253
01:02:30,520 --> 01:02:34,080
and watching it again,

1254
01:02:34,120 --> 01:02:35,840
Barb played an amazing game.

1255
01:02:35,880 --> 01:02:39,560
She was bloody good...

1256
01:02:39,600 --> 01:02:42,840
and you know, so...
I am pretty gutted,

1257
01:02:42,880 --> 01:02:45,760
because she pulled up Mike
for being arrogant

1258
01:02:45,800 --> 01:02:48,160
with his korero to her

1259
01:02:48,200 --> 01:02:49,920
and yeah, respectively so,

1260
01:02:49,960 --> 01:02:52,320
and then she goes
and does that same to us

1261
01:02:52,360 --> 01:02:53,400
with her pitch.

1262
01:02:53,440 --> 01:02:54,816
So, I was kind of confused
at the end,

1263
01:02:54,840 --> 01:02:57,840
that's when I ended up
wanting to share,

1264
01:02:57,880 --> 01:02:59,720
actually no this is...

1265
01:02:59,760 --> 01:03:02,240
So, you think some of it
was deserving?

1266
01:03:02,280 --> 01:03:05,080
Um, at that time, yup.

1267
01:03:05,120 --> 01:03:06,160
- Yup.
- Shannon...

1268
01:03:08,760 --> 01:03:11,840
Shannon,
Tom also referred to you.

1269
01:03:11,880 --> 01:03:14,800
What do you make of what
you said in that final tribal?

1270
01:03:14,840 --> 01:03:16,960
I mean, I'm kind of the same
as Sala.

1271
01:03:17,000 --> 01:03:18,480
After watching the show,

1272
01:03:18,520 --> 01:03:20,680
I think she played a better game

1273
01:03:20,720 --> 01:03:22,360
than I gave her credit for
at the time.

1274
01:03:22,400 --> 01:03:24,680
But at the same time,
she clearly was lacking

1275
01:03:24,720 --> 01:03:26,680
the social game,
like I was as well,

1276
01:03:26,720 --> 01:03:29,200
which is why, you know,
I ended up here.

1277
01:03:29,240 --> 01:03:32,600
But, the fact that six of us
had the same opinion,

1278
01:03:32,640 --> 01:03:35,280
I mean, that is
a big aspect of Survivor,

1279
01:03:35,320 --> 01:03:36,840
which she was lacking in.

1280
01:03:36,880 --> 01:03:39,000
So, I mean,
we were just speaking honestly

1281
01:03:39,040 --> 01:03:40,320
at that point.

1282
01:03:40,360 --> 01:03:42,480
- From what we had experience.
- Fair comment.

1283
01:03:42,520 --> 01:03:45,440
All right, after the break,
Tom's game is next.

1284
01:03:45,480 --> 01:03:47,680
You don't want to miss it.

1285
01:04:00,880 --> 01:04:03,040
You're back live
at Auckland's Civic

1286
01:04:03,080 --> 01:04:05,760
for the Survivor New Zealand
final.

1287
01:04:05,800 --> 01:04:07,880
Now, he was mentally
and physically

1288
01:04:07,920 --> 01:04:10,320
the strongest player
in the game.

1289
01:04:10,360 --> 01:04:13,480
In challenges,
he was unstoppable.

1290

Lee.

Be yourself, back yourself.

If you have a goal that you

- feels right...

I'd hoped that someone could truly

and that there's three of us left.

41
00:03:20,030 --> 00:03:23,970
It just feels incredible to know
that we are this close

42
00:03:24,070 --> 00:03:25,570
to the finish line.

43
00:03:28,870 --> 00:03:30,570
To get there to the end...

44
00:03:31,710 --> 00:03:34,290
..I just need to win
the final Immunity Challenge.

45
00:03:36,810 --> 00:03:38,210
It's gonna be one helluva fight.

46
00:03:45,270 --> 00:03:47,650
To see all the torches

47
00:03:47,790 --> 00:03:52,130
that represented all the people that
have gone through this whole game,

48
00:03:52,230 --> 00:03:53,890
is so surreal.

49
00:03:56,950 --> 00:04:00,970
It makes me feel like I do deserve
to be in the final three.

50
00:04:03,670 --> 00:04:08,090
And those other players tried
but I've outlasted them.

51
00:04:10,910 --> 00:04:13,010
Joan! It's been a long time.

52
00:04:13,110 --> 00:04:14,410
I didn't meet Joan.

53
00:04:14,550 --> 00:04:15,850
- Me either.
- I did.

54
00:04:15,990 --> 00:04:19,650
She was the first person that would
put her hand up for the puzzle.

55
00:04:19,790 --> 00:04:23,130
I think she knew that it could make
her a hero or send her packing.

56
00:04:23,270 --> 00:04:27,130
Adam. I feel like he gave
away his cards a little too early.

57
00:04:27,230 --> 00:04:28,570
I want to find the idol.

58
00:04:28,710 --> 00:04:31,010
You can come and have a look for it,
if you want to play with me.

59
00:04:31,150 --> 00:04:35,550
TARA: Oh, Kate.
This player, good at challenges.

60
00:04:35,670 --> 00:04:37,210
- Yay!
- Good job, Kate!

61
00:04:37,350 --> 00:04:40,650
- Mr. Character himself.
- The soul of the tribe.

62
00:04:40,750 --> 00:04:42,130
Tarzan.

63
00:04:44,230 --> 00:04:45,570
TARZAN: But I happen to be in a game

64
00:04:45,710 --> 00:04:47,410
where you're supposed to draw alliances.

65
00:04:47,550 --> 00:04:51,130
Well, maybe being a friend to
somebody might make a stronger one.

66
00:04:51,270 --> 00:04:55,370
Being true to myself,
for me, was everything.

67
00:04:55,470 --> 00:04:57,290
God, I love this game!

68
00:04:57,390 --> 00:04:59,530
Oh, my favourite!

69
00:04:59,670 --> 00:05:01,210
- Aimee!
- Aimee.

70
00:05:01,350 --> 00:05:04,890
She looked like a hairdresser
and, in fact, she was a plumber.

71
00:05:04,990 --> 00:05:06,130
Spewin'!

72
00:05:06,270 --> 00:05:10,490
Sam was a pocket rocket
in our challenges.

73
00:05:10,590 --> 00:05:13,410
Her downfall, though, was Mark.

74
00:05:13,510 --> 00:05:16,930
MARK: Sam and I, we're a close pair.

75
00:05:17,070 --> 00:05:19,970
If I met her on the outside,
I'd definitely be keen on her.

76
00:05:20,110 --> 00:05:25,770
They were just like a power pair and
so we had to send Mark and Sam home.

77
00:05:29,110 --> 00:05:31,090
- Jacqui!
- Oh, Jacqui.

78
00:05:31,230 --> 00:05:33,050
JACQUI: It's like a game
of Monopoly, you know?

79
00:05:33,190 --> 00:05:34,490
You can be playing
with your best friend,

80
00:05:34,630 --> 00:05:36,890
and as soon as you hit Mayfair,
you just buy it

81
00:05:37,030 --> 00:05:39,050
and then you put hotels on it
and wipe her out.

82
00:05:40,210 --> 00:05:43,190
- Kent.
- My strategy is find the dickhead.

83
00:05:43,310 --> 00:05:45,730
If you look around
and you can't find the dickhead,

84
00:05:45,830 --> 00:05:48,370
it's you and you're in real trouble.

85
00:05:48,470 --> 00:05:52,610
Oh, here's one - AK.

86
00:05:52,750 --> 00:05:56,690
I will say that he played a great
game. But look where it got him.

87
00:05:56,830 --> 00:05:59,210
It's a chicken idol. Look at it -
it's in the shape of a chicken.

88
00:05:59,350 --> 00:06:02,010
I was completely on the outs
from the start of this.

89
00:06:02,150 --> 00:06:05,050
I turned it round. I gained trust.
But that swap cost me.

90
00:06:05,190 --> 00:06:07,490
- Oh, we got AK!
- Yeah!

91
00:06:07,630 --> 00:06:11,570
I just want to be remembered
as the player that played big.

92
00:06:11,710 --> 00:06:14,190
JERICHO: Ben 10. He was
the youngest contestant.

93
00:06:14,270 --> 00:06:15,190
Wow.

94
00:06:15,310 --> 00:06:19,410
Odette. She'd say what she wanted
to say and she would move on.

95
00:06:20,750 --> 00:06:23,470
- Our first jury member.
- Jarrad!

96
00:06:23,550 --> 00:06:25,730
Oh, an incredibly guy.

97
00:06:25,870 --> 00:06:29,190
One of my closest allies in this game.

98
00:06:29,310 --> 00:06:31,730
JARRAD: Up until the merge,
I was in control.

99
00:06:31,870 --> 00:06:34,930
Come the merge,
that control has slipped away.

100
00:06:35,070 --> 00:06:36,830
PETER: I actually
really liked Anneliese.

101
00:06:36,910 --> 00:06:38,370
Higher! Higher!

102
00:06:38,470 --> 00:06:40,050
We went to Exile together,

103
00:06:40,190 --> 00:06:44,770
so we shared this moment that no-one
else in the game can experience.

104
00:06:44,870 --> 00:06:46,730
Master Hen Zen.

105
00:06:46,830 --> 00:06:48,190
Henry!

106
00:06:49,270 --> 00:06:52,570
- JONATHAN: Henry takes it for Asaga!
- (ALL CHEER)

107
00:06:52,670 --> 00:06:54,290
He had the charisma, the charm.

108
00:06:54,390 --> 00:06:55,370
Whoo!

109
00:06:55,470 --> 00:06:57,250
People fell under Henry's spell.

110
00:06:57,390 --> 00:07:00,050
HENRY: First thing I said was
a lie - I'm a yoga instructor.

111
00:07:00,150 --> 00:07:01,050
Namaste.

112
00:07:01,190 --> 00:07:05,130
I was throwing challenges,
I was building multiple alliances.

113
00:07:05,230 --> 00:07:06,610
I want to be remembered as the guy

114
00:07:06,750 --> 00:07:09,130
that absolutely played the game
from day one.

115
00:07:10,870 --> 00:07:12,250
PETER: Tessa.

116
00:07:12,350 --> 00:07:14,930
She was logical, she was smart.

117
00:07:16,110 --> 00:07:18,570
I felt like I not only lost
a player in the game

118
00:07:18,710 --> 00:07:21,530
but actually like a true friend
when Tess went home.

119
00:07:21,630 --> 00:07:23,770
JERICHO: Whoa, Sarah!

120
00:07:23,910 --> 00:07:29,050
The model that can start a fire
and doesn't mind to get dirty.

121
00:07:29,150 --> 00:07:30,190
Mm!

122
00:07:32,710 --> 00:07:34,330
- Luke.
- Oh, Lukey!

123
00:07:34,430 --> 00:07:35,330
Oh!

124
00:07:35,430 --> 00:07:37,410
Yeah, boy!

125
00:07:37,550 --> 00:07:38,410
- Ra!
- (SQUEALS)

126
00:07:38,550 --> 00:07:40,890
- Oh, (BLEEP). 
- Got ya.

127
00:07:40,990 --> 00:07:41,970
Got ya!

128
00:07:42,110 --> 00:07:44,330
JERICHO: I couldn't have had
another brother in this game

129
00:07:44,430 --> 00:07:45,370
other than Luke.

130
00:07:45,470 --> 00:07:48,010
He was probably my other half.

131
00:07:48,150 --> 00:07:51,210
LUKE: I'm here to stir the pot,
make sure everyone's on their toes.

132
00:07:51,310 --> 00:07:52,210
I'm creeping.

133
00:07:52,350 --> 00:07:54,730
You can't be sitting there, walking
around, thinking you're the boss.

134
00:07:54,830 --> 00:07:56,250
I'm the boss!

135
00:07:56,390 --> 00:07:59,210
PETER: Ziggy.
She was a fierce competitor.

136
00:07:59,310 --> 00:08:01,610
A powerhouse in the challenges.

137
00:08:01,750 --> 00:08:04,610
Ziggy wins first individual immunity.

138
00:08:05,710 --> 00:08:07,290
Oh, my Locky.

139
00:08:08,790 --> 00:08:12,470
I don't know if I could've got
this far, really, without him.

140
00:08:12,610 --> 00:08:16,410
You know, the guy won three
immunity challenges in a row.

141
00:08:16,510 --> 00:08:17,410
Yeah!

142
00:08:17,510 --> 00:08:19,470
Oh, I love you, Locky.

143
00:08:21,630 --> 00:08:23,330
- Mish!
- Michelle.

144
00:08:23,470 --> 00:08:27,110
On the barge she had this beautiful
dress on and she was freezing

145
00:08:27,250 --> 00:08:29,370
and we were all thinking,
"She won't last long."

146
00:08:29,510 --> 00:08:32,570
JONATHAN: Michelle takes
individual immunity!

147
00:08:32,710 --> 00:08:35,490
JERICHO: She wanted to come out of
this game with fireworks

148
00:08:35,590 --> 00:08:37,330
and she did.

149
00:08:48,010 --> 00:08:49,410
TARA: For a minute there, I thought,

150
00:08:49,550 --> 00:08:51,410
"My name isn't on any of these torches

151
00:08:51,550 --> 00:08:53,770
"and that's because
I'm still here."

152
00:08:53,910 --> 00:08:56,490
And it made me feel
a little bit more confident

153
00:08:56,630 --> 00:08:58,850
to lead into that
final Immunity Challenge.

154
00:08:58,950 --> 00:09:00,490
Oh, my gosh.

155
00:09:04,370 --> 00:09:05,490
It's epic.

156
00:09:07,770 --> 00:09:11,650
Even though I haven't won
a single challenge,

157
00:09:11,790 --> 00:09:15,850
I feel this one is, more than ever,
the important one.

158
00:09:15,950 --> 00:09:17,490
This is the finale.

159
00:09:17,630 --> 00:09:19,410
This is the one that gives you the power

160
00:09:19,550 --> 00:09:21,410
to choose who you want to take
to the final two.

161
00:09:21,550 --> 00:09:26,890
So this one is like...
the golden buckle in barrel racing.

162
00:09:26,990 --> 00:09:28,690
Come on in, guys.

163
00:09:33,770 --> 00:09:36,610
PETER: Last night, I could see that
the Immunity Necklace

164
00:09:36,710 --> 00:09:38,490
was my lifeline in this game.

165
00:09:38,630 --> 00:09:42,730
And I think it will be my lifeline
again for the next Tribal.

166
00:09:42,870 --> 00:09:45,250
The way I see it is that
this challenge is do or die.

167
00:09:45,390 --> 00:09:49,110
And... I need to do
because I don't want to die.

168
00:09:56,070 --> 00:09:57,290
This is it, guys.

169
00:09:58,710 --> 00:10:01,650
You ready to get to your final
Immunity Challenge?

170
00:10:01,790 --> 00:10:02,970
- Yes!
- Yep.

171
00:10:03,110 --> 00:10:06,330
First things first.
Peter, need to take it back.

172
00:10:07,630 --> 00:10:08,930
Thank you.

173
00:10:11,490 --> 00:10:16,470
For the last time,
immunity is back up for grabs.

174
00:10:17,850 --> 00:10:21,110
OK, today's challenge
may look a little familiar.

175
00:10:22,710 --> 00:10:24,470
That's because we did it
here last year...

176
00:10:26,190 --> 00:10:29,970
..and it turned out to be
the toughest challenge in the game.

177
00:10:31,770 --> 00:10:34,290
This year, it may even be
a little tougher.

178
00:10:35,950 --> 00:10:38,890
Right now it's late afternoon,
but soon that sun's going to set.

179
00:10:41,270 --> 00:10:43,050
And you'll be competing at night.

180
00:10:43,150 --> 00:10:44,050
Oh!

181
00:10:45,710 --> 00:10:48,830
You're gonna get wet and you'll
have no sun to keep you warm.

182
00:10:49,950 --> 00:10:52,850
You'll hear the waves
but you won't see them coming.

183
00:10:54,910 --> 00:10:58,170
This is the challenge where Kristie
made her mark in Survivor.

184
00:10:59,990 --> 00:11:01,570
Now it's time to make yours.

185
00:11:03,270 --> 00:11:05,250
Alright, you know how this works.

186
00:11:05,390 --> 00:11:08,890
You're gonna stand with both feet
on narrow pedestals

187
00:11:08,990 --> 00:11:11,110
with one hand on the idol.

188
00:11:11,250 --> 00:11:15,530
If at any stage you break contact
at any of those three points,

189
00:11:15,670 --> 00:11:19,410
if your free hand touches the idol
or the stand that it's sitting on...

190
00:11:20,510 --> 00:11:22,330
..you're out of the challenge.

191
00:11:23,470 --> 00:11:25,930
Last person left standing wins immunity

192
00:11:26,030 --> 00:11:29,750
and a spot in the final two,

193
00:11:29,890 --> 00:11:34,110
guaranteed a 50% chance
of winning $500,000

194
00:11:34,190 --> 00:11:36,970
and the title of Sole Survivor.

195
00:11:37,110 --> 00:11:39,650
Alright, let's draw for spots
and get started.

196
00:11:39,790 --> 00:11:41,570
- Good luck. Good luck, Peter.
- Good luck.

197
00:11:51,730 --> 00:11:55,010
Alright... assume the position.

198
00:12:04,990 --> 00:12:08,010
For immunity
and a spot in the final two,

199
00:12:08,110 --> 00:12:10,490
this challenge is now on.

200
00:12:18,190 --> 00:12:20,690
This is a pretty simple challenge,
this one.

201
00:12:20,830 --> 00:12:22,650
Just need to hang on as long as you can.

202
00:12:26,410 --> 00:12:29,170
It's not a very comfortable position.

203
00:12:29,310 --> 00:12:31,570
There's not much to balance on
on those pedestals.

204
00:12:35,230 --> 00:12:38,470
Soon that discomfort
will turn into pain.

205
00:12:38,610 --> 00:12:40,530
And then it becomes about
pain management.

206
00:12:41,710 --> 00:12:43,470
Mind over matter at that point.

207
00:12:46,550 --> 00:12:50,050
So much of this challenge
is really just psychological.

208
00:12:51,830 --> 00:12:53,690
Convincing yourself
that you can keep going.

209
00:12:55,010 --> 00:12:56,930
This is what Survivor's about.

210
00:12:57,030 --> 00:12:59,290
You gotta dig deep if you want it.

211
00:13:02,090 --> 00:13:03,610
Here we go.

212
00:13:06,370 --> 00:13:07,970
That swell's starting to come up.

213
00:13:09,430 --> 00:13:11,650
And we're not even mid tide yet.

214
00:13:11,750 --> 00:13:14,170
That's gonna be the first of many...

215
00:13:16,190 --> 00:13:17,170
..I'm guessing.

216
00:13:21,350 --> 00:13:23,050
You guys have been
out here for 30 minutes.

217
00:13:24,290 --> 00:13:26,290
Tara, the sun's about to set.

218
00:13:26,430 --> 00:13:28,570
You're gonna be doing this
challenge at night.

219
00:13:28,670 --> 00:13:29,850
How do you feel about that?

220
00:13:29,990 --> 00:13:33,370
When I can see the waves come,
I can sort of duck my head down.

221
00:13:33,510 --> 00:13:35,130
At night-time,
a wave could hit you in the face

222
00:13:35,230 --> 00:13:36,650
and you could just lose balance.

223
00:13:36,790 --> 00:13:39,010
So this has upped the ante
with doing it in the dark,

224
00:13:39,110 --> 00:13:40,010
that's for sure.

225
00:13:41,270 --> 00:13:44,470
What about you, Peter. Are you
concerned, with your back to ocean?

226
00:13:44,590 --> 00:13:48,690
If it's dark, my back to the ocean
doesn't make a difference, so... no.

227
00:13:50,750 --> 00:13:53,290
We've had a cyclone, we've had storms.

228
00:13:53,430 --> 00:13:56,290
That's why you've just got to
be able to tough it out.

229
00:13:56,430 --> 00:13:57,970
- Yeah.
- Is that your mantra today?

230
00:13:58,070 --> 00:13:59,330
"Tough it out"?

231
00:13:59,430 --> 00:14:00,810
Yep, got to tough it out.

232
00:14:01,910 --> 00:14:03,210
I like it.

233
00:14:24,230 --> 00:14:26,330
Well, the sun has well and truly gone.

234
00:14:31,550 --> 00:14:33,650
This is the last of the light.

235
00:14:35,730 --> 00:14:37,250
Night's about to fall.

236
00:14:45,110 --> 00:14:47,970
I hope you're all prepared for the wet,

237
00:14:48,070 --> 00:14:51,450
the cold, wind and the dark.

238
00:14:53,750 --> 00:14:55,850
This is where the real challenge begins.

239
00:14:57,150 --> 00:14:58,970
Oh, my God.

240
00:15:11,262 --> 00:15:12,942
JERICHO: Whoa.

241
00:15:13,610 --> 00:15:14,922
Wow!

242
00:15:14,938 --> 00:15:17,371
- You guys all get that?
- Yep, right in the face.

243
00:15:18,344 --> 00:15:20,404
One hour, guys.

244
00:15:20,504 --> 00:15:21,844
How's everyone feeling?

245
00:15:21,984 --> 00:15:23,244
- JERICHO: Good.
- PETER: Good.

246
00:15:23,344 --> 00:15:24,484
Shit.

247
00:15:24,584 --> 00:15:26,104
I'll be honest.

248
00:15:26,184 --> 00:15:27,164
Thank you, Tara.

249
00:15:27,264 --> 00:15:29,024
Everyone else is lying to me, right?

250
00:15:34,384 --> 00:15:35,324
JERICHO: Whoo...

251
00:15:35,424 --> 00:15:37,304
It is jet-black out here.

252
00:15:37,444 --> 00:15:40,324
You really cannot see
what's going on with the surf.

253
00:15:42,584 --> 00:15:44,684
- You can hear them, but
you can't see 'em. - Yep.

254
00:15:44,824 --> 00:15:46,364
You don't know which one's gonna hit.

255
00:15:49,244 --> 00:15:51,484
- Whoa.
- Ahh!

256
00:15:51,584 --> 00:15:53,764
Oh, my God.

257
00:15:57,224 --> 00:15:59,884
You're moving your feet around a
lot, Jericho. Are they getting sore?

258
00:15:59,984 --> 00:16:02,304
They're good, actually. I'm fine.

259
00:16:03,484 --> 00:16:06,584
Or am I lying?! (LAUGHS)

260
00:16:06,664 --> 00:16:08,404
You'll never know.

261
00:16:09,544 --> 00:16:12,324
So, game face is definitely
a strategy for you?

262
00:16:12,424 --> 00:16:13,324
Yeah.

263
00:16:15,184 --> 00:16:16,664
Well, I hope you're comfortable

264
00:16:16,784 --> 00:16:19,664
because you have been out here
for 90 minutes.

265
00:16:34,504 --> 00:16:38,884
Peter, how would it feel to make it
to the final two, on Day 55?

266
00:16:38,984 --> 00:16:40,304
As far as you can go?

267
00:16:40,444 --> 00:16:43,124
It honestly would be a dream come true.

268
00:16:43,264 --> 00:16:45,084
I've loved Survivor
for a really long time

269
00:16:45,224 --> 00:16:48,484
and to win would be, you know,
the whole package.

270
00:16:48,624 --> 00:16:52,724
But the only way you can
make that dream official right now

271
00:16:52,824 --> 00:16:54,304
is to win this challenge.

272
00:16:55,704 --> 00:16:57,964
So, that's what I've got to
focus on doing.

273
00:17:08,904 --> 00:17:11,244
Guys, you've been out here
for two hours now.

274
00:17:12,924 --> 00:17:15,044
Don't give up now.

275
00:17:16,564 --> 00:17:18,444
Very different pictures here.

276
00:17:19,544 --> 00:17:21,944
Jericho looking very solid.

277
00:17:23,024 --> 00:17:25,844
Peter, head down, in the zone.

278
00:17:27,504 --> 00:17:31,304
Tara, moving around a lot, trying
to find something comfortable.

279
00:17:35,404 --> 00:17:37,584
The muscles must be cramping now.

280
00:17:43,104 --> 00:17:47,204
Tara, what do you think has got you
this far in the game?

281
00:17:47,304 --> 00:17:49,044
Yeah, I was just being me.

282
00:17:49,144 --> 00:17:51,944
I'm a stay-at-home mum, you know?

283
00:17:52,024 --> 00:17:53,164
So...

284
00:17:53,304 --> 00:17:55,444
Oh, no, don't get me wrong.
I love my job, but...

285
00:17:56,664 --> 00:17:58,084
..some of these guys are,
you know...

286
00:17:58,184 --> 00:17:59,844
Like, we had Ziggy, the Olympian,

287
00:17:59,944 --> 00:18:02,644
and Locky jumps off buildings and...

288
00:18:02,784 --> 00:18:04,804
- Jarrad's an incredible photographer.
- Yeah.

289
00:18:04,984 --> 00:18:07,044
- Tessa's a doctor. There's so many
amazing people. - That's right.

290
00:18:07,184 --> 00:18:10,044
That's true, and everyone has a shot
in this game.

291
00:18:11,204 --> 00:18:12,604
Just... it's just...

292
00:18:12,704 --> 00:18:14,604
Yeah, I just feel very blessed.

293
00:18:14,704 --> 00:18:15,964
But...

294
00:18:17,464 --> 00:18:18,764
..I just don't want to
disappoint anyone.

295
00:18:18,904 --> 00:18:21,304
I don't want to
disappoint myself. So...

296
00:18:22,544 --> 00:18:23,604
Yeah.

297
00:18:32,064 --> 00:18:34,364
Tara, you seem to be getting
quite emotional.

298
00:18:34,504 --> 00:18:36,604
- What's going on for you?
- Oh, I'm just trying to pull it in.

299
00:18:36,704 --> 00:18:38,004
Pull it all together, you know?

300
00:18:38,144 --> 00:18:39,484
My emotions are starting to get over me

301
00:18:39,624 --> 00:18:42,664
and I'm really trying hard
to just... bear down.

302
00:18:42,744 --> 00:18:46,024
But... it's starting to hurt and...

303
00:18:46,144 --> 00:18:48,124
..I just don't want to feel like
I don't...

304
00:18:49,244 --> 00:18:51,224
..feel like I'm not
meant to be here, but I am.

305
00:18:51,304 --> 00:18:53,044
But... I just can't...

306
00:18:54,224 --> 00:18:55,804
I'm just trying my hardest, that's all.

307
00:18:55,904 --> 00:18:57,304
I'm trying really hard.

308
00:19:03,124 --> 00:19:04,884
Hey, you're final three.

309
00:19:06,484 --> 00:19:08,324
You totally deserve to be here.

310
00:19:10,204 --> 00:19:12,364
JERICHO: You're doing so well, Tara.

311
00:19:12,464 --> 00:19:14,404
(CRIES) I know. I'm trying!

312
00:19:14,544 --> 00:19:16,524
- PETER: You're doing amazing, Tara.
- I really am trying!

313
00:19:17,984 --> 00:19:20,044
My legs aren't holding me anymore.

314
00:19:23,304 --> 00:19:25,004
PETER: You got this Tara.
Don't give up.

315
00:19:25,104 --> 00:19:27,224
Do your best, Tara.

316
00:19:28,684 --> 00:19:30,364
(BREATHES HEAVILY)

317
00:19:43,564 --> 00:19:45,304
Tara, you can cry all you want

318
00:19:45,444 --> 00:19:48,604
but just keep your hand on that idol
and your feet on the pedestals.

319
00:19:51,544 --> 00:19:53,304
There's one thing about Survivor

320
00:19:53,444 --> 00:19:55,244
that I keep on saying, again and again.

321
00:19:56,984 --> 00:19:59,084
Just never give up.

322
00:19:59,184 --> 00:20:00,644
Nup.

323
00:20:10,104 --> 00:20:12,684
I know all three of you
want to win this challenge.

324
00:20:12,824 --> 00:20:15,844
And that necklace has
some serious power tonight.

325
00:20:18,024 --> 00:20:19,944
Let go of that idol

326
00:20:20,064 --> 00:20:22,884
and you could be letting go of
your place in the game.

327
00:20:30,324 --> 00:20:31,484
(GROANS)

328
00:20:31,584 --> 00:20:34,764
The waves really pounding in now.

329
00:20:38,824 --> 00:20:41,304
Ohhhh...

330
00:20:44,464 --> 00:20:45,604
Talk.

331
00:20:45,744 --> 00:20:48,364
I don't know if I can talk now
because I... it's bad.

332
00:20:50,864 --> 00:20:53,604
What's the different names again?
So, a stallion is...?

333
00:20:56,264 --> 00:20:57,524
A st...

334
00:20:57,624 --> 00:21:00,084
A stallion is a male horse.

335
00:21:00,184 --> 00:21:02,944
A mare is a female horse.

336
00:21:04,404 --> 00:21:07,164
A filly is a young female horse

337
00:21:07,264 --> 00:21:09,764
and colt is a young male horse.

338
00:21:09,864 --> 00:21:11,224
JERICHO: A colt?

339
00:21:11,304 --> 00:21:12,944
C-O-L-T?

340
00:21:14,044 --> 00:21:15,364
(GASPS AND CHUCKLES)

341
00:21:15,504 --> 00:21:17,604
I know what you're do...
It's good. Keep trying.

342
00:21:17,704 --> 00:21:19,944
I'm trying, eh? I'm trying to talk.

343
00:21:21,024 --> 00:21:21,944
Um...

344
00:21:24,904 --> 00:21:26,304
PETER: Oh... God.

345
00:21:33,484 --> 00:21:35,304
You're doing amazing, Tara.

346
00:21:35,444 --> 00:21:38,684
Tara looks like
she's in serious pain now.

347
00:21:38,784 --> 00:21:40,444
Really starting to wobble.

348
00:21:42,204 --> 00:21:43,524
Ooh.

349
00:21:45,624 --> 00:21:47,684
Tara almost loses her balance.

350
00:21:47,784 --> 00:21:49,244
Nice recovery.

351
00:21:50,844 --> 00:21:52,224
Good job, Tara.

352
00:21:53,664 --> 00:21:56,844
You've been out here for 53 days.

353
00:21:56,984 --> 00:22:02,124
That is a long time with not much
food, not much sleep...

354
00:22:03,764 --> 00:22:05,324
Incredibly exhausting.

355
00:22:07,144 --> 00:22:10,124
How much is left in the tank
for this final challenge?

356
00:22:16,944 --> 00:22:19,304
And she's had enough.
She's stepping out of the challenge.

357
00:22:21,844 --> 00:22:22,764
(GROANS)

358
00:22:22,864 --> 00:22:24,644
Two hours and 55 minutes.

359
00:22:24,784 --> 00:22:26,604
- (GROANS)
- JERICHO: Wow, almost three.

360
00:22:26,704 --> 00:22:28,964
Almost three hours, Tara.

361
00:22:31,564 --> 00:22:32,484
Yep.

362
00:22:32,624 --> 00:22:34,524
Your family's gonna be
very proud of you.

363
00:22:34,624 --> 00:22:35,844
I hope so.

364
00:22:35,944 --> 00:22:37,524
You've done incredibly well.

365
00:22:37,664 --> 00:22:40,484
- You did so well, Tara.
- You did great, Tara.

366
00:22:40,584 --> 00:22:42,004
Alright, here we go.

367
00:22:42,144 --> 00:22:43,164
- Ready?
- Yep.

368
00:22:43,264 --> 00:22:44,404
Up you hop.

369
00:22:56,944 --> 00:22:58,724
So, now we're down to two.

370
00:22:59,824 --> 00:23:01,864
Peter and Jericho...

371
00:23:01,944 --> 00:23:05,164
..battling it out for that necklace.

372
00:23:06,884 --> 00:23:09,004
Who's gonna be the last one standing?

373
00:23:13,984 --> 00:23:15,084
Wow!

374
00:23:17,984 --> 00:23:19,724
Just as Tara steps off,

375
00:23:19,824 --> 00:23:22,324
the ocean gets really angry.

376
00:23:25,184 --> 00:23:27,324
We're not even at high tide yet.

377
00:23:32,264 --> 00:23:33,584
Jericho...

378
00:23:33,664 --> 00:23:35,584
..if Peter wins,

379
00:23:35,704 --> 00:23:37,164
are you worried you could be going home?

380
00:23:37,264 --> 00:23:38,364
Yeah.

381
00:23:38,464 --> 00:23:39,724
Peter...

382
00:23:39,864 --> 00:23:41,164
- Yep.
- ..if Jericho wins,

383
00:23:41,304 --> 00:23:43,164
are you worried that
you could be going home?

384
00:23:43,264 --> 00:23:44,804
Absolutely, yes.

385
00:23:47,244 --> 00:23:50,044
Well, you guys have now been
out here for three and a half hours.

386
00:23:50,184 --> 00:23:52,944
How much longer do you think
you've got in you?

387
00:23:53,024 --> 00:23:54,804
Um, till the morning.

388
00:23:54,944 --> 00:23:56,964
- Till the morning?
- Yeah.

389
00:23:57,064 --> 00:23:58,244
Wow.

390
00:23:59,504 --> 00:24:01,404
Peter, is that a little bit
of a concern?

391
00:24:01,504 --> 00:24:03,584
No, I'll match that if I have to.

392
00:24:07,784 --> 00:24:09,804
Looks like we might be here for a while.

393
00:24:32,784 --> 00:24:35,364
You guys are just getting smashed now.

394
00:24:37,564 --> 00:24:39,944
The wind is definitely picking up.

395
00:24:40,064 --> 00:24:42,444
That's not gonna help, with wet clothes.

396
00:25:46,944 --> 00:25:49,364
Another massive wave pounds them both.

397
00:25:53,264 --> 00:25:54,364
Damn.

398
00:25:54,504 --> 00:25:57,724
Every wave now just cuts to the bone.

399
00:25:58,824 --> 00:26:00,324
The wind kicking up.

400
00:26:00,424 --> 00:26:02,944
Soaked to the core.

401
00:26:03,064 --> 00:26:05,364
Really starting to shake with the cold.

402
00:26:06,824 --> 00:26:08,644
There's no way to increase
your body temperature

403
00:26:08,784 --> 00:26:10,684
when you're stuck in one position
like that.

404
00:26:17,844 --> 00:26:19,524
It's all about the psychology now.

405
00:26:21,304 --> 00:26:23,044
"How long can I last?"...

406
00:26:24,304 --> 00:26:26,404
..versus "How long can they last?"

407
00:26:28,464 --> 00:26:29,944
It's a waiting game now.

408
00:26:38,504 --> 00:26:41,924
Both boys determined
to give it everything they've got.

409
00:26:42,024 --> 00:26:44,724
Reaching to the bottom of the tank.

410
00:26:46,464 --> 00:26:49,004
Trying to find that inner strength
to keep going.

411
00:26:57,184 --> 00:26:59,584
Who's gonna reach
the end of their limit?

412
00:27:23,024 --> 00:27:25,324
(PETER GROANS)

413
00:27:30,964 --> 00:27:32,304
Jonathan?

414
00:27:35,824 --> 00:27:38,004
Can I have a hand getting down, please?

415
00:27:38,104 --> 00:27:39,924
You want to step down?

416
00:27:40,024 --> 00:27:41,304
Alright.

417
00:27:41,384 --> 00:27:44,084
After five and a quarter hours,

418
00:27:44,184 --> 00:27:48,724
Peter no longer can stand up.

419
00:27:51,824 --> 00:27:57,324
Jericho wins the final immunity.

420
00:27:57,424 --> 00:27:58,504
Let's rock!

421
00:27:58,644 --> 00:27:59,924
You're right, you're right,
you're right.

422
00:28:00,024 --> 00:28:01,724
Just take your time.

423
00:28:01,824 --> 00:28:03,084
Oh! Oh, ma...

424
00:28:03,224 --> 00:28:05,404
Sit down for a bit, babe.
Sit down for a little bit.

425
00:28:06,484 --> 00:28:09,324
I don't cry. I don't cry.

426
00:28:09,424 --> 00:28:10,524
You alright?

427
00:28:11,684 --> 00:28:14,084
That was a massive, massive effort.

428
00:28:14,184 --> 00:28:15,964
(JERICHO SPEAKS INDISTINCTLY)

429
00:28:16,064 --> 00:28:18,504
Peter, come here, come here. Bro...

430
00:28:18,584 --> 00:28:21,584
You made me fight for my life!

431
00:28:22,764 --> 00:28:25,724
You have gained my respect, my bro.

432
00:28:27,324 --> 00:28:30,244
Man, I'm so proud of you.

433
00:28:30,384 --> 00:28:32,684
Peter, how you feeling?
Think you can walk?

434
00:28:32,784 --> 00:28:34,404
I'm OK.

435
00:28:37,904 --> 00:28:40,244
Sit and... sit and talk.

436
00:28:41,384 --> 00:28:43,524
Take this off, my bro,
'cause it's really damp.

437
00:28:49,984 --> 00:28:54,004
We proved to everybody that we
deserve to be in the final three.

438
00:28:54,144 --> 00:28:57,304
No-one can tell us and devalue
what we've achieved.

439
00:28:57,384 --> 00:28:58,304
Yeah?

440
00:29:01,764 --> 00:29:03,724
(ALL SCREAM)

441
00:29:04,944 --> 00:29:06,124
(LAUGHS) What?!

442
00:29:06,224 --> 00:29:07,604
God!

443
00:29:17,109 --> 00:29:19,569
JONATHAN: Peter and Tara,
that was a massive effort

444
00:29:19,669 --> 00:29:21,869
but, Jericho, come on over.

445
00:29:21,989 --> 00:29:25,149
- Good work, Jer.
- Well and truly earned this.

446
00:29:25,229 --> 00:29:27,969
After five hours...

447
00:29:28,069 --> 00:29:30,169
..and 13 minutes.

448
00:29:30,309 --> 00:29:33,769
First Individual Immunity win
in the final challenge.

449
00:29:33,869 --> 00:29:34,889
Congratulations.

450
00:29:34,989 --> 00:29:37,369
You are safe, can not be voted out.

451
00:29:37,469 --> 00:29:41,369
Guaranteed a spot in the final two,

452
00:29:41,509 --> 00:29:45,649
where you will get a chance
to plead your case to the jury.

453
00:29:46,849 --> 00:29:49,649
But before we get to that...

454
00:29:49,789 --> 00:29:52,449
..tomorrow night at Tribal Council,
you have a big decision to make.

455
00:29:52,589 --> 00:29:58,869
Your vote will decide
who will join you in the final two

456
00:29:58,989 --> 00:30:01,729
and who will become
the final member of the jury.

457
00:30:03,589 --> 00:30:08,049
It's a lot to think about. Go back
to camp, get a good night's sleep.

458
00:30:08,189 --> 00:30:10,329
I'll see you guys tomorrow
at Tribal Council.

459
00:30:10,469 --> 00:30:12,209
- Alright. Well done. Congratulations.
- Thank you.

460
00:30:12,309 --> 00:30:14,169
ALL: Thanks, Jonathan.

461
00:30:14,269 --> 00:30:15,609
TARA: Well done, Jer.

462
00:30:39,109 --> 00:30:41,509
JERICHO: This is the biggest
decision of my entire life.

463
00:30:43,029 --> 00:30:46,169
Tonight is deciding
the person that will sit next to me

464
00:30:46,309 --> 00:30:50,169
and plead their case against mine
for that Sole Survivor title

465
00:30:50,269 --> 00:30:52,169
and that $500,000.

466
00:30:52,269 --> 00:30:54,309
It's crazy.

467
00:30:56,069 --> 00:30:58,089
You can weigh up the two options
that I have -

468
00:30:58,189 --> 00:30:59,869
they're both very different people.

469
00:31:01,629 --> 00:31:04,449
It's like trying to decide
apples and oranges.

470
00:31:06,469 --> 00:31:10,249
And I could possibly be putting the
wrong person in the finals with me

471
00:31:10,349 --> 00:31:13,529
and giving someone else $500,000.

472
00:31:13,669 --> 00:31:18,869
It is the biggest,
most terrifying position to be in

473
00:31:18,989 --> 00:31:20,409
that I have to make a decision
like that.

474
00:31:24,349 --> 00:31:26,149
We'll now bring in
the members of our jury.

475
00:31:27,489 --> 00:31:31,569
Jarrad, Anneliese, Henry, Sarah...

476
00:31:32,949 --> 00:31:37,209
..Luke, Ziggy, Locky

477
00:31:37,349 --> 00:31:40,049
and Michelle, voted out
at the last Tribal Council.

478
00:31:42,309 --> 00:31:43,509
Well, first of all,

479
00:31:43,629 --> 00:31:48,249
I want to say that was an epic
battle in the final challenge.

480
00:31:48,389 --> 00:31:51,509
Massive effort from everyone.
Well done.

481
00:31:51,589 --> 00:31:53,509
And just to catch up the jury.

482
00:31:53,629 --> 00:31:56,969
So, the final challenge
was the same as last year

483
00:31:57,069 --> 00:31:58,369
except we did it at night,

484
00:31:58,509 --> 00:32:02,169
which added a whole level
of difficulty unto itself.

485
00:32:03,769 --> 00:32:06,449
Tara lasted almost three hours.

486
00:32:06,589 --> 00:32:10,449
The boys went for an impressive
five hours and 13 minutes

487
00:32:10,549 --> 00:32:12,249
before Peter stepped off.

488
00:32:12,389 --> 00:32:13,649
- Well done.
- Good job.

489
00:32:18,069 --> 00:32:20,049
So, Jericho,
you finally got your wish -

490
00:32:20,189 --> 00:32:23,849
first Individual Immunity win
in the final challenge.

491
00:32:23,949 --> 00:32:24,869
How does that feel?

492
00:32:24,949 --> 00:32:27,009
The Survivor gods were telling me,

493
00:32:27,149 --> 00:32:30,009
"Patience
and you will get your wish."

494
00:32:30,109 --> 00:32:31,809
And it was quite of a battle.

495
00:32:31,949 --> 00:32:35,689
I didn't just get it easily,
I had to earn it.

496
00:32:35,829 --> 00:32:37,929
And I have mad respect
for the two of them.

497
00:32:38,029 --> 00:32:39,329
It was a good fight.

498
00:32:40,989 --> 00:32:42,809
Well, you hold all the power tonight.

499
00:32:42,949 --> 00:32:45,689
Is it more important to you
to take someone you can beat

500
00:32:45,829 --> 00:32:49,509
or someone who you think will put up
a good fight in the final two?

501
00:32:49,589 --> 00:32:51,169
It's not about who's an easy win.

502
00:32:51,309 --> 00:32:54,809
It's more so who deserves
to be sitting next to me

503
00:32:54,949 --> 00:32:58,849
and how they should stand against me
in the final two.

504
00:32:58,949 --> 00:33:01,049
That's how I look at it.

505
00:33:03,269 --> 00:33:08,509
Tara, why should Jericho
not take Peter to the end?

506
00:33:08,589 --> 00:33:10,449
I still feel strongly

507
00:33:10,589 --> 00:33:14,689
that Jeri and I are both lovable
and social characters in the game

508
00:33:14,789 --> 00:33:17,929
and we take every move seriously.

509
00:33:18,069 --> 00:33:22,089
And, you know, that's why I feel
that if he was to take Peter,

510
00:33:22,229 --> 00:33:26,149
the jury would see that as
he's just taken the easy ride out.

511
00:33:29,949 --> 00:33:32,209
- My turn?
- Yeah.

512
00:33:32,349 --> 00:33:37,449
Firstly, I couldn't disagree more. I
do not think I am the easy ride out.

513
00:33:37,589 --> 00:33:40,369
I think Jericho
has played a really good game.

514
00:33:40,469 --> 00:33:42,789
And I believe that the jury

515
00:33:42,929 --> 00:33:47,689
would respect someone who stuck
to their word in taking big plays.

516
00:33:47,829 --> 00:33:50,529
And I believe
I am a big player in this game.

517
00:33:52,169 --> 00:33:54,249
I believe I've really had to
fight my way through.

518
00:33:54,389 --> 00:33:57,649
And I've worked with a lot of people
and I've worked individually.

519
00:33:57,789 --> 00:34:00,409
And I believe that
if he does take Tara to the end,

520
00:34:00,549 --> 00:34:03,089
when there is very likely
a consensus from the jury

521
00:34:03,189 --> 00:34:05,169
that Tara is the weaker player,

522
00:34:05,309 --> 00:34:07,569
then he's potentially
undermining his own game,

523
00:34:07,709 --> 00:34:12,849
whereby he's not taking risks
and he's not making a big move

524
00:34:12,989 --> 00:34:15,689
in taking someone like me
who's played a really good game

525
00:34:15,789 --> 00:34:16,849
to the end.

526
00:34:16,989 --> 00:34:20,449
Sorry.
But, like, you had the opportunity.

527
00:34:20,589 --> 00:34:22,329
- You owned this necklace...
- Yeah.

528
00:34:22,429 --> 00:34:23,609
..three days ago.

529
00:34:23,749 --> 00:34:25,209
And you went around to me and Michelle

530
00:34:25,349 --> 00:34:28,009
and you were like, "Just pick
Jericho. Jericho's the easy vote."

531
00:34:28,149 --> 00:34:31,049
And you're trying to sit here and
tell me that you've taken huge risk.

532
00:34:31,189 --> 00:34:34,089
It was the last opportunity
to prove to the jury

533
00:34:34,189 --> 00:34:36,309
that you've got some sort of balls

534
00:34:36,429 --> 00:34:40,009
to go ahead and battle
for that spot that you want.

535
00:34:40,149 --> 00:34:42,869
I took that opportunity
and hold on to it.

536
00:34:42,949 --> 00:34:44,929
And I didn't let it go.

537
00:34:47,749 --> 00:34:49,569
I make logical decisions in this game.

538
00:34:49,709 --> 00:34:52,689
And I weighed up
what the jury was thinking

539
00:34:52,789 --> 00:34:54,089
and I also weighed up

540
00:34:54,229 --> 00:34:58,529
that the final challenge
was most likely going to be physical

541
00:34:58,669 --> 00:35:03,329
and for my game, the most logical
decision and the smartest option

542
00:35:03,429 --> 00:35:05,569
was honestly to take out Jericho.

543
00:35:09,229 --> 00:35:11,369
Alright. Well, I'm going to give you
guys a final pitch.

544
00:35:11,509 --> 00:35:14,569
Peter, why should Jericho
take you to the end?

545
00:35:14,709 --> 00:35:19,049
Jericho, I believe
I have played a really good game.

546
00:35:19,189 --> 00:35:22,789
The jury, because they are
made of such big game players,

547
00:35:22,929 --> 00:35:24,929
they want to see someone
who's played a strong game

548
00:35:25,029 --> 00:35:27,169
in the final with Jericho.

549
00:35:27,309 --> 00:35:31,809
So, I believe not taking me
will undermine Jericho's game

550
00:35:31,949 --> 00:35:35,809
because he is based on playing
big risks and making big moves.

551
00:35:35,949 --> 00:35:37,649
And if you're taking an easier option,

552
00:35:37,749 --> 00:35:38,969
and I'm sorry, Tara,

553
00:35:39,109 --> 00:35:40,889
but I do believe
you are the easier option tonight...

554
00:35:42,389 --> 00:35:46,529
..because you did spend
a lot of time in Locky's shadow.

555
00:35:46,669 --> 00:35:50,429
I don't believe all of your moves
have been logical in this game.

556
00:35:50,509 --> 00:35:52,689
I believe if you don't take me,

557
00:35:52,829 --> 00:35:56,209
then the jury will consider that
as a negative.

558
00:35:59,349 --> 00:36:02,329
OK. So, Tara, why should Jericho
take you to the end?

559
00:36:02,469 --> 00:36:06,249
In my defence,
I could be classed as an underdog

560
00:36:06,389 --> 00:36:08,809
or I could be classed as a weak player.

561
00:36:08,909 --> 00:36:10,149
But you know what? Bring it on.

562
00:36:10,289 --> 00:36:13,609
Because if you want a fight,
then bring me.

563
00:36:13,749 --> 00:36:19,789
You take Petey and it will be
a bit of a disrespect to the game.

564
00:36:19,929 --> 00:36:21,429
- That's what I'm saying.
- Wow.

565
00:36:21,569 --> 00:36:23,729
I just want to say, I disagree
entirely with that last statement.

566
00:36:23,869 --> 00:36:26,149
Well, of course you disagree.
It's my time to pitch.

567
00:36:26,229 --> 00:36:27,149
You just had a pitch.

568
00:36:27,289 --> 00:36:29,249
- Now it's my time to pitch.
- Sorry. I thought you were finished.

569
00:36:29,389 --> 00:36:30,929
You disagree.
Of course you disagree.

570
00:36:31,069 --> 00:36:34,689
I'm a strong player and I feel
that at the end of the day,

571
00:36:34,829 --> 00:36:37,729
if you wanted to have a fight
and battle it out

572
00:36:37,869 --> 00:36:39,809
and prove
that you are the Sole Survivor,

573
00:36:39,909 --> 00:36:42,609
then I'll be sitting next to you.

574
00:36:50,269 --> 00:36:52,569
OK. So, this is how
it's going to work.

575
00:36:52,709 --> 00:36:55,609
Peter and Tara,
you can't vote for yourself,

576
00:36:55,749 --> 00:36:58,609
you can't vote for Jericho, so you
can only vote for each other,

577
00:36:58,749 --> 00:37:01,649
which means that your votes
cancel each other out.

578
00:37:01,789 --> 00:37:06,449
So, Jericho, ultimately you decide
who's going to leave this game

579
00:37:06,549 --> 00:37:09,289
and be the final member of the jury.

580
00:37:12,509 --> 00:37:14,969
- Are you ready?
- Oh, I'm ready.

581
00:37:15,069 --> 00:37:17,209
Jericho, it's time to vote.

582
00:38:17,509 --> 00:38:19,049
I'll go get the vote.

583
00:38:39,349 --> 00:38:41,209
Once the vote is read
the decision is final,

584
00:38:41,309 --> 00:38:42,429
the person voted out

585
00:38:42,569 --> 00:38:45,289
will be asked to leave
the Tribal Council area immediately.

586
00:38:45,389 --> 00:38:46,969
I'll read the vote.

587
00:38:59,089 --> 00:39:02,169
22nd person voted out
from Australian Survivor,

588
00:39:02,269 --> 00:39:04,569
final member of our jury...

589
00:39:04,669 --> 00:39:06,209
..Peter.

590
00:39:06,309 --> 00:39:07,529
You need to bring me your torch.

591
00:39:11,709 --> 00:39:14,309
Congratulations.
And good luck, you guys.

592
00:39:16,729 --> 00:39:19,309
And stay up, you guys,
we're hanging out tonight.

593
00:39:27,869 --> 00:39:29,649
Peter, the tribe has spoken.

594
00:39:33,069 --> 00:39:35,329
- (LOCKY CHUCKLES)
- Bring it in.

595
00:39:38,029 --> 00:39:39,569
- Time to go.
- See you, Peter.

596
00:39:39,709 --> 00:39:41,069
- Bye, Petey.
- Well done.

597
00:39:41,149 --> 00:39:42,889
Congratulations.

598
00:39:52,669 --> 00:39:54,889
Holy crap.

599
00:39:54,989 --> 00:39:56,609
Day 55.

600
00:39:58,269 --> 00:39:59,849
Yeah.

601
00:39:59,949 --> 00:40:01,929
Jericho and Tara, congratulations.

602
00:40:02,069 --> 00:40:07,069
You are the final two. You've done
everything you can in this game.

603
00:40:07,149 --> 00:40:08,729
And now it's going to be up to them.

604
00:40:08,829 --> 00:40:09,929
Oh, my God.

605
00:40:10,029 --> 00:40:12,149
So go home, get some sleep

606
00:40:12,269 --> 00:40:14,969
and think about
how you're going to convince them

607
00:40:15,069 --> 00:40:17,009
that you deserve the $500,000.

608
00:40:17,149 --> 00:40:19,449
- Grab your torches, head on out.
- JERICHO: Wow.

609
00:40:29,389 --> 00:40:31,649
TARA: Holy crap.

610
00:40:35,509 --> 00:40:39,169
I took you because you really
deserve it more than he does.

611
00:40:58,016 --> 00:41:02,576
JERICHO: Good morning, Vietnam!

612
00:41:02,716 --> 00:41:08,176
TARA: Hello,
day fifty-frickin'-five.

613
00:41:08,316 --> 00:41:11,416
We were destined to be here at day 55.

614
00:41:11,516 --> 00:41:13,856
55 days on this island.

615
00:41:14,936 --> 00:41:17,296
Aaahhh!

616
00:41:17,396 --> 00:41:19,616
I could win half a million!

617
00:41:19,756 --> 00:41:22,656
What the heck? I'm just
a flight attendant from Melbourne.

618
00:41:27,296 --> 00:41:31,136
I have been dreaming of this moment,

619
00:41:31,276 --> 00:41:34,216
to know that I have a shot
in winning Survivor.

620
00:41:34,356 --> 00:41:38,496
To me, I feel like dreams can come true.

621
00:41:38,636 --> 00:41:42,176
It's starting to clear up
into a nice day.

622
00:41:42,316 --> 00:41:46,256
The last thing I need to do
is convince the jury tonight

623
00:41:46,396 --> 00:41:50,216
that I am worthy of that title
of Sole Survivor.

624
00:41:56,556 --> 00:41:57,936
(BOTH SQUEAL WITH EXCITEMENT)

625
00:42:00,796 --> 00:42:02,136
BOTH: "Congratulations.

626
00:42:02,236 --> 00:42:03,936
"You have made it to day 55.

627
00:42:04,076 --> 00:42:07,396
"Tonight you face
your last Tribal Council.

628
00:42:07,536 --> 00:42:12,296
"To help you prepare, breakfast
is provided in the crate below!"

629
00:42:12,396 --> 00:42:14,976
Oh, my goodness!

630
00:42:15,076 --> 00:42:16,456
Ohhh!

631
00:42:19,356 --> 00:42:23,456
For me, there is no option
apart from winning this.

632
00:42:23,596 --> 00:42:26,576
Back in the Philippines,
my parents weren't wealthy.

633
00:42:26,716 --> 00:42:32,936
In fact, we lived in a shelter that
just was able to withstand the rain.

634
00:42:33,036 --> 00:42:35,776
Let's cook some food!

635
00:42:37,116 --> 00:42:40,216
The reason why I stand here
is because they worked

636
00:42:40,356 --> 00:42:43,216
blood, sweat and tears for me
and so I owe it to them.

637
00:42:44,796 --> 00:42:45,896
Holy moly.

638
00:42:45,996 --> 00:42:47,136
Are you kidding me?

639
00:42:47,236 --> 00:42:49,616
Let's enjoy it sizzle.

640
00:42:49,716 --> 00:42:51,856
I feel like they deserve everything

641
00:42:51,996 --> 00:42:54,936
and I want to be the person
that can finally provide for them

642
00:42:55,076 --> 00:42:56,856
just as much as they provided for me.

643
00:42:56,996 --> 00:42:59,896
(POP!)
Yay! 55 days!

644
00:42:59,996 --> 00:43:01,036
55 days.

645
00:43:01,176 --> 00:43:03,176
- Congratulations.
- Congratulations, babe.

646
00:43:03,916 --> 00:43:05,976
Cheers to...

647
00:43:06,116 --> 00:43:09,396
..outlasting every single contestant
in this game,

648
00:43:09,476 --> 00:43:11,336
and doing an amazing job at it.

649
00:43:13,016 --> 00:43:15,456
Mmm! Mm.

650
00:43:15,596 --> 00:43:18,676
What a way to finish
a really tough game.

651
00:43:18,756 --> 00:43:19,856
I really want that title

652
00:43:19,996 --> 00:43:23,936
because I feel that I deserve it
more than anyone in this game.

653
00:43:26,476 --> 00:43:27,456
I'll be honest,

654
00:43:27,596 --> 00:43:30,776
I did second prioritise
making friends in this game.

655
00:43:30,876 --> 00:43:31,776
Oh.

656
00:43:32,856 --> 00:43:34,176
People underestimated me.

657
00:43:34,316 --> 00:43:39,036
People thought that
I was this angelic boy, when really,

658
00:43:39,116 --> 00:43:41,036
I was a wolf in sheep's clothing.

659
00:43:42,156 --> 00:43:45,336
I always made sure that resources
were used wisely.

660
00:43:45,436 --> 00:43:46,336
I had Luke.

661
00:43:46,476 --> 00:43:51,036
He was my best friend
and we conquered Asaga together.

662
00:43:51,176 --> 00:43:56,576
Then I had the jar of cookies
and I used it to build an army.

663
00:43:56,716 --> 00:44:01,676
I placed certain people in
the front line to fight my battles,

664
00:44:01,756 --> 00:44:03,396
to act as shields.

665
00:44:03,516 --> 00:44:05,856
They were the ones that got taken down,

666
00:44:05,996 --> 00:44:09,676
with my name never been written down
until 52 days later.

667
00:44:09,816 --> 00:44:13,816
And that is why
I guaranteed myself a spot

668
00:44:13,956 --> 00:44:16,856
to plead my case in front of the jury.

669
00:44:16,996 --> 00:44:21,036
I am going to make sure that
they give me that crown tonight,

670
00:44:21,116 --> 00:44:22,036
because I deserve it.

671
00:44:27,216 --> 00:44:29,216
One, two, three.

672
00:44:30,996 --> 00:44:33,576
If I ever met Jericho
in the outside world,

673
00:44:33,716 --> 00:44:36,416
it would probably be more of just
a "hi, hi, see ya later."

674
00:44:36,556 --> 00:44:38,176
- Whoo!
- Whoo!

675
00:44:38,316 --> 00:44:40,976
The fact is,
we have a great relationship

676
00:44:41,116 --> 00:44:43,676
and we could even have a good
friendship outside the game.

677
00:44:43,756 --> 00:44:46,976
2017 Sole Survivor! Whoo!

678
00:44:47,116 --> 00:44:49,416
- What!? No, you're not!
- (SQUEALS)

679
00:44:49,516 --> 00:44:52,036
But tonight at Tribal Council,

680
00:44:52,176 --> 00:44:53,976
I'll be leaving the friendship
at the door.

681
00:44:55,156 --> 00:44:57,696
Jeri and I will be going in
as fierce competitors.

682
00:44:58,496 --> 00:44:59,416
Look at this.

683
00:44:59,556 --> 00:45:04,256
This is the home we've been
living in for the last 55 days.

684
00:45:04,396 --> 00:45:07,496
I look at it and I go, "Jericho
has been living in this beach

685
00:45:07,596 --> 00:45:08,896
"since day one."

686
00:45:09,036 --> 00:45:12,696
How cool is it even
that I'm going to prove to you

687
00:45:12,836 --> 00:45:15,096
that you shouldn't have arrived
in this game?

688
00:45:15,236 --> 00:45:17,456
- Oh-hoo!
- (LAUGHS)

689
00:45:17,596 --> 00:45:20,616
Jericho made a mistake
taking me to the final two.

690
00:45:20,756 --> 00:45:25,296
He's looking at me as
not a big threat when I will be.

691
00:45:26,236 --> 00:45:31,776
I survived by getting booted out
of Samatau, headed to Exile Beach,

692
00:45:31,876 --> 00:45:33,816
then I had to come here to Asaga,

693
00:45:33,956 --> 00:45:36,296
form new relationships and build trust,

694
00:45:36,396 --> 00:45:37,896
make it to the merge,

695
00:45:37,996 --> 00:45:40,336
and Jericho has never left Asaga.

696
00:45:40,476 --> 00:45:43,036
- Bye, beach!
- Bye, beach!

697
00:45:43,116 --> 00:45:44,496
But then on top of that,

698
00:45:44,636 --> 00:45:49,696
I can say that I have survived
21 Tribal Councils

699
00:45:49,836 --> 00:45:53,176
and Jeri only got
his name written down once.

700
00:45:53,276 --> 00:45:55,136
He definitely had it easy.

701
00:46:13,836 --> 00:46:16,036
- I'm really emotional.
- Same.

702
00:46:16,116 --> 00:46:17,576
(LAUGHS)

703
00:46:17,716 --> 00:46:20,696
I don't really...
I don't know if I want to go.

704
00:46:22,156 --> 00:46:25,336
I just feel like we're saying
goodbye to our home.

705
00:46:25,476 --> 00:46:28,176
Half a million dollars -
it sets up my family.

706
00:46:28,316 --> 00:46:32,536
I have three growing boys
and with Mum living with us as well,

707
00:46:32,676 --> 00:46:35,136
it'd be nice to get her a little
place where she can call home.

708
00:46:36,276 --> 00:46:39,316
So I would do anything
to win that money.

709
00:46:39,396 --> 00:46:40,616
Oh, man.

710
00:46:40,716 --> 00:46:42,056
I'm gonna miss this place.

711
00:46:43,576 --> 00:46:44,816
What a journey.

712
00:46:51,296 --> 00:46:52,676
You. Ladies first.

713
00:46:52,756 --> 00:46:53,676
Thanks.

714
00:46:55,076 --> 00:46:56,776
Bye-bye.

715
00:47:00,556 --> 00:47:04,396
It's nerve racking to go into
the last Tribal Council

716
00:47:04,516 --> 00:47:07,496
knowing that the person
that I chose to sit next to

717
00:47:07,636 --> 00:47:10,496
is the person that I'm battling it
out for that title of Sole Survivor.

718
00:47:12,696 --> 00:47:15,736
There is a big possibility that Tara
could run away with the money

719
00:47:15,836 --> 00:47:17,736
and that I made the wrong decision

720
00:47:17,876 --> 00:47:20,336
and that I should have taken Peter
instead of Tara.

721
00:47:20,476 --> 00:47:24,976
But the decision I make
is a decision I have to own

722
00:47:25,116 --> 00:47:29,456
and if it's Tara that wins it,
then the only person to blame is me.

723
00:47:44,731 --> 00:47:51,137
(DRAMATIC MUSIC)

724
00:48:14,342 --> 00:48:16,162
I'll now bring in
the members of our jury.

725
00:48:19,782 --> 00:48:20,702
Jarrad,

726
00:48:20,782 --> 00:48:22,282
Anneliese,

727
00:48:22,382 --> 00:48:23,282
Henry,

728
00:48:23,382 --> 00:48:24,722
Sarah,

729
00:48:24,822 --> 00:48:25,722
Luke,

730
00:48:25,822 --> 00:48:27,322
Ziggy,

731
00:48:27,422 --> 00:48:28,322
Locky,

732
00:48:28,422 --> 00:48:29,482
Michelle,

733
00:48:29,622 --> 00:48:31,922
Peter, voted out
in the last Tribal Council.

734
00:48:37,142 --> 00:48:41,282
So here we are, day 55,
final Tribal Council.

735
00:48:41,382 --> 00:48:42,422
Congratulations.

736
00:48:42,502 --> 00:48:43,422
JERICHO: Thank you.

737
00:48:43,542 --> 00:48:48,882
Jericho, Tara, you two have gone
as far as you can go in this game,

738
00:48:49,022 --> 00:48:52,642
and tonight the power now shifts
to the jury.

739
00:48:52,782 --> 00:48:55,702
Nine people you've had a hand -
either directly or indirectly -

740
00:48:55,842 --> 00:48:58,322
voting out from this game
will now decide

741
00:48:58,462 --> 00:49:01,722
which of you two deserves
the title of Sole Survivor

742
00:49:01,862 --> 00:49:04,562
and the half a million dollars
that goes with it.

743
00:49:04,702 --> 00:49:07,162
Now, up until this point,
they've been pretty much quiet.

744
00:49:09,342 --> 00:49:12,122
They're gonna have an opportunity
tonight to address you.

745
00:49:12,262 --> 00:49:15,362
They can ask anything
and you can answer however you want.

746
00:49:15,502 --> 00:49:17,282
But remember,
whatever you say to the jury

747
00:49:17,382 --> 00:49:19,722
could make or break your game.

748
00:49:19,822 --> 00:49:21,242
So this is how it's gonna work.

749
00:49:21,382 --> 00:49:23,322
You will each make an opening statement.

750
00:49:23,462 --> 00:49:26,082
This is your chance to pitch to the jury

751
00:49:26,182 --> 00:49:28,882
why you deserve to win this game.

752
00:49:29,022 --> 00:49:31,322
Then, one by one, they'll address you.

753
00:49:31,462 --> 00:49:35,722
Finally, they'll go to vote
to decide who will win this game.

754
00:49:39,582 --> 00:49:40,842
You ready?

755
00:49:40,942 --> 00:49:42,002
Ready.

756
00:49:42,102 --> 00:49:44,162
Yep. Let's do it.

757
00:49:44,262 --> 00:49:46,442
Tara, you're up.

758
00:49:47,522 --> 00:49:49,922
Hi, guys. Um...

759
00:49:50,062 --> 00:49:54,562
I guess for myself, it was
so hard going against you guys,

760
00:49:54,662 --> 00:49:56,082
I have to say straight off the bat.

761
00:49:56,182 --> 00:49:57,562
It was scary.

762
00:49:57,702 --> 00:50:04,242
Sitting on that barge on day one,
looking around, I was petrified.

763
00:50:04,382 --> 00:50:06,702
Locky's arms were bigger than my legs,

764
00:50:06,842 --> 00:50:10,882
so I knew I had some work to do
and I knew my game plan,

765
00:50:10,982 --> 00:50:12,602
I would have to be a social player.

766
00:50:13,862 --> 00:50:15,362
I spoke to everyone.

767
00:50:15,462 --> 00:50:16,962
I knew I could draw people in,

768
00:50:17,102 --> 00:50:19,282
that it was a way of keeping you guys in

769
00:50:19,422 --> 00:50:21,962
that got me to where I am here today.

770
00:50:24,722 --> 00:50:27,202
You've got to remember, yes,
this is a game,

771
00:50:27,342 --> 00:50:30,082
but I'm a human being
and I have emotions.

772
00:50:32,102 --> 00:50:33,342
When I moved over to Asaga,

773
00:50:33,482 --> 00:50:37,342
I went from the highest high
of being in a great alliance

774
00:50:37,482 --> 00:50:40,842
to the lowest low of feeling like
nobody wants you

775
00:50:40,942 --> 00:50:42,642
and you're pretty well rejected.

776
00:50:44,462 --> 00:50:47,522
So I promised myself I wasn't
just gonna grab on to, like,

777
00:50:47,622 --> 00:50:49,062
two or three people.

778
00:50:49,142 --> 00:50:50,962
I was gonna spread my wings,

779
00:50:51,102 --> 00:50:54,722
making sure I have alliances with
every member in the Asaga group,

780
00:50:54,862 --> 00:50:56,962
so if I ever was in a bottom
of an alliance,

781
00:50:57,102 --> 00:51:00,342
I knew I had a plan A, a plan B
and even a plain C.

782
00:51:02,302 --> 00:51:04,082
When we hit the merge,

783
00:51:04,222 --> 00:51:07,482
I knew straightaway
I was always gonna stick with Locky.

784
00:51:07,622 --> 00:51:10,282
A lot of you guys see Locky as my shield

785
00:51:10,422 --> 00:51:13,522
and I am first to admit
that he was my shield.

786
00:51:13,622 --> 00:51:15,342
I needed someone big and mighty

787
00:51:15,482 --> 00:51:17,602
to get me through
the next couple of Tribals,

788
00:51:17,702 --> 00:51:19,882
so I was happy to tag along.

789
00:51:19,982 --> 00:51:21,882
So then with all that said,

790
00:51:22,022 --> 00:51:25,242
there had to come a time
to take out Locky.

791
00:51:25,382 --> 00:51:29,122
It was my chance to prove
that I have had a shield

792
00:51:29,262 --> 00:51:33,482
but the shield now needs to go and
I have to start using my own armour.

793
00:51:34,622 --> 00:51:38,242
So then day 50, day 51 came,
we were getting close to top three.

794
00:51:38,382 --> 00:51:42,342
I could have went the easy way out
with Petey and Michelle,

795
00:51:42,422 --> 00:51:44,722
but the person I knew

796
00:51:44,862 --> 00:51:48,202
that deserved to be at least
battling out for the top three

797
00:51:48,342 --> 00:51:51,202
and not just getting an easy vote
was Jeri,

798
00:51:51,342 --> 00:51:54,802
and what better way than to fight
with a fire challenge?

799
00:51:56,142 --> 00:51:58,002
All I can say now is,

800
00:51:58,142 --> 00:52:01,582
I feel tonight that this is the spot
that I deserve,

801
00:52:01,722 --> 00:52:04,362
and I just hope I've played
a big enough game

802
00:52:04,462 --> 00:52:06,342
that the jury will respect.

803
00:52:09,942 --> 00:52:10,842
Jericho.

804
00:52:11,882 --> 00:52:13,502
Over to you.

805
00:52:13,622 --> 00:52:16,922
First and foremost,
I just want to thank you all,

806
00:52:17,022 --> 00:52:18,922
to have been a part of this game.

807
00:52:19,062 --> 00:52:22,962
I feel that every single one of you
played an amazing game.

808
00:52:25,942 --> 00:52:30,762
Now. To open the Book of Jericho
that needs to be revealed.

809
00:52:33,162 --> 00:52:36,082
I had one goal that was in my mind

810
00:52:36,182 --> 00:52:39,802
and that was that if I can convince

811
00:52:39,942 --> 00:52:47,522
and make anyone believe that I was
this saint, kind-hearted Jericho,

812
00:52:47,662 --> 00:52:51,362
that would never hurt anybody,
then I was already winning.

813
00:52:54,422 --> 00:52:57,202
At some stage in this game,
everyone really thought that

814
00:52:57,342 --> 00:53:01,442
I was this lovable guy and that
you could find a friend in me.

815
00:53:01,582 --> 00:53:05,402
And friendship was there,
but at the same time,

816
00:53:05,542 --> 00:53:09,442
I was willing to blindside
every single one of you

817
00:53:09,582 --> 00:53:12,442
when I felt it was most important
and useful to me.

818
00:53:14,302 --> 00:53:17,282
But if I wanted to get further
into the game,

819
00:53:17,422 --> 00:53:19,962
I knew that I needed to have people
to use as shields,

820
00:53:20,062 --> 00:53:21,722
so I had the jar of cookies.

821
00:53:22,862 --> 00:53:26,502
With these cookies, I decided
I would take Luke and I told him,

822
00:53:26,622 --> 00:53:29,422
"You are the person that
I feel like I can trust."

823
00:53:29,502 --> 00:53:31,202
Then I told Henry.

824
00:53:31,302 --> 00:53:32,882
I then told Sarah.

825
00:53:34,262 --> 00:53:36,962
I told every single one of those
three different stories

826
00:53:37,062 --> 00:53:38,722
to make them feel special

827
00:53:38,862 --> 00:53:43,122
and so when they had started to feel
like they find loyalty in me,

828
00:53:43,222 --> 00:53:44,402
I was like, great.

829
00:53:44,502 --> 00:53:46,802
I have three shields that I can use.

830
00:53:46,942 --> 00:53:49,282
All I needed was that
they get to the merge.

831
00:53:52,462 --> 00:53:56,802
One thing that I can tell you is
that everything that I did

832
00:53:56,902 --> 00:53:58,882
I can say that they were my moves

833
00:53:59,022 --> 00:54:01,722
and I'm not going to try
and hide that away.

834
00:54:03,262 --> 00:54:07,162
I feel that, to respect this game
is to make risky moves

835
00:54:07,302 --> 00:54:09,922
and make sure that they were big moves,

836
00:54:10,062 --> 00:54:15,062
and I feel that every player here
see that these big moves

837
00:54:15,202 --> 00:54:18,482
is how you respect this thing
that we call Survivor.

838
00:54:18,622 --> 00:54:22,802
You know, I stood in front of you
and won three individual challenges.

839
00:54:22,942 --> 00:54:25,602
I won the immunity challenge
that was most important,

840
00:54:25,742 --> 00:54:27,362
that guaranteed me a spot
in the final two.

841
00:54:28,862 --> 00:54:33,202
I won an individual challenge which
proved to you that I can make a fire

842
00:54:33,342 --> 00:54:37,082
and I gained an advantage that
refined this whole entire jury

843
00:54:37,182 --> 00:54:38,802
to be in my favour.

844
00:54:40,502 --> 00:54:42,562
They were game changing moves.

845
00:54:43,702 --> 00:54:47,842
And that's why I am sitting here
and I came up on top.

846
00:54:51,342 --> 00:54:55,522
Alright, jury, you've heard
from both Tara and Jericho.

847
00:54:55,622 --> 00:54:57,402
Now it's gonna be your turn.

848
00:54:59,022 --> 00:55:00,702
Ask your questions wisely,

849
00:55:00,822 --> 00:55:05,202
get everything you need to make that
half million dollar decision.

850
00:55:23,178 --> 00:55:26,818
Alright, jury, you've heard
from both Tara and Jericho.

851
00:55:26,898 --> 00:55:29,598
Now it's gonna be your turn.

852
00:55:31,718 --> 00:55:34,598
Michelle, you're first up.

853
00:55:41,418 --> 00:55:45,118
Congratulations, first of all.
You're both sitting there.

854
00:55:47,638 --> 00:55:53,038
The question I've gotta ask is -

855
00:55:53,178 --> 00:55:57,998
tell me the biggest move
you made in the game.

856
00:55:58,138 --> 00:56:01,538
I want one that you yourself
have orchestrated.

857
00:56:02,978 --> 00:56:06,438
So, Tara, I'm gonna let you go first.

858
00:56:06,538 --> 00:56:07,758
Trying to get Locky out.

859
00:56:09,338 --> 00:56:13,198
Around day 40 I went up to Luke
and Jericho and I said, "I'm ready.

860
00:56:13,338 --> 00:56:16,358
"If you guys want to come on board,
I'm ready to take out Locky."

861
00:56:18,298 --> 00:56:20,818
The reason why I wanted
to get Locky out was

862
00:56:20,958 --> 00:56:26,638
I wanted to allow myself at least
15 days of proving that, yes,

863
00:56:26,778 --> 00:56:29,538
I used him as a shield
and now I'm on my own.

864
00:56:31,138 --> 00:56:32,998
Now, we weren't expected

865
00:56:33,138 --> 00:56:35,678
that he was gonna keep winning
Immunity Necklaces, so...

866
00:56:37,418 --> 00:56:39,918
..I couldn't get him out
until day 49.

867
00:56:43,278 --> 00:56:44,878
Jericho.

868
00:56:45,018 --> 00:56:48,898
I believe my biggest move was
when I had my moral dilemma.

869
00:56:49,018 --> 00:56:51,638
I decided I wanted to make this
jar of cookies

870
00:56:51,738 --> 00:56:54,078
just as powerful as an idol,

871
00:56:54,218 --> 00:56:56,438
and so I decided to take
three people that

872
00:56:56,578 --> 00:56:59,538
I saw in Asaga were
the most crucial people,

873
00:56:59,658 --> 00:57:02,678
and they will be the people that
I feel that I could take with me

874
00:57:02,778 --> 00:57:03,958
to use as shields.

875
00:57:05,818 --> 00:57:08,818
I told every single one of
those three different stories

876
00:57:08,898 --> 00:57:10,918
to make them feel special and wanted

877
00:57:11,058 --> 00:57:14,358
and know that their alliance
was basically to me.

878
00:57:16,838 --> 00:57:20,558
That's why I've got myself further
in the game, because I had shields,

879
00:57:20,658 --> 00:57:23,838
and I also felt like I didn't float

880
00:57:23,978 --> 00:57:29,178
because I made this coalition
on my own and they didn't know that.

881
00:57:30,698 --> 00:57:32,838
OK. Good luck, guys.

882
00:57:38,518 --> 00:57:40,318
Anneliese, you're up.

883
00:57:44,778 --> 00:57:46,198
