- Hi, Anneliese.
- Hi, guys.

884
00:57:46,338 --> 00:57:48,758
First and foremost,
huge congratulations.

885
00:57:48,898 --> 00:57:51,678
I'm so happy for you that the
two of you are sitting here.

886
00:57:51,778 --> 00:57:54,558
Jeri, when I came over to Asaga,

887
00:57:54,658 --> 00:57:56,838
the perception that I had of things

888
00:57:56,978 --> 00:57:58,758
was that you were working
very closely with Luke

889
00:57:58,898 --> 00:58:01,198
and that you were maybe
even riding Luke's coat-tails

890
00:58:01,298 --> 00:58:02,538
a little bit.

891
00:58:02,658 --> 00:58:04,758
But I want to give you
a right of reply -

892
00:58:04,898 --> 00:58:07,478
a way to counteract the things
that I've been thinking.

893
00:58:08,698 --> 00:58:11,998
Yeah, I believe that people
will perceive me as the person

894
00:58:12,138 --> 00:58:17,838
that rode Luke's coat-tails,
but I look at it as Santa Claus.

895
00:58:17,978 --> 00:58:20,558
You ride the sleigh,
but I'm the one with the whip.

896
00:58:22,118 --> 00:58:24,998
There were times where he would try
and tell me what to do

897
00:58:25,138 --> 00:58:26,558
and I'd say, "No, that's not happening

898
00:58:26,658 --> 00:58:27,838
"'cause that's not logical."

899
00:58:27,978 --> 00:58:32,838
Like, I had the whip
and he was the reindeer.

900
00:58:32,938 --> 00:58:34,598
(LAUGHS)

901
00:58:34,698 --> 00:58:35,878
OK.

902
00:58:36,018 --> 00:58:38,638
- Tara.
- Yes.

903
00:58:38,778 --> 00:58:41,438
If I were to put you
and Jericho on a pedestal,

904
00:58:41,578 --> 00:58:44,838
Jericho would be a little higher
than you at this point in time.

905
00:58:44,978 --> 00:58:47,598
What I want to know is how and why

906
00:58:47,738 --> 00:58:51,038
it's strategic to sit
next to Jericho here.

907
00:58:51,178 --> 00:58:54,078
How does that benefit
your own personal game play.

908
00:58:55,478 --> 00:58:58,558
I wanted to fight for my spot
and I wanted to go against

909
00:58:58,698 --> 00:59:02,118
someone that out of the four of us
deserved to be battling it out

910
00:59:02,218 --> 00:59:03,398
for the top three.

911
00:59:03,538 --> 00:59:07,358
I knew he was good at challenges -
we had one more challenge to go -

912
00:59:07,498 --> 00:59:10,038
so I knew it was going to be
between him and Petey,

913
00:59:10,178 --> 00:59:12,318
and I was hoping it was going to be
Jericho

914
00:59:12,418 --> 00:59:14,918
that won the Immunity Necklace.

915
00:59:15,058 --> 00:59:17,278
Once I knew that necklace was his

916
00:59:17,418 --> 00:59:21,318
I was hoping that because I did
help him get to the fire challenge

917
00:59:21,418 --> 00:59:22,478
he would take me.

918
00:59:23,718 --> 00:59:24,838
Thank you, both of you.

919
00:59:24,978 --> 00:59:28,838
I want to let you know that my mind
is open and I'm willing to listen to

920
00:59:28,978 --> 00:59:30,918
anything that you guys
have to say tonight.

921
00:59:31,018 --> 00:59:32,238
BOTH: Thank you.

922
00:59:34,498 --> 00:59:35,878
Locky, you're next.

923
00:59:40,018 --> 00:59:43,538
Congratulations, guys.
55 days, that's amazing.

924
00:59:45,738 --> 00:59:47,178
- Tara.
- Yeah.

925
00:59:48,778 --> 00:59:51,238
I'm super-proud of you
planning to get me out.

926
00:59:51,338 --> 00:59:53,318
Oh, good.

927
00:59:53,458 --> 00:59:56,278
I knew it was coming and, like,
I'm not bitter or anything about it.

928
00:59:56,418 --> 00:59:57,918
I'm super-proud for you
that you did it.

929
00:59:59,578 --> 01:00:02,878
Jericho, my question to you was, the
day we went out swimming and stuff,

930
01:00:03,018 --> 01:00:04,958
like, to me that was
a pure, genuine moment.

931
01:00:05,058 --> 01:00:07,078
And I just wanted to know -

932
01:00:07,218 --> 01:00:10,638
was that genuine to you
or was that just game play?

933
01:00:10,778 --> 01:00:15,818
That was probably one of the biggest
highlights of this entire game.

934
01:00:15,898 --> 01:00:17,478
Oh, awesome.

935
01:00:17,578 --> 01:00:19,878
The minute you left, I spoke to Tara

936
01:00:19,978 --> 01:00:23,078
and I really said that I truly found

937
01:00:23,218 --> 01:00:26,958
somebody that I could actually hang
out with outside of this game.

938
01:00:28,938 --> 01:00:31,958
I saw the Locky that
wasn't playing the game.

939
01:00:33,178 --> 01:00:35,638
I'm very proud of both of you. Well
done, guys. Thank you very much.

940
01:00:35,778 --> 01:00:36,638
- Thanks, Locky.
- Thank you.

941
01:00:40,158 --> 01:00:41,758
Ziggy, it's your turn.

942
01:00:44,278 --> 01:00:45,198
Congratulations.

943
01:00:45,338 --> 01:00:47,638
I know we're all super-jealous
that it's not us sitting there,

944
01:00:47,778 --> 01:00:52,178
but you did outlast us all,
so hat off to you both.

945
01:00:52,298 --> 01:00:56,118
My question is to both of you.
I'll let Jericho go first.

946
01:00:56,258 --> 01:00:59,838
So, Jericho, why do you think
Tara should be the Sole Survivor?

947
01:01:00,978 --> 01:01:03,318
- Oh, that's a good one.
- That's a good one.

948
01:01:03,418 --> 01:01:06,278
I think Tara has evolved.

949
01:01:06,378 --> 01:01:08,678
Originally she acted on emotions

950
01:01:08,818 --> 01:01:11,638
and definitely wore
her heart on her sleeve.

951
01:01:11,778 --> 01:01:15,038
Then the second half of this game
she started to change it up,

952
01:01:15,178 --> 01:01:18,818
she started realising that if she
wants to get far into this game,

953
01:01:18,958 --> 01:01:21,598
she has to start making big moves
and risky ones

954
01:01:21,698 --> 01:01:23,838
and controversial ones.

955
01:01:23,978 --> 01:01:28,078
She just put herself on the line
and it was, like, mad respect.

956
01:01:28,218 --> 01:01:32,358
And that's why I think she deserves
to be here and be a Sole Survivor.

957
01:01:35,298 --> 01:01:37,758
Alright, Tara, why do you think
Jericho should be the Sole Survivor?

958
01:01:37,898 --> 01:01:42,678
The strategising aside,
the fella is 159cm?

959
01:01:42,778 --> 01:01:43,678
Mm.

960
01:01:43,818 --> 01:01:47,478
And he drags logs that are twice his
size from the one end of the beach

961
01:01:47,618 --> 01:01:51,458
to the other and he makes sure
that fire is always going.

962
01:01:51,598 --> 01:01:54,478
He makes sure that
we've always got food, comfort.

963
01:01:54,578 --> 01:01:57,178
When there was 12 of us in the hut,

964
01:01:57,298 --> 01:01:59,558
he was the one that was sleeping at
the bottom of our feet like a dog,

965
01:01:59,658 --> 01:02:01,398
because he knew there was no room.

966
01:02:02,838 --> 01:02:05,078
Jericho's heart has got him
where he is today,

967
01:02:05,218 --> 01:02:07,838
and this is why he deserves to be here.

968
01:02:09,118 --> 01:02:12,458
- Alright, cool. Well, congrats, guys.
- BOTH: Thanks, Ziggy.

969
01:02:14,278 --> 01:02:15,458
I'm sweating.

970
01:02:16,698 --> 01:02:18,198
Jarrad, you're up.

971
01:02:22,838 --> 01:02:27,558
Now, I'm sure you guys know, I've
been on the jury for a long time.

972
01:02:27,658 --> 01:02:29,598
(ALL LAUGH)

973
01:02:29,738 --> 01:02:34,838
I have had to sit there listening
to how great everybody's game is

974
01:02:34,978 --> 01:02:38,558
and how everything was
everybody else's fault,

975
01:02:38,698 --> 01:02:41,958
and all the amazing players
are sitting here.

976
01:02:42,058 --> 01:02:43,878
But that's it, we are sitting here

977
01:02:44,018 --> 01:02:46,458
and you two are the ones
that are still in the game,

978
01:02:46,538 --> 01:02:48,598
so, Tara and Jericho, well done.

979
01:02:48,698 --> 01:02:50,198
BOTH: Thank you.

980
01:02:50,338 --> 01:02:52,238
Now, one of you will
walk away the winner,

981
01:02:52,378 --> 01:02:56,178
one of you will unfortunately
join the ranks of us

982
01:02:56,258 --> 01:02:57,478
and walk away with nothing.

983
01:02:59,298 --> 01:03:03,718
Let's say, Jericho,
you walk away with nothing.

984
01:03:03,858 --> 01:03:08,458
Let's say you lose tonight. If you
lose tonight, where did it go wrong?

985
01:03:11,058 --> 01:03:13,818
I believe that my mistake

986
01:03:13,958 --> 01:03:16,358
that could cost me
the whole, entire game

987
01:03:16,458 --> 01:03:19,358
was to send home Tessa off the jury.

988
01:03:20,618 --> 01:03:24,678
I don't know exactly what
she would have done at the jury,

989
01:03:24,818 --> 01:03:27,958
but Tessa could have
potentially been the person

990
01:03:28,058 --> 01:03:30,678
that could have vouched for me.

991
01:03:30,778 --> 01:03:32,998
And the thing is, I won't know...

992
01:03:34,638 --> 01:03:36,478
..because I have taken her out.

993
01:03:38,458 --> 01:03:40,358
I do have some final words for you,
Jericho.

994
01:03:40,458 --> 01:03:42,278
Yeah, sure.

995
01:03:42,378 --> 01:03:44,238
I came to you after the merge,

996
01:03:44,378 --> 01:03:46,598
we discussed who
we would vote for that night

997
01:03:46,738 --> 01:03:49,358
and we would send a message
to each other

998
01:03:49,498 --> 01:03:53,458
with an underline to
show our trust was there.

999
01:03:53,538 --> 01:03:57,278
Now, you voted for me that night,

1000
01:03:57,418 --> 01:04:00,958
and to add salt to the wound
you underlined my name.

1001
01:04:02,358 --> 01:04:03,598
Now, Jericho...

1002
01:04:04,898 --> 01:04:06,878
..what goes around comes around.

1003
01:04:08,418 --> 01:04:09,818
And when I go up to write tonight...

1004
01:04:12,478 --> 01:04:15,118
..I'm gonna be sending a message
to you with an underline as well.

1005
01:04:20,218 --> 01:04:22,038
Cheers, guys.

1006
01:04:26,358 --> 01:04:28,918
Holy shit-balls, that was good.

1007
01:04:47,142 --> 01:04:48,682
Sarah, it's your turn.

1008
01:04:54,222 --> 01:04:55,722
Well, I'm a little bit nervous.

1009
01:04:57,262 --> 01:04:59,562
Firstly, congratulations
to the both of you.

1010
01:04:59,662 --> 01:05:02,362
This is an amazing achievement.

1011
01:05:02,502 --> 01:05:07,122
So, in saying that, Jericho,
the thing is,

1012
01:05:07,262 --> 01:05:11,542
your game seems to be panicked
and convenient at times.

1013
01:05:12,922 --> 01:05:14,402
In the last few Tribals

1014
01:05:14,542 --> 01:05:17,042
you've talked a lot about playing
a fearless game.

1015
01:05:17,142 --> 01:05:18,322
So much so that you said

1016
01:05:18,462 --> 01:05:21,122
that you fearlessly stood by
your core alliance members.

1017
01:05:21,262 --> 01:05:25,082
Now, in the vote that
I was sent home, in your own words,

1018
01:05:25,222 --> 01:05:29,042
you said that, "When a cat is
drowning you don't save it."

1019
01:05:29,142 --> 01:05:30,482
So, you let me go home.

1020
01:05:32,202 --> 01:05:34,902
And in your opening pitch you said that

1021
01:05:35,022 --> 01:05:38,202
if the one thing that you could do
was to convince people

1022
01:05:38,342 --> 01:05:43,602
that you were nice when really you
were a lying, villainous character.

1023
01:05:45,342 --> 01:05:47,762
I've heard you contradict
that in your answers tonight.

1024
01:05:47,902 --> 01:05:49,762
You have said that
you are actually nice.

1025
01:05:49,862 --> 01:05:52,122
Yeah.

1026
01:05:52,262 --> 01:05:56,602
I'm confused, so this is your chance
to clarify what you meant by that.

1027
01:05:58,202 --> 01:06:02,002
I came into this game
with the real raw me,

1028
01:06:02,142 --> 01:06:06,022
and that is this person that
I feel like I find passion

1029
01:06:06,162 --> 01:06:08,322
in selflessly doing things for others.

1030
01:06:09,662 --> 01:06:13,182
But in this game where
the prime goal is to make sure

1031
01:06:13,322 --> 01:06:17,442
you lie to people and manipulate
just for your selfish gain...

1032
01:06:18,662 --> 01:06:22,762
..I feel like I couldn't
just do the raw me

1033
01:06:22,902 --> 01:06:26,002
and say that, yeah, I will
selflessly do things for others,

1034
01:06:26,142 --> 01:06:29,402
because if I did,
then I would be acting on emotions.

1035
01:06:30,702 --> 01:06:32,122
And I feel like in this game,

1036
01:06:32,262 --> 01:06:36,002
when you do act on emotion
it ends up doing wrong moves.

1037
01:06:36,142 --> 01:06:41,002
And that's the reason why I felt
like I had to be capable of lying

1038
01:06:41,142 --> 01:06:43,962
and I had to be capable
of manipulating others.

1039
01:06:45,182 --> 01:06:47,962
That is how I'm trying
to explain my story.

1040
01:06:51,502 --> 01:06:53,322
(THUNDER CRACKS)

1041
01:06:56,982 --> 01:06:58,642
OK. Thanks.

1042
01:06:58,742 --> 01:07:01,002
Thanks.

1043
01:07:01,142 --> 01:07:02,962
I can't believe it's raining
on the last Tribal Council.

1044
01:07:03,102 --> 01:07:05,542
Well, you guys started the game
in the rain.

1045
01:07:05,662 --> 01:07:07,762
It looks like you're gonna
finish it in the rain.

1046
01:07:07,862 --> 01:07:09,562
Luke, you're up.

1047
01:07:10,802 --> 01:07:11,722
(GROANS)

1048
01:07:14,202 --> 01:07:16,482
- Alrighty.
- (ALL LAUGH)

1049
01:07:16,622 --> 01:07:18,902
Man, it feels like I'm
back on the boat, day one.

1050
01:07:20,362 --> 01:07:22,002
I'll start off with you, Tara.

1051
01:07:22,102 --> 01:07:24,322
I wanna say congratulations.

1052
01:07:24,462 --> 01:07:28,122
55 days, it is
a massive task to get here.

1053
01:07:28,262 --> 01:07:31,922
I just think you've played
a good game. You're a good person.

1054
01:07:32,022 --> 01:07:33,322
Yeah, I'll just move on to Jeri.

1055
01:07:35,422 --> 01:07:37,402
Jericho, my boy!

1056
01:07:37,502 --> 01:07:38,842
I had the most memorable moments

1057
01:07:38,982 --> 01:07:41,602
throughout the whole game with you,
brother.

1058
01:07:41,742 --> 01:07:43,922
As much as people say it
about riding coat-tails,

1059
01:07:44,062 --> 01:07:47,322
I feel like we were always
coming together talking about

1060
01:07:47,462 --> 01:07:50,302
divide and conquer
and creating conflict,

1061
01:07:50,442 --> 01:07:54,002
and so our discussions were quite even.

1062
01:07:55,642 --> 01:07:57,202
Obviously we'd go off

1063
01:07:57,342 --> 01:08:01,122
and I would bring conversations
about who to get out, maybe more.

1064
01:08:02,742 --> 01:08:06,402
But I still believe that you deserve
credit to a lot of those moves.

1065
01:08:08,262 --> 01:08:10,082
Alright, sweet.

1066
01:08:11,982 --> 01:08:14,682
Alright, Peter. It's your turn.

1067
01:08:14,782 --> 01:08:17,842
Oh, no. He's gonna hammer me.

1068
01:08:17,942 --> 01:08:19,322
Hey, I'm not gonna blast you. Chill.

1069
01:08:19,462 --> 01:08:21,082
- Oh, really?
- Yeah.

1070
01:08:23,422 --> 01:08:26,122
- Congratulations, guys - final two.
- Thanks, Petey.

1071
01:08:26,222 --> 01:08:28,542
Tara, I'm gonna start with you.

1072
01:08:28,662 --> 01:08:32,182
For a lot of this game,
you were under Locky's wing.

1073
01:08:32,302 --> 01:08:34,602
And I want to know a move that you made

1074
01:08:34,702 --> 01:08:36,682
during the time under Locky's wing

1075
01:08:36,822 --> 01:08:39,842
that you personally contributed to
or influenced.

1076
01:08:41,082 --> 01:08:42,282
We got AK out.

1077
01:08:43,702 --> 01:08:47,182
It has to go back to when
I went up to you and Ziggy

1078
01:08:47,302 --> 01:08:51,962
and Jarrad on the beach at Samatau
and I said, "Let's bring in Tessa.

1079
01:08:52,102 --> 01:08:55,322
"Let's bring in her as a number
and get rid of AK."

1080
01:08:55,462 --> 01:08:57,882
That was under Locky's wing,
and I remember he was like,

1081
01:08:58,022 --> 01:08:59,462
"I don't wanna do it.
I don't wanna do it."

1082
01:08:59,542 --> 01:09:01,082
It didn't go forward,

1083
01:09:01,222 --> 01:09:04,722
but then another twist happened
with the tribe swap.

1084
01:09:04,862 --> 01:09:07,762
I already feel that I gave you guys
enough info about AK to say,

1085
01:09:07,862 --> 01:09:09,722
"We've gotta get him out."

1086
01:09:09,822 --> 01:09:11,602
That was me coming out with a move.

1087
01:09:14,062 --> 01:09:18,822
Jericho, I want you to tell me in
three key words what was your game.

1088
01:09:19,902 --> 01:09:22,482
Adaptable. Flexible.

1089
01:09:22,622 --> 01:09:24,362
'Adaptable' and 'flexible'
are too similar.

1090
01:09:24,462 --> 01:09:26,182
OK, sorry.

1091
01:09:27,542 --> 01:09:29,922
OK. Adaptable.

1092
01:09:31,162 --> 01:09:32,882
Under the radar.

1093
01:09:32,982 --> 01:09:33,962
And deadly.

1094
01:09:35,542 --> 01:09:39,082
Cool. Thank you guys so much. I'm
excited to vote and see who wins.

1095
01:09:39,222 --> 01:09:41,362
- Thanks, Petey.
- (WHISPERS) Thanks, Pete.

1096
01:09:42,702 --> 01:09:44,722
Alright, Henry, you're up.

1097
01:09:47,253 --> 01:09:48,313
Namaste, y'all.

1098
01:09:49,533 --> 01:09:51,073
Let's finish with a bang, yeah?

1099
01:09:51,213 --> 01:09:52,473
- Go for it.
- Alright.

1100
01:09:52,613 --> 01:09:55,033
Tara, I want you to saddle up
'cause the barrels are coming.

1101
01:09:55,173 --> 01:09:57,553
Jericho, put your seatbelt on
'cause there is turbulence coming.

1102
01:09:57,693 --> 01:09:59,813
- Yes.
- (ALL LAUGH)

1103
01:09:59,893 --> 01:10:03,313
Alright. Tara, are you ready?

1104
01:10:03,413 --> 01:10:04,873
I'm saddled up.

1105
01:10:05,013 --> 01:10:06,753
The best thing about Australian Survivor

1106
01:10:06,853 --> 01:10:08,173
is that it goes for 55 days.

1107
01:10:08,253 --> 01:10:11,353
You get 55 days to build a game.

1108
01:10:11,493 --> 01:10:15,453
For me, I came in as a fake
yoga instructor from day one

1109
01:10:15,533 --> 01:10:17,453
and built a game around that.

1110
01:10:18,893 --> 01:10:20,713
All the way until I got kicked out.

1111
01:10:20,853 --> 01:10:23,393
What day did you start playing the game

1112
01:10:23,533 --> 01:10:25,553
and how did you start playing the game?

1113
01:10:25,653 --> 01:10:27,313
Honestly?

1114
01:10:29,053 --> 01:10:31,553
I started playing the game
when Locky went home

1115
01:10:31,653 --> 01:10:33,073
and I was on my own two feet.

1116
01:10:35,113 --> 01:10:39,753
I used only six days to
make some pretty big moves.

1117
01:10:39,893 --> 01:10:43,873
That might have been too late
or not enough for some people,

1118
01:10:43,973 --> 01:10:45,873
but that is my honest answer.

1119
01:10:47,133 --> 01:10:48,193
I'll just do a little pitch for you,

1120
01:10:48,333 --> 01:10:50,353
'cause you're not the best at speaking.

1121
01:10:50,453 --> 01:10:52,113
I'm not the best at speaking?

1122
01:10:52,253 --> 01:10:56,353
Um... you survived on
your social game to get to the end.

1123
01:10:56,493 --> 01:10:58,233
You're sitting there,
and not only sitting there,

1124
01:10:58,373 --> 01:11:02,033
you were pivotal in deciding
if Jericho could get to the end.

1125
01:11:02,173 --> 01:11:04,913
So, you chose, you kept him alive
and you got him there.

1126
01:11:05,053 --> 01:11:07,913
You've basically stated that
you didn't have any moves.

1127
01:11:08,053 --> 01:11:11,753
All the jury, all I hear is
"All our big moves put us there."

1128
01:11:11,893 --> 01:11:14,593
Maybe she's the smart one saying,
"I'm not gonna make my big moves

1129
01:11:14,733 --> 01:11:18,533
"till the final seconds, and then
that's how I'm gonna win this game."

1130
01:11:23,093 --> 01:11:28,673
Jericho, I've seen some moves
which in my eyes are inconsistent,

1131
01:11:28,813 --> 01:11:31,113
confusing and detrimental
to your game play.

1132
01:11:32,413 --> 01:11:34,033
You're talking about these shields.

1133
01:11:34,173 --> 01:11:36,833
My understanding is you use
the shield to protect yourself,

1134
01:11:36,973 --> 01:11:40,273
you don't get that shield and then
stab it yourself by voting them out.

1135
01:11:42,293 --> 01:11:44,753
You did that to shield Sarah
and shield me.

1136
01:11:48,013 --> 01:11:49,913
Next thing, you had one of the biggest,

1137
01:11:50,053 --> 01:11:53,813
most powerful moments in the game -
you could send a jury member home.

1138
01:11:54,913 --> 01:11:56,273
It was a bad move.

1139
01:11:57,693 --> 01:12:00,453
One, Tessa basically said she
thought Tara was the weaker player,

1140
01:12:00,593 --> 01:12:03,353
yet you still vote her out and yet
you still brought Tara to the end.

1141
01:12:05,453 --> 01:12:10,533
So, all I want to know is
do you think you had good moves

1142
01:12:10,673 --> 01:12:13,633
that outweigh what I believe the bad
moves were in your game play?

1143
01:12:19,653 --> 01:12:22,953
Yeah, I feel like I have to own
all the decisions I make.

1144
01:12:24,813 --> 01:12:26,673
I knew that when it comes to the merge

1145
01:12:26,813 --> 01:12:29,913
you were working with all these
people that were quality players,

1146
01:12:30,053 --> 01:12:32,953
and there was gonna be a point
where every single dangerous player

1147
01:12:33,093 --> 01:12:35,093
was going to be knocked out, regardless.

1148
01:12:36,573 --> 01:12:39,993
It could have been me at that point,
and so when I started realising

1149
01:12:40,133 --> 01:12:43,813
that I was in jeopardy I knew that
I needed to have an escape goat.

1150
01:12:43,933 --> 01:12:46,393
It meant that I had to
make sure there was conflict

1151
01:12:46,493 --> 01:12:47,393
between two parties.

1152
01:12:47,493 --> 01:12:48,953
And as long as there was conflict,

1153
01:12:49,093 --> 01:12:51,273
I was basically eating
an invisible popcorn

1154
01:12:51,373 --> 01:12:53,393
watching two people battling out.

1155
01:12:53,533 --> 01:12:55,813
And that's why I felt like I manoeuvred

1156
01:12:55,893 --> 01:12:57,393
through a lot of Tribal Councils

1157
01:12:57,533 --> 01:12:59,473
where my name was never written down.

1158
01:12:59,613 --> 01:13:02,993
When you're actually on the island
you have to make lies

1159
01:13:03,133 --> 01:13:05,393
in order to make sure
you cover yourself.

1160
01:13:05,533 --> 01:13:07,393
You have to start thinking
outside of the box.

1161
01:13:09,113 --> 01:13:12,713
I decided that I was going to take
that route, make great moves

1162
01:13:12,853 --> 01:13:17,633
and see that I can blindside
and do things like lying

1163
01:13:17,773 --> 01:13:20,633
and deceiving that I don't normally do.

1164
01:13:20,773 --> 01:13:25,553
And I can confidently say that,
yeah, I have your blood on my hands,

1165
01:13:25,653 --> 01:13:27,713
and I'm fine with that.

1166
01:13:30,933 --> 01:13:33,553
And that's why I still am sitting here,

1167
01:13:33,693 --> 01:13:35,753
and I feel like that's why
you're sitting there.

1168
01:13:39,613 --> 01:13:41,453
Great answer.

1169
01:13:41,593 --> 01:13:44,453
Guys, you got there, you smashed us.
Love you all.

1170
01:13:49,533 --> 01:13:54,313
OK, well, jury, you've had your
chance to address Jericho and Tara,

1171
01:13:54,453 --> 01:13:57,633
you've heard everything
they've had to say.

1172
01:13:57,773 --> 01:14:00,113
You should have enough information
now to decide

1173
01:14:00,253 --> 01:14:03,393
who you think most deserves
the title of Sole Survivor

1174
01:14:03,533 --> 01:14:05,273
and the half-million
that goes with it.

1175
01:14:05,413 --> 01:14:09,393
Now, remember tonight
you are voting for a winner.

1176
01:14:13,693 --> 01:14:14,813
For the last time...

1177
01:14:16,913 --> 01:14:18,193
..it is time to vote.

1178
01:14:19,893 --> 01:14:20,993
Jarrad, you're up.

1179
01:14:53,333 --> 01:14:58,553
Tara, I came into this vote tonight
really undecided

1180
01:14:58,693 --> 01:15:02,313
and I'm actually quite surprised
at where my vote has ended up.

1181
01:15:02,453 --> 01:15:04,453
I hope you win
and I hope my vote gets you there.

1182
01:15:14,613 --> 01:15:18,553
I've seen your game over 55 days,
and it was entertaining.

1183
01:15:18,693 --> 01:15:22,833
And we did do good moves,
so, goddamn, alright.

1184
01:15:58,333 --> 01:15:59,633
I'll go count the votes.

1185
01:16:14,753 --> 01:16:17,313
Guys, it's been an incredible season.

1186
01:16:17,453 --> 01:16:19,393
You've all played hard and played well.

1187
01:16:20,753 --> 01:16:23,233
Whoever wins this game
definitely deserves it.

1188
01:16:25,473 --> 01:16:27,953
Now all that's left to do
is read the votes.

1189
01:16:31,533 --> 01:16:32,513
But...

1190
01:16:35,373 --> 01:16:37,633
..I'm gonna do that
back in Australia.

1191
01:16:37,733 --> 01:16:40,033
(ALL EXCLAIM)

1192
01:16:40,133 --> 01:16:42,513
No!

1193
01:16:42,653 --> 01:16:45,593
- I'll see you guys there.
- Oh, my God!

1194
01:16:47,333 --> 01:16:49,153
(ALL EXCLAIM)

1195
01:16:51,433 --> 01:16:53,353
Oh, my God.

1196
01:17:29,168 --> 01:17:35,359
(DRAMATIC MUSIC)

1197
01:17:35,359 --> 01:17:41,331
(CHEERING, APPLAUSE)

1198
01:17:46,183 --> 01:17:52,827
(LOUD CHEERING)

1199
01:18:02,192 --> 01:18:05,198
Wow.

1200
01:18:05,779 --> 01:18:08,678
Wow!

1201
01:18:09,315 --> 01:18:12,370
Crazy!

1202
01:18:12,849 --> 01:18:17,890
(CHEERING CONTINUES)

1203
01:18:24,678 --> 01:18:25,898
Welcome to the finale.

1204
01:18:25,998 --> 01:18:29,018
(CHEERING AND WHOOPING)

1205
01:18:29,118 --> 01:18:32,138
Alright. OK. Let's get to it.

1206
01:18:32,278 --> 01:18:35,898
Look, it has been an incredible
season of twists and turns

1207
01:18:36,038 --> 01:18:38,298
and blindsides -
a lot of blindsides.

1208
01:18:38,438 --> 01:18:41,498
It was Survivor at its absolute best.

1209
01:18:41,598 --> 01:18:44,458
And it's all thanks to you guys.

1210
01:18:44,558 --> 01:18:47,458
(CHEERING, APPLAUSE)

1211
01:18:50,958 --> 01:18:55,378
Tara, Jericho, you guys
did what 22 others couldn't,

1212
01:18:55,478 --> 01:18:57,078
you made it to Day 55.

1213
01:18:57,158 --> 01:18:58,818
Congratulations.

1214
01:19:04,718 --> 01:19:07,338
OK. So, you made your pitch
to the jury.

1215
01:19:07,478 --> 01:19:11,538
And in the final twist of the game,
some say it's the cruellest twist,

1216
01:19:11,678 --> 01:19:13,898
but the people that you voted out
and put over there,

1217
01:19:14,038 --> 01:19:15,738
they are the ones who have now decided

1218
01:19:15,878 --> 01:19:20,618
which of you two
deserves to win this game.

1219
01:19:21,958 --> 01:19:24,618
- Tara, you seem nervous.
- Oh, I'm nervous.

1220
01:19:24,758 --> 01:19:25,618
- You are?
- Yep.

1221
01:19:25,758 --> 01:19:28,258
- I don't speak when I'm nervous.
- (CHUCKLES) OK. Alright.

1222
01:19:28,398 --> 01:19:31,138
- This is me really nervous.
- That's you really nervous.

1223
01:19:31,238 --> 01:19:33,298
Jericho, what's your gut on this?

1224
01:19:33,398 --> 01:19:34,978
Oh, I'm shaking.

1225
01:19:35,078 --> 01:19:37,438
But I'm proud of my experience.

1226
01:19:37,518 --> 01:19:38,458
I'm proud of my game

1227
01:19:38,598 --> 01:19:42,858
and I hope I made Australia proud,
my family proud, the fans proud

1228
01:19:42,958 --> 01:19:44,078
and Survivor.

1229
01:19:44,158 --> 01:19:45,378
(CHEERING, APPLAUSE)

1230
01:19:50,198 --> 01:19:52,978
- Ask me again. Ask me again.
- (LAUGHS)

1231
01:19:53,078 --> 01:19:57,458
OK. Alright, guys. Moment of truth.

1232
01:19:58,738 --> 01:20:02,218
One of you
is about to be crowned Sole Survivor

1233
01:20:02,318 --> 01:20:04,258
and walk away with $500,000.

1234
01:20:04,358 --> 01:20:07,798
(CHEERING, APPLAUSE)

1235
01:20:11,958 --> 01:20:13,938
- Are you ready?
- Yeah.

1236
01:20:14,078 --> 01:20:17,458
OK. Remember,
these are votes for a winner.

1237
01:20:17,558 --> 01:20:18,818
Mm-hm.

1238
01:20:18,958 --> 01:20:22,438
For the final time,
I'm going to read the votes.

1239
01:20:23,678 --> 01:20:25,378
I'm really proud of you.

1240
01:20:27,598 --> 01:20:29,098
Whoo.

1241
01:20:30,118 --> 01:20:33,498
First vote...

1242
01:20:33,598 --> 01:20:35,718
Jericho.

1243
01:20:35,798 --> 01:20:37,538
(CHEERING, APPLAUSE)

1244
01:20:44,798 --> 01:20:46,438
Jericho.

1245
01:20:54,618 --> 01:20:55,538
Tara.

1246
01:20:55,638 --> 01:20:57,938
(CHEERING, APPLAUSE)

1247
01:21:02,878 --> 01:21:05,078
Hmm. Tara.

1248
01:21:08,798 --> 01:21:10,658
We're tied.

1249
01:21:10,758 --> 01:21:14,298
Two votes Tara, two votes Jericho.

1250
01:21:18,238 --> 01:21:19,138
Tara.

1251
01:21:23,258 --> 01:21:25,738
Three votes Tara, two votes Jericho.

1252
01:21:29,318 --> 01:21:30,218
Jericho.

1253
01:21:34,738 --> 01:21:38,898
We are tied again - three votes
Tara, three votes Jericho.

1254
01:21:42,678 --> 01:21:44,298
Jericho.

1255
01:21:44,398 --> 01:21:47,938
(CHEERING, APPLAUSE)

1256
01:21:51,378 --> 01:21:53,898
That's four votes Jericho,
three votes Tara.

1257
01:21:57,038 --> 01:21:59,078
Winner of Australian Survivor...

1258
01:21:59,158 --> 01:22:00,258
..Jericho!

1259
01:22:28,878 --> 01:22:33,578
Jericho is the Sole Survivor!
And he just won $500,000.

1260
01:22:33,678 --> 01:22:35,658
Jericho, where are you?

1261
01:22:35,798 --> 01:22:38,138
- Jeri!
- WOMAN: There's your money, Jeri.

1262
01:22:38,278 --> 01:22:40,258
Here's your cheque -
half a million dollars.

1263
01:22:40,358 --> 01:22:42,218
Oh, my God!

1264
01:22:42,318 --> 01:22:44,718
(ALL CHEER)

1265
01:22:49,598 --> 01:22:52,078
There have been
so many great moments this season.

1266
01:22:52,198 --> 01:22:55,658
And we're going to get everyone
out here to talk all about them,

1267
01:22:55,758 --> 01:22:57,378
so don't go away.

1268
01:22:57,478 --> 01:22:59,298
It's the Survivor Reunion Show.

1269
01:22:59,398 --> 01:23:02,738
Bro, you won!

1270
01:23:06,878 --> 01:23:10,138
Jericho, he's just a good dude, man.

1271
01:23:11,438 --> 01:23:16,098
JERICHO: People think that I'm this
naive, young, innocent angel kid.

1272
01:23:16,238 --> 01:23:19,358
But I came into this game
leaving my morals out the door.

1273
01:23:19,498 --> 01:23:22,798
Of course I'm going to
take these cookies.

1274
01:23:23,878 --> 01:23:26,218
Whether it's lie, cheat and steal,

1275
01:23:26,358 --> 01:23:29,378
I was willing to do whatever it takes

1276
01:23:29,478 --> 01:23:32,078
to win that Sole Survivor title.

1277
01:23:32,158 --> 01:23:34,618
Gonna kill some tribemates.

1278
01:23:34,718 --> 01:23:36,178
I'm the brown Cookie Monster

1279
01:23:36,318 --> 01:23:39,938
and I'm going to drag someone
with me down to hell. (LAUGHS)

1280
01:23:40,038 --> 01:23:41,218
WOMAN: Go, Jeri!

1281
01:23:42,598 --> 01:23:44,738
JONATHAN: Wow, Jericho
has some serious skills up there.

1282
01:23:44,838 --> 01:23:46,538
Oh!

1283
01:23:46,678 --> 01:23:49,798
Jericho is off to a very quick start.

1284
01:23:49,918 --> 01:23:52,798
Jericho is trying to find
that inner strength to keep going.

1285
01:23:52,898 --> 01:23:54,818
WOMAN: Proud of you, Jeri.

1286
01:23:56,398 --> 01:23:58,778
I've grown so much.

1287
01:23:58,878 --> 01:24:01,298
And I've made a lot of friends here.

1288
01:24:02,698 --> 01:24:04,538
I found a brother in Luke.

1289
01:24:04,678 --> 01:24:07,298
I couldn't have done half
of the things I did without him.

1290
01:24:09,678 --> 01:24:12,298
This experience
will always be part of me.

1291
01:24:14,278 --> 01:24:16,538
It's taught me a lot
and I'm grateful for that.

1292
01:24:16,638 --> 01:24:17,858
Oh, man.

1293
01:24:19,598 --> 01:24:21,078
Whoo!

1294
01:24:21,158 --> 01:24:23,578
(CHEERING, APPLAUSE)

1295
01:24:27,798 --> 01:24:31,718
Jericho has just been crowned
the Sole Survivor for 2017

1296
01:24:31,798 --> 01:24:33,658
and won $500,000!

1297
01:24:33,758 --> 01:24:35,418
Whoo!

1298
01:24:39,318 --> 01:24:44,078
Jericho. Firstly, congratulations.
But I want you to be honest with me.

1299
01:24:44,198 --> 01:24:49,218
Day one, we're on that barge and the
rain is pissing down, it's dark,

1300
01:24:49,318 --> 01:24:51,218
it's apocalyptic, in your own terms,

1301
01:24:51,358 --> 01:24:55,738
and everyone else is out there and
they have their best game face on.

1302
01:24:55,878 --> 01:24:57,458
Did you think
you'd be sitting here right now?

1303
01:24:57,638 --> 01:24:59,538
- Did you think you were going
to win this thing? - No way.

1304
01:24:59,638 --> 01:25:01,218
Honestly I looked at everybody

1305
01:25:01,358 --> 01:25:05,658
and I was just like, "Holy crap.
I'm honestly against these guys."

1306
01:25:05,798 --> 01:25:08,078
Some of them are, like, 6'4"
and I was just like...

1307
01:25:08,198 --> 01:25:10,578
..how would I compete against them
in the challenges?

1308
01:25:10,718 --> 01:25:14,658
But honestly, I'm still shocked
that I'm still standing here.

1309
01:25:14,798 --> 01:25:17,898
I was surprised
at my own capability. So, yeah.

1310
01:25:19,798 --> 01:25:22,618
Well, it looked like
you were having a blast out there.

1311
01:25:22,758 --> 01:25:25,718
You looked like you were scheming
and laughing all the way to Day 55.

1312
01:25:25,838 --> 01:25:28,258
What was it about this game
that you love so much?

1313
01:25:28,398 --> 01:25:30,838
Oh, look, I've been watching
Survivor since I was a kid.

1314
01:25:30,978 --> 01:25:35,658
And so, being there every day,
I just savoured the moment.

1315
01:25:35,758 --> 01:25:37,618
And if it was my last day,

1316
01:25:37,758 --> 01:25:41,358
I made sure that it was going to be
the most amazing day.

1317
01:25:41,498 --> 01:25:44,458
So, you know, with the Locky experience,

1318
01:25:44,598 --> 01:25:47,458
that was, like,
one of my biggest highlight.

1319
01:25:47,598 --> 01:25:50,538
I was...
I was just stoked that I was there.

1320
01:25:50,678 --> 01:25:53,538
Well, I gotta say
I loved the Locky moment too.

1321
01:25:53,678 --> 01:25:56,358
That was pretty...
That was pretty cool.

1322
01:25:56,498 --> 01:26:00,498
But one of my favourite things about
your game was the whole cookie saga.

1323
01:26:00,638 --> 01:26:01,498
- (LAUGHS)
- OK?

1324
01:26:01,638 --> 01:26:04,658
- Show them your tie, Jeri.
- That...

1325
01:26:04,758 --> 01:26:05,658
Particularly that moment

1326
01:26:05,798 --> 01:26:09,378
when you were standing behind
the tribe just eating those cookies.

1327
01:26:10,458 --> 01:26:12,098
That was hilarious.

1328
01:26:12,238 --> 01:26:15,998
- Jacqui, did you have any idea?
- Absolutely none.

1329
01:26:16,138 --> 01:26:17,538
You had no idea
there was a Cookie Monster?

1330
01:26:17,678 --> 01:26:19,998
Absolutely none. Nuh. I couldn't
believe it watching it back.

1331
01:26:20,078 --> 01:26:22,218
I just thought, "You little bugger."

1332
01:26:22,318 --> 01:26:24,018
Right.

1333
01:26:24,158 --> 01:26:27,358
Well, there was one person that you
formed a pretty special bond with...

1334
01:26:27,438 --> 01:26:28,358
..Luke.

1335
01:26:28,438 --> 01:26:29,358
(LAUGHTER)

1336
01:26:35,698 --> 01:26:38,018
Piece of crap.

1337
01:26:38,158 --> 01:26:40,718
This was what
I had to put up with all the time.

1338
01:26:40,798 --> 01:26:41,998
It was driving me crazy.

1339
01:26:42,138 --> 01:26:44,658
Can you guys behave?
Just for a little bit?

1340
01:26:44,758 --> 01:26:46,578
No. I love it. It's great.

1341
01:26:46,718 --> 01:26:48,998
So, what was it about Luke
that you were drawn to?

1342
01:26:49,138 --> 01:26:52,498
Oh, I don't know. He just had that
funny vibe where I was just, like...

1343
01:26:52,638 --> 01:26:54,138
He's the guy who wants to create chaos.

1344
01:26:54,278 --> 01:26:56,578
And I was like,
"I'm jumping on board with that,"

1345
01:26:56,678 --> 01:26:58,178
'cause honestly I was, like,

1346
01:26:58,318 --> 01:27:00,218
there's going to be times
where we're going to be too serious

1347
01:27:00,358 --> 01:27:02,998
and I need something
where I can just laugh it off.

1348
01:27:03,138 --> 01:27:07,858
And the minute he started acting
like, "Nah, let's change it up."

1349
01:27:07,958 --> 01:27:09,898
And I was like, "Boom, I'm so in."

1350
01:27:10,038 --> 01:27:12,738
It was an instant connection.
Love at first sight.

1351
01:27:12,838 --> 01:27:14,378
(LAUGHS)

1352
01:27:14,478 --> 01:27:15,418
TARA: Here we go.

1353
01:27:19,918 --> 01:27:22,138
Honestly, lifelong friendship hopefully.

1354
01:27:22,238 --> 01:27:23,138
Yeah. For sure.

1355
01:27:23,238 --> 01:27:24,298
Even though he's in Perth

1356
01:27:24,438 --> 01:27:26,818
I'll be visiting to see his kids,
see his wife.

1357
01:27:26,958 --> 01:27:30,178
And be like, "Yo, I need a room."
You know what I mean?

1358
01:27:30,318 --> 01:27:33,538
And now I know he's making all that
money I might have to charge him.

1359
01:27:33,638 --> 01:27:35,218
You know what I mean?

1360
01:27:35,318 --> 01:27:37,298
There'll be rent.

1361
01:27:40,818 --> 01:27:42,498
Nice.

1362
01:27:42,638 --> 01:27:45,498
Tara, you were the only other person
that made it to Day 55.

1363
01:27:45,638 --> 01:27:48,378
You came second. But it's no mean
feat coming second in this game.

1364
01:27:48,478 --> 01:27:50,458
You played a brilliant social game.

1365
01:27:50,598 --> 01:27:53,018
- How proud are you?
- I'm pretty proud.

1366
01:27:53,158 --> 01:27:56,178
Like, I feel coming into this tonight,

1367
01:27:56,278 --> 01:27:58,018
like, Jeri and I spoke so much

1368
01:27:58,158 --> 01:28:01,498
and we kept saying,
like, both of us feel deserving.

1369
01:28:01,598 --> 01:28:02,898
So that's where, you know,

1370
01:28:03,038 --> 01:28:06,298
at the end of the day,
I'm not shattered, I'm not gutted.

1371
01:28:06,398 --> 01:28:08,298
I did this experience,

1372
01:28:08,438 --> 01:28:10,738
like, hopefully
not getting out the first day.

1373
01:28:10,878 --> 01:28:12,718
So I was pretty stoked that, you know,

1374
01:28:12,838 --> 01:28:15,538
I got to experience Day 55 with Jeri.

1375
01:28:23,278 --> 01:28:26,818
Now, were you surprised how hard
everyone started playing this game

1376
01:28:26,918 --> 01:28:28,358
right from the get-go?

1377
01:28:28,438 --> 01:28:30,358
Right from A.K. Yes.

1378
01:28:30,438 --> 01:28:32,218
That is correct.

1379
01:28:32,318 --> 01:28:33,638
Um, no. I...

1380
01:28:33,778 --> 01:28:36,638
I didn't even know how to approach
the whole game play, you know?

1381
01:28:36,718 --> 01:28:38,578
I... I guess from the start

1382
01:28:38,718 --> 01:28:41,458
I was sort of still asking everyone,
"Like, where's the huts?"

1383
01:28:41,598 --> 01:28:43,378
In America... And they're like,
"You have to build them."

1384
01:28:43,518 --> 01:28:45,818
And I'm like...
You have to do what now?

1385
01:28:45,918 --> 01:28:48,058
So, no...

1386
01:28:48,198 --> 01:28:53,458
These guys came out swinging
from day one. So it's a tough game.

1387
01:28:53,558 --> 01:28:54,718
It is a tough game.

1388
01:28:54,838 --> 01:28:57,458
And there were no shortage
of big players this season.

1389
01:28:57,598 --> 01:29:01,538
I mean, there's Henry, Locky, Luke.
I mean, in fact all of you.

1390
01:29:01,678 --> 01:29:04,298
You all came out of the gate,
swinging for the fences.

1391
01:29:04,438 --> 01:29:07,938
It was great to watch.
I always say go big or go home.

1392
01:29:08,078 --> 01:29:11,738
And this season there was one player
who ended up doing both.

1393
01:29:11,838 --> 01:29:13,738
Let's take a look.

1394
01:29:19,998 --> 01:29:22,538
I came into this game
hoping to play to my strengths,

1395
01:29:22,638 --> 01:29:23,818
which was my social game.

1396
01:29:23,958 --> 01:29:25,458
- Why not?
- You remind me of my Uncle Mark.

1397
01:29:25,598 --> 01:29:26,538
- Do I?
- Yeah, man.

1398
01:29:26,678 --> 01:29:29,998
I plan on making an alliance with
every single person in my tribe.

1399
01:29:35,918 --> 01:29:38,498
I'm here to play Survivor.
I'm not here to make friends.

1400
01:29:38,598 --> 01:29:40,818
I'm playing to win.

1401
01:29:40,918 --> 01:29:42,778
My plan is organised chaos.

1402
01:29:44,918 --> 01:29:46,538
- What?
- It's a rock.

1403
01:29:53,758 --> 01:29:56,578
I want to elevate the stress
and paranoia.

1404
01:29:56,718 --> 01:29:58,738
- Oh, I could slap him.
- (CHUCKLES)

1405
01:29:58,878 --> 01:30:01,018
Playing a hell of a game, though.
Hell of a game.

1406
01:30:04,458 --> 01:30:07,378
He is a very smart player.

1407
01:30:07,518 --> 01:30:10,378
I just want to be remembered
as the player that played big.

1408
01:30:10,518 --> 01:30:13,778
You're like little puppets. He's the
mastermind and you're the puppets.

1409
01:30:16,878 --> 01:30:18,218
(CHEERING, APPLAUSE)

1410
01:30:27,238 --> 01:30:29,098
Well, A.K.,
when I look at that footage

1411
01:30:29,238 --> 01:30:33,058
I think that's pretty good strategy
to try and befriend everyone.

1412
01:30:33,158 --> 01:30:34,178
Why do you think it didn't work?

1413
01:30:34,278 --> 01:30:37,218
Um... Well, I feel like it did work.

1414
01:30:37,358 --> 01:30:41,738
I mean, I stuck with my best brother
Jarrad from day one, Ziggy.

1415
01:30:41,838 --> 01:30:42,738
No.

1416
01:30:42,878 --> 01:30:46,638
But I think my problem was I was
going off alone with these people

1417
01:30:46,778 --> 01:30:48,498
when they were going out
getting firewood,

1418
01:30:48,598 --> 01:30:50,858
when they were finding things

1419
01:30:50,998 --> 01:30:53,138
and I was having these one-on-one
conversations with them

1420
01:30:53,278 --> 01:30:55,018
where I probably
should have just sat myself

1421
01:30:55,118 --> 01:30:56,298
where we were building the shelter

1422
01:30:56,438 --> 01:30:58,218
and had these conversations
around people

1423
01:30:58,318 --> 01:31:00,298
so it didn't look so suspicious.

1424
01:31:00,438 --> 01:31:03,718
OK. Look, I gotta ask. Chicken Idol.
Really?

1425
01:31:05,798 --> 01:31:08,098
Hands up.
Who bought the Chicken Idol?

1426
01:31:08,238 --> 01:31:11,538
- It's a rock.
- (LAUGHTER)

1427
01:31:11,678 --> 01:31:14,738
I wasn't on the same tribe as A.K.
So...

1428
01:31:14,878 --> 01:31:16,818
- Ben definitely would have bought it.
- (LAUGHTER)

1429
01:31:16,918 --> 01:31:18,218
Oh...

1430
01:31:18,358 --> 01:31:21,378
- Ben, that was harsh.
- Yeah. Mate.

1431
01:31:21,478 --> 01:31:23,898
It's all good.

1432
01:31:23,998 --> 01:31:25,218
Well, A.K., I think it's fair to say

1433
01:31:25,358 --> 01:31:28,818
that you put quite a few noses
out of joint early in the game,

1434
01:31:28,918 --> 01:31:31,098
but none more so than Tara.

1435
01:31:31,238 --> 01:31:34,298
Tara, what was it about A.K.
that just rubbed you the wrong way?

1436
01:31:34,438 --> 01:31:37,998
I think it was just
going out too hard at the start.

1437
01:31:38,118 --> 01:31:40,818
And, like, you know,
he said, we're trying to build fire

1438
01:31:40,958 --> 01:31:43,218
and we're trying to do huts
and he's just, like, scamming

1439
01:31:43,358 --> 01:31:44,778
and running around
looking for chicken idols.

1440
01:31:44,918 --> 01:31:49,458
So, yeah, I guess...
I mean, I love him but... Now.

1441
01:31:49,558 --> 01:31:51,658
But, I mean...

1442
01:31:51,798 --> 01:31:54,178
So you guys have had contact
since the game finished?

1443
01:31:54,318 --> 01:31:55,378
- Yeah.
- It's cool.

1444
01:31:55,518 --> 01:31:58,218
He's, like,
the godfather of my children.

1445
01:31:58,318 --> 01:32:00,778
No. No. I was kidding.

1446
01:32:00,878 --> 01:32:02,458
Wow. Did I miss something?

1447
01:32:02,598 --> 01:32:04,058
- LOCKY: Hey?!
- I'm kidding.

1448
01:32:04,158 --> 01:32:06,998
Locky. Locky. Locky, look at me.

1449
01:32:07,078 --> 01:32:08,018
No. No. No.

1450
01:32:08,158 --> 01:32:12,858
So, I guess you could say it was
just his game play. It scared me.

1451
01:32:12,958 --> 01:32:14,018
That's what it was.

1452
01:32:14,118 --> 01:32:15,498
It was so powerful and so good

1453
01:32:15,638 --> 01:32:18,578
that I was just like,
"Let's just get him."

1454
01:32:18,718 --> 01:32:20,898
Well, A.K.,
when we did the tribe swap

1455
01:32:20,998 --> 01:32:22,778
and you pulled that Asaga buff,

1456
01:32:22,918 --> 01:32:24,818
did you think that was it,
"My game's up"?

1457
01:32:24,918 --> 01:32:25,818
Yeah.

1458
01:32:25,958 --> 01:32:28,358
I mean, Tara and Anneliese
had been over at Asaga

1459
01:32:28,438 --> 01:32:31,458
for probably a week at that point

1460
01:32:31,598 --> 01:32:34,638
and, you know,
perception is 90% of reality

1461
01:32:34,718 --> 01:32:35,898
and the chances of me making it

1462
01:32:36,038 --> 01:32:38,738
through that next Tribal
Council at Asaga were pretty slim.

1463
01:32:38,878 --> 01:32:42,778
Luke, how's your wall looking
with A.K.'s head stuffed on it?

1464
01:32:44,278 --> 01:32:48,498
Yeah. The only one I didn't get
was Lock. He escaped it.

1465
01:32:48,638 --> 01:32:51,218
But, yeah,
it was all about trophies for me.

1466
01:32:52,678 --> 01:32:55,178
So, like, the room is full at home.

1467
01:32:55,278 --> 01:32:57,378
(LAUGHTER)

1468
01:32:57,518 --> 01:33:01,658
Well, A.K.,
you were a master manipulator.

1469
01:33:01,758 --> 01:33:02,998
You played a hell of a game.

1470
01:33:03,138 --> 01:33:04,818
- Well done.
- Thanks, mate.

1471
01:33:04,918 --> 01:33:06,998
(CHEERING, APPLAUSE)

1472
01:33:11,038 --> 01:33:12,498
Coming up after the break,

1473
01:33:12,638 --> 01:33:15,858
we're going to hear from
the one and only Tarzan.

1474
01:33:15,998 --> 01:33:18,298
- And later...
- (CHEERING, APPLAUSE)

1475
01:33:18,438 --> 01:33:20,218
And later,
we're going to speak to the player

1476
01:33:20,358 --> 01:33:23,498
who made possibly the dumbest move
of the game.

1477
01:33:23,598 --> 01:33:24,498
Don't go away.

1478
01:33:36,017 --> 01:33:37,322
(SHOUTS)

1479
01:33:38,807 --> 01:33:42,507
Australian Survivor has been
the toughest thing I've ever done.

1480
01:33:42,647 --> 01:33:46,267
Testing my boundaries, seeing what
type of a man I really was.

1481
01:33:46,367 --> 01:33:48,427
JONATHAN: Oh, a huge fall!

1482
01:33:48,567 --> 01:33:50,467
That's what this game was about for me.

1483
01:33:50,607 --> 01:33:54,627
Mark is furiously trying to get
that kindling to catch.

1484
01:33:56,007 --> 01:33:58,027
- No way.
- Stick it in your pocket.

1485
01:33:58,127 --> 01:34:00,027
(AUDIENCE APPLAUDS)

1486
01:34:00,167 --> 01:34:02,887
I just want to be remembered
as the lovable character

1487
01:34:03,027 --> 01:34:05,947
who didn't let the game
get in the way of life.

1488
01:34:06,047 --> 01:34:07,427
Tarzan, you are just my hero.

1489
01:34:07,527 --> 01:34:08,427
Thanks, mate.

1490
01:34:08,567 --> 01:34:12,787
Honesty and integrity - look,
it may not win this game for you,

1491
01:34:12,927 --> 01:34:15,787
but I just wanted me grandkids
to be proud,

1492
01:34:15,887 --> 01:34:17,547
and going, "That's our Pop."

1493
01:34:17,647 --> 01:34:19,267
This is a moral dilemma.

1494
01:34:20,587 --> 01:34:21,507
To me...

1495
01:34:21,607 --> 01:34:23,147
We won! We won!

1496
01:34:23,287 --> 01:34:25,907
..that is the duck's nuts
of being a Pop.

1497
01:34:26,007 --> 01:34:27,427
You're a rock star, Tarzan.

1498
01:34:27,527 --> 01:34:31,707
(APPLAUSE)

1499
01:34:34,927 --> 01:34:36,907
Welcome back to the reunion show!

1500
01:34:37,047 --> 01:34:40,107
The entire cast of Australian
Survivor season two is here,

1501
01:34:40,207 --> 01:34:42,747
including this man, Tarzan.

1502
01:34:42,847 --> 01:34:44,107
Hey, mate.

1503
01:34:45,867 --> 01:34:47,547
Thank you.

1504
01:34:49,087 --> 01:34:52,607
Tarzan,
if social media is any indication,

1505
01:34:52,727 --> 01:34:54,827
you were one of the most loved
players in the game.

1506
01:34:54,967 --> 01:34:59,027
What's the reaction been like
for you on the street?

1507
01:34:59,167 --> 01:35:02,827
Well, mate, I'm not gonna die
not knowing what it was like

1508
01:35:02,927 --> 01:35:04,627
to be famous for a day.

1509
01:35:04,727 --> 01:35:06,347
(LAUGHTER)

1510
01:35:06,447 --> 01:35:08,627
You know, I have had a blast.

1511
01:35:08,767 --> 01:35:12,247
There's not one moment I wouldn't
cherish for the rest of my life

1512
01:35:12,387 --> 01:35:16,427
and I wouldn't change a thing,
and I suppose at the end of the day,

1513
01:35:16,567 --> 01:35:18,707
maybe that's what made me so lovable.

1514
01:35:18,807 --> 01:35:20,307
ALL: Awwww.

1515
01:35:20,407 --> 01:35:23,907
Thanks, mate! (LAUGHS)

1516
01:35:25,127 --> 01:35:27,507
Thanks, guys!

1517
01:35:29,087 --> 01:35:30,987
Alright, I want to talk about the Idol.

1518
01:35:31,087 --> 01:35:31,987
Yeah.

1519
01:35:32,127 --> 01:35:34,067
Now, surely you must have known
that by giving it to Tessa

1520
01:35:34,167 --> 01:35:35,387
you put your own game at risk.

1521
01:35:35,487 --> 01:35:37,507
Yes, Tessa needed it.

1522
01:35:37,607 --> 01:35:39,427
I didn't feel I needed the Idol

1523
01:35:39,567 --> 01:35:43,707
until somebody with initials AK
sort of...

1524
01:35:43,807 --> 01:35:45,107
..you know, changed a few things.

1525
01:35:45,207 --> 01:35:46,107
But he tried.

1526
01:35:46,207 --> 01:35:47,467
He was on our side for a minute.

1527
01:35:47,607 --> 01:35:49,707
I'm glad you brought that up
because when I...

1528
01:35:49,847 --> 01:35:52,707
..when I watched it, I thought,
that's actually quite brilliant.

1529
01:35:52,887 --> 01:35:54,527
- You're gonna flip the whole
game on its head. - Yeah.

1530
01:35:54,667 --> 01:35:56,607
You're gonna send someone else home,
I think it was gonna be...

1531
01:35:56,727 --> 01:35:59,107
- Locky, yeah. I was gonna...
- Great blindside.

1532
01:35:59,207 --> 01:36:00,107
Yes.

1533
01:36:00,207 --> 01:36:01,607
But then you went and told AK.

1534
01:36:01,727 --> 01:36:03,987
- Yeah, I know! (LAUGHS)
- Why?

1535
01:36:04,127 --> 01:36:07,747
Well, I think in life,
I've done this before,

1536
01:36:07,887 --> 01:36:10,067
if you want to get trust,
you've got to give it.

1537
01:36:10,207 --> 01:36:12,027
So in this case, we didn't get it back,

1538
01:36:12,167 --> 01:36:15,187
but that was the game
and that was the risk.

1539
01:36:15,287 --> 01:36:17,067
Tessa did bring it.

1540
01:36:17,207 --> 01:36:19,067
Like, she went on and she kept going.

1541
01:36:19,167 --> 01:36:21,667
(APPLAUSE)

1542
01:36:21,807 --> 01:36:25,467
Well, look, Tarzan, people may have
viewed you giving the Idol to Tessa

1543
01:36:25,607 --> 01:36:29,067
as a bad decision,
but in a game that's 55 days long,

1544
01:36:29,207 --> 01:36:31,427
everyone's bound to make
a bad decision or two.

1545
01:36:31,567 --> 01:36:32,667
- Yeah.
- Right, Ziggy?

1546
01:36:32,767 --> 01:36:34,147
(LAUGHTER)

1547
01:36:34,247 --> 01:36:36,027
Oh, Ziggy, I'm just...

1548
01:36:38,567 --> 01:36:40,947
(LAUGHS)

1549
01:36:41,087 --> 01:36:46,467
OK. Ziggy, seriously, seriously, you
found the biggest power in the game,

1550
01:36:46,607 --> 01:36:47,707
- the Super Idol.
- Yeah.

1551
01:36:47,847 --> 01:36:50,667
And then you used it to save the
biggest threat in the game, Locky.

1552
01:36:50,807 --> 01:36:52,187
- Yeah.
- Thanks, Zig.

1553
01:36:52,287 --> 01:36:53,987
Good decision or bad decision?

1554
01:36:54,127 --> 01:36:57,787
Well, there was no, like, trust
between Anneliese and I,

1555
01:36:57,927 --> 01:37:02,527
so for me to send Locky home who
I thought I'd built some trust with,

1556
01:37:02,667 --> 01:37:06,707
to form an alliance with Anneliese,
who I'd already broken trust with,

1557
01:37:06,807 --> 01:37:07,787
to me just seemed crazy.

1558
01:37:07,927 --> 01:37:11,027
And, I mean,
I was a threat in challenges.

1559
01:37:11,127 --> 01:37:12,627
Locky was a threat in challenges.

1560
01:37:12,767 --> 01:37:14,307
I thought it was too early
to get rid of him

1561
01:37:14,447 --> 01:37:17,667
because I'd be the next target
to be sent home, so...

1562
01:37:17,807 --> 01:37:19,187
..I stand by it.
(APPLAUSE)

1563
01:37:19,287 --> 01:37:20,787
Alright. Good.

1564
01:37:23,407 --> 01:37:26,607
Tessa, Jericho won
a special advantage in the game

1565
01:37:26,687 --> 01:37:28,627
and he voted you off the jury.

1566
01:37:28,727 --> 01:37:30,467
Bad decision?

1567
01:37:30,567 --> 01:37:32,147
Oh, well...

1568
01:37:32,287 --> 01:37:34,747
It's hard to go back in time,
isn't it, Jeri?

1569
01:37:34,847 --> 01:37:37,787
It was heartbreaking for me.

1570
01:37:37,887 --> 01:37:39,607
I'm a huge fan of this game.

1571
01:37:39,727 --> 01:37:43,067
I so wanted to have my say
at that final Tribal Council,

1572
01:37:43,167 --> 01:37:44,747
but honestly,

1573
01:37:44,887 --> 01:37:47,267
we didn't know who was gonna be
in the final two at that stage.

1574
01:37:47,407 --> 01:37:50,707
And it's true, if this guy
had been sitting at the end

1575
01:37:50,807 --> 01:37:53,247
that I would've made a pitch for him

1576
01:37:53,387 --> 01:37:55,987
and that would've been dangerous
on the jury.

1577
01:37:56,087 --> 01:37:57,387
Whoo.

1578
01:37:57,527 --> 01:37:59,627
- (LAUGHTER)
- Whoo.

1579
01:37:59,727 --> 01:38:03,707
(APPLAUSE)

1580
01:38:03,807 --> 01:38:05,027
Jacqui.

1581
01:38:05,127 --> 01:38:06,987
Jonathan.

1582
01:38:07,087 --> 01:38:08,067
OK.

1583
01:38:08,207 --> 01:38:12,667
You let Henry hold on to the Idol
that you guys both found.

1584
01:38:12,767 --> 01:38:14,907
Do you regret that decision?

1585
01:38:15,047 --> 01:38:18,787
Oh, look, there's 23 of us that say
"Would've, could've, should've,

1586
01:38:18,887 --> 01:38:19,887
"why didn't I?"

1587
01:38:20,027 --> 01:38:22,747
And yeah,
I'm not finished with Henry yet.

1588
01:38:22,847 --> 01:38:24,607
(LAUGHS)

1589
01:38:24,687 --> 01:38:26,627
Alrighty. Well...

1590
01:38:26,727 --> 01:38:28,467
(CHEERING)

1591
01:38:28,607 --> 01:38:31,787
- Well, on that note...
- (AUDIENCE MEMBER WOLF WHISTLES)

1592
01:38:31,927 --> 01:38:34,627
Coming up after the break,
we're gonna talk to the guy

1593
01:38:34,767 --> 01:38:38,387
who probably made the worst decision
of the whole game -

1594
01:38:38,527 --> 01:38:42,187
Henry and the Idol
he took home in his pocket.

1595
01:38:42,327 --> 01:38:45,467
And later, we'll talk to
the king of the jungle.

1596
01:38:45,567 --> 01:38:46,547
Don't go away.

1597
01:38:46,647 --> 01:38:50,067
(APPLAUSE)

1598
01:38:56,273 --> 01:38:57,373
HENRY: Twisting the whole body.

1599
01:38:58,813 --> 01:39:00,313
Twisting that spine.

1600
01:39:00,413 --> 01:39:01,833
People think of me

1601
01:39:01,973 --> 01:39:05,153
as this blue-eyed,
Zen-loving yoga instructor,

1602
01:39:05,293 --> 01:39:08,313
and the truth is, from day one,
I've been in game mode.

1603
01:39:08,413 --> 01:39:10,033
(CONTESTANTS CHEER)

1604
01:39:10,133 --> 01:39:11,913
JONATHAN: Big launch from Henry!

1605
01:39:12,013 --> 01:39:13,153
I've thrown challenges.

1606
01:39:13,253 --> 01:39:15,373
Everyone's in sync for Asaga.

1607
01:39:15,453 --> 01:39:16,873
Except Henry.

1608
01:39:16,973 --> 01:39:19,373
Asaga, losing their steam.

1609
01:39:19,453 --> 01:39:21,193
I replanted Idols.

1610
01:39:25,093 --> 01:39:27,153
I might look like Jesus
but I'm playing like the devil.

1611
01:39:27,253 --> 01:39:29,033
Boom! Yeah!

1612
01:39:29,133 --> 01:39:30,913
Yeah!

1613
01:39:31,053 --> 01:39:33,953
I don't think anyone could argue
that they played better than me.

1614
01:39:34,093 --> 01:39:36,433
If anyone has a hidden Immunity Idol
and they want to play it,

1615
01:39:36,533 --> 01:39:38,013
now would be the time to do so.

1616
01:39:41,553 --> 01:39:42,473
Henry.

1617
01:39:45,333 --> 01:39:47,033
Game up. Snap away.

1618
01:39:47,133 --> 01:39:49,033
Henry, the tribe has spoken.

1619
01:39:51,333 --> 01:39:52,753
(LAUGHS)

1620
01:39:52,853 --> 01:39:55,273
(APPLAUSE)

1621
01:40:00,173 --> 01:40:03,673
Welcome back to the
Australian Survivor reunion show.

1622
01:40:06,473 --> 01:40:08,233
Henry.

1623
01:40:08,373 --> 01:40:13,313
OK, so, in that moment in Tribal
when I ask if someone has an Idol,

1624
01:40:13,453 --> 01:40:17,013
I normally give it a moment and I hold,

1625
01:40:17,153 --> 01:40:21,033
but with you I just kept holding
and holding and holding,

1626
01:40:21,173 --> 01:40:23,373
thinking, "He's gonna play it.
He's gonna play it. He's...

1627
01:40:23,453 --> 01:40:25,393
"No, he's not gonna play it."

1628
01:40:25,533 --> 01:40:27,273
- Yeah.
- What was going on?

1629
01:40:27,413 --> 01:40:29,953
I don't know. I couldn't hear Locky.
He wasn't speaking loud enough.

1630
01:40:31,273 --> 01:40:32,733
Yeah, nah, honestly, like,

1631
01:40:32,853 --> 01:40:34,793
everyone's, oh,
what a dumb-dumb I am,

1632
01:40:34,933 --> 01:40:37,193
but you've got to give credit
to the people

1633
01:40:37,293 --> 01:40:38,793
that orchestrated that blindside.

1634
01:40:38,893 --> 01:40:41,033
Like, we had no time to scramble.

1635
01:40:41,173 --> 01:40:44,873
We had two different kind of little
groups of people coming together in,

1636
01:40:45,013 --> 01:40:49,193
like, 30 seconds of this rain
kind of set-up back at camp,

1637
01:40:49,333 --> 01:40:51,833
so that was one of the best episodes
I've seen of Survivor,

1638
01:40:51,973 --> 01:40:56,913
just how they got that plan
in motion, and I looked like a fool,

1639
01:40:57,013 --> 01:40:58,733
but man, it was a good move.

1640
01:40:58,813 --> 01:41:00,793
It took six of them. So...

1641
01:41:00,893 --> 01:41:03,373
(OTHERS CHEER)

1642
01:41:08,173 --> 01:41:11,393
Well, Henry, there is no dispute
you were a dope in that moment.

1643
01:41:11,533 --> 01:41:13,233
- But...
- (LAUGHTER)

1644
01:41:13,373 --> 01:41:15,433
..you played a hell of a game,
you really did. Well done.

1645
01:41:15,533 --> 01:41:17,513
Thank you. Thank you.

1646
01:41:23,913 --> 01:41:25,553
Alright, so let's talk about yoga.

1647
01:41:25,653 --> 01:41:27,473
How much yoga have you really done?

1648
01:41:27,573 --> 01:41:30,913
Yeah, I did one class with...

1649
01:41:31,053 --> 01:41:34,513
..my brother-in-law and sister and
bought a book on the plane to Samoa,

1650
01:41:34,613 --> 01:41:36,513
and read, like, a chapter.

1651
01:41:36,613 --> 01:41:38,913
So, honestly, like...

1652
01:41:39,013 --> 01:41:41,473
You just say a couple of words.

1653
01:41:41,613 --> 01:41:43,873
- The rest is...
- OK, OK.

1654
01:41:44,013 --> 01:41:48,433
Hands up. Who bought the story
that he was a yoga instructor?

1655
01:41:49,613 --> 01:41:52,273
Hindsight. Hindsight.

1656
01:41:52,373 --> 01:41:54,073
Sarah, really?

1657
01:41:54,213 --> 01:41:55,873
I mean, look, I'm as stiff as a board

1658
01:41:56,013 --> 01:41:58,013
and I know more than he does in yoga.

1659
01:41:58,153 --> 01:42:00,793
There was definitely that suspicion
but I feel for me

1660
01:42:00,893 --> 01:42:02,433
I still thought he did yoga.

1661
01:42:02,573 --> 01:42:06,433
Like, he is that Zen-loving
that I thought that he was...

1662
01:42:06,573 --> 01:42:08,033
..there was some sort of yoga
in his life.

1663
01:42:08,133 --> 01:42:10,393
But none at all. He's a labourer.

1664
01:42:10,493 --> 01:42:12,593
(LAUGHS)

1665
01:42:12,733 --> 01:42:14,233
- Well played. Um...
- Thank you.

1666
01:42:14,333 --> 01:42:16,673
On a more serious note, now,

1667
01:42:16,813 --> 01:42:20,673
your mother passed away a couple of
weeks before you came into the game.

1668
01:42:20,813 --> 01:42:23,013
What did Survivor mean to you and her?

1669
01:42:23,093 --> 01:42:24,753
Yeah, so...

1670
01:42:24,893 --> 01:42:27,373
She just taught me
all through life to chase my dreams

1671
01:42:27,493 --> 01:42:29,673
and one of my dreams has been
to get on Survivor

1672
01:42:29,813 --> 01:42:32,873
and obviously she was fine
when I first applied

1673
01:42:33,013 --> 01:42:35,433
and then through the application process

1674
01:42:35,573 --> 01:42:38,233
became bad and went into palliative care

1675
01:42:38,333 --> 01:42:39,653
and I found out I was on

1676
01:42:39,793 --> 01:42:42,433
and it was six weeks I think
after she passed away.

1677
01:42:42,573 --> 01:42:46,273
So I was in a pretty important time
for my family, the grieving process,

1678
01:42:46,413 --> 01:42:48,553
to, you know, kind of process it all.

1679
01:42:48,693 --> 01:42:50,713
But, you know, it was that shining light

1680
01:42:50,853 --> 01:42:53,733
that we all needed in the family,
so, you know,

1681
01:42:53,853 --> 01:42:56,433
I'm the man I am today
because of the last three years

1682
01:42:56,573 --> 01:42:59,553
and the game I played then,
so I'm stoked

1683
01:42:59,653 --> 01:43:00,673
and I would always have gone out

1684
01:43:00,813 --> 01:43:02,273
because that's what Mum would've wanted.

1685
01:43:02,373 --> 01:43:05,073
(APPLAUSE)

1686
01:43:12,373 --> 01:43:15,273
Now, earlier in the game,
you teamed up with Jacqui

1687
01:43:15,373 --> 01:43:16,753
and became a power couple.

1688
01:43:16,853 --> 01:43:18,193
Was that intentional?

1689
01:43:18,273 --> 01:43:19,553
Um, yeah, it was.

1690
01:43:19,693 --> 01:43:21,953
We got along really well and I thought

1691
01:43:22,093 --> 01:43:25,793
she was the perfect person
to work with, so yeah,

1692
01:43:25,933 --> 01:43:28,753
it was the perfect little pair
to go forward with

1693
01:43:28,893 --> 01:43:30,833
and we found an Idol
which kind of solidified it.

1694
01:43:30,933 --> 01:43:31,873
My Idol.

1695
01:43:32,013 --> 01:43:34,233
- Which... which...
- (LAUGHS)

1696
01:43:34,333 --> 01:43:35,653
Which he's now gonna give to me.

1697
01:43:35,733 --> 01:43:36,913
Which is now coming to my house.

1698
01:43:37,013 --> 01:43:38,873
Want it, Jacqui? You want it?

1699
01:43:38,973 --> 01:43:41,033
(APPLAUSE)

1700
01:43:44,173 --> 01:43:46,013
- I said I'd give it to her.
- I will use it.

1701
01:43:48,453 --> 01:43:49,833
Jac, does that make everything better?

1702
01:43:49,973 --> 01:43:52,193
Oh...
(LAUGHS)

1703
01:43:52,293 --> 01:43:54,313
I don't think so, but nice try.

1704
01:43:54,453 --> 01:44:00,233
Well, look, you weren't the only
couple who got together in the game.

1705
01:44:00,373 --> 01:44:02,833
- Let's take a look.
- AUDIENCE: Oooh!

1706
01:44:07,913 --> 01:44:09,153
LOCKY: Mark and Sammy...

1707
01:44:10,693 --> 01:44:11,833
I don't know what's going on there.

1708
01:44:13,173 --> 01:44:15,593
Definitely a bit closer
than everyone else.

1709
01:44:20,173 --> 01:44:21,913
JERICHO: That's such a good thing!

1710
01:44:31,473 --> 01:44:33,553
Sam. Total babe.

1711
01:44:33,693 --> 01:44:35,653
Oh, look, if I met her
on the outside and she was single,

1712
01:44:35,793 --> 01:44:39,033
I'd definitely be keen on her.
(LAUGHS)

1713
01:44:39,133 --> 01:44:41,873
(APPLAUSE)

1714
01:44:43,733 --> 01:44:45,153
(WOLF WHISTLE)

1715
01:44:49,013 --> 01:44:52,433
Well, Mark, I think it's fair to say
that your close ties with Sam

1716
01:44:52,573 --> 01:44:55,753
ended up damaging your game, but
is there a silver lining to this?

1717
01:44:55,853 --> 01:44:56,753
There is.

1718
01:44:56,893 --> 01:44:59,313
We've come out and we've had
a great life ever since the game.

1719
01:44:59,453 --> 01:45:01,793
And when I was there and I first met Sam

1720
01:45:01,933 --> 01:45:03,373
I knew there was something special
about her

1721
01:45:03,493 --> 01:45:08,233
and we were close in the game early,
I knew it was gonna be a risk

1722
01:45:08,333 --> 01:45:09,593
and we took it anyway,

1723
01:45:09,733 --> 01:45:12,553
but we got targeted by the tribe
earlier than I thought, so...

1724
01:45:12,653 --> 01:45:14,233
But it was worth it. (LAUGHS)

1725
01:45:14,333 --> 01:45:17,073
Awwww. (APPLAUSE)

1726
01:45:21,173 --> 01:45:22,373
So you guys are still together?

1727
01:45:22,493 --> 01:45:23,793
- Absolutely.
- Nice.

1728
01:45:23,933 --> 01:45:27,653
Those are pretty nice words
otherwise. (LAUGHS)

1729
01:45:27,793 --> 01:45:29,913
Sam, did you perceive
your relationship with Mark

1730
01:45:30,013 --> 01:45:31,193

1973
01:55:44,506 --> 01:55:46,246
And you held your own. Well done.

1974
01:55:46,346 --> 01:55:47,246
CONTESTANTS: Yeah!

1975
01:55:47,346 --> 01:55:50,346
(CHEERING AND APPLAUSE)

1976
01:55:54,026 --> 01:55:57,206
Well, Locky, you were a powerhorse.

1977
01:55:57,346 --> 01:56:01,126
You ended up winning
three Immunity Challenges in a row.

1978
01:56:01,266 --> 01:56:04,086
You were two seconds away from
winning that fourth one.

1979
01:56:04,186 --> 01:56:05,366
Does that keep you up at night?

1980
01:56:05,466 --> 01:56:06,566
Nah, not at all.

1981
01:56:06,666 --> 01:56:07,846
Nah, yeah, every night.

1982
01:56:07,986 --> 01:56:09,526
(LAUGHTER)
Um...

1983
01:56:09,666 --> 01:56:11,126
- Alright, Michelle...
- Yeah.

1984
01:56:11,226 --> 01:56:12,726
OK, so, you beat Locky.

1985
01:56:12,866 --> 01:56:14,566
- Yep.
- You beat him by two seconds.

1986
01:56:14,706 --> 01:56:16,066
- But you beat him.
- Yes.

1987
01:56:16,146 --> 01:56:17,486
And you won a car.

1988
01:56:17,626 --> 01:56:20,726
I mean, arguably,
the best Immunity Challenge to win.

1989
01:56:20,826 --> 01:56:21,926
I mean, and what a car.

1990
01:56:22,026 --> 01:56:23,526
Holden Trailblazer.

1991
01:56:23,626 --> 01:56:25,966
(LAUGHTER AND APPLAUSE)

1992
01:56:26,066 --> 01:56:27,526
I know what I'm doin'!

1993
01:56:27,666 --> 01:56:30,986
You do. Nice plug for
the sponsor there. I like it.

1994
01:56:31,126 --> 01:56:32,486
- It's an amazing car, so...
- Great.

1995
01:56:32,586 --> 01:56:33,566
I love it.

1996
01:56:33,706 --> 01:56:35,446
Great. Well, you won it,
fair and square. Well done.

1997
01:56:35,546 --> 01:56:36,646
Thank you.

1998
01:56:36,746 --> 01:56:38,726
(APPLAUSE)

1999
01:56:41,386 --> 01:56:42,286
Aimee...

2000
01:56:42,426 --> 01:56:46,346
I think you had the biggest fall
of the season.

2001
01:56:46,486 --> 01:56:48,166
In fact, probably the biggest fall
in Survivor,

2002
01:56:48,266 --> 01:56:49,806
certainly that I've ever seen.

2003
01:56:49,946 --> 01:56:52,086
Whenever I watch that footage, I cringe.

2004
01:56:52,226 --> 01:56:54,206
How is it for you,
when you see that back?

2005
01:56:54,346 --> 01:56:57,126
Yeah. Oh, man, I fell so hard.
But I was...

2006
01:56:57,226 --> 01:56:58,526
I actually said after it,

2007
01:56:58,666 --> 01:57:01,126
"My mum dropped me on the head
a lot when I was a child,

2008
01:57:01,226 --> 01:57:02,706
"so I'm just used to it."

2009
01:57:02,786 --> 01:57:04,086
(LAUGHTER)

2010
01:57:04,186 --> 01:57:05,086
Sorry, Mum.

2011
01:57:05,226 --> 01:57:07,706
(APPLAUSE)
Alright. OK.

2012
01:57:07,846 --> 01:57:10,086
Well, look, in a game where the object

2013
01:57:10,226 --> 01:57:12,606
is to outwit, outplay
and outlast each other,

2014
01:57:12,706 --> 01:57:14,126
it was really nice to see

2015
01:57:14,266 --> 01:57:16,726
that Aussie mateship
was still at its core.

2016
01:57:16,826 --> 01:57:17,846
Let's take a look.

2017
01:57:19,146 --> 01:57:21,246
Ah-ha-ha!

2018
01:57:21,386 --> 01:57:23,006
JERICHO: When I came into this game,
I didn't think

2019
01:57:23,146 --> 01:57:24,606
that I would make genuine friendships.

2020
01:57:24,746 --> 01:57:28,066
But Survivor has really surprised me.

2021
01:57:32,186 --> 01:57:34,446
I've found probably
my best friends here.

2022
01:57:36,586 --> 01:57:37,526
(ALL CHEER)

2023
01:57:37,666 --> 01:57:39,486
TARA: When you get thrown into
this game,

2024
01:57:39,626 --> 01:57:42,486
you have to build trust,
you've got to build friendship.

2025
01:57:42,626 --> 01:57:45,286
You've got to have
that one friend in the game

2026
01:57:45,426 --> 01:57:47,766
that you can just say
whatever you want to.

2027
01:57:47,866 --> 01:57:49,446
That's what I feel with Locky.

2028
01:57:49,586 --> 01:57:53,066
Mum, my best friend, he's hot.
You'll love him.

2029
01:57:53,186 --> 01:57:55,206
I'm not breaking up with you, I promise.

2030
01:57:55,346 --> 01:57:57,706
- I know. I love ya.
- I know. I love you too.

2031
01:57:57,846 --> 01:58:01,606
It's so tough out here,
and it's been really difficult.

2032
01:58:01,746 --> 01:58:03,846
- (CRIES) So, that's my mum.
- That's Shirls.

2033
01:58:03,946 --> 01:58:05,486
That's the littlest one?

2034
01:58:05,626 --> 01:58:08,606
But to go through it with people
who love and support me,

2035
01:58:08,706 --> 01:58:10,446
that's something to be grateful for.

2036
01:58:10,546 --> 01:58:12,126
Aww! That's gold!

2037
01:58:13,266 --> 01:58:14,706
JERICHO: It's really
made me question,

2038
01:58:14,786 --> 01:58:17,446
"Are you here for that prizemoney

2039
01:58:17,586 --> 01:58:20,526
"or is there more
that's more valuable?"

2040
01:58:20,626 --> 01:58:23,086
(CHEERING AND APPLAUSE)

2041
01:58:31,906 --> 01:58:35,406
Locky, you and Tara seemed to be
tight, very tight, from day one.

2042
01:58:35,506 --> 01:58:36,566
Why do you think that was?

2043
01:58:36,706 --> 01:58:38,486
Uh, we just, like,
got along, as friends.

2044
01:58:38,626 --> 01:58:40,286
I mean, we were on the bottom
a fair bit together

2045
01:58:40,386 --> 01:58:41,446
and that just brought us together,

2046
01:58:41,586 --> 01:58:43,166
and we've just got the same humour
and everything.

2047
01:58:43,306 --> 01:58:44,646
Yeah, and she's a really good friend.

2048
01:58:44,746 --> 01:58:46,706
And he's really hot!

2049
01:58:46,786 --> 01:58:48,446
(LAUGHTER)

2050
01:58:48,546 --> 01:58:50,126
(CHEERING AND APPLAUSE)

2051
01:58:50,266 --> 01:58:53,086
Well, Tara, in the end,
you had to vote out...

2052
01:58:53,226 --> 01:58:54,926
Well, you didn't have to,
but you DID vote out

2053
01:58:55,066 --> 01:58:57,346
your best friend
and closest ally in the game.

2054
01:58:57,426 --> 01:58:59,066
How hard was that for you?

2055
01:58:59,146 --> 01:59:00,206
It was a struggle.

2056
01:59:00,346 --> 01:59:03,526
Like, I tried my best
to try and, you know, get around it

2057
01:59:03,666 --> 01:59:06,646
but at the end of the day, I had to
do, you know, a good move.

2058
01:59:06,786 --> 01:59:10,286
And it was just suckful
that it had to be Locky.

2059
01:59:10,426 --> 01:59:12,886
Locky, did you think Tara
would ever turn on you?

2060
01:59:13,026 --> 01:59:14,406
No.
(LAUGHTER)

2061
01:59:14,546 --> 01:59:16,986
No. I mean, like, I even said
to her, in the game,

2062
01:59:17,126 --> 01:59:19,126
I'm like, "Hey, like, you're
probably gonna have to turn on me

2063
01:59:19,266 --> 01:59:20,986
"and when you do it,
I'm gonna be super-proud."

2064
01:59:21,126 --> 01:59:22,806
But, um, yeah, I didn't see it coming.

2065
01:59:22,906 --> 01:59:24,606
Like, she played it pretty well.

2066
01:59:24,746 --> 01:59:27,926
And, like, I felt pretty confident
with the challenges,

2067
01:59:28,066 --> 01:59:31,426
but, yeah, it stung a little bit,
watching it back.

2068
01:59:31,566 --> 01:59:32,806
Did you give her your vote in the end?

2069
01:59:32,906 --> 01:59:33,926
I did.

2070
01:59:34,066 --> 01:59:35,346
- AUDIENCE: Aw!
- Nice!

2071
01:59:35,426 --> 01:59:37,366
(APPLAUSE)

2072
01:59:38,806 --> 01:59:42,346
(CHEERING)

2073
01:59:42,486 --> 01:59:44,566
Stick around because, after the break,

2074
01:59:44,706 --> 01:59:47,286
we're gonna talk to Kristie
and Phoebe from season one

2075
01:59:47,386 --> 01:59:49,346
and these guys are gonna come clean

2076
01:59:49,486 --> 01:59:51,446
with some of the biggest secrets
of the game.

2077
01:59:51,546 --> 01:59:52,726
Don't go away.

2078
01:59:52,826 --> 01:59:55,006
(CHEERING AND APPLAUSE)

2079
02:00:03,373 --> 02:00:06,375
(CHEERING AND APPLAUSE)

2080
02:00:11,407 --> 02:00:15,687
Well, I'm sitting here with winner
Kristie and Phoebe from season one.

2081
02:00:15,827 --> 02:00:19,687
Kristie, how have you enjoyed
the game play so far this season?

2082
02:00:19,827 --> 02:00:23,387
Oh, it's been incredible.
You guys have absolutely killed it.

2083
02:00:23,507 --> 02:00:25,207
They took it up to a whole
'nother level.

2084
02:00:25,347 --> 02:00:28,687
The twists were great and you took
advantage of every opportunity.

2085
02:00:28,787 --> 02:00:30,387
I am so proud.

2086
02:00:30,507 --> 02:00:33,567
Nice.
(APPLAUSE)

2087
02:00:35,467 --> 02:00:38,287
Phoebe, how would you rate this season?

2088
02:00:38,427 --> 02:00:41,207
Oh, I mean, no secret
I'm a Survivor superfan.

2089
02:00:41,307 --> 02:00:42,887
And I've gotta say that,

2090
02:00:43,027 --> 02:00:46,807
this is, without a doubt, one of
my favourite seasons of all time.

2091
02:00:46,907 --> 02:00:49,967
So, well done, guys.

2092
02:00:50,107 --> 02:00:53,207
Well, it wouldn't be a good
season of Survivor

2093
02:00:53,347 --> 02:00:55,167
without a whole bunch of secrets
and lies.

2094
02:00:55,267 --> 02:00:56,847
Let's take a look.

2095
02:00:56,987 --> 02:01:01,407
Put your hand up
if you haven't lied in this game.

2096
02:01:01,547 --> 02:01:04,687
(LAUGHS)
Yeah. Whatever!

2097
02:01:06,767 --> 02:01:09,167
Gentleman in the back there.

2098
02:01:09,307 --> 02:01:12,207
I'm a fashion designer
from New York City.

2099
02:01:12,307 --> 02:01:13,667
I'm actually a fashion designer,

2100
02:01:13,807 --> 02:01:17,807
but in my 16 years in the military
I was a special ops commander.

2101
02:01:19,907 --> 02:01:21,527
There's no way I want to let people know

2102
02:01:21,667 --> 02:01:23,887
what I was up to in my previous life.

2103
02:01:23,987 --> 02:01:25,127
I could be seen as a threat.

2104
02:01:25,267 --> 02:01:28,027
HENRY: So we had some jam and sugar
left over.

2105
02:01:28,107 --> 02:01:30,327
So sweet.

2106
02:01:30,467 --> 02:01:34,567
I'm gonna make sure that
I get all this jam into my belly.

2107
02:01:36,827 --> 02:01:37,847
There's, like, nothing left.

2108
02:01:37,987 --> 02:01:40,887
Someone's literally put their finger
in there and licked it clean.

2109
02:01:41,027 --> 02:01:44,087
Anneliese would have had the jam,
for sure.

2110
02:01:44,187 --> 02:01:46,487
Everyone believes Anneliese did it.

2111
02:01:46,587 --> 02:01:47,607
That wasn't our intention,

2112
02:01:47,747 --> 02:01:49,327
but now I hope I can get away with this.

2113
02:01:49,427 --> 02:01:50,447
A Super Idol.

2114
02:01:50,547 --> 02:01:53,087
It's a power like I've never seen.

2115
02:01:53,187 --> 02:01:54,407
But, before you know it,

2116
02:01:54,547 --> 02:01:56,607
you're like kicked out of here
because you've got an advantage.

2117
02:01:56,707 --> 02:01:59,087
So, I was gonna lie to my tribe.

2118
02:01:59,227 --> 02:02:00,927
I'm not allowed to tell you
exactly what it is.

2119
02:02:01,027 --> 02:02:04,167
If I say it, then it's void.

2120
02:02:04,307 --> 02:02:07,047
HENRY: I don't think Ziggy's
telling us everything.

2121
02:02:07,147 --> 02:02:09,027
I think she's lying.

2122
02:02:19,067 --> 02:02:20,247
OK. Quick poll.

2123
02:02:20,347 --> 02:02:23,767
Hands up who bought Ziggy's story.

2124
02:02:23,867 --> 02:02:26,527
Wow. Really?

2125
02:02:26,627 --> 02:02:28,307
(LAUGHTER)

2126
02:02:28,447 --> 02:02:30,487
Well, if there was one person
in this game

2127
02:02:30,627 --> 02:02:34,327
who was more suited to Survivor,
it was Mark.

2128
02:02:34,467 --> 02:02:38,247
But no-one seemed to twig
that he was ex-military.

2129
02:02:38,387 --> 02:02:41,887
Mark, was it hard not to
go into full military mode?

2130
02:02:42,027 --> 02:02:44,887
It was a long bow to draw to say
I was a fashion designer.

2131
02:02:45,027 --> 02:02:47,167
I don't think one person would have
actually believed it.

2132
02:02:47,307 --> 02:02:49,967
But it was hard not to explain
such a big part of my life.

2133
02:02:50,067 --> 02:02:51,727
Because I think when I explain it

2134
02:02:51,867 --> 02:02:53,807
people will understand me
a bit more socially.

2135
02:02:53,947 --> 02:02:58,407
So, it was hard not going into
full military mode, yeah.

2136
02:02:58,547 --> 02:03:03,073
Jacqui, did you honestly believe
that he was just a fashion designer?

2137
02:03:03,117 --> 02:03:06,677
- Oh, that jacket. (LAUGHS)
- It is a nice jacket.

2138
02:03:06,817 --> 02:03:10,297
I only got to spoon with him
one night and then she took over.

2139
02:03:10,437 --> 02:03:15,397
(LAUGHTER, APPLAUSE)
We'll leave that alone.

2140
02:03:15,537 --> 02:03:18,097
Henry. So, you wake up
in the middle of the night.

2141
02:03:18,197 --> 02:03:20,457
You're stealing the jam, the sugar.

2142
02:03:20,597 --> 02:03:22,137
Was there a moment there
when you thought,

2143
02:03:22,237 --> 02:03:23,577
"Maybe I shouldn't be doing this."

2144
02:03:23,717 --> 02:03:25,537
Yeah, we just got back
after the Jarrad vote.

2145
02:03:25,677 --> 02:03:28,697
And me, Luke and Jerry were like,
"Let's go eat the jam."

2146
02:03:28,797 --> 02:03:30,137
Put it on beans. Doing everything.

2147
02:03:30,277 --> 02:03:32,137
Ate all that, then in the morning
it was like, oh, having fun.

2148
02:03:32,277 --> 02:03:33,677
Then everyone's just blaming Anneliese.

2149
02:03:33,817 --> 02:03:35,857
So the next night I'm like,
"Ooh, there's sugar there too."

2150
02:03:35,997 --> 02:03:37,897
So I'm like, let's get that into me.
Tipping that out.

2151
02:03:38,037 --> 02:03:41,337
Yeah, they can have rice.
That's alright.

2152
02:03:41,437 --> 02:03:43,457
Anneliese...

2153
02:03:43,557 --> 02:03:45,057
(GIGGLES)

2154
02:03:45,157 --> 02:03:46,757
Annaliese...

2155
02:03:49,977 --> 02:03:54,057
..why do you think you were framed
as the jam thief?

2156
02:03:54,157 --> 02:03:55,417
(LAUGHS)

2157
02:03:55,557 --> 02:03:59,057
Um... it could be because
I stare at people

2158
02:03:59,197 --> 02:04:00,697
when they have food left
and they're eating,

2159
02:04:00,797 --> 02:04:02,457
and that makes them uncomfortable.

2160
02:04:02,597 --> 02:04:05,857
But... I guess it had to be
something about my personality

2161
02:04:05,997 --> 02:04:08,217
that would make people think
that I ate the jam.

2162
02:04:08,357 --> 02:04:11,577
And maybe because I was carrying
the empty jam jar as well.

2163
02:04:11,677 --> 02:04:15,257
I'm... I don't know. (LAUGHS)

2164
02:04:15,357 --> 02:04:17,777
(APPLAUSE AND LAUGHTER)

2165
02:04:17,917 --> 02:04:21,937
Before we finish up,
I want to thank all of you again

2166
02:04:22,037 --> 02:04:23,537
for an exceptional season.

2167
02:04:23,637 --> 02:04:24,657
Well done.

2168
02:04:36,637 --> 02:04:39,297
Henry, what have you learnt
from your time on Survivor?

2169
02:04:39,437 --> 02:04:42,037
Oh, that it's the best game ever.
I had the best fun out there.

2170
02:04:42,177 --> 02:04:45,677
So, if they go around for season 3,
apply. Anyone can do it.

2171
02:04:45,757 --> 02:04:47,257
And play your Idol, right?

2172
02:04:47,397 --> 02:04:50,257
Oh, yeah.
Well, Jacqui's decision now.

2173
02:04:50,397 --> 02:04:52,497
- Maybe it didn't work.
- Maybe not. Maybe not.

2174
02:04:52,637 --> 02:04:55,097
Luke, would you... would you
do it again?

2175
02:04:55,237 --> 02:04:58,097
Er, I gotta run it past the wife
I think, yeah.

2176
02:04:58,197 --> 02:05:00,177
And the kids, you know.

2177
02:05:00,277 --> 02:05:01,577
Yeah, look...

2178
02:05:01,717 --> 02:05:04,037
I don't know. Hit me up
in a couple of years, you know?

2179
02:05:04,117 --> 02:05:05,977
Ooh.

2180
02:05:06,117 --> 02:05:09,297
Jericho.
Any tips for future players?

2181
02:05:09,397 --> 02:05:11,137
Ah, have fun out there.

2182
02:05:11,237 --> 02:05:14,737
Scheme, lie - do everything...

2183
02:05:14,837 --> 02:05:16,777
..with a smile.

2184
02:05:16,877 --> 02:05:19,037
With a smile. Exactly.

2185
02:05:25,397 --> 02:05:28,897
Well, that is it for season 2
of Australian Survivor.

2186
02:05:28,997 --> 02:05:33,677
(CHEERING AND APPLAUSE)

2187
02:05:33,757 --> 02:05:38,737
55 days, 24 people, one Survivor.

2188
02:05:38,837 --> 02:05:40,757
Congratulations, Jericho.

2189
02:05:40,837 --> 02:05:42,577
Goodnight!

2190
02:05:49,637 --> 02:05:52,037
(TRIUMPHANT MUSIC)

2191
02:05:54,837 --> 02:05:56,817
- Thanks, JL.
- Oh, thank you.

2192
02:06:02,377 --> 02:06:03,417
Hey.

2193
02:06:05,137 --> 02:06:06,697
Well done. You deserve it.



## S05E25

﻿1
00:00:00,000 --> 00:00:04,162
WWW.MY-SUBS.COM

1
00:00:03,495 --> 00:00:04,954
Coming into Survivor,

2
00:00:05,095 --> 00:00:08,034
I knew it was the toughest game
you can play.

3
00:00:08,175 --> 00:00:10,754
But I came into the game
to play honourably,

4
00:00:10,855 --> 00:00:14,274
with loyalty and integrity.

5
