00:00:14,415 --> 00:00:19,114
And the title of Sole Survivor
would just be the ants pants.

6
00:00:19,255 --> 00:00:23,074
People shouldn't underestimate
what a 60-year-old can do.

7
00:00:25,835 --> 00:00:26,874
Oh!

8
00:00:27,015 --> 00:00:29,914
She's right
in the environment she knows best.

9
00:00:30,015 --> 00:00:31,594
Look at Shane go!

10
00:00:35,375 --> 00:00:38,074
I'm representing
my generation.

11
00:00:39,475 --> 00:00:41,874
You don't have to, you know,
warehouse yourself

12
00:00:42,015 --> 00:00:44,874
and sit in a rocking chair
knitting booties.

13
00:00:44,975 --> 00:00:47,074
Shane, keep doing that!

14
00:00:47,215 --> 00:00:51,454
Let's not forget the fact that Shane
was a gold medallist three times

15
00:00:51,535 --> 00:00:52,874
at the age of 15.

16
00:00:55,615 --> 00:00:58,314
Shane Gould
is not just a champion...

17
00:01:00,335 --> 00:01:01,634
Oh, jeez!

18
00:01:01,775 --> 00:01:03,354
..she's a national treasure,
basically.

19
00:01:05,695 --> 00:01:08,874
I'm inclined to do a...
do a blindside.

20
00:01:08,975 --> 00:01:10,814
I think it's time to make moves.

21
00:01:10,895 --> 00:01:13,394
I'm worried about Shonelle.

22
00:01:13,495 --> 00:01:15,874
I want to get them apart.

23
00:01:15,975 --> 00:01:18,754
I can outwit and outplay people.

24
00:01:18,855 --> 00:01:19,994
Are you threatening me?

25
00:01:20,135 --> 00:01:24,274
People better be careful, 'cause
there might be a sting in the tail.

26
00:01:24,375 --> 00:01:26,674
Don't with Shane Gould.

27
00:01:26,775 --> 00:01:28,174
She's so good.

28
00:01:29,255 --> 00:01:30,174
She'll give it a crack.

29
00:01:30,295 --> 00:01:33,154
I've given it my all
and learnt on the run

30
00:01:33,255 --> 00:01:35,914
and I worked hard to find my way,

31
00:01:36,055 --> 00:01:38,834
negotiate my way
through the maze of relationships.

32
00:01:38,975 --> 00:01:41,314
- Three-way.
- Shh!

33
00:01:42,775 --> 00:01:45,874
I came into this game as a champion.

34
00:01:45,975 --> 00:01:48,514
And I'm leaving as a champion.

35
00:01:48,655 --> 00:01:52,674
And it really is up there
with my other achievements.

36
00:01:52,775 --> 00:01:54,554
It's really the icing on the cake.

37
00:02:00,295 --> 00:02:01,474
Welcome back!

38
00:02:01,615 --> 00:02:05,094
It's the Australian Survivor
Reunion Show.

39
00:02:05,235 --> 00:02:10,354
Shane Gould has just been crowned
the Sole Survivor for 2018

40
00:02:10,455 --> 00:02:13,234
and won $500,000.

41
00:02:20,195 --> 00:02:22,114
Thanks for playing the game.

42
00:02:22,255 --> 00:02:25,354
- Firstly, Shane, congratulations.
- Thank you, Jonathan.

43
00:02:25,495 --> 00:02:28,914
- You're welcome.
- It was a real treat to be involved.

44
00:02:29,055 --> 00:02:31,274
Yeah, really appreciate the privilege.

45
00:02:31,415 --> 00:02:33,994
- So, Olympic legend.
- Mm.

46
00:02:34,095 --> 00:02:35,634
Australian of the Year.

47
00:02:35,775 --> 00:02:37,914
Now Sole Survivor.
How does that feel?

48
00:02:38,995 --> 00:02:41,034
It feels surreal, you know?

49
00:02:41,175 --> 00:02:44,274
It's been a while
since I won an Olympic medal.

50
00:02:44,415 --> 00:02:50,114
Um... and it was a challenge
to see what I'm made of.

51
00:02:50,215 --> 00:02:52,514
To, um... I don't know.

52
00:02:52,615 --> 00:02:55,394
Just do something crazy, you know?

53
00:02:56,895 --> 00:02:59,594
You know, some people
talk about swimming being, um,

54
00:02:59,695 --> 00:03:01,714
not being an individual sport.

55
00:03:01,815 --> 00:03:03,594
But I reflected on it a lot

56
00:03:03,695 --> 00:03:05,094
and, actually, when you're swimming,

57
00:03:05,235 --> 00:03:07,354
you've got to watch people
and be aware of people,

58
00:03:07,455 --> 00:03:08,834
where they are next to you.

59
00:03:08,975 --> 00:03:10,714
You've got to read their body language.

60
00:03:10,855 --> 00:03:13,234
And I think I used that
to my advantage.

61
00:03:13,375 --> 00:03:18,194
OK, so going into the final tribal,
you go up against a top barrister,

62
00:03:18,335 --> 00:03:22,754
someone who
talks to a jury for a living.

63
00:03:23,895 --> 00:03:25,114
How did that feel?

64
00:03:25,255 --> 00:03:27,554
It was a really, really tough moment.

65
00:03:27,695 --> 00:03:30,914
But I knew Sharn was, um,
very eloquent,

66
00:03:31,055 --> 00:03:35,354
so I had to try and memorise,
you know, my achievements

67
00:03:35,455 --> 00:03:37,394
and how I played the game.

68
00:03:37,535 --> 00:03:40,354
And then when the questions started
coming, it was really difficult.

69
00:03:40,495 --> 00:03:44,154
So I thought, "Oh, that's it." You
know, "Sharn's got it for sure."

70
00:03:44,295 --> 00:03:47,834
It seemed to me
when you first started Survivor,

71
00:03:47,935 --> 00:03:49,474
you first started on the game,

72
00:03:49,615 --> 00:03:52,814
you seemed quite overwhelmed by all
of it, which I totally get.

73
00:03:52,895 --> 00:03:54,954
I often feel overwhelmed too.

74
00:03:55,055 --> 00:03:57,394
But as the game went on,

75
00:03:57,535 --> 00:03:59,814
you really seemed to find your groove
and relax into it.

76
00:03:59,935 --> 00:04:01,714
- Is that a fair assessment?
- Yeah.

77
00:04:01,855 --> 00:04:04,634
I was quietly just sort of,
you know, doing stuff

78
00:04:04,775 --> 00:04:07,994
and gathering information
and getting to know people.

79
00:04:08,095 --> 00:04:11,314
And as the numbers got less,

80
00:04:11,455 --> 00:04:14,634
it seemed the pressure was more on
and I rose to the pressure, I think.

81
00:04:14,775 --> 00:04:16,674
I liked the pressure.

82
00:04:16,775 --> 00:04:18,094
You really did. Absolutely.

83
00:04:20,395 --> 00:04:24,634
Mat, day one, you're on the boat
heading down the river

84
00:04:24,775 --> 00:04:28,034
and sitting there, in the Champion's
tribe, is Shane Gould.

85
00:04:28,175 --> 00:04:30,154
- What did you think?
- I was impressed.

86
00:04:30,255 --> 00:04:32,354
Um, I knew exactly who she was.

87
00:04:32,495 --> 00:04:36,394
And, I mean, I think I was the next
oldest in the tribe

88
00:04:36,535 --> 00:04:39,394
and, you know,
Shane's got 19 years on me.

89
00:04:39,535 --> 00:04:43,194
So I was impressed with her courage
and her tenacity

90
00:04:43,295 --> 00:04:45,554
and, yeah, you know, I loved it.

91
00:04:45,655 --> 00:04:46,714
It was great.

92
00:04:46,855 --> 00:04:48,714
Well, effectively Shane's been crowned

93
00:04:48,815 --> 00:04:50,674
the champion of the Champions.

94
00:04:50,815 --> 00:04:52,674
What have you learned from her
during Survivor?

95
00:04:52,775 --> 00:04:54,094
Don't with Shane Gould.

96
00:05:00,255 --> 00:05:01,634
Sorry, darling.

97
00:05:03,975 --> 00:05:10,114
Shane, you never panicked, no matter
how much the pressure was on.

98
00:05:10,215 --> 00:05:11,754
And you never became paranoid.

99
00:05:11,895 --> 00:05:14,994
And these are two things that often
will unravel people's games.

100
00:05:15,135 --> 00:05:16,634
And you never went there,
you held it together.

101
00:05:16,775 --> 00:05:18,874
Here you are.
Congratulations. Well done.

102
00:05:18,975 --> 00:05:20,354
Thank you.

103
00:05:25,055 --> 00:05:29,354
Sharn, you were the only other one
to make it to the end of the game.

104
00:05:29,455 --> 00:05:30,474
Five to four votes.

105
00:05:30,615 --> 00:05:32,234
- It was pretty close.
- Yeah.

106
00:05:32,375 --> 00:05:34,394
Let's take a look
at that final vote read.

107
00:05:36,215 --> 00:05:38,954
Shane, you impressed me tonight, girl.

108
00:05:39,095 --> 00:05:41,594
I wish I heard more about your game
when you were out there,

109
00:05:41,695 --> 00:05:43,454
but you really proved yourself.

110
00:05:45,435 --> 00:05:47,094
I'm just going for the underdog.

111
00:05:47,235 --> 00:05:49,094
I think it's actually quite impressive.

112
00:05:51,755 --> 00:05:55,154
You told me to put my weapon down,
but...

113
00:05:55,255 --> 00:05:56,454
..it's my respect pistol.

114
00:05:56,535 --> 00:05:57,594
Congrats on a great game.

115
00:05:58,935 --> 00:06:01,634
You're more of a physical,
dominant player than Shane,

116
00:06:01,735 --> 00:06:03,114
so my vote is going for you.

117
00:06:04,395 --> 00:06:09,034
Unfortunately I can only award
one of you with my vote.

118
00:06:09,175 --> 00:06:12,674
And, Sharn, I feel that you played
the superior game.

119
00:06:16,375 --> 00:06:20,554
You don't win on loyalty but you win
on game play. You win on challenges.

120
00:06:20,695 --> 00:06:23,754
You win on everything else.
You still have my vote.

121
00:06:25,275 --> 00:06:27,274
I really value honesty

122
00:06:27,415 --> 00:06:30,194
and I think Shane really showed that
tonight.

123
00:06:30,295 --> 00:06:32,354
Her game is really endearing

124
00:06:32,455 --> 00:06:34,674
and I'd be really proud if she won.

125
00:06:36,255 --> 00:06:38,454
Shane, I'm voting for you.

126
00:06:38,535 --> 00:06:40,314
Ooh!

127
00:06:40,455 --> 00:06:43,814
I think you were the most honest
and loyal person

128
00:06:43,895 --> 00:06:45,634
that I played with in this game.

129
00:06:45,735 --> 00:06:47,474
Sharn, you made a mistake.

130
00:06:47,615 --> 00:06:50,874
Your mistake of being disloyal to me
cost me the game.

131
00:06:50,975 --> 00:06:54,474
But it also cost you my vote.

132
00:06:54,575 --> 00:06:57,454
Shane, I hope you win. I love you.

133
00:06:59,975 --> 00:07:02,114
Survivors don't run from challenges,

134
00:07:02,255 --> 00:07:04,634
they accept them
and take them on board.

135
00:07:04,735 --> 00:07:06,114
So for me...

136
00:07:07,415 --> 00:07:09,194
..Shane is the Sole Survivor.

137
00:07:21,755 --> 00:07:24,814
Wow, that's tough to watch.
Sharn, you missed out by one vote.

138
00:07:24,895 --> 00:07:26,194
How does that feel?

139
00:07:26,335 --> 00:07:28,114
Well, of course, you know,
it's disappointing, sure.

140
00:07:28,255 --> 00:07:30,354
It's one vote between me
and $500,000, you know?

141
00:07:30,495 --> 00:07:33,194
And I played my heart out out there.
But you know what?

142
00:07:33,335 --> 00:07:36,554
I wouldn't change a thing because
I played the game true to myself.

143
00:07:36,695 --> 00:07:40,554
I took Shane
because I respected her game

144
00:07:40,695 --> 00:07:42,754
and she deserved to be sitting
there at the end with me.

145
00:07:42,895 --> 00:07:45,994
And if that's the way the cookie
crumbles, so be it. I accept it.

146
00:07:46,095 --> 00:07:48,194
But, you know, this jury

147
00:07:48,335 --> 00:07:50,114
is different to the jury
that I deal with, Jonathan,

148
00:07:50,255 --> 00:07:52,874
because the jury that I deal with
is an objective one.

149
00:07:53,015 --> 00:07:55,454
These guys, they've all
got their emotions tied into it.

150
00:07:55,535 --> 00:07:56,914
And that's the difference, yeah?

151
00:07:57,055 --> 00:08:00,274
Well, you've kind of touched on
the $500,000 question

152
00:08:00,415 --> 00:08:01,594
- I was gonna ask you.
- Yeah.

153
00:08:01,735 --> 00:08:04,454
Do you regret not taking Brian
to the final two?

154
00:08:04,535 --> 00:08:07,954
Look, I mean,
you can't do that in this game

155
00:08:08,055 --> 00:08:09,554
because you've got to move forward.

156
00:08:09,655 --> 00:08:11,714
And you can't go back and think,

157
00:08:11,855 --> 00:08:13,714
"I wish I would've done something
differently."

158
00:08:13,855 --> 00:08:16,314
You know, my purpose
and objective was to get Brian out.

159
00:08:16,455 --> 00:08:19,034
He was gunning for me,
I was gunning for him.

160
00:08:19,175 --> 00:08:21,154
I had that opportunity, so I took it.

161
00:08:21,295 --> 00:08:24,474
OK, so you said that we can't play
that hypothetical game

162
00:08:24,575 --> 00:08:26,474
but I can because I'm in charge.

163
00:08:26,615 --> 00:08:27,474
- Of course.
- So...

164
00:08:27,575 --> 00:08:28,674
I love it.

165
00:08:28,815 --> 00:08:29,914
I want to play
the "What if..." game.

166
00:08:30,015 --> 00:08:30,914
OK. Alright.

167
00:08:31,055 --> 00:08:34,454
So let's say that you did take Brian
to the final two.

168
00:08:34,575 --> 00:08:37,194
- Yep.
- And you put Shane on the jury.

169
00:08:37,295 --> 00:08:38,314
Uh-huh.

170
00:08:38,455 --> 00:08:40,596
Shane, who would you have voted for,
Sharn or Brian?

171
00:08:41,142 --> 00:08:43,291
See?

172
00:08:43,338 --> 00:08:45,517
I did share a bed... I did share
a bed with you for three nights.

173
00:08:45,618 --> 00:08:47,157
You did. You did, yes.

174
00:08:47,298 --> 00:08:50,057
Um... I probably would have
voted Sharn.

175
00:08:50,138 --> 00:08:53,277
Um, because, um, yeah,

176
00:08:53,418 --> 00:08:57,057
she'd, um, helped me
along through the game

177
00:08:57,138 --> 00:08:58,517
and we had a bond.

178
00:08:58,658 --> 00:09:00,477
But I would have voted
for second for you.

179
00:09:00,578 --> 00:09:01,697
Thank you.

180
00:09:06,038 --> 00:09:07,157
Sam...

181
00:09:11,798 --> 00:09:13,237
..Sharn missed out by one vote.

182
00:09:13,378 --> 00:09:15,237
But do you think
she played a great game?

183
00:09:15,378 --> 00:09:19,637
Well, I did write her name down,
so obviously that's a yes.

184
00:09:19,778 --> 00:09:21,417
Sharn had a more active game than Shane

185
00:09:21,538 --> 00:09:23,317
and as the question I asked
sort of alluded to,

186
00:09:23,418 --> 00:09:24,957
that was a big focus for me.

187
00:09:25,098 --> 00:09:29,717
It's hard to make big moves
and then survive the fallout,

188
00:09:29,858 --> 00:09:32,557
and Sharn managed to do that
and I was quite impressed.

189
00:09:35,858 --> 00:09:38,417
Sharn, you played a hell of a game.
Well done.

190
00:09:38,498 --> 00:09:39,517
Thanks.

191
00:09:39,658 --> 00:09:43,797
Coming up, we'll take a look at some
of this year's epic challenges

192
00:09:43,938 --> 00:09:47,397
and catch up with challenge beast
Lydia Lassila.

193
00:09:47,538 --> 00:09:50,317
Later, we'll talk
to the Godfather about THAT tribal

194
00:09:50,418 --> 00:09:52,077
that ended his game.

195
00:09:52,178 --> 00:09:53,557
Don't go away.

196
00:10:00,721 --> 00:10:03,220
Survivors ready? Go!

197
00:10:03,321 --> 00:10:04,620
You've got this!

198
00:10:04,721 --> 00:10:05,940
Zach takes him down.

199
00:10:07,161 --> 00:10:08,680
Mat is all over him.

200
00:10:08,801 --> 00:10:10,420
- Come on!
- You can be pretty brutal.

201
00:10:11,661 --> 00:10:13,220
This game is on.

202
00:10:13,321 --> 00:10:14,580
Throw me the axe! Throw the axe!

203
00:10:14,721 --> 00:10:17,860
Contenders or the Champions,
who wants it the most?

204
00:10:19,281 --> 00:10:21,260
Contenders want blood on this one.

205
00:10:21,361 --> 00:10:22,500
Steve goes in!

206
00:10:22,641 --> 00:10:24,380
I suppose you can call me
the Commando Killer.

207
00:10:25,861 --> 00:10:27,580
Just like that, Zach is in.

208
00:10:27,681 --> 00:10:29,100
Get off! Get off!

209
00:10:29,241 --> 00:10:32,620
Mat's beaten Robbie every time
they go head to head.

210
00:10:32,721 --> 00:10:34,140
Good job, Mat.

211
00:10:34,241 --> 00:10:35,340
You got this, Rob.

212
00:10:35,441 --> 00:10:36,540
Ooh, ooh!

213
00:10:36,641 --> 00:10:38,740
My turn! Yes!

214
00:10:38,881 --> 00:10:42,500
Australian Survivor's
most brutal challenge ever.

215
00:10:42,641 --> 00:10:44,780
How much can you take on
before you panic?

216
00:10:44,881 --> 00:10:46,320
Good job, Jenna, good job.

217
00:10:46,401 --> 00:10:47,740
Oh, let go!

218
00:10:47,881 --> 00:10:49,780
Oh, shit.

219
00:10:49,881 --> 00:10:51,020
Oh, no, no!

220
00:10:51,121 --> 00:10:53,340
Can we have the medic come in?

221
00:10:53,441 --> 00:10:54,940
I wanna finish this.

222
00:10:57,321 --> 00:10:59,900
OK, so just run
and go for broke.

223
00:11:02,061 --> 00:11:04,140
Oh! She belly flops!

224
00:11:04,241 --> 00:11:05,700
That's gonna leave a mark.

225
00:11:07,661 --> 00:11:09,320
Oh, Monika misses again.

226
00:11:09,401 --> 00:11:10,780
That was a hard hit.

227
00:11:10,881 --> 00:11:11,940
Are you bleeding?

228
00:11:12,041 --> 00:11:13,220
I don't know!

229
00:11:13,321 --> 00:11:14,460
Come on, Mon, you've got this.

230
00:11:14,601 --> 00:11:16,540
Monika, trying again.
She gets the rope.

231
00:11:19,921 --> 00:11:21,900
Five-time Olympian.

232
00:11:23,361 --> 00:11:24,680
Lydia's a machine.

233
00:11:25,761 --> 00:11:27,500
Lydia's whipping across this.

234
00:11:27,601 --> 00:11:29,180
Good job, Lyd.

235
00:11:29,281 --> 00:11:30,700
Wow, huge effort from Lydia.

236
00:11:34,121 --> 00:11:36,620
Lydia's been a powerhouse
in every challenge.

237
00:11:36,721 --> 00:11:38,260
I think she's a terminator.

238
00:11:41,921 --> 00:11:44,540
Champions are proving who they are!

239
00:11:44,681 --> 00:11:48,140
Damien takes it out for the Champions!

240
00:11:52,361 --> 00:11:54,420
Welcome back to the reunion show

241
00:11:54,561 --> 00:11:58,780
Champions Versus Contenders.

242
00:11:58,921 --> 00:12:04,220
Damien, we saw you win that first
immunity challenge for the Champions.

243
00:12:04,321 --> 00:12:05,420
How did that feel?

244
00:12:05,521 --> 00:12:06,580
It was amazing.

245
00:12:06,721 --> 00:12:08,740
It was good to get out there
and just be able to...

246
00:12:08,841 --> 00:12:09,740
I think contribute.

247
00:12:09,881 --> 00:12:11,460
That was my fear
coming into the game, I was like,

248
00:12:11,601 --> 00:12:13,940
"Alright, what if I can't contribute
to the team in any way?"

249
00:12:14,081 --> 00:12:16,620
You know, like, every single person
on the team

250
00:12:16,721 --> 00:12:17,860
has done something amazing

251
00:12:18,001 --> 00:12:21,700
so it was great to be able to go out
and sort of compete alongside them.

252
00:12:21,841 --> 00:12:25,580
You know, it's still intimidating,
'cause they're all awesome.

253
00:12:25,721 --> 00:12:28,260
So you wanna kind of step up
when you get the ball. So...

254
00:12:28,401 --> 00:12:31,420
I was breathing heavy when I threw
the first one, I'm not gonna lie.

255
00:12:31,561 --> 00:12:33,140
It was a wide.

256
00:12:36,201 --> 00:12:39,260
Lydia, we've never seen
such an incredible athlete

257
00:12:39,361 --> 00:12:40,420
on Australian Survivor.

258
00:12:40,561 --> 00:12:43,060
You were amazing to watch.

259
00:12:43,161 --> 00:12:44,900
I don't know about that.

260
00:12:46,341 --> 00:12:50,340
So earlier this year, you competed
in, what, is it your fifth Olympics?

261
00:12:50,481 --> 00:12:53,180
- Yep.
- Why did you wanna play Survivor?

262
00:12:53,321 --> 00:12:56,180
Um, it was a really good segue for me.

263
00:12:56,321 --> 00:13:00,860
I was retiring from sport and wanted
to just dive into a new challenge

264
00:13:01,001 --> 00:13:04,500
and what better way to do that,
to dive into Survivor?

265
00:13:04,641 --> 00:13:08,820
Um, and it's just everything
about Survivor attracted me to it.

266
00:13:08,921 --> 00:13:10,620
You know, the physical challenges

267
00:13:10,761 --> 00:13:13,100
and I really loved
the survival aspect of it.

268
00:13:13,241 --> 00:13:16,900
Um, and of course, there's
that social game, the manipulation

269
00:13:17,041 --> 00:13:20,100
and seeing how far you can
advance yourself. It's tricky.

270
00:13:20,241 --> 00:13:23,580
Robbie, at times, you seemed
transfixed by Lydia. What...?

271
00:13:23,721 --> 00:13:26,500
Ooh!

272
00:13:30,921 --> 00:13:32,900
I think we're all transfixed
by Robbie.

273
00:13:33,001 --> 00:13:34,340
Oh, stop it.

274
00:13:34,441 --> 00:13:36,380
What was it about her? What?

275
00:13:36,521 --> 00:13:37,780
- Well...
- Those eyes.

276
00:13:37,921 --> 00:13:42,140
What really sort of attracted me to
Lydia is her sort of mental courage

277
00:13:42,241 --> 00:13:43,500
and mental stamina, you know?

278
00:13:43,641 --> 00:13:45,380
Especially in that box court
challenge, you know,

279
00:13:45,521 --> 00:13:47,680
when I was really struggling,
I was at my limit,

280
00:13:47,801 --> 00:13:50,500
she said, "You've gotta dig deep,
you've gotta find your happy place,

281
00:13:50,601 --> 00:13:51,980
"you've got so much more in you."

282
00:13:52,121 --> 00:13:54,100
And just to hear that from someone
like that, you know,

283
00:13:54,201 --> 00:13:55,680
it changed me as a person.

284
00:13:55,801 --> 00:13:58,320
So I have so much respect for her
because she changed me,

285
00:13:58,441 --> 00:13:59,820
for the better.

286
00:13:59,921 --> 00:14:02,020
Ooh. Winning.

287
00:14:05,521 --> 00:14:08,320
Lydia, how did it feel
when you watched the show back

288
00:14:08,461 --> 00:14:10,960
and you're up on the pole,
fighting for your life,

289
00:14:11,101 --> 00:14:14,620
and Shane Gould
is planning your blindside?

290
00:14:16,241 --> 00:14:18,260
Oh, look, it wasn't surprising, really.

291
00:14:18,401 --> 00:14:20,860
I knew Shane had that in her
as well, you know?

292
00:14:21,001 --> 00:14:24,320
And sometimes in Survivor, you
have a bit of a stroke of bad luck.

293
00:14:24,461 --> 00:14:25,900
You know, it rained for, like,
two minutes

294
00:14:26,041 --> 00:14:29,380
and I slipped off the pole that
I wasn't gonna slip off, you know?

295
00:14:29,521 --> 00:14:32,460
So, um, things change really quickly.

296
00:14:32,561 --> 00:14:34,620
People kind of get a little jumpy.

297
00:14:34,721 --> 00:14:36,580
Um, we had a really strong alliance,

298
00:14:36,721 --> 00:14:40,420
one that probably didn't need to be
broken at the time that it was.

299
00:14:40,561 --> 00:14:42,460
And perhaps that would have advanced,

300
00:14:42,561 --> 00:14:44,380
you know, a lot more people's game.

301
00:14:44,521 --> 00:14:48,380
You have unfinished business with
this game. Would you play again?

302
00:14:48,481 --> 00:14:50,220
Oh, absolutely. I would.

303
00:14:50,361 --> 00:14:52,420
I loved every minute of it.

304
00:14:58,121 --> 00:15:01,980
Mat, one of my favourite rivalries
was between...

305
00:15:02,081 --> 00:15:04,260
..you and... Robbie...

306
00:15:04,441 --> 00:15:06,820
- Would you call that a rivalry?
- I knew you were gonna say that!

307
00:15:06,961 --> 00:15:09,100
- What did you say?
- You and Robbie, I love that battle.

308
00:15:09,201 --> 00:15:10,780
Remind me, what was the score.

309
00:15:10,921 --> 00:15:12,860
- Oh...!
- Eight to one.

310
00:15:13,001 --> 00:15:15,680
From the first time that I saw him
and it started,

311
00:15:15,801 --> 00:15:17,580
I was terrified,
rocking into every challenge,

312
00:15:17,721 --> 00:15:19,500
- 'cause he gave it everything and...
- He did.

313
00:15:19,641 --> 00:15:21,860
..I guess just had
a bit of luck on my side.

314
00:15:22,001 --> 00:15:25,180
Robbie, how was it,
going up against a rugby legend?

315
00:15:25,321 --> 00:15:27,780
The very first challenge,
I looked at him and was like,

316
00:15:27,921 --> 00:15:30,020
"I'm bigger than him,
I'm younger than him,

317
00:15:30,161 --> 00:15:32,860
"I'm better looking than him..."

318
00:15:33,001 --> 00:15:34,740
No, but I went into that, like,
"I've got this.

319
00:15:34,881 --> 00:15:37,220
"You know,
I can get this first challenge."

320
00:15:37,321 --> 00:15:38,860
And then... I underestimated him.

321
00:15:39,001 --> 00:15:41,540
So all I could do was learn
from every single mistake

322
00:15:41,681 --> 00:15:44,140
and try and get better and better
and try and beat him.

323
00:15:44,281 --> 00:15:45,740
- Nice.
- It was good fun.

324
00:15:48,121 --> 00:15:51,020
Monika, you're petrified of heights.

325
00:15:51,161 --> 00:15:53,140
I mean, you belly flopped off it
almost every time and...

326
00:15:53,241 --> 00:15:54,700
All! Every time!

327
00:15:54,841 --> 00:15:57,980
One of them, you ended up, you know,
cutting your lip, bleeding,

328
00:15:58,081 --> 00:15:59,700
but you never gave up.

329
00:15:59,841 --> 00:16:01,900
That was probably the most
terrifying moment of my life,

330
00:16:02,001 --> 00:16:03,620
thus far, it really was.

331
00:16:03,761 --> 00:16:06,540
But as bad as it was,
I proved to myself

332
00:16:06,681 --> 00:16:09,140
that I'm so much more courageous
than I ever gave myself credit for.

333
00:16:09,281 --> 00:16:11,180
You know... Thank you.

334
00:16:13,801 --> 00:16:15,860
Well done.
Well done for the courage.

335
00:16:15,961 --> 00:16:16,980
Thank you.

336
00:16:20,161 --> 00:16:25,100
Well, the point of Survivor
is to outwit, outplay and outlast

337
00:16:25,201 --> 00:16:26,460
all the others,

338
00:16:26,601 --> 00:16:29,340
and one guy thought he could do it
better than anyone else.

339
00:16:29,481 --> 00:16:30,740
Let's take a look.

340
00:16:30,841 --> 00:16:32,140
If you don't know me,

341
00:16:32,281 --> 00:16:34,820
you've been living under a rock
for the last 10 years.

342
00:16:36,141 --> 00:16:37,740
I'm King Russell.

343
00:16:38,841 --> 00:16:40,800
And I'm the only king here, baby.

344
00:16:40,901 --> 00:16:42,100
X...

345
00:16:43,501 --> 00:16:44,900
..marks the spot.

346
00:16:47,441 --> 00:16:49,820
It's amazing
how good I am at this game.

347
00:16:49,961 --> 00:16:54,140
It's Christmas every day of the year
when Russell Hantz is here!

348
00:16:55,841 --> 00:16:58,980
I'm gonna show you Aussies
how to play the game.

349
00:16:59,081 --> 00:17:00,180
What?!

350
00:17:00,281 --> 00:17:01,460
Oh, OK.

351
00:17:01,601 --> 00:17:04,380
They is so stupid, they're
walking around with the devil

352
00:17:04,481 --> 00:17:06,100
and don't even know he's there.

353
00:17:06,241 --> 00:17:09,460
If we align like this right now,
we're going to the end together.

354
00:17:09,561 --> 00:17:11,540
I'm playing with a bunch of dweebs.

355
00:17:11,681 --> 00:17:14,680
There's no damn way
they putting my name down.

356
00:17:14,761 --> 00:17:16,340
Russell? So Mr Texas,

357
00:17:16,481 --> 00:17:19,420
there's no chance am I gonna be
in alliance with that man.

358
00:17:21,681 --> 00:17:24,980
If anyone has a hidden immunity idol
and they wanna play it,

359
00:17:25,081 --> 00:17:26,320
now would be the time to do so.

360
00:17:29,861 --> 00:17:32,580
Russell, the tribe has spoken.

361
00:17:34,481 --> 00:17:35,580
Well done, guys.

362
00:17:35,721 --> 00:17:38,060
You've played the game three times
and never won, mate.

363
00:17:38,201 --> 00:17:40,320
Maybe go home and review it
and try again.

364
00:17:46,521 --> 00:17:50,100
Well, unfortunately,
our favourite villain, Russell,

365
00:17:50,241 --> 00:17:53,580
has decided not to be here
but he is here in spirit.

366
00:18:00,881 --> 00:18:04,320
Sharn, you called his bluff
and he went home wearing his idol.

367
00:18:04,461 --> 00:18:06,980
- Mm.
- How does it feel, outplaying Russell?

368
00:18:07,121 --> 00:18:09,380
- Feels great.
- It felt great in that moment.

369
00:18:09,521 --> 00:18:12,860
You know, us girls, we kind of knew
that that was what he was gonna do,

370
00:18:13,001 --> 00:18:15,740
he was out there, pretending,
and it was awesome.

371
00:18:15,841 --> 00:18:17,700
And we kind of enjoyed that moment.

372
00:18:17,841 --> 00:18:19,780
Only 'cause he'd been
big-noting himself, you know?

373
00:18:19,921 --> 00:18:22,460
And especially because he had
the idol around his neck.

374
00:18:22,561 --> 00:18:24,060
I mean, come on, you know?

375
00:18:24,161 --> 00:18:26,340
That's confidence, over-confident.

376
00:18:26,481 --> 00:18:29,860
Steve, if you could describe Russell
with one word, what would it be?

377
00:18:29,961 --> 00:18:31,260
Idiot.

378
00:18:34,561 --> 00:18:37,860
Well, going home with an idol
was a theme of this season.

379
00:18:39,161 --> 00:18:41,380
After the break, we're gonna chat
with the Godfather

380
00:18:41,521 --> 00:18:45,220
about the biggest blindside
in Australian Survivor history.

381
00:18:45,361 --> 00:18:47,260
Don't go away.

382
00:18:54,136 --> 00:18:56,758
Can they score?! Yes!

383
00:18:57,105 --> 00:18:59,144
I've played at the top level
for my country

384
00:18:59,225 --> 00:19:00,924
in rugby league and rugby union.

385
00:19:01,065 --> 00:19:04,604
I've played against the biggest,
the best, the strongest, the fastest.

386
00:19:04,705 --> 00:19:06,644
Why would I sign up for this?

387
00:19:06,745 --> 00:19:08,724
Well, because it's the ultimate game.

388
00:19:10,025 --> 00:19:11,144
Takes a shot.

389
00:19:13,065 --> 00:19:15,924
Survivor is the toughest game
you could ever play.

390
00:19:17,805 --> 00:19:21,044
As much as this game of Survivor
is physical in the challenges,

391
00:19:21,145 --> 00:19:22,244
it's also social.

392
00:19:22,385 --> 00:19:26,144
My goal is just to make sure that
I've got some really tight bonds

393
00:19:26,225 --> 00:19:27,884
with the people in the tribe.

394
00:19:28,025 --> 00:19:29,724
I want you to singe off my cheek hairs.

395
00:19:29,865 --> 00:19:32,044
That's a big flame! You're going to
burn my eyelashes.

396
00:19:33,165 --> 00:19:36,884
I feel like I've got a fairly decent
bit of control.

397
00:19:37,025 --> 00:19:39,144
This is our life right now,
but it's a game.

398
00:19:39,225 --> 00:19:41,444
So, as well as the social game,

399
00:19:41,545 --> 00:19:43,204
it's important to bring people over.

400
00:19:43,305 --> 00:19:44,324
The new alliance.

401
00:19:45,445 --> 00:19:47,244
Yeah, Mat is fun in everything he does.

402
00:19:47,385 --> 00:19:48,844
You've all got gifts.

403
00:19:48,985 --> 00:19:52,964
He's charming and charismatic. He's
totally acting like the Godfather.

404
00:19:54,305 --> 00:19:56,004
Right now, I guess you could say
I feel good.

405
00:19:56,145 --> 00:19:59,524
I've got a hidden immunity idol
and I've got a good alliance,

406
00:19:59,625 --> 00:20:00,724
it's rock solid.

407
00:20:00,865 --> 00:20:03,404
It's now just about working out
how that alliance

408
00:20:03,545 --> 00:20:05,404
turns into me being the Sole Survivor.

409
00:20:07,905 --> 00:20:09,244
Welcome back.

410
00:20:10,385 --> 00:20:14,044
Right now, we're talking to
the Godfather himself.

411
00:20:14,145 --> 00:20:16,084
Mat, did you realise on the island

412
00:20:16,225 --> 00:20:18,144
that you... they'd given you
that nickname?

413
00:20:18,265 --> 00:20:19,724
No.

414
00:20:19,865 --> 00:20:23,084
I mean, how do you think you got
the nickname of the Godfather?

415
00:20:23,185 --> 00:20:24,884
Oh, just Benji being Benji.

416
00:20:25,025 --> 00:20:26,644
He'd point his finger,
people going home.

417
00:20:26,745 --> 00:20:28,204
Calling the shots the whole time.

418
00:20:28,345 --> 00:20:30,504
I don't know, I like to
just talk to people.

419
00:20:30,625 --> 00:20:33,804
Like, I'm a fun, social person and...

420
00:20:33,945 --> 00:20:36,004
..I guess because
I was sort of talking a lot

421
00:20:36,145 --> 00:20:39,924
and things seemed to happen based on
what our alliance were deciding,

422
00:20:40,065 --> 00:20:41,964
people thought I was
pulling all the strings.

423
00:20:42,105 --> 00:20:45,784
But I stand here and I'll say,
and Sharn will agree,

424
00:20:45,925 --> 00:20:47,524
we would all just sit
and talk about it,

425
00:20:47,665 --> 00:20:51,044
and I guess because I was delivering
the information,

426
00:20:51,185 --> 00:20:54,604
it seemed to be, you know,
I was the Godfather, so...

427
00:20:54,745 --> 00:20:58,144
- My son just got a Godfather T-shirt.
- Really?

428
00:20:59,705 --> 00:21:02,164
Well, you've achieved so much
in your life.

429
00:21:02,265 --> 00:21:04,084
Why did you want to play Survivor?

430
00:21:04,225 --> 00:21:05,884
I remember watching the original series

431
00:21:05,985 --> 00:21:07,404
when Richard Hatch won,

432
00:21:07,545 --> 00:21:08,924
and I remember just looking at it,
thinking,

433
00:21:09,065 --> 00:21:11,144
"Man, these guys have got no idea.
I want to get into it."

434
00:21:11,265 --> 00:21:14,964
So, to get the chance, I just wanted
to get in there and test myself.

435
00:21:15,105 --> 00:21:17,884
Yeah, it was a challenge,
but one that I thoroughly enjoyed.

436
00:21:19,305 --> 00:21:21,884
Steve, you and Mat
quickly became buddies.

437
00:21:22,025 --> 00:21:24,084
What was it about him
that you were drawn to?

438
00:21:24,225 --> 00:21:25,444
God...

439
00:21:25,585 --> 00:21:28,004
- Is it the eyes or...?
- Yeah, the eyes.

440
00:21:28,145 --> 00:21:31,484
- And the moustache.
- Yeah, the mo'.

441
00:21:31,585 --> 00:21:33,804
No, he's a chatterbox.

442
00:21:33,945 --> 00:21:36,164
- And, um...
- Someone had to talk.

443
00:21:40,345 --> 00:21:43,964
Well, Mat, you were
a physical powerhouse,

444
00:21:44,105 --> 00:21:46,924
you had a great social game,
a strong alliance,

445
00:21:47,025 --> 00:21:48,804
and an idol in your pocket,

446
00:21:48,905 --> 00:21:50,564
but then it all went tits-up.

447
00:21:50,665 --> 00:21:51,724
Let's have a look.

448
00:21:53,025 --> 00:21:55,404
If anyone has a hidden immunity idol
and you want to play it,

449
00:21:55,505 --> 00:21:56,884
now would be the time to do so.

450
00:21:56,985 --> 00:21:58,844
I do have one I want to play.

451
00:22:02,225 --> 00:22:03,444
But I'm playing it for Mat.

452
00:22:06,465 --> 00:22:07,364
No, no, no.

453
00:22:08,525 --> 00:22:09,724
Don't play it for Mat.

454
00:22:13,385 --> 00:22:15,484
No, play it for you.

455
00:22:18,085 --> 00:22:20,844
Play it for you.
It's going to go to a re-vote.

456
00:22:26,165 --> 00:22:27,804
- Alright.
- It's your idol.

457
00:22:27,945 --> 00:22:30,004
You play it
the way you want to play it.

458
00:22:30,105 --> 00:22:31,644
OK...

459
00:22:34,585 --> 00:22:36,084
Don't gamble your life, Sharn.

460
00:22:36,185 --> 00:22:37,284
You're getting played.

461
00:22:41,945 --> 00:22:43,644
I'll play it for...

462
00:22:46,745 --> 00:22:48,144
..for myself.

463
00:22:54,785 --> 00:22:57,084
Sharn, so I'm clear,
you're playing this for yourself?

464
00:22:59,225 --> 00:23:00,444
- Yes.
- Yes.

465
00:23:00,585 --> 00:23:02,964
What's going on?

466
00:23:03,105 --> 00:23:04,324
- I...
- You're getting played.

467
00:23:04,425 --> 00:23:05,324
It's going to be split.

468
00:23:07,165 --> 00:23:10,844
16th person voted out of Australian
Survivor: Champions vs Contenders...

469
00:23:12,465 --> 00:23:13,524
..Mat.

470
00:23:31,505 --> 00:23:32,924
I think it's safe to say

471
00:23:33,065 --> 00:23:36,044
that was the biggest blindside
we've seen on this show,

472
00:23:36,145 --> 00:23:37,724
certainly the craziest.

473
00:23:37,865 --> 00:23:41,724
Now, the whole country was in shock
when that happened.

474
00:23:41,825 --> 00:23:43,884
I mean, I was in shock at the time.

475
00:23:43,985 --> 00:23:45,484
What was going through your head?

476
00:23:45,625 --> 00:23:50,244
When Benji piped up, it was probably
smarter than what he even thought

477
00:23:50,345 --> 00:23:51,724
because not only did he...

478
00:23:51,865 --> 00:23:55,204
When he said split vote, and
"Don't gamble your life" to Sharn,

479
00:23:55,345 --> 00:23:58,784
I thought, "Well, they've obviously
thrown votes on Sharn."

480
00:23:58,925 --> 00:24:02,424
Well, we've got four votes on Brian,
so I'll be right.

481
00:24:02,565 --> 00:24:04,924
I still didn't even think
in my head, "Play my idol."

482
00:24:05,065 --> 00:24:07,004
Like, it just...
I didn't even think...

483
00:24:07,145 --> 00:24:09,424
I didn't even think about
pulling my idol out of the bag,

484
00:24:09,565 --> 00:24:12,724
or Mo's idol, I should say,
out of the bag.

485
00:24:12,865 --> 00:24:16,204
It was, um... I was just
trying to calculate stuff.

486
00:24:16,345 --> 00:24:20,644
And I literally... like, it happens
that... in my mind, that quick.

487
00:24:20,785 --> 00:24:23,144
Like, Sharn stood up and said
she was playing it for me,

488
00:24:23,225 --> 00:24:24,524
and I'm sort of trying to calculate,

489
00:24:24,665 --> 00:24:28,284
but by the time I looked around,
my name was being read out,

490
00:24:28,385 --> 00:24:29,484
and I thought, "Oh, it's over."

491
00:24:29,625 --> 00:24:33,284
But I think because Benji
was so aware of his play,

492
00:24:33,425 --> 00:24:36,484
and it was coming undone,
he was quick to jump on it

493
00:24:36,625 --> 00:24:39,424
when he saw it unfolding against him.

494
00:24:39,505 --> 00:24:41,044
OK, I'm glad you brought that up.

495
00:24:41,185 --> 00:24:44,964
Benji, it was a ballsy, brilliant move,

496
00:24:45,105 --> 00:24:49,644
but had you planned for that, or
were you just thinking on your feet?

497
00:24:49,745 --> 00:24:52,644
I 100% planned for that.

498
00:24:52,745 --> 00:24:54,804
I knew it was going down that way

499
00:24:54,945 --> 00:24:57,004
because Sharn and I
had talks on the beach earlier.

500
00:24:57,145 --> 00:24:59,044
I disagree with that.
I don't think you knew,

501
00:24:59,185 --> 00:25:02,524
because, you know what, I kind of
formed my view in tribal council.

502
00:25:02,665 --> 00:25:06,204
I had... I was sitting there,
intending to play it for myself,

503
00:25:06,345 --> 00:25:08,284
and then the way that the council
was going down,

504
00:25:08,425 --> 00:25:10,084
I'm thinking, "Yep, this is
what's going to happen.

505
00:25:10,225 --> 00:25:11,804
"I'm playing it for Matty."
So, I don't...

506
00:25:11,945 --> 00:25:15,144
And I reckon, from what I saw
of Benji's reaction,

507
00:25:15,265 --> 00:25:17,164
he thought, "Shit,
I've gotta do something here."

508
00:25:17,265 --> 00:25:18,324
I think he used that word.

509
00:25:18,465 --> 00:25:21,124
Maybe he considered it,
but he didn't know.

510
00:25:21,225 --> 00:25:22,204
There's no way.

511
00:25:22,345 --> 00:25:26,004
Like... Because like I said, I was
thinking that in tribal council,

512
00:25:26,105 --> 00:25:27,124
literally at that time.

513
00:25:27,265 --> 00:25:29,284
I thought, "Why would I, you know,
do this?

514
00:25:29,425 --> 00:25:31,564
"Why would I play it for myself
when I can play it for Mat,

515
00:25:31,705 --> 00:25:34,204
"and then, you know,
ultimately save Mat."

516
00:25:34,345 --> 00:25:36,724
But then when Benji piped up,
I thought,

517
00:25:36,865 --> 00:25:39,604
"OK, maybe there's something
I don't know about,

518
00:25:39,705 --> 00:25:40,844
"it could go to a re-vote,"

519
00:25:40,985 --> 00:25:43,604
and there would have been, you know,
a completely different story.

520
00:25:43,705 --> 00:25:44,644
There's so many things...

521
00:25:44,785 --> 00:25:47,564
On that point too, Sharn,
I was flipping, 100%.

522
00:25:47,705 --> 00:25:50,524
I'd made my mind up, "I wanna
take down this Champion alliance,"

523
00:25:50,625 --> 00:25:52,084
which was killing us the whole game.

524
00:25:52,185 --> 00:25:53,084
I had an idol in my pocket

525
00:25:53,225 --> 00:25:54,924
and I knew the votes
were landing on Brian.

526
00:25:55,065 --> 00:25:59,084
If you played that for Mat,
I'd play my idol for Brian

527
00:25:59,185 --> 00:26:00,284
and then you go home.

528
00:26:01,945 --> 00:26:04,684
Well, Survivor really is
about key moments,

529
00:26:04,825 --> 00:26:08,144
and I think it's fair to say, Mat,
that you had quite a few.

530
00:26:08,265 --> 00:26:11,204
So, not getting rid of Brian
when you had a chance,

531
00:26:11,305 --> 00:26:12,684
good or bad decision?

532
00:26:12,825 --> 00:26:16,724
Yeah, it's probably a move
I regret a little, that one.

533
00:26:16,825 --> 00:26:18,444
Nah, don't worry about it.

534
00:26:19,905 --> 00:26:22,604
Keeping Benji over Sam.
Good or bad decision?

535
00:26:22,745 --> 00:26:26,424
Um, I don't think... I don't think
that was a bad decision

536
00:26:26,565 --> 00:26:28,484
because I know what Sam was plotting.

537
00:26:28,585 --> 00:26:29,724
Oh, yeah, yeah.

538
00:26:29,865 --> 00:26:32,564
It was either going to be Benji
or me going after Mat next.

539
00:26:32,705 --> 00:26:33,884
- Yeah.
- I got the honours.

540
00:26:33,985 --> 00:26:35,884
Yeah, well, screw you.

541
00:26:36,025 --> 00:26:38,684
Well, to finish up, what was the
hardest part of the game for you?

542
00:26:38,785 --> 00:26:40,144
It was probably that final vote.

543
00:26:40,265 --> 00:26:44,444
Looking at Shane and Sharn,
you know, both my alliance,

544
00:26:44,585 --> 00:26:46,924
you know, I just had to make
a logical decision.

545
00:26:47,065 --> 00:26:50,684
Would have been a lot easier
if she'd taken Brian.

546
00:26:50,825 --> 00:26:52,924
For me, that is.
Maybe not for others.

547
00:26:53,065 --> 00:26:55,924
I'm just getting whacked everywhere,
aren't I?

548
00:26:56,025 --> 00:26:56,964
Still love you.

549
00:26:57,065 --> 00:26:58,524
We love you, Grubby.

550
00:26:58,665 --> 00:27:01,444
Alright. Well, after the break,
we talk to the guy

551
00:27:01,545 --> 00:27:03,484
that took down the Godfather.

552
00:27:03,625 --> 00:27:06,084
And later, we catch up
with power couple Shonella.

553
00:27:06,185 --> 00:27:07,564
Stick around.

554
00:27:17,061 --> 00:27:19,780
I have told many lies
in this game to many people.

555
00:27:19,921 --> 00:27:23,620
They're saying Anita tonight
and Shonee next.

556
00:27:23,761 --> 00:27:26,660
It's important for us
to know who we're playing with.

557
00:27:26,801 --> 00:27:28,480
That's the lie that sent me to Exile.

558
00:27:30,761 --> 00:27:33,020
I didn't make anything up.
You never said that...

559
00:27:33,161 --> 00:27:36,060
You said that you were
targeting those three...

560
00:27:36,201 --> 00:27:38,820
Benji, don't stand here
and lie to my face, bro.

561
00:27:38,921 --> 00:27:41,780
So, the curtain has been drawn back

562
00:27:41,921 --> 00:27:43,900
and everyone has seen me
holding the strings.

563
00:27:44,001 --> 00:27:46,300
I have told, like, one lie.

564
00:27:46,441 --> 00:27:48,300
So, I'm not actually
a graphic designer.

565
00:27:48,441 --> 00:27:50,500
- Oh, really?
- Yeah, I'm not.

566
00:27:50,601 --> 00:27:52,180
I run a business.

567
00:27:52,321 --> 00:27:54,120
It made, like,
over $1 million last year.

568
00:27:54,241 --> 00:27:55,580
- Oh, my God.
- Yeah.

569
00:27:55,681 --> 00:27:57,500
Benji told me he's a millionaire.

570
00:27:58,741 --> 00:28:00,860
Benji is sneaky as.

571
00:28:01,001 --> 00:28:02,700
I don't think that's his real accent.

572
00:28:02,801 --> 00:28:04,380
I got your back out here.

573
00:28:04,521 --> 00:28:07,500
- It's Sharnji. Sharnji.
- Sharnji to the end.

574
00:28:07,601 --> 00:28:11,660
Sharnji to the endji. Totally.

575
00:28:11,761 --> 00:28:12,780
That's our motto.

576
00:28:13,921 --> 00:28:15,860
- What do you mean, you haven't lied?
- Not much.

577
00:28:16,001 --> 00:28:19,360
- Not that much.
- Well, some.

578
00:28:19,441 --> 00:28:20,780
Wait, let me think about it.

579
00:28:20,881 --> 00:28:22,500
Maybe I have.

580
00:28:24,041 --> 00:28:27,140
Welcome back to the
Australian Survivor Reunion Show.

581
00:28:27,281 --> 00:28:29,700
Shane has just won
half a million dollars.

582
00:28:29,841 --> 00:28:32,260
She says she played
with loyalty and honesty,

583
00:28:32,401 --> 00:28:36,540
a completely different approach
to this man here, Benji.

584
00:28:36,681 --> 00:28:41,340
Roughly how many lies do you think
you told during this game?

585
00:28:41,481 --> 00:28:42,620
- Um...
- Don't lie.

586
00:28:44,081 --> 00:28:45,420
Lost count on day two.

587
00:28:45,561 --> 00:28:47,380
Robbie says we didn't tell
that many but actually,

588
00:28:47,481 --> 00:28:48,700
what I wanted to do is...

589
00:28:48,841 --> 00:28:51,020
There's a guy who thinks he's
the biggest villain of all time

590
00:28:51,161 --> 00:28:54,220
and he got voted out first on
his tribe and doesn't even show up.

591
00:28:54,361 --> 00:28:59,120
So I wanted to just take his hat
and put it where it belongs.

592
00:28:59,201 --> 00:29:01,140
Because he's not the greatest.

593
00:29:03,421 --> 00:29:05,780
I was gonna do that.

594
00:29:05,921 --> 00:29:08,580
But to answer your question,
I told a lot of lies out there.

595
00:29:08,721 --> 00:29:10,820
- A lot?
- A lot.

596
00:29:10,961 --> 00:29:13,980
I don't know
if I told the truth at any one time.

597
00:29:14,121 --> 00:29:17,340
Well, look, in a game where you need
to vote someone out

598
00:29:17,481 --> 00:29:21,120
every second night,
deception is obviously key,

599
00:29:21,201 --> 00:29:23,460
and you were a master at it.

600
00:29:23,561 --> 00:29:25,180
Was that a plan coming in?

601
00:29:25,321 --> 00:29:27,820
Yeah, when you get the opportunity
to play Survivor, I mean,

602
00:29:27,921 --> 00:29:28,980
so many people try out for this

603
00:29:29,121 --> 00:29:30,760
and we're all so appreciative
we got on.

604
00:29:30,901 --> 00:29:32,780
Like, you've got to play hard,
you've got to go out there,

605
00:29:32,921 --> 00:29:35,060
you've got to lie, you've got
to deceive, you've got to have fun.

606
00:29:35,161 --> 00:29:36,220
You've just got to give 100% at it.

607
00:29:36,361 --> 00:29:37,580
So when I got the opportunity,
I'm like,

608
00:29:37,681 --> 00:29:39,140
"Yeah, I'm gonna play it big,"

609
00:29:39,281 --> 00:29:42,860
because, like, I don't want to get
dragged to the end by the Godfather.

610
00:29:42,961 --> 00:29:44,620
I want to play my own game

611
00:29:44,761 --> 00:29:46,340
and set my own rules
like I do with my own life.

612
00:29:46,481 --> 00:29:50,220
Well, you lied to get rid of Tegan,
but she came back.

613
00:29:50,321 --> 00:29:51,580
Were you nervous about that?

614
00:29:51,721 --> 00:29:54,540
I was very nervous, yeah.
Tegan came back really scary.

615
00:29:54,641 --> 00:29:56,460
She came back with a vengeance.

616
00:29:56,601 --> 00:29:59,460
And you just revealed all of my and
Robbie's plans, and Zach's plans,

617
00:29:59,561 --> 00:30:01,780
so that was very nerve-racking.

618
00:30:01,881 --> 00:30:03,420
But we put an end to that.

619
00:30:05,721 --> 00:30:07,140
Tegan, how did you feel

620
00:30:07,281 --> 00:30:09,820
knowing that your game was
turned upside-down by a lie?

621
00:30:09,921 --> 00:30:11,820
It was really shocking to me

622
00:30:11,961 --> 00:30:15,140
because I just didn't think
that Benji had it in him.

623
00:30:15,281 --> 00:30:19,980
So when Anita came to Exile and
told me what had happened, I just...

624
00:30:20,121 --> 00:30:24,020
I was so shocked. You know,
it was written all over my face.

625
00:30:24,121 --> 00:30:26,140
At tribal council, I had no idea

626
00:30:26,281 --> 00:30:28,540
that I was gonna be the person
getting sent home that night.

627
00:30:28,681 --> 00:30:32,940
Well, speaking of lies, there was
one that was never uncovered.

628
00:30:33,041 --> 00:30:34,660
Jackie.

629
00:30:34,801 --> 00:30:36,300
Speed Cuber.

630
00:30:36,401 --> 00:30:45,080
Yeah, I actually never told
a single person

631
00:30:45,221 --> 00:30:48,180
and, you know, I went in there
to play Survivor and...

632
00:30:48,321 --> 00:30:50,940
..you know...

633
00:30:51,041 --> 00:30:53,340
I wasn't there to go camping.

634
00:30:53,441 --> 00:30:55,020
I wasn't there to make friends.

635
00:30:55,121 --> 00:30:56,980
I wasn't there to climb walls.

636
00:30:59,001 --> 00:31:01,120
I was there to play Survivor.
Like, yeah.

637
00:31:01,241 --> 00:31:05,660
And unfortunately, you know,
I went home early.

638
00:31:05,801 --> 00:31:08,760
But I just never wanted to go in there

639
00:31:08,841 --> 00:31:10,120
and just hang on to someone

640
00:31:10,241 --> 00:31:12,700
and just try
and get to the end that way.

641
00:31:17,361 --> 00:31:19,980
Benji, there was another secret
that was never uncovered.

642
00:31:20,081 --> 00:31:23,300
For you, Survivor is a family affair.

643
00:31:23,441 --> 00:31:26,180
- Anneliese... Where are you?
- Hey.

644
00:31:26,281 --> 00:31:29,980
Anneliese from season two
is your sister.

645
00:31:30,121 --> 00:31:31,340
Yeah, she is.
She's my little sister.

646
00:31:31,481 --> 00:31:34,140
- Hey, Ben.
- Hey, how are you going?

647
00:31:34,241 --> 00:31:35,860
Yeah, she is my little sis.

648
00:31:36,001 --> 00:31:38,540
She went out and played
a hell of a game out there

649
00:31:38,641 --> 00:31:40,620
and she lasted 38 days

650
00:31:40,761 --> 00:31:44,340
and I went out and played
a hell of a game and lasted 39 days.

651
00:31:45,961 --> 00:31:49,940
Yeah, but, Benji, at least Anneliese
played her idol before she went home.

652
00:31:50,041 --> 00:31:51,700
Thank you!

653
00:31:51,801 --> 00:31:52,780
Speaking of your idol,

654
00:31:52,921 --> 00:31:55,500
let's take a look at that scene
that we will never forget.

655
00:31:57,641 --> 00:31:59,980
I'm going.

656
00:32:02,301 --> 00:32:03,760
That's delicious.

657
00:32:05,221 --> 00:32:07,020
What's this?

658
00:32:07,121 --> 00:32:08,860
Goddamn, it's a clue.

659
00:32:08,961 --> 00:32:10,140
I'm gonna try and cover it.

660
00:32:11,721 --> 00:32:13,120
Yes.

661
00:32:14,381 --> 00:32:15,780
So good, man.

662
00:32:15,921 --> 00:32:18,220
Building up a sweat.
I'm slowing down.

663
00:32:18,321 --> 00:32:21,820
Mm!

664
00:32:29,561 --> 00:32:31,540
This is not my finest moment.

665
00:32:38,561 --> 00:32:40,760
OK, hands up if that was the grossest
thing you've ever seen?

666
00:32:40,841 --> 00:32:43,020
No, I've seen grosser.

667
00:32:43,161 --> 00:32:46,020
- You didn't experience, Jono.
- What?

668
00:32:46,161 --> 00:32:48,340
- Me and him had to experience that.
- I was getting to that.

669
00:32:48,481 --> 00:32:51,120
- OK.
- Both you guys turned up afterwards.

670
00:32:51,241 --> 00:32:53,400
What did you think
when you watch that back?

671
00:32:53,541 --> 00:32:55,940
I've got two dogs and two kids at home.

672
00:32:56,081 --> 00:32:58,860
And they've got better table manners
than Benji, so...

673
00:32:59,001 --> 00:33:02,820
Look, 23 days into the game,
we're all still pretty hungry.

674
00:33:02,961 --> 00:33:05,180
So, I mean, even if
I had have seen him eat like that,

675
00:33:05,321 --> 00:33:07,980
I probably... I still would have
went in and had nachos.

676
00:33:08,121 --> 00:33:12,140
But everyone that's come up to me
since coming home,

677
00:33:12,281 --> 00:33:14,180
they've asked me
if I've eaten nachos again.

678
00:33:14,321 --> 00:33:17,820
I don't think I could ever eat
nachos without him on my mind.

679
00:33:17,921 --> 00:33:20,820
I certainly can't eat nachos again.

680
00:33:20,961 --> 00:33:24,300
Coming up after the break, we'll chat
to the power couple Shonella.

681
00:33:24,441 --> 00:33:27,460
And later, we'll talk to
the most controversial player

682
00:33:27,561 --> 00:33:28,980
we've ever had.

683
00:33:29,081 --> 00:33:30,540
Don't go away.

684
00:33:40,088 --> 00:33:41,349
Eww!

685
00:33:41,349 --> 00:33:42,608
- What was that?
- My God.

686
00:33:42,608 --> 00:33:45,142
A bug just flew so close to my ear.

687
00:33:45,277 --> 00:33:48,596
Fenella and I have a special ability
to find cracks

688
00:33:48,697 --> 00:33:50,516
and just float our way to the top.

689
00:33:50,617 --> 00:33:52,496
Game on, molls.

690
00:33:54,937 --> 00:33:58,356
We laugh at the same things
and, yeah, she's my bestie.

691
00:33:58,457 --> 00:33:59,956
Yay.

692
00:34:00,097 --> 00:34:01,496
Ah, slipped through
the cracks once again.

693
00:34:03,497 --> 00:34:04,676
I think the biggest topic is...

694
00:34:09,337 --> 00:34:14,156
It's very obvious that Shonee and
Fenella are a really tight pair.

695
00:34:14,297 --> 00:34:16,496
We've started calling them Shonella.

696
00:34:16,577 --> 00:34:18,236
Because they are a power couple.

697
00:34:24,577 --> 00:34:26,196
Shane, are there
any tight two alliances?

698
00:34:26,297 --> 00:34:28,196
There's a Shonella.

699
00:34:28,297 --> 00:34:30,156
Shonella?

700
00:34:30,297 --> 00:34:32,396
- Is that, like, a perfume.
- Sounds expensive.

701
00:34:32,497 --> 00:34:33,996
Luxurious.

702
00:34:35,277 --> 00:34:37,956
- You've got a necklace on, too.
- I'll clap to that.

703
00:34:38,097 --> 00:34:41,716
Welcome back to
the Australian Survivor Reunion Show.

704
00:34:41,857 --> 00:34:45,596
We're talking to Shonella,
this year's unlikely power couple.

705
00:34:45,737 --> 00:34:48,036
Unlikely? What do you mean, mate?
Match made in heaven.

706
00:34:50,517 --> 00:34:54,956
Shonee, what was it about Fenella
that you found irresistible?

707
00:34:55,057 --> 00:34:56,516
Well, I came for the rice...

708
00:34:56,657 --> 00:34:58,316
I didn't come for the rice,
I came for the money,

709
00:34:58,457 --> 00:34:59,956
and stayed for the rice and this lady.

710
00:35:00,057 --> 00:35:01,156
Beautiful.

711
00:35:01,297 --> 00:35:03,516
I ate a termite
and it turned into love.

712
00:35:05,777 --> 00:35:08,396
When you were called out as a power
couple, was that a surprise to you?

713
00:35:08,497 --> 00:35:09,436
Not at all.

714
00:35:09,577 --> 00:35:11,716
We were like,
"Why did it take people 40 days

715
00:35:11,857 --> 00:35:13,956
"to realise
that we are very powerful?"

716
00:35:14,057 --> 00:35:15,236
No. I think it was 45, wasn't it?

717
00:35:15,377 --> 00:35:17,796
- No. It didn't last that long.
- Oh. 44.

718
00:35:19,337 --> 00:35:23,396
Well, back on day one
when you saw the Champions walk in,

719
00:35:23,497 --> 00:35:24,436
what were you thinking?

720
00:35:24,577 --> 00:35:28,356
Shane was the only one I knew.
I did a project on her in Year 5.

721
00:35:33,377 --> 00:35:34,676
And I think I got an A.

722
00:35:37,657 --> 00:35:41,276
Well, Mat, I mean, Shonella,
they had a great social game.

723
00:35:41,417 --> 00:35:43,196
Do you think
people underestimated them?

724
00:35:43,297 --> 00:35:44,496
Oh, I certainly didn't.

725
00:35:44,577 --> 00:35:46,076
I knew that they were powerful

726
00:35:46,217 --> 00:35:51,076
and I knew that they were two votes,
that they were not separating,

727
00:35:51,177 --> 00:35:52,316
they were dangerous.

728
00:35:52,457 --> 00:35:55,356
Well, two is a strong number
in this game,

729
00:35:55,457 --> 00:35:57,396
but three is even stronger.

730
00:35:57,537 --> 00:36:00,496
And there was one guy
that fit right in with the Shonella.

731
00:36:00,577 --> 00:36:02,076
Oh, boy.

732
00:36:02,217 --> 00:36:05,236
I'm going to play at Survivor
like I play football.

733
00:36:05,337 --> 00:36:07,756
Survivors, ready? Go!

734
00:36:07,897 --> 00:36:12,276
Oh, Brian pushes Heath to the side.
Too easy.

735
00:36:12,417 --> 00:36:15,796
He puts it in the square and Brian
takes it out for the Champions.

736
00:36:15,937 --> 00:36:18,996
Oh, my God, are you kidding me?

737
00:36:19,137 --> 00:36:21,796
Grubby, you've got to
get that checked out, man.

738
00:36:23,337 --> 00:36:24,356
No-one needs to see that.

739
00:36:26,397 --> 00:36:27,316
Jesus.

740
00:36:28,397 --> 00:36:29,556
King Grub.

741
00:36:29,697 --> 00:36:32,436
I don't know if
I like to take that mantle.

742
00:36:34,257 --> 00:36:36,156
I mean, I'll take the Grub part of it.

743
00:36:36,257 --> 00:36:37,496
You look good, Grubby.

744
00:36:37,637 --> 00:36:39,676
They could have probably
found worser nicknames.

745
00:36:39,817 --> 00:36:41,496
I've probably had worse in my time

746
00:36:41,617 --> 00:36:43,076
at high school and football.

747
00:36:43,177 --> 00:36:44,236
But I'll take it.

748
00:36:45,577 --> 00:36:48,196
- Who wants to see the white whale?
- Me. Please.

749
00:36:48,297 --> 00:36:49,196
The girls keep using it,

750
00:36:49,337 --> 00:36:50,756
that means they
actually care about you.

751
00:36:50,897 --> 00:36:52,676
- Grubby bum.
- What?! Oh, my God.

752
00:37:00,577 --> 00:37:04,796
Brian, I think I've been scarred for
life after seeing that last image.

753
00:37:04,937 --> 00:37:06,596
You knew there was a camera rolling
on you, right?

754
00:37:06,737 --> 00:37:09,556
I knew there was numerous cameras.
But I had to wash.

755
00:37:11,497 --> 00:37:13,876
You won four
individual immunity challenges,

756
00:37:13,977 --> 00:37:15,916
a car, and you came third.

757
00:37:16,057 --> 00:37:17,956
Are you happy with the way you played?

758
00:37:18,057 --> 00:37:19,676
Yeah. You look at the series now,

759
00:37:19,817 --> 00:37:21,756
you think, hindsight,
"If I did this differently,

760
00:37:21,857 --> 00:37:22,956
"if I did that differently..."

761
00:37:23,057 --> 00:37:24,676
But do I get fitter?

762
00:37:24,817 --> 00:37:28,316
Do I learn how to make fire
before I come into Survivor? Yes.

763
00:37:28,457 --> 00:37:30,556
Maybe I could have changed things
but then you just don't know

764
00:37:30,697 --> 00:37:33,436
what else could have changed
in that scenario.

765
00:37:33,577 --> 00:37:35,316
There might have been
a different person,

766
00:37:35,417 --> 00:37:36,956
a different player in this game,

767
00:37:37,057 --> 00:37:39,636
so to come in as raw as I did,

768
00:37:39,777 --> 00:37:41,556
to come third
from the position I was in,

769
00:37:41,697 --> 00:37:44,036
I'm definitely very happy
with what I've achieved.

770
00:37:49,417 --> 00:37:52,396
Were there similarities
between how you played Survivor

771
00:37:52,537 --> 00:37:54,916
- and how you played footy?
- Dirty.

772
00:37:55,057 --> 00:37:57,076
Dirty? Yeah. I heard...

773
00:37:57,217 --> 00:38:00,676
Nah. I probably wasn't the most
professional footballer

774
00:38:00,777 --> 00:38:02,316
when I played the game.

775
00:38:02,417 --> 00:38:04,396
I used to like to have a good time.

776
00:38:04,537 --> 00:38:07,996
But playing team sport
I knew how to get a team together

777
00:38:08,137 --> 00:38:11,836
and if there's a way
that we can manipulate the game,

778
00:38:11,937 --> 00:38:14,196
not classified as cheating,

779
00:38:14,337 --> 00:38:16,916
- if I can bend the rules somehow...
- Being grubby.

780
00:38:17,057 --> 00:38:18,836
..I would do that
as much as possible.

781
00:38:20,337 --> 00:38:21,916
Well, Australia was surprised

782
00:38:22,057 --> 00:38:25,796
when you voted out Steve
when he was Dead Man Walking.

783
00:38:25,897 --> 00:38:27,836
What was the logic behind that?

784
00:38:27,977 --> 00:38:30,756
In that position, yes, he hadn't
gone very well in challenges,

785
00:38:30,897 --> 00:38:33,496
but I knew
when it comes to the last challenge,

786
00:38:33,577 --> 00:38:36,856
it's always very demanding.

787
00:38:36,977 --> 00:38:39,436
So if you're going to take someone
like Steve to the final three,

788
00:38:39,537 --> 00:38:41,516
you're going to be up against it.

789
00:38:41,657 --> 00:38:44,316
So, hindsight, I probably
should have taken Sharn out.

790
00:38:44,417 --> 00:38:45,396
Um...

791
00:38:45,537 --> 00:38:46,916
- Yeah.
- Yeah.

792
00:38:47,057 --> 00:38:49,076
You look back at it
and you've made mistakes.

793
00:38:49,217 --> 00:38:52,316
Was that one of them?
Maybe. Maybe not. I don't know.

794
00:38:52,457 --> 00:38:56,076
Mate, there's no hard feelings
on my behalf for anyone here.

795
00:38:56,177 --> 00:38:57,516
I think it was... it's amazing.

796
00:38:57,657 --> 00:39:01,196
And it's amazing to sit here with
everybody tonight and reminisce.

797
00:39:01,297 --> 00:39:03,036
I think a lot of us here

798
00:39:03,177 --> 00:39:06,156
would put our hand up and say
we'd go back there in a heartbeat.

799
00:39:11,177 --> 00:39:13,956
After the break, we'll talk to Zach,

800
00:39:14,097 --> 00:39:16,356
the most controversial player
we've ever had.

801
00:39:16,497 --> 00:39:18,236
Yeah...

802
00:39:24,837 --> 00:39:27,296
Zach has it! And Zach
takes it for the Contenders.

803
00:39:27,437 --> 00:39:29,536
Zach has him on the edge.
And that's it!

804
00:39:31,677 --> 00:39:33,776
#CommandoKiller.

805
00:39:33,877 --> 00:39:36,056
Look at all that muscle out there!

806
00:39:37,677 --> 00:39:40,036
Why don't you puff your chest
a little more, mate?

807
00:39:40,117 --> 00:39:41,256
You should borrow my sports bra.

808
00:39:41,397 --> 00:39:43,976
I think it is highly possible that a
woman could beat me in a challenge.

809
00:39:44,077 --> 00:39:45,976
But that all depends on what it is.

810
00:39:46,117 --> 00:39:48,756
If it's physical strength,
girl, no chance.

811
00:39:48,837 --> 00:39:50,856
OK. But if we're looking

812
00:39:50,997 --> 00:39:54,576
at, maybe, like,
a dishwashing challenge

813
00:39:54,717 --> 00:39:57,696
or maybe a sewing challenge,
I might be in trouble.

814
00:39:57,837 --> 00:40:00,816
We've got girls
that just... they suck.

815
00:40:00,957 --> 00:40:03,536
We've got graphic designers and mums

816
00:40:03,677 --> 00:40:05,176
and whatever the hell it is Paige does.

817
00:40:06,477 --> 00:40:07,816
The plan is from here

818
00:40:07,957 --> 00:40:10,036
is just to cut out
all the rest of the girls

819
00:40:10,177 --> 00:40:11,756
and just systematically wipe them out.

820
00:40:11,877 --> 00:40:12,756
"Oh, my God.

821
00:40:12,877 --> 00:40:14,696
"I can't believe
you guys voted for me."

822
00:40:17,017 --> 00:40:18,576
Eighth person voted out

823
00:40:18,717 --> 00:40:21,896
Champions Versus Contenders...

824
00:40:21,997 --> 00:40:23,256
..Zach.

825
00:40:23,397 --> 00:40:26,776
Just a washed-up gladiator
that ended up on the wrong beach.

826
00:40:31,201 --> 00:40:33,840
Welcome back to the Reunion Show.

827
00:40:33,981 --> 00:40:37,440
Now, we've gotta talk about the man
who caused so much discussion

828
00:40:37,581 --> 00:40:40,380
on the beach and in the lounge rooms
around the country.

829
00:40:40,461 --> 00:40:41,740
Zach.

830
00:40:43,341 --> 00:40:44,560
Um...

831
00:40:44,701 --> 00:40:47,080
Dude, what is it that you have
against the female Contenders?

832
00:40:47,221 --> 00:40:49,680
I didn't have anything
against the female contestants.

833
00:40:49,821 --> 00:40:51,560
You've taken it the absolute wrong way.

834
00:40:51,701 --> 00:40:55,480
Serious. No, you don't know.

835
00:40:56,981 --> 00:41:00,020
I mean, the thing is I was just
getting so frustrated at that stage.

836
00:41:00,101 --> 00:41:01,200
I mean, we were just losing

837
00:41:01,341 --> 00:41:03,840
challenge after challenge
after challenge, and from what I...

838
00:41:03,981 --> 00:41:07,320
I mean, the Champions' girls
were just so bad ass.

839
00:41:07,461 --> 00:41:11,280
You know, you have a look at them,
we've got Olympic gold medallists

840
00:41:11,421 --> 00:41:14,760
and, you know, just absolute killers.

841
00:41:16,181 --> 00:41:19,600
So, you know,
they were whooping our women.

842
00:41:19,701 --> 00:41:21,160
Whoopin' 'em.

843
00:41:21,301 --> 00:41:25,240
You've got to remember,
Zach's pumping a lot of meat.

844
00:41:25,381 --> 00:41:28,240
He's got bigger boobs than half of
us girls on the tribe to start with.

845
00:41:28,381 --> 00:41:30,920
So, you know, he can sit there and
talk about dishwasher challenges,

846
00:41:31,021 --> 00:41:32,800
but maybe if he tried one,

847
00:41:32,941 --> 00:41:35,380
he'd be sitting down there
instead of up here, so...

848
00:41:35,501 --> 00:41:38,680
Whoo...

849
00:41:42,841 --> 00:41:44,320
Zach, at any point, did you think,

850
00:41:44,461 --> 00:41:46,280
you know,
"Maybe I should just shut up"?

851
00:41:46,381 --> 00:41:48,520
Look. Sure.

852
00:41:48,621 --> 00:41:50,480
I think a couple of times there

853
00:41:50,621 --> 00:41:52,680
I thought maybe
I should just keep my mouth shut.

854
00:41:52,821 --> 00:41:57,680
But there's only so much stupidity
you can listen to before I just...

855
00:42:01,741 --> 00:42:04,200
Fenella, what do you say to that?

856
00:42:04,341 --> 00:42:07,800
- Um... Look...
- Say it.

857
00:42:07,901 --> 00:42:09,380
Everyone's speechless.

858
00:42:09,501 --> 00:42:11,840
I don't even know.
Look, Zach is his own person.

859
00:42:11,981 --> 00:42:14,520
But at the end of the day I'm so
glad Zach came into this tribe

860
00:42:14,621 --> 00:42:15,520
because it meant

861
00:42:15,661 --> 00:42:18,200
that I could be sitting where I am
and he's where he is.

862
00:42:23,921 --> 00:42:25,960
OK. Before we finish up, Lydia,

863
00:42:26,101 --> 00:42:29,880
you've achieved so much in your
career, where does Survivor rank?

864
00:42:31,021 --> 00:42:34,520
Oh, it's one of the best experiences
probably of my life.

865
00:42:35,701 --> 00:42:36,740
It's been incredible.

866
00:42:36,861 --> 00:42:39,040
- Mat, would you do it again?
- Ah, tomorrow.

867
00:42:41,521 --> 00:42:45,240
Moana, how would you sum up
your experience on Survivor?

868
00:42:45,381 --> 00:42:47,380
It was probably the best experience
of my life.

869
00:42:47,521 --> 00:42:51,100
Like, same as Lyds, I'd absolutely
do it again. It was pretty awesome.

870
00:42:51,181 --> 00:42:53,760
Benji, any tips for future players?

871
00:42:53,901 --> 00:42:57,840
If you find one of these things, or
the necklace, you've got to play it.

872
00:42:57,941 --> 00:43:00,040
Apparently it saves you out there.

873
00:43:01,861 --> 00:43:04,200
So, if you think you have what it takes

874
00:43:04,301 --> 00:43:06,320
to win the greatest game on earth,

875
00:43:06,461 --> 00:43:09,880
casting is now open for the next
season of Australian Survivor.

876
00:43:13,621 --> 00:43:16,880
And next year, it could be you up here.

877
00:43:17,021 --> 00:43:22,280
Contenders, Champions, thank you
for a brilliant season. Well done.

878
00:43:26,361 --> 00:43:29,760
So, after 50 days and 24 people,

879
00:43:29,861 --> 00:43:31,840
we have one Survivor.

880
00:43:31,941 --> 00:43:33,640
Goodnight.



## S06E17

1
00:00:00,000 --> 00:00:04,162
WWW.MY-SUBS.CO

1
00:00:42,694 --> 00:00:46,574
Right. It is the Survivor
SA: Philippines reunion show

2
00:00:46,614 --> 00:00:48,014
live from Cape Town

3
00:00:48,054 --> 00:00:51,174
with Tom Swartz
just won a million rand

4
00:00:51,214 --> 00:00:55,214
as well as a Huawei prize
package, which includes...

5
00:00:55,254 --> 00:00:59,494
Which includes the Huawei
P20 Pro and MateBook X bundle,

6
00:00:59,534 --> 00:01:04,534
a watch, a 360 degree camera -
to name but a few wonderful prizes.

7
00:01:04,574 --> 00:01:08,974
Tom, we've covered so much
already, but the night is far from over.

8
00:01:09,014 --> 00:01:12,614
We have the entire cast
here from this amazing season.

9
00:01:12,654 --> 00:01:14,494
Yeah. Round of applause.

10
00:01:14,534 --> 00:01:17,054
Why not?

11
00:01:21,334 --> 00:01:23,734
Tom. Congratulations.

12
00:01:23,774 --> 00:01:25,334
Thank you very much.

13
00:01:25,374 --> 00:01:28,174
To win this game, you
have to have so many factors

14
00:01:28,214 --> 00:01:31,334
counting in your favour,
like you mentioned, Jeanne.

15
00:01:31,374 --> 00:01:34,814
But what it ultimately comes
down to is just how you ebb and flow

16
00:01:34,854 --> 00:01:36,094
with the game, how you adapt

17
00:01:36,134 --> 00:01:37,814
with the things that
we throw at you.

18
00:01:37,854 --> 00:01:40,134
You did that very well.

19
00:01:40,174 --> 00:01:43,454
I tend to ebb, but I sort
of go against the flow.

20
00:01:43,494 --> 00:01:45,254
Which you did very well.

21
00:01:45,294 --> 00:01:46,934
Now, here's the thing.

22
00:01:46,974 --> 00:01:49,294
What was your best
move of the game?

23
00:01:52,894 --> 00:01:56,494
I think providing and
never, ever giving up.

24
00:01:58,294 --> 00:01:59,774
Lots of nods from everyone else.

25
00:02:03,694 --> 00:02:06,174
You can't get to where you are
without making some mistakes,

26
00:02:06,214 --> 00:02:08,094
biggest mistake?

27
00:02:08,134 --> 00:02:10,254
Opening my mouth.

28
00:02:11,574 --> 00:02:14,334
I just needed to change feet,

29
00:02:14,374 --> 00:02:16,894
but also to have just
enough time to lick a spoon.

30
00:02:16,934 --> 00:02:19,494
I was just going to say, you
talked about eating as well, right?

31
00:02:19,534 --> 00:02:21,934
Jeanne, incredible achievement.

32
00:02:21,974 --> 00:02:24,254
Making it this far in the
game. Second place.

33
00:02:30,774 --> 00:02:33,294
Looking back in
retrospect, is there anything

34
00:02:33,334 --> 00:02:35,534
you would have done differently?

35
00:02:35,574 --> 00:02:38,414
I think I would have
liked to come in the game

36
00:02:38,454 --> 00:02:40,214
and been a big character

37
00:02:40,254 --> 00:02:43,294
like Tevin or Wern or Tom
and dominated in that way.

38
00:02:43,334 --> 00:02:46,414
But I saw quite early on that
I couldn't be that character,

39
00:02:46,454 --> 00:02:47,974
and that kind of
made me a bit sad

40
00:02:48,014 --> 00:02:50,150
cos that's the kind of
character I like to watch on TV.

41
00:02:50,174 --> 00:02:52,934
But I think my biggest regret is
voting Wern out after seeing that.

42
00:02:52,974 --> 00:02:55,694
So...

43
00:02:55,734 --> 00:02:59,854
Oh, well. His vote wouldn't
have counted anyway. So...

44
00:02:59,894 --> 00:03:02,174
Every single move
in this game counts.

45
00:03:02,214 --> 00:03:04,094
And it's true of
that one as well.

46
00:03:04,134 --> 00:03:07,254
OK. So, no matter how great
a player you are in this game

47
00:03:07,294 --> 00:03:08,694
or how better a
player you might be,

48
00:03:08,734 --> 00:03:11,574
one thing you can't get
by without is relationships.

49
00:03:11,614 --> 00:03:12,814
It's a currency in this game

50
00:03:12,854 --> 00:03:15,414
and we had all kinds
of those this season.

51
00:03:15,454 --> 00:03:19,094
I'm going to start with
with Tom and Chane.

52
00:03:19,134 --> 00:03:21,614
Chane, you two
had, like, some...

53
00:03:21,654 --> 00:03:24,934
It was like a best friend thing
going on right from the start.

54
00:03:24,974 --> 00:03:27,014
We thought it was going
all the way to the end.

55
00:03:27,054 --> 00:03:28,774
It went south very quickly.

56
00:03:28,814 --> 00:03:31,494
Was it just Tom's table manners?

57
00:03:31,534 --> 00:03:33,894
It played a very big part.

58
00:03:33,934 --> 00:03:35,614
No, I'm joking!

59
00:03:35,654 --> 00:03:39,814
But when we went
to Visayas tribe

60
00:03:39,854 --> 00:03:43,654
and Tom lost his
temper quite a bit

61
00:03:43,694 --> 00:03:47,774
and for my gameplay, I
just thought that it'll be better

62
00:03:47,814 --> 00:03:51,454
if I step back and side
with Palesa and Vusi.

63
00:03:51,494 --> 00:03:52,974
OK. Good answer. Tom,

64
00:03:53,014 --> 00:03:56,134
I must just add that if I have to
go with Chane and back her up

65
00:03:56,174 --> 00:03:58,734
in the fact that I will never look
at a chocolate fountain again

66
00:03:58,774 --> 00:04:00,014
in the same way.

67
00:04:00,054 --> 00:04:01,574
Thank you!

68
00:04:01,614 --> 00:04:04,974
Palesa, with Tom again.
Interesting relationship.

69
00:04:05,014 --> 00:04:07,454
You had almost the flip of that
because you were arch enemies

70
00:04:07,494 --> 00:04:09,214
from the get-go and
that beautiful moment

71
00:04:09,254 --> 00:04:11,414
where you won that
challenge together

72
00:04:11,454 --> 00:04:13,214
and he creeped into your heart.

73
00:04:13,254 --> 00:04:15,094
Old-school charm, right?

74
00:04:15,134 --> 00:04:18,334
- I don't know about heart, but...
- Mine or yours?

75
00:04:20,294 --> 00:04:23,574
But I mean, Tom and I
were big personalities

76
00:04:23,614 --> 00:04:25,774
and we were too
bold in the crawl.

77
00:04:25,814 --> 00:04:28,774
So of course we were meant
to clash in some sort of way.

78
00:04:28,814 --> 00:04:31,094
But those personalities
are two people

79
00:04:31,134 --> 00:04:34,054
that are also when they
work together, you know,

80
00:04:34,094 --> 00:04:36,694
bring out something epic.

81
00:04:36,734 --> 00:04:40,574
Indeed, it was epic to
watch you guys going at it.

82
00:04:40,614 --> 00:04:43,894
Let's talk about you, because
you also had some sort

83
00:04:43,934 --> 00:04:45,494
of strange and wonderful

84
00:04:45,534 --> 00:04:47,654
conglomeration of
relationships going on there.

85
00:04:47,694 --> 00:04:50,334
I'm going to... You know what?
I'm going to ask Katinka this.

86
00:04:50,374 --> 00:04:53,414
But first, big it up for the
youngest player of the season.

87
00:04:56,534 --> 00:04:58,774
Here's a question.
Here's a question.

88
00:04:58,814 --> 00:05:01,294
Katinka... The don. Be honest.

89
00:05:01,334 --> 00:05:04,294
Did he have his girls
wrapped around his finger?

90
00:05:04,334 --> 00:05:06,974
I didn't feel like I was
wrapped around his finger.

91
00:05:07,014 --> 00:05:09,654
I think... Well, Werner
played a really good game,

92
00:05:09,694 --> 00:05:12,094
but I really think that we
formed a really good relationship

93
00:05:12,134 --> 00:05:14,174
which is going to
continue out of the game.

94
00:05:14,214 --> 00:05:17,414
- Like I said, wrapped around the finger.
- Yeah. - Yeah.

95
00:05:18,894 --> 00:05:20,254
Annalize...

96
00:05:20,294 --> 00:05:22,134
Your answer to that question?

97
00:05:22,174 --> 00:05:25,214
Well, I had to play the
game just to be with the don,

98
00:05:25,254 --> 00:05:28,694
but I was definitely not
wrapped around his finger.

99
00:05:28,734 --> 00:05:33,534
At some stage, he was wrapped
around mine and no-one even knew that.

100
00:05:34,614 --> 00:05:36,614
- I knew that, Anna.
- Thank you. Thank you.

101
00:05:36,654 --> 00:05:39,214
OK. Betrayal. Huge
part of this game.

102
00:05:39,254 --> 00:05:40,534
We know it's part of the game.

103
00:05:40,574 --> 00:05:42,254
You expect it to
come at some point,

104
00:05:42,294 --> 00:05:44,534
but when it does,
sometimes it cuts really deep.

105
00:05:44,574 --> 00:05:46,814
- Toni, you experienced it that way.
- Yep. Tissues.

106
00:05:46,854 --> 00:05:49,814
I'm joking. Betrayal for me
was with Werner, definitely.

107
00:05:49,854 --> 00:05:53,534
We connected so well, but
like this was war in a way.

108
00:05:53,574 --> 00:05:55,934
And in any war and
anything that's, like, traumatic,

109
00:05:55,974 --> 00:05:57,294
there's collateral damage,

110
00:05:57,334 --> 00:06:00,214
but there's collateral beauty,
which was the friendships.

111
00:06:00,254 --> 00:06:01,734
This is collateral beauty.

112
00:06:01,774 --> 00:06:04,254
So I've got a collateral
beauty out of all of this,

113
00:06:04,294 --> 00:06:06,574
as well as matching tattoos
with my two guys here.

114
00:06:06,614 --> 00:06:10,494
So, I mean, the betrayal
came with some some beauty.

115
00:06:10,534 --> 00:06:11,814
And where is it at now?

116
00:06:11,854 --> 00:06:13,854
Have you guys made
up? Everything fine again?

117
00:06:13,894 --> 00:06:16,214
No, I'm never talking
to him again. I'm joking!

118
00:06:19,094 --> 00:06:20,134
You look so worried.

119
00:06:20,174 --> 00:06:24,494
Werner and I are going to enter
My Kitchen Rules next, maybe, hey?

120
00:06:24,534 --> 00:06:26,694
Hunt on live TV.

121
00:06:26,734 --> 00:06:29,334
OK. So much to talk
about, so little time,

122
00:06:29,374 --> 00:06:30,974
but we are not done just yet.

123
00:06:31,014 --> 00:06:34,014
After the break, we'll be
talking idols and blindsides.

124
00:06:34,054 --> 00:06:37,134
And we also find out
who you, the viewer,

125
00:06:37,174 --> 00:06:41,294
voted as the Mahindra fan
favourite player of the season.

126
00:06:41,334 --> 00:06:43,694
Plus, a huge announcement.

127
00:06:43,734 --> 00:06:46,214
Stay right where you are.

128
00:06:59,574 --> 00:07:03,534
As I flipped over the shell,
there was an envelope.

129
00:07:04,574 --> 00:07:05,974
"Congratulations.

130
00:07:06,014 --> 00:07:08,374
"You've found a clue to
a hidden immunity idol."

131
00:07:08,414 --> 00:07:10,014
If I have to
eat it, I'll eat it.

132
00:07:10,054 --> 00:07:12,294
I'm not going back to
the camp with that clue.

133
00:07:12,334 --> 00:07:14,454
That clue does not exist.

134
00:07:14,494 --> 00:07:16,054
So that's automatically five.

135
00:07:16,094 --> 00:07:18,734
We've got a majority.

136
00:07:18,774 --> 00:07:21,094
..the blindside. He's a threat.

137
00:07:21,134 --> 00:07:23,054
He's got to go. First one out.

138
00:07:23,094 --> 00:07:25,574
If we pull this off,
it'll be amazing.

139
00:07:25,614 --> 00:07:27,134
Well, I love your work, girl.

140
00:07:27,174 --> 00:07:28,774
Oh, thank you!

141
00:07:28,814 --> 00:07:30,454
Seamus.

142
00:07:32,054 --> 00:07:34,294
Let's pull a blindside.

143
00:07:34,334 --> 00:07:35,934
This is damn awesome.

144
00:07:35,974 --> 00:07:38,294
- Why don't we do that?
- I give you my word.

145
00:07:38,334 --> 00:07:40,654
- That's my word.
- What did they do?

146
00:07:40,694 --> 00:07:44,014
I could make him think
that we have an idea.

147
00:07:44,054 --> 00:07:46,574
His eyes beam up.

148
00:07:46,614 --> 00:07:50,094
And then I know that
I think I've got him.

149
00:07:51,334 --> 00:07:52,494
Reveal.

150
00:07:54,014 --> 00:07:55,414
Neil, you have the white rock.

151
00:07:55,454 --> 00:07:57,494
That means you are voted out.

152
00:08:00,254 --> 00:08:02,694
My idol is gone!

153
00:08:02,734 --> 00:08:04,934
Would you put that
in your pants, please?

154
00:08:04,974 --> 00:08:06,334
Because that belongs to me.

155
00:08:07,694 --> 00:08:09,494
Oh, goodness' sake!

156
00:08:11,294 --> 00:08:15,734
Ace and I, we think we found a
clue to the hidden immunity idol.

157
00:08:15,774 --> 00:08:19,814
- I'm so excited!
- Does anybody have any idea what I said?

158
00:08:19,854 --> 00:08:22,014
I'm not going home today.

159
00:08:22,054 --> 00:08:23,254
I found the idol.

160
00:08:23,294 --> 00:08:25,174
I don't believe you.

161
00:08:25,214 --> 00:08:26,734
Ace, the tribe has spoken.

162
00:08:30,054 --> 00:08:31,454
One idol, everybody knows about,

163
00:08:31,494 --> 00:08:33,214
and that's why he has
a target on his back.

164
00:08:33,254 --> 00:08:36,094
The second one is the
one that we can play with.

165
00:08:36,134 --> 00:08:37,774
Do you want me to keep that one?

166
00:08:37,814 --> 00:08:40,454
I will use this idol
to protect our lives.

167
00:08:41,734 --> 00:08:45,334
The best part of a blindside
is not letting him see it come.

168
00:08:45,374 --> 00:08:47,414
Tevin, the tribe has spoken.

169
00:08:50,174 --> 00:08:51,934
I get a clue.

170
00:08:51,974 --> 00:08:54,974
I'm never going to tell
anybody about the idol.

171
00:08:56,574 --> 00:08:58,414
There's no idols showing up.

172
00:08:58,454 --> 00:08:59,894
No.

173
00:08:59,934 --> 00:09:03,214
PK, I think that is indeed
a hidden immunity idol.

174
00:09:06,134 --> 00:09:07,214
I'm playing for myself.

175
00:09:10,294 --> 00:09:11,974
Three immunity idols playing.

176
00:09:14,694 --> 00:09:16,774
I found a package.

177
00:09:16,814 --> 00:09:18,534
I love this game.

178
00:09:18,574 --> 00:09:20,254
I found a package.

179
00:09:20,294 --> 00:09:22,934
If anyone has a hidden immunity
idol and you'd like to play it,

180
00:09:22,974 --> 00:09:25,894
now would be the time to do so.

181
00:09:25,934 --> 00:09:28,174
Palesa, you need
to bring me a torch.

182
00:09:29,694 --> 00:09:32,534
If Werner doesn't win
immunity, let's get him out.

183
00:09:32,574 --> 00:09:35,814
Tom, you don't stand a
chance against Werner.

184
00:09:35,854 --> 00:09:38,214
You see, she's got a
plan to upset everybody.

185
00:09:38,254 --> 00:09:41,334
When we get to
four, we vote you off.

186
00:09:41,374 --> 00:09:43,774
True story. I know that
you're a fan, Jeanne.

187
00:09:43,814 --> 00:09:46,254
I would like you to
come to the front,

188
00:09:46,294 --> 00:09:48,374
and I want to give
you an opportunity

189
00:09:48,414 --> 00:09:51,014
to play an idol for yourself.

190
00:09:51,054 --> 00:09:53,054
Katinka.

191
00:09:53,094 --> 00:09:55,094
The tribe has spoken.

192
00:10:03,734 --> 00:10:07,934
You are watching Survivor
SA: Philippines reunion show live

193
00:10:07,974 --> 00:10:09,934
from the Mother City, Cape Town.

194
00:10:09,974 --> 00:10:12,334
There is so much to catch up on.

195
00:10:12,374 --> 00:10:14,934
It is time for us to
do some idle talk.

196
00:10:14,974 --> 00:10:16,574
I'm going to start with you.

197
