00:10:16,614 --> 00:10:18,934
I'm going to... Let's
just say what it was.

198
00:10:18,974 --> 00:10:21,094
You were the idol
bloodhound of the season.

199
00:10:21,134 --> 00:10:22,174
Did you come into the show

200
00:10:22,214 --> 00:10:24,654
thinking you're going
to find every idol you can

201
00:10:24,694 --> 00:10:26,174
and just search all the time?

202
00:10:26,214 --> 00:10:27,494
Not really.

203
00:10:27,534 --> 00:10:31,534
Because the thing is, it's very
hard trying to control these people

204
00:10:31,574 --> 00:10:33,694
and then there's idols as well.

205
00:10:33,734 --> 00:10:35,854
So the best thing to do
with them is to find them

206
00:10:35,894 --> 00:10:38,294
and put them in your own bag
and then the game can go on.

207
00:10:38,334 --> 00:10:40,494
- It's as simple as that.
- So it was a strategy

208
00:10:40,534 --> 00:10:42,814
cos you kept searching even
when all the idols were gone.

209
00:10:42,854 --> 00:10:46,174
- I never stopped.
- Every morning!

210
00:10:46,214 --> 00:10:47,774
Ace, how frustrating!

211
00:10:47,814 --> 00:10:52,294
How frustrating because
you spent an entire day

212
00:10:52,334 --> 00:10:53,854
just digging up the whole camp

213
00:10:53,894 --> 00:10:56,494
with a little bit of
help from a friend.

214
00:10:56,534 --> 00:10:58,534
And then he comes
in, in one fell swoop,

215
00:10:58,574 --> 00:11:02,094
he just finds it
almost effortlessly.

216
00:11:02,134 --> 00:11:04,334
I just got back
from the Philippines,

217
00:11:04,374 --> 00:11:05,574
now straight to Cape Town.

218
00:11:09,414 --> 00:11:12,134
Right from the start,

219
00:11:12,174 --> 00:11:13,214
I was thrown curveballs

220
00:11:13,254 --> 00:11:15,654
and then eventually the
game threw a curveball.

221
00:11:15,694 --> 00:11:17,774
I dug a grave and
they buried me in it.

222
00:11:19,174 --> 00:11:22,734
Well, at least, you
know, you dig very well.

223
00:11:22,774 --> 00:11:24,454
It was beautiful to watch.

224
00:11:24,494 --> 00:11:27,174
Palesa, something else
that was beautiful to watch

225
00:11:27,214 --> 00:11:29,974
was you digging the
idol out at Tribal Council

226
00:11:30,014 --> 00:11:32,174
and the looks on
everyone's faces.

227
00:11:32,214 --> 00:11:33,614
What a surprise.

228
00:11:33,654 --> 00:11:35,214
But, then, also, when you left

229
00:11:35,254 --> 00:11:37,574
Tribal Council with
an idol in your pocket,

230
00:11:37,614 --> 00:11:41,134
what did you need to
trigger you to play your idol?

231
00:11:41,174 --> 00:11:42,854
What should have happened?

232
00:11:42,894 --> 00:11:46,254
I think it wasn't anything,
any external that could

233
00:11:46,294 --> 00:11:48,454
have convinced me
to play or not to play.

234
00:11:48,494 --> 00:11:51,614
I had a fight in my own mind
from the moment I walked in.

235
00:11:51,654 --> 00:11:53,294
Play, don't play.
Play, don't play.

236
00:11:53,334 --> 00:11:55,814
And the last one that
came out was play.

237
00:11:55,854 --> 00:11:57,614
But now I have a souvenir

238
00:11:57,654 --> 00:12:00,974
for my 11-year-old
son, Loazi, to take home.

239
00:12:01,014 --> 00:12:04,414
- Still wearing and proudly!
- Still am, always.

240
00:12:04,454 --> 00:12:07,934
OK, let's talk about
another big moment.

241
00:12:07,974 --> 00:12:11,654
PK, this one from you, the
night of the idol extravaganza.

242
00:12:11,694 --> 00:12:13,894
I mean, you started all
of that, played an idol,

243
00:12:13,934 --> 00:12:17,294
and then everyone was just
pulling idols out from everywhere.

244
00:12:17,334 --> 00:12:20,094
Did you come in thinking
you're going to cause that chaos?

245
00:12:20,134 --> 00:12:22,814
I mean, you know me,
I just needed security.

246
00:12:22,854 --> 00:12:26,534
And once I found it in
that idol, I went to the pots.

247
00:12:26,574 --> 00:12:28,134
I had to do what I
do, stirred the pots.

248
00:12:28,174 --> 00:12:30,254
Got everybody thinking,
got everybody playing.

249
00:12:30,294 --> 00:12:32,174
And, I mean, I wanted
to play a beautiful game

250
00:12:32,214 --> 00:12:33,574
and I got a chance to do that.

251
00:12:33,614 --> 00:12:35,654
And that idol gave me
an opportunity to do that.

252
00:12:35,694 --> 00:12:39,134
Definitely a beautiful moment
in the game of Survivor.

253
00:12:41,454 --> 00:12:44,294
One of the other elements of
this game that we love to watch

254
00:12:44,334 --> 00:12:47,014
almost the most, I
think, are the blindsides,

255
00:12:47,054 --> 00:12:48,974
usually orchestrated
by the castaways

256
00:12:49,014 --> 00:12:50,774
using idols and strategies.

257
00:12:50,814 --> 00:12:53,214
But sometimes, it's the
game that throws the blindside.

258
00:12:53,254 --> 00:12:56,814
Neil, I'm talking about you.

259
00:12:56,854 --> 00:13:00,374
Do you still shudder when
you see little white rocks?

260
00:13:02,334 --> 00:13:05,254
I see white rocks
everywhere that I go now.

261
00:13:05,294 --> 00:13:07,734
What does it feel like
leaving the game like that?

262
00:13:07,774 --> 00:13:11,254
Well, look, there was a
bit of irony in it, leaving it,

263
00:13:11,294 --> 00:13:15,374
but I left like a rock
star. It made for great TV.

264
00:13:15,414 --> 00:13:18,574
But I do have something
that belongs to you.

265
00:13:18,614 --> 00:13:20,534
I want to... I would
like to return to you.

266
00:13:20,574 --> 00:13:22,534
I don't know why you're
still holding on to that.

267
00:13:22,574 --> 00:13:25,414
That is bad luck! Throw it away!

268
00:13:25,454 --> 00:13:29,214
Vusi, there you are.

269
00:13:29,254 --> 00:13:32,854
Did that send the game
into a new direction for you?

270
00:13:32,894 --> 00:13:36,294
Absolutely. I think it actually
showed that the game

271
00:13:36,334 --> 00:13:38,094
is all about chance and luck.

272
00:13:38,134 --> 00:13:41,174
And sometimes no matter how
much you play and how good you are,

273
00:13:41,214 --> 00:13:44,014
if the wheels of
fortune are not with you,

274
00:13:44,054 --> 00:13:46,174
you can just go straight out.

275
00:13:46,214 --> 00:13:49,454
That is true indeed, especially
for someone like Seamus.

276
00:13:49,494 --> 00:13:52,094
Seamus, you came into this
game, you played fast and hard.

277
00:13:53,494 --> 00:13:55,134
You also left fast and hard!

278
00:13:57,654 --> 00:13:58,934
But I do want to give it to you.

279
00:13:58,974 --> 00:14:01,094
You brought it, so
thank you for doing that.

280
00:14:01,134 --> 00:14:04,134
When you left, you said, you know,
this is going to be a boring season.

281
00:14:04,174 --> 00:14:07,134
These guys just aren't
playing. What do you think now?

282
00:14:07,174 --> 00:14:09,014
I've changed my mind completely.

283
00:14:09,054 --> 00:14:11,374
They really did
escalate the game play,

284
00:14:11,414 --> 00:14:15,054
as the game progressed and
as the first person voted out,

285
00:14:15,094 --> 00:14:18,494
you know, there's not much I can
say to carry any form of validity here,

286
00:14:18,534 --> 00:14:21,334
but they had a fantastic season
and congratulations to Tom.

287
00:14:21,374 --> 00:14:23,214
You've definitely
earned it, well done.

288
00:14:29,734 --> 00:14:32,534
Well, these guys have just been
39 days in the game of Survivor,

289
00:14:32,574 --> 00:14:33,894
so they know how tough it is.

290
00:14:33,934 --> 00:14:38,014
But no matter how much we try
and prepare our new castaways to let

291
00:14:38,054 --> 00:14:39,734
them know how
rough it's going to be,

292
00:14:39,774 --> 00:14:43,014
it just, it's almost
always a rude awakening.

293
00:14:43,054 --> 00:14:44,734
Here's a little reminder.

294
00:14:49,694 --> 00:14:52,414
Assuming you don't have
rice, you never got that, right?

295
00:14:52,454 --> 00:14:54,134
Yeah, that's our only problem.

296
00:14:54,174 --> 00:14:56,670
- You guys have nothing for food.
- Nothing. - Literally nothing.

297
00:14:56,694 --> 00:14:58,214
Just coconuts.

298
00:14:58,254 --> 00:14:59,694
Oh, my word.

299
00:15:02,574 --> 00:15:05,094
We pretty much ran out of food.
We don't have food any more.

300
00:15:06,454 --> 00:15:07,734
Going to get hungry.

301
00:15:09,654 --> 00:15:13,414
Maybe we should then
go fish, while it's like this.

302
00:15:13,454 --> 00:15:15,494
- Can you fish?
- No.

303
00:15:18,334 --> 00:15:20,134
Our wood is wet.

304
00:15:20,174 --> 00:15:21,854
Everything is wet.

305
00:15:21,894 --> 00:15:26,294
We actually feeling the fatigue
coming in, myself and Toni.

306
00:15:26,334 --> 00:15:27,454
I've had a runny tummy.

307
00:15:27,494 --> 00:15:30,214
I'm on day four without
having an actual meal.

308
00:15:30,254 --> 00:15:32,774
So we're in the
worst place right now.

309
00:15:32,814 --> 00:15:34,134
It sucks.

310
00:15:35,894 --> 00:15:39,254
I'm like, we need to maybe
look for a fish, but there's no way

311
00:15:39,294 --> 00:15:41,334
I can go into that water.

312
00:15:41,374 --> 00:15:43,854
I can't even go into the
water to wash myself.

313
00:15:45,134 --> 00:15:46,974
I'm so tired and depleted.

314
00:15:58,454 --> 00:16:01,374
Someone please give
Toni a hug. Come on.

315
00:16:04,814 --> 00:16:07,214
They must all
give me a hug later!

316
00:16:07,254 --> 00:16:09,094
Loads of hugs waiting to happen.

317
00:16:09,134 --> 00:16:10,814
Toni, how tough was this?

318
00:16:10,854 --> 00:16:12,254
It was brutal.

319
00:16:12,294 --> 00:16:14,134
That moment especially
was very brutal.

320
00:16:14,174 --> 00:16:19,294
But even the day that that episode
was on, driving home that day,

321
00:16:19,334 --> 00:16:21,894
I just started crying because
I remember that very dark

322
00:16:21,934 --> 00:16:23,254
place that we woke up in.

323
00:16:23,294 --> 00:16:26,294
But people are waking up like
that every day in the real world.

324
00:16:26,334 --> 00:16:30,094
So, you know, it really just makes
you reflect and it really humbles

325
00:16:30,134 --> 00:16:33,254
you into, like, it's like realise
what your blessings are.

326
00:16:33,294 --> 00:16:36,014
Once again,
life-changing this game is.

327
00:16:36,054 --> 00:16:37,614
PK. Yeah, yeah, well done.

328
00:16:43,054 --> 00:16:45,174
PK, you came into this
game built like a machine.

329
00:16:45,214 --> 00:16:47,214
You left like a small machine.

330
00:16:49,414 --> 00:16:51,054
How tough was it for you?

331
00:16:51,094 --> 00:16:54,054
It was probably the toughest
thing I've ever done, you know?

332
00:16:54,094 --> 00:16:57,534
I mean, one thing I did realise,
though, is that as human beings,

333
00:16:57,574 --> 00:17:01,334
you think you need to eat food or do
something like maybe eat a banana

334
00:17:01,374 --> 00:17:02,654
before you go to the gym.

335
00:17:02,694 --> 00:17:05,694
But then I realised that we
have so much energy inside of us.

336
00:17:05,734 --> 00:17:07,734
You don't need to get
energy anywhere else

337
00:17:07,774 --> 00:17:08,974
except from inside of you.

338
00:17:09,014 --> 00:17:11,774
And that's one thing
Survivor taught me. It's in here.

339
00:17:16,734 --> 00:17:19,654
One of the questions I get asked
most about this game and I think

340
00:17:19,694 --> 00:17:22,574
it's true for you guys as well
now, is whether or not this game

341
00:17:22,614 --> 00:17:25,014
is as rough as it
looks on screen.

342
00:17:25,054 --> 00:17:27,054
You know, does it look,
is it as bad as it looks?

343
00:17:27,094 --> 00:17:28,774
And I always tell
people, no, it's not.

344
00:17:28,814 --> 00:17:30,294
It's much, much worse.

345
00:17:30,334 --> 00:17:32,574
There's no way we can
convey to the viewers

346
00:17:32,614 --> 00:17:33,894
what you guys go through.

347
00:17:33,934 --> 00:17:36,454
But there is something we can
show you to give you an inkling

348
00:17:36,494 --> 00:17:40,974
of how bad it gets, and that
is how much weight they lose.

349
00:17:54,654 --> 00:17:56,014
And together...

350
00:18:06,414 --> 00:18:07,971
- Jeanne...
- You can't fake that.

351
00:18:07,983 --> 00:18:09,014
You can't fake that.

352
00:18:09,054 --> 00:18:10,854
No, you can't.

353
00:18:10,894 --> 00:18:14,934
I put all that weight back on, so...

354
00:18:14,974 --> 00:18:18,094
We lost the weight, but I
found it again, so that's fine.

355
00:18:18,134 --> 00:18:20,934
Oh, no, it's brutal.
It's not just the food.

356
00:18:20,974 --> 00:18:24,614
The food is one thing,
but your mind is racing

357
00:18:24,654 --> 00:18:26,174
100 million miles a minute.

358
00:18:26,214 --> 00:18:30,334
But it's also
starved of anything -

359
00:18:30,374 --> 00:18:33,574
information, news, the things
that we consume every single day,

360
00:18:33,614 --> 00:18:36,814
and that also the
boredom kills you.

361
00:18:36,854 --> 00:18:38,534
And it's a whole
bunch of things.

362
00:18:38,574 --> 00:18:41,694
It's being dirty, it's being
wet, your body is chafing.

363
00:18:41,734 --> 00:18:43,614
Everything is awful.

364
00:18:43,654 --> 00:18:46,894
Everything is awful,
except a few of the people.

365
00:18:46,934 --> 00:18:49,174
But some of them were awful too!

366
00:18:51,574 --> 00:18:53,134
Just joking.

367
00:18:53,174 --> 00:18:55,054
Tom, you've got some
rice in your beard!

368
00:18:55,094 --> 00:18:58,814
I will never eat rice or
coconut again in my life.

369
00:18:58,854 --> 00:18:59,934
No lie!

370
00:18:59,974 --> 00:19:04,094
As you know, Mahindra has
been running a fan favourite

371
00:19:04,134 --> 00:19:05,974
competition
throughout the series.

372
00:19:06,014 --> 00:19:10,014
And after the break, we'll find
out who of the entire cast received

373
00:19:10,054 --> 00:19:11,134
the most votes.

374
00:19:11,174 --> 00:19:13,534
We will also announce
which lucky viewer will win

375
00:19:13,574 --> 00:19:14,814
a brand-new Mahindra.

376
00:19:14,854 --> 00:19:19,094
And we chat to one of the most
talked about players of the season -

377
00:19:19,134 --> 00:19:20,694
Marthunis.

378
00:19:20,734 --> 00:19:24,934
This is the Survivor SA
Philippines live reunion show.

379
00:19:24,974 --> 00:19:26,454
Do not go away.

380
00:19:43,999 --> 00:19:45,439
Welcome to Survivor.

381
00:19:50,039 --> 00:19:51,359
I can show them dumb blonde.

382
00:19:51,399 --> 00:19:55,639
I will literally just be sitting on
the beach just looking like this.

383
00:19:59,639 --> 00:20:04,479
I see Tom taking the
spoon and licking it.

384
00:20:04,519 --> 00:20:06,279
I wanted to throw
up in my mouth.

385
00:20:06,319 --> 00:20:08,999
Dude, two of those girls
had false eyelashes on.

386
00:20:09,039 --> 00:20:10,439
- Really?
- Yes.

387
00:20:10,479 --> 00:20:13,639
This is not Ibiza, darling. You're
not coming here to party scene.

388
00:20:13,679 --> 00:20:18,199
You can blame me but
just remember, my name is...

389
00:20:18,239 --> 00:20:20,159
Do I get to choose
somebody to go with me?

390
00:20:20,199 --> 00:20:22,759
Are you preempting this?
Are you the host suddenly?

391
00:20:22,799 --> 00:20:26,439
This thing has so much power to it that
every now and then I overstep my boundary,

392
00:20:26,479 --> 00:20:28,519
now that I'm
wearing it. I'm sorry.

393
00:20:30,719 --> 00:20:32,919
- New phone. - New phone, Darling.
- New phone.

394
00:20:32,959 --> 00:20:34,999
Call me on my SHELLphone.

395
00:20:38,439 --> 00:20:41,719
Tom is grating me.

396
00:20:41,759 --> 00:20:44,319
He's going at it,
not even chewing.

397
00:20:44,359 --> 00:20:48,079
Then he's in the fountain
with his whole hand, stuffing it.

398
00:20:48,119 --> 00:20:51,639
Then he proceeds
to lick his whole hand.

399
00:20:51,679 --> 00:20:53,679
Oh, I am not a quitter.

400
00:20:53,719 --> 00:20:55,279
Honestly, I've come here to win.

401
00:20:55,319 --> 00:20:57,255
I'm going to win this and
then also win Miss World

402
00:20:57,279 --> 00:20:59,239
later this year as well.

403
00:20:59,279 --> 00:21:02,639
The only thing I'll quit is
maybe a diet or a gym contract.

404
00:21:09,759 --> 00:21:10,999
Welcome back.

405
00:21:11,039 --> 00:21:13,879
This is the live reunion show
of Survivor SA Philippines,

406
00:21:13,919 --> 00:21:15,439
live from Cape Town.

407
00:21:15,479 --> 00:21:18,319
We'll be announcing the fan
favourite castaway in a moment.

408
00:21:18,359 --> 00:21:21,679
But first, love him or hate him,

409
00:21:21,719 --> 00:21:25,719
one of the most controversial
players of the season is Marthunis.

410
00:21:25,759 --> 00:21:29,799
And you don't have to be a
member of Mensa to understand why.

411
00:21:34,679 --> 00:21:37,599
Immediately, something that stands
out is a man wearing a suit and tie.

412
00:21:37,639 --> 00:21:40,679
Now it's either he's come here
to play the game strategically

413
00:21:40,719 --> 00:21:42,879
or he's just playing
the game very stupidly

414
00:21:42,919 --> 00:21:45,279
because he's immediately
drawing attention to himself.

415
00:21:45,319 --> 00:21:46,999
Good, guys, we've got water.

416
00:21:47,039 --> 00:21:49,039
Who's this brother in his suit?

417
00:21:49,079 --> 00:21:50,479
What is he doing?

418
00:21:50,519 --> 00:21:53,039
Ladies, dinner in an hour.

419
00:21:53,079 --> 00:21:54,879
Alpha males do
not run this place.

420
00:21:54,919 --> 00:21:57,439
Tom, does your age give you
advantage or disadvantage?

421
00:21:57,479 --> 00:21:59,439
Has your mouth ever
got you smacked?

422
00:22:01,239 --> 00:22:03,399
If you die, life carries on.

423
00:22:03,439 --> 00:22:04,719
I've got a wife and kids.

424
00:22:04,759 --> 00:22:06,479
As if I don't have a life.

425
00:22:06,519 --> 00:22:09,959
You are not leaving people
behind that rely on you.

426
00:22:09,999 --> 00:22:12,319
Everything
Marthunis says is just,

427
00:22:12,359 --> 00:22:15,719
he's like holding something
against you the entire time.

428
00:22:15,759 --> 00:22:17,559
Do you...

429
00:22:17,599 --> 00:22:19,639
Go get us some water.

430
00:22:19,679 --> 00:22:21,879
Do the woman's job and
go get me some water.

431
00:22:21,919 --> 00:22:24,439
Thanks. Go get us some
water. Do the woman's job.

432
00:22:25,879 --> 00:22:28,479
Sexist, misogynistic ***.

433
00:22:28,519 --> 00:22:31,119
Like, you guys think you're
going to blindside me, and...

434
00:22:31,159 --> 00:22:32,359
Oh, it's so funny.

435
00:22:32,399 --> 00:22:34,719
So what's your next
move going to be?

436
00:22:34,759 --> 00:22:36,919
Quit just before
you guys can do that.

437
00:22:39,279 --> 00:22:41,359
This game is too tough for you.

438
00:22:41,399 --> 00:22:42,679
That's 100% correct.

439
00:22:42,719 --> 00:22:43,839
Leave the torch.

440
00:22:50,879 --> 00:22:52,199
What can I say, Marthunis?

441
00:22:52,239 --> 00:22:55,999
We should have known when you were standing
on the boat at attention in a suit.

442
00:22:56,039 --> 00:22:58,239
We should have known
what was coming, right?

443
00:22:58,279 --> 00:23:01,719
Here's the thing. You left the
game under harsh circumstances.

444
00:23:01,759 --> 00:23:04,199
I'm hoping that it wasn't
all negative for you.

445
00:23:04,239 --> 00:23:06,959
Was there something
positive in it as well?

446
00:23:06,999 --> 00:23:10,279
You know, Nico, I
came to Survivor to win.

447
00:23:10,319 --> 00:23:13,759
I didn't come to make
friends, but I feel like a winner

448
00:23:13,799 --> 00:23:15,559
because I made
these four friends.

449
00:23:15,599 --> 00:23:18,959
These four guys next to me became
my friends, my Mindanao tribe.

450
00:23:18,999 --> 00:23:21,039
And I feel like a winner.

451
00:23:21,079 --> 00:23:22,359
You certainly are.

452
00:23:28,839 --> 00:23:31,879
We had a fantastic cast this
season, including Marthunis.

453
00:23:31,919 --> 00:23:35,359
And you had the
opportunity...

454
00:23:35,399 --> 00:23:38,319
You had the opportunity
to vote for your favourite

455
00:23:38,359 --> 00:23:40,439
in our Mahindra fan
favourite competition.

456
00:23:40,479 --> 00:23:44,239
And just by voting, one of
the viewers is the lucky winner

457
00:23:44,279 --> 00:23:48,519
of the Mahindra XUV500 W8.

458
00:23:48,559 --> 00:23:50,239
Our winner is...

459
00:23:51,919 --> 00:23:53,519
..Claudette Harmse.

460
00:23:53,559 --> 00:23:54,879
Congratulations, Claudette.

461
00:24:01,599 --> 00:24:02,599
All right.

462
00:24:02,639 --> 00:24:08,119
So one of our viewers drives
away in a brand-new Mahindra.

463
00:24:08,159 --> 00:24:10,959
But what about our castaways?

464
00:24:13,799 --> 00:24:16,439
The winner of the fan
favourite vote also drives away

465
00:24:16,479 --> 00:24:18,199
in a brand-new Mahindra.

466
00:24:41,599 --> 00:24:42,999
Take a look at that.

467
00:24:43,039 --> 00:24:47,079
The KUV100 NXT K8 petrol.

468
00:24:47,119 --> 00:24:49,399
So one of our castaways,
one of the fan favourites,

469
00:24:49,439 --> 00:24:51,679
will drive away in
that great Mahindra.

470
00:24:51,719 --> 00:24:54,119
The three favourites
in the running are:

471
00:25:01,239 --> 00:25:05,439
The biggest thing that's changed
inside of me is appreciation.

472
00:25:07,759 --> 00:25:10,599
This has definitely taught
me a lot about myself.

473
00:25:10,639 --> 00:25:12,959
I learned that I'm
stronger than I think I am.

474
00:25:14,999 --> 00:25:16,199
It's been amazing.

475
00:25:16,239 --> 00:25:20,239
I'm so blessed and so happy
to have been a part of this.

476
00:25:20,279 --> 00:25:21,879
I got to play it.

477
00:25:38,119 --> 00:25:39,239
Who will win the car?

478
00:25:39,279 --> 00:25:40,919
Tom, would you
like to drive that?

479
00:25:40,959 --> 00:25:42,279
Hell, yes.

480
00:25:43,839 --> 00:25:45,439
Katinka, 19 years old.

481
00:25:45,479 --> 00:25:47,639
That's a good place to start.

482
00:25:47,679 --> 00:25:49,559
Being humble. I'm
going to start there.

483
00:25:49,599 --> 00:25:52,799
That's a wonderful
place to have at any age.

484
00:25:52,839 --> 00:25:54,039
Werner?

485
00:25:54,079 --> 00:25:55,319
Wonderful prize.

486
00:26:35,172 --> 00:26:38,800
It's time to find out which one of
them is our fan favourite winner.

487
00:26:38,847 --> 00:26:42,367
And that person is none
other than the incredible...

488
00:26:45,327 --> 00:26:47,287
..Werner!

489
00:27:02,847 --> 00:27:04,527
You can go sit down.

490
00:27:08,087 --> 00:27:11,727
Look at him, just ready to
jump in and drive away, right?

491
00:27:11,767 --> 00:27:15,487
Congratulations, Werner.
Enjoy the Mahindra.

492
00:27:15,527 --> 00:27:17,527
I got it right. I think...

493
00:27:17,567 --> 00:27:18,807
Well, let me just ask the cast.

494
00:27:18,847 --> 00:27:21,447
Were you guys surprised
that this guy was a pastor?

495
00:27:24,327 --> 00:27:26,367
He played the
game like a pastor.

496
00:27:28,447 --> 00:27:30,567
Except for the lying part!

497
00:27:30,607 --> 00:27:32,007
The congregation.

498
00:27:33,087 --> 00:27:35,887
Werner, fan favourite.
That means something...

499
00:27:35,927 --> 00:27:37,687
You were doing
something right, OK?

500
00:27:37,727 --> 00:27:39,007
Let's talk about your game.

501
00:27:40,967 --> 00:27:42,647
Why do you want
to talk about me?

502
00:27:44,287 --> 00:27:45,847
Was it life-changing for you?

503
00:27:45,887 --> 00:27:49,207
Nico, for me, it felt like I
was on the outside looking in.

504
00:27:49,247 --> 00:27:51,687
People know I applied
last time, didn't make it.

505
00:27:51,727 --> 00:27:55,207
And I saw these guys
standing on the beach.

506
00:27:55,247 --> 00:27:58,407
I felt, man, I'm happy for
you, but I wanted to be there.

507
00:27:58,447 --> 00:28:01,487
So to be in the show,
it's just amazing.

508
00:28:02,727 --> 00:28:04,207
Well, you have been amazing.

509
00:28:04,247 --> 00:28:05,647
And I think everyone will agree,

510
00:28:05,687 --> 00:28:07,847
it was wonderful
having you on the show.

511
00:28:09,167 --> 00:28:13,687
We have one winner tonight,
the sole Survivor, Tom Swartz.

512
00:28:13,727 --> 00:28:17,207
Tom, the winner of the show.

513
00:28:17,247 --> 00:28:17,925
Yes.

514
00:28:17,937 --> 00:28:20,023
What do you feel like right
now as you're sitting over there?

515
00:28:20,047 --> 00:28:21,807
Slightly surreal.

516
00:28:23,047 --> 00:28:26,407
It's starting to sink in now because
I'm starting to vibrate a bit more.

517
00:28:26,447 --> 00:28:29,327
And the more we have
like these ad breaks,

518
00:28:29,367 --> 00:28:31,767
the more these guys are
saying their drinks are on me.

519
00:28:31,807 --> 00:28:34,247
So that's also making
it a bit more real.

520
00:28:34,287 --> 00:28:36,367
We got to stop all of
that right there! OK.

521
00:28:36,407 --> 00:28:38,943
Well, tell me this. Your life is
going to change from here on in.

522
00:28:38,967 --> 00:28:41,087
How did it change the
moment you got off the island?

523
00:28:41,127 --> 00:28:43,527
How did your perspective
on life change?

524
00:28:43,567 --> 00:28:48,327
Getting home was, I think, just
one of the best days of my life.

525
00:28:48,367 --> 00:28:54,527
Seeing the people that I love that
much, be that happy to see me back,

526
00:28:54,567 --> 00:28:56,167
which included my wife!

527
00:28:58,447 --> 00:29:02,167
And our house was a lot tidier
while I was away, apparently.



## S06E24

1
00:00:00,000 --> 00:00:04,162
WWW.MY-SUBS.COM

1
00:00:06,234 --> 00:00:08,407
12 Champions...

2
00:00:08,572 --> 00:00:11,051
Survivor is that ultimate test.

3
00:00:11,132 --> 00:00:13,991
There's no room for failure.

4
00:00:14,092 --> 00:00:15,951
..12 Contenders...

5
00:00:16,092 --> 00:00:18,791
I'm willing to do what
needs to be done to win.

6
00:00:18,932 --> 00:00:22,391
Champions, we're coming for you.

7
00:00:22,492 --> 00:00:23,991
Go!

8
00:00:24,092 --> 00:00:26,111
..playing the greatest game...

9
00:00:26,252 --> 00:00:28,951
Give it all you've got.
That's why you're here!

10
00:00:29,052 --> 00:00:30,052
Arrgh!

11
00:00:30,092 --> 00:00:31,092
Come on, boys!

12
00:00:31,132 --> 00:00:32,691
Arrgh!

13
00:00:32,772 --> 00:00:35,351
..Australian Survivor has ever seen.

14
00:00:36,432 --> 00:00:38,211
Arrgh, arrgh...

15
00:00:39,452 --> 00:00:40,831
One by one...

16
00:00:40,932 --> 00:00:45,431
Nova, Steven, Shaun, David, John.

17
00:00:45,532 --> 00:00:47,231
..they were voted out...

18
00:00:47,332 --> 00:00:48,471
The tribe has spoken.

19
00:00:51,872 --> 00:00:55,231
..until just three remain.

20
00:00:57,772 --> 00:00:58,772
Baden...

21
00:00:58,832 --> 00:01:02,231
Survivor has definitely
pushed me to my limits.

22
00:01:02,332 --> 00:01:04,631
But now I want the title.

23
00:01:04,732 --> 00:01:06,231
..Harry...

24
00:01:06,332 --> 00:01:08,271
I've done a lot of sneaky things

25
00:01:08,412 --> 00:01:12,991
and I didn't work hard to just
hand the win over to someone else.

26
00:01:14,132 --> 00:01:15,271
..Pia.

27
00:01:15,412 --> 00:01:18,191
I said that if I wasn't
the first one out,

28
00:01:18,292 --> 00:01:19,871
I'd be the last one standing.

29
00:01:20,012 --> 00:01:23,591
So I'm just going to give it my all
and I'm going to fight to the death.

30
00:01:23,692 --> 00:01:26,471
One Champion, two Contenders.

31
00:01:27,932 --> 00:01:31,791
Who will be crowned Sole Survivor?

32
00:03:13,932 --> 00:03:16,391
I'm here at final three.

33
00:03:19,492 --> 00:03:22,711
While it's been an amazing experience...

34
00:03:24,172 --> 00:03:27,511
..I'm ready to finish this game

35
00:03:27,652 --> 00:03:31,491
because I'm actually now
in the box seat to win.

36
00:03:33,372 --> 00:03:35,231
I'm the ultimate Contender.

37
00:03:35,372 --> 00:03:38,871
I've had four jobs, worked
for everything I have.

38
00:03:39,012 --> 00:03:42,551
And since day one I've
played this game hard.

39
00:03:44,052 --> 00:03:48,751
We're down to hours
until final challenge,

40
00:03:48,852 --> 00:03:52,511
final tribal council,

41
00:03:52,612 --> 00:03:54,791
$500,000.

42
00:03:54,932 --> 00:03:59,231
I'm so close I can basically taste it.

43
00:04:13,572 --> 00:04:16,751
This is the ice-cream
truck that I have wanted

44
00:04:16,852 --> 00:04:19,271
since I was five years old.

45
00:04:20,752 --> 00:04:22,211
This is marrying my girlfriend.

46
00:04:26,672 --> 00:04:29,911
I might be up against a genius,

47
00:04:30,012 --> 00:04:32,031
and an amazing Australian actress

48
00:04:32,172 --> 00:04:36,671
but I feel like I played a
better game than both of them.

49
00:04:37,932 --> 00:04:40,431
And I just need to
prove that to the jury.

50
00:04:40,532 --> 00:04:43,271
I've had countless nicknames,

51
00:04:43,412 --> 00:04:47,751
Dirty Harry, Harry
Houdini, the cockroach.

52
00:04:47,892 --> 00:04:52,911
But right now, I'm just Harry Hills
and I'm going to be Sole Survivor.

53
00:05:00,852 --> 00:05:04,211
Last night I took
away Luke's dream.

54
00:05:06,512 --> 00:05:09,911
It felt really horrific to vote him out.

55
00:05:10,012 --> 00:05:12,151
He's been a real ally of mine.

56
00:05:12,292 --> 00:05:14,391
You know, I'm going to
sit with that decision

57
00:05:14,492 --> 00:05:15,571
for the rest of my life.

58
00:05:18,372 --> 00:05:20,271
Now I have to win it.

59
00:05:20,412 --> 00:05:24,591
I owe it to him and I owe
it to myself to fight for this.

60
00:05:24,732 --> 00:05:28,031
I want it to be for something. I
don't want it to be for nothing.

61
00:05:30,872 --> 00:05:34,991
I'm the last woman standing and
I'm the last Champ standing.

62
00:05:35,132 --> 00:05:37,271
I would love another
Champion to take it out.

63
00:05:37,412 --> 00:05:40,031
And I would love to be that
champion. I'm their last shot.

64
00:05:41,152 --> 00:05:43,471
I'm here because I
played the right game,

65
00:05:43,572 --> 00:05:46,031
being incredibly social,

66
00:05:46,132 --> 00:05:50,111
making smart moves on the sly.

67
00:05:50,212 --> 00:05:53,391
And if I get to the final two,

68
00:05:53,532 --> 00:05:56,631
I'm going to give a
kick-arse pitch to the jury.

69
00:05:57,812 --> 00:05:59,591
And I'm hoping that I can win.

70
00:06:07,412 --> 00:06:11,791
People do underestimate me.
I'm the shy, awkward PhD student.

71
00:06:11,932 --> 00:06:14,111
Everyone I know back
home would be surprised

72
00:06:14,252 --> 00:06:16,231
that I even applied to be on Survivor.

73
00:06:17,652 --> 00:06:20,291
I don't think people expected
me to make it this far.

74
00:06:20,412 --> 00:06:25,351
But here I am after 48 days
of challenges and tribals

75
00:06:25,492 --> 00:06:29,931
and endless tests of my
physical and mental abilities,

76
00:06:30,012 --> 00:06:32,111
I've only got one more challenge.

77
00:06:32,252 --> 00:06:36,931
I've been so close to an individual
immunity win several times.

78
00:06:37,012 --> 00:06:39,031
I really want to get that win

79
00:06:39,172 --> 00:06:41,031
and not be carried to the
final two by someone else.

80
00:06:42,852 --> 00:06:46,631
But also personally to
show everyone back home

81
00:06:46,772 --> 00:06:50,071
that people like me can
do these sorts of things.

82
00:06:51,652 --> 00:06:53,931
This is my last chance to win
that beautiful necklace.

83
00:07:06,472 --> 00:07:09,031
We're going into war here.

84
00:07:09,172 --> 00:07:11,351
I'm going to do everything
I can to beat Pia...

85
00:07:13,212 --> 00:07:15,951
..taking Baden to the end, to final two.

86
00:07:16,052 --> 00:07:17,751
That was always my plan.

87
00:07:17,892 --> 00:07:22,311
And saying, "Hey. I'm a true Contender.

88
00:07:22,452 --> 00:07:24,191
"And I deserve to win Sole Survivor."

89
00:07:24,292 --> 00:07:25,831
Come on in, guys.

90
00:07:27,732 --> 00:07:30,551
I'm so nervous
about today's challenge.

91
00:07:30,692 --> 00:07:33,311
I know that if Harry
wins immunity today,

92
00:07:33,452 --> 00:07:35,431
he's not going to take me to final two.

93
00:07:36,832 --> 00:07:39,791
This will seal my fate in this game.

94
00:07:39,892 --> 00:07:41,111
Arm strength.

95
00:07:41,252 --> 00:07:44,151
I just have to do whatever
it takes to beat him.

96
00:07:44,292 --> 00:07:46,671
He's gonna fight me to the death
and I'm going to do the same.

97
00:07:58,592 --> 00:08:02,231
Guys, congratulations
on making it to Day 49.

98
00:08:02,372 --> 00:08:06,751
You have outlasted 21 other
players to get this far.

99
00:08:06,852 --> 00:08:08,871
That is no easy feat. Well done.

100
00:08:10,292 --> 00:08:12,651
You ready to get to your
final immunity challenge?

101
00:08:12,772 --> 00:08:13,791
- Yes.
- Of course.

102
00:08:13,892 --> 00:08:15,551
First things first.

103
00:08:15,652 --> 00:08:17,011
You're gonna have to take it off me.

104
00:08:17,132 --> 00:08:19,391
You're not... you're not
going to help me, huh?

105
00:08:19,492 --> 00:08:21,311
Nuh.

106
00:08:21,412 --> 00:08:22,751
Alrighty.

107
00:08:26,292 --> 00:08:30,431
For the last time, immunity
is back up for grabs.

108
00:08:30,572 --> 00:08:35,011
If you only win one
challenge in this game,

109
00:08:35,092 --> 00:08:36,671
this is the one to win.

110
00:08:41,172 --> 00:08:42,172
For today's challenge

111
00:08:42,252 --> 00:08:45,751
you're going to stand
on narrow pedestals

112
00:08:45,892 --> 00:08:50,231
while holding onto ropes
attached to two heavy idols.

113
00:08:50,332 --> 00:08:53,231
If at any point you drop an idol

114
00:08:53,332 --> 00:08:55,831
or you take a foot off a pedestal,

115
00:08:55,932 --> 00:08:57,831
you're out of the challenge.

116
00:08:57,932 --> 00:09:01,011
Last person standing wins immunity

117
00:09:01,132 --> 00:09:04,711
and a guaranteed spot in the final two

118
00:09:04,852 --> 00:09:07,671
and a 50% chance of winning
a half million dollars

119
00:09:07,772 --> 00:09:09,151
and the title of Sole Survivor.

120
00:09:09,292 --> 00:09:11,791
Plus you will get to choose who's
gonna be sitting next to you

121
00:09:11,892 --> 00:09:13,671
at that final tribal.

122
00:09:13,772 --> 00:09:15,391
Everything is on the line today.

123
00:09:15,492 --> 00:09:17,011
This is the one to win.

124
00:09:20,372 --> 00:09:22,791
Now, because it's your final challenge

125
00:09:22,932 --> 00:09:25,231
and you might need a
little extra motivation,

126
00:09:25,372 --> 00:09:28,511
we have some people here
today to help cheer you on.

127
00:09:28,612 --> 00:09:29,612
No...

128
00:09:32,032 --> 00:09:34,831
Harry, who would you
most like to see today?

129
00:09:34,932 --> 00:09:36,671
My family and Jordan.

130
00:09:36,772 --> 00:09:39,191
Come on out, guys.

131
00:09:52,472 --> 00:09:55,271
Hi, look at your beard.

132
00:10:00,992 --> 00:10:03,551
Well done. I'm so proud of you.

133
00:10:06,552 --> 00:10:08,751
I've missed you so much.

134
00:10:09,972 --> 00:10:11,311
Nice to meet you.

135
00:10:11,412 --> 00:10:13,271
Hi. I feel like I know you.

136
00:10:13,372 --> 00:10:15,111
Harry, you want to introduce us?

137
00:10:15,252 --> 00:10:19,631
This is my mum and this
is my girlfriend Jordan.

138
00:10:19,772 --> 00:10:21,271
- Hi.
- Hi.

139
00:10:21,412 --> 00:10:24,831
So, Harry, how does it feel
seeing Jordan after 49 days?

140
00:10:24,932 --> 00:10:27,371
It's incredible.

141
00:10:27,452 --> 00:10:29,231
Like...

142
00:10:29,372 --> 00:10:32,731
..I feel like there's energy with me now

143
00:10:32,812 --> 00:10:36,151
that I haven't had 49 days.

144
00:10:37,652 --> 00:10:40,251
You're so skinny.

145
00:10:40,392 --> 00:10:41,871
I've never seen his
beard this long before.

146
00:10:41,972 --> 00:10:44,111
Your hair looks nice, though.

147
00:10:44,292 --> 00:10:47,391
- So, Jordan, you know how much of
a superfan Harry is. - Yeah.

148
00:10:47,492 --> 00:10:48,731
What do you think it means to him

149
00:10:48,852 --> 00:10:50,591
to be standing here at
this final challenge?

150
00:10:50,732 --> 00:10:53,191
Oh, God. This is absolutely
a dream come true for him.

151
00:10:53,332 --> 00:10:55,231
I honestly knew that
he would get this far.

152
00:10:55,372 --> 00:10:57,671
And to see him here, I'm
just... I'm so happy for him.

153
00:10:57,812 --> 00:11:00,031
- I'm so proud of him.
- We're very proud of him.

154
00:11:00,172 --> 00:11:02,091
He's done an amazing
job to get this far.

155
00:11:02,172 --> 00:11:04,231
Obviously you guys have as well.

156
00:11:04,372 --> 00:11:06,591
It's been a long time. We've
heard so much about you guys.

157
00:11:06,732 --> 00:11:08,111
It's nice to finally see you as well.

158
00:11:08,252 --> 00:11:10,271
It's like we know you,
especially you, Jordan.

159
00:11:10,412 --> 00:11:12,191
Oh, that's good. I'm glad
you're talking about me.

160
00:11:13,812 --> 00:11:15,631
So, Baden, are you ready
for a little love from home?

161
00:11:15,772 --> 00:11:18,991
Oh, jeez. I don't know if I'll
ever be ready but I'm excited.

162
00:11:19,092 --> 00:11:21,231
Let's find out.

163
00:11:21,332 --> 00:11:22,391
Come on out, guys.

164
00:11:23,972 --> 00:11:25,731
Cal!

165
00:11:37,072 --> 00:11:39,551
Oh, you all came.

166
00:11:40,632 --> 00:11:42,951
Good to see you.

167
00:11:43,092 --> 00:11:44,831
It's so good to see you
guys. It's been so long.

168
00:11:44,972 --> 00:11:46,140
- Look at you.
- What's going on?

169
00:11:46,141 --> 00:11:47,556
I know. I know.

170
00:11:49,692 --> 00:11:50,991
So, Baden, who do we have here?

171
00:11:51,132 --> 00:11:54,191
So, we've got Mum and Dad
on my left, Glen and Karen,

172
00:11:54,292 --> 00:11:55,631
and I've got my brother
Callum here as well.

173
00:11:55,772 --> 00:11:57,831
I'm so glad they could
all make it and be here.

174
00:11:57,932 --> 00:11:59,991
It's just... It's so special.

175
00:12:00,132 --> 00:12:02,451
Just to have them come out
here and see me here.

176
00:12:02,592 --> 00:12:04,951
Karen, did you think
he'd make it to Day 49?

177
00:12:05,092 --> 00:12:07,871
Uh, no. Because at home his
nickname is the 'nutty professor'.

178
00:12:09,692 --> 00:12:11,031
He's not very good at basic life skills.

179
00:12:11,132 --> 00:12:14,111
So hopefully that's improved.

180
00:12:14,212 --> 00:12:15,212
Maybe a little hopefully.

181
00:12:15,252 --> 00:12:16,831
- Big change.
- Huge.

182
00:12:16,932 --> 00:12:18,331
Glen, do you sense that he's changed?

183
00:12:18,472 --> 00:12:21,311
Gosh, from the start I just
wouldn't have believed

184
00:12:21,452 --> 00:12:24,151
he would have tackled a challenge
like this totally on his own.

185
00:12:24,252 --> 00:12:26,391
Yeah. Very, very proud.

186
00:12:26,532 --> 00:12:30,351
So, Baden, why did you want to play
this crazy game in the first place?

187
00:12:30,452 --> 00:12:34,511
I applied just to show myself

188
00:12:34,652 --> 00:12:37,111
that I can do things that I
didn't think were possible.

189
00:12:37,252 --> 00:12:39,831
Like, I'm very risk averse back home.

190
00:12:39,932 --> 00:12:41,271
I don't try things often.

191
00:12:41,372 --> 00:12:43,351
And here I am after seven weeks.

192
00:12:43,452 --> 00:12:45,711
I've had such a big experience here

193
00:12:45,852 --> 00:12:48,671
and I've done so many things I
thought I would never be able to do

194
00:12:48,812 --> 00:12:51,591
that I feel like a
different person almost

195
00:12:51,732 --> 00:12:53,671
that I don't fully appreciate
until I get home again

196
00:12:53,772 --> 00:12:55,911
how much I have changed.

197
00:12:56,012 --> 00:12:57,231
Alright.

198
00:12:57,372 --> 00:12:59,271
So, Pia, you stepped out
of a challenge 20 days ago

199
00:12:59,412 --> 00:13:01,191
- to talk to your family on the phone.
- Yes.

200
00:13:01,372 --> 00:13:03,591
- Are you ready to see them in the flesh?
- Yes.

201
00:13:03,692 --> 00:13:05,271
Come on out, guys.

202
00:13:11,272 --> 00:13:19,171
Oh, my God!

203
00:13:19,252 --> 00:13:21,711
What happened to you? You're so big.

204
00:13:24,132 --> 00:13:25,671
Hi.

205
00:13:25,772 --> 00:13:27,811
Oh, my God.

206
00:13:29,352 --> 00:13:31,031
Are you good?

207
00:13:31,172 --> 00:13:34,231
How are you? You've gotten so big.

208
00:13:34,332 --> 00:13:35,391
Look at your earrings.

209
00:13:35,492 --> 00:13:37,191
Hi.

210
00:13:37,292 --> 00:13:39,351
I'm so glad you came.

211
00:13:39,492 --> 00:13:42,171
- I love you.
- I'm so glad you came.

212
00:13:49,512 --> 00:13:51,631
So, Pia, introduce us to the tribe.

213
00:13:51,732 --> 00:13:53,531
This is my husband Luke.

214
00:13:53,652 --> 00:13:55,551
And this is my daughter
Lily and my son James

215
00:13:55,692 --> 00:13:59,111
who's had a massive,
massive growth spurt.

216
00:13:59,252 --> 00:14:01,791
- Are you a bit tired?
- No.

217
00:14:03,452 --> 00:14:05,751
- Say hello. - Spin around, buddy.
Spin around that way. That's it.

218
00:14:05,852 --> 00:14:08,231
Say hi. Are you gonna wave?

219
00:14:08,332 --> 00:14:09,711
Hey.

220
00:14:09,852 --> 00:14:12,711
So, Luke, what did you think
when Pia first came to you

221
00:14:12,852 --> 00:14:16,991
and said, "Honey, I think I'm
going to go and play Survivor

222
00:14:17,132 --> 00:14:20,551
"for a couple of months and you
can take care of the kids"?

223
00:14:20,692 --> 00:14:23,671
I wasn't surprised because I know
how much she loves the show.

224
00:14:23,812 --> 00:14:26,831
Did you think that she'd
make it this far?

225
00:14:27,972 --> 00:14:30,071
Honestly I did. I kind of did.

226
00:14:34,872 --> 00:14:37,071
It's alright. I didn't.

227
00:14:37,172 --> 00:14:40,591
I thought voted out Day 1. Yeah.

228
00:14:40,732 --> 00:14:43,711
I just... I just kind of...
I think she's incredible.

229
00:14:43,812 --> 00:14:46,111
I know what she's capable.

230
00:14:46,252 --> 00:14:50,951
I think it's in her nature to
maybe resist challenges like this

231
00:14:51,092 --> 00:14:55,351
but once she puts her mind to
things she's... she's unstoppable.

232
00:14:55,492 --> 00:14:57,891
And it just doesn't really
surprise me to see her here now

233
00:14:57,972 --> 00:14:59,531
to be honest.

234
00:14:59,672 --> 00:15:01,471
- Thanks.
- It's alright.

235
00:15:03,692 --> 00:15:06,471
So, Pia, what does being away
from the family for so long

236
00:15:06,572 --> 00:15:08,911
made you realise?

237
00:15:10,692 --> 00:15:12,311
Mwah.

238
00:15:12,452 --> 00:15:14,531
You know, I couldn't love them any more,

239
00:15:14,672 --> 00:15:18,071
but I appreciate them on
such a deep level now.

240
00:15:18,212 --> 00:15:20,271
Like, no part of my life
will I take for granted.

241
00:15:20,412 --> 00:15:22,791
You know, silly things
like making lunches

242
00:15:22,932 --> 00:15:24,711
or, you know, having to get
kids ready for school.

243
00:15:24,852 --> 00:15:27,551
Sometimes you don't think
about how lucky you are.

244
00:15:27,652 --> 00:15:29,031
And I think every single moment

245
00:15:29,172 --> 00:15:30,951
that I get to spend with
these kids and Luke

246
00:15:31,052 --> 00:15:33,191
is going to be even more special now

247
00:15:33,332 --> 00:15:36,251
because I appreciate it
on such a high level.

248
00:15:36,372 --> 00:15:38,631
What would it mean to you
to win this challenge today?

249
00:15:38,772 --> 00:15:43,071
I've worked so hard and I've had so
many ups and downs to get here.

250
00:15:43,172 --> 00:15:44,891
I mean, there's been times when

251
00:15:45,032 --> 00:15:47,631
I thought I wasn't going
to make it even five days.

252
00:15:47,772 --> 00:15:50,911
So just to win this challenge
would be incredible.

253
00:15:51,052 --> 00:15:53,631
And to know that I have a
chance to get to the final two

254
00:15:53,732 --> 00:15:55,631
and plead my case would be amazing.

255
00:15:57,872 --> 00:15:59,511
Alright. Well, loved ones,

256
00:15:59,652 --> 00:16:01,391
you're going to be cheering
on from the bench today.

257
00:16:01,532 --> 00:16:04,111
I'm going to give everyone
a minute to catch up.

258
00:16:04,252 --> 00:16:07,431
And then Pia, Baden, Harry
we're gonna get to it.

259
00:16:07,572 --> 00:16:09,431
Oh, my goodness, it's
so good to see you.

260
00:16:11,092 --> 00:16:12,391
- Look at my nails.
- I know.

261
00:16:12,492 --> 00:16:14,551
They've been like this since Day 2.

262
00:16:14,652 --> 00:16:16,031
Did you miss me?

263
00:16:30,132 --> 00:16:33,071
- Mate. Thanks, mate.
- Good luck.

264
00:16:36,892 --> 00:16:38,971
- This is gonna be fun, Harry.
- It's not going to be fun.

265
00:16:40,632 --> 00:16:41,632
Did you say it's going to be fun?

266
00:16:41,692 --> 00:16:43,391
A special kind of fun.

267
00:16:48,412 --> 00:16:49,671
Oh, yeah. They feel nice, huh?

268
00:16:49,812 --> 00:16:52,551
Nice and soft, you know, a bit cushy.

269
00:16:56,292 --> 00:16:57,971
Alright, everyone.

270
00:16:58,052 --> 00:16:59,711
Go ahead and grab your handles.

271
00:17:03,892 --> 00:17:06,871
When you're ready, take up
your position on the pedestals.

272
00:17:09,492 --> 00:17:12,071
Get a nice comfortable position

273
00:17:12,172 --> 00:17:13,631
'cause you're gonna be here a while.

274
00:17:15,712 --> 00:17:16,712
For immunity

275
00:17:16,772 --> 00:17:19,231
and a spot in the final two...

276
00:17:20,492 --> 00:17:21,511
..this challenge is now on.

277
00:17:48,978 --> 00:17:51,377
Pretty simple challenge.

278
00:17:51,518 --> 00:17:54,220
In each of those idols you
have 10% of your body weight.

279
00:17:54,744 --> 00:17:57,163
You just need to keep both
feet on those pedestals,

280
00:17:57,264 --> 00:17:58,443
both idols in the air.

281
00:17:59,684 --> 00:18:02,503
But as is often the case in Survivor,

282
00:18:02,644 --> 00:18:05,223
the simple ones can
be the most difficult.

283
00:18:07,464 --> 00:18:10,283
Nothing comfortable about that position.

284
00:18:10,424 --> 00:18:15,123
The pedestals are gonna start
grinding into the soles of your feet.

285
00:18:16,304 --> 00:18:19,523
That discomfort soon is
going to turn into pain.

286
00:18:21,144 --> 00:18:23,043
Then it becomes about pain management.

287
00:18:24,264 --> 00:18:25,923
Mind over matter at that point.

288
00:18:29,144 --> 00:18:30,863
Alright. That's it.
That's all I got to say.

289
00:18:30,944 --> 00:18:32,443
I'll see you guys in four hours.

290
00:18:32,644 --> 00:18:33,644
Hey.

291
00:19:08,384 --> 00:19:10,243
Baden gonna try out Harry's position.

292
00:19:16,184 --> 00:19:18,043
Baden almost knocks himself out.

293
00:19:20,104 --> 00:19:22,043
Just finding somewhere
comfortable, Jonathan.

294
00:19:22,184 --> 00:19:25,583
You really do not want to
slip in this challenge.

295
00:20:02,744 --> 00:20:04,323
Ooh, a little slip from Baden.

296
00:20:05,404 --> 00:20:07,403
Nothing to see here, right?

297
00:20:34,104 --> 00:20:36,123
That's one hour, guys.

298
00:20:41,744 --> 00:20:43,763
What's the record
for the longest challenge?

299
00:20:43,904 --> 00:20:47,083
Six hours and 28 minutes is the record.

300
00:20:48,304 --> 00:20:51,663
- Would they really last that long?
- They've just gotta push through it.

301
00:20:53,864 --> 00:20:56,563
Baden is the only one up there
with a smile right now.

302
00:21:02,464 --> 00:21:04,243
I would have loved to have
done some proper stargazing

303
00:21:04,344 --> 00:21:05,683
while we're standing here, but...

304
00:21:07,604 --> 00:21:09,663
If I look up, I think I might pass out.

305
00:21:09,744 --> 00:21:11,203
I can see, like, three stars.

306
00:21:11,304 --> 00:21:13,303
Yeah. I was looking up before.

307
00:21:16,224 --> 00:21:18,403
You should see it from our
beach, Mum, it's beautiful.

308
00:21:18,544 --> 00:21:20,803
The whole Milky Way,
all the different stars.

309
00:21:20,904 --> 00:21:21,923
Yeah. Wow.

310
00:21:22,064 --> 00:21:25,243
- So many shooting stars.
- Yeah. Excellent.

311
00:21:42,604 --> 00:21:44,963
You know that you can use shooting
stars to determine winds, Jonathan.

312
00:21:45,104 --> 00:21:47,723
- Really.
- Yeah.

313
00:21:47,864 --> 00:21:50,123
Because the trail they leave
drifts with the wind.

314
00:21:50,224 --> 00:21:53,203
Oh, interesting.

315
00:21:53,344 --> 00:21:55,243
He's not actually
normally this talkative.

316
00:21:55,384 --> 00:21:58,043
- Oh, really?
- Yeah. It's a changed person.

317
00:21:58,144 --> 00:21:59,963
He chats a lot, don't you, Bay?

318
00:22:00,104 --> 00:22:02,403
Did I tell you that everyone
calls me 'Bay' here?

319
00:22:02,544 --> 00:22:04,163
- Bay?
- Bay.

320
00:22:04,304 --> 00:22:07,043
- Like 'bay'. Like Chopper Bay?
- Yeah. Like, Bay.

321
00:22:07,144 --> 00:22:08,803
Where else would you rather be?

322
00:22:08,944 --> 00:22:12,043
Honestly, in the middle of Fiji
standing on some torture pegs.

323
00:22:12,184 --> 00:22:13,683
Do you know how much
difference there is, though,

324
00:22:13,824 --> 00:22:16,443
between, like, a dry crunchy
rice and like a risottoey rice?

325
00:22:16,544 --> 00:22:18,203
Oh, my gosh.

326
00:22:18,304 --> 00:22:20,123
Oh, Dad, how did Brighton do?

327
00:22:20,264 --> 00:22:22,603
Did they get relegated?
Or are they safe?

328
00:22:22,744 --> 00:22:24,403
Oh, the stars are back. Thank goodness.

329
00:22:25,744 --> 00:22:29,323
We haven't been in a room
with walls in 49 days, Pia.

330
00:22:29,424 --> 00:22:31,283
Why did we choose to do this?

331
00:22:32,824 --> 00:22:34,243
Ooh. All good, Harry?

332
00:22:34,344 --> 00:22:35,843
Yeah. I'm readjusting.

333
00:22:37,404 --> 00:22:39,683
Is Harrison actually
you're full first name?

334
00:23:00,844 --> 00:23:08,163
Arrgh! Oh...

335
00:23:08,264 --> 00:23:09,463
Ow...

336
00:23:12,104 --> 00:23:14,403
Pia in a serious amount of pain.

337
00:23:16,044 --> 00:23:18,683
- Oh...
- Whoa.

338
00:23:18,824 --> 00:23:20,563
- Harry.
- Harry.

339
00:23:23,344 --> 00:23:25,563
Almost overbalances.

340
00:23:25,664 --> 00:23:26,664
Nice save.

341
00:23:28,284 --> 00:23:29,883
I love you.

342
00:23:44,064 --> 00:23:47,043
Everyone giving it everything.

343
00:23:48,784 --> 00:23:50,763
A lot of pain on Harry's face now.

344
00:23:50,864 --> 00:23:53,103
Ow...

345
00:23:56,104 --> 00:24:00,383
Guys, you've been up
there for five hours.

346
00:24:01,684 --> 00:24:04,283
- Massive effort from everyone
- Good job, everybody.

347
00:24:04,384 --> 00:24:05,523
Well done.

348
00:24:07,124 --> 00:24:08,963
Arrgh! No...

349
00:24:10,624 --> 00:24:12,643
Pia buckled over in pain.

350
00:24:17,264 --> 00:24:21,483
Pia up on her toes, legs
shaking uncontrollably.

351
00:24:23,184 --> 00:24:26,163
Just wondering how much
more of this she can take.

352
00:24:27,304 --> 00:24:29,923
There's nothing but
pure agony on her face.

353
00:24:33,144 --> 00:24:35,283
Hard to watch.

354
00:24:35,384 --> 00:24:37,743
Oh, yeah. It's just hard.

355
00:24:40,484 --> 00:24:42,743
Arms shaking.

356
00:24:48,184 --> 00:24:51,563
Trying to find that inner
strength to keep going.

357
00:24:52,644 --> 00:24:55,603
Hang in there, P, you can do it.

358
00:25:02,344 --> 00:25:05,243
Just hang in there, sweetheart.

359
00:25:05,344 --> 00:25:07,323
Just breathe. Breathe deep.

360
00:25:10,624 --> 00:25:11,963
Just breathe.

361
00:25:30,024 --> 00:25:33,163
Pia in an excruciating
amount of pain now.

362
00:25:44,284 --> 00:25:46,243
Hey, P, sweetie.

363
00:25:46,384 --> 00:25:49,563
I'm not gonna get any
more proud of you, OK?

364
00:25:49,704 --> 00:25:54,643
Alright. so whatever you need
to do, you just do it, OK?

365
00:25:55,744 --> 00:25:58,603
But I love you and I'm
so proud of you, OK?

366
00:25:58,704 --> 00:26:00,323
So you just do your best.

367
00:26:00,424 --> 00:26:02,203
I don't want to go home.

368
00:26:10,224 --> 00:26:12,043
Just hang in there, kiddo. Kiddo.

369
00:26:12,144 --> 00:26:13,463
If you don't want to go home,

370
00:26:13,604 --> 00:26:15,843
just dig deep and hang in there, OK?

371
00:26:16,924 --> 00:26:21,523
Think about the kids and
just work through it.

372
00:26:27,444 --> 00:26:29,323
Just breathe. Just breathe.

373
00:27:02,704 --> 00:27:05,843
Great job. Great job, sweetheart.

374
00:27:07,084 --> 00:27:09,963
Pia really digging deep.

375
00:27:12,984 --> 00:27:14,643
Giving it everything.

376
00:27:33,144 --> 00:27:34,883
Guys, I just want to let you know

377
00:27:35,024 --> 00:27:38,323
you've been up there for
six hours and 30 minutes.

378
00:27:43,584 --> 00:27:44,723
Well done, guys.

379
00:27:44,864 --> 00:27:48,603
You guys officially hold the
record for the longest challenge

380
00:27:48,704 --> 00:27:50,403
in Australian Survivor history.

381
00:27:50,504 --> 00:27:52,243
Wow!

382
00:27:52,344 --> 00:27:54,043
Great job, everybody.

383
00:27:56,784 --> 00:27:58,543
Keep going, Harry.

384
00:27:58,664 --> 00:28:01,163
Now it's about who wants
that necklace the most.

385
00:28:18,144 --> 00:28:22,483
Harry cannot control
the shake in his leg.

386
00:28:39,304 --> 00:28:41,043
Arrgh!

387
00:28:45,164 --> 00:28:47,163
Pia contorted in pain.

388
00:28:59,744 --> 00:29:01,603
- JLP...
- Yeah.

389
00:29:03,444 --> 00:29:05,163
Can you help me get down, please?

390
00:29:12,424 --> 00:29:17,643
And after six hours and 40 minutes,

391
00:29:17,744 --> 00:29:20,683
Harry steps out of the challenge.

392
00:29:20,784 --> 00:29:23,363
Great effort. Take a seat.

393
00:29:26,144 --> 00:29:27,403
Great job, Harry.

394
00:29:28,664 --> 00:29:30,283
It was a great effort.

395
00:29:30,424 --> 00:29:32,843
- Come here.
- Unbelievable effort.

396
00:29:45,544 --> 00:29:49,803
We're left with two, Baden and Pia.

397
00:29:51,444 --> 00:29:52,963
I can't move.

398
00:29:56,704 --> 00:29:59,263
I think I have to get
down. I'm so sorry.

399
00:29:59,404 --> 00:30:01,983
It's OK. Just do whatever
you have to do, sweetheart.

400
00:30:02,064 --> 00:30:03,443
I'm so proud.

401
00:30:03,544 --> 00:30:05,623
I'm trying to get down but I can't.

402
00:30:05,704 --> 00:30:08,483
You want to get down? OK.

403
00:30:10,004 --> 00:30:13,683
After over six hours and 40 minutes...

404
00:30:19,964 --> 00:30:21,803
..that's it, Baden.

405
00:30:30,504 --> 00:30:31,983
Thank you.

406
00:30:33,424 --> 00:30:34,763
Baden, congratulations.

407
00:30:34,864 --> 00:30:36,923
After six hours and 40 minutes...

408
00:30:37,024 --> 00:30:38,723
Wow.

409
00:30:38,864 --> 00:30:42,203
..you have won the final
individual immunity.

410
00:30:42,304 --> 00:30:44,043
Oh, my God.

411
00:30:55,802 --> 00:30:58,421
- Baden, come on over.
- Jonathan.

412
00:31:00,722 --> 00:31:03,281
Turn around. Congratulations.

413
00:31:04,542 --> 00:31:08,101
First individual immunity win,

414
00:31:08,242 --> 00:31:11,281
guaranteed a spot at
that final tribal council

415
00:31:11,422 --> 00:31:13,981
where you will have a chance
to plead your case to the jury.

416
00:31:16,202 --> 00:31:20,821
It's just so special but mostly that
my family were here to see this.

417
00:31:20,922 --> 00:31:23,181
I've come so close so many times

418
00:31:23,282 --> 00:31:26,061
and it just means so much to me

419
00:31:26,162 --> 00:31:28,461
that you guys are here for this one.

420
00:31:29,822 --> 00:31:31,181
One big decision left.

421
00:31:31,322 --> 00:31:34,301
Who are you gonna take
to that final tribal?

422
00:31:34,442 --> 00:31:38,861
And who's gonna join the
jury at the end of tonight?

423
00:31:39,962 --> 00:31:41,061
It's a lot to think about.

424
00:31:41,162 --> 00:31:43,381
It's... That's huge.

425
00:31:43,562 --> 00:31:45,921
- Guys, say goodbye to your loved ones.
- Yep.

426
00:31:46,062 --> 00:31:47,741
And I'll see you guys tonight at tribal.

427
00:31:47,922 --> 00:31:50,941
- See you, Mum. You can hardly walk.
- I know.

428
00:31:51,082 --> 00:31:53,061
I got the victory I've
been craving for so long

429
00:31:53,162 --> 00:31:54,641
and I could not be happier.

430
00:31:54,762 --> 00:31:56,821
Nice to meet you guys. Nice to meet you.

431
00:31:56,962 --> 00:32:00,101
And that's making me skip along
even though my feet are killing me.

432
00:32:01,802 --> 00:32:04,281
But now it's actually kind of terrifying

433
00:32:04,362 --> 00:32:05,941
how much power I hold at the moment.

434
00:32:06,082 --> 00:32:08,781
I have no idea who to
take to the end with me.

435
00:32:08,882 --> 00:32:10,741
And if I make the wrong choice here,

436
00:32:10,882 --> 00:32:13,021
I could be dooming
myself to second place.

437
00:32:13,162 --> 00:32:16,181
This is a half-a-million-dollar choice.

438
00:32:49,162 --> 00:32:51,641
I'll now bring in the
members of our jury.

439
00:32:51,782 --> 00:32:53,541
- Wow.
- Shaun.

440
00:32:53,682 --> 00:32:55,221
- David.
- Wow. Baden's got it.

441
00:32:55,362 --> 00:32:58,181
- John, Daisy...
- My God.

442
00:32:58,282 --> 00:32:59,781
..Simon.

443
00:32:59,922 --> 00:33:01,541
- Janine...
- Oh, my God.

444
00:33:01,642 --> 00:33:02,642
Abbey,

445
00:33:02,682 --> 00:33:05,661
and Luke, voted out
at the last tribal council.

446
00:33:10,942 --> 00:33:15,781
Well, first of all, congratulations,
guys, for breaking the record

447
00:33:15,922 --> 00:33:20,141
for the longest challenge in
Australian Survivor history.

448
00:33:20,242 --> 00:33:21,301
Well done.

449
00:33:21,402 --> 00:33:24,181
But after six hours and 40 minutes

450
00:33:24,322 --> 00:33:29,221
Baden, it was you who walked out
of there wearing that necklace.

451
00:33:30,642 --> 00:33:34,261
Now you have the power to decide
who's going to be in the final two.

452
00:33:34,362 --> 00:33:35,581
Is that weighing on you?

453
00:33:35,682 --> 00:33:38,361
Absolutely it's weighing on me.

454
00:33:38,482 --> 00:33:42,141
It's the sort of power that you can
only dream of having in this game.

455
00:33:42,282 --> 00:33:46,821
And there's definitely two major
things in my mind tonight.

456
00:33:46,962 --> 00:33:49,541
The strength of both
Harry and Pia's games

457
00:33:49,682 --> 00:33:52,861
and what the jury is looking
for in a player at the end.

458
00:33:58,962 --> 00:34:01,181
Alright. Pia.

459
00:34:01,322 --> 00:34:03,421
After the game that you've played so far

460
00:34:03,562 --> 00:34:05,901
and your effort in the challenge today

461
00:34:06,042 --> 00:34:10,501
do you think you deserve to be in
the final two more than Harry does?

462
00:34:10,642 --> 00:34:13,181
I mean, I don't want to say I
deserve to be in the final two

463
00:34:13,282 --> 00:34:14,941
more than Harry does.

464
00:34:15,042 --> 00:34:16,261
But I definitely think

465
00:34:16,402 --> 00:34:20,021
that Baden has a better
shot at winning against me.

466
00:34:26,602 --> 00:34:29,101
These guys have played the game together

467
00:34:29,202 --> 00:34:31,101
and they've made the same moves.

468
00:34:31,242 --> 00:34:33,941
But Harry is a little more strategic.

469
00:34:36,102 --> 00:34:38,621
If you put them both in the final two,

470
00:34:38,762 --> 00:34:42,501
it will be harder for Baden
to own some of those moves.

471
00:34:48,882 --> 00:34:51,461
Harry, what would you say to that?

472
00:34:51,602 --> 00:34:53,741
I think the problem that
just got highlighted there

473
00:34:53,842 --> 00:34:57,261
is that my game is already out there

474
00:34:57,402 --> 00:35:00,741
but I've seen Pia's game
since the tribe swap.

475
00:35:00,842 --> 00:35:03,621
And it's subtle, yes.

476
00:35:03,762 --> 00:35:07,621
But if you think that it's
been a weak game in any way,

477
00:35:07,722 --> 00:35:09,461
then you're dead wrong.

478
00:35:13,102 --> 00:35:16,421
Walking into tomorrow's
tribal if Pia is here,

479
00:35:16,522 --> 00:35:18,081
she's gonna have a lot of surprises.

480
00:35:18,162 --> 00:35:20,181
On top of that,

481
00:35:20,322 --> 00:35:24,621
there's a lot to be gained by
taking a fellow Contender here.

482
00:35:24,762 --> 00:35:26,021
I mean, you just look at the numbers.

483
00:35:26,122 --> 00:35:27,501
There's five Champions

484
00:35:27,642 --> 00:35:32,021
and less than that in
Contenders at the moment.

485
00:35:32,162 --> 00:35:35,341
If you're taking Pia,
you're against the odds.

486
00:35:38,722 --> 00:35:41,341
I will say, though, with the Champions,

487
00:35:41,442 --> 00:35:44,101
there are a few I voted out who,

488
00:35:44,242 --> 00:35:47,221
I mean, actually all of
them except for Janine,

489
00:35:47,322 --> 00:35:50,341
who are not happy with me.

490
00:35:50,482 --> 00:35:53,441
I also didn't spend that much
time with the Contenders

491
00:35:53,562 --> 00:35:56,501
so I'm not sure that there's
a lot of love coming my way.

492
00:35:57,922 --> 00:36:00,301
And you did a really good
job working with Abbey

493
00:36:00,402 --> 00:36:02,821
and that alliance of four.

494
00:36:02,922 --> 00:36:03,941
You bamboozled me a lot

495
00:36:04,082 --> 00:36:06,941
when I was going between,
like, Abbey and everyone

496
00:36:07,042 --> 00:36:08,941
trying to save myself.

497
00:36:09,082 --> 00:36:10,701
I really think there's a better chance

498
00:36:10,802 --> 00:36:12,861
that if you took me you would win.

499
00:36:13,002 --> 00:36:15,901
She sounds very convincing
right now to me.

500
00:36:17,522 --> 00:36:19,101
I'm just saying.

501
00:36:23,182 --> 00:36:26,101
I mean, she is a professional actress

502
00:36:26,242 --> 00:36:29,661
and she's gone through this
game being quite deceptive

503
00:36:29,762 --> 00:36:32,521
about how strong she is.

504
00:36:32,602 --> 00:36:35,181
That's dangerous.

505
00:36:42,682 --> 00:36:45,861
On that note, Baden, you
really have no idea

506
00:36:46,002 --> 00:36:48,941
what these two are planning
to pitch to the jury.

507
00:36:49,042 --> 00:36:51,581
Does that worry you?

508
00:36:51,682 --> 00:36:54,101
It does worry me.

509
00:36:54,242 --> 00:36:55,981
While I'm listening to
what everyone is saying

510
00:36:56,122 --> 00:36:58,741
I can't take everything as being
completely truthful from them

511
00:36:58,882 --> 00:37:03,061
because it benefits their game to
try and convince me to take them.

512
00:37:05,822 --> 00:37:08,581
I mean, I've only known Pia since merge

513
00:37:08,722 --> 00:37:10,621
and I had a bit of a holiday
from Harry in the middle

514
00:37:10,722 --> 00:37:13,061
so I don't know their entire games.

515
00:37:13,162 --> 00:37:14,901
But, um... But...

516
00:37:16,422 --> 00:37:18,181
What was the question again?

517
00:37:23,462 --> 00:37:26,381
Can I just clarify something
and be honest very quickly?

518
00:37:26,482 --> 00:37:28,461
Absolutely.

519
00:37:28,602 --> 00:37:33,541
I told Baden straight out that I
would like to take him to final two.

520
00:37:33,682 --> 00:37:37,461
And that he didn't have to
promise anything to me.

521
00:37:39,242 --> 00:37:43,621
And I said that purely because
I think Pia beats both of us.

522
00:37:46,982 --> 00:37:47,982
Really.

523
00:37:50,542 --> 00:37:52,341
No.

524
00:37:53,802 --> 00:37:57,581
I think if you won today,
you wouldn't have taken me

525
00:37:57,682 --> 00:37:59,741
because you would have taken Baden

526
00:37:59,842 --> 00:38:01,421
because you think you can beat him.

527
00:38:02,542 --> 00:38:06,161
You know that there's a lot of moves
that you feel like you can claim.

528
00:38:10,342 --> 00:38:11,621
We've made some of the same moves

529
00:38:11,762 --> 00:38:14,541
but Baden has made
probably better connections

530
00:38:14,682 --> 00:38:18,261
with a whole lot of
people compared to me.

531
00:38:18,362 --> 00:38:20,701
Baden spent more time with Luke.

532
00:38:20,802 --> 00:38:22,421
Spent more time with Dave.

533
00:38:22,562 --> 00:38:24,941
Spent more time with some
of the old Contenders as well.

534
00:38:25,082 --> 00:38:27,241
But I do think that everyone's
been trying to get you out

535
00:38:27,322 --> 00:38:29,541
and no one's been able to.

536
00:38:31,122 --> 00:38:34,541
I would say that would
be your last big move

537
00:38:34,682 --> 00:38:37,981
to take out the person that everyone
else has tried to take out.

538
00:38:46,962 --> 00:38:48,741
You're willing to bet half
a million dollars on that?

539
00:38:48,882 --> 00:38:51,141
That is the question tonight, isn't it?

540
00:38:57,722 --> 00:39:00,381
OK. So, Harry, Pia, you
can't vote for Baden,

541
00:39:00,522 --> 00:39:02,141
which means you can only
vote for each other

542
00:39:02,282 --> 00:39:04,881
effectively cancelling each other out.

543
00:39:05,002 --> 00:39:08,581
So, Baden, it is your
vote that will decide

544
00:39:08,722 --> 00:39:12,241
who will be leaving this game and
become the final number of our jury.

545
00:39:16,042 --> 00:39:17,741
Baden,

546
00:39:17,842 --> 00:39:19,421
it is time to vote.

547
00:40:27,782 --> 00:40:29,421
I'll collect the vote.

548
00:40:50,722 --> 00:40:53,781
OK. Once the vote is read
the decision is final.

549
00:40:53,882 --> 00:40:55,321
The person voted out

550
00:40:55,462 --> 00:40:57,321
will be asked to leave the
tribal council area immediately.

551
00:40:57,402 --> 00:40:58,541
I'll read the vote.

552
00:41:04,262 --> 00:41:07,661
22nd person voted out
of Australian Survivor,

553
00:41:07,762 --> 00:41:09,661
final member of our jury...

554
00:41:14,062 --> 00:41:15,461
..Harry.

555
00:41:16,842 --> 00:41:18,221
You need to bring me your torch.

556
00:41:18,322 --> 00:41:20,461
Sorry, Harry.

557
00:41:20,602 --> 00:41:23,661
- Don't worry about it.
- It's been amazing, man.

558
00:41:25,122 --> 00:41:26,141
Harry.

559
00:41:29,482 --> 00:41:31,221
We'll see you soon, mate.

560
00:41:33,002 --> 00:41:34,101
Thank you.

561
00:41:39,862 --> 00:41:41,141
Oh! Do it.

562
00:41:43,222 --> 00:41:45,261
Harry, the tribe has spoken.

563
00:41:45,362 --> 00:41:46,621
They sure have.

564
00:41:49,002 --> 00:41:50,341
Time for you to go.

565
00:41:50,482 --> 00:41:53,021
It's been an absolute privilege
to play with all of you.

566
00:41:53,122 --> 00:41:55,581
Like, just an honour.

567
00:41:55,722 --> 00:41:57,861
- Can't wait to see you guys tomorrow.
- See you tomorrow.

568
00:41:58,002 --> 00:42:00,741
- That's exactly right, Harry.
- Give it your best.

569
00:42:04,222 --> 00:42:05,461
Dang.

570
00:42:08,482 --> 00:42:09,821
Well, congratulations.

571
00:42:09,922 --> 00:42:11,961
You are the final two.

572
00:42:13,082 --> 00:42:14,901
You've gone as far as
you can in this game,

573
00:42:15,042 --> 00:42:17,901
and now it's up to these guys, the jury.

574
00:42:19,042 --> 00:42:21,621
So, I suggest go back to
camp, get some rest...

575
00:42:22,802 --> 00:42:24,741
..and think about how you're
going to convince them

576
00:42:24,882 --> 00:42:27,021
that you deserve the
title of Sole Survivor

577
00:42:27,162 --> 00:42:28,781
and the half million that goes with it.

578
00:42:30,402 --> 00:42:32,341
Grab your torches, head on out.

579
00:42:32,442 --> 00:42:33,681
Goodnight.

580
00:43:08,621 --> 00:43:11,385
- Oh, my God, Baden.
- Right.

581
00:43:11,385 --> 00:43:13,344
- I can't believe we did it.
- Final day.

582
00:43:13,344 --> 00:43:14,933
- Look at us.
- Final day.

583
00:43:19,353 --> 00:43:22,242
That will do it. Day 50.

584
00:43:22,242 --> 00:43:24,275
- Pia.
- Final two.

585
00:43:24,275 --> 00:43:26,788
- Congratulations, mate.
- Congratulations, mate.

586
00:43:27,406 --> 00:43:30,205
50 days ago I'd never even built a fire,

587
00:43:30,306 --> 00:43:32,245
but here I am,

588
00:43:32,386 --> 00:43:35,365
one step away from
becoming Sole Survivor.

589
00:43:35,466 --> 00:43:37,285
That's overwhelming to me.

590
00:43:37,426 --> 00:43:40,685
I've been thinking about playing
this game for almost 20 years.

591
00:43:42,546 --> 00:43:45,285
It's my time to take this out.

592
00:43:45,426 --> 00:43:50,245
But also, how many people
get to be this close

593
00:43:50,346 --> 00:43:52,645
to winning half a million dollars?

594
00:43:52,786 --> 00:43:56,465
I mean, I'm not someone
who has a lot of money.

595
00:43:58,586 --> 00:44:01,485
Ever since my first big
role, Looking For Alibrandi,

596
00:44:01,626 --> 00:44:04,605
I've been lucky to work
a lot as an actor.

597
00:44:04,746 --> 00:44:07,525
But I still have to have other
jobs to support myself.

598
00:44:07,626 --> 00:44:08,805
I teach.

599
00:44:08,946 --> 00:44:11,725
This is a small industry
and I do it for the love.

600
00:44:13,906 --> 00:44:15,285
We're a normal Aussie family,

601
00:44:15,426 --> 00:44:18,925
we saved so hard to save
for a deposit for a house.

602
00:44:19,066 --> 00:44:21,565
If I won the money I'd
pay off my mortgage

603
00:44:21,666 --> 00:44:23,525
and have a better life for my kids.

604
00:44:25,946 --> 00:44:28,885
Tonight I'm going into the final tribal.

605
00:44:28,986 --> 00:44:30,485
I get to plead my case to the jury.

606
00:44:32,506 --> 00:44:33,725
If I nail it...

607
00:44:35,206 --> 00:44:38,825
..I could be going home and
changing my kids' lives.

608
00:44:43,646 --> 00:44:45,765
I see a box.

609
00:44:45,906 --> 00:44:48,205
- What is this?
- Oh, my God, Baden!

610
00:44:48,306 --> 00:44:49,485
Food!

611
00:44:49,586 --> 00:44:54,925
Oh, my God, there's bread and eggs.

612
00:44:56,586 --> 00:44:57,825
- Oh, my God.
- Mmm!

613
00:44:57,946 --> 00:45:00,045
I haven't had bread in so
long. Let's go smash it!

614
00:45:00,146 --> 00:45:01,285
Holy cow!

615
00:45:01,426 --> 00:45:03,005
- Oh, my God.
- We're going to be so full.

616
00:45:04,546 --> 00:45:06,765
- Oh, my God. Yummy.
- Yummy.

617
00:45:08,266 --> 00:45:10,205
Imagine how happy Harry
would be if he was here.

618
00:45:10,346 --> 00:45:13,125
Oh, he would be cooking up a feast, eh?

619
00:45:13,266 --> 00:45:15,285
Dammit, should have... No,
I shouldn't have kept him.

620
00:45:17,806 --> 00:45:19,005
Final two feast.

621
00:45:20,466 --> 00:45:22,765
That's a Survivor fan's dream. Isn't it?

622
00:45:24,186 --> 00:45:26,285
- Here's cheers, Pia.
- Cheers.

623
00:45:26,426 --> 00:45:28,045
- Is it OK?
- Mm!

624
00:45:30,866 --> 00:45:32,725
It means more than I can describe

625
00:45:32,866 --> 00:45:35,125
to be able to say that I
made it to the final day

626
00:45:35,266 --> 00:45:37,725
of Australian Survivor, that I
surpassed all these other people.

627
00:45:37,866 --> 00:45:39,825
Who would have thought
us two oddballs...

628
00:45:39,906 --> 00:45:40,906
I know.

629
00:45:40,966 --> 00:45:43,045
Think of the people
that were here, Baden.

630
00:45:43,186 --> 00:45:45,365
All the athletes, all the
strategic masterminds.

631
00:45:45,466 --> 00:45:46,825
We took them.

632
00:45:46,906 --> 00:45:48,765
I just have one more to go

633
00:45:48,906 --> 00:45:51,545
before I can claim the
title of Sole Survivor.

634
00:45:53,826 --> 00:45:56,565
Back in the real world I'm a PhD student

635
00:45:56,706 --> 00:46:00,165
who is introverted, shy,
cautious, risk averse.

636
00:46:00,306 --> 00:46:03,005
I always struggled socially growing up.

637
00:46:03,146 --> 00:46:06,045
I was terrified that one
day I might not belong.

638
00:46:07,566 --> 00:46:09,765
I came into this game
looking to have a shot

639
00:46:09,866 --> 00:46:11,685
and empower people like me.

640
00:46:11,826 --> 00:46:16,605
While Survivor has definitely
pushed me to my limits physically,

641
00:46:16,746 --> 00:46:20,685
I've had to be pushed more than
I've ever pushed myself socially.

642
00:46:22,446 --> 00:46:25,405
I feel like I've transformed.

643
00:46:25,546 --> 00:46:27,845
I've made good connections with people

644
00:46:27,986 --> 00:46:31,365
and used that to be
able to get to the end.

645
00:46:31,506 --> 00:46:33,905
This experience makes
me feel like I belong.

646
00:46:35,546 --> 00:46:38,125
I am the last Contender
left in this game.

647
00:46:39,906 --> 00:46:41,905
The nerds never get a chance
at something like this.

648
00:46:42,026 --> 00:46:44,805
I'm fighting to show that even
your nerdy, awkward person

649
00:46:44,946 --> 00:46:49,685
can come out here, play a social
game and win half a million dollars.

650
00:46:49,826 --> 00:46:52,965
I just need to convince the
jury I deserve the prize

651
00:46:53,066 --> 00:46:55,545
and the title more than Pia.

652
00:46:55,626 --> 00:46:57,565
It's a scary task.

653
00:46:57,706 --> 00:46:59,925
- I can't play for second.
- Nuh.

654
00:47:00,066 --> 00:47:03,125
And I feel like Harry's
game was just so good.

655
00:47:03,226 --> 00:47:04,325
Yeah.

656
00:47:04,466 --> 00:47:07,265
Building up a
resume of good moves,

657
00:47:07,346 --> 00:47:10,245
I made alliances, I made blindsides.

658
00:47:10,386 --> 00:47:14,285
Harry, I took him out because I
looked at his game and my game

659
00:47:14,426 --> 00:47:16,685
and went, "This is the scalp I need."

660
00:47:20,026 --> 00:47:23,445
I do worry that some of them
will see me as a "goat",

661
00:47:23,586 --> 00:47:26,405
someone who has been carried
to the end by others

662
00:47:26,546 --> 00:47:28,485
so that they can be
crushed in the final tribal.

663
00:47:30,286 --> 00:47:32,485
I need to sell the fact that
I've always been playing,

664
00:47:32,586 --> 00:47:34,265
I haven't just watched and waited,

665
00:47:34,386 --> 00:47:37,685
I've actually fought
really hard to be here.

666
00:47:43,386 --> 00:47:46,205
I don't like talking about
myself. I don't like bragging.

667
00:47:47,866 --> 00:47:50,925
But I'm looking tonight to
show that this transformation

668
00:47:51,066 --> 00:47:53,405
is not for nothing and
that to complete it,

669
00:47:53,546 --> 00:47:55,925
the title would be the
ultimate icing on the cake.

670
00:47:57,866 --> 00:48:00,085
- This is it, Pia, 50 days.
- Oh, my God.

671
00:48:00,226 --> 00:48:02,125
Do you know how long
I've wanted to do this?

672
00:48:04,366 --> 00:48:05,645
Goodbye, fire.

673
00:48:08,526 --> 00:48:10,085
Pink and blue.

674
00:48:10,226 --> 00:48:12,165
- One pink, one blue.
- Battle of the ages. Cheers.

675
00:48:12,266 --> 00:48:13,565
Cheers, Pia.

676
00:48:13,706 --> 00:48:16,525
Tonight, there's nine people in
the jury standing between me

677
00:48:16,626 --> 00:48:18,645
and me winning Sole Survivor.

678
00:48:23,666 --> 00:48:25,165
It's a tough pitch.

679
00:48:25,306 --> 00:48:27,165
Baden's got a lot of
friends on that jury

680
00:48:27,306 --> 00:48:30,265
and the only person I didn't
put on that jury was Janine.

681
00:48:31,466 --> 00:48:33,565
That's eight people who I've voted out.

682
00:48:33,706 --> 00:48:35,725
They could easily vote
for him instead of me

683
00:48:35,826 --> 00:48:37,925
because they feel hard done by.

684
00:48:39,106 --> 00:48:42,045
I don't know if it's going to be
a hostile jury or a friendly jury,

685
00:48:42,146 --> 00:48:44,445
but I just have to remind people

686
00:48:44,586 --> 00:48:47,085
that I've played harder
and I should win.

687
00:48:49,346 --> 00:48:51,285
This is more important than
anything I've ever done.

688
00:48:53,586 --> 00:48:55,565
This is the final fight

689
00:48:55,706 --> 00:48:58,365
and I'm ready to give the
performance of my life.

690
00:49:58,311 --> 00:50:00,410
We'll now bring in the
members of our jury.

691
00:50:07,351 --> 00:50:09,610
Shaun, David,

692
00:50:09,711 --> 00:50:11,970
John,

693
00:50:12,071 --> 00:50:13,490
Daisy...

694
00:50:14,651 --> 00:50:16,250
..Simon,

695
00:50:16,351 --> 00:50:17,890
Janine,

696
00:50:17,991 --> 00:50:20,210
Abbey,

697
00:50:20,311 --> 00:50:22,650
Luke and Harry.

698
00:50:22,751 --> 00:50:23,930
Harry!

699
00:50:24,031 --> 00:50:25,970
Voted out at the last tribal council.

700
00:50:33,071 --> 00:50:35,730
Pia, Baden, congratulations.

701
00:50:35,871 --> 00:50:38,930
You guys have gone as far
as you can go in the game.

702
00:50:39,071 --> 00:50:42,170
But tonight, the power
now shifts to the jury.

703
00:50:42,311 --> 00:50:45,290
Nine people you've had a hand
either directly or indirectly

704
00:50:45,391 --> 00:50:46,810
in voting out from this game

705
00:50:46,951 --> 00:50:49,650
will now decide which of
you two deserves the title

706
00:50:49,791 --> 00:50:52,930
of Sole Survivor and the half
million dollars that goes with it.

707
00:50:54,271 --> 00:50:57,770
Now, in a moment you'll each
make an opening statement.

708
00:50:57,911 --> 00:51:00,550
This is your chance to pitch to the jury

709
00:51:00,691 --> 00:51:03,290
why you think you
deserve to win this game.

710
00:51:03,391 --> 00:51:05,690
The jury will then address you.

711
00:51:05,831 --> 00:51:08,450
They'll ask you questions
and you'll answer them,

712
00:51:08,591 --> 00:51:11,910
and then they'll have a chance
to respond to your answers

713
00:51:11,991 --> 00:51:14,170
in an open forum.

714
00:51:14,271 --> 00:51:16,050
Once everyone's said their piece,

715
00:51:16,151 --> 00:51:18,450
the jury will then go up to vote

716
00:51:18,551 --> 00:51:21,090
to decide who will win this game.

717
00:51:22,171 --> 00:51:23,270
You guys ready?

718
00:51:25,591 --> 00:51:26,730
Yeah.

719
00:51:27,871 --> 00:51:29,090
Ready as I'll ever be.

720
00:51:30,291 --> 00:51:32,410
Baden, take it away.

721
00:51:37,511 --> 00:51:38,810
OK, here we go.

722
00:51:38,911 --> 00:51:39,970
Um...

723
00:51:43,391 --> 00:51:46,890
I came into this game as
someone who thought that

724
00:51:47,031 --> 00:51:49,650
applying for Survivor
was a terrifying thing.

725
00:51:49,751 --> 00:51:54,010
I came in super-awkward, super-shy.

726
00:51:56,351 --> 00:51:58,330
I couldn't be the challenge beast

727
00:51:58,471 --> 00:52:00,050
that somehow I got called at some point.

728
00:52:01,431 --> 00:52:04,770
I didn't want to be the orchestrator
of the big strategic moves.

729
00:52:06,631 --> 00:52:10,570
I knew that my best bet
was to play from the middle.

730
00:52:13,151 --> 00:52:16,330
Get into good relationships
with as many people as possible

731
00:52:16,471 --> 00:52:18,270
and hold as much information as I could.

732
00:52:20,071 --> 00:52:24,070
I knew what the plays were going
into every single tribal council.

733
00:52:27,451 --> 00:52:28,890
Just after tribe swap

734
00:52:29,031 --> 00:52:32,210
I could see the
Contenders' strong alliance

735
00:52:32,311 --> 00:52:33,810
was not going to last forever.

736
00:52:33,951 --> 00:52:37,090
I started to make inroads
with the Champions,

737
00:52:37,191 --> 00:52:38,530
and that started with Luke.

738
00:52:40,091 --> 00:52:41,890
Once you get to merge,

739
00:52:41,991 --> 00:52:44,890
I had the inroads with Luke and Dave

740
00:52:45,031 --> 00:52:48,630
so that I had access to some
information from the Champions,

741
00:52:48,751 --> 00:52:50,450
enough to keep myself
off the chopping block

742
00:52:50,551 --> 00:52:52,130
as the Contenders crumbled.

743
00:52:53,351 --> 00:52:57,630
In my mind, in this game, once you
get into the leader position

744
00:52:57,771 --> 00:53:00,210
you have a very short amount of time
before you're kicked out of it,

745
00:53:00,311 --> 00:53:01,450
normally out of the game entirely.

746
00:53:02,871 --> 00:53:05,850
So my goal was to get into
that position as late as possible

747
00:53:05,991 --> 00:53:09,130
and sit there at the end
with the power.

748
00:53:10,931 --> 00:53:13,130
And that's what I did
at the very final challenge.

749
00:53:14,291 --> 00:53:16,890
I knew that Harry would have
taken me to the final two

750
00:53:17,031 --> 00:53:19,850
and Pia would have taken me to
the final two, so why did I fight?

751
00:53:19,991 --> 00:53:23,370
Why didn't I just step down and save
myself the pain and the torture?

752
00:53:23,511 --> 00:53:25,370
I did it because I needed that scalp.

753
00:53:25,511 --> 00:53:28,490
I needed that big resume filler
at the end

754
00:53:28,631 --> 00:53:31,530
to finish off this game
and take control of the game

755
00:53:31,631 --> 00:53:32,770
right when it mattered most.

756
00:53:34,591 --> 00:53:37,530
I understand that you might see my
game as something as more passive...

757
00:53:39,431 --> 00:53:40,730
..but the moves are there,

758
00:53:40,871 --> 00:53:44,530
and the move to intentionally stay
in the middle from beginning to end

759
00:53:44,631 --> 00:53:46,010
is my claim to fame.

760
