00:53:47,731 --> 00:53:49,010
And I will own it tonight.

761
00:53:58,231 --> 00:53:59,290
Pia...

762
00:54:00,831 --> 00:54:02,490
..what would you like to say
to the jury?

763
00:54:05,031 --> 00:54:06,031
Hi.

764
00:54:09,971 --> 00:54:11,350
I came into this game

765
00:54:11,471 --> 00:54:13,610
knowing that I was going to play
a social game.

766
00:54:13,751 --> 00:54:15,570
You know, I wasn't going
to be the strongest,

767
00:54:15,711 --> 00:54:18,010
but I knew that what I wanted to do

768
00:54:18,151 --> 00:54:22,250
was be underestimated but
always be fiercely strategic.

769
00:54:23,591 --> 00:54:28,650
Unfortunately I was thrown into a
tribe of very accomplished athletes.

770
00:54:30,231 --> 00:54:33,890
Everyone wanted me out of there
because I wasn't athletic enough.

771
00:54:33,991 --> 00:54:36,530
I really had to play hard.

772
00:54:36,631 --> 00:54:38,450
I worked on Nova

773
00:54:38,591 --> 00:54:42,350
and she changed the vote to
Anastasia and it saved me.

774
00:54:42,491 --> 00:54:44,970
And then I really quickly
had to make alliances,

775
00:54:45,071 --> 00:54:46,530
so I made an alliance of four.

776
00:54:47,791 --> 00:54:51,810
And then we got Abbey and Roscoe
to switch to an alliance of six

777
00:54:51,911 --> 00:54:53,210
and we did dominate.

778
00:54:54,791 --> 00:54:58,130
We went to a tribe swap
and Janine became the Godmother

779
00:54:58,231 --> 00:55:00,130
and I became the Smiling Assassin.

780
00:55:01,831 --> 00:55:06,090
I went to a merge and we did
organise a blindside against Dave.

781
00:55:08,831 --> 00:55:11,610
When finally my alliance
did turn on me...

782
00:55:13,271 --> 00:55:14,810
..I knew that when people
were coming for me

783
00:55:14,951 --> 00:55:17,250
I wanted to have a buffer of
strong people around me,

784
00:55:17,351 --> 00:55:18,810
so they'd come for them first.

785
00:55:20,031 --> 00:55:21,850
That buffer worked

786
00:55:21,991 --> 00:55:24,250
because you came for Simon first
and then Janine.

787
00:55:25,911 --> 00:55:28,610
I put most of you on that jury
except for you, Janine.

788
00:55:29,751 --> 00:55:31,430
I did go to 20 tribal councils,

789
00:55:31,551 --> 00:55:35,330
my name only came up in four
and I was never under threat.

790
00:55:35,471 --> 00:55:38,330
I was always that slippery
little sucker that was there

791
00:55:38,471 --> 00:55:40,850
and you didn't know you needed
to get me until it was too late.

792
00:55:40,991 --> 00:55:45,250
As lovers of Survivor, I hope
that you will vote for the person

793
00:55:45,351 --> 00:55:46,890
who played the best strategic game,

794
00:55:47,031 --> 00:55:50,010
and I think we all know 100%
that that was me.

795
00:55:52,071 --> 00:55:55,290
To vote for me as Sole Survivor
could change my life,

796
00:55:55,391 --> 00:55:57,170
my family's life.

797
00:55:57,311 --> 00:56:01,930
It was a joy to play with you all
and I thank you.

798
00:56:02,031 --> 00:56:03,290
Thanks.

799
00:56:10,311 --> 00:56:12,650
Alright, jury, you've heard
their pitches.

800
00:56:12,751 --> 00:56:15,170
Now it's your turn to ask questions.

801
00:56:20,151 --> 00:56:22,370
Shaun, would you like to kick it off?

802
00:56:22,511 --> 00:56:24,110
- Guys.
- Hi.

803
00:56:24,251 --> 00:56:25,790
- Hey, Shaun.
- Congratulations.

804
00:56:25,911 --> 00:56:28,970
It's an amazing effort to go
50 days, you know, for anyone,

805
00:56:29,111 --> 00:56:31,730
let alone, I guess, an actress
and a PhD student

806
00:56:31,831 --> 00:56:33,370
who barely leaves his room.

807
00:56:35,191 --> 00:56:38,010
But with no bullshit, no digressing,

808
00:56:38,151 --> 00:56:42,250
I want to hear why you think the
other person doesn't deserve to win.

809
00:56:42,391 --> 00:56:44,230
And I think I'd like to start with Pia.

810
00:56:47,371 --> 00:56:51,010
Well, firstly, if you're looking
to vote for the person

811
00:56:51,151 --> 00:56:54,430
who had the best personal growth
and who learned how to make friends

812
00:56:54,611 --> 00:56:57,170
and had a good time out here, then you
absolutely should vote for Baden.

813
00:56:58,691 --> 00:56:59,970
But you cannot vote for Baden

814
00:57:00,111 --> 00:57:02,050
if you're voting for
the best strategic player.

815
00:57:05,231 --> 00:57:07,690
I don't think Baden played
a strategic game at all.

816
00:57:07,831 --> 00:57:11,650
I think he just sat next
to people who were really clever

817
00:57:11,791 --> 00:57:14,250
and they kept him around
because he was an easy person

818
00:57:14,351 --> 00:57:15,650
who would do what they said.

819
00:57:19,271 --> 00:57:22,850
I would counter that
by saying that in my mind

820
00:57:22,991 --> 00:57:25,970
your game has been you've worked
yourself into an alliance early on

821
00:57:26,111 --> 00:57:28,410
and you rode that alliance
until it faltered.

822
00:57:29,951 --> 00:57:31,890
You've been blindsided twice in a row

823
00:57:32,031 --> 00:57:33,610
and then you've been taken through
to the final...

824
00:57:33,751 --> 00:57:35,970
I wasn't blindsided twice. I knew
Janine was getting voted out.

825
00:57:37,331 --> 00:57:38,730
You only say that afterwards.

826
00:57:40,171 --> 00:57:42,090
Like, where's the evidence that...
No, I said it then.

827
00:57:42,191 --> 00:57:43,210
I said it then, that night.

828
00:57:43,351 --> 00:57:46,010
You said it that night,
that you knew that Janine was going?

829
00:57:46,151 --> 00:57:48,290
She actually said to me,
she turned to me and went,

830
00:57:48,431 --> 00:57:50,610
"Mate, we're screwed,
and it's probably you."

831
00:57:50,711 --> 00:57:56,530
Um...

832
00:57:58,031 --> 00:58:00,170
..sitting here with a jury
that probably has

833
00:58:00,311 --> 00:58:01,930
some of the biggest challenge threats

834
00:58:02,071 --> 00:58:05,570
and biggest strategic players
in the history of Survivor...

835
00:58:09,271 --> 00:58:11,810
..personally I both consider
you guys goats.

836
00:58:15,751 --> 00:58:19,150
I would like to hear the truth
on how you think your goat game

837
00:58:19,231 --> 00:58:21,850
was advantageous to you,

838
00:58:21,951 --> 00:58:23,810
and how did that get you to the end?

839
00:58:32,251 --> 00:58:33,810
A goat is someone who follows.

840
00:58:35,591 --> 00:58:37,010
I definitely didn't follow people.

841
00:58:38,591 --> 00:58:42,130
If you are calling me goat, like,
does me blindsiding you not count?

842
00:58:46,391 --> 00:58:47,930
The girls will back me up.

843
00:58:48,071 --> 00:58:50,510
Janine, Abbey and myself were
the ones who thought of it

844
00:58:50,631 --> 00:58:54,530
back at Contenders' camp where
Dave was gunning for Daisy.

845
00:58:55,971 --> 00:58:57,230
I told the girls, and I said,

846
00:58:57,351 --> 00:58:59,190
let's not wait to get you
before you got us.

847
00:59:00,691 --> 00:59:02,230
I worked on Johnno and Harry.

848
00:59:03,431 --> 00:59:06,230
So I had a really big hand
in voting Dave out,

849
00:59:06,311 --> 00:59:08,130
but I had to be careful

850
00:59:08,271 --> 00:59:11,690
because what happens when you
are at the forefront of moves?

851
00:59:11,791 --> 00:59:13,330
You get voted out.

852
00:59:14,471 --> 00:59:15,770
Dave,

853
00:59:15,911 --> 00:59:19,370
you need to know where to sit
and how to make big moves

854
00:59:19,511 --> 00:59:22,970
without being at the forefront
because this is Australian Survivor

855
00:59:23,111 --> 00:59:25,090
and it's very different
to American Survivor.

856
00:59:25,231 --> 00:59:28,810
And in Australia, if we see
someone taking control,

857
00:59:28,951 --> 00:59:30,650
you're going to end up
sitting on the jury.

858
00:59:30,751 --> 00:59:32,290
That's why you're there.

859
00:59:33,671 --> 00:59:37,230
Dave, what I did not do is sit
at the back of an alliance,

860
00:59:37,371 --> 00:59:39,250
at the bottom and
not make any decisions.

861
00:59:42,691 --> 00:59:43,691
I'm not a goat.

862
00:59:43,831 --> 00:59:45,690
I'm a hard-playing Survivor
and I deserve to be here.

863
00:59:48,991 --> 00:59:51,870
And you think that I just sat and watched
every decision be made and didn't...

864
00:59:52,011 --> 00:59:53,530
- I don't know your game well enough.
- OK.

865
00:59:56,711 --> 01:00:00,930
I've put my piece many times in
groups of how I want the vote to go.

866
01:00:01,031 --> 01:00:02,170
Sure.

867
01:00:05,691 --> 01:00:08,530
Um... I'm not a goat.

868
01:00:10,471 --> 01:00:12,250
I made moves. I...

869
01:00:14,951 --> 01:00:18,410
I looked at the people coming
into the endgame and I thought,

870
01:00:18,551 --> 01:00:22,370
"Who here do I have the best chance
of beating at the end?"

871
01:00:22,511 --> 01:00:24,010
You look at Abbey, she's
a challenge threat,

872
01:00:24,151 --> 01:00:26,690
she's played some great moves, she's
moved from alliances to alliances

873
01:00:26,831 --> 01:00:29,810
at the right time to
keep herself above water.

874
01:00:29,951 --> 01:00:32,170
Look at Luke, all the immunity
wins, idols and advantages

875
01:00:32,271 --> 01:00:33,610
all the strategy.

876
01:00:33,751 --> 01:00:35,930
And Look at Harry, he's also
played two idols perfectly

877
01:00:36,031 --> 01:00:38,450
and played an incredibly wily game.

878
01:00:40,391 --> 01:00:43,890
So I pegged my mark and
I said that... to myself

879
01:00:44,031 --> 01:00:46,770
that if I had the choice I
would want Pia at the end.

880
01:00:48,711 --> 01:00:50,890
But Baden, you didn't choose
to take me to the end,

881
01:00:51,031 --> 01:00:52,730
you chose to vote me out and not Abbey.

882
01:00:52,871 --> 01:00:55,610
So, clearly you wanted to take
Abbey to the end instead of me.

883
01:00:55,751 --> 01:00:57,130
Wait, when did I choose to vote you out?

884
01:01:00,611 --> 01:01:03,090
When Luke sent you away
from tribal council

885
01:01:03,231 --> 01:01:05,130
you were going to vote
my name, not Abbey,

886
01:01:05,271 --> 01:01:08,370
so clearly you didn't choose to take
me to the end from the beginning.

887
01:01:11,191 --> 01:01:12,690
So that's not true.

888
01:01:36,581 --> 01:01:39,400
I looked at the people
coming into the end game

889
01:01:39,581 --> 01:01:43,880
and I thought, "Who here do I have the
best chance of beating at the end?"

890
01:01:44,021 --> 01:01:48,160
So I pegged my mark and
I said that, to myself,

891
01:01:48,301 --> 01:01:52,040
that if I had the choice I
would want Pia at the end.

892
01:01:52,181 --> 01:01:54,440
But Baden, you didn't choose
to take me to the end,

893
01:01:54,581 --> 01:01:57,600
you chose to vote me out not
Abbey, so that's not true.

894
01:02:04,521 --> 01:02:06,560
Bay, I just would like
to ask you directly

895
01:02:06,701 --> 01:02:08,600
do you think you played
a good social game?

896
01:02:08,741 --> 01:02:10,760
Yes, absolutely, I played
a good social game.

897
01:02:10,901 --> 01:02:13,720
I made sure that I had good
relationships with everyone.

898
01:02:13,861 --> 01:02:17,300
I made sure that when it came
time to pick off Contenders

899
01:02:17,421 --> 01:02:20,300
that I was seen as someone
that you didn't wanna get rid of.

900
01:02:20,381 --> 01:02:23,480
I mean... My... I own my game.

901
01:02:23,581 --> 01:02:25,200
I played from the middle.

902
01:02:25,341 --> 01:02:28,320
Do you know how hard it is to manage
multiple alliances at the same time

903
01:02:28,461 --> 01:02:30,600
and stop them from both turning on you?

904
01:02:31,821 --> 01:02:36,000
There's a perception that I am
the person that you wanna take

905
01:02:36,141 --> 01:02:37,720
because I won't be able
to put up a good fight

906
01:02:37,861 --> 01:02:39,680
but I have... I'm
putting up a good fight.

907
01:02:39,781 --> 01:02:41,720
I think that I can take Pia,

908
01:02:41,821 --> 01:02:43,240
it's not a foregone conclusion here.

909
01:02:45,261 --> 01:02:48,680
I've had to move from alliance
to alliance from group to group,

910
01:02:48,821 --> 01:02:51,720
I didn't just ride one
alliance until it faltered.

911
01:02:53,741 --> 01:02:57,040
And I've managed to do it in a way
where it's gotten me to the end.

912
01:03:01,041 --> 01:03:03,440
I've gotta say, Pia...

913
01:03:03,581 --> 01:03:06,480
..as a social player, I think
you're a social superwoman.

914
01:03:06,581 --> 01:03:08,200
You are off the charts.

915
01:03:08,301 --> 01:03:09,920
Thank you.

916
01:03:11,221 --> 01:03:12,840
I was actually genuinely scared of you

917
01:03:12,981 --> 01:03:14,680
because I thought, "My God,
please don't target me

918
01:03:14,781 --> 01:03:16,920
"because you are seriously scary."

919
01:03:17,061 --> 01:03:20,120
I see you as the wolf
in goat's clothing.

920
01:03:22,681 --> 01:03:26,320
You were the reason why myself,
and I believe Abbey, got so far.

921
01:03:27,841 --> 01:03:29,380
You were ruthless.

922
01:03:29,521 --> 01:03:33,840
My question is can you please give
myself and this group some examples

923
01:03:34,021 --> 01:03:37,200
of where the Smiling Assassin really
convinced people they're safe.

924
01:03:41,181 --> 01:03:43,680
In the first half of the game,

925
01:03:43,821 --> 01:03:46,320
almost every single
person who I voted out

926
01:03:46,421 --> 01:03:47,720
thought I was their best friend

927
01:03:47,861 --> 01:03:49,320
and they came up to me
just before the vote

928
01:03:49,421 --> 01:03:50,840
and said, "Are you voting for me?"

929
01:03:50,981 --> 01:03:53,560
And I said, "Oh, my God, no,
never." And I voted them out.

930
01:03:57,001 --> 01:03:59,120
Like Susie, everyone, Nova...

931
01:03:59,221 --> 01:04:00,740
I mean, Nova was a big one,

932
01:04:00,861 --> 01:04:02,560
I sat there and had to
really make her happy

933
01:04:02,661 --> 01:04:04,520
just before we blindsided her.

934
01:04:04,661 --> 01:04:07,800
So I could have real
relationships with people

935
01:04:07,941 --> 01:04:10,680
but I had no problem in separating
my relationships with people

936
01:04:10,781 --> 01:04:12,440
and the game.

937
01:04:12,581 --> 01:04:16,020
I really did work on making sure
people who were getting blindsided

938
01:04:16,161 --> 01:04:17,880
didn't know they were
getting blindsided.

939
01:04:18,021 --> 01:04:19,740
I'll vouch for you on that too

940
01:04:19,861 --> 01:04:23,100
I think the conversation I had
before my blindside was, ah...

941
01:04:23,281 --> 01:04:26,920
Yeah, made me feel a little too... too
comfortable, unfortunately.

942
01:04:27,061 --> 01:04:29,160
Comfortable enough to
walk home with an idol.

943
01:04:29,301 --> 01:04:32,440
Yeah. It was, pretty, you
know, pretty big for me.

944
01:04:34,261 --> 01:04:35,740
Harry.

945
01:04:35,821 --> 01:04:38,320
OK...

946
01:04:38,421 --> 01:04:40,240
It's quite clear that...

947
01:04:40,381 --> 01:04:43,520
..to use the analogy of, like,
drivers and passengers,

948
01:04:43,661 --> 01:04:46,800
these two both, they're not
ever in the driver's seat

949
01:04:46,941 --> 01:04:50,380
but they're the person beside
them sort of navigating.

950
01:04:50,521 --> 01:04:53,760
The thing that I think is really
important from both of you

951
01:04:53,901 --> 01:04:57,100
is that there is a fine
line between navigator...

952
01:04:59,001 --> 01:05:00,120
..and passenger.

953
01:05:01,821 --> 01:05:04,760
And you're really gonna
have to articulate that.

954
01:05:07,341 --> 01:05:11,000
I have played a game where I
have controlled what people did.

955
01:05:11,141 --> 01:05:13,200
I'm whispering in people's
ears, making suggestions,

956
01:05:13,301 --> 01:05:14,840
steering them away from things.

957
01:05:14,941 --> 01:05:16,320
Like, when we coming into merge,

958
01:05:16,461 --> 01:05:19,440
I made sure that it was Dave who
was having the hate not Luke,

959
01:05:19,541 --> 01:05:21,160
because I was working with Luke

960
01:05:21,261 --> 01:05:23,320
and I pushed for that to be the case.

961
01:05:24,561 --> 01:05:26,320
I was a part of many moves.

962
01:05:26,461 --> 01:05:29,680
I never stepped into the driver's seat

963
01:05:29,821 --> 01:05:33,480
but I didn't get
blindsided once by a result.

964
01:05:33,621 --> 01:05:38,120
And I don't think that Pia can
say that, in complete truth.

965
01:05:38,261 --> 01:05:40,600
- No, I definitely got blindsided.
- Yeah, exactly.

966
01:05:40,741 --> 01:05:44,520
And then, at the end, you've not been
able to make the ultimate choice

967
01:05:44,621 --> 01:05:46,100
about who to take with you.

968
01:05:48,101 --> 01:05:51,040
Sure. But I didn't magically
appear here tonight.

969
01:05:51,181 --> 01:05:53,360
- No, I'm not saying that.
- I'm here because I played hard,

970
01:05:53,501 --> 01:05:55,880
because when my alliance
faltered, I knew it was coming

971
01:05:55,981 --> 01:05:57,360
and I worked out how to save myself.

972
01:05:58,861 --> 01:06:00,800
Having an alliance is not a weakness,

973
01:06:00,941 --> 01:06:02,920
sticking with your alliance
is not a weakness.

974
01:06:03,061 --> 01:06:05,600
Making big decisions at the
forefront of your alliance

975
01:06:05,701 --> 01:06:07,200
is not a weakness.

976
01:06:07,301 --> 01:06:10,240
I had to work out how to be strong,

977
01:06:10,381 --> 01:06:11,800
how to be on the right side of votes,

978
01:06:11,941 --> 01:06:14,680
how to manipulate votes without
people knowing I was doing it

979
01:06:14,821 --> 01:06:18,200
and how to get people on the jury
without getting a target on my back.

980
01:06:19,821 --> 01:06:23,240
I've worked with each and every
one of you on at least one vote

981
01:06:23,341 --> 01:06:25,680
whether directly or indirectly.

982
01:06:25,821 --> 01:06:29,680
My game was about
sitting in the position

983
01:06:29,781 --> 01:06:31,880
where I had access to information.

984
01:06:32,021 --> 01:06:35,240
I worked with alliances that
were working really well

985
01:06:35,381 --> 01:06:38,920
and my alliances rallied
and we dominated.

986
01:06:39,061 --> 01:06:43,460
But I think my game was something
that was enjoyable to be around.

987
01:06:43,601 --> 01:06:47,240
I was someone who was
willing to vote anyone out.

988
01:06:47,381 --> 01:06:50,120
I would do it with a smile on my face

989
01:06:50,261 --> 01:06:52,040
if it meant that I would get further.

990
01:07:00,341 --> 01:07:01,680
John.

991
01:07:03,821 --> 01:07:07,040
We all came into the
game with a strategy,

992
01:07:07,181 --> 01:07:09,600
be the beast, social
or strategy, whatever.

993
01:07:10,981 --> 01:07:15,180
How did your social game make
you have to adapt throughout?

994
01:07:17,941 --> 01:07:21,320
I've gone from being
this awkward shy person

995
01:07:21,421 --> 01:07:23,200
to someone who's played a game

996
01:07:23,341 --> 01:07:26,720
where people have not
wanted to get rid of me.

997
01:07:27,861 --> 01:07:29,880
I've changed in this game.

998
01:07:31,201 --> 01:07:33,520
I'm here, not just for me,

999
01:07:33,661 --> 01:07:37,120
but people like me who feel that
they're a bit introverted or shy

1000
01:07:37,261 --> 01:07:40,180
and now I'm here, pleading
my case to you guys.

1001
01:07:41,541 --> 01:07:45,760
I've played an ultimate game
of sitting right in the middle.

1002
01:07:48,781 --> 01:07:51,180
I was seen as someone
who was more malleable,

1003
01:07:51,301 --> 01:07:52,820
more able to be worked
on than the others.

1004
01:07:53,981 --> 01:07:56,760
To get to the end, you need to know
when the time is right to strike

1005
01:07:56,861 --> 01:07:58,600
and when the time is right to hold.

1006
01:08:00,101 --> 01:08:02,960
And I made sure that I struck at
the time at the end of the game

1007
01:08:03,101 --> 01:08:05,040
so that there wasn't a
chance to be picked off.

1008
01:08:10,521 --> 01:08:12,180
Alright, Luke,

1009
01:08:12,261 --> 01:08:14,000
it's gonna be lucky last.

1010
01:08:15,221 --> 01:08:16,840
Do you have a question?

1011
01:08:21,781 --> 01:08:23,800
I'll just go to P...

1012
01:08:23,941 --> 01:08:28,840
ah, look, I like to think that I
helped save you twice in the game.

1013
01:08:30,341 --> 01:08:33,120
It's obviously got to,
like, where you are now.

1014
01:08:34,561 --> 01:08:37,560
I would've loved to have
that favour repaid.

1015
01:08:40,441 --> 01:08:41,640
It wasn't.

1016
01:08:44,141 --> 01:08:46,240
Why should I give you my vote?

1017
01:08:53,921 --> 01:08:55,280
Luke...

1018
01:08:58,421 --> 01:09:02,040
..voting you out was one of
the hardest things I had to do

1019
01:09:02,141 --> 01:09:03,840
because I know we've spoken about

1020
01:09:03,981 --> 01:09:06,200
how much we wanted to
win this for our families

1021
01:09:06,301 --> 01:09:09,600
and I will never get over...

1022
01:09:09,741 --> 01:09:11,920
..having to take that
dream away from you.

1023
01:09:13,381 --> 01:09:16,760
Last night, when I was standing on that
podium for 6 hours and 40 minutes,

1024
01:09:16,901 --> 01:09:21,280
I wasn't doing it so that
I could break a record,

1025
01:09:21,381 --> 01:09:23,600
I was doing it so that...

1026
01:09:23,741 --> 01:09:26,240
..if I took away your chance to be here,

1027
01:09:26,381 --> 01:09:29,000
I was gonna make damn sure
that I was here instead.

1028
01:09:30,501 --> 01:09:33,960
Because I didn't want voting
you out to be futile.

1029
01:09:35,921 --> 01:09:38,760
As much as I love working with
Harry I knew that if Harry won,

1030
01:09:38,861 --> 01:09:40,640
I was not gonna be sitting here

1031
01:09:40,781 --> 01:09:43,560
so I was ready to die up on that thing.

1032
01:09:46,281 --> 01:09:49,260
I think I played a great game.

1033
01:09:49,341 --> 01:09:51,040
I didn't have the best physical game

1034
01:09:51,181 --> 01:09:55,320
but in every single challenge, I
pushed myself to the absolute limits

1035
01:09:55,461 --> 01:09:59,040
to help my team, to be a good teammate.

1036
01:10:00,521 --> 01:10:02,200
Yes, I voted some of you out...

1037
01:10:03,461 --> 01:10:05,720
..but my game was a
really good social game,

1038
01:10:05,821 --> 01:10:07,080
it was a strategic game.

1039
01:10:07,221 --> 01:10:09,160
I certainly wasn't someone
who was sitting around,

1040
01:10:09,301 --> 01:10:11,040
waiting for people to
tell me what to do.

1041
01:10:11,181 --> 01:10:13,680
I was always at the forefront
of making decisions.

1042
01:10:15,701 --> 01:10:19,160
Just because I wasn't playing
a big game that was out there,

1043
01:10:19,301 --> 01:10:22,040
doesn't mean I wasn't
playing a big game.

1044
01:10:24,141 --> 01:10:26,360
I just wasn't stupid enough
to let everyone know

1045
01:10:26,461 --> 01:10:28,320
because I didn't wanna get voted out.

1046
01:10:30,221 --> 01:10:31,900
And that's why I'm sitting here.

1047
01:10:35,161 --> 01:10:36,800
Well said.

1048
01:10:39,441 --> 01:10:40,520
Mm.

1049
01:10:45,461 --> 01:10:48,400
Alright, guys, well, you
should have enough information

1050
01:10:48,541 --> 01:10:51,400
to decide who deserves the
title of Sole Survivor

1051
01:10:51,541 --> 01:10:53,080
and the half million that goes with it.

1052
01:10:55,701 --> 01:10:58,720
Remember, tonight, you
are voting for a winner.

1053
01:11:00,921 --> 01:11:03,760
For the last time, it is time to vote.

1054
01:11:31,769 --> 01:11:33,588
OK, guys,

1055
01:11:33,729 --> 01:11:35,508
you should have enough information now

1056
01:11:35,649 --> 01:11:38,068
to decide who deserves the
title of Sole Survivor

1057
01:11:38,209 --> 01:11:39,548
and the half million that goes with it.

1058
01:11:42,069 --> 01:11:44,908
Remember, tonight, you
are voting for a winner.

1059
01:11:47,169 --> 01:11:50,268
For the last time, it is time to vote.

1060
01:11:51,929 --> 01:11:53,308
Shaun, you're up.

1061
01:13:11,789 --> 01:13:12,868
Good.

1062
01:13:30,149 --> 01:13:32,068
I'll go count the votes.

1063
01:13:51,869 --> 01:13:55,228
Guys, it's been an incredible season,

1064
01:13:55,369 --> 01:13:58,988
the only thing left to
do, Pia and Baden...

1065
01:13:59,089 --> 01:14:00,428
..is to read the votes.

1066
01:14:02,489 --> 01:14:06,708
But, a moment like this should be
shared with people you love the most.

1067
01:14:06,809 --> 01:14:07,828
Oh!

1068
01:14:09,469 --> 01:14:10,908
Come on in, guys.

1069
01:14:13,949 --> 01:14:16,128
Oh, my God, it's Lily.

1070
01:14:18,569 --> 01:14:20,428
Hello!

1071
01:14:20,529 --> 01:14:28,529
Hello.

1072
01:14:41,029 --> 01:14:43,028
Say hi to my friends.

1073
01:14:43,129 --> 01:14:44,348
Hello.

1074
01:14:45,949 --> 01:14:47,488
Say hi, Jamesy.

1075
01:14:55,089 --> 01:14:57,388
I can't believe that I'm here.

1076
01:14:57,489 --> 01:14:59,268
Can't believe this is happening.

1077
01:15:02,329 --> 01:15:06,988
Karen, how proud are you
of Baden right now?

1078
01:15:07,129 --> 01:15:09,868
- Extremely proud.
- Oh, Mum.

1079
01:15:10,009 --> 01:15:12,148
Especially after what
I watched last night.

1080
01:15:12,249 --> 01:15:16,708
What does it mean to see him
standing here on Day 50?

1081
01:15:16,849 --> 01:15:19,188
He's a changed person.

1082
01:15:19,289 --> 01:15:22,868
More confident, talking a lot more.

1083
01:15:24,969 --> 01:15:27,228
Even full of a bit of sass, last night.

1084
01:15:27,369 --> 01:15:29,388
Yeah.

1085
01:15:29,529 --> 01:15:31,628
I'm lost for words at the
moment, though. Jeez.

1086
01:15:34,749 --> 01:15:36,308
So Luke,

1087
01:15:36,449 --> 01:15:39,488
you think Pia deserves
to take this one out?

1088
01:15:41,209 --> 01:15:42,428
She...

1089
01:15:42,569 --> 01:15:45,308
I don't know, it's in the
hands of the jury, I guess.

1090
01:15:45,449 --> 01:15:49,588
Certainly... I'm just amazed
by everything she's achieved.

1091
01:15:52,409 --> 01:15:55,208
I can't get any prouder
of her at this point.

1092
01:15:55,289 --> 01:15:56,848
This is, to me, an affirmation

1093
01:15:56,969 --> 01:15:59,868
of everything that I've always
thought she's capable of.

1094
01:16:11,789 --> 01:16:15,348
Alright, guys, remember,
these votes are for a win.

1095
01:16:18,369 --> 01:16:20,268
I'm gonna read the votes.

1096
01:16:30,469 --> 01:16:32,108
First vote...

1097
01:16:32,209 --> 01:16:33,308
..Pia.

1098
01:16:44,969 --> 01:16:47,228
Pia. That's two votes Pia.

1099
01:16:55,369 --> 01:16:57,508
Pia. That's three votes Pia.

1100
01:17:07,649 --> 01:17:10,228
Pia. That's four votes Pia.

1101
01:17:27,549 --> 01:17:30,708
Winner of Australian Survivor, Pia.

1102
01:17:34,889 --> 01:17:37,068
Oh, Pia!

1103
01:17:38,209 --> 01:17:41,748
Wow! Oh, my God, Pia.

1104
01:17:41,849 --> 01:17:43,588
That was amazing.

1105
01:17:47,669 --> 01:17:48,788
Oh, my God!

1106
01:17:51,169 --> 01:17:52,948
Thank you, guys!

1107
01:17:54,529 --> 01:17:57,148
I gave it my best shot.

1108
01:17:57,249 --> 01:17:59,308
The dream.

1109
01:17:59,409 --> 01:18:01,068
She deserves it.

1110
01:18:04,249 --> 01:18:06,868
Your mum is incredible. Yeah?

1111
01:18:06,969 --> 01:18:08,348
Pia?

1112
01:18:08,449 --> 01:18:10,428
Here's your cheque.

1113
01:18:10,569 --> 01:18:15,628
Congratulations, you are
Australia's Sole Survivor 2019.

1114
01:18:21,729 --> 01:18:23,388
Go, Pia.

1115
01:18:27,669 --> 01:18:30,988
I can't believe I won Survivor!

1116
01:18:35,829 --> 01:18:36,948
I'm overwhelmed.

1117
01:18:37,089 --> 01:18:41,548
I just paid off my mortgage in
seven traumatising weeks.

1118
01:18:41,689 --> 01:18:44,288
Your mummy did such a great job.

1119
01:18:44,369 --> 01:18:46,068
My kids love Survivor

1120
01:18:46,209 --> 01:18:48,548
so to have them there
to see their mum win,

1121
01:18:48,689 --> 01:18:51,388
I'm so grateful that they
could share it with me.

1122
01:18:51,529 --> 01:18:55,708
This was the most amazing
experience in my life.

1123
01:18:55,809 --> 01:18:58,428
This is my friend Dave. Say hi.

1124
01:18:58,529 --> 01:19:00,388
I'm bonded with those people for life

1125
01:19:00,529 --> 01:19:03,868
and I've come away from
this a better person.

1126
01:19:03,969 --> 01:19:07,108
High five. Yee, boy!

1127
01:19:07,249 --> 01:19:09,648
Playing Survivor was a lifelong dream.

1128
01:19:09,769 --> 01:19:13,008
I always said that I was gonna
be first person voted out

1129
01:19:13,129 --> 01:19:16,388
or I would win and I
actually won!

1130
01:19:23,649 --> 01:19:27,648
Well, we went looking for Alibrandi
but I think we found Scarface.

1131
01:19:30,289 --> 01:19:33,908
You, for me, are the winner
of Sole Survivor in 2019.

1132
01:19:34,009 --> 01:19:35,348
Congratulations on that pitch.

1133
01:19:35,489 --> 01:19:37,708
I thought it was brilliant
so you've got my vote.

1134
01:19:37,849 --> 01:19:40,648
Your pitch has definitely
won it for me tonight.

1135
01:19:40,769 --> 01:19:43,508
I think you played a
great understated game.

1136
01:19:47,649 --> 01:19:51,288
Pia, wow, you played a
magnificent social game.

1137
01:19:51,369 --> 01:19:53,428
You surprised me big-time tonight.

1138
01:19:53,569 --> 01:19:55,148
I think you played a very subtle game,

1139
01:19:55,249 --> 01:19:57,228
um, I don't think you're a goat.

1140
01:19:57,329 --> 01:19:59,028
Congratulations, Pia.

1141
01:19:59,169 --> 01:20:02,308
I hope you enjoy the
title of Sole Survivor

1142
01:20:02,409 --> 01:20:03,788
'cause you've earnt it.

1143
01:20:03,929 --> 01:20:06,908
I have loved, loved, loved
playing this game with you.

1144
01:20:07,049 --> 01:20:10,508
You deserve it, you're
an amazing player.

1145
01:20:10,649 --> 01:20:13,648
You owe me dinner and a
night out with my family.

1146
01:20:13,729 --> 01:20:15,268
Alright.



## S07E24

1
00:00:00,000 --> 00:00:04,162
WWW.MY-SUBS.CO

﻿1
00:00:04,406 --> 00:00:08,105
It began with 24 All Stars...

2
00:00:08,206 --> 00:00:09,865
It's the best of the best.

3
00:00:09,966 --> 00:00:11,785
..ready to outwit...

4
00:00:11,926 --> 00:00:14,425
I'm 10 times stronger
going into All Stars

5
00:00:14,526 --> 00:00:16,425
than I was the first time.

6
00:00:16,526 --> 00:00:18,145
..outplay...

7
00:00:18,286 --> 00:00:20,145
I'm going in this
time with vengeance.

8
00:00:20,286 --> 00:00:22,145
I'm not gonna make the
same mistakes again.

9
00:00:22,246 --> 00:00:23,325
..and...

10
00:00:23,406 --> 00:00:24,865
Survivors, ready...

11
00:00:24,966 --> 00:00:26,465
..outlast...

12
00:00:26,566 --> 00:00:27,685
Push! Come on!

13
00:00:27,766 --> 00:00:29,865
..the best of the best...

14
00:00:29,966 --> 00:00:31,385
Go, Lydia!

15
00:00:31,526 --> 00:00:36,745
..in the greatest game of
Australian Survivor ever seen.

16
00:00:36,886 --> 00:00:39,965
Brooke wins individual immunity again!

17
00:00:41,306 --> 00:00:43,065
History has been made...

18
00:00:43,206 --> 00:00:45,685
I got two idols and
the immunity necklace.

19
00:00:45,806 --> 00:00:47,745
No one man should have all this power.

20
00:00:47,846 --> 00:00:50,065
..through the most loyal alliances...

21
00:00:50,206 --> 00:00:52,145
It's us three through to merge and on.

22
00:00:52,246 --> 00:00:53,265
To the end.

23
00:00:53,366 --> 00:00:55,105
..and...

24
00:00:55,206 --> 00:00:58,685
I'll, uh, play it for Jacqui.

25
00:00:59,786 --> 00:01:01,865
..spectacular blindsides.

26
00:01:01,966 --> 00:01:03,105
Daisy.

27
00:01:04,486 --> 00:01:06,065
Abbey.

28
00:01:07,226 --> 00:01:09,865
Phoebe.

29
00:01:09,966 --> 00:01:11,585
Flick.

30
00:01:12,666 --> 00:01:14,065
Locky.

31
00:01:15,406 --> 00:01:18,105
One by one, they were voted out...

32
00:01:20,126 --> 00:01:24,225
..and now three allies
must go it alone.

33
00:01:25,386 --> 00:01:26,625
Moana.

34
00:01:26,766 --> 00:01:29,185
People thought I was
this quiet girl in the shelter.

35
00:01:29,286 --> 00:01:31,185
This is not by accident.

36
00:01:31,286 --> 00:01:32,825
But I've come this far

37
00:01:32,966 --> 00:01:36,345
and I'm not ready
to give it up for anything.

38
00:01:37,486 --> 00:01:38,545
David.

39
00:01:38,686 --> 00:01:40,785
I've been controlling
this game since day one.

40
00:01:40,926 --> 00:01:43,185
I know what's on the line.
I know what's at stake.

41
00:01:43,286 --> 00:01:45,185
And it's so close, I can taste it.

42
00:01:46,426 --> 00:01:47,905
Sharn.

43
00:01:48,046 --> 00:01:51,105
I'm not gonna let anything
stand in my way this time.

44
00:01:51,246 --> 00:01:53,705
I'm coming for it.
I'm gonna take it. I'm gonna win.

45
00:01:56,286 --> 00:01:58,865
Three All Stars

46
00:01:58,966 --> 00:02:00,825
worthy of the title.

47
00:02:02,166 --> 00:02:07,045
Tonight one will be crowned
Sole Survivor.

48
00:03:39,506 --> 00:03:41,065
I've made final three.

49
00:03:43,286 --> 00:03:46,385
I keep pinching myself,
like, "Wake up, man."

50
00:03:46,486 --> 00:03:48,345
And I'm waking up and I'm here!

51
00:03:50,586 --> 00:03:51,985
Last time I played,

52
00:03:52,126 --> 00:03:55,705
I wanted to make the biggest,
the craziest moves possible.

53
00:03:55,806 --> 00:03:57,545
I'm a Golden God right now.

54
00:03:57,646 --> 00:04:00,065
A Golden God. I am a Golden God.

55
00:04:00,166 --> 00:04:02,545
And I let my ego get away from me...

56
00:04:02,646 --> 00:04:03,945
David.

57
00:04:04,086 --> 00:04:06,345
..and I went home
with an idol in my pocket.

58
00:04:07,646 --> 00:04:11,665
Because of that, I've played
a very different game this time.

59
00:04:13,726 --> 00:04:15,225
I've evolved.

60
00:04:16,526 --> 00:04:18,185
I wanted to make bold moves,

61
00:04:18,326 --> 00:04:21,545
but I also wanted to make
genuine relationships.

62
00:04:21,646 --> 00:04:23,425
And because of that,

63
00:04:23,566 --> 00:04:26,025
I've been a part
of the strongest alliance

64
00:04:26,166 --> 00:04:27,905
that Australian Survivor's ever seen.

65
00:04:34,686 --> 00:04:37,545
I have an immense respect
for Mo and Sharn.

66
00:04:39,026 --> 00:04:41,265
They've both played huge games.

67
00:04:43,046 --> 00:04:47,545
These women are two of
the strongest, toughest women

68
00:04:47,646 --> 00:04:49,945
I've ever met in my life.

69
00:04:51,166 --> 00:04:53,385
They're my Survivor family now.

70
00:04:54,526 --> 00:04:56,785
But I have a real family,

71
00:04:56,926 --> 00:04:59,125
and that's who
I'm actually playing for.

72
00:04:59,266 --> 00:05:03,665
I have to keep telling myself I'm
doing this for my kids, for my wife.

73
00:05:09,306 --> 00:05:11,385
If I win that Sole Survivor title,

74
00:05:11,526 --> 00:05:15,785
I want to move back to Australia
to bring me closer to my sons...

75
00:05:17,126 --> 00:05:19,665
..to reunite my daughter
with her brothers...

76
00:05:21,186 --> 00:05:24,105
..to make sure we can be as one

77
00:05:24,246 --> 00:05:27,545
and as whole as we possibly can when
you're living with a split family.

78
00:05:29,206 --> 00:05:31,145
This money would
give me the chance to do that.

79
00:05:33,746 --> 00:05:35,485
And this is it for me.

80
00:05:37,086 --> 00:05:39,665
I just have to last
one more day in this game

81
00:05:39,766 --> 00:05:41,545
and one more win

82
00:05:41,646 --> 00:05:43,705
and all my dreams come true.

83
00:05:53,006 --> 00:05:54,686
Winning the final
Immunity Challenge

84
00:05:54,726 --> 00:05:57,205
is the most important challenge
of the whole game.

85
00:05:57,346 --> 00:06:00,265
You get the choice who
sits next to you in that final two.

86
00:06:01,646 --> 00:06:03,766
One of the great things
about having a strong alliance

87
00:06:03,806 --> 00:06:06,585
is that it enables you
to get to this end of the game.

88
00:06:06,726 --> 00:06:09,265
But the alliance
is gonna break tonight.

89
00:06:09,406 --> 00:06:14,225
Only two of us are gonna get a shot
at half a million dollars.

90
00:06:14,366 --> 00:06:16,905
The fact that I have been
at the final three,

91
00:06:17,006 --> 00:06:18,905
not only once, but twice,

92
00:06:19,046 --> 00:06:21,905
just shows that
I know how to play this game.

93
00:06:22,006 --> 00:06:24,665
Shane, Sharn,

94
00:06:24,806 --> 00:06:27,945
one of you
is about to be crowned Sole Survivor

95
00:06:28,086 --> 00:06:31,345
and walk away
with half a million dollars.

96
00:06:31,486 --> 00:06:35,265
I have been so close to the title
that it hurts.

97
00:06:35,366 --> 00:06:36,985
Winner of Australian Survivor...

98
00:06:37,086 --> 00:06:38,086
..Shane!

99
00:06:40,166 --> 00:06:41,925
I lost by one vote,

100
00:06:42,006 --> 00:06:43,785
and that is heartbreaking.

101
00:06:45,046 --> 00:06:47,785
But one thing I pride myself on
is being resilient

102
00:06:47,926 --> 00:06:51,025
and being able to move past things
in life, so I did that.

103
00:06:56,926 --> 00:07:00,265
I moved past the fact
that it slipped through my fingers.

104
00:07:01,766 --> 00:07:05,625
Now is the time for me
to rewrite my Survivor history.

105
00:07:09,366 --> 00:07:11,065
Coming into Survivor the second time,

106
00:07:11,166 --> 00:07:13,425
I had a huge target on my back.

107
00:07:13,566 --> 00:07:17,105
So, my plan
was to be aggressively covert,

108
00:07:17,246 --> 00:07:19,305
play both sides, and that's what I did.

109
00:07:20,866 --> 00:07:23,505
I've deliberately
set myself up in this game

110
00:07:23,646 --> 00:07:26,625
as being someone that can go unnoticed,

111
00:07:26,726 --> 00:07:28,705
even though I'm a huge player.

112
00:07:30,226 --> 00:07:32,585
I dreamt of winning
the first time around.

113
00:07:32,686 --> 00:07:34,385
I want this the second time.

114
00:07:34,526 --> 00:07:36,925
This was my dream.
It's been my dream for so long.

115
00:07:37,046 --> 00:07:41,345
So, I'm not gonna let anything
stand in my way this time.

116
00:07:41,486 --> 00:07:43,785
I'm coming for it.
I'm gonna take it.

117
00:07:43,886 --> 00:07:45,665
I'm gonna win.

118
00:08:02,926 --> 00:08:04,925
I've never felt so sick before.

119
00:08:06,446 --> 00:08:10,505
I've tried
and I've tried to push through.

120
00:08:11,866 --> 00:08:14,285
Last time I played Australian Survivor,

121
00:08:14,406 --> 00:08:18,745
I had to leave the game at day 16
because of health reasons.

122
00:08:20,306 --> 00:08:23,705
Oh, man, it takes guts to sort of
come in here just to start off

123
00:08:23,846 --> 00:08:27,065
but to try and tough it out
the way you have... yeah.

124
00:08:27,206 --> 00:08:29,705
You've done an amazing job.
You're making me cry. Don't cry.

125
00:08:31,926 --> 00:08:34,925
Moana, the tribe has spoken.

126
00:08:38,006 --> 00:08:42,425
So, coming back, for me,
was finishing what I started...

127
00:08:46,626 --> 00:08:48,385
..picking up where I left off...

128
00:08:49,986 --> 00:08:52,065
..proving everyone wrong.

129
00:08:53,406 --> 00:08:57,825
I planned to come in here
and play a quiet, strategic game

130
00:08:57,966 --> 00:09:00,425
because I knew there was
gonna be loud game players.

131
00:09:00,566 --> 00:09:02,825
And I just don't want to be
another loud game player.

132
00:09:02,926 --> 00:09:04,385
I wanted to be me...

133
00:09:06,486 --> 00:09:09,465
..which is quiet, sneaky,
a little bit cheeky.

134
00:09:11,306 --> 00:09:13,225
While everyone was strategising early,

135
00:09:13,366 --> 00:09:16,345
I was focused on building strong
and loyal relationships.

136
00:09:16,486 --> 00:09:20,505
People came to ME with information
while I called the shots.

137
00:09:20,646 --> 00:09:23,065
People wanted to protect me
AND work with me

138
00:09:23,206 --> 00:09:26,065
because they wanted the safety
of the loyal alliance that I built.

139
00:09:29,006 --> 00:09:31,505
I didn't come back
just to give it a shot.

140
00:09:31,606 --> 00:09:33,905
I'm back to win.

141
00:09:34,046 --> 00:09:36,885
I've sacrificed more than
you can possibly imagine to be here.

142
00:09:38,166 --> 00:09:40,465
I look after my entire family.

143
00:09:40,606 --> 00:09:43,745
I take care of my mum, who's very ill.

144
00:09:43,886 --> 00:09:47,365
And I'm full-time carer of
my beautiful disabled sister, Vinny.

145
00:09:50,846 --> 00:09:55,025
The last 49 days, I could be at home
taking care of everybody.

146
00:09:55,166 --> 00:09:57,665
But I know that they want me
to give this everything.

147
00:10:00,026 --> 00:10:02,025
And that's why I'm
here, I'm here for them.

148
00:10:04,726 --> 00:10:08,025
A half a million dollars
would be life-changing.

149
00:10:08,166 --> 00:10:11,065
The only thing left standing in the
way of me being the Sole Survivor

150
00:10:11,166 --> 00:10:13,505
is one challenge.

151
00:10:13,606 --> 00:10:17,105
And... I'm ready to take that on.

152
00:10:24,886 --> 00:10:28,025
Sharn, myself and
Mo have a great friendship.

153
00:10:28,126 --> 00:10:30,025
But...

154
00:10:30,166 --> 00:10:34,225
..I know there's a big chance that,
one of them wins this challenge,

155
00:10:34,366 --> 00:10:36,705
they'll take the other
one to final Tribal.

156
00:10:37,886 --> 00:10:40,365
So this final Immunity
Challenge is do or die for me.

157
00:10:43,526 --> 00:10:47,725
$500,000 and the title of Sole Survivor

158
00:10:47,846 --> 00:10:50,905
looming on the back of my
performance in this challenge.

159
00:10:52,406 --> 00:10:55,225
The pressure is immense.

160
00:10:55,326 --> 00:10:57,365
Pressure makes diamonds, baby.

161
00:10:58,486 --> 00:11:02,545
And I plan to give it everything
today, absolutely everything.

162
00:11:07,066 --> 00:11:08,725
That looks epic.

163
00:11:10,206 --> 00:11:13,905
First of all, congratulations
on making it to day 49.

164
00:11:14,046 --> 00:11:16,905
Getting this far in Survivor
is no easy feat.

165
00:11:17,046 --> 00:11:18,785
But to do it in a season of All Stars,

166
00:11:18,886 --> 00:11:20,725
that is a hell of an achievement.

167
00:11:20,846 --> 00:11:22,365
Well done.
Thanks, Jonathan.

168
00:11:23,926 --> 00:11:26,725
Now, the only thing
standing between you and day 50

169
00:11:26,806 --> 00:11:28,305
is one more challenge.

170
00:11:28,446 --> 00:11:30,521
You guys ready to get to
the final Immunity Challenge?

171
00:11:30,526 --> 00:11:31,526
Yes, we are.

172
00:11:31,606 --> 00:11:33,085
Yeah, boy.
Yes, sir, we sure are.

173
00:11:33,206 --> 00:11:35,126
Alright, David, hand it over.
Thank you, brother.

174
00:11:35,166 --> 00:11:36,345
Thank you.

175
00:11:37,926 --> 00:11:41,585
For the last time,
immunity is back up for grabs.
Back up for grabs.

176
00:11:43,266 --> 00:11:44,725
For today's challenge...

177
00:11:46,326 --> 00:11:48,445
..you're gonna stand
on narrow pedestals

178
00:11:48,526 --> 00:11:49,985
with one hand on an idol

179
00:11:50,126 --> 00:11:52,305
and the other hand holding onto a ring.

180
00:11:52,446 --> 00:11:54,625
That ring is attached to a rubber cord.

181
00:11:54,766 --> 00:11:57,865
It will be constantly
pulling you away from the idol.

182
00:11:58,006 --> 00:12:00,945
If at any point
you step off the pedestals

183
00:12:01,086 --> 00:12:04,185
or your hands come away
from the idol or the ring,

184
00:12:04,286 --> 00:12:06,145
you're out of the challenge.

185
00:12:06,286 --> 00:12:09,385
Last person left standing wins immunity

186
00:12:09,526 --> 00:12:12,305
and a guaranteed spot
at that final Tribal Council,

187
00:12:12,446 --> 00:12:15,505
where you will have a chance
to pitch your case to the jury

188
00:12:15,646 --> 00:12:18,265
why you deserve
the title of Sole Survivor

189
00:12:18,406 --> 00:12:20,246
and the half million dollars
that goes with it.

190
00:12:22,446 --> 00:12:25,805
Plus, you'll get to decide who'll be
sitting next to you at that Tribal.

191
00:12:26,906 --> 00:12:29,225
A lot on the line today,

192
00:12:29,366 --> 00:12:32,745
so we thought we'd invite some people
here to help you get through it.

193
00:12:37,446 --> 00:12:38,905
Sharn...
Yep.

194
00:12:39,006 --> 00:12:41,505
..as a mother, how difficult is it

195
00:12:41,646 --> 00:12:43,505
being away from your kids
for this long?

196
00:12:46,006 --> 00:12:50,865
Words can't describe
how difficult it is, Jonathan.

197
00:12:53,006 --> 00:12:55,105
You basically just have to
try and shut them out

198
00:12:55,246 --> 00:12:57,001
and concentrate
on what you're doing out here

199
00:12:57,006 --> 00:13:01,305
because otherwise I would just
be walking around like this 24/7.

200
00:13:01,406 --> 00:13:03,865
So it's so hard. It's so hard.

201
00:13:06,706 --> 00:13:08,185
You ready to see them?

202
00:13:08,286 --> 00:13:10,225
Oh, my gosh, yes. Yes, please.

203
00:13:10,326 --> 00:13:12,385
Alright. Come on in, guys.

204
00:13:15,246 --> 00:13:18,105
Where are they?

205
00:13:25,606 --> 00:13:27,165
Oh, my gosh, they've all grown!

206
00:13:33,266 --> 00:13:34,505
Oh, buddy!

207
00:13:37,166 --> 00:13:39,465
I love you guys.

208
00:13:39,566 --> 00:13:41,665
Oh...

209
00:13:41,766 --> 00:13:44,545
I love you guys so much.

210
00:13:46,606 --> 00:13:48,225
Hey, Sharn.
Yes, Jonathan.

211
00:13:48,366 --> 00:13:50,265
Can you remind us
who everyone is, again?

212
00:13:50,406 --> 00:13:51,805
Yeah, OK.
It's quite the clan.

213
00:13:51,946 --> 00:13:53,905
I know, I know.
I've got quite the... the tribe.

214
00:13:54,046 --> 00:13:56,425
So, this is Jack.
Hello.

215
00:13:56,526 --> 00:13:58,465
Will, my oldest boy.

216
00:13:58,606 --> 00:14:01,945
Amelie, my oldest daughter.
And Bella, my baby girl.

217
00:14:02,046 --> 00:14:03,745
And my gorgeous husband, Damien.

218
00:14:03,886 --> 00:14:06,665
So, Damien, incredibly,
you're standing here

219
00:14:06,806 --> 00:14:09,465
for the second time on day 49.
Deja vu. Yep.

220
00:14:09,606 --> 00:14:11,825
Can you believe that Sharn
has made it this far again?

221
00:14:11,926 --> 00:14:13,305
Yep.

222
00:14:13,406 --> 00:14:14,625
You can?

223
00:14:14,766 --> 00:14:16,206
That was the correct answer.

224
00:14:16,246 --> 00:14:19,585
Yeah, very, very impressed
but not overly surprised.

225
00:14:20,826 --> 00:14:22,745
So, Will...
Yep.

226
00:14:22,886 --> 00:14:24,441
..what have you learnt
from your mother,

227
00:14:24,446 --> 00:14:27,345
seeing her achieve so much
in this game, not once but twice?

228
00:14:27,446 --> 00:14:28,945
Yeah, I know. Oh, heaps.

229
00:14:29,086 --> 00:14:31,425
I mean, she's so determined.
She's so courageous.

230
00:14:31,526 --> 00:14:33,025
She's got it all, really.

231
00:14:33,126 --> 00:14:35,305
Oh, thank you, Will.

232
00:14:36,546 --> 00:14:38,265
Aw.

233
00:14:40,846 --> 00:14:42,165
Moana,

234
00:14:42,306 --> 00:14:45,105
now, you just got married
before you came out here, right?

235
00:14:45,206 --> 00:14:46,705
Four days, Jonathan.

236
00:14:46,846 --> 00:14:50,265
Four days? Wow.
Are you missing your wife?

237
00:14:50,406 --> 00:14:54,425
I think I've barely kissed her,
Jonathan, since I got married, so...

238
00:14:54,566 --> 00:14:57,345
Now, you're also the primary
caregiver for your sister.

239
00:14:58,806 --> 00:15:00,745
Is it tough being away from her
for this long?

240
00:15:00,886 --> 00:15:03,425
Yeah, Vinny and me
are just inseparable.

241
00:15:03,566 --> 00:15:06,945
So, not seeing or hearing from her
this long has been really hard.

242
00:15:08,646 --> 00:15:10,525
Well, let's bring
you all back together.

243
00:15:10,606 --> 00:15:12,545
Bella, Vinny, come on out!

244
00:15:22,086 --> 00:15:23,465
Bella, don't cry.

245
00:15:31,626 --> 00:15:33,165
Come here!

246
00:15:34,566 --> 00:15:36,225
Mo!

247
00:15:36,326 --> 00:15:37,705
Vinny!

248
00:15:37,806 --> 00:15:39,185
Mo!

249
00:15:41,346 --> 00:15:49,346
I've missed you.

250
00:15:56,406 --> 00:15:57,885
Vinny, you look beautiful!

251
00:15:58,026 --> 00:15:59,905
Doesn't she?
She got a new dress for you.

252
00:16:00,006 --> 00:16:01,605
Go give him a cuddle, Vin.

253
00:16:01,686 --> 00:16:03,145
Give him a hug.

254
00:16:03,286 --> 00:16:05,465
Oh, my God.
Oh!

255
00:16:05,566 --> 00:16:08,265
I was waiting for that.

256
00:16:08,366 --> 00:16:09,366
Oh, no.

257
00:16:10,546 --> 00:16:14,745
So, Bella, was it difficult
being away from her for this long?

258
00:16:14,846 --> 00:16:17,105
Um, this has been...

259
00:16:17,206 --> 00:16:19,505
Oh, Bella, don't cry.

260
00:16:19,646 --> 00:16:21,561
It's OK, it's OK.
It's good tears. It's good tears.

261
00:16:21,566 --> 00:16:24,025
It's been, like, the hardest
two months of my life.

262
00:16:27,846 --> 00:16:29,785
Right, Vin?
Oh, you got Dave.

263
00:16:29,926 --> 00:16:32,505
I can't cry too much
'cause she'll cry.

264
00:16:32,646 --> 00:16:35,185
Did you expect her
to make it to final three?

265
00:16:35,326 --> 00:16:36,326
Yeah.
You did?

266
00:16:36,406 --> 00:16:37,406
I did.

267
00:16:37,526 --> 00:16:39,241
I knew when she went
that I wasn't gonna see her

268
00:16:39,246 --> 00:16:41,545
for a really long time.

269
00:16:41,686 --> 00:16:44,505
And I knew the second time round,
she was coming out here to win.

270
00:16:46,966 --> 00:16:49,905
Vinny, Vinny, you know your sister
better than anyone else.

271
00:16:50,006 --> 00:16:52,025
How would you describe her?

272
00:16:52,126 --> 00:16:54,245
Yeah, yeah, good sister.

273
00:16:54,326 --> 00:16:55,745
Takes care of me.

274
00:16:55,846 --> 00:16:58,265
Um, gave me coffee in the morning.

275
00:16:58,366 --> 00:17:01,245
And takes me to F45.

276
00:17:01,326 --> 00:17:03,025
That's right.

277
00:17:03,126 --> 00:17:05,705
So, Moana, you've often said

278
00:17:05,846 --> 00:17:07,601
that you're playing this game
for your family.

279
00:17:07,606 --> 00:17:11,305
If you do win,
how would it change their lives?

280
00:17:11,406 --> 00:17:12,905
So much, Jonathan.

281
00:17:13,046 --> 00:17:16,465
Like, our family, my family,
Bella's family.

282
00:17:16,606 --> 00:17:20,665
You know, to be able to have that
kind of money would be unbelievable,

283
00:17:20,806 --> 00:17:23,325
and what it could do for us
could change our lives.

284
00:17:25,406 --> 00:17:27,705
So, David, you've played two seasons
back to back.

285
00:17:27,806 --> 00:17:28,806
Yes, sir.

286
00:17:28,846 --> 00:17:30,521
That's a lot of days
away from your family.

287
00:17:30,526 --> 00:17:32,865
How do you think they're coping?

288
00:17:32,966 --> 00:17:35,425
Oh, well...

289
00:17:36,906 --> 00:17:39,865
I know my wife, and she's super strong.

290
00:17:40,006 --> 00:17:42,281
So, I know she's been hanging
in there and doing really great

291
00:17:42,286 --> 00:17:43,665
when I've been gone.

292
00:17:43,766 --> 00:17:46,385
But, uh, yeah, it's been hard, Jon.

293
00:17:49,006 --> 00:17:50,425
Alright, well...

294
00:17:50,566 --> 00:17:51,905
Yep.
..let's make it happen.

295
00:17:52,046 --> 00:17:53,425
Oh, yes, please.
Come on out, guys!

296
00:17:53,526 --> 00:17:54,985
Go, Dave.

297
00:17:59,286 --> 00:18:02,265
Oh!

298
00:18:02,366 --> 00:18:03,745
Oh...

299
00:18:05,686 --> 00:18:07,545
Watch out.

300
00:18:11,146 --> 00:18:12,625
Yeah!

301
00:18:12,726 --> 00:18:16,265
Come on, baby!

302
00:18:16,406 --> 00:18:19,685
Oh, you still got your Champ's buff.
Baby.

303
00:18:19,766 --> 00:18:21,185
Hey, baby!

304
00:18:25,006 --> 00:18:26,825
Ah... Hey.

305
00:18:26,926 --> 00:18:28,905
Oh, wow, you are beautiful.

306
00:18:29,006 --> 00:18:31,045
Oh, baby Rei!

307
00:18:31,126 --> 00:18:32,685
That's for you, my love.

308
00:18:32,806 --> 00:18:35,185
No, it's for you.
Oh, you brought one for me?

309
00:18:35,286 --> 00:18:36,505
Oh, wow.

310
00:18:36,606 --> 00:18:38,505
You are a sight for sore eyes.

311
00:18:41,166 --> 00:18:42,705
Pearl...
Yeah.

312
00:18:42,846 --> 00:18:45,046
..what did you think
when David came to you and he said,

313
00:18:45,106 --> 00:18:48,065
"Honey, I think I'm gonna
go play Survivor again"?

314
00:18:48,166 --> 00:18:50,585
I said, "Great, awesome."

315
00:18:50,726 --> 00:18:52,065
Really?
Yeah.

316
00:18:52,206 --> 00:18:55,065
I was so happy for him
and the opportunity

317
00:18:55,206 --> 00:18:58,105
and he had such an excellent time
the first time.

318
00:18:58,246 --> 00:19:03,505
So I think it was a chance
to do something incredible again.

319
00:19:03,646 --> 00:19:05,585
So, Rei...
Use your big voice.

320
00:19:05,726 --> 00:19:07,345
Yeah?
..does Daddy look different to you?

321
00:19:08,506 --> 00:19:11,145
No. He's perfect.

322
00:19:11,246 --> 00:19:13,105
Aw.

323
00:19:13,246 --> 00:19:15,145
Alright, you got room
for a little bit more?

324
00:19:15,246 --> 00:19:17,705
Oh, yeah, I think maybe I do.

325
00:19:17,846 --> 00:19:20,305
Well, your two boys from Perth
couldn't be here...

326
00:19:20,406 --> 00:19:21,406
Yeah.

327
00:19:21,466 --> 00:19:23,065
..but they still
want to wish you luck.

328
00:19:23,166 --> 00:19:25,265
Oh, man.

329
00:19:31,586 --> 00:19:32,745
Hello.

330
00:19:32,846 --> 00:19:35,045
Winston, Go-go, it's Dad!

331
00:19:35,166 --> 00:19:36,685
How are you?
Hi.

332
00:19:36,766 --> 00:19:38,145
I'm good!

333
00:19:38,246 --> 00:19:39,945
You guys doing well?

334
00:19:40,046 --> 00:19:41,825
Yes!

335
00:19:41,966 --> 00:19:44,045
I've been thinking about you
every day, guys.

336
00:19:44,126 --> 00:19:45,545
I've got my necklace.

337
00:19:45,686 --> 00:19:48,286
I've been thinking about you every
day, talking about you nonstop.

338
00:19:48,366 --> 00:19:50,225
I love you guys so much.

339
00:19:50,326 --> 00:19:52,465
I cannot wait to see you.

340
00:19:52,566 --> 00:19:53,865
Love you, too.

341
00:19:53,966 --> 00:19:55,465
Alright, boys.

342
00:19:55,606 --> 00:19:57,145
We got some business to take care of.

343
00:19:57,286 --> 00:19:59,625
I love youse
and I'll talk to you real soon.

344
00:19:59,766 --> 00:20:02,185
OK, love you. Bye.
Bye, boys.

345
00:20:05,246 --> 00:20:08,785
OK, families. You guys are gonna
be cheering on from the bench today.

346
00:20:08,926 --> 00:20:10,905
I'm gonna give everyone
a minute to catch up.

347
00:20:11,046 --> 00:20:15,045
And then, Sharn, Moana, David,
we're gonna get to it.

348
00:20:15,126 --> 00:20:17,665
Yep, alright, Jonathan. Thank you.

349
00:20:17,766 --> 00:20:20,425
Mmm! Come in, group hug, group hug!

350
00:20:20,526 --> 00:20:22,125
Aw, you guys!

351
00:20:22,246 --> 00:20:24,985
I can't believe you're all here again!

352
00:20:25,086 --> 00:20:26,625
You look good.

353
00:20:26,766 --> 00:20:28,785
I know, she's got a new dress.
She got a spray tan.

354
00:20:28,886 --> 00:20:31,825
Ooh, girl! You look beautiful.

355
00:20:31,926 --> 00:20:34,225
Oh, baby.

356
00:20:34,366 --> 00:20:37,465
I've been dreaming about this
for 49 days.

357
00:21:06,506 --> 00:21:08,905
Alright, everyone's in position.

358
00:21:11,846 --> 00:21:14,345
For immunity

359
00:21:14,446 --> 00:21:16,305
and a spot in the final two...

360
00:21:19,166 --> 00:21:21,705
..this challenge is now on.

361
00:21:32,486 --> 00:21:35,545
If you only win one challenge
in this game...

362
00:21:36,666 --> 00:21:38,665
..this is the one to win.

363
00:21:41,366 --> 00:21:44,865
Guarantee yourself a spot
in that final two.

364
00:21:46,366 --> 00:21:48,145
Pretty simple.

365
00:21:48,286 --> 00:21:50,305
Just need to keep both
feet on those pedestals,

366
00:21:50,406 --> 00:21:52,025
one hand on the idol

367
00:21:52,126 --> 00:21:54,185
and the other hand on the ring.

368
00:21:54,326 --> 00:22:00,065
And that rubber band constantly
pulling you away from the idol,

369
00:22:00,206 --> 00:22:03,025
making it more difficult
to maintain balance.

370
00:22:06,486 --> 00:22:09,825
The longer this goes on,
the more fatigue will set in...

371
00:22:11,026 --> 00:22:12,585
..body and mind.

372
00:22:14,046 --> 00:22:17,305
All it's gonna take is one
lapse in concentration...

373
00:22:18,566 --> 00:22:21,705
..to break contact with
one of those four points,

374
00:22:21,806 --> 00:22:23,505
you're out of the challenge.

375
00:22:26,286 --> 00:22:28,505
After 49 days...

376
00:22:29,826 --> 00:22:32,185
..it's all come down to this.

377
00:22:55,972 --> 00:22:59,197
If you only win one
challenge in this game...

378
00:22:59,424 --> 00:23:01,791
..this is the one to win.

379
00:23:02,290 --> 00:23:05,949
Guarantee yourself a spot
in that final two.

380
00:23:09,150 --> 00:23:10,869
You've got this, babe!

381
00:23:12,770 --> 00:23:14,909
You need to keep both feet
on those pedestals,

382
00:23:15,010 --> 00:23:16,829
one hand on the idol

383
00:23:16,930 --> 00:23:18,949
and the other hand on the ring.

384
00:23:20,170 --> 00:23:22,709
Break contact
with one of those four points...

385
00:23:24,070 --> 00:23:26,349
..you're out of the challenge.

386
00:23:29,570 --> 00:23:32,429
David trying different positions.

387
00:23:32,530 --> 00:23:34,509
There's no good position in this one.

388
00:23:35,790 --> 00:23:37,469
There's not.

389
00:23:37,610 --> 00:23:42,149
That rubber band constantly
forcing you into something awkward.

390
00:23:43,290 --> 00:23:45,229
Yeah, that's a nice touch
this time round, Jon.

391
00:23:45,330 --> 00:23:46,829
It's All Stars, baby.

392
00:23:51,490 --> 00:23:54,109
Moana readjusting her feet.

393
00:23:54,210 --> 00:23:56,589
It is so much harder than it looks.

394
00:23:56,730 --> 00:23:58,409
It's hard, yeah.
The balancing.

395
00:23:59,650 --> 00:24:02,789
Those pedestals are gonna really
grind into the soles of your feet.

396
00:24:05,310 --> 00:24:07,829
David grimacing

397
00:24:07,930 --> 00:24:10,309
as he readjusts that back foot.

398
00:24:10,450 --> 00:24:15,189
Shuffling around on those pedestals
will give your feet some relief

399
00:24:15,290 --> 00:24:18,269
but you also risk slipping off.

400
00:24:21,850 --> 00:24:25,909
Ooh, big slip from Moana.

401
00:24:26,050 --> 00:24:29,069
That's how quickly
you can fall out of this challenge.

402
00:24:30,310 --> 00:24:31,749
Gotta stay focused.

403
00:24:33,030 --> 00:24:34,869
One lapse, and you're done.

404
00:24:37,330 --> 00:24:39,629
Interesting when these waves
start coming in.

405
00:24:52,510 --> 00:24:54,769
The tide's starting to come in now.

406
00:24:54,890 --> 00:24:57,129
Here we go.
Ooh, I felt it.

407
00:24:57,250 --> 00:24:59,229
Eventually it'll get up to the pegs...

408
00:25:02,370 --> 00:25:04,229
..make them wet and slippery,

409
00:25:04,370 --> 00:25:07,709
making it more difficult to get a grip.

410
00:25:07,810 --> 00:25:09,629
Uh-oh.

411
00:25:15,730 --> 00:25:17,349
Sharn...

412
00:25:17,490 --> 00:25:20,189
..is this harder than
the last final challenge you did?

413
00:25:20,290 --> 00:25:21,829
Um, yeah, I think so,

414
00:25:21,970 --> 00:25:23,909
because it calls on
different strengths.

415
00:25:24,050 --> 00:25:26,229
There's a lot of components
in this challenge

416
00:25:26,370 --> 00:25:28,709
versus the one that I had
as my final challenge.

417
00:25:30,650 --> 00:25:33,549
David, how are you feeling up there?
Uh, really good, Jon.

418
00:25:33,690 --> 00:25:35,669
There's a little bit
of a balance element to it

419
00:25:35,810 --> 00:25:38,589
that could potentially be
the decisive factor, I suppose.

420
00:25:38,690 --> 00:25:42,189
But I'm in this 110%, Jon.

421
00:25:42,330 --> 00:25:46,149
Like, this is life for me, man,
and I will die up here if I have to.

422
00:26:01,090 --> 00:26:02,589
That's one hour, guys.

423
00:26:02,690 --> 00:26:04,069
Good job, guys!

424
00:26:04,210 --> 00:26:05,309
Whoo!
Woo-hoo!

425
00:26:05,450 --> 00:26:06,789
Whoo!
Guys, amazing!

426
00:26:08,650 --> 00:26:11,869
Tightest alliance
in the history of Survivor.

427
00:26:11,970 --> 00:26:13,189
Yeah, boy!

428
00:26:13,330 --> 00:26:14,669
Yew!
Yeah, boy.

429
00:26:14,810 --> 00:26:17,009
It's gonna have to break tonight,
though.

430
00:26:17,110 --> 00:26:19,149
Yeah.

431
00:26:19,290 --> 00:26:21,005
And that's when we hoped
it would break, Jon.

432
00:26:21,010 --> 00:26:22,129
You know?
Yep.

433
00:26:22,210 --> 00:26:24,149
At three.

434
00:26:24,290 --> 00:26:26,989
Be nice to be the one who dictates
how it breaks, though.

435
00:26:27,090 --> 00:26:28,789
Yeah, it would.

436
00:26:28,890 --> 00:26:30,229
That's true.

437
00:26:43,030 --> 00:26:44,429
David crouched down,

438
00:26:44,530 --> 00:26:47,349
looking for some kind of relief,

439
00:26:47,450 --> 00:26:49,389
any relief.

440
00:26:52,490 --> 00:26:55,269
So much of this challenge
is psychological.

441
00:26:57,010 --> 00:26:59,709
It's just convincing yourself
to keep going.

442
00:27:18,930 --> 00:27:22,149
Oh, whoa, Moana.

443
00:27:22,250 --> 00:27:23,629
Oh, careful.

444
00:27:23,730 --> 00:27:25,869
Almost loses it.

445
00:27:32,370 --> 00:27:33,429
Ah...

446
00:27:33,570 --> 00:27:35,029
Oh, Mo!
Mo, Mo, Mo!

447
00:27:35,170 --> 00:27:37,269
Far out!
Oh, my God!

448
00:27:38,510 --> 00:27:41,569
And that's it, out of
nowhere, Moana falls.

449
00:27:41,690 --> 00:27:44,869
Are you alright?
She is out of the challenge.

450
00:27:45,010 --> 00:27:46,309
You OK?
Damn.

451
00:27:46,410 --> 00:27:47,789
Shit.

452
00:27:47,930 --> 00:27:49,709
Oh, Mo.

453
00:27:49,850 --> 00:27:51,209
Great effort, though.
You alright?

454
00:27:51,290 --> 00:27:52,349
Yeah.

455
00:27:55,930 --> 00:27:57,069
Oh, OK, OK.

456
00:27:57,170 --> 00:27:59,029
You OK, Mo?

457
00:28:00,290 --> 00:28:02,289
Great effort, Mo.
You did great, girl.

458
00:28:02,410 --> 00:28:04,589
So good.
Awesome.

459
00:28:04,690 --> 00:28:06,829
Well done, Mo.

460
00:28:08,090 --> 00:28:12,629
After an hour and 10 minutes, Moana
slips, she's out of the challenge.

461
00:28:12,730 --> 00:28:14,109
Well done, Mo.

462
00:28:15,290 --> 00:28:17,069
Come here and let me snuggle you.

463
00:28:17,170 --> 00:28:18,789
And we're down to two.

464
00:28:22,610 --> 00:28:24,589
After 49 days,

465
00:28:24,690 --> 00:28:27,349
it's come down to David and Sharn

466
00:28:27,490 --> 00:28:30,349
battling it out
for that final necklace.

467
00:28:37,230 --> 00:28:39,789
Wow, this thing's got serious now,
didn't it? Just got real.

468
00:29:02,770 --> 00:29:05,589
You guys have been up there
for 90 minutes.

469
00:29:05,690 --> 00:29:07,469
Tide is rising.

470
00:29:13,390 --> 00:29:14,709
Wow.

471
00:29:14,850 --> 00:29:17,469
Those pedestals
are getting very slippery now.

472
00:29:17,570 --> 00:29:20,469
Every readjustment a huge risk.

473
00:29:55,450 --> 00:29:57,069
We're going together?

474
00:29:57,170 --> 00:29:58,709
Alright. Yeah, I'm down.

475
00:29:58,850 --> 00:30:01,109
You on? You on?
I'm on. Like, I'm on.

476
00:30:10,530 --> 00:30:12,189
It makes sense, I think.

477
00:30:14,250 --> 00:30:16,109
I did, I always said at the start,

478
00:30:16,250 --> 00:30:18,005
I wanted to sit with
the best player at the end...

479
00:30:18,010 --> 00:30:19,389
Yep.
..and I thought,

480
00:30:19,530 --> 00:30:22,949
"What... what am I doing
if I can't live up to that?"

481
00:30:23,090 --> 00:30:25,109
I want my game to be able
to speak for itself.

482
00:30:25,210 --> 00:30:26,210
Yep.

483
00:30:26,250 --> 00:30:28,789
I want to be able to go against
someone that made big moves

484
00:30:28,930 --> 00:30:31,450
and played an amazing game and
I know will speak well at Tribal.

485
00:30:31,490 --> 00:30:32,490
I know.

486
00:30:39,810 --> 00:30:41,189
It fits,

487
00:30:41,330 --> 00:30:44,229
because I learnt
from my mistake last time.

488
00:30:44,330 --> 00:30:45,389
Yep.

489
00:30:45,530 --> 00:30:49,149
And I feel like it's an honour
to be here with you, you know.

490
00:30:49,290 --> 00:30:50,869
Yeah, Sharn, I feel the same way.
Yep.

491
00:30:51,010 --> 00:30:53,410
And that's why it'll be an honour
to sit with you at the end.

492
00:30:54,390 --> 00:30:56,949
Yep.

493
00:31:25,890 --> 00:31:28,069
Here comes the rain.

494
00:31:28,170 --> 00:31:30,189
Rain starting to come in.

495
00:31:30,330 --> 00:31:32,050
That's gonna make the idol
wet and slippery.

496
00:31:45,170 --> 00:31:46,170
Oh!

497
00:31:46,250 --> 00:31:48,069
Rain's really kicked in.

498
00:31:48,170 --> 00:31:49,829
That tide's coming up.

499
00:31:49,930 --> 00:31:51,309
Look at that.

500
00:31:51,410 --> 00:31:53,469
Whoo!

501
00:31:53,570 --> 00:31:55,269
Bring it on!

502
00:32:10,096 --> 00:32:12,166
Wow, it's really hammering down now.

503
00:32:12,450 --> 00:32:14,829
It's gonna make that idol
nice and slippery.

504
00:32:17,470 --> 00:32:18,949
Yeah, it has.

505
00:32:20,550 --> 00:32:22,149
It definitely has.

506
00:32:32,830 --> 00:32:34,909
Lots of shifting around now.

507
00:32:35,050 --> 00:32:38,089
Those pressure points
are taking a beating.

508
00:32:40,010 --> 00:32:42,589
Every readjustment
presents a risk, though.

509
00:32:49,610 --> 00:32:51,749
Wow!
Whoo! Look at that!

510
00:32:51,890 --> 00:32:54,229
Yeah!
Really coming up now.

511
00:32:54,370 --> 00:32:56,189
- Oh, oh, oh, wow.
- Oh, my God!

512
00:32:57,930 --> 00:33:00,269
Waves consistently
hitting your feet now.

513
00:33:03,290 --> 00:33:06,629
It's only a matter of time before
one of these waves takes you out.

514
00:33:11,770 --> 00:33:13,829
Oh, jeez! Oh, man!

515
00:33:13,970 --> 00:33:15,829
And out of nowhere...
Oh, no!

516
00:33:15,930 --> 00:33:18,909
Oh...
..Sharn slips.

517
00:33:19,010 --> 00:33:20,149
..man!

518
00:33:22,490 --> 00:33:26,949
And David wins final immunity!

519
00:33:27,050 --> 00:33:28,869
Oh, no. I just slipped!

520
00:33:28,970 --> 00:33:30,829
Ooh! Can't even get up.

521
00:33:32,750 --> 00:33:34,229
Oh, man!
Beautiful, girl.

522
00:33:34,370 --> 00:33:35,789
I was so good.
Beautiful.

523
00:33:35,890 --> 00:33:37,589
Oh. Oh.

524
00:33:37,690 --> 00:33:38,690
Man!

525
00:33:39,850 --> 00:33:42,169
Ohhh...
You were absolutely amazing.

526
00:33:43,250 --> 00:33:44,949
Oh, David.

527
00:33:45,090 --> 00:33:46,549
- Oh.
- Well done, Dave.

528
00:33:46,650 --> 00:33:47,949
Oh.

529
00:33:48,050 --> 00:33:49,589
Hey, baby!

530
00:33:51,990 --> 00:33:52,990
Oh!

531
00:34:03,910 --> 00:34:05,509
Oh, I'm so sorry, guys.

532
00:34:05,650 --> 00:34:08,909
That's alright. You did well.
I did. But I just slipped.

533
00:34:09,010 --> 00:34:10,589
I just...

534
00:34:10,730 --> 00:34:12,970
It's alright, it's alright.
You're right. Take your time.

535
00:34:27,850 --> 00:34:29,149
David,

536
00:34:29,250 --> 00:34:31,989
guaranteed to see day 50.

537
00:34:32,090 --> 00:34:33,509
How does that feel?

538
00:34:33,610 --> 00:34:35,189
Um...

539
00:34:35,330 --> 00:34:36,909
..it's everything I dreamed
it would be.

540
00:34:37,010 --> 00:34:38,869
My dreams have come true today.

541
00:34:39,010 --> 00:34:42,629
I feel like I'm asleep.
I'm just dreaming right now.

542
00:34:42,730 --> 00:34:44,309
David, come on over.

543
00:34:45,570 --> 00:34:47,229
Congratulations, buddy.

544
00:34:53,610 --> 00:34:55,709
Congratulations, mate.

545
00:34:56,970 --> 00:34:59,589
Final immunity is yours.

546
00:34:59,730 --> 00:35:03,589
Guaranteed a 50% chance
of winning this game

547
00:35:03,730 --> 00:35:05,809
and the half million dollars
that goes with it.

548
00:35:05,890 --> 00:35:07,269
One big decision left...

549
00:35:09,590 --> 00:35:11,809
..who you're gonna take
to that final Tribal Council

550
00:35:11,930 --> 00:35:15,189
and who's gonna become the ninth
and final member of our jury.

551
00:35:15,330 --> 00:35:16,965
You'll have the afternoon
to think about it.

552
00:35:16,970 --> 00:35:18,809
I'm gonna give you a moment
to say goodbye.

553
00:35:18,950 --> 00:35:21,231
Head back to camp and I'll
see you guys tonight at Tribal.

554
00:35:21,350 --> 00:35:22,809
Well done, mate.
Thanks, man.

555
00:35:22,950 --> 00:35:23,950
Cheers.
Thanks, brother.

556
00:35:24,050 --> 00:35:26,349
Well done, David. So good.

557
00:35:28,510 --> 00:35:30,309
I lost balanced and slipped.

558
00:35:30,450 --> 00:35:33,189
I'm absolutely devastated
'cause I had so much more to give.

559
00:35:35,370 --> 00:35:36,829
I'm OK now.
See you tomorrow night.

560
00:35:36,930 --> 00:35:38,349
But Dave won,

561
00:35:38,490 --> 00:35:40,909
and now he has to choose
between me and Sharn.

562
00:35:42,650 --> 00:35:45,669
This is Dave's chance to prove that
he played a better game than me.

563
00:35:45,810 --> 00:35:47,365
See you. Bye, girls.
See ya, guys.

564
00:35:47,370 --> 00:35:48,709
Bye, guys.
See you.

565
00:35:48,850 --> 00:35:51,989
He said he wanted to go up against
the best player at the end.

566
00:35:52,090 --> 00:35:53,789
By taking me, he could prove that.

567
00:35:56,190 --> 00:35:59,469
Making the decision
on who you take to that final two

568
00:35:59,610 --> 00:36:02,469
is the most difficult decision
that you have in this entire game.

569
00:36:04,090 --> 00:36:07,709
But I am optimistic
that he will take me to the end.

570
00:36:07,850 --> 00:36:10,229
David and I have had
a good relationship.

571
00:36:10,330 --> 00:36:11,789
And, more importantly, today,

572
00:36:11,930 --> 00:36:14,349
when we were out of the challenge,
he promised me again

573
00:36:14,490 --> 00:36:18,169
that there was 100% he was gonna
take me to the final two,

574
00:36:18,310 --> 00:36:20,909
and I'm gonna absolutely
hold him to that promise...

575
00:36:22,890 --> 00:36:24,789
..or there's gonna be
all hell to pay.

576
00:36:59,492 --> 00:37:01,411
I'll now bring in
the members of our jury.

577
00:37:03,372 --> 00:37:04,891
Locky,

578
00:37:04,992 --> 00:37:06,371
Harry,

579
00:37:06,472 --> 00:37:07,611
Zach,

580
00:37:07,712 --> 00:37:08,971
Jacqui,

581
00:37:09,072 --> 00:37:11,011
Shonee,

582
00:37:11,112 --> 00:37:12,611
AK,

583
00:37:12,712 --> 00:37:14,471
Tarzan...

584
00:37:16,726 --> 00:37:20,131
..and Brooke,
voted out at the last Tribal Council.

585
00:37:26,213 --> 00:37:28,832
So, David, big day.

586
00:37:28,973 --> 00:37:30,792
Got to see your family.

587
00:37:30,893 --> 00:37:32,752
Won the final immunity.

588
00:37:32,893 --> 00:37:35,272
Guaranteed yourself
final Tribal Council.

589
00:37:35,453 --> 00:37:37,568
Yeah.
I'm guessing you're feeling
pretty happy right now.

590
00:37:37,573 --> 00:37:39,272
Yeah, I feel amazing, Jon.

591
00:37:39,413 --> 00:37:41,272
It was an incredible day
I think for all of us,

592
00:37:41,413 --> 00:37:45,192
just to get to see our family and to
participate in that final challenge.

593
00:37:46,713 --> 00:37:48,392
And it was a really happy day.

594
00:37:48,533 --> 00:37:50,832
But in some ways, it's a pretty sad day

595
00:37:50,973 --> 00:37:53,352
because I have a heavy decision
to make tonight.

596
00:37:54,913 --> 00:37:58,032
Are you feeling the weight
of ending an ally's chance

597
00:37:58,133 --> 00:38:00,352
at winning a half million dollars?

598
00:38:02,333 --> 00:38:03,712
It's a hard decision,

599
00:38:03,853 --> 00:38:06,752
but it's one that
I'm glad I'm getting to make.

600
00:38:08,253 --> 00:38:11,072
I need to do what is best for my game.

601
00:38:11,213 --> 00:38:13,752
But I have had
real relationships out here

602
00:38:13,893 --> 00:38:15,832
and real friendships
with both of these guys,

603
00:38:15,973 --> 00:38:19,112
and that's honestly
what the harder part of that is.

604
00:38:22,053 --> 00:38:27,672
So, Moana, time spent together
can definitely solidify loyalty.

605
00:38:27,813 --> 00:38:30,752
Do you think that's gonna
factor into tonight's vote?

606
00:38:32,853 --> 00:38:35,972
Since David and I
have formed an alliance,

607
00:38:36,093 --> 00:38:37,972
I've stuck by him
through thick and thin.

608
00:38:38,053 --> 00:38:42,152
And I feel like I've had his back

609
00:38:42,293 --> 00:38:44,472
more than almost anybody in this game.

610
00:38:44,573 --> 00:38:46,252
Well, I... She's not the only one.

611
00:38:50,213 --> 00:38:52,872
They have had a long time together
to form bonds

612
00:38:52,973 --> 00:38:54,552
and that relationship.

613
00:38:54,693 --> 00:38:59,992
But, at the same time, I feel like
once I became part of the alliance

614
00:39:00,133 --> 00:39:03,992
and that friendship was formed,
I've done exactly the same thing.

615
00:39:05,133 --> 00:39:08,672
We have had that strong bond
together, had each other's backs.

616
00:39:08,813 --> 00:39:11,432
I told him I wanted to sit with him
at the end, final two.

617
00:39:12,713 --> 00:39:14,152
In fact, we discussed it today

618
00:39:14,293 --> 00:39:16,272
when we were up
in the challenge together.

619
00:39:16,413 --> 00:39:19,332
What, that you wanted
to take each other to the end?

620
00:39:19,413 --> 00:39:20,413
Absolutely.

621
00:39:21,993 --> 00:39:24,912
David made a promise to me
that he would take me to final two,

622
00:39:25,053 --> 00:39:27,432
up there, when we were in
that physically gruelling state.

623
00:39:27,533 --> 00:39:30,152
We both did, we both promised...

624
00:39:31,713 --> 00:39:35,752
..because we want to deliver
best of the best for All Stars.

625
00:39:39,493 --> 00:39:43,072
Moana, has David made
a final-two promise with you?

626
00:39:43,213 --> 00:39:45,872
David has made
a final-two promise with me.

627
00:39:49,333 --> 00:39:52,053
Of course he's gonna do it. He has
to do it. That's playing the game.

628
00:39:54,173 --> 00:39:58,332
So, Moana, how confident are you that
David's gonna keep his promise to you

629
00:39:58,413 --> 00:40:00,192
over Sharn's promise?

630
00:40:00,293 --> 00:40:01,992
That promise doesn't mean nothing.

631
00:40:04,073 --> 00:40:05,872
Dave now needs to make a decision.

632
00:40:05,973 --> 00:40:07,352
It's a tough decision,

633
00:40:07,493 --> 00:40:09,288
but he has to make a decision
what's best for his game,

634
00:40:09,293 --> 00:40:10,992
but he also has to factor in the jury.

635
00:40:12,453 --> 00:40:16,352
And then you've got Sharn,
who addresses a jury for a living.

636
00:40:16,493 --> 00:40:19,072
And she's been here before.
She's addressed them before.

637
00:40:19,173 --> 00:40:20,752
She knows what that's about.

638
00:40:20,893 --> 00:40:23,872
Imagine what she'll do to you
if she went to top two.

639
00:40:25,773 --> 00:40:27,693
Also, Jonathan...
Can I, sorry, just say to that,

640
00:40:27,773 --> 00:40:29,352
a regular jury, yeah.

641
00:40:29,493 --> 00:40:31,592
One that's in everyday life?
Correct.

642
00:40:31,733 --> 00:40:35,272
But I've had one go at a Survivor
jury, and I failed at that.

643
00:40:35,413 --> 00:40:40,272
And it, yeah, so my track record in
front of a Survivor jury, not good.

644
00:40:45,713 --> 00:40:48,912
So, Sharn, why shouldn't he take Moana?

645
00:40:51,413 --> 00:40:53,912
One of the things when
you've got to consider your pitch

646
00:40:54,053 --> 00:40:56,872
is that if you've been
playing with someone the whole game

647
00:40:56,973 --> 00:40:58,472
or in the same tribe,

648
00:40:58,613 --> 00:41:00,333
that it's gonna be hard
to distinguish moves

649
00:41:00,373 --> 00:41:02,472
if you've had a similar game style

650
00:41:02,613 --> 00:41:04,952
and you've had
those shared experiences.

651
00:41:05,093 --> 00:41:06,653
So, I think
there's a distinct advantage

652
00:41:06,773 --> 00:41:09,312
in taking someone that
hasn't been with you the whole game

653
00:41:09,453 --> 00:41:12,832
because then you can own
those moves easily.

654
00:41:12,973 --> 00:41:15,992
And I think for these guys, the way
I've been seeing them operate,

655
00:41:16,133 --> 00:41:18,412
they've worked together
quite closely on some moves,

656
00:41:18,533 --> 00:41:20,472
and I think I would have
a hard time working out

657
00:41:20,613 --> 00:41:23,692
who was actually running the show
between the moves.

658
00:41:23,773 --> 00:41:25,432
I have got a different game to him,

659
00:41:25,573 --> 00:41:27,692
so that is something
that is clearly distinguishable

660
00:41:27,773 --> 00:41:29,352
for the jury to determine.

661
00:41:32,253 --> 00:41:35,792
OK, Sharn, so why should David
take you to the end?

662
00:41:39,213 --> 00:41:42,592
I think he understands the bond
that we've had and that we've made.

663
00:41:42,693 --> 00:41:44,112
Um...

664
00:41:44,253 --> 00:41:47,592
..but, most of all, he did make me
that promise today out there.

665
00:41:49,653 --> 00:41:52,412
That's a big deal.

666
00:41:52,533 --> 00:41:54,052
We were feeling the pain out there...

667
00:41:55,353 --> 00:41:57,832
..and we had
a real moment out there.

668
00:42:00,433 --> 00:42:02,513
I hope it was real to Dave,
'cause it was real to me.

669
00:42:09,353 --> 00:42:13,412
So, David, Sharn is really
leaning on this promise tonight.

670
00:42:13,493 --> 00:42:15,792
Uh, yeah, she is.

671
00:42:17,293 --> 00:42:20,992
But, again, there's a lot of factors
to take into account tonight,

672
00:42:21,133 --> 00:42:23,432
not just that single promise
that was made.

673
00:42:27,613 --> 00:42:31,712
So, Moana, why should David
take you to the end?

674
00:42:31,853 --> 00:42:34,592
'Cause I'm not holding him
to his promise.

675
00:42:37,533 --> 00:42:40,832
But I want that opportunity.
I have played my arse off.

676
00:42:40,973 --> 00:42:43,272
It's no fluke that
I'm still sitting here at top three.

677
00:42:43,413 --> 00:42:46,232
It ain't a fluke. I got a story to
tell, and I want to tell my story.

678
00:42:46,373 --> 00:42:48,712
Sharn's had her chance.
I want my chance.

679
00:42:50,573 --> 00:42:51,992
I'm throwing him a challenge.

680
00:42:52,133 --> 00:42:54,032
I'm saying
take me 'cause I want to verse you.

681
00:42:57,133 --> 00:42:59,352
If you think I'm an easybeat,
take me and prove it.

682
00:43:01,793 --> 00:43:04,792
Prove it to the jury that you're
the best that's ever played the game

683
00:43:04,893 --> 00:43:06,312
and beat me.

684
00:43:19,413 --> 00:43:22,432
So, David, you've made
a lot of promises tonight.

685
00:43:26,693 --> 00:43:29,672
How critical is this decision
tonight for your game?

686
00:43:31,653 --> 00:43:34,192
It's a half-a-million-dollar
decision tonight.

687
00:43:38,293 --> 00:43:39,352
Alright.

688
00:43:39,453 --> 00:43:41,272
Well, before we go to vote,

689
00:43:41,413 --> 00:43:45,312
Moana, Sharn, your votes
effectively cancel each other out,

690
00:43:45,453 --> 00:43:49,152
so the only vote that
really counts tonight is David's.

691
00:43:54,373 --> 00:43:56,792
David, you're up.

692
00:44:59,013 --> 00:45:00,552
I'll go collect the vote.

693
00:45:23,213 --> 00:45:25,712
OK, once the vote is read,
the decision is final.

694
00:45:25,813 --> 00:45:27,232
Person voted out will be asked

695
00:45:27,373 --> 00:45:29,152
to leave
the Tribal Council area immediately.

696
00:45:30,893 --> 00:45:32,272
I'll read the vote.

697
00:45:39,933 --> 00:45:44,352
22nd person voted out and ninth
and final member of our jury...

698
00:45:47,393 --> 00:45:48,872
..Moana.

699
00:45:51,313 --> 00:45:53,272
You need to bring me your torch.

700
00:45:57,893 --> 00:45:59,212
I'm sorry, girl.

701
00:46:07,673 --> 00:46:08,792
See ya, Mo.

702
00:46:09,893 --> 00:46:11,952
Yeah, I will, darling.

703
00:46:12,053 --> 00:46:13,432
Me too. See ya.

704
00:46:18,273 --> 00:46:19,872
49 days ain't too bad, Jonathan.

705
00:46:19,973 --> 00:46:21,512
Ain't too bad at all.

706
00:46:25,673 --> 00:46:28,832
Moana, the tribe has spoken.

707
00:46:31,013 --> 00:46:32,472
Time for you to go.
Give us a hug?

708
00:46:32,573 --> 00:46:33,992
Yeah, you betcha.

709
00:46:34,133 --> 00:46:35,133
Thanks.
Well played.

710
00:46:35,253 --> 00:46:37,432
See ya, guys. See ya.
See ya, Mo.

711
00:46:53,753 --> 00:46:55,152
OK?

712
00:46:58,833 --> 00:47:00,512
Well, congratulations.

713
00:47:00,653 --> 00:47:03,712
You two have gone
as far as you can go in this game.

714
00:47:04,953 --> 00:47:07,872
And, now, tomorrow night
it's gonna be up to the jury.

715
00:47:09,133 --> 00:47:13,152
So, I suggest you go back to camp
and get a good night's sleep

716
00:47:13,293 --> 00:47:15,592
and think about how
you're gonna convince them

717
00:47:15,733 --> 00:47:17,872
that you deserve
the title of Sole Survivor

718
00:47:18,013 --> 00:47:19,573
