and the half million that goes with it.

719
00:47:19,613 --> 00:47:21,472
Grab your torches, head on out.

720
00:47:21,573 --> 00:47:23,012
I'll see you guys tomorrow.

721
00:47:23,093 --> 00:47:24,872
Well done.

722
00:48:10,083 --> 00:48:12,435
Can you believe it?

723
00:48:12,473 --> 00:48:14,561
I can't quite believe it, to be honest.

724
00:48:14,636 --> 00:48:17,703
Oh, me either.
The final notch on the tree.

725
00:48:17,844 --> 00:48:20,498
Better make it a good one.
You better.

726
00:48:21,712 --> 00:48:24,931
Day 50! We're here!

727
00:48:25,032 --> 00:48:27,091
What an incredible feeling.

728
00:48:27,192 --> 00:48:28,611
Nice one.

729
00:48:28,752 --> 00:48:30,631
50!

730
00:48:30,712 --> 00:48:34,051
Wow.
50 days.

731
00:48:34,192 --> 00:48:35,611
So good.
22 names.

732
00:48:35,752 --> 00:48:37,851
Yeah.
I got to put Mo's initials in, yeah?

733
00:48:37,952 --> 00:48:39,351
Yeah.

734
00:48:39,432 --> 00:48:41,411
But...

735
00:48:41,552 --> 00:48:44,811
..last night the decision
was pretty heartbreaking.

736
00:48:45,992 --> 00:48:49,411
Mo's been probably
my closest ally on the beach.

737
00:48:49,512 --> 00:48:51,651
She's become like my sister out here.

738
00:48:51,752 --> 00:48:54,091
So it was a tough decision.

739
00:48:54,192 --> 00:48:55,811
But...

740
00:48:55,952 --> 00:48:58,071
..only the toughest come out here
and win.

741
00:48:59,232 --> 00:49:01,307
Yeah, it was epic.
Feels good to win
that last one, doesn't it?

742
00:49:01,312 --> 00:49:02,891
Oh...

743
00:49:02,992 --> 00:49:04,371
..yeah, feels amazing.

744
00:49:04,472 --> 00:49:06,251
Yeah. Thank you for...

745
00:49:06,352 --> 00:49:07,771
Yeah, welcome. My pleasure.

746
00:49:07,912 --> 00:49:10,251
It's just awesome to share this with.
..letting me be here.

747
00:49:10,392 --> 00:49:12,347
You don't know how much
it means to me. It's incredible.

748
00:49:12,352 --> 00:49:14,491
I have a fair idea...
Yeah.

749
00:49:14,632 --> 00:49:17,891
..'cause I think it means
a lot to me, so...

750
00:49:19,012 --> 00:49:21,412
Winning the title of Sole Survivor
and half a million dollars

751
00:49:21,432 --> 00:49:23,291
just means the world to me.

752
00:49:23,392 --> 00:49:24,971
I've literally bled for this game.

753
00:49:25,112 --> 00:49:29,771
It's been blood, sweat, tears,
a lot of family sacrifice.

754
00:49:31,072 --> 00:49:34,531
I'm out here making my kids proud.
I'm making my family proud.

755
00:49:35,672 --> 00:49:37,171
They are everything to me.

756
00:49:38,652 --> 00:49:43,091
I used my smarts
to outwit 22 other competitors.

757
00:49:43,192 --> 00:49:45,291
I dug in deep when I needed it.

758
00:49:45,392 --> 00:49:46,931
I stayed calm under pressure.

759
00:49:47,032 --> 00:49:49,371
I made fire from scratch,

760
00:49:49,472 --> 00:49:52,331
from scratch, no flint, no nothin'.

761
00:49:52,432 --> 00:49:54,071
I proved I'm not just a pretty face.

762
00:49:55,232 --> 00:49:58,251
I am worthy of the
title of Sole Survivor.

763
00:49:58,352 --> 00:50:01,731
This is the realisation of my dream.

764
00:50:01,832 --> 00:50:03,331
This is what I worked for,

765
00:50:03,472 --> 00:50:05,711
and I'm not gonna let
it slip out of my grasp.

766
00:50:10,232 --> 00:50:12,431
Oh, listen to that frying noise.

767
00:50:12,512 --> 00:50:13,651
Mmm-mmm-mmm!

768
00:50:13,792 --> 00:50:16,251
That's a sound that I have missed.
Do you hear this?

769
00:50:16,352 --> 00:50:18,431
Final-two breakfast.

770
00:50:19,952 --> 00:50:21,491
Yew!

771
00:50:23,192 --> 00:50:24,787
To final two.
Cheers to the final two, Dave.

772
00:50:24,792 --> 00:50:26,131
Hey?
Congratulations.

773
00:50:27,312 --> 00:50:28,451
Mmm.

774
00:50:29,592 --> 00:50:31,131
Wow.
Wow.

775
00:50:31,272 --> 00:50:33,291
That tastes good.
It does taste good.

776
00:50:34,512 --> 00:50:35,931
Hoo-ee.
Yeah.

777
00:50:37,172 --> 00:50:38,791
This is it.

778
00:50:38,872 --> 00:50:40,791
Oh, yeah.

779
00:50:40,872 --> 00:50:42,251
Oh, boy.

780
00:50:42,352 --> 00:50:44,011
Thank you for cooking breakfast.

781
00:50:44,112 --> 00:50:46,131
My pleasure.

782
00:50:46,272 --> 00:50:48,691
David chose me last night
to go to the final two

783
00:50:48,792 --> 00:50:50,431
instead of Mo.

784
00:50:50,552 --> 00:50:53,811
But, truth is, I absolutely think
that David's made a mistake.

785
00:50:55,072 --> 00:50:59,251
I am the first Australian Survivor
to make it to 100 days.

786
00:50:59,352 --> 00:51:02,091
I've made it to final two twice.

787
00:51:02,232 --> 00:51:05,431
I've outplayed, outlast,
outwitted all of those people.

788
00:51:05,572 --> 00:51:09,851
And I feel so honoured
to be in that position.

789
00:51:11,272 --> 00:51:13,571
But this is where the
history ends right here

790
00:51:13,712 --> 00:51:15,272
because what I'm gonna change this time

791
00:51:15,312 --> 00:51:16,971
is that I'm gonna be
the winner this time.

792
00:51:21,152 --> 00:51:25,011
Losing last time had a
huge impact on my life.

793
00:51:25,152 --> 00:51:27,491
I didn't have a day where I
didn't think about that loss,

794
00:51:27,592 --> 00:51:28,971
for months on end.

795
00:51:29,112 --> 00:51:32,531
It's hard because I was
so close to it last time,

796
00:51:32,632 --> 00:51:34,091
one vote off.

797
00:51:34,232 --> 00:51:37,511
I'm even more determined to
make it mine this time round.

798
00:51:37,632 --> 00:51:40,331
This time it is the second opportunity.

799
00:51:40,432 --> 00:51:42,571
I've sacrificed so much for that.

800
00:51:42,712 --> 00:51:45,731
To be able to bring that home for
my family just means everything.

801
00:51:50,952 --> 00:51:53,151
I'll be entering final
Tribal Council tonight

802
00:51:53,292 --> 00:51:56,251
with 100 days'
experience under my belt.

803
00:51:56,392 --> 00:51:58,331
I know what to expect from that jury.

804
00:51:58,472 --> 00:52:00,651
I know how they're gonna
come out with their questions,

805
00:52:00,752 --> 00:52:03,251
and I know how to respond to them.

806
00:52:03,392 --> 00:52:05,971
I'm not going to falter
at the last stage.

807
00:52:06,112 --> 00:52:08,291
I'm throwing it all to the wall tonight.

808
00:52:10,152 --> 00:52:13,371
I'm absolutely going
to win that jury over.

809
00:52:26,172 --> 00:52:27,787
I am gonna miss this place...
Yeah, me too.

810
00:52:27,792 --> 00:52:29,011
..and this experience.

811
00:52:29,152 --> 00:52:30,707
It's been amazing.
Incredible, hasn't it?

812
00:52:30,712 --> 00:52:32,931
So incredible.
I've loved every minute of it.

813
00:52:33,072 --> 00:52:34,931
Ready to do this?
I'm ready to do this.

814
00:52:35,072 --> 00:52:36,571
Oh, my goodness.
Yep.

815
00:52:36,712 --> 00:52:38,251
This is it.
Wow.

816
00:52:38,352 --> 00:52:39,771
You V me, huh?

817
00:52:39,872 --> 00:52:41,511
So long, Kalokalo.

818
00:52:41,592 --> 00:52:43,511
Yeah, so long, Kalokalo.

819
00:52:48,452 --> 00:52:51,211
This is my courtroom tonight.
I have my case prepared.

820
00:52:53,512 --> 00:52:55,451
I have collected evidence
throughout this game,

821
00:52:55,592 --> 00:52:57,691
and I'm ready to sell that to the jury.

822
00:52:59,332 --> 00:53:01,291
I am going to pitch to that jury

823
00:53:01,432 --> 00:53:04,371
and prove beyond reasonable
doubt that I am the best player

824
00:53:04,512 --> 00:53:06,171
and I deserve that title
of Sole Survivor.

825
00:53:09,532 --> 00:53:11,971
I feel excited about
facing the jury tonight.

826
00:53:12,072 --> 00:53:14,171
I love Tribal Councils.

827
00:53:14,272 --> 00:53:16,511
This is the ultimate Tribal Council.

828
00:53:16,592 --> 00:53:20,451
But I know that Sharn is a barrister.

829
00:53:20,592 --> 00:53:22,571
She's been at a final
Tribal Council before.

830
00:53:22,712 --> 00:53:25,511
This will be 100 days
for her in the game.

831
00:53:25,632 --> 00:53:28,051
I know that Sharn wants
her redemption on this,

832
00:53:28,152 --> 00:53:31,231
but I am hungrier than ever.

833
00:53:31,352 --> 00:53:33,451
Ah, man.
Phwoar, Sole Survivor's right there!

834
00:53:33,592 --> 00:53:35,472
I want to go to Tribal right now.
Let's do this.

835
00:53:38,172 --> 00:53:40,531
Sharn will not be getting
in my way tonight.

836
00:54:27,244 --> 00:54:29,909
Evening.
Good evening.

837
00:54:29,909 --> 00:54:31,972
I'll now bring in the
members of our jury.

838
00:54:34,261 --> 00:54:35,868
Locky,

839
00:54:35,868 --> 00:54:37,368
Harry,

840
00:54:37,368 --> 00:54:38,608
Zach,

841
00:54:38,608 --> 00:54:40,569
Jacqui,

842
00:54:40,569 --> 00:54:42,671
Shonee...

843
00:54:43,976 --> 00:54:45,692
..AK,

844
00:54:46,290 --> 00:54:48,357
Tarzan,

845
00:54:49,240 --> 00:54:51,041
Brooke...

846
00:54:51,967 --> 00:54:54,149
..and Moana,

847
00:54:54,149 --> 00:54:56,903
voted out at the last Tribal Council.

848
00:55:01,595 --> 00:55:04,054
So, here we are,

849
00:55:04,155 --> 00:55:07,374
day 50 and your final Tribal Council.

850
00:55:09,015 --> 00:55:12,354
You two have gone as far
as you can go in the game.

851
00:55:12,475 --> 00:55:15,214
And tonight the power
shifts to the jury.

852
00:55:16,555 --> 00:55:19,134
Nine people you've had a hand
in voting out of this game

853
00:55:19,275 --> 00:55:23,494
will now decide which of you two
deserves the title of Sole Survivor

854
00:55:23,635 --> 00:55:25,654
and the half million
dollars that goes with it.

855
00:55:25,755 --> 00:55:27,354
This is how it's gonna work.

856
00:55:27,495 --> 00:55:29,454
You're each gonna make
an opening statement.

857
00:55:29,595 --> 00:55:31,854
This is your chance to pitch to the jury

858
00:55:31,955 --> 00:55:33,974
why you deserve to win this game.

859
00:55:34,075 --> 00:55:36,494
Then the jury will address you.

860
00:55:36,635 --> 00:55:39,294
They'll ask you questions,
and you'll answer them.

861
00:55:39,435 --> 00:55:44,294
Then they'll have a chance to rebut
your answers in an open forum.

862
00:55:45,715 --> 00:55:48,614
Once everyone's said their piece,
the jury will go up to vote

863
00:55:48,755 --> 00:55:52,294
to decide the winner of
Australian Survivor: All Stars.

864
00:55:54,815 --> 00:55:56,494
Sharn, you want to take it away?

865
00:56:03,415 --> 00:56:04,854
Good evening, everybody.

866
00:56:06,655 --> 00:56:09,614
I am the only person in
Australian Survivor history

867
00:56:09,715 --> 00:56:12,294
to play 100 days of this game.

868
00:56:12,395 --> 00:56:15,574
I've never had my torch snuffed.

869
00:56:15,715 --> 00:56:20,374
My strategy in this game was to
play an aggressively covert game.

870
00:56:20,475 --> 00:56:22,014
The reason for that,

871
00:56:22,155 --> 00:56:25,774
the two winners were voted out in
the first two Tribal Councils,

872
00:56:25,915 --> 00:56:28,974
so I knew very quickly that I
couldn't make any real big moves

873
00:56:29,075 --> 00:56:31,214
that were overt.

874
00:56:31,355 --> 00:56:34,614
So, I assumed the role of
this quiet house mouse

875
00:56:34,755 --> 00:56:37,494
but building genuine
relationships with everybody

876
00:56:37,635 --> 00:56:40,094
so that I could play the
game across the board.

877
00:56:41,375 --> 00:56:46,454
At tribe swap, I saw an opportunity
to build multiple alliances.

878
00:56:46,555 --> 00:56:49,214
I was working with Nick and Lee,

879
00:56:49,315 --> 00:56:52,094
but also, without anyone knowing,

880
00:56:52,235 --> 00:56:55,214
I set up an alliance with Mo and Dave...

881
00:56:57,595 --> 00:56:59,334
..which is a pivotal point in my game.

882
00:57:01,595 --> 00:57:03,294
Then there was the vote on Phoebe.

883
00:57:04,615 --> 00:57:06,794
I controlled that Tribal Council

884
00:57:06,935 --> 00:57:09,430
because I basically could choose
which alliance I wanted to go with

885
00:57:09,435 --> 00:57:11,534
because I knew everyone's votes.

886
00:57:11,635 --> 00:57:13,434
Then we hit merge.

887
00:57:13,555 --> 00:57:15,654
Now, this is when my
game really ramps up.

888
00:57:17,335 --> 00:57:19,294
I wanted Jacqui to go.

889
00:57:19,435 --> 00:57:22,434
The way I did that was
convincing AK, Shonee and Brooke

890
00:57:22,515 --> 00:57:24,254
not to go to rocks.

891
00:57:24,395 --> 00:57:26,894
You all witnessed how I did
that, ladies and gentlemen.

892
00:57:28,235 --> 00:57:32,014
The next vote, AK, Brooke and
Shonee wanted me to vote with them

893
00:57:32,115 --> 00:57:34,014
to blindside David.

894
00:57:34,155 --> 00:57:37,014
I let them believe that that's
what I was going to do,

895
00:57:37,115 --> 00:57:38,694
and I could've done it.

896
00:57:39,915 --> 00:57:41,854
But I saw him as an asset to my game.

897
00:57:41,995 --> 00:57:44,654
The Golden God was the
golden ticket to the end.

898
00:57:44,795 --> 00:57:46,974
He was the greatest
shield I could have had,

899
00:57:47,075 --> 00:57:48,654
and proof is in the pudding.

900
00:57:49,775 --> 00:57:51,214
So, ask yourselves,

901
00:57:51,355 --> 00:57:53,934
why do you think I'm sitting
here again after 50 days?

902
00:57:56,315 --> 00:57:57,934
It's not because I was dragged here.

903
00:57:59,775 --> 00:58:02,734
I have been the puppet master.

904
00:58:02,835 --> 00:58:04,574
I have made calculated moves,

905
00:58:04,715 --> 00:58:06,614
switched alliances when I've needed to

906
00:58:06,715 --> 00:58:08,254
and been adaptable the whole game.

907
00:58:09,795 --> 00:58:12,794
I'm asking you to
consider my total history,

908
00:58:12,875 --> 00:58:14,794
my 100 days in the game.

909
00:58:16,075 --> 00:58:18,234
I've had an incredible
time playing with you all

910
00:58:18,315 --> 00:58:20,854
and it's been an absolute privilege.

911
00:58:20,955 --> 00:58:21,955
Thank you.

912
00:58:26,775 --> 00:58:28,734
Alright, David. Good luck.

913
00:58:30,415 --> 00:58:32,934
Ladies and gentlemen of the jury!

914
00:58:35,075 --> 00:58:38,454
Dudes, it's so honoured
to be sitting here,

915
00:58:38,595 --> 00:58:43,094
have played with the biggest players
in the biggest season of All Stars.

916
00:58:43,235 --> 00:58:46,974
On day one, I was excited to play
with guys like AK and like Locky

917
00:58:47,115 --> 00:58:49,614
because I'd seen their games,
I'd wanted to play with them.

918
00:58:49,715 --> 00:58:51,574
And then we brought Brooke in on it

919
00:58:51,715 --> 00:58:54,094
and we fell into a
really great majority.

920
00:58:55,195 --> 00:58:56,874
But it wasn't enough for me.

921
00:58:56,995 --> 00:58:59,874
I wanted to make sure I was
gonna be safe at tribe swap.

922
00:59:01,035 --> 00:59:02,854
And so...

923
00:59:02,955 --> 00:59:04,974
..I was the mole!

924
00:59:05,075 --> 00:59:08,174
I was the bloody mole on Vakama!

925
00:59:09,755 --> 00:59:12,614
When tribe swap happened,
I was in a little bit of trouble

926
00:59:12,755 --> 00:59:16,934
because Phoebe and I were
put into a minority position.

927
00:59:18,115 --> 00:59:21,774
But I found my first idol on day 17.

928
00:59:23,715 --> 00:59:28,614
And then after the cake shop
reward, Phoebe found a clue.

929
00:59:30,455 --> 00:59:32,514
I used my social game for her to tell me

930
00:59:32,655 --> 00:59:35,374
where the location of my
second idol was gonna be.

931
00:59:39,395 --> 00:59:40,934
It was in a termite mound.

932
00:59:41,035 --> 00:59:43,374
And I took Phoebe to where I thought

933
00:59:43,515 --> 00:59:45,715
there was good termite mounds
in the middle of the camp,

934
00:59:45,835 --> 00:59:48,094
but I knew exactly the
one I wanted to check,

935
00:59:48,235 --> 00:59:50,534
which was the one behind the shelter.

936
00:59:51,675 --> 00:59:54,614
I'm the only person in
Australian Survivor history

937
00:59:54,715 --> 00:59:57,414
to have two idols at the same time.

938
00:59:59,475 --> 01:00:01,014
From there, merge happened.

939
01:00:01,115 --> 01:00:02,574
I linked back up with Lock,

940
01:00:02,715 --> 01:00:07,694
and, I'm sorry, big fella, I
orchestrated your blindside.

941
01:00:10,315 --> 01:00:12,294
You guys know I pushed
really hard for Harry.

942
01:00:12,395 --> 01:00:13,814
There was a good reason for that.

943
01:00:13,955 --> 01:00:16,534
I wanted to be able to sit here and say

944
01:00:16,675 --> 01:00:18,694
I had the most consecutive days played

945
01:00:18,795 --> 01:00:21,174
in Australian Survivor history.

946
01:00:21,315 --> 01:00:25,594
And to do that, I knew that Harry
had to be gone before day 34.

947
01:00:25,675 --> 01:00:27,814
And Harry went out on day 32.

948
01:00:27,915 --> 01:00:29,654
So, here I sit with that title.

949
01:00:30,795 --> 01:00:34,814
Finally, we get down to the real
dirty nitty-gritty of this game.

950
01:00:36,715 --> 01:00:40,234
I had formed really tight
relationships between all of you.

951
01:00:40,315 --> 01:00:43,014
Tarz, man, um...

952
01:00:43,115 --> 01:00:45,334
..I genuinely love you, man,

953
01:00:45,475 --> 01:00:48,134
and we had such a good
connection in the game.

954
01:00:49,755 --> 01:00:51,614
This was such a tough
decision for me, brother.

955
01:00:53,475 --> 01:00:58,934
And basically, at the five, it
was time for me to take on board

956
01:00:59,075 --> 01:01:02,094
what I thought was gonna
be best for my family,

957
01:01:02,235 --> 01:01:05,894
and unfortunately it was
to send you home, brother.

958
01:01:08,055 --> 01:01:10,974
Brooke, challenge beast.

959
01:01:11,075 --> 01:01:14,134
Your performances were just amazing.

960
01:01:14,235 --> 01:01:16,234
I finally got ya.

961
01:01:18,135 --> 01:01:19,934
Now I sat with girls

962
01:01:20,075 --> 01:01:23,594
who I felt like I'd formed
a really strong bond with.

963
01:01:24,795 --> 01:01:29,694
Mo, I got to make the choice, the
hard choice of sending you home.

964
01:01:29,835 --> 01:01:31,955
It's probably the worst thing
I had to do in the game.

965
01:01:33,595 --> 01:01:36,654
But I played big.
I played unapologetically.

966
01:01:36,795 --> 01:01:39,954
I made big, exciting
and interesting moves.

967
01:01:40,075 --> 01:01:43,054
And, in a way, I've played the
most honest game I ever have.

968
01:01:44,235 --> 01:01:48,294
Thanks for this opportunity, guys.
What an amazing season.

969
01:01:49,415 --> 01:01:51,334
And, man, I had a lot of fun.

970
01:01:52,835 --> 01:01:54,694
That's it.

971
01:01:56,135 --> 01:01:57,294
Alright, guys.

972
01:01:57,435 --> 01:02:00,070
Well, you've heard everything that
Sharn and David have had to say.

973
01:02:00,075 --> 01:02:03,054
It's now your turn to ask questions.

974
01:02:03,195 --> 01:02:06,414
Remember, you need to find out
everything you need to know

975
01:02:06,555 --> 01:02:08,155
to make a
half-a-million-dollar decision.

976
01:02:09,835 --> 01:02:11,614
Locky.

977
01:02:11,715 --> 01:02:13,294
Alright, guys. Congratulations.

978
01:02:13,435 --> 01:02:16,054
I mean, 50 days, it's not an easy feat,

979
01:02:16,195 --> 01:02:17,830
but you both done it,
you both made it there.

980
01:02:17,835 --> 01:02:19,654
And, yeah, congratulations, well done.

981
01:02:19,795 --> 01:02:22,314
My question, the first one is to Dave.

982
01:02:22,435 --> 01:02:25,214
Since day one when we
were working together,

983
01:02:25,355 --> 01:02:28,014
you said, "Oh, I want to make big
moves, I want to cause chaos,"

984
01:02:28,115 --> 01:02:29,574
and stuff like that.

985
01:02:29,715 --> 01:02:31,270
But it seemed to be when you hit merge,

986
01:02:31,275 --> 01:02:32,974
that kind of went out the window

987
01:02:33,115 --> 01:02:37,654
and you sort of sided with
a big, boring alliance.

988
01:02:37,795 --> 01:02:40,854
What I kind of want to ask is,
where did the Golden God go?

989
01:02:43,115 --> 01:02:45,534
Uh, man, the Golden God was still there.

990
01:02:45,675 --> 01:02:48,734
I just kind of had to shed
that skin a little bit.

991
01:02:50,235 --> 01:02:52,694
I felt like my game had
to evolve this time

992
01:02:52,835 --> 01:02:56,414
because the Golden God was
sitting up there at the 10 spot,

993
01:02:56,515 --> 01:02:58,314
and I wanted to sit here.

994
01:02:59,435 --> 01:03:03,774
So, at merge, I thought I was still
orchestrating big moves, brother.

995
01:03:03,915 --> 01:03:05,555
I thought you were,
like, the biggest one.

996
01:03:07,155 --> 01:03:09,414
But I was trying to
protect my information

997
01:03:09,515 --> 01:03:11,534
and keep stuff a bit more to myself

998
01:03:11,675 --> 01:03:14,094
'cause that was a mistake I
made the last time I played.

999
01:03:15,275 --> 01:03:16,374
Yep.

1000
01:03:19,555 --> 01:03:20,694
Shonee.

1001
01:03:20,835 --> 01:03:23,394
Jonathan.
You're up.

1002
01:03:23,535 --> 01:03:26,494
Sharn...
Yep.

1003
01:03:26,635 --> 01:03:28,674
..I've sat here before and
you've sat there before

1004
01:03:28,815 --> 01:03:30,894
and you didn't get my vote last time.

1005
01:03:34,335 --> 01:03:36,094
So, why should I vote for you this time?

1006
01:03:41,635 --> 01:03:45,374
Well, Shonee, I feel like I've
played a real strong game.

1007
01:03:46,755 --> 01:03:50,114
I've learnt from the mistakes
that I made the first time.

1008
01:03:50,195 --> 01:03:52,674
This time I played smarter.

1009
01:03:52,815 --> 01:03:56,054
My design playing this game
was to be aggressively covert

1010
01:03:56,195 --> 01:03:58,334
and have those subtle
game-plays on the way

1011
01:03:58,475 --> 01:04:00,814
to make sure I get through,
and it worked for me.

1012
01:04:02,595 --> 01:04:06,534
And also I built that
alliance with Mo and Dave,

1013
01:04:06,675 --> 01:04:09,294
which ultimately turned
into the Mokuta seven

1014
01:04:09,435 --> 01:04:12,134
that dominated the merge and became
one of the strongest alliances

1015
01:04:12,235 --> 01:04:13,814
Australian Survivor has ever seen.

1016
01:04:15,195 --> 01:04:17,934
And that's why I think this
time you should vote for me.

1017
01:04:19,355 --> 01:04:20,814
Alright, AK.

1018
01:04:22,115 --> 01:04:23,694
You got any questions for 'em?

1019
01:04:26,015 --> 01:04:28,054
Sharn,

1020
01:04:28,155 --> 01:04:29,854
on day 40...

1021
01:04:31,195 --> 01:04:34,254
..you convinced Shonee,
Brooke and myself

1022
01:04:34,355 --> 01:04:35,854
not to go to rocks.

1023
01:04:37,275 --> 01:04:41,534
And that is the biggest
regret of my game.

1024
01:04:41,675 --> 01:04:44,174
And my Survivor mantra
is to have no regrets.

1025
01:04:45,555 --> 01:04:49,134
And it was all because you
didn't want to gamble your game.

1026
01:04:51,015 --> 01:04:53,174
But to win my vote tonight,

1027
01:04:53,275 --> 01:04:55,254
you might have to do just that.

1028
01:04:57,835 --> 01:05:00,894
So I have a bag here
with four rocks in it.

1029
01:05:04,055 --> 01:05:08,294
Three of those rocks are black
and one of those rocks is white.

1030
01:05:08,395 --> 01:05:10,414
And that white rock represents you.

1031
01:05:11,775 --> 01:05:13,894
So I'm gonna propose
an opportunity to you.

1032
01:05:15,955 --> 01:05:20,854
Would you rather back your game and
back your performance here tonight

1033
01:05:20,955 --> 01:05:22,454
and you can try and convince me

1034
01:05:22,595 --> 01:05:24,814
as to why I should write your name down?

1035
01:05:26,555 --> 01:05:28,394
Or would you like to gamble...

1036
01:05:31,015 --> 01:05:33,054
..and when I go to vote tonight,

1037
01:05:33,155 --> 01:05:34,814
if I draw that white rock,

1038
01:05:34,915 --> 01:05:37,454
I will 100%...

1039
01:05:37,555 --> 01:05:39,614
..vote your name?

1040
01:05:39,715 --> 01:05:41,174
What?

1041
01:05:49,215 --> 01:05:51,414
Uh, so, uh...

1042
01:05:53,355 --> 01:05:55,974
Go to rocks.

1043
01:05:57,555 --> 01:06:00,014
Can I sit on it, or do you
want an answer right now?

1044
01:06:00,115 --> 01:06:01,654
I want an answer right now.

1045
01:06:05,635 --> 01:06:10,014
Uh... Oh!

1046
01:06:25,497 --> 01:06:28,376
I have a bag here with four rocks in it.

1047
01:06:28,477 --> 01:06:31,016
And one of those rocks is white.

1048
01:06:31,117 --> 01:06:33,216
And that white rock represents you.

1049
01:06:35,157 --> 01:06:37,736
Would you rather back your game,

1050
01:06:37,837 --> 01:06:39,916
or would you like to gamble...

1051
01:06:41,077 --> 01:06:45,136
..and be guaranteed a 25% chance
that I'm gonna write your name down?

1052
01:06:45,237 --> 01:06:47,056
What?

1053
01:06:52,277 --> 01:06:55,296
Uh... Oh!

1054
01:06:55,437 --> 01:06:57,636
It's hard! It's a hard one!

1055
01:06:58,757 --> 01:07:02,416
Hat off to you, brother.
That's incredible. I love it.

1056
01:07:02,557 --> 01:07:07,416
Part of me is thinking, because I
convinced you not to go to rocks

1057
01:07:07,557 --> 01:07:09,336
that, what the hell, you
know, go, gamble it.

1058
01:07:11,637 --> 01:07:14,216
But the other part of me
thinks I want to back myself.

1059
01:07:15,657 --> 01:07:19,136
I take real pride in the way
that I've played this game.

1060
01:07:20,317 --> 01:07:22,296
Uh, so, uh...

1061
01:07:24,177 --> 01:07:27,016
Go to rocks.

1062
01:07:28,637 --> 01:07:32,016
I'm not a gambling person.
You might be. But I really am not.

1063
01:07:34,557 --> 01:07:38,216
But I feel like luck's
on my side tonight.

1064
01:07:41,517 --> 01:07:45,416
But I lost by one vote
the last time I played.

1065
01:07:46,817 --> 01:07:48,576
So...

1066
01:07:48,677 --> 01:07:50,696
..maybe I put faith in my game, AK.

1067
01:07:52,617 --> 01:07:55,016
Yeah. I don't want a 25% chance.

1068
01:07:55,157 --> 01:07:57,376
And I hope that you can see
everything that I've done

1069
01:07:57,477 --> 01:07:58,996
in this game to get me here.

1070
01:07:59,077 --> 01:08:00,336
Yep.

1071
01:08:00,477 --> 01:08:02,237
I respect your decision.
Do you respect that?

1072
01:08:02,317 --> 01:08:04,636
I respect you as a game player.
I've said it from day one.

1073
01:08:05,937 --> 01:08:08,736
When I was asked who the biggest
threat coming into All Stars was,

1074
01:08:08,837 --> 01:08:10,336
I said, "Sharn is."

1075
01:08:10,477 --> 01:08:12,517
And I think you sitting there
tonight has proven it.

1076
01:08:17,877 --> 01:08:19,936
Golden God.
Hi.

1077
01:08:20,077 --> 01:08:23,496
As Sharn said, you know, she has
played 100 days in this game

1078
01:08:23,597 --> 01:08:25,216
and she's made it to the end twice.

1079
01:08:25,357 --> 01:08:29,376
So, I want to know why you think
Sharn shouldn't win again.

1080
01:08:32,177 --> 01:08:33,896
I think I played a better game.

1081
01:08:35,897 --> 01:08:38,896
And I was the idol king.

1082
01:08:40,017 --> 01:08:43,016
I kept two idols in the game for 19 days

1083
01:08:43,117 --> 01:08:45,256
without having to play one.

1084
01:08:45,397 --> 01:08:48,056
I had you play an idol for
me at the start of the game.

1085
01:08:48,157 --> 01:08:51,176
I had Mat play an idol for Jacqui.

1086
01:08:51,317 --> 01:08:53,656
I played an idol for
my main man, Tarzan.

1087
01:08:55,037 --> 01:08:56,896
But at no point during the game

1088
01:08:57,037 --> 01:09:00,296
did I actually need to
play an idol for myself.

1089
01:09:01,517 --> 01:09:05,736
I managed to use my social game
and my important relationships

1090
01:09:05,837 --> 01:09:07,576
to help me get to the end.

1091
01:09:12,897 --> 01:09:14,496
Um, Sharn...

1092
01:09:14,597 --> 01:09:15,696
Harry.

1093
01:09:15,797 --> 01:09:18,616
..uh, on several occasions,

1094
01:09:18,757 --> 01:09:22,096
there were moments where
you sort of pulled out

1095
01:09:22,197 --> 01:09:24,216
of new alliances being formed.

1096
01:09:27,237 --> 01:09:30,356
And it is destructive.

1097
01:09:31,877 --> 01:09:33,896
I'd like you to comment on that idea

1098
01:09:34,037 --> 01:09:36,416
of, like, destructive
versus constructive.

1099
01:09:39,097 --> 01:09:42,216
Well, I think, there, it is
destructive AND constructive.

1100
01:09:42,357 --> 01:09:46,496
That is, uh, me thinking
about my options,

1101
01:09:46,637 --> 01:09:51,096
getting options out there so I can
change direction if I need to

1102
01:09:51,237 --> 01:09:54,416
or if I feel like I need to
move with a different alliance.

1103
01:09:54,557 --> 01:09:56,157
And it was a deliberate
thing to do that.

1104
01:09:56,277 --> 01:09:59,656
I just want to know if you think
that that was a smart strategy,

1105
01:09:59,797 --> 01:10:02,376
considering you lied to a
lot of us here on the jury

1106
01:10:02,517 --> 01:10:04,376
and we're all gonna determine your fate.

1107
01:10:06,197 --> 01:10:07,976
The damage that I've done along the way

1108
01:10:08,117 --> 01:10:10,376
was required because of the
game that I was playing.

1109
01:10:10,477 --> 01:10:12,456
That's why I was playing the middle,

1110
01:10:12,557 --> 01:10:14,016
because if something happened,

1111
01:10:14,157 --> 01:10:16,176
I was ready to shift,
I was ready to adapt.

1112
01:10:16,317 --> 01:10:18,976
So then when I had to make a
move, that's what I had to do,

1113
01:10:19,117 --> 01:10:20,877
I had to lie to that
person to make the move.

1114
01:10:23,437 --> 01:10:26,436
It was a smart strategy
because I'm sitting here now.

1115
01:10:26,557 --> 01:10:31,076
To me, it seems like you're focused
so much on getting to the top two...

1116
01:10:32,797 --> 01:10:34,896
..rather than the damage
you do to the jury.

1117
01:10:39,357 --> 01:10:40,997
You've done a lot of
damage along the way.

1118
01:10:45,490 --> 01:10:46,869
Can I ask you a question, Sharn?

1119
01:10:46,970 --> 01:10:47,970
Yes, sure, Tarzan.

1120
01:10:48,090 --> 01:10:51,009
That particular Tribal Council
that nearly went to rocks...

1121
01:10:52,670 --> 01:10:54,649
..when you came back
from the second vote,

1122
01:10:54,730 --> 01:10:56,949
you told me to vote for Mo.

1123
01:10:57,090 --> 01:11:00,109
And then when we got back
to camp, you denied it.

1124
01:11:01,690 --> 01:11:03,229
Why would you do that?

1125
01:11:08,090 --> 01:11:11,509
Yeah, I just wanted to test you,
to see where your loyalties were.

1126
01:11:14,650 --> 01:11:17,469
But I could've voted her out.
No, if you had done that,

1127
01:11:17,610 --> 01:11:19,189
then that would've, no...
Shit.

1128
01:11:19,290 --> 01:11:20,869
But she'd have gone home.

1129
01:11:23,470 --> 01:11:25,429
What I wanted was Jacqui to go.

1130
01:11:27,170 --> 01:11:28,869
And we'd had some
conversations, Tarzan,

1131
01:11:29,010 --> 01:11:30,949
and I just didn't know...
Not against Mo.

1132
01:11:31,050 --> 01:11:32,189
Never.

1133
01:11:34,630 --> 01:11:38,189
So, you wanted to risk my game

1134
01:11:38,290 --> 01:11:41,009
to test Tarzan's trust?

1135
01:11:41,090 --> 01:11:43,269
No. I didn't. I didn't.

1136
01:11:43,410 --> 01:11:45,069
I didn't want to risk your game,
Moana.

1137
01:11:45,210 --> 01:11:47,749
I didn't think he would do it.
I wanted to test that out.

1138
01:11:49,250 --> 01:11:51,149
So, now it had a dual purpose.

1139
01:11:55,370 --> 01:11:58,109
It d... Well, if he did vote for Mo,
if he did vote for you,

1140
01:11:58,250 --> 01:12:00,389
and you did go,
then that would've happened.

1141
01:12:03,570 --> 01:12:05,469
But if you want to make a move,
you have to own it.

1142
01:12:05,610 --> 01:12:07,509
This is All Stars.
Like, own your moves.

1143
01:12:09,810 --> 01:12:12,909
I am. I'm-I'm saying to Tarzan
it had a dual purpose.

1144
01:12:13,050 --> 01:12:15,949
My...my strategy was
Jacqui going that night.

1145
01:12:17,330 --> 01:12:21,989
I learnt that Jacqui wanted to vote
Zach out, that she was gonna flip.

1146
01:12:22,130 --> 01:12:24,949
I weighed up whether or not
I should stand in the way

1147
01:12:25,050 --> 01:12:27,229
or let the vote go through.

1148
01:12:27,370 --> 01:12:30,789
Now, for me, I could see how close
Zach and Dave were.

1149
01:12:30,930 --> 01:12:33,829
I knew Dave had an idol
that he could've played for Zach

1150
01:12:33,970 --> 01:12:35,789
and saved him,
but I didn't say anything.

1151
01:12:35,890 --> 01:12:37,669
I was silent.

1152
01:12:37,810 --> 01:12:41,629
So, your big move ultimately
became my biggest covert blindside.

1153
01:12:44,610 --> 01:12:48,349
Just to clarify, you're saying
your biggest move in this game

1154
01:12:48,450 --> 01:12:50,629
is a move that you did nothing on?

1155
01:12:56,750 --> 01:12:59,469
Sometimes an omission
or not doing something

1156
01:12:59,570 --> 01:13:01,149
can be a big move.

1157
01:13:01,250 --> 01:13:02,629
Like, sometimes there are big moves,

1158
01:13:02,770 --> 01:13:04,469
but other times there are subtleties,

1159
01:13:04,610 --> 01:13:07,509
to know when to be restrained,
to know when to go big.

1160
01:13:07,650 --> 01:13:11,149
I wanted to work
quietly, and I did that.

1161
01:13:12,330 --> 01:13:14,829
I think it's a brilliant move,
to be able to do it in that way.

1162
01:13:16,130 --> 01:13:17,949
Keep owning that.

1163
01:13:18,050 --> 01:13:19,109
Sorry?

1164
01:13:19,250 --> 01:13:21,309
Keep owning that.
Yeah. Thanks, Harry.

1165
01:13:23,470 --> 01:13:25,809
You're sort of talking about the
big moves, you want the big moves,

1166
01:13:25,890 --> 01:13:27,949
but doing it in such a way

1167
01:13:28,090 --> 01:13:31,609
that other people
don't have a chance to then rebuild,

1168
01:13:31,690 --> 01:13:33,809
it's still really powerful,

1169
01:13:33,890 --> 01:13:36,349
taking advantage of a situation.

1170
01:13:36,450 --> 01:13:38,749
That's what she did.

1171
01:13:42,330 --> 01:13:44,229
Moana, do you have any questions?

1172
01:13:48,530 --> 01:13:50,149
Dave.
Yep.

1173
01:13:52,250 --> 01:13:54,509
I hold nothing against you
for voting me out last night...

1174
01:13:56,090 --> 01:13:58,109
..even though I feel like
it was a little bit weak.

1175
01:13:59,830 --> 01:14:03,509
You know, you sat next to me
Tribal in, Tribal out,

1176
01:14:03,650 --> 01:14:05,589
saying,
"I want to be with the best,"

1177
01:14:05,690 --> 01:14:08,949
and then you had my torch snuffed

1178
01:14:09,090 --> 01:14:10,809
because you didn't want
to compete against me.

1179
01:14:12,650 --> 01:14:15,629
But I understand that
you have to put your family first.

1180
01:14:18,730 --> 01:14:22,309
But you took away my dream, and that
was to take care of my family.

1181
01:14:24,270 --> 01:14:26,389
So, I need to ask you a question.

1182
01:14:31,250 --> 01:14:32,829
Were you worried
I played a bigger game?

1183
01:14:38,770 --> 01:14:40,389
Was a super hard decision, man.

1184
01:14:42,610 --> 01:14:44,629
It ended up being a
selfish decision, Mo.

1185
01:14:44,770 --> 01:14:46,529
I felt like sitting here
with you at the end

1186
01:14:46,610 --> 01:14:48,189
would be detrimental to my game.

1187
01:14:50,190 --> 01:14:52,989
You had a really good chance
of taking votes away from me.

1188
01:14:55,970 --> 01:14:59,589
Whilst my heart was with you
and hurts for you and your family...

1189
01:15:01,190 --> 01:15:03,229
..it gave me the best
chance to win the game.

1190
01:15:05,730 --> 01:15:07,989
It is Sole Survivor,
unfortunately, Momo.

1191
01:15:08,130 --> 01:15:10,269
And, um, that's why I made the choice.

1192
01:15:11,630 --> 01:15:13,389
Cool. OK.

1193
01:15:14,550 --> 01:15:19,589
Um, I need to know exactly
why you need my vote

1194
01:15:19,730 --> 01:15:23,869
and that half a million
dollars that we all wanted.

1195
01:15:28,210 --> 01:15:31,909
Uh, guys, um, tough game.

1196
01:15:32,050 --> 01:15:36,829
I'm sitting in a position
that you all deserve to sit in.

1197
01:15:36,930 --> 01:15:38,789
Everyone was such a big player.

1198
01:15:38,930 --> 01:15:41,529
I learnt so much from all your games,

1199
01:15:41,610 --> 01:15:43,749
about social game play,

1200
01:15:43,850 --> 01:15:45,709
about physical game play,

1201
01:15:45,810 --> 01:15:47,309
about being yourself,

1202
01:15:47,410 --> 01:15:50,249
not being frightened to play.

1203
01:15:52,330 --> 01:15:56,349
But I think I had big hands in
putting all you guys on the jury.

1204
01:15:57,810 --> 01:16:00,629
When it came to Harry,
I really wanted Harry out.

1205
01:16:00,770 --> 01:16:02,669
Harry was a massive threat
to my game last time.

1206
01:16:02,770 --> 01:16:04,169
He blindsided me.

1207
01:16:05,730 --> 01:16:08,029
Zach, uh, he was a big
part of my endgame,

1208
01:16:08,130 --> 01:16:10,789
but got taken out.

1209
01:16:10,930 --> 01:16:14,389
And then I really wanted to get some
revenge on Jacqui because of Zach.

1210
01:16:14,530 --> 01:16:16,629
That was definitely an idea I floated.

1211
01:16:17,830 --> 01:16:19,789
I pitched AK to you guys multiple times,

1212
01:16:19,930 --> 01:16:23,029
and I drove that vote forward as well.

1213
01:16:23,170 --> 01:16:26,549
Getting Shonee out of the game
was huge, huge challenge threat.

1214
01:16:26,650 --> 01:16:28,989
And gives the best evils.

1215
01:16:29,130 --> 01:16:31,909
I won the individual immunity
that sent Brooke home.

1216
01:16:33,410 --> 01:16:36,529
And then Mo, I made the choice
for Sharn to sit here.

1217
01:16:36,670 --> 01:16:39,469
She didn't convince me of nothing.
I made that choice.

1218
01:16:39,610 --> 01:16:41,889
And I've been making these choices
through merge.

1219
01:16:42,010 --> 01:16:44,829
I'm not here being like, "I'm
the best player that ever played."

1220
01:16:44,970 --> 01:16:48,189
Everyone had a part
in people going home.

1221
01:16:49,490 --> 01:16:51,789
But I could be the loudest voice
when I needed to.

1222
01:16:53,530 --> 01:16:56,549
I hope I'm the Sole Survivor
that All Stars deserves.

1223
01:16:57,910 --> 01:17:00,189
It was an honour
to play with you guys.

1224
01:17:01,330 --> 01:17:04,149
And I owe you all
a debt of gratitude.

1225
01:17:11,050 --> 01:17:12,389
Alright, guys.

1226
01:17:12,530 --> 01:17:14,549
Well, you should have
more than enough information now

1227
01:17:14,690 --> 01:17:17,829
to decide who you think
deserves the title of Sole Survivor

1228
01:17:17,970 --> 01:17:20,549
and the half million dollars
that goes with it.

1229
01:17:22,630 --> 01:17:24,989
Remember, tonight you are
voting for a winner.

1230
01:17:26,650 --> 01:17:28,029
For the last time...

1231
01:17:29,930 --> 01:17:31,789
..it is time to vote.

1232
01:17:45,984 --> 01:17:47,143
Alright, guys.

1233
01:17:47,284 --> 01:17:49,303
Well, you should have more
than enough information now

1234
01:17:49,444 --> 01:17:52,643
to decide who you think
deserves the title of Sole Survivor

1235
01:17:52,764 --> 01:17:55,183
and the half million dollars
that goes with it.

1236
01:17:57,304 --> 01:18:00,103
Remember, tonight you are
voting for a winner.

1237
01:18:03,184 --> 01:18:04,663
For the last time...

1238
01:18:06,084 --> 01:18:07,823
..it is time to vote.

1239
01:18:10,104 --> 01:18:11,303
Locky, you're up.

1240
01:19:53,244 --> 01:19:55,363
I'll go count the votes.

1241
01:20:17,964 --> 01:20:21,783
Well, there's no doubt this season
was played at the highest level...

1242
01:20:23,004 --> 01:20:27,383
..proving why you guys were chosen
as Australia's first All Stars.

1243
01:20:29,284 --> 01:20:32,663
Sharn, David, congratulations
on an incredible game.

1244
01:20:34,924 --> 01:20:38,263
All that's left to do now
is read the votes...

1245
01:20:41,364 --> 01:20:43,343
..which I'm gonna do
back in Australia.

1246
01:20:44,804 --> 01:20:46,543
Wow.

1247
01:20:47,844 --> 01:20:50,223
I'll see you guys there.
See ya, Jonathan.

1248
01:20:50,364 --> 01:20:52,183
See ya, Jon.
Oh.

1249
01:20:54,084 --> 01:20:56,343
Wow.

1250
01:21:23,464 --> 01:21:25,183
Good evening! G'day, guys.

1251
01:21:25,324 --> 01:21:26,663
Evening.
Hello.

1252
01:21:26,764 --> 01:21:28,143
Good evening. I'm Osher Gunsberg.

1253
01:21:28,284 --> 01:21:30,703
I am sure you weren't expecting
to see me here.

1254
01:21:30,804 --> 01:21:33,503
Don't worry, this is indeed

1255
01:21:33,644 --> 01:21:37,143
the grand finale
of Australian Survivor: All Stars.

1256
01:21:37,284 --> 01:21:39,983
And fear not,
I am not here to count roses.

1257
01:21:40,084 --> 01:21:41,823
I'm not even here to count any votes.

1258
01:21:41,964 --> 01:21:45,143
Jonathan, will do that.
He'll be joining us shortly.

1259
01:21:45,284 --> 01:21:48,623
Just like you, we are doing our best
during this pandemic.

1260
01:21:48,764 --> 01:21:52,623
But nothing was gonna stop us
from making this show,

1261
01:21:52,764 --> 01:21:55,803
even the fact that a few people
can't be here in person,

1262
01:21:55,944 --> 01:21:59,503
including one of our final two,
Sharn,

1263
01:21:59,644 --> 01:22:02,823
who is joining us
from her home in Melbourne.

1264
01:22:02,964 --> 01:22:05,823
Sharn, g'day.
I'm glad you guys are here. Welcome.

1265
01:22:05,924 --> 01:22:07,343
Hi.

1266
01:22:07,484 --> 01:22:11,583
And the man that
even I wanted to see standing here,

1267
01:22:11,724 --> 01:22:15,023
Mr Survivor himself,
Jonathan LaPaglia,

1268
01:22:15,164 --> 01:22:17,703
joining us via satellite
from Los Angeles, California.

1269
01:22:17,804 --> 01:22:19,303
Jonathan, good evening.

1270
01:22:19,444 --> 01:22:22,343
Hey, hi, everyone.

1271
01:22:22,444 --> 01:22:24,143
How's it going over there, Jonathan?

1272
01:22:24,284 --> 01:22:28,063
Oh, look, it's, uh,
it's pretty strange.

1273
01:22:28,204 --> 01:22:31,303
I mean, the whole town
is locked down right now.

1274
01:22:31,444 --> 01:22:34,063
But I'm super bummed
I can't be there tonight.

1275
01:22:34,204 --> 01:22:36,903
This is my favourite part
of the show.

1276
01:22:37,044 --> 01:22:38,943
I mean, I don't know about you,
Osher,

1277
01:22:39,084 --> 01:22:42,583
but I love grilling the contestants
about their game-play

1278
01:22:42,684 --> 01:22:44,343
and watching them squirm.

1279
01:22:44,484 --> 01:22:48,343
So I'm gonna leave that in
your capable hands tonight. Enjoy.

1280
01:22:48,484 --> 01:22:53,423
However, there was no way
I was gonna let this pandemic

1281
01:22:53,524 --> 01:22:56,503
separate me from this.

1282
01:22:56,644 --> 01:22:59,743
I have the votes.

1283
01:22:59,884 --> 01:23:04,623
Now, when we decided
to put 24 All Stars on the island,

1284
01:23:04,724 --> 01:23:06,383
we knew it was gonna be great.

1285
01:23:06,484 --> 01:23:08,383
But thanks to you guys,

1286
01:23:08,524 --> 01:23:14,423
we ended up with the best season
of Australian Survivor so far,

1287
01:23:14,524 --> 01:23:16,263
without a doubt.

1288
01:23:20,484 --> 01:23:22,523
David and Sharn,

1289
01:23:22,644 --> 01:23:26,343
you two have done what
no-one else could do,

1290
01:23:26,444 --> 01:23:28,303
you have made it to the end.

1291
01:23:28,444 --> 01:23:32,343
And in doing so,
you put nine people on the jury,

1292
01:23:32,484 --> 01:23:34,883
which might be
the most difficult part of Survivor

1293
01:23:35,004 --> 01:23:41,163
because ultimately it is the jury
who will decide who wins this game.

1294
01:23:41,304 --> 01:23:46,463
And a jury of All Stars
was never gonna be easy to please.

1295
01:23:47,904 --> 01:23:52,883
David, how would you sum up
this season of All Stars?

1296
01:23:53,004 --> 01:23:56,583
It was, uh, hard,
understatement of the year.

1297
01:23:56,724 --> 01:23:59,783
I think everyone
came to just play hard.

1298
01:23:59,924 --> 01:24:03,983
And you saw the result, it just
ended up being an amazing season.

1299
01:24:04,084 --> 01:24:06,183
I think we were operating at a level

1300
01:24:06,324 --> 01:24:09,063
where every player
was bringing their A game,

1301
01:24:09,204 --> 01:24:11,163
and that's what
we've been left with here.

1302
01:24:12,524 --> 01:24:16,623
Sharn, what does it mean
to get all the way to the end

1303
01:24:16,724 --> 01:24:19,623
playing against 23 other All Stars?

1304
01:24:19,724 --> 01:24:22,743
Jonathan, it means everything to me.

1305
01:24:22,884 --> 01:24:28,143
To be able to sit here a second
time, I'm super proud of my effort.

1306
01:24:28,284 --> 01:24:30,943
And, yeah, it means the world
to be here in this position, again.

1307
01:24:31,084 --> 01:24:34,983
But on an All Star season,
even better. It's awesome.

1308
01:24:35,124 --> 01:24:41,103
So, Will, did you know that your mum
is the only person in Australia

1309
01:24:41,204 --> 01:24:44,823
to play Survivor for 100 days?

1310
01:24:44,924 --> 01:24:47,023
Yes, I was well aware.

1311
01:24:47,164 --> 01:24:49,183
She's a great player and I don't know
how she's done it twice,

1312
01:24:49,284 --> 01:24:50,663
but she's done it.

1313
01:24:50,804 --> 01:24:52,783
And I'm proud of her,
regardless if she wins or loses.

1314
01:24:53,924 --> 01:24:55,463
Pretty amazing.

1315
01:24:55,604 --> 01:25:00,263
Rei, what did you think
about how your dad played All Stars?

1316
01:25:00,404 --> 01:25:05,823
Um, well, at first
I was, like, really shocked

1317
01:25:05,924 --> 01:25:08,103
and then, um...

1318
01:25:08,204 --> 01:25:10,063
..I was really happy

1319
01:25:10,164 --> 01:25:13,383
that he got into All Stars for him.

1320
01:25:14,484 --> 01:25:15,623
Nice.

1321
01:25:18,044 --> 01:25:21,263
Alright, guys.
Well, the time has come.

1322
01:25:21,404 --> 01:25:25,543
One of you two
is about to be crowned Sole Survivor

1323
01:25:25,684 --> 01:25:28,143
and walk away
with half a million dollars.

1324
01:25:28,284 --> 01:25:31,943
Remember, these votes
are for the win.

1325
01:25:32,044 --> 01:25:34,243
For the last time...

1326
01:25:34,324 --> 01:25:36,863
..I'm gonna read the votes.

1327
01:25:42,764 --> 01:25:44,423
First vote...

1328
01:25:44,524 --> 01:25:52,524
David.

1329
01:25:58,044 --> 01:25:59,983
That's two votes David.

1330
01:26:06,944 --> 01:26:08,343
Sharn.

1331
01:26:09,504 --> 01:26:12,503
Two votes David, one vote Sharn.

1332
01:26:20,704 --> 01:26:22,103
David.

1333
01:26:23,644 --> 01:26:26,463
Three votes David, one vote Sharn.

1334
01:26:35,504 --> 01:26:36,903
David.

1335
01:26:38,304 --> 01:26:41,343
Four votes David, one vote Sharn.

1336
01:26:50,684 --> 01:26:53,323
Winner of
Australian Survivor: All Stars...

1337
01:26:53,444 --> 01:26:55,583
..David.

1338
01:26:58,564 --> 01:26:59,663
Yeah, Dave!

1339
01:27:01,824 --> 01:27:03,483
Yeah, Dave!

1340
01:27:07,704 --> 01:27:09,043
Yeah, Dave!

1341
01:27:17,284 --> 01:27:18,763
David! David!

1342
01:27:18,904 --> 01:27:21,523
Absolutely amazing.
Come here, man. Come here.

1343
01:27:21,624 --> 01:27:23,563
David, you are the Sole Survivor!

1344
01:27:23,664 --> 01:27:27,403
David, you have won $500,000!

1345
01:27:27,544 --> 01:27:29,663
Wowee!

1346
01:27:29,744 --> 01:27:30,963
Oh!

1347
01:27:31,104 --> 01:27:35,003
An All Star season
deservedly won by an all-star player.

1348
01:27:35,104 --> 01:27:36,723
David's proven he is just that.

1349
01:27:36,824 --> 01:27:38,683
Thank you so much, Jonathan,

1350
01:27:38,824 --> 01:27:41,563
for joining us all the way
from Los Angeles.

1351
01:27:41,704 --> 01:27:43,363
Thank you so much, mate.

1352
01:27:43,504 --> 01:27:45,723
Oh, thank you, guys.
Congratulations, David!

1353
01:27:45,864 --> 01:27:48,803
Thanks, brother.
Everyone else, enjoy the show.

1354
01:27:50,024 --> 01:27:52,443
After the break, we will celebrate
all of David's best moments

1355
01:27:52,584 --> 01:27:55,363
and ask those burning questions
on the Reunion Show.

1356
01:27:55,464 --> 01:27:56,883
Don't go anywhere!

1357
01:28:08,936 --> 01:28:10,435
It was kind
of a dream come true

1358
01:28:10,536 --> 01:28:11,995
to come back here to play All Stars.

1359
01:28:13,676 --> 01:28:16,275
I love this game.
I love being a part of the game.

1360
01:28:16,416 --> 01:28:19,675
I love the opportunity
that I got to play it,

1361
01:28:19,776 --> 01:28:22,035
not once but twice.

1362
01:28:28,376 --> 01:28:32,195
I came into this game
with a pretty specific game plan...

1363
01:28:33,336 --> 01:28:36,395
..and that was to make
very unlikely alliances.

1364
01:28:36,576 --> 01:28:39,195
I'm trusting you with this.
Yeah, I'm trusting you
with this, too.

1365
01:28:39,336 --> 01:28:41,115
Alliances that people thought
would never happen.

1366
01:28:41,216 --> 01:28:42,755
We're all good, man.

1367
01:28:42,896 --> 01:28:44,795
- We're gonna get 'em.
- Yeah, we are good.

1368
01:28:44,936 --> 01:28:47,455
And I relied on my social game
to really bring them in.

1369
01:28:47,576 --> 01:28:49,035
We'll keep this one
between us, yeah?

1370
01:28:49,136 --> 01:28:50,555
Yep.

1371
01:28:50,696 --> 01:28:52,755
David, I love him.
I love this game, to be honest.

1372
01:28:52,856 --> 01:28:55,155
He's got his eyes on everything.

1373
01:28:56,356 --> 01:28:57,755
Great at finding idols.

1374
01:28:57,856 --> 01:28:58,995
Yes!

1375
01:28:59,096 --> 01:29:00,515
I think he's a great player.

1376
01:29:03,216 --> 01:29:05,835
I successfully navigated
my way through this game...

1377
01:29:05,976 --> 01:29:07,515
I'm so happy you guys are back.
Oh.

1378
01:29:07,656 --> 01:29:09,755
..because I was able to
adapt myself strategically.

1379
01:29:11,016 --> 01:29:13,115
I made some huge moves
when I needed to.

1380
01:29:13,256 --> 01:29:16,795
Physically, just pushed me to
the edge, every single challenge.

1381
01:29:16,936 --> 01:29:19,835
David determined
to take this reward.

1382
01:29:19,936 --> 01:29:22,235
David giving it everything.

1383
01:29:22,376 --> 01:29:25,555
I wanted to prove that you
can come into Survivor

1384
01:29:25,696 --> 01:29:29,275
and play a big game and still sit
in the final Tribal Council.

1385
01:29:29,416 --> 01:29:32,995
He is right there.
Can he land that ball?

1386
01:29:33,096 --> 01:29:34,675
And he does!

1387
01:29:34,816 --> 01:29:38,315
Yeah, I've played a very
different game this time.

1388
01:29:38,456 --> 01:29:40,195
And I shared great moments with people.

1389
01:29:40,336 --> 01:29:42,475
You know, I wanted to make
genuine relationships.

1390
01:29:42,576 --> 01:29:43,955
Oh, what?

1391
01:29:44,096 --> 01:29:46,955
And because of that, I've been
a part of the strongest alliance

1392
01:29:47,096 --> 01:29:48,595
that Australian Survivor's ever seen.

1393
01:29:48,736 --> 01:29:50,395
It's kind of an
achievement in this game.

1394
01:29:50,496 --> 01:29:52,455
Oh...

1395
01:29:53,736 --> 01:29:56,095
To changing my family's life,

1396
01:29:56,176 --> 01:29:57,875
to realising my dream...

1397
01:29:57,976 --> 01:29:59,475
Hey, come on, baby!

1398
01:29:59,576 --> 01:30:00,995
..I'm so proud.

1399
01:30:01,096 --> 01:30:02,096
Hi, baby!

1400
01:30:02,236 --> 01:30:04,995
I don't think I've played
the perfect game this time,

1401
01:30:05,096 --> 01:30:07,115
but, man, I've been pretty close.

1402
01:30:07,216 --> 01:30:10,095
Vakama!

1403
01:30:16,016 --> 01:30:19,515
All Stars Reunion Show,

1404
01:30:19,656 --> 01:30:23,455
where David has just won
half a million dollars

1405
01:30:23,536 --> 01:30:25,715
and the title of Sole Survivor.

1406
01:30:27,596 --> 01:30:29,315
I am standing in for Jonathan tonight,

1407
01:30:29,456 --> 01:30:33,275
who was unable to travel into
the country at the moment.

1408
01:30:33,376 --> 01:30:35,395
So, David, how do you feel right now?

1409
01:30:35,536 --> 01:30:38,035
I feel really emotional,
actually, Osher.

1410
01:30:38,176 --> 01:30:43,195
I think everyone gave their
heart and soul for this game,

1411
01:30:43,296 --> 01:30:45,075
and I felt like I did the same.

1412
01:30:45,216 --> 01:30:47,915
So, to be able to sit
here as the Sole Survivor

1413
01:30:48,016 --> 01:30:49,675
is a dream come true.

1414
01:30:49,816 --> 01:30:53,235
And it's a dream come true
in front of my family

1415
01:30:53,376 --> 01:30:56,175
and in front of people that are
genuinely close friends of mine.

1416
01:30:56,316 --> 01:31:00,595
And I know out on the beach, we go
hard and we go against each other,

1417
01:31:00,736 --> 01:31:03,755
but this is a second
family for me right here.

1418
01:31:03,896 --> 01:31:05,715
And I just... I'm just so appreciative

1419
01:31:05,816 --> 01:31:07,275
I just can't even put it into words.

1420
01:31:07,416 --> 01:31:09,175
So, talk about game-play for a second.

1421
01:31:09,316 --> 01:31:13,755
In Champions Versus Contenders,
you did play a pretty big game.

1422
01:31:13,856 --> 01:31:15,955
So, coming into All Stars,

1423
01:31:16,096 --> 01:31:18,235
how would you say your
strategy was different?

1424
01:31:18,376 --> 01:31:21,555
I really wanted to
still play a big game.

1425
01:31:21,656 --> 01:31:23,035
I'm a fan of the show.

1426
01:31:23,176 --> 01:31:25,835
And I love seeing that, love
seeing those big players.

1427
01:31:25,976 --> 01:31:27,755
So I didn't want to deviate too much.

1428
01:31:27,896 --> 01:31:31,275
But I think the time I
played Champions/Contenders,

1429
01:31:31,416 --> 01:31:36,715
I was spinning, like, a lot of lies,
just even about my personal life.

1430
01:31:36,856 --> 01:31:41,435
So, what I wanted to do this time
was just to keep my secrets better

1431
01:31:41,536 --> 01:31:44,175
and to improve my relationships.

1432
01:31:44,316 --> 01:31:47,955
I just tried to be as genuine as
possible, make real connections,

1433
01:31:48,096 --> 01:31:50,115
and I think that's the
reason I'm sitting here.

1434
01:31:50,256 --> 01:31:53,755
You gave yourself the
nickname 'the Golden God'.

1435
01:31:53,896 --> 01:31:56,275
Course he did.

1436
01:31:56,416 --> 01:31:58,535
Shonee, what is it like
when you meet someone

1437
01:31:58,676 --> 01:32:00,955
who gives themself
a nickname like that?

1438
01:32:01,096 --> 01:32:03,555
Yeah, I mean, you have to
be pretty full of yourself.

1439
01:32:07,216 --> 01:32:08,635
I kid.

1440
01:32:08,736 --> 01:32:09,835
Do you?

1441
01:32:09,936 --> 01:32:12,075
I dunno!

1442
01:32:12,176 --> 01:32:14,835
Nice one, Shon.

1443
01:32:14,976 --> 01:32:17,255
Brooke, let me ask you this.
Why is it...

1444
01:32:17,376 --> 01:32:20,075
Like, you obviously knew his game
from seeing him play already.

1445
01:32:20,256 --> 01:32:22,795
Why is it that you thought you could trust
him in the early days of All Stars?

1446
01:32:22,936 --> 01:32:26,595
I did trust him. I mean,
he's a charming little thing.

1447
01:32:26,736 --> 01:32:28,555
I was gonna say something else.

1448
01:32:28,656 --> 01:32:30,275
But, um, yeah, I don't know,

1449
01:32:30,416 --> 01:32:32,835
he just works it and he
managed to suck us all in,

1450
01:32:32,936 --> 01:32:34,535
as much as I hate to admit it.

1451
01:32:34,616 --> 01:32:35,616
Oh!

1452
01:32:35,696 --> 01:32:37,675
I hate it.

1453
01:32:37,816 --> 01:32:40,475
David, sitting next to
Sharn in the final Tribal

1454
01:32:40,616 --> 01:32:43,895
was never going to be easy
because she has done it before.

1455
01:32:43,976 --> 01:32:44,976
Mmm.

1456
01:32:45,016 --> 01:32:47,515
What was your strategy
going into that final Tribal?

1457
01:32:47,616 --> 01:32:49,955
I think, going into final Tribal,

1458
01:32:50,096 --> 01:32:52,155
I felt like Sharn having
sat there before,

1459
01:32:52,256 --> 01:32:53,955
gave her a good experience.

1460
01:32:54,096 --> 01:32:58,035
But, for me, having sat on a jury
gave me just as much experience.

1461
01:32:58,136 --> 01:33:01,835
So when it came to reading the room

1462
01:33:01,976 --> 01:33:04,435
and knowing kind of what a jury wants,

1463
01:33:04,576 --> 01:33:06,275
I actually feel like I
had an advantage there,

1464
01:33:06,416 --> 01:33:10,255
just because Sharn hasn't had
that chance to be in Jury Villa.

1465
01:33:11,656 --> 01:33:16,515
Well, Sharn has played twice,
made it all the way both times.

1466
01:33:16,656 --> 01:33:20,275
And this is how she got
to the end on All Stars.

1467
01:33:24,256 --> 01:33:25,955
I definitely came into Survivor

1468
01:33:26,056 --> 01:33:28,155
the second time for redemption.

1469
01:33:28,296 --> 01:33:29,915
Oh!
A fire pit!

1470
01:33:30,056 --> 01:33:32,675
But I knew that coming
in to play All Stars,

1471
01:33:32,776 --> 01:33:34,715
I had a huge target on my back.

1472
01:33:34,856 --> 01:33:38,475
So, my game plan this
time has been subtle...

1473
01:33:38,616 --> 01:33:42,255
If Dave does something weird
like play his idol for Tarzy,

1474
01:33:42,396 --> 01:33:44,895
then everyone goes on Dave, saves me.

1475
01:33:44,976 --> 01:33:46,715
..making huge moves, but covertly...

1476
01:33:46,856 --> 01:33:50,355
You and you, I got your
back till the very end.

1477
01:33:50,496 --> 01:33:53,195
..so I can cement the
relationships I have in this game

1478
01:33:53,336 --> 01:33:55,635
so that they can feel like they
can trust me, moving forward.

1479
01:33:58,276 --> 01:33:59,995
OK.
Oh, my God.

1480
01:34:00,136 --> 01:34:01,755
Sharn is so good at playing both sides

1481
01:34:01,896 --> 01:34:03,515
and convincing you that she is with you.

1482
01:34:06,856 --> 01:34:09,715
Sharn, the best player to play
the game that hasn't won,

1483
01:34:09,816 --> 01:34:11,195
without a doubt.

1484
01:34:12,976 --> 01:34:14,395
But, at the same time,

1485
01:34:14,536 --> 01:34:16,995
I have made some real connections
out there, real friendships.

1486
01:34:17,136 --> 01:34:20,155
Your shells will be sparkly clean!
I can see my own reflection in it!

1487
01:34:20,256 --> 01:34:21,675
What I've missed the most...

1488
01:34:21,776 --> 01:34:22,776
There's my family!

1489
01:34:22,896 --> 01:34:26,475
..is seeing my family every
day, being with them every day.

1490
01:34:26,576 --> 01:34:29,155
I feel incredibly proud of my game.

1491
01:34:29,296 --> 01:34:33,235
I am the first Australian
Survivor to make it to 100 days.

1492
01:34:33,376 --> 01:34:35,515
Sharn gets to the buoy first.

1493
01:34:35,616 --> 01:34:37,755
I'm owning that. That's mine.

1494
01:34:37,856 --> 01:34:39,275
Take a wild shot.

1495
01:34:39,416 --> 01:34:41,355
And lands it!

1496
01:34:41,456 --> 01:34:42,675
Yeah, baby!

1497
01:34:42,816 --> 01:34:45,355
It's been a great experience.
I've absolutely loved it.

1498
01:34:45,456 --> 01:34:48,915
Sharn wins immunity!

1499
01:34:54,936 --> 01:34:59,335
Sharn is the only Australian
player to play 100 days.

1500
01:34:59,456 --> 01:35:03,755
She's won individual immunity
five times across two seasons

1501
01:35:03,896 --> 01:35:08,915
and she's reached the
end of the game twice.

1502
01:35:09,056 --> 01:35:14,075
Sharn, how proud are you of
your Survivor achievements?

1503
01:35:14,176 --> 01:35:16,195
I am so proud, Osher.

1504
01:35:16,336 --> 01:35:18,675
I have always been a fan of Survivor,

1505
01:35:18,816 --> 01:35:21,975
so this is really a
dream come true for me.

1506
01:35:22,096 --> 01:35:25,995
To even play the game for
me is a huge achievement,

1507
01:35:26,136 --> 01:35:29,475
no less to be sitting here and
I've never had my torch snuffed.

1508
01:35:29,616 --> 01:35:31,975
How awesome is that?
It's incredible.

1509
01:35:32,056 --> 01:35:34,995
How was your All Stars game different

1510
01:35:35,136 --> 01:35:37,275
to when first time that
you played Survivor?

1511
01:35:37,416 --> 01:35:41,195
I went in knowing that people
knew I was a really strong player

1512
01:35:41,336 --> 01:35:44,915
and strong strategically and
socially, and physically, too.

1513
01:35:45,016 --> 01:35:46,555
So I had to change tact.

1514
01:35:46,696 --> 01:35:49,975
So I basically exploited the
fact that I could be trusted

1515
01:35:50,056 --> 01:35:52,115
to get myself to the end this time.

1516
01:35:52,256 --> 01:35:55,195
And it worked. I got myself to the end.

1517
01:35:55,336 --> 01:35:57,835
But, unfortunately, I just
couldn't convince that jury.

1518
01:35:57,936 --> 01:36:00,835
Sharn, you made a conscious decision

1519
01:36:00,976 --> 01:36:04,055
to work with David all
the way to the very end.

1520
01:36:04,136 --> 01:36:05,515
Why was that?

1521
01:36:05,656 --> 01:36:08,955
I tried to pitch voting
out David early on

1522
01:36:09,056 --> 01:36:10,995
when the first tribe swap happened,

1523
01:36:11,136 --> 01:36:13,715
and some people didn't want to
take that option at that time.

1524
01:36:13,856 --> 01:36:17,055
So I thought, "OK, well, if
they're not gonna work with me,

1525
01:36:17,136 --> 01:36:18,715
"I'll work with him,"

1526
01:36:18,856 --> 01:36:21,155
and so I ended up
moving in that direction.

1527
01:36:21,296 --> 01:36:24,395
And it paid off because I
made it to final two again.

1528
01:36:25,676 --> 01:36:27,875
Well, regardless of tonight's result,

1529
01:36:28,016 --> 01:36:31,395
Sharn, we cannot forget, no-one
can take this away from you,

1530
01:36:31,536 --> 01:36:34,155
you hold the record of the
most days ever played

1531
01:36:34,296 --> 01:36:37,195
in Australian Survivor
history, 100 days.

1532
01:36:37,296 --> 01:36:41,075
Sharn, massive, massive result.

1533
01:36:42,536 --> 01:36:44,415
So, in a season of All Stars,

1534
01:36:44,536 --> 01:36:47,235
it wasn't just the players
who dialled things up.

1535
01:36:47,376 --> 01:36:50,595
The challenges, the challenges
were more brutal than ever.

1536
01:36:50,696 --> 01:36:52,475
We'll take a look at those next

1537
01:36:52,616 --> 01:36:55,875
and we'll be dishing up the 'Shontent'

1538
01:36:55,976 --> 01:36:58,555
with fan favourite Shonee.

1539
01:36:58,656 --> 01:37:00,195
We'll be right back.

1540
01:37:05,740 --> 01:37:07,231
Survivors, ready...

1541
01:37:08,814 --> 01:37:10,819
..go!

1542
01:37:10,819 --> 01:37:13,524
Oh, right out of the
gate, they're into it.

1543
01:37:13,524 --> 01:37:14,961
Get him! Get him, Lock!

1544
01:37:15,207 --> 01:37:16,860
It is scrappy out there.

1545
01:37:16,860 --> 01:37:21,121
Everyone scrambling to get up
and over that first A-frame.

1546
01:37:21,207 --> 01:37:24,680
This is All Stars.
Push! Come on!

1547
01:37:24,790 --> 01:37:26,717
We've turned it up to 11.

1548
01:37:30,023 --> 01:37:32,104
That's gonna hurt.

1549
01:37:32,104 --> 01:37:33,941
Oh, it is chaos.

1550
01:37:35,790 --> 01:37:38,232
Everyone digging in.

1551
01:37:38,232 --> 01:37:40,598
Everyone's getting exhausted.

1552
01:37:40,598 --> 01:37:43,680
Go, Lydia!
Wow!

1553
01:37:43,680 --> 01:37:46,640
Yeah, Locky, you beast!

1554
01:37:46,640 --> 01:37:48,431
He is a machine.

1555
01:37:48,431 --> 01:37:51,064
Shonee wins immunity!
Whoo!

1556
01:37:51,064 --> 01:37:52,346
Pilates.

1557
01:37:52,346 --> 01:37:55,731
Sharn gets it,
goes for a shot...

1558
01:37:57,033 --> 01:37:58,828
And lands it!

1559
01:37:58,828 --> 01:38:01,245
You little ripper!

1560
01:38:01,245 --> 01:38:02,944
A lot of pressure on Lee.

1561
01:38:02,944 --> 01:38:04,396
No!

1562
01:38:04,396 --> 01:38:05,780
Lee takes a shot.

1563
01:38:05,780 --> 01:38:06,857
It's short.

1564
01:38:06,857 --> 01:38:09,322
Come on, you've got
this, Lee. You've got it.

1565
01:38:09,322 --> 01:38:11,870
Why show that?! Why show that?

1566
01:38:11,870 --> 01:38:13,804
It's all mental now.

1567
01:38:13,804 --> 01:38:16,317
You just need to push through that pain.

1568
01:38:20,427 --> 01:38:24,099
Brooke proving she is a
force to be reckoned with.

1569
01:38:25,203 --> 01:38:27,625
Everyone else trying to catch Brooke.

1570
01:38:28,702 --> 01:38:32,521
And that's it! Brooke wins immunity!

1571
01:38:33,799 --> 01:38:37,316
Brooke wins individual immunity again.

1572
01:38:40,736 --> 01:38:43,389
This is what Survivor's about.

1573
01:38:49,169 --> 01:38:51,614
Agh!
Pull!

1574
01:38:51,639 --> 01:38:54,631
- Aagh!
- Go, go, go, go, go! Pull!

1575
01:38:57,669 --> 01:38:59,798
And that's it!

1576
01:38:59,798 --> 01:39:01,498
Come on!

1577
01:39:04,911 --> 01:39:08,470
All Stars Reunion Show.

1578
01:39:08,551 --> 01:39:10,570
Lee, I've got to ask you straight up,

1579
01:39:10,711 --> 01:39:13,490
compared to the first time
you played this game,

1580
01:39:13,631 --> 01:39:16,570
how would you describe the challenges
you faced in All Stars?

1581
01:39:16,671 --> 01:39:18,770
They were absolutely hectic.

1582
01:39:18,911 --> 01:39:22,170
Those first couple of weeks, I don't
think we knew what we were in for,

1583
01:39:22,311 --> 01:39:27,410
um, apart from, you know,
some throwing mishaps on my behalf.

1584
01:39:27,551 --> 01:39:29,170
Yeah, I loved every...

1585
01:39:29,311 --> 01:39:30,970
That's what I lived for.
I lived for the challenges.

1586
01:39:31,111 --> 01:39:33,370
And to come up against
these big rigs, these big units,

1587
01:39:33,471 --> 01:39:35,130
I'm still recovering from it, mate.

1588
01:39:35,271 --> 01:39:37,370
Yeah, I was gonna ask about that.
Yeah.

1589
01:39:37,511 --> 01:39:39,730
You were a professional
cricket player...

1590
01:39:39,831 --> 01:39:41,210
Ex, ex, yeah.

1591
01:39:41,311 --> 01:39:42,970
..professional cricket player,

1592
01:39:43,111 --> 01:39:47,050
uh, struggling to get those balls
in the goal there.

1593
01:39:47,151 --> 01:39:48,530
Rub it in.

1594
01:39:48,671 --> 01:39:50,770
Did the tribe
give you any stick for that?

1595
01:39:50,911 --> 01:39:52,410
I honestly thought
I was gonna get voted off.

1596
01:39:52,551 --> 01:39:54,770
That's how hectic I thought
the game was gonna be.

1597
01:39:54,911 --> 01:39:57,250
I thought, "They're gonna be
ruthless, I'm gonna be outta there."

1598
01:39:57,351 --> 01:39:58,730
And so I thought, "You know what?

1599
01:39:58,831 --> 01:40:00,370
"I'll just go for a walk here,

1600
01:40:00,511 --> 01:40:03,170
"just go missing for a while and let
some other names come forward."

1601
01:40:03,271 --> 01:40:05,170
So, yeah, managed to get through it.

1602
01:40:05,311 --> 01:40:08,130
Well, you didn't get voted off, but
you did get a nickname, didn't you?

1603
01:40:08,271 --> 01:40:10,210
Uh, 'Custard Arm
Carseldine', which is...

1604
01:40:10,311 --> 01:40:11,610
..it hurts.

1605
01:40:11,751 --> 01:40:13,290
It hurts, Osh.

1606
01:40:13,431 --> 01:40:15,970
Thanks to Nick, actually. I gotta
thank Nick for giving me that one.

1607
01:40:16,111 --> 01:40:17,770
Yeah, bit of payback.
Yeah.

1608
01:40:17,911 --> 01:40:20,490
Locky, none of us could possibly forget

1609
01:40:20,591 --> 01:40:24,210
you launching yourself face first

1610
01:40:24,351 --> 01:40:27,830
at those impenetrable
fortresses of sticks.

1611
01:40:27,911 --> 01:40:29,410
What were you thinking?

1612
01:40:29,551 --> 01:40:31,370
Clearly, nothing.

1613
01:40:31,511 --> 01:40:33,330
That's how I do everything,
don't really think too much.

1614
01:40:33,471 --> 01:40:35,830
But, uh, just, yeah,
went headfirst into it

1615
01:40:35,951 --> 01:40:38,370
and just as fast as I could.
Did it hurt?

1616
01:40:38,511 --> 01:40:40,190
Yeah, I've still got, like,
scars on my back from it,

1617
01:40:40,271 --> 01:40:41,890
but, I dunno, it was pretty fun.

1618
01:40:42,031 --> 01:40:44,610
Harry, I have to mention the
challenge we just saw there.

1619
01:40:44,751 --> 01:40:48,290
I do believe
it is called 'Holy Hell'.

1620
01:40:48,391 --> 01:40:50,010
You faced it twice.

1621
01:40:50,151 --> 01:40:52,050
- It beat you twice.
- It did.

1622
01:40:52,151 --> 01:40:54,210
How did it feel when you saw that

1623
01:40:54,351 --> 01:40:56,090
and like,
"Oh, this is what I'm doing today"?

1624
01:40:56,231 --> 01:41:00,690
So, it was either a bit of
horrible curse, horrible luck,

1625
01:41:00,831 --> 01:41:03,930
um, or just
the Survivor gods hate me.

1626
01:41:04,071 --> 01:41:07,330
But the other people
had to share my pain as well,

1627
01:41:07,431 --> 01:41:08,970
so, I guess, if I was gonna go out,

1628
01:41:09,111 --> 01:41:10,690
that's something
to share with everyone.

1629
01:41:10,791 --> 01:41:11,791
Got it.

1630
01:41:11,911 --> 01:41:16,570
Brooke, your challenge performance
was absolutely incredible to watch.

1631
01:41:16,711 --> 01:41:21,330
You won no less than four Individual
Immunity Challenges in this game.

1632
01:41:21,431 --> 01:41:23,210
Was dominating at challenges

1633
01:41:23,351 --> 01:41:25,550
a strategy of yours
when you were going into this?

1634
01:41:25,691 --> 01:41:28,890
No, to be honest, I really wanted
to downplay that side.

1635
01:41:29,031 --> 01:41:30,550
I didn't do a very good job,
clearly.

1636
01:41:30,631 --> 01:41:32,770
I think I'm just too competitive.

1637
01:41:32,911 --> 01:41:36,050
Brooke wasn't the only challenge
beast on the island this year.

1638
01:41:36,191 --> 01:41:40,550
Shonee, you won
two fantastic immunities as well.

1639
01:41:40,671 --> 01:41:42,930
Do you think the people
underestimated you?

1640
01:41:43,071 --> 01:41:44,490
I think they definitely
underestimated me.

1641
01:41:44,631 --> 01:41:46,690
But, you know, you have these
random leisure activities,

1642
01:41:46,831 --> 01:41:51,330
doggy paddling in the pool, Pilates,
but they come in really handy.

1643
01:41:51,471 --> 01:41:53,250
Are you really
expecting me to believe

1644
01:41:53,391 --> 01:41:55,970
that you just doggy paddling
in your local pool

1645
01:41:56,071 --> 01:41:58,570
had you beat the Golden God...

1646
01:41:58,711 --> 01:42:00,910
Yeah.
..who looked like he was drowning?

1647
01:42:01,031 --> 01:42:03,010
Totally.

1648
01:42:03,151 --> 01:42:05,330
I do that all the time with my
friend. I'm just paddling, chatting.

1649
01:42:05,431 --> 01:42:06,930
So I was out there thinking...

1650
01:42:07,071 --> 01:42:08,910
♪ Just keep swimming,
swimming, swimming... ♪

1651
01:42:09,091 --> 01:42:11,290
That was your song
that you were singing?

1652
01:42:11,431 --> 01:42:13,010
Yeah, in my head.
And out loud.

1653
01:42:13,151 --> 01:42:16,910
You tread water for two hours.

1654
01:42:17,031 --> 01:42:18,850
I watch my kid play water polo
every weekend

1655
01:42:18,991 --> 01:42:20,410
and she's treading water
for 24 minutes

1656
01:42:20,551 --> 01:42:22,090
and then she's stuffed
for the rest of the day.

1657
01:42:22,191 --> 01:42:23,570
Well, tell her to try harder.

1658
01:42:26,951 --> 01:42:30,570
Well, challenges
weren't the only thing

1659
01:42:30,671 --> 01:42:33,570
that Shonee wanted to take charge of.

1660
01:42:36,151 --> 01:42:38,370
I'm so glad, you know.
I was not expecting you to be back.

1661
01:42:42,171 --> 01:42:45,490
Shonee is my Survivor spirit animal.

1662
01:42:45,631 --> 01:42:51,450
She is the funniest Survivor
that's ever played.

1663
01:42:55,651 --> 01:42:57,170
I want the strongest players

1664
01:42:57,311 --> 01:42:59,370
physically and strategically
around me.

1665
01:42:59,511 --> 01:43:01,650
Shonee is by far
the weakest link in our tribe.

1666
01:43:01,791 --> 01:43:03,130
Lies.
Yeah, if we want to stay strong

1667
01:43:03,271 --> 01:43:05,290
and actually have a shot at winning
challenges, she's gotta go.

1668
01:43:05,431 --> 01:43:08,330
- John's happy to write Shonee.
- Uh-huh.

1669
01:43:08,431 --> 01:43:10,410
Shonee, you have five votes

1670
01:43:10,511 --> 01:43:12,130
and you're going to Exile tonight.

1671
01:43:14,031 --> 01:43:17,730
It is time to drop your buffs.

1672
01:43:17,871 --> 01:43:21,490
Mokuta tried to vote me out last night.

1673
01:43:21,591 --> 01:43:23,210
But I'm back, bitches.

1674
01:43:24,351 --> 01:43:25,930
Now I'm gonna come after them.

1675
01:43:27,071 --> 01:43:30,090
If you want to weaken
Mokuta, then you keep me.

1676
01:43:30,191 --> 01:43:31,610
Yeah, no, 100%.

1677
01:43:31,751 --> 01:43:35,630
It's a new vote, it's a new tribe.
We've got to win some challenges.

1678
01:43:35,751 --> 01:43:37,930
I've got other people
here, other friends.

1679
01:43:38,031 --> 01:43:39,970
Let's just see what they do tonight.

1680
01:43:40,071 --> 01:43:43,090
I will not stop until I get revenge

1681
01:43:43,191 --> 01:43:45,850
on Abbey, Lydia...

1682
01:43:45,951 --> 01:43:47,570
Lydia, the tribe has spoken.

1683
01:43:47,671 --> 01:43:48,810
..and John.

1684
01:43:48,951 --> 01:43:51,530
John.

1685
01:43:51,631 --> 01:43:53,010
I'm so happy.

1686
01:43:53,111 --> 01:43:55,730
This tribe feels like the pure joy

1687
01:43:55,871 --> 01:43:58,210
of finding a decent margarita
on happy-hour special.

1688
01:43:58,311 --> 01:44:00,210
I love it here.

1689
01:44:01,391 --> 01:44:05,810
Shonee, it appears that hell hath
no fury like Shonee scorned.

1690
01:44:05,951 --> 01:44:09,290
Are you that cold and calculating
in your day-to-day life,

1691
01:44:09,431 --> 01:44:11,010
or is that something that only shows up

1692
01:44:11,151 --> 01:44:12,770
when you're playing for
half a million dollars?

1693
01:44:12,911 --> 01:44:15,170
I am a sweet, innocent
cherub in my real life.

1694
01:44:15,311 --> 01:44:18,450
But when half a million dollars
is definitely on the line,

1695
01:44:18,591 --> 01:44:21,570
then, yeah, the sweet
cherub is out the door.

1696
01:44:21,711 --> 01:44:23,210
Well, that sweet cherub came into play.

1697
01:44:23,351 --> 01:44:25,690
Your social game has been
praised quite a lot.

1698
01:44:25,831 --> 01:44:28,350
How do you go about
getting people on side?

1699
01:44:28,431 --> 01:44:30,410
Just chatting, get to know them.

1700
01:44:30,551 --> 01:44:33,630
You actually do have a lot in common
with people when you get chatting.

1701
01:44:33,711 --> 01:44:35,090
Did you really grow up in Toowoomba?

1702
01:44:35,191 --> 01:44:37,490
Um, no, but I was born there.

1703
01:44:37,631 --> 01:44:39,170
I was born there.

1704
01:44:39,311 --> 01:44:41,630
But I moved when I was, like,
six months old or...yeah.

1705
01:44:41,751 --> 01:44:44,290
The moment you said it, I'm like,
"She totally lied to you."

1706
01:44:44,431 --> 01:44:47,690
I know about the Carnival
of Flowers, so...

1707
01:44:47,831 --> 01:44:51,810
Uh, John, you were on the
receiving end of Shonee's wrath.

1708
01:44:51,911 --> 01:44:53,450
What was it like to be there?

1709
01:44:53,591 --> 01:44:55,810
Mate, we bit off more
than we could chew, eh.

1710
01:44:55,911 --> 01:44:57,490
Her social game was unbelievable.

1711
01:44:57,631 --> 01:45:00,130
She was probably thrown a little
bit of a bone with the Exile,

1712
01:45:00,271 --> 01:45:02,690
but the way she came back
was just unbelievable.

1713
01:45:02,831 --> 01:45:06,730
Then became a challenge
beast as well, so hats off.

1714
01:45:06,871 --> 01:45:08,650
Well, in a moment, we're gonna look back

1715
01:45:08,791 --> 01:45:11,170
at the most jaw-dropping
moments from Tribal Council

1716
01:45:11,311 --> 01:45:14,450
and we will get to the bottom
of that epic alliance

1717
01:45:14,591 --> 01:45:18,090
between the Golden God
and the Godfather.

1718
01:45:30,243 --> 01:45:34,262
I'm happy to flip on Zachy
boy, but it'll upset the alliance.

1719
01:45:34,363 --> 01:45:36,382
But I have to think about my game.

1720
01:45:36,483 --> 01:45:38,582
We tried to pitch Jacqui to Zach

1721
01:45:38,683 --> 01:45:40,222
and pitch Zach to Jacqui,

1722
01:45:40,363 --> 01:45:42,382
and we got caught out.
They're not gonna crack.

1723
01:45:47,043 --> 01:45:48,982
Third member of our jury...

1724
01:45:49,083 --> 01:45:50,342
..Zach.

1725
01:45:55,243 --> 01:45:58,982
Right now my best option
is to blindside Flick.

1726
01:45:59,123 --> 01:46:02,262
But if I have a skerrick of a doubt
in my mind,

1727
01:46:02,363 --> 01:46:04,102
I'm playing that advantage.

1728
01:46:04,203 --> 01:46:07,462
I do not want to play an idol.

1729
01:46:07,603 --> 01:46:09,222
I'm gonna play
something else instead.

1730
01:46:16,083 --> 01:46:18,702
I guess
the ballsiest play today

1731
01:46:18,843 --> 01:46:23,382
is gonna be me putting my faith
in some of these people here.

1732
01:46:23,523 --> 01:46:24,622
Flick...
Yep.

1733
01:46:24,763 --> 01:46:26,742
..the tribe has spoken.
They have.

1734
01:46:29,523 --> 01:46:35,442
Shonee, Brooke, AK and Sharn
will all draw rocks.

1735
01:46:41,243 --> 01:46:42,702
Jacqui.

1736
01:46:46,683 --> 01:46:48,542
Best thing
about the blindside

1737
01:46:48,683 --> 01:46:51,342
is seeing that person's face go,
"What the heck just happened?"

1738
01:46:52,723 --> 01:46:54,982
If you sit there all the way to the
end just doing the safest stuff,

1739
01:46:55,083 --> 01:46:56,462
that's just boring...

1740
01:46:57,783 --> 01:47:00,262
..and you're not getting my vote.

1741
01:47:00,403 --> 01:47:03,222
13th person voted out of
Australian Survivor: All Stars

1742
01:47:03,323 --> 01:47:05,502
and first member of our jury...

1743
01:47:05,643 --> 01:47:07,702
..Locky.
Shit, eh. Good one.

1744
01:47:10,763 --> 01:47:13,942
All Stars Reunion Show.

1745
01:47:14,043 --> 01:47:16,382
Let's talk Tribal Council.

1746
01:47:16,523 --> 01:47:20,342
Locky, we just saw you say
how much you love a blindside.

1747
01:47:20,443 --> 01:47:21,443
Yeah.

1748
01:47:21,583 --> 01:47:24,382
Now that you've been on
the receiving end of a blindside,

1749
01:47:24,483 --> 01:47:25,902
do you still feel the same?

1750
01:47:26,043 --> 01:47:28,522
Yeah, they're still amazing.
They're so cool.

1751
01:47:28,643 --> 01:47:30,902
And it was so funny
watching that back.

1752
01:47:31,003 --> 01:47:32,522
I looked like such a dick.

1753
01:47:32,603 --> 01:47:34,162
But that's what I wanted to see,

1754
01:47:34,303 --> 01:47:38,462
and to get it done on you,
yeah, it was kind of bittersweet.

1755
01:47:38,603 --> 01:47:43,422
Jacqui, you seemed pretty happy
with yourself when you took out Zach.

1756
01:47:43,563 --> 01:47:45,902
How did it feel
to orchestrate the perfect blindside?

1757
01:47:46,003 --> 01:47:50,162
Oh, look, um...

1758
01:47:50,243 --> 01:47:51,702
How did it feel, Zach?

1759
01:47:51,843 --> 01:47:53,302
Yeah, boss.

1760
01:47:53,443 --> 01:47:55,902
Look, it felt good.
It's a pretty good feeling.

1761
01:47:56,003 --> 01:47:58,102
It's...yeah, it's a...

1762
01:47:58,243 --> 01:48:01,262
You want more of it. You get
hungry for that feeling, yeah.

1763
01:48:01,363 --> 01:48:03,102
Zach, did you have any inkling at all

1764
01:48:03,243 --> 01:48:05,022
that Jacqui was gonna flip
on the alliance?

1765
01:48:05,123 --> 01:48:07,302
It was definitely a concern of mine.

1766
01:48:07,443 --> 01:48:10,462
Moving into that Tribal,
I'd actually spoke to Dave about it,

1767
01:48:10,603 --> 01:48:12,622
and I'm like, "Man, we really need
to stack these votes, hey.

1768
01:48:12,763 --> 01:48:14,422
"I don't think splitting the vote's
the right idea."

1769
01:48:14,563 --> 01:48:17,102
And he's like, "No, it'll be fine.
I'll play my idol for you."

1770
01:48:17,243 --> 01:48:20,662
And at the Tribal itself,
I was feeling pretty good

1771
01:48:20,803 --> 01:48:22,822
'cause, you know, these guys
were putting on a pretty good show

1772
01:48:22,963 --> 01:48:25,302
saying, "Oh, yeah, nah,
they're stonewalling us,

1773
01:48:25,403 --> 01:48:27,162
"there's no way it's gonna happen."

1774
01:48:27,303 --> 01:48:29,382
And it wasn't until AK
started saying that,

1775
01:48:29,483 --> 01:48:31,162
I started sketchin' out a little bit

1776
01:48:31,303 --> 01:48:33,422
because AK never lies down,
you know.

1777
01:48:33,563 --> 01:48:36,462
So...but, by that stage,
I don't know, it was a bit too late.

1778
01:48:36,603 --> 01:48:38,862
Well, obviously,
not everybody's here tonight.

1779
01:48:38,963 --> 01:48:41,102
I'm clearly not Jonathan LaPaglia,

1780
01:48:41,243 --> 01:48:43,062
but he was able to join us
via satellite before.

1781
01:48:43,203 --> 01:48:46,422
And some people are actually able to
join us via satellite from Melbourne.

1782
01:48:46,563 --> 01:48:49,942
Moana's joined us for the night.
So grateful that you're here.

1783
01:48:50,083 --> 01:48:53,182
Moana, you played
a very different game

1784
01:48:53,283 --> 01:48:55,302
to many of the other tribemates.

1785
01:48:55,443 --> 01:48:57,022
You played your cards
pretty close to your chest.

1786
01:48:57,163 --> 01:48:59,582
Was that a deliberate move?
Absolutely.

1787
01:48:59,683 --> 01:49:01,262
If I used that to my advantage,

1788
