734
00:53:37,380 --> 00:53:42,299
I'm not ashamed to say that
I took opportunities to strike.

735
00:53:42,340 --> 00:53:44,939
You were all a threat.

736
00:53:44,980 --> 00:53:49,859
Because if I didn't strike at you,
you would have striked at me.

737
00:53:52,980 --> 00:53:58,339
I came here to show that
brains can trump over brawn

738
00:53:58,380 --> 00:54:00,659
if you have a good strategy.

739
00:54:00,700 --> 00:54:03,179
A man with a plan is dangerous,

740
00:54:03,220 --> 00:54:06,659
and I've been very
dangerous in this game.

741
00:54:06,700 --> 00:54:12,819
I've been frank, I've been fearless,
but I've also been 100% me.

742
00:54:13,900 --> 00:54:18,899
I know I'm not perfect, I know I'm
not gonna win Miss Congeniality,

743
00:54:18,940 --> 00:54:21,499
but I've given it my damn all

744
00:54:21,540 --> 00:54:26,739
to outwit, outplay
and outlast 22 players.

745
00:54:26,780 --> 00:54:30,819
And the only thing that my
game is missing is my crown.

746
00:54:30,860 --> 00:54:33,819
This is my election day.

747
00:54:33,860 --> 00:54:37,539
This is your time to
go to the ballot box

748
00:54:37,580 --> 00:54:41,659
and give me the crown that I
think my strategic game deserves.

749
00:54:45,780 --> 00:54:46,939
Wow.

750
00:54:48,660 --> 00:54:50,019
Hayley...

751
00:54:51,340 --> 00:54:52,659
..now it's your shot.

752
00:54:58,340 --> 00:55:00,219
Hey, jury.

753
00:55:01,580 --> 00:55:03,499
I'm sitting here in front of you today

754
00:55:03,540 --> 00:55:07,379
and I am genuinely proud of
the game that I have played.

755
00:55:08,460 --> 00:55:12,619
I started in the Brains tribe
and I was in a majority alliance,

756
00:55:12,660 --> 00:55:16,099
but I always knew what the
minority alliance was doing.

757
00:55:16,140 --> 00:55:20,099
And I had the power to
swing any of those votes.

758
00:55:22,460 --> 00:55:24,939
And that is where the
power lies in this game.

759
00:55:27,300 --> 00:55:31,779
It's not the person at the top
who is dictating who goes home,

760
00:55:31,820 --> 00:55:34,699
it's the person who sits in the
middle, who has all the information

761
00:55:34,740 --> 00:55:37,019
and can decide if they
wanna swing or not.

762
00:55:39,180 --> 00:55:42,379
When it came to the vote for George,

763
00:55:42,420 --> 00:55:45,939
I made a decision that I wanted
to swing and take out Joey.

764
00:55:47,620 --> 00:55:50,499
And Baden and Wai
came with me on that vote

765
00:55:50,540 --> 00:55:54,299
and we took out one of the
biggest players in the Brains tribe -

766
00:55:54,340 --> 00:55:55,419
amazing Joey.

767
00:55:56,780 --> 00:55:58,459
And the timing for that was perfect

768
00:55:58,500 --> 00:56:01,979
because it was just before
we went to tribe swap.

769
00:56:02,020 --> 00:56:03,539
But...

770
00:56:03,580 --> 00:56:07,739
..as Survivor goes, tribe
swap is a little bit of luck,

771
00:56:07,780 --> 00:56:10,139
and we didn't end up with that luck.

772
00:56:10,180 --> 00:56:15,419
We were in a tribe with
four Brain and five Brawn.

773
00:56:16,660 --> 00:56:20,979
Luckily, at that point, I had found
myself with my public immunity idol.

774
00:56:22,420 --> 00:56:24,259
And that idol that I found,

775
00:56:24,300 --> 00:56:28,019
I managed to play to maximum
effect over three different tribals.

776
00:56:29,340 --> 00:56:34,139
First, we were in this
minority, but I had a choice -

777
00:56:34,180 --> 00:56:37,699
I could let Baden go home
and use the idol to save myself,

778
00:56:37,740 --> 00:56:42,019
or I could tell the Brawn
I am going to flip a coin,

779
00:56:42,060 --> 00:56:44,779
one of us will use the idol
and you're gonna have to break.

780
00:56:44,820 --> 00:56:46,659
And it worked.

781
00:56:47,860 --> 00:56:51,099
And suddenly we had control of
the game, and Shannon went home.

782
00:56:52,780 --> 00:56:54,579
Next, it was the Simon vote.

783
00:56:55,740 --> 00:56:58,059
Someone who had two idols in his pocket.

784
00:56:59,940 --> 00:57:02,699
I needed to play my part in that vote,

785
00:57:02,740 --> 00:57:05,779
and that was I needed to hold that idol.

786
00:57:05,820 --> 00:57:08,699
I had to trust in these new
relationships I had made...

787
00:57:09,860 --> 00:57:13,019
..and I needed to
trust that if I held it,

788
00:57:13,060 --> 00:57:15,299
then he wouldn't play
his and he would go home.

789
00:57:18,020 --> 00:57:23,499
Finally, it was the Kez vote, and
George did leak information to me,

790
00:57:23,540 --> 00:57:26,179
but I'm the one who
had to execute that move.

791
00:57:26,220 --> 00:57:29,619
I had to make the decision
if I wanted to expose myself,

792
00:57:29,660 --> 00:57:33,459
risk playing an idol for someone
who wasn't me, play it on Laura,

793
00:57:33,500 --> 00:57:38,179
save her, and then cover it all
up by saying that I was the oracle.

794
00:57:39,900 --> 00:57:45,219
That idol lasted three votes and
got me much further in the game.

795
00:57:45,260 --> 00:57:50,819
But no-one plays a perfect game
and I ended up at Redemption Rock.

796
00:57:52,420 --> 00:57:56,579
That was a really crucial
turning point for me.

797
00:57:56,620 --> 00:57:59,659
I was playing hard and
fast and really strategic.

798
00:57:59,700 --> 00:58:02,779
I had to adapt my gameplay.

799
00:58:02,820 --> 00:58:04,779
But first I had to get
back in this game,

800
00:58:04,820 --> 00:58:09,459
and I was up against Baden,
a Tour de France winner.

801
00:58:09,500 --> 00:58:12,899
And winning that
redemption rock challenge

802
00:58:12,940 --> 00:58:16,299
gave me the confidence to
really test myself physically.

803
00:58:17,780 --> 00:58:23,819
I came back thinking maybe that is
something that I CAN lean into here,

804
00:58:23,860 --> 00:58:28,019
and I ended up winning the
immunity necklace four times -

805
00:58:28,060 --> 00:58:29,499
the most out of anyone here.

806
00:58:31,140 --> 00:58:33,379
And I'm really proud of the way

807
00:58:33,420 --> 00:58:36,099
that I've managed to
play a physical game.

808
00:58:37,660 --> 00:58:41,739
I know that this game is
about outwitting socially,

809
00:58:41,780 --> 00:58:45,739
outlasting physically and
outplaying strategically...

810
00:58:47,500 --> 00:58:50,699
..and I think I am the
one person left here

811
00:58:50,740 --> 00:58:54,259
who has done all three of
those things really, really well.

812
00:58:56,460 --> 00:58:59,339
And I'm really grateful
and proud that I'm still here.

813
00:59:03,340 --> 00:59:04,499
Very good.

814
00:59:08,420 --> 00:59:12,579
Alright, jury, you have heard
two very excellent pitches.

815
00:59:15,100 --> 00:59:18,739
Now it is your turn to ask questions.

816
00:59:33,843 --> 00:59:38,420
Alright, jury. You have heard
two very excellent pitches.

817
00:59:38,586 --> 00:59:41,825
Now it is your turn to ask questions.

818
00:59:44,306 --> 00:59:46,425
Laura, wanna go first?

819
00:59:46,466 --> 00:59:48,105
Sure.

820
00:59:48,146 --> 00:59:51,073
Well, on behalf of all of us,
I want to say congratulations.

821
00:59:51,085 --> 00:59:52,065
Thanks.

822
00:59:52,106 --> 00:59:53,545
This has been an epic journey

823
00:59:53,586 --> 00:59:56,665
and to make it all the way to
the end is bloody incredible.

824
00:59:56,706 --> 01:00:01,545
And just so you know, I have
not solidified anything in my mind.

825
01:00:01,586 --> 01:00:03,425
So, to hear your pitches tonight,

826
01:00:03,466 --> 01:00:06,025
but also your answers
is really important to me.

827
01:00:06,066 --> 01:00:08,785
And I know it is for a
lot of other people here.

828
01:00:08,826 --> 01:00:12,945
George, what have you learnt
about yourself in this game?

829
01:00:15,066 --> 01:00:17,025
Thank you for your question, Laura,

830
01:00:17,066 --> 01:00:19,305
and I think it's a very good question.

831
01:00:19,346 --> 01:00:24,625
So, every night when I lie down
wide awake in the freezing cold,

832
01:00:24,666 --> 01:00:27,985
I do reflect on what I
learn every single day.

833
01:00:28,026 --> 01:00:31,305
I'm just a boy from suburban Bankstown.

834
01:00:31,346 --> 01:00:34,625
I don't think anyone
would ever have expected

835
01:00:34,666 --> 01:00:38,705
that I would last 48 days
in these harsh conditions.

836
01:00:38,746 --> 01:00:40,505
But I've done it.

837
01:00:40,546 --> 01:00:42,785
And what I've learned

838
01:00:42,826 --> 01:00:47,505
is that I can do anything
when I put my mind to it.

839
01:00:48,826 --> 01:00:54,025
I've come up with a lot of
innovative ways to survive out here

840
01:00:54,066 --> 01:00:57,025
because I couldn't just rely on my body.

841
01:00:57,066 --> 01:01:03,025
I gathered intelligence
like a secret covert agent.

842
01:01:03,066 --> 01:01:06,625
I listened to Gerald and Flick
talking to Dani by the pool.

843
01:01:06,666 --> 01:01:09,385
I was literally hanging
on the edge of a cliff.

844
01:01:09,426 --> 01:01:11,305
I listened to Hayley and Wai

845
01:01:11,346 --> 01:01:12,905
talking at the well.

846
01:01:12,946 --> 01:01:17,345
Andrew didn't realise that I was
lying down like a snake in the grass

847
01:01:17,386 --> 01:01:19,785
on a rock right behind him.

848
01:01:19,826 --> 01:01:23,585
I just learned to survive,
and I'm really proud of that.

849
01:01:29,826 --> 01:01:31,865
OK, Cara. You're next.

850
01:01:34,546 --> 01:01:40,745
Hayley, did you come in intending
to lie, manipulate and deceive,

851
01:01:40,786 --> 01:01:43,745
or did it just come about organically?

852
01:01:47,986 --> 01:01:50,705
I came into this game
as a really big fan,

853
01:01:50,746 --> 01:01:55,465
and I absolutely knew that a part
of this game is lying and deceiving.

854
01:01:55,506 --> 01:01:58,905
And to be honest, that's a part
of what I do in my real world.

855
01:01:58,946 --> 01:02:02,345
Like I'm a researcher and I
run experiments on people.

856
01:02:02,386 --> 01:02:04,305
We have to run placebos.

857
01:02:04,346 --> 01:02:06,545
That means we have people coming in

858
01:02:06,586 --> 01:02:09,785
and we're giving them
entirely fake treatments.

859
01:02:09,826 --> 01:02:12,345
And I wanted to bring
those skills into this game.

860
01:02:12,386 --> 01:02:15,625
And I had absolutely
no worries in doing that.

861
01:02:15,666 --> 01:02:18,745
If you have a plan in place, you
can't let someone else have a plan

862
01:02:18,786 --> 01:02:20,465
that is going to counteract that.

863
01:02:20,506 --> 01:02:22,545
You have to misdirect.

864
01:02:22,586 --> 01:02:24,225
So I am really happy and proud

865
01:02:24,266 --> 01:02:27,945
about the ways that I have
managed to misdirect people

866
01:02:27,986 --> 01:02:29,385
and lie and deceive.

867
01:02:29,426 --> 01:02:32,105
It's not a dirty word
to me in this game,

868
01:02:32,146 --> 01:02:33,865
and I feel like I'm sitting here

869
01:02:33,906 --> 01:02:37,425
because I managed to do that
really well at just the right times.

870
01:02:40,706 --> 01:02:42,505
Alright, Andrew.

871
01:02:42,546 --> 01:02:46,865
Oh, right, it was about
six weeks ago that I said,

872
01:02:46,906 --> 01:02:48,545
"You know what? George and Hayley,

873
01:02:48,586 --> 01:02:51,585
"they're definitely the most
dangerous characters in this game."

874
01:02:51,626 --> 01:02:54,545
And, yeah, I don't know what part
of the memo youse didn't get, but...

875
01:02:54,586 --> 01:02:55,825
- I believed you.
- There it is.

876
01:02:55,866 --> 01:02:57,465
I'm going to keep it short and sharp.

877
01:02:57,506 --> 01:03:01,745
What regrets did you have and
what would you do differently?

878
01:03:02,986 --> 01:03:05,145
I'm going to be frank. I don't have any.

879
01:03:07,186 --> 01:03:09,425
Because every move I've done,

880
01:03:09,466 --> 01:03:12,865
despite being risky,
has got me to this seat.

881
01:03:19,186 --> 01:03:21,785
I do have some regrets in this game,

882
01:03:21,826 --> 01:03:24,385
and the one that I think
is the most obvious for me

883
01:03:24,426 --> 01:03:27,305
is the one that landed
me at Redemption Rock.

884
01:03:27,346 --> 01:03:32,025
I made the decision to expose
George as the double agent

885
01:03:32,066 --> 01:03:35,705
and Emmett told everybody
else and my game was blown.

886
01:03:35,746 --> 01:03:38,865
So I think that if I could
go back and do that again,

887
01:03:38,906 --> 01:03:41,265
I would have only told that to Dani.

888
01:03:41,306 --> 01:03:43,185
It would have been a
very different outcome.

889
01:03:43,226 --> 01:03:45,825
I'm glad you mentioned
that you've got regrets

890
01:03:45,866 --> 01:03:48,825
because at the Outback
Retreat, you sat next to Flick and I

891
01:03:48,866 --> 01:03:50,865
and you told us that you were all in.

892
01:03:50,906 --> 01:03:52,385
You had all the power in the game.

893
01:03:52,426 --> 01:03:56,585
So what was the point
at poking us even further?

894
01:03:56,626 --> 01:04:00,505
And do you regret it now
that we now have the power?

895
01:04:02,186 --> 01:04:05,945
I knew that if I didn't say that
I was going to work with you

896
01:04:05,986 --> 01:04:07,745
and give you confidence

897
01:04:07,786 --> 01:04:12,025
that you would start swinging
at me and it would risk my game,

898
01:04:12,066 --> 01:04:13,545
so I had to misdirect you

899
01:04:13,586 --> 01:04:16,825
so that you didn't come
up with an alternative plan.

900
01:04:16,866 --> 01:04:21,105
It was hard to have to
deceive you in that way,

901
01:04:21,146 --> 01:04:22,545
but I don't regret it.

902
01:04:22,586 --> 01:04:23,745
I think it was necessary

903
01:04:23,786 --> 01:04:26,625
because I don't think you
would have gone down easily.

904
01:04:26,666 --> 01:04:29,225
I appreciate the honesty and
my vote is up for grabs tonight

905
01:04:29,266 --> 01:04:31,425
and I want to see
people owning their lives

906
01:04:31,466 --> 01:04:34,665
and owning their gameplay,
no matter who gets stung by it.

907
01:04:37,306 --> 01:04:39,145
Alright, Gerald, what have you got?

908
01:04:39,186 --> 01:04:40,985
Alright. Um...

909
01:04:41,026 --> 01:04:43,345
Awesome work on getting here, guys.

910
01:04:43,386 --> 01:04:47,785
So, my question to you is, if
this game restarted right now

911
01:04:47,826 --> 01:04:50,665
with the 11 people that are here,

912
01:04:50,706 --> 01:04:55,705
who do you think would work
with you on this jury right now?

913
01:04:59,546 --> 01:05:03,225
Gerald, for me, knowing
what you've all seen

914
01:05:03,266 --> 01:05:05,265
and how I've played this game...

915
01:05:07,386 --> 01:05:09,705
..the answer should be none of you,

916
01:05:09,746 --> 01:05:14,625
because whilst on first impressions,
no-one expected me to be a threat,

917
01:05:14,666 --> 01:05:16,945
look at me now.

918
01:05:20,426 --> 01:05:23,945
I am going to take almost the
opposite approach to George

919
01:05:23,986 --> 01:05:26,425
in saying that I feel like I
would work with all of you

920
01:05:26,466 --> 01:05:27,705
if I came back in this game.

921
01:05:27,746 --> 01:05:29,465
And I think that you
would all work with me

922
01:05:29,506 --> 01:05:31,545
because you all wrote my name down

923
01:05:31,586 --> 01:05:35,265
and somehow I came back and
you still trusted me to work with you.

924
01:05:35,306 --> 01:05:38,625
I think that that shows
that I have the ability

925
01:05:38,666 --> 01:05:41,265
to adapt my game

926
01:05:41,306 --> 01:05:44,425
and to get you to trust me
even when maybe you shouldn't.

927
01:05:46,026 --> 01:05:47,745
I think you're probably right.

928
01:05:47,786 --> 01:05:49,985
I couldn't really see you coming
back from Redemption Rock.

929
01:05:50,026 --> 01:05:52,225
I congratulate you on proving me wrong,

930
01:05:52,266 --> 01:05:53,545
but I think you believed it too.

931
01:05:55,386 --> 01:05:58,065
Alright, Dani. What do you want to ask?

932
01:05:59,106 --> 01:06:00,425
George.

933
01:06:00,466 --> 01:06:04,465
So, I... being a challenge
beast and also a Brawn,

934
01:06:04,506 --> 01:06:08,665
you can appreciate that I respect
physicality and never giving up.

935
01:06:08,706 --> 01:06:10,625
And when it comes to challenges,

936
01:06:10,666 --> 01:06:14,705
you decided not to play a big
part of the game, the outplay.

937
01:06:14,746 --> 01:06:18,065
I've been saying the whole
time, you can't just be strategic.

938
01:06:18,106 --> 01:06:20,185
You'd like to believe that
you are one of the best players

939
01:06:20,226 --> 01:06:22,385
in Australian Survivor history.

940
01:06:22,426 --> 01:06:24,825
So when you sat down on challenges,

941
01:06:24,866 --> 01:06:29,465
explain to the jury why you gave
up on such a big part of the game.

942
01:06:40,210 --> 01:06:45,769
So, George, me being a
challenge beast and also a Brawn,

943
01:06:45,810 --> 01:06:50,169
you can appreciate that I respect
physicality and never giving up.

944
01:06:50,210 --> 01:06:52,129
And when it comes to challenges,

945
01:06:52,170 --> 01:06:55,889
you decided not to play a big
part of the game, the outplay.

946
01:06:55,930 --> 01:06:58,529
You'd like to believe that
you are one of the best players

947
01:06:58,570 --> 01:07:00,689
in Australian Survivor history.

948
01:07:00,730 --> 01:07:02,929
So when you sat down on challenges,

949
01:07:02,970 --> 01:07:06,849
explain to the jury why you gave
up on such a big part of the game.

950
01:07:09,450 --> 01:07:13,489
Thanks, I appreciate your
question, Dani, about my physicality,

951
01:07:13,530 --> 01:07:15,929
And I'm happy to
provide an answer to you.

952
01:07:15,970 --> 01:07:21,089
So, I know what my strengths and
weaknesses are as an individual.

953
01:07:21,130 --> 01:07:25,689
I know I'm not good enough if
the only criteria is physicality.

954
01:07:25,730 --> 01:07:28,449
I know that. That's my weakness.

955
01:07:28,490 --> 01:07:33,849
And I papered over my weaknesses
this entire game because I had to.

956
01:07:33,890 --> 01:07:36,849
But my greatest strength is my strategy.

957
01:07:36,890 --> 01:07:39,489
It's my ability to be
a political operative.

958
01:07:43,850 --> 01:07:46,409
Alright, Flick. You're up.

959
01:07:46,450 --> 01:07:48,489
OK, so, Hayley,

960
01:07:48,530 --> 01:07:53,609
we've had many discussions,
none of which I think were truthful.

961
01:07:53,650 --> 01:07:55,049
Yeah.

962
01:07:55,090 --> 01:07:57,169
Why did you never want to work with me?

963
01:07:57,210 --> 01:07:59,529
Oh, I did want to work with you.

964
01:07:59,570 --> 01:08:03,249
Ultimately, the aim was that we
would work with you, come merge.

965
01:08:03,290 --> 01:08:06,289
But we got there and
you didn't come with us.

966
01:08:06,330 --> 01:08:08,329
And then we got so far into the game

967
01:08:08,370 --> 01:08:12,489
that it was no longer about
who would I like to work with.

968
01:08:12,530 --> 01:08:14,449
It was about who do
I think that I can beat.

969
01:08:14,490 --> 01:08:16,289
And I know I got called a flipper,

970
01:08:16,330 --> 01:08:20,849
but I know that when I did
flip, I flipped at the right time.

971
01:08:20,890 --> 01:08:25,689
When George had exposed
himself by using his idol for Cara

972
01:08:25,730 --> 01:08:28,449
and we were all
thinking of voting him out,

973
01:08:28,490 --> 01:08:32,489
I decided that instead of going
with you, Dani and Emmett

974
01:08:32,530 --> 01:08:34,889
flipped over to George, Cara and Wai

975
01:08:34,930 --> 01:08:37,049
because I knew if I was
with the four of them,

976
01:08:37,090 --> 01:08:39,209
I was the strongest
physical player there.

977
01:08:39,250 --> 01:08:42,569
So that set me up to be
sitting here in the final two.

978
01:08:42,610 --> 01:08:45,209
And I think that was one of the
most important moves I made.

979
01:08:46,810 --> 01:08:48,689
OK.

980
01:08:48,730 --> 01:08:51,409
So, George, how much have you relied

981
01:08:51,450 --> 01:08:56,409
on lying and manipulation in this
game to get you to where you are?

982
01:08:56,450 --> 01:08:59,889
I would say when you assess my game,

983
01:08:59,930 --> 01:09:04,409
you should look at
the intent of my actions

984
01:09:04,450 --> 01:09:06,729
and the intent of the outcome.

985
01:09:06,770 --> 01:09:11,209
I had to do what needed to be done.

986
01:09:11,250 --> 01:09:15,689
So in terms of the degree
of lying and manipulation,

987
01:09:15,730 --> 01:09:19,689
I thread a very fine
line, but I had to do it.

988
01:09:19,730 --> 01:09:21,289
It's Survivor.

989
01:09:25,610 --> 01:09:27,769
Alright, Emmett. What
do you got, brother?

990
01:09:27,810 --> 01:09:29,529
I'm going to start off by saying,

991
01:09:29,570 --> 01:09:32,369
George, the cockroach of
Bankstown couldn't squash him,

992
01:09:32,410 --> 01:09:34,489
couldn't figure out how
to get you out of the game.

993
01:09:34,530 --> 01:09:35,649
And I'm sure these Brains crew

994
01:09:35,690 --> 01:09:37,969
couldn't figure out how to get
you out of the game as well.

995
01:09:38,010 --> 01:09:39,209
So I respect you for that.

996
01:09:39,250 --> 01:09:40,969
And I think you've done an amazing job

997
01:09:41,010 --> 01:09:43,689
at evading near-death experiences.

998
01:09:43,730 --> 01:09:46,449
And I love all the powerful
moves that you played.

999
01:09:46,490 --> 01:09:50,289
But from my perspective, the
thing that I'm going to touch on

1000
01:09:50,330 --> 01:09:53,449
in terms of your comparison
between the two of you

1001
01:09:53,490 --> 01:09:56,809
is George, you've burned
bridges with everyone.

1002
01:09:56,850 --> 01:09:59,209
You've not only deceived
people and lied to people

1003
01:09:59,250 --> 01:10:00,569
and voted people off,

1004
01:10:00,610 --> 01:10:04,609
but you've done it in a way that's
rubbed so many people the wrong way.

1005
01:10:04,650 --> 01:10:07,249
If you had the chance to do this again,

1006
01:10:07,290 --> 01:10:09,289
would you play the game the same

1007
01:10:09,330 --> 01:10:12,289
and still be spinning lies

1008
01:10:12,330 --> 01:10:14,329
and destroying relationships
with everyone in the game?

1009
01:10:15,410 --> 01:10:18,889
- That's my question.
- Thank you. Thank you, Emmett.

1010
01:10:18,930 --> 01:10:21,169
And that's a very tough question,

1011
01:10:21,210 --> 01:10:24,569
but I appreciate the
level of thought and detail

1012
01:10:24,610 --> 01:10:26,369
that you put into it.

1013
01:10:26,410 --> 01:10:28,729
The difficult thing about Survivor

1014
01:10:28,770 --> 01:10:35,689
is that fine line between strategy
and what's interpreted as lying.

1015
01:10:35,730 --> 01:10:38,049
I don't shy away from the fact

1016
01:10:38,090 --> 01:10:41,049
that I caused each and every one of you

1017
01:10:41,090 --> 01:10:45,569
to be there in some degree
or another, except for Baden.

1018
01:10:45,610 --> 01:10:46,849
I own that.

1019
01:10:48,370 --> 01:10:50,089
I still feel like you're
beating around the bush

1020
01:10:50,130 --> 01:10:52,009
of what I'm actually trying to ask.

1021
01:10:52,050 --> 01:10:53,449
I accept what you're saying,

1022
01:10:53,490 --> 01:10:56,089
but the decision that
you have to make tonight

1023
01:10:56,130 --> 01:11:00,529
is based on who you think
deserves the title of Sole Survivor.

1024
01:11:00,570 --> 01:11:03,129
I think I deserve it. I'm
proud of my resume.

1025
01:11:03,170 --> 01:11:05,369
I don't know how the
hell else to say it, man.

1026
01:11:05,410 --> 01:11:10,409
But, like, my question was, if
you had a chance to do it again,

1027
01:11:10,450 --> 01:11:13,049
would you push
yourself harder physically

1028
01:11:13,090 --> 01:11:16,969
or build more relationships
without burning so many bridges?

1029
01:11:19,450 --> 01:11:20,569
I don't think so.

1030
01:11:25,770 --> 01:11:28,129
If it's not good enough
for you, that's fine,

1031
01:11:28,170 --> 01:11:30,689
we're all entitled to our opinion.

1032
01:11:30,730 --> 01:11:33,689
But I reiterate, I
wouldn't change anything.

1033
01:11:33,730 --> 01:11:37,529
I needed to do what I did to get here.

1034
01:11:38,930 --> 01:11:42,409
And that has resulted in
eight of the nine jury members

1035
01:11:42,450 --> 01:11:44,009
sitting on that bench.

1036
01:11:44,050 --> 01:11:47,569
I've put you there. I blindsided you.

1037
01:11:47,610 --> 01:11:52,649
And I'm sitting here right now
with the best resume in the game.

1038
01:11:52,690 --> 01:11:55,729
And if that's the criteria that
you're gonna assess your vote with,

1039
01:11:55,770 --> 01:11:57,169
give me your vote.

1040
01:12:07,290 --> 01:12:13,569
So, Hayley, how do you see your
game and George's game differently?

1041
01:12:13,610 --> 01:12:17,369
And why did you decide to
ultimately take George to the end,

1042
01:12:17,410 --> 01:12:21,569
because you both have
such strong strategic games?

1043
01:12:21,610 --> 01:12:24,689
My game is not just about
having a resume strategically.

1044
01:12:24,730 --> 01:12:28,369
I think that my game
is way more rounded.

1045
01:12:28,410 --> 01:12:31,449
I knew that I would be up
against a formidable speaker

1046
01:12:31,490 --> 01:12:35,249
and someone who is funny
and engaging and charismatic.

1047
01:12:35,290 --> 01:12:38,729
But I still back my game
in sitting next to him tonight.

1048
01:12:38,770 --> 01:12:41,569
I have played a really strategic game

1049
01:12:41,610 --> 01:12:44,529
and I know I've played
a really physical game

1050
01:12:44,570 --> 01:12:47,889
and I also played a
really strong social game.

1051
01:12:47,930 --> 01:12:50,409
But if you have all of those things,

1052
01:12:50,450 --> 01:12:52,849
then you're probably
going to end up on the jury.

1053
01:12:52,890 --> 01:12:55,729
So I had to cover up
some of my strategic play

1054
01:12:55,770 --> 01:13:00,889
and I needed to manipulate my
threat level so that I could get here.

1055
01:13:00,930 --> 01:13:02,689
There's no point playing a big game

1056
01:13:02,730 --> 01:13:06,169
unless I can get to the final two
and prove that my game was good.

1057
01:13:06,210 --> 01:13:09,209
I feel like there is a number of moves

1058
01:13:09,250 --> 01:13:11,129
that I was really proud of in this game.

1059
01:13:11,170 --> 01:13:12,689
But the physical aspect

1060
01:13:12,730 --> 01:13:15,089
is what surprised me the
absolute most out here.

1061
01:13:16,530 --> 01:13:20,649
I came up against some
huge endurance athletes,

1062
01:13:20,690 --> 01:13:22,849
some challenge beasts,

1063
01:13:22,890 --> 01:13:26,889
and I managed to
outwrestle an MMA fighter,

1064
01:13:26,930 --> 01:13:30,129
I managed to outbalance
a big wave surfer,

1065
01:13:30,170 --> 01:13:32,009
I pushed myself past the point

1066
01:13:32,050 --> 01:13:33,929
that I possibly thought I could

1067
01:13:33,970 --> 01:13:36,769
in some really tough
endurance challenges.

1068
01:13:36,810 --> 01:13:39,729
And lastly, on that
very crucial challenge,

1069
01:13:39,770 --> 01:13:43,289
I used everything I
knew about pain to win.

1070
01:13:43,330 --> 01:13:48,129
I think that my game encompasses
what it means to be a Brain,

1071
01:13:48,170 --> 01:13:50,529
but what it means to be a Brawn.

1072
01:13:50,570 --> 01:13:53,809
It is about giving 110% in the physical,

1073
01:13:53,850 --> 01:13:56,169
in the social and in the strategic.

1074
01:13:57,530 --> 01:14:00,409
And I have done that.

1075
01:14:05,850 --> 01:14:07,129
Alright, guys.

1076
01:14:07,170 --> 01:14:10,609
You should have all the
information you need now to decide

1077
01:14:10,650 --> 01:14:13,729
who you think deserves
the title of Sole Survivor

1078
01:14:13,770 --> 01:14:16,529
and the half million that goes with it.

1079
01:14:16,570 --> 01:14:21,489
Remember, tonight,
you're voting for a winner.

1080
01:14:21,530 --> 01:14:23,569
For the last time,

1081
01:14:23,610 --> 01:14:26,089
it is... time to vote.

1082
01:14:43,577 --> 01:14:46,816
Alright, guys, you should have
all the information you need now

1083
01:14:46,857 --> 01:14:50,136
to decide who you think
deserves the title of Sole Survivor

1084
01:14:50,177 --> 01:14:51,896
and the half million that goes with it.

1085
01:14:54,817 --> 01:14:57,376
Remember tonight, you
are voting for a winner.

1086
01:15:01,537 --> 01:15:03,616
For the last time,

1087
01:15:03,657 --> 01:15:06,976
it is... time to vote.

1088
01:15:07,017 --> 01:15:08,656
Baden, you're up.

1089
01:15:25,897 --> 01:15:28,696
George, the cockroach that never dies.

1090
01:15:28,737 --> 01:15:30,856
I'm actually voting
for you to win tonight.

1091
01:15:30,897 --> 01:15:33,256
I think you've played
an amazing, mastermind,

1092
01:15:33,297 --> 01:15:35,416
covert game of Survivor.

1093
01:16:00,497 --> 01:16:03,096
The only thing I can say

1094
01:16:03,137 --> 01:16:04,576
is that, Hayley,

1095
01:16:04,617 --> 01:16:08,936
you outwitted, outlasted and outplayed.

1096
01:16:08,977 --> 01:16:10,416
So congratulations, babe.

1097
01:16:30,017 --> 01:16:33,376
Both of you had really
compelling arguments,

1098
01:16:33,417 --> 01:16:35,856
but I had to go with you.

1099
01:16:35,897 --> 01:16:39,936
I think you have been an amazing
player in the game strategically.

1100
01:16:57,977 --> 01:16:59,936
I'll go count the votes.

1101
01:17:14,577 --> 01:17:16,176
Well, there is no doubt

1102
01:17:16,217 --> 01:17:19,256
that this has been an incredible season.

1103
01:17:19,297 --> 01:17:21,976
The only thing left to
do, Hayley and George,

1104
01:17:22,017 --> 01:17:23,656
is read the votes.

1105
01:17:23,697 --> 01:17:28,456
But... a moment like this
really should be shared

1106
01:17:28,497 --> 01:17:30,736
with the people you love the most.

1107
01:17:30,777 --> 01:17:32,136
Come on in, guys.

1108
01:17:33,377 --> 01:17:35,976
Yes!

1109
01:17:45,257 --> 01:17:46,976
Come here. So good.

1110
01:18:00,137 --> 01:18:02,096
- Maria...
- Yes.

1111
01:18:02,137 --> 01:18:05,536
..how proud are you
of your son right now?

1112
01:18:05,577 --> 01:18:09,256
There aren't enough words to
tell you how proud I am of him.

1113
01:18:09,297 --> 01:18:10,736
I love him very much.

1114
01:18:13,177 --> 01:18:16,136
Pamela, this seems to be a
really emotional moment for you.

1115
01:18:16,177 --> 01:18:20,096
I'm just so proud of
him for making it this far,

1116
01:18:20,137 --> 01:18:23,216
and no matter what,
I love him very much.

1117
01:18:24,817 --> 01:18:27,416
George, what's going
through your head right now?

1118
01:18:27,457 --> 01:18:29,256
No matter what the outcome is,

1119
01:18:29,297 --> 01:18:31,056
there's gonna be a deserving winner.

1120
01:18:31,097 --> 01:18:34,576
I'm hoping it's me. I've got
my fingers and toes crossed.

1121
01:18:34,617 --> 01:18:37,616
I'm praying to the Survivor
gods, Macedonian Jesus,

1122
01:18:37,657 --> 01:18:39,216
anyone who'd listen.

1123
01:18:39,257 --> 01:18:41,896
And I'm just hoping that
I can get the job done.

1124
01:18:44,257 --> 01:18:48,576
So, Jimmy, do you think Hayley
deserves to take this one out?

1125
01:18:48,617 --> 01:18:51,016
Yeah, of course.

1126
01:18:51,057 --> 01:18:54,256
But I'm incredibly biased.

1127
01:18:54,297 --> 01:18:56,776
Kate, you've known Hayley a long time.

1128
01:18:56,817 --> 01:18:58,336
What do you think it means to her

1129
01:18:58,377 --> 01:19:01,696
to be standing here living
out her childhood dream?

1130
01:19:01,737 --> 01:19:05,176
Hayley had a Survivor
themed 21st birthday

1131
01:19:05,217 --> 01:19:07,296
back in the day,

1132
01:19:07,337 --> 01:19:09,696
tiki torches and everything.

1133
01:19:09,737 --> 01:19:13,216
I know it just means
everything to her to be here.

1134
01:19:13,257 --> 01:19:15,776
Wow. True Survivor geek.

1135
01:19:15,817 --> 01:19:17,296
I was hiding that.

1136
01:19:18,817 --> 01:19:21,536
Hayley, what's going
through your head right now?

1137
01:19:21,577 --> 01:19:24,776
I never even dreamed I
would be able to play this game,

1138
01:19:24,817 --> 01:19:28,096
let alone stand here at the final
two and have a chance to win.

1139
01:19:28,137 --> 01:19:31,176
And I am so proud to be standing here,

1140
01:19:31,217 --> 01:19:32,656
I'm proud to be standing next to George.

1141
01:19:32,697 --> 01:19:34,096
He's played a phenomenal game.

1142
01:19:34,137 --> 01:19:36,976
And, yeah, I can't wait
to see what's in that urn.

1143
01:19:42,377 --> 01:19:44,576
Alright, guys, let's get to it.

1144
01:19:44,617 --> 01:19:47,176
Remember, these votes are for a winner.

1145
01:19:48,297 --> 01:19:52,736
And with nine jury members,
it only takes five votes.

1146
01:19:57,817 --> 01:19:59,296
I'll read the votes.

1147
01:20:05,857 --> 01:20:07,576
First vote...

1148
01:20:07,617 --> 01:20:08,617
..Hayley.

1149
01:20:16,497 --> 01:20:17,816
George.

1150
01:20:17,857 --> 01:20:20,456
One vote Hayley, one vote George.

1151
01:20:25,937 --> 01:20:27,896
Hayley.

1152
01:20:27,937 --> 01:20:30,336
That's two votes
Hayley, one vote George.

1153
01:20:38,297 --> 01:20:40,016
George.

1154
01:20:40,057 --> 01:20:41,656
We're tied.

1155
01:20:41,697 --> 01:20:44,056
Two votes Hayley, two votes George.

1156
01:20:53,137 --> 01:20:54,137
Hayley.

1157
01:20:55,337 --> 01:20:57,736
Three votes Hayley, two votes George.

1158
01:21:02,817 --> 01:21:04,256
Hayley.

1159
01:21:05,297 --> 01:21:07,896
Four votes Hayley, two votes George.

1160
01:21:12,497 --> 01:21:16,816
Winner of Australian Survivor
Brains versus Brawn, Hayley.

1161
01:21:22,817 --> 01:21:25,656
Oh, congratulations!

1162
01:21:41,937 --> 01:21:45,416
Hayley, congratulations.

1163
01:21:45,457 --> 01:21:48,856
Not only are you half
a million dollars richer,

1164
01:21:48,897 --> 01:21:51,456
but you are Sole Survivor,

1165
01:21:51,497 --> 01:21:53,976
Brains versus Brawn.

1166
01:21:54,017 --> 01:21:56,656
Well done,
Queen! You deserve it!

1167
01:21:56,697 --> 01:21:58,496
Whoo!

1168
01:22:00,257 --> 01:22:03,336
I am in complete
shock at what's just happened.

1169
01:22:03,377 --> 01:22:05,176
I am the Sole Survivor.

1170
01:22:05,217 --> 01:22:08,096
I have learned that I can do
way more than I think I can.

1171
01:22:08,137 --> 01:22:09,816
I survived for 48 days.

1172
01:22:09,857 --> 01:22:11,336
I made massive blindsides.

1173
01:22:11,377 --> 01:22:14,136
I was a physical beast out here

1174
01:22:14,177 --> 01:22:15,616
and I never thought I would be.

1175
01:22:15,657 --> 01:22:17,696
Well done, Hayley.

1176
01:22:19,297 --> 01:22:21,736
I'm proud of being able to come out here

1177
01:22:21,777 --> 01:22:24,976
and play a really big strategic game.

1178
01:22:25,017 --> 01:22:26,576
I didn't want to hide in the shadows.

1179
01:22:26,617 --> 01:22:30,136
I wanted to make big moves
from the start and I did that.

1180
01:22:30,177 --> 01:22:33,176
I think the relationships
surprised me most about this game.

1181
01:22:33,217 --> 01:22:36,536
I thought I could come in here and
deceive people and vote them out

1182
01:22:36,577 --> 01:22:38,136
and I wouldn't feel bad about it.

1183
01:22:38,177 --> 01:22:41,816
But the truth is, you make
really close friendships here

1184
01:22:41,857 --> 01:22:45,096
and it really is difficult to
vote someone out of this game.

1185
01:22:46,697 --> 01:22:47,936
Oh, Wai!

1186
01:22:49,097 --> 01:22:53,176
I have wanted to play
this game for so long

1187
01:22:53,217 --> 01:22:57,736
and half a million dollars
is gonna change my life.

1188
01:22:57,777 --> 01:23:02,536
And just never, ever, ever giving
up, I think is the secret to winning.

1189
01:23:11,657 --> 01:23:13,776
I believe that the winner of Survivor

1190
01:23:13,817 --> 01:23:19,456
should be someone who possesses
physical, strategic and social game.

1191
01:23:19,497 --> 01:23:21,656
And, Hayley, you tick all the boxes.

1192
01:23:22,857 --> 01:23:26,416
Hayley, I think your game
was the most well rounded.

1193
01:23:26,457 --> 01:23:28,736
You've put a foot forward in everything.

1194
01:23:28,777 --> 01:23:31,416
You've worked best with so many people

1195
01:23:31,457 --> 01:23:34,576
that would still be on
your side at any moment.

1196
01:23:34,617 --> 01:23:38,056
You outwitted, outlasted and outplayed.

1197
01:23:38,097 --> 01:23:39,256
Well played.

1198
01:23:41,497 --> 01:23:46,856
I had to go with what I
think a true survivor is.

1199
01:23:46,897 --> 01:23:48,656
And to me, that was you, Hayley.

1200
01:23:48,697 --> 01:23:51,176
Not only am I so, so impressed

1201
01:23:51,217 --> 01:23:54,816
by your social, strategic
and physical game,

1202
01:23:54,857 --> 01:23:58,216
I'm amazed at how you owned
every single moment of that.

1203
01:23:58,238 --> 01:24:00,860
And I am so proud
to call you friend, ally

1204
01:24:00,860 --> 01:24:04,340
and hopefully Sole Survivor after this.



## S09E24

1
00:00:00,000 --> 00:00:04,162
WWW.MY-SUBS.CO

1
00:00:01,254 --> 00:00:04,813
The
ancient Australian wilderness...

2
00:00:05,595 --> 00:00:08,772
..a place like nowhere else on earth.

3
00:00:10,332 --> 00:00:12,533
And the unforgiving stage...

4
00:00:13,538 --> 00:00:15,899
..for Blood v. Water.

5
00:00:16,347 --> 00:00:18,332
Say goodbye to your loved one.

6
00:00:18,379 --> 00:00:20,578
You're gonna be playing against them.

7
00:00:20,619 --> 00:00:24,098
- Oh, God.
- Torn apart before the game even began.

8
00:00:24,139 --> 00:00:26,378
- Get him, Jesse!
- Brothers...

9
00:00:26,419 --> 00:00:28,098
- Whoo!
- ..sisters...

10
00:00:28,139 --> 00:00:29,458
Mel, go!

11
00:00:29,499 --> 00:00:30,658
..cousins...

12
00:00:30,699 --> 00:00:31,858
Vicious.

13
00:00:31,899 --> 00:00:33,498
..partners...

14
00:00:33,539 --> 00:00:36,418
..even Survivor royalty...

15
00:00:36,459 --> 00:00:39,578
Queen Sandra
taking on her princess, Nina.

16
00:00:40,619 --> 00:00:42,418
..locked together...

17
00:00:42,459 --> 00:00:44,458
- ..in a brutal...
- Is she OK?

18
00:00:44,499 --> 00:00:46,578
- ..individual game...
- Medic! Medic!

19
00:00:46,619 --> 00:00:48,498
..of raw power...

20
00:00:48,539 --> 00:00:49,898
Charging that wall.

21
00:00:49,939 --> 00:00:51,658
..and epic endurance.

22
00:00:51,699 --> 00:00:52,938
Over 50 minutes.

23
00:00:52,979 --> 00:00:54,418
Aaaagh!

24
00:00:55,579 --> 00:00:56,738
Cheers me, my dog.

25
00:00:56,779 --> 00:00:58,058
New bonds emerged...

26
00:00:58,099 --> 00:00:59,978
Joker and Two-Face.

27
00:01:00,019 --> 00:01:01,378
This is gonna be crazy!

28
00:01:01,419 --> 00:01:03,458
..as old relationships
felt the strain...

29
00:01:03,499 --> 00:01:04,738
Don't get angry at me.

30
00:01:04,779 --> 00:01:07,898
Don't try and burn relationships
that I spent ages building.

31
00:01:07,939 --> 00:01:10,618
..and trust turned to betrayal.

32
00:01:10,659 --> 00:01:13,498
I am so sorry, baby sis.

33
00:01:13,539 --> 00:01:15,298
..in a season that delivered...

34
00:01:15,339 --> 00:01:17,538
What do you mean
you've got Jesse's idol?

35
00:01:17,579 --> 00:01:18,978
..the most treacherous act...

36
00:01:19,019 --> 00:01:20,058
Jesse.

37
00:01:20,099 --> 00:01:22,458
..in Australian Survivor history.

38
00:01:24,259 --> 00:01:25,538
What a stitch-up!

39
00:01:25,579 --> 00:01:27,458
It's eat or be eaten.

40
00:01:27,499 --> 00:01:29,538
I have become an animal out here.

41
00:01:29,579 --> 00:01:32,418
I can't decide if this is
worse than being blindsided.

42
00:01:32,459 --> 00:01:33,858
Through painful...

43
00:01:33,899 --> 00:01:35,298
Croc.

44
00:01:35,339 --> 00:01:36,378
..passionate...

45
00:01:36,419 --> 00:01:38,258
- Ben.
- ..and I'm so proud of you.

46
00:01:38,299 --> 00:01:39,778
..and shocking goodbyes...

47
00:01:39,819 --> 00:01:40,819
Khanh.

48
00:01:40,859 --> 00:01:43,498
Noooooo!

49
00:01:43,539 --> 00:01:46,378
..one by one, they fell.

50
00:01:46,419 --> 00:01:47,938
The tribe has spoken.

51
00:01:49,539 --> 00:01:51,058
That was flipping epic!

52
00:01:51,099 --> 00:01:54,578
And now... just four remain.

53
00:01:55,619 --> 00:01:56,738
The commander.

54
00:01:56,779 --> 00:01:58,578
I was a professional soldier.

55
00:01:58,619 --> 00:02:00,898
I won't stop until the mission is done.

56
00:02:00,939 --> 00:02:02,498
The warrior.

57
00:02:02,539 --> 00:02:04,658
I have been to hell and back.

58
00:02:04,699 --> 00:02:07,738
I didn't come all this way to fail now.

59
00:02:07,779 --> 00:02:09,218
The pilot.

60
00:02:09,259 --> 00:02:11,218
My whole game has
been a game of control.

61
00:02:11,259 --> 00:02:13,138
I am the captain out
here, I'm coming in to land

62
00:02:13,179 --> 00:02:15,898
and I'm gonna do what I have
to do to get to Sole Survivor.

63
00:02:15,939 --> 00:02:18,258
The social strategist.

64
00:02:18,299 --> 00:02:20,978
If I had to do a vote now on
who's played the best social game,

65
00:02:21,019 --> 00:02:22,418
it's 100% me.

66
00:02:22,459 --> 00:02:24,018
I'm going for that title.

67
00:02:25,219 --> 00:02:29,218
Four very different games.

68
00:02:30,259 --> 00:02:34,058
And tonight, one will be crowned

69
00:02:34,099 --> 00:02:36,418
Sole Survivor.

70
00:02:53,419 --> 00:02:55,058
Day 46.

71
00:02:55,099 --> 00:02:57,698
Tomorrow is the last
day of this entire game,

72
00:02:57,739 --> 00:02:59,498
and it's done, it's wrapped up.

73
00:02:59,539 --> 00:03:01,378
It just feels so surreal.

74
00:03:05,259 --> 00:03:07,738
I came into this game
with my partner, Ben.

75
00:03:08,899 --> 00:03:11,858
And when Ben was
eliminated, it was really hard.

76
00:03:12,939 --> 00:03:15,858
I was pretty emotional, but
it's given me double motivation

77
00:03:15,899 --> 00:03:18,418
to take this out and
be the Sole Survivor.

78
00:03:18,459 --> 00:03:20,578
I feel like I deserve to be here

79
00:03:20,619 --> 00:03:23,218
because, having been on
the bottom most of the time,

80
00:03:23,259 --> 00:03:27,218
I feel like I've forged my
way into this final spot.

81
00:03:27,259 --> 00:03:28,698
To be the Sole Survivor,

82
00:03:28,739 --> 00:03:31,298
I think you should really
have had to put up a fight.

83
00:03:31,339 --> 00:03:34,138
It's written in the word,
'Survivor'. You've got to survive.

84
00:03:34,179 --> 00:03:37,498
You've got to actually have
put in blood, sweat and tears.

85
00:03:37,539 --> 00:03:42,618
And I don't think any of the other
23 players have fought this hard.

86
00:03:44,419 --> 00:03:47,578
Um, yeah, I'm proud. I didn't
realise I'd say those words.

87
00:03:47,619 --> 00:03:49,178
I'm pretty proud.

88
00:03:50,339 --> 00:03:54,338
When it comes to immunities, I
have won 10 immunity challenges,

89
00:03:54,379 --> 00:03:57,538
three of those being
individual immunity necklaces.

90
00:03:57,579 --> 00:03:59,218
That says I am a physical threat.

91
00:03:59,259 --> 00:04:01,698
It says that I am worthy
of playing this game.

92
00:04:02,779 --> 00:04:07,618
Now the only thing standing
between here and the final three

93
00:04:07,659 --> 00:04:09,338
is today's challenge.

94
00:04:09,379 --> 00:04:12,018
And I have no other
option except for win.

95
00:04:12,059 --> 00:04:14,418
There isn't room for a
second or third place.

96
00:04:14,459 --> 00:04:16,218
So I'm aiming for Sole Survivor

97
00:04:16,259 --> 00:04:18,378
and I'm gonna reach out and grab it.

98
00:04:36,979 --> 00:04:40,138
The winner of Blood v. Water is
going to be decided tomorrow night.

99
00:04:41,339 --> 00:04:43,298
I'm almost there and I can taste it

100
00:04:43,339 --> 00:04:46,018
and I've just got to focus and
make sure I do everything I can

101
00:04:46,059 --> 00:04:48,138
to just get through one
more day in the game.

102
00:04:49,339 --> 00:04:52,058
I've played socially,
I've played physically.

103
00:04:52,099 --> 00:04:54,858
My strategy is one step ahead,
two steps ahead, sometimes,

104
00:04:54,899 --> 00:04:56,378
of everyone.

105
00:04:56,419 --> 00:04:58,178
When I really stepped
into that captain's chair

106
00:04:58,219 --> 00:04:59,858
was that vote on Jordie.

107
00:04:59,899 --> 00:05:02,138
But, you know, I've worked
with a strong alliance.

108
00:05:02,179 --> 00:05:03,658
You have to trust your conversations.

109
00:05:03,699 --> 00:05:05,218
You have to trust your relationships.

110
00:05:05,259 --> 00:05:08,058
You've got to trust the people you've
been working with this whole time.

111
00:05:08,099 --> 00:05:10,658
I'd love to make top three
with Chrissy and Mark.

112
00:05:11,779 --> 00:05:15,178
Standing in my way for
Sole Survivor is Shay.

113
00:05:16,259 --> 00:05:18,538
Everything's on the line. This is
the way I've wanted to play the game.

114
00:05:18,579 --> 00:05:21,338
Now I've got to beat the
challenge beast, so it's a must-win.

115
00:05:22,699 --> 00:05:25,418
I've sacrificed being
away from my fiancee,

116
00:05:25,459 --> 00:05:27,698
who's pregnant with a
little baby on the way.

117
00:05:27,739 --> 00:05:30,378
So, that's priceless time
that you can't get back.

118
00:05:30,419 --> 00:05:32,378
So, I don't want it to be for nothing.

119
00:05:32,419 --> 00:05:33,858
I've got to do this for my family

120
00:05:33,899 --> 00:05:36,098
and the people that, you
know, matter to me back home.

121
00:05:50,019 --> 00:05:53,698
I think if I compare the
Chrissy that I was on day one

122
00:05:53,739 --> 00:05:55,298
compared to me today,

123
00:05:55,339 --> 00:05:59,418
my confidence in what I actually
can do are two different things.

124
00:06:00,899 --> 00:06:04,338
I teamed up with the best
in the biz, Mark and Josh.

125
00:06:04,379 --> 00:06:07,418
Being out here with these
people, absolute gurus of the game,

126
00:06:07,459 --> 00:06:09,098
and I've kept up...

127
00:06:09,139 --> 00:06:11,058
You know, you underestimate
what you're capable of.

128
00:06:11,099 --> 00:06:13,778
I underestimated myself
big-time, coming into here.

129
00:06:15,339 --> 00:06:17,338
If I had to do a vote
now, with the jury,

130
00:06:17,379 --> 00:06:19,978
on who's played the best
social game, it's 100% me.

131
00:06:21,099 --> 00:06:23,178
And I'll back myself
as hard as I can for that

132
00:06:23,219 --> 00:06:25,778
because my whole life
revolves around people.

133
00:06:25,819 --> 00:06:27,618
I love people.

134
00:06:27,659 --> 00:06:29,298
I don't think there's anyone at camp

135
00:06:29,339 --> 00:06:31,418
that loved everyone there more than me.

136
00:06:32,579 --> 00:06:36,898
I think the role that I
had let me go very clean,

137
00:06:36,939 --> 00:06:38,578
without any blood on my hands.

138
00:06:39,659 --> 00:06:42,738
You know, like, I got through votes

139
00:06:42,779 --> 00:06:44,858
and putting people over in that jury

140
00:06:44,899 --> 00:06:46,338
without getting dirty.

141
00:06:46,379 --> 00:06:47,778
And that's clever in itself.

142
00:06:49,019 --> 00:06:51,258
$500,000 would change anyone's life.

143
00:06:51,299 --> 00:06:53,658
It's a ridiculous amount of money -

144
00:06:53,699 --> 00:06:57,418
an amount of money that no-one
would ever see in one lump sum, ever.

145
00:06:57,459 --> 00:06:59,738
You know, it's years and
years and years of work.

146
00:07:00,859 --> 00:07:02,098
Oh, my God.

147
00:07:02,139 --> 00:07:03,858
I couldn't have chosen
three bigger targets.

148
00:07:03,899 --> 00:07:06,138
But if I want to be the Sole
Survivor, I've gotta beat the best.

149
00:07:06,179 --> 00:07:07,618
So bring it on.

150
00:07:10,419 --> 00:07:12,858
Survivor means everything to me

151
00:07:12,899 --> 00:07:15,458
because it changed
the course of my life.

152
00:07:15,499 --> 00:07:18,378
The first time I played,
I met my wife, Sam.

153
00:07:18,419 --> 00:07:21,538
We have a family now and
it's... it's given me everything.

154
00:07:21,579 --> 00:07:25,058
So, the chance to come back
with Sam, it's a dream come true.

155
00:07:26,819 --> 00:07:29,338
Sam and I were the last of 12 couples,

156
00:07:29,379 --> 00:07:31,698
and I could have played
the idol for her and...

157
00:07:31,739 --> 00:07:33,378
..I could have saved her.

158
00:07:34,739 --> 00:07:36,578
But we always said, at the start,

159
00:07:36,619 --> 00:07:38,218
if one of us win, both of us win.

160
00:07:38,259 --> 00:07:41,338
So now I'm just gonna
have to carry through.

161
00:07:42,819 --> 00:07:45,698
Just coming back a second
time, this is redemption.

162
00:07:45,739 --> 00:07:49,098
This time, I'm a far
more savvy social player.

163
00:07:49,139 --> 00:07:52,738
I wanted to meet everyone
and be a trusted team member.

164
00:07:52,779 --> 00:07:55,498
I had a really strong strategic game,

165
00:07:55,539 --> 00:07:57,418
and, so, from that social bond,

166
00:07:57,459 --> 00:07:58,858
I got a lot of information

167
00:07:58,899 --> 00:08:00,818
and it just totally
changed the way I played

168
00:08:00,859 --> 00:08:03,458
and I had space and time to think.

169
00:08:03,499 --> 00:08:06,218
And then, finally, I wanted
to make sure, physically,

170
00:08:06,259 --> 00:08:08,378
I was seen as indispensable to my tribe.

171
00:08:09,899 --> 00:08:11,458
I found an idol.

172
00:08:11,499 --> 00:08:14,658
I held a second idol
for 44 days combined.

173
00:08:14,699 --> 00:08:18,578
That takes nerve, it takes
courage, it takes steel.

174
00:08:18,619 --> 00:08:20,778
I've put everything into this game.

175
00:08:21,979 --> 00:08:25,458
Like any family, we struggle,
we pay bills, we have a mortgage.

176
00:08:25,499 --> 00:08:27,218
I'm playing for Harry,

177
00:08:27,259 --> 00:08:30,458
and to bring him home
the title of Sole Survivor

178
00:08:30,499 --> 00:08:32,938
and the half million
dollars that goes with it,

179
00:08:32,979 --> 00:08:34,618
it would change our lives.

180
00:08:34,659 --> 00:08:37,178
Now I'm at the final
step, I have to get it done.

181
00:08:37,219 --> 00:08:39,978
This is the final part. I've
just got, like, one last push.

182
00:08:41,099 --> 00:08:43,418
The only way I'm
coming off that challenge

183
00:08:43,459 --> 00:08:45,818
is by total and complete failure.

184
00:08:45,859 --> 00:08:48,818
It'll be because my body
can't hold me anymore.

185
00:09:10,819 --> 00:09:12,338
Come on in!

186
00:09:33,139 --> 00:09:37,258
Congratulations on making it to day 46.

187
00:09:37,299 --> 00:09:40,338
You have endured intense conditions

188
00:09:40,379 --> 00:09:43,978
and outlasted 20 others,
including your loved ones,

189
00:09:44,019 --> 00:09:46,938
to make it to the final four,

190
00:09:46,979 --> 00:09:48,418
which is significant

191
00:09:48,459 --> 00:09:50,298
because this season...

192
00:09:51,539 --> 00:09:56,938
..final tribal will include
not two but three people.

193
00:09:57,979 --> 00:10:01,858
That means three of you will
have a chance to pitch to the jury

194
00:10:01,899 --> 00:10:05,058
why you deserve the
title of Sole Survivor

195
00:10:05,099 --> 00:10:07,058
and the half a million
dollars that goes with it.

196
00:10:08,739 --> 00:10:10,658
Now, this is a big moment,

197
00:10:10,699 --> 00:10:12,258
and there's a lot on the line,

198
00:10:12,299 --> 00:10:15,898
so you might need a
little love from home...

199
00:10:15,939 --> 00:10:18,018
- Aw...
- ..to help you through it.

200
00:10:18,059 --> 00:10:21,538
Chrissy, are you ready
to speak to your family?

201
00:10:31,219 --> 00:10:32,458
Hello?

202
00:10:36,299 --> 00:10:43,858
What are you doing?!

203
00:10:47,899 --> 00:10:49,258
Hi!

204
00:10:50,579 --> 00:10:52,098
I miss you guys.

205
00:10:52,139 --> 00:10:54,738
I got a couple more things to
do here, and then I'll be home.

206
00:11:02,139 --> 00:11:04,458
OK. Put the cordial on ice.

207
00:11:04,499 --> 00:11:06,098
I'm coming home soon.

208
00:11:08,379 --> 00:11:10,418
Love you, bubbies. See you then.

209
00:11:12,659 --> 00:11:13,858
Bye!

210
00:11:15,339 --> 00:11:16,618
Oh, shit.

211
00:11:17,779 --> 00:11:20,418
Chrissy, did hearing from your family

212
00:11:20,459 --> 00:11:23,698
remind you why you're out
here, playing this crazy game?

213
00:11:23,739 --> 00:11:25,778
Yeah, that's long overdue.

214
00:11:31,419 --> 00:11:32,978
Yeah, I'm ready to go now.

215
00:11:34,619 --> 00:11:36,258
Alright, Mark.

216
00:11:36,299 --> 00:11:38,098
- Here you go.
- Great. Thank you.

217
00:11:38,139 --> 00:11:39,298
Hello?

218
00:11:39,339 --> 00:11:41,098
- Hello, it's Mark.
- Hello?

219
00:11:41,139 --> 00:11:43,018
- How are you?
- Oh!

220
00:11:43,059 --> 00:11:44,578
Get the boy.

221
00:11:44,619 --> 00:11:45,858
Hold up.

222
00:11:54,179 --> 00:11:56,458
Say, "Hello, Daddy."

223
00:11:56,499 --> 00:11:58,418
Hey, mate, it's Daddy!

224
00:11:59,579 --> 00:12:03,058
It's Daddy! Hey. It's
Daddy. How are you?

225
00:12:04,499 --> 00:12:08,698
I love you, mate.

226
00:12:09,899 --> 00:12:12,458
I'm coming home. I'm coming home soon.

227
00:12:15,099 --> 00:12:20,018
I love you, mate. I'm
gonna see you soon.

228
00:12:26,139 --> 00:12:28,218
No, thank you because,
you know, I don't...

229
00:12:28,259 --> 00:12:30,378
I haven't had my mum for a
long time, so I appreciate it

230
00:12:30,419 --> 00:12:32,018
and you're my mum now.

231
00:12:32,059 --> 00:12:33,818
I tell you what...

232
00:12:55,699 --> 00:12:58,658
- I love you. See you soon.
- OK. Bye-bye, Mark.

233
00:13:03,459 --> 00:13:05,698
So, Mark...

234
00:13:05,739 --> 00:13:08,898
..that's the most emotion I've
seen from you in two seasons.

235
00:13:08,939 --> 00:13:10,418
Yep.

236
00:13:10,459 --> 00:13:13,058
Oh, God, he's a young...
he's a young man.

237
00:13:13,099 --> 00:13:15,178
We left him behind for a long time

238
00:13:15,219 --> 00:13:17,418
and it's hard to do that.

239
00:13:17,459 --> 00:13:19,618
But I came here to do a job

240
00:13:19,659 --> 00:13:21,418
and I owe it to him to get it done.

241
00:13:23,659 --> 00:13:24,858
Shay?

242
00:13:26,939 --> 00:13:29,418
- I don't know who this is gonna be.
- I wonder.

243
00:13:34,179 --> 00:13:35,578
Aw, bless!

244
00:13:38,819 --> 00:13:40,378
Hi, Dad.

245
00:13:40,419 --> 00:13:42,378
Oh... Mum's here, too.

246
00:13:44,339 --> 00:13:46,578
I'm good. How are you?

247
00:13:48,579 --> 00:13:50,538
I miss you so much.

248
00:13:50,579 --> 00:13:53,018
I'm sorry I was away for so long.

249
00:13:55,379 --> 00:13:58,458
- What's up, Benny?!
- That's... that's Chrissy.

250
00:13:58,499 --> 00:14:00,978
We, um... we're about to do...

251
00:14:01,019 --> 00:14:02,858
our last... our last challenge.

252
00:14:10,099 --> 00:14:13,258
Love you, Dad. Bye, Mum, love you.

253
00:14:13,299 --> 00:14:14,738
Miss you.

254
00:14:14,779 --> 00:14:16,818
- Bye, Spuddy.
- Bye.

255
00:14:18,099 --> 00:14:22,578
So, Shay, you gave up
your letter for everyone else.

256
00:14:22,619 --> 00:14:25,778
Was it nice to finally have
some love of your own?

257
00:14:25,819 --> 00:14:27,298
Yeah, I really needed that.

258
00:14:27,339 --> 00:14:28,818
I've been thinking about that letter,

259
00:14:28,859 --> 00:14:34,138
and that's the boost I needed to...
to just hopefully get through today.

260
00:14:37,099 --> 00:14:38,378
Josh, you ready?

261
00:14:39,779 --> 00:14:41,858
- There you go.
- Thanks, mate.

262
00:14:41,899 --> 00:14:42,938
Hello?

263
00:14:42,979 --> 00:14:44,098
Hey, babe.

264
00:14:44,138 --> 00:14:45,138
Hi!

265
00:14:45,139 --> 00:14:46,378
What's goin' on?

266
00:14:48,979 --> 00:14:51,098
How you goin'?

267
00:14:54,499 --> 00:14:57,458
Oh, babe, I found out about a week ago.

268
00:15:00,899 --> 00:15:03,658
Oh... I was so happy.

269
00:15:03,699 --> 00:15:05,818
Oh, my God, I was so happy.

270
00:15:05,859 --> 00:15:07,258
Amazing, babe!

271
00:15:12,819 --> 00:15:15,898
Thank you. I love youse all. Yeah.

272
00:15:15,939 --> 00:15:17,938
Love you, bubby!

273
00:15:17,979 --> 00:15:20,378
Oh...

274
00:15:20,419 --> 00:15:21,938
- OK.
- Love you!

275
00:15:21,979 --> 00:15:23,778
Alright. I'll see youse later.

276
00:15:23,819 --> 00:15:26,658
- Bye.
- See you soon. Bye. Love you, bye.

277
00:15:29,939 --> 00:15:32,218
So, Josh, did hearing from the family

278
00:15:32,259 --> 00:15:34,698
give you the strength you need today?

279
00:15:34,739 --> 00:15:36,658
Yeah. They've given
me a little boost, man.

280
00:15:36,699 --> 00:15:38,418
I know it's the last effort, so...

281
00:15:38,459 --> 00:15:40,138
..I'll just give it everything I've got.

282
00:15:44,819 --> 00:15:48,978
Well, I know you're all dying
to find out why we're here.

283
00:15:49,019 --> 00:15:52,978
Are you ready to get to
your final immunity challenge?

284
00:15:53,019 --> 00:15:54,778
Yeah.

285
00:15:54,819 --> 00:15:57,658
Shay, I'm gonna need it back.

286
00:16:04,899 --> 00:16:09,418
For the last time, immunity
is back up for grabs.

287
00:16:10,459 --> 00:16:12,618
For today's challenge,

288
00:16:12,659 --> 00:16:14,778
you are going to hold onto pegs,

289
00:16:14,819 --> 00:16:17,498
perched over a waterfall.

290
00:16:17,539 --> 00:16:19,258
At regular intervals,

291
00:16:19,299 --> 00:16:21,698
you'll move further down the pegs,

292
00:16:21,739 --> 00:16:23,258
making it more difficult.

293
00:16:23,299 --> 00:16:26,618
As time goes on, your arms will tire

294
00:16:26,659 --> 00:16:28,418
until you can no longer hold on...

295
00:16:29,779 --> 00:16:31,378
..and you fall into the water.

296
00:16:33,819 --> 00:16:36,498
Last person standing wins immunity,

297
00:16:36,539 --> 00:16:39,938
guaranteed a spot in the final three.

298
00:16:42,419 --> 00:16:44,498
As for the rest of you,
tribal council tonight,

299
00:16:44,539 --> 00:16:48,538
where somebody is going to
become the 20th person voted out

300
00:16:48,579 --> 00:16:52,138
and 10th and final member of our jury.

301
00:16:55,819 --> 00:16:57,058
This is it.

302
00:16:57,099 --> 00:17:00,898
This could be a half-million
dollar challenge right here.

303
00:17:04,219 --> 00:17:06,458
Let's sort the spots. Let's get to it.

304
00:17:30,259 --> 00:17:32,858
Alright, everyone's in position.

305
00:17:34,419 --> 00:17:35,898
Oh...

306
00:17:41,659 --> 00:17:44,458
I don't know what's
better - to look up or down.

307
00:17:49,019 --> 00:17:52,178
For immunity and a
spot in the final three...

308
00:17:57,819 --> 00:18:00,898
..this challenge is now on.

309
00:18:03,459 --> 00:18:04,618
Oh...

310
00:18:30,142 --> 00:18:32,861
This challenge is now on.

311
00:18:35,782 --> 00:18:37,061
Oh...

312
00:18:38,182 --> 00:18:41,621
If you only win one
challenge this season...

313
00:18:41,662 --> 00:18:43,101
..this is it.

314
00:18:47,102 --> 00:18:50,941
All you gotta do is stay up
there longer than anyone else...

315
00:18:52,222 --> 00:18:56,301
..and you will have secured
your spot at the final tribal council...

316
00:18:57,462 --> 00:19:00,221
..where you will have the
chance to pitch to the jury

317
00:19:00,262 --> 00:19:03,741
why you deserve the
title of Sole Survivor.

318
00:19:11,742 --> 00:19:14,701
These first couple of
pegs are the easy ones.

319
00:19:14,742 --> 00:19:18,021
You can take your hand off
at this stage to get a little relief.

320
00:19:27,782 --> 00:19:29,661
Oh, the stretch is real now.

321
00:19:32,742 --> 00:19:36,181
Hands are gonna hurt, shoulders are
gonna hurt, forearms are gonna hurt.

322
00:19:38,662 --> 00:19:40,981
Nowhere to hide in this challenge.

323
00:19:54,382 --> 00:19:55,501
Alright.

324
00:19:55,542 --> 00:19:56,941
You've been on that first peg

325
00:19:56,982 --> 00:19:58,661
for 15 minutes.

326
00:19:58,702 --> 00:20:01,661
I think it is time to
move on to the third.

327
00:20:02,742 --> 00:20:04,981
I'm gonna give you three seconds.

328
00:20:05,022 --> 00:20:08,221
Three, two...

329
00:20:08,262 --> 00:20:09,901
..one...

330
00:20:12,342 --> 00:20:13,541
Oh, shit.

331
00:20:13,582 --> 00:20:15,261
Everyone on the third post.

332
00:20:15,302 --> 00:20:17,861
I don't understand how your
body reaches that bottom one.

333
00:20:17,902 --> 00:20:19,501
You must be horizontal.

334
00:20:19,542 --> 00:20:21,141
- Yeah.
- Pretty much.

335
00:20:23,462 --> 00:20:27,341
That discomfort soon
is gonna turn into pain.

336
00:20:27,382 --> 00:20:29,741
Then it becomes about pain management.

337
00:20:29,782 --> 00:20:32,941
- What a game.
- What a game.

338
00:20:39,822 --> 00:20:41,581
After 46 days out here,

339
00:20:41,622 --> 00:20:44,741
there's not gonna be much
left in the tank anymore.

340
00:20:44,782 --> 00:20:46,821
You're gonna be running on fumes.

341
00:20:53,462 --> 00:20:54,621
Mark, how you feeling?

342
00:20:55,742 --> 00:20:57,061
Definitely locking the arms up.

343
00:20:57,102 --> 00:20:59,661
Triceps, biceps, forearm.

344
00:20:59,702 --> 00:21:02,101
Shoulders.

345
00:21:02,142 --> 00:21:04,061
Yeah, quite difficult.

346
00:21:04,102 --> 00:21:06,821
- Yeah, it's a forearm burner, man. Yeah.
- It is?

347
00:21:09,022 --> 00:21:11,101
Mark? Mark?

348
00:21:19,902 --> 00:21:21,261
How are you feeling, Shay?

349
00:21:23,702 --> 00:21:25,501
Laser focus.

350
00:21:42,262 --> 00:21:43,621
Alright!

351
00:21:44,822 --> 00:21:47,101
You've all been up there for an hour.

352
00:21:47,142 --> 00:21:49,901
Now we're gonna get to
the meat of the challenge.

353
00:21:49,942 --> 00:21:53,621
We're gonna move on to the next peg.

354
00:21:53,662 --> 00:21:58,221
Three, two and one.

355
00:22:01,062 --> 00:22:03,421
- Lots of movement from everyone.
- Oh...

356
00:22:03,462 --> 00:22:06,141
Everyone trying to find some relief.

357
00:22:12,102 --> 00:22:15,181
Chrissy, head down,
trying to breathe through it.

358
00:22:15,222 --> 00:22:18,101
Immunity is on the line tonight.

359
00:22:21,262 --> 00:22:23,741
The tightest alliance

360
00:22:23,782 --> 00:22:25,301
versus Shay.

361
00:22:26,582 --> 00:22:28,821
But it might have to
break tonight, though.

362
00:22:31,662 --> 00:22:34,061
Tribal will be interesting.

363
00:22:35,502 --> 00:22:39,061
We've got some big decisions
to make if I come out of this alive.

364
00:22:40,702 --> 00:22:45,341
- Head or heart.
- Whole game.

365
00:22:46,782 --> 00:22:49,381
But then you put my kids on the phone.

366
00:22:49,422 --> 00:22:51,861
Shouldn't have done that for these guys.

367
00:22:51,902 --> 00:22:53,301
Ah!

368
00:23:13,302 --> 00:23:16,301
We are gonna move on to the next peg.

369
00:23:18,342 --> 00:23:22,461
In three, two, one...

370
00:23:24,542 --> 00:23:27,821
Mark just slowly working those arms.

371
00:23:28,902 --> 00:23:30,661
Methodically keeping it moving.

372
00:23:32,902 --> 00:23:34,701
Chrissy...

373
00:23:34,742 --> 00:23:36,661
..really starting to struggle now.

374
00:23:36,702 --> 00:23:39,341
She's not even close.

375
00:23:39,382 --> 00:23:43,781
Doing everything she can to
work through that pain in her hands.

376
00:23:43,822 --> 00:23:47,621
Ohh!

377
00:23:47,662 --> 00:23:50,141
Chrissy, groaning now.

378
00:23:50,182 --> 00:23:52,141
Really trying to shake it out.

379
00:24:00,182 --> 00:24:03,741
We're gonna move on
to the second-last peg.

380
00:24:05,462 --> 00:24:09,461
Three, two, one...

381
00:24:11,862 --> 00:24:14,421
We're really stretched out now.

382
00:24:15,942 --> 00:24:20,301
Shay, Josh, looking strong.

383
00:24:22,182 --> 00:24:26,221
Chrissy still in it,
despite all the pain.

384
00:24:29,862 --> 00:24:31,181
Ahh...

385
00:24:31,222 --> 00:24:35,141
Chrissy almost loses
her balance. Nice save!

386
00:24:35,182 --> 00:24:36,901
Ohh!

387
00:24:40,382 --> 00:24:42,221
Chrissy giving it everything.

388
00:24:52,302 --> 00:24:53,421
Wow.

389
00:24:55,462 --> 00:24:56,901
Ohh!

390
00:25:03,702 --> 00:25:05,461
I'm going, Joshie.

391
00:25:05,502 --> 00:25:06,502
Hold on.

392
00:25:10,302 --> 00:25:12,901
Chrissy first in.

393
00:25:12,942 --> 00:25:15,541
After an hour and 32 minutes,

394
00:25:15,582 --> 00:25:18,461
she is out of the challenge.

395
00:25:18,502 --> 00:25:21,381
No shot at immunity.

396
00:25:21,422 --> 00:25:23,541
We're now down to three.

397
00:25:23,582 --> 00:25:26,861
Mark, Josh

398
00:25:26,902 --> 00:25:28,261
and Shay,

399
00:25:28,302 --> 00:25:31,621
all battling it out for
that final necklace.

400
00:25:44,622 --> 00:25:47,261
Those pressure points
are taking a beating.

401
00:25:49,182 --> 00:25:50,821
Gotta stay focused.

402
00:25:53,822 --> 00:25:56,701
Everyone giving it everything.

403
00:26:02,702 --> 00:26:04,181
Oh.

404
00:26:06,942 --> 00:26:09,141
Josh really starting to shake.

405
00:26:11,502 --> 00:26:14,701
Putting in a tremendous
amount of work to stay in this.

406
00:26:14,742 --> 00:26:16,901
Amazing. Amazing.

407
00:26:18,062 --> 00:26:21,221
Trying to find some relief somewhere.

408
00:26:21,262 --> 00:26:22,781
Oh.

409
00:26:24,422 --> 00:26:27,101
Let's go, let's go. Focus.

410
00:26:27,142 --> 00:26:29,821
Josh continues to fight.

411
00:26:40,622 --> 00:26:43,101
Josh continues to shake.

412
00:26:43,142 --> 00:26:45,021
But he is still in it.

413
00:26:53,502 --> 00:26:54,941
Oh, I'm gonna go, bro.

414
00:26:56,862 --> 00:26:58,301
That's it!

415
00:27:00,582 --> 00:27:05,941
After an hour and 38 minutes,
Josh can no longer hold in.

416
00:27:05,982 --> 00:27:08,741
He drops. No shot at immunity.

417
00:27:16,622 --> 00:27:21,301
We now have a showdown
between Mark and Shay,

418
00:27:21,342 --> 00:27:24,621
the biggest and the
smallest left in the game...

419
00:27:24,662 --> 00:27:26,301
- Yes!
- ..going head-to-head.

420
00:27:28,302 --> 00:27:30,421
It's all come down to this.

421
00:27:31,662 --> 00:27:34,781
Who can hold that plank
position the longest?

422
00:27:40,342 --> 00:27:43,901
Battling it out for that final necklace.

423
00:27:43,942 --> 00:27:48,781
It's the only way to guarantee
that you do not end up on the jury

424
00:27:48,822 --> 00:27:52,221
and that you end up in the final three

425
00:27:52,262 --> 00:27:56,061
where you will have a shot
to pitch your case to the jury.

426
00:28:00,502 --> 00:28:03,581
Mark is a big boy,
but he is still in it.

427
00:28:03,622 --> 00:28:04,781
Hold, Marky.

428
00:28:06,662 --> 00:28:08,941
Mark really sweating now.

429
00:28:10,982 --> 00:28:13,341
Who's gonna reach their limit first?

430
00:28:17,542 --> 00:28:22,581
Oh, Shay, gracefully doing some
ballet moves right next to him.

431
00:28:24,622 --> 00:28:25,901
Taunting him.

432
00:28:44,022 --> 00:28:46,221
Mark has been consistent this whole time

433
00:28:46,262 --> 00:28:48,581
but he is flipping from side to side.

434
00:28:48,622 --> 00:28:50,381
He is digging deep.

435
00:28:50,422 --> 00:28:52,101
He's clearly in pain now.

436
00:29:02,062 --> 00:29:03,621
Can Mark hold on?

437
00:29:09,342 --> 00:29:10,781
No! That's it!

438
00:29:16,582 --> 00:29:20,181
Shay wins final immunity!

439
00:29:20,222 --> 00:29:22,781
Whoo!

440
00:29:22,822 --> 00:29:23,941
Wow.

441
00:29:26,422 --> 00:29:28,581
Good job, Shay!

442
00:29:30,222 --> 00:29:32,101
Good job, Marky.

443
00:29:44,582 --> 00:29:46,541
Shay, come on over.

444
00:29:50,742 --> 00:29:52,541
Wow.

445
00:29:52,582 --> 00:29:54,301
Congratulations.

446
00:29:54,342 --> 00:29:56,301
Final immunity is yours.

447
00:29:56,342 --> 00:30:00,021
You have guaranteed
yourself a spot at the final tribal

448
00:30:00,062 --> 00:30:02,501
where you will get a
chance to pitch to the jury

449
00:30:02,542 --> 00:30:05,261
why you deserve the
title of Sole Survivor.

450
00:30:05,302 --> 00:30:06,741
Well done.

451
00:30:06,782 --> 00:30:08,541
As for the rest of you,
tribal council tonight

452
00:30:08,582 --> 00:30:12,661
where one of you will become the
10th and final member of our jury.

453
00:30:12,702 --> 00:30:15,861
Won't be you. Alright,
head back to camp.

454
00:30:15,902 --> 00:30:17,541
I'll see you tonight.

455
00:30:17,582 --> 00:30:18,861
Crazy.

456
00:30:25,462 --> 00:30:28,421
Tonight at tribal council,
there's really not many options.

457
00:30:28,462 --> 00:30:32,861
Shay having immunity, it means
it's basically Chrissy or Josh.

458
00:30:32,902 --> 00:30:37,181
It's a hard choice deciding whether
to vote out my best mate, Josh,

459
00:30:37,222 --> 00:30:40,141
or Chrissy, who's been
tight with me since day one.

460
00:30:40,182 --> 00:30:42,261
One of us is going
home and the other three

461
00:30:42,302 --> 00:30:45,541
are gonna be pitching to a
jury for the title of Sole Survivor.

462
00:30:45,582 --> 00:30:48,861
Someone's going to be
disappointed, so there's a lot at stake.

463
00:31:08,073 --> 00:31:10,012
Congratulations, Shay.

464
00:31:10,012 --> 00:31:11,985
Oh, I'm sorry.

465
00:31:11,985 --> 00:31:14,913
I can hear it in your voice,
you're just like, "Screw you."

466
00:31:16,913 --> 00:31:19,392
I just won today's final
immunity challenge

467
00:31:19,433 --> 00:31:21,952
so I'm wearing the final necklace.

468
00:31:21,993 --> 00:31:24,072
That means I'm safe from tonight's vote

469
00:31:24,113 --> 00:31:27,352
and I am a one-in-three
shot from winning this game.

470
00:31:27,393 --> 00:31:28,752
Mind-blowing.

471
00:31:29,953 --> 00:31:31,752
Mate, well done.

472
00:31:31,793 --> 00:31:33,832
- Sorry. I'm sorry.
- Don't be sorry.

473
00:31:33,873 --> 00:31:36,392
- I wasn't in your top-four plan.
- Don't be sorry.

474
00:31:36,433 --> 00:31:38,832
- That was the risk of taking...
- Stop ruining our plans.

475
00:31:38,873 --> 00:31:39,952
You know?

476
00:31:39,993 --> 00:31:42,712
- Who forged their way into the top three.
- That's it. That's the whole game.

477
00:31:42,753 --> 00:31:44,792
Yeah. Oh, we're gonna have a chat.

478
00:31:44,833 --> 00:31:46,592
- Yeah.
- We'll be back.

479
00:31:52,953 --> 00:31:55,792
Surely they're not leaving us
together, are they?

480
00:31:57,793 --> 00:32:00,192
This is going to be the
hardest vote for you.

481
00:32:00,233 --> 00:32:02,112
- Let's sit. I feel weak already.
- Yeah.

482
00:32:03,393 --> 00:32:07,152
It feels nice to finally have a little
bit of a comfy seat in this game

483
00:32:07,193 --> 00:32:11,712
'cause I have struggled from the
bottom and fought my way here.

484
00:32:12,913 --> 00:32:16,272
In the top three, I want to be
sitting at the end with Chrissy.

485
00:32:16,313 --> 00:32:19,672
However, now my next thought
is, who do I want to sit next to

486
00:32:19,713 --> 00:32:22,472
out of the two big physical threats,

487
00:32:22,513 --> 00:32:24,632
and they're both strategic players.

488
00:32:24,673 --> 00:32:26,912
So my vote tonight is definitely based

489
00:32:26,953 --> 00:32:29,272
on who I think I can beat at the end.

490
00:32:29,313 --> 00:32:32,032
Just don't speak too loud
'cause they're behind us. Um...

491
00:32:33,833 --> 00:32:36,592
Um, yeah, Mark's my first option.

492
00:32:37,793 --> 00:32:39,872
I feel like he's got so
much up his sleeve.

493
00:32:41,233 --> 00:32:45,392
The ball is kind of in both
our court to do the same thing.

494
00:32:45,433 --> 00:32:47,152
I know.

495
00:32:47,193 --> 00:32:50,192
The only other option is that
they're gonna both write you.

496
00:32:50,233 --> 00:32:51,672
Yeah. 100%.

497
00:32:53,033 --> 00:32:54,952
So, do you think Josh will vote you?

498
00:32:56,513 --> 00:32:59,032
- I don't think Josh will write me.
- So he's gonna pull you aside

499
00:32:59,073 --> 00:33:01,792
- and say Mark.
- 100%. 1,000%.

500
00:33:02,833 --> 00:33:05,312
But you'd be stupid not to take me.

501
00:33:11,953 --> 00:33:12,953
What?

502
00:33:19,513 --> 00:33:22,512
Chrissy was happy to
throw you under last night.

503
00:33:22,552 --> 00:33:23,552
Mm.

504
00:33:23,553 --> 00:33:26,152
And she would have jeopardised
my game if that plan went through.

505
00:33:28,193 --> 00:33:29,632
So you and I load up on her...?

506
00:33:29,673 --> 00:33:31,992
I'm 100% locking in on
her now I've thought about it.

507
00:33:33,393 --> 00:33:34,672
OK. Let's just do it.

508
00:33:36,953 --> 00:33:38,992
Plan tonight is me and
Mark vote for Chrissy

509
00:33:39,033 --> 00:33:41,272
and we hope the girls
get their signals crossed,

510
00:33:41,313 --> 00:33:45,072
Chrissy voting for Mark and
Shay putting my name down

511
00:33:45,113 --> 00:33:46,912
and then Chrissy goes home.

512
00:33:46,953 --> 00:33:49,032
It's a master plan, mate.

513
00:33:49,073 --> 00:33:51,992
Me and Mark, if we stay solid, which
we will because we're tied together,

514
00:33:52,033 --> 00:33:54,432
are gonna guarantee
each other at least fire.

515
00:33:54,473 --> 00:33:58,592
The beauty is about this play,
right, we will mope around camp.

516
00:33:58,633 --> 00:34:01,312
We're gonna pitch that this chat is
us saying, "May the best man win."

517
00:34:01,353 --> 00:34:03,712
"We know where
we're at." We do all this.

518
00:34:03,753 --> 00:34:05,392
Yep. Sentimental.

519
00:34:05,433 --> 00:34:06,992
Sentimental, that's it.

520
00:34:07,033 --> 00:34:09,072
Me and Chrissy have
been tight as since day one

521
00:34:09,113 --> 00:34:11,232
but $500,000 is on the line

522
00:34:11,273 --> 00:34:15,032
and this play is
strategic, it's smart play.

523
00:34:15,073 --> 00:34:16,712
- I'll go and pitch 'em anyway.
- Yeah.

524
00:34:16,753 --> 00:34:18,752
- Pitch your ass off, mate.
- I'll just pitch you.

525
00:34:18,793 --> 00:34:21,312
- Pitch me hard.
- Are you ready for my acting?

526
00:34:21,353 --> 00:34:23,312
Both of us, mate, let's put it on.

527
00:34:32,553 --> 00:34:35,632
So... what did Mark say?

528
00:34:35,673 --> 00:34:38,552
We actually just realised that
we can see the writing on the wall

529
00:34:38,593 --> 00:34:40,952
and it was more of just a chat

530
00:34:40,993 --> 00:34:42,512
- between blokes, saying...
- OK.

531
00:34:42,553 --> 00:34:45,392
..you know, we knew that we're
gonna gun for each other today.

532
00:34:45,433 --> 00:34:46,592
Yep.

533
00:34:46,633 --> 00:34:48,112
You don't wanna give away your plan.

534
00:34:48,153 --> 00:34:50,952
I'm acting like Shay and Chrissy
have my game in their hands

535
00:34:50,993 --> 00:34:53,192
and I need them to
believe that that's the case.

536
00:34:53,233 --> 00:34:55,872
- Oh, my God.
- Yeah. Yep.

537
00:34:55,913 --> 00:34:59,792
Mark's game's similar to
mine and Mark's had two idols.

538
00:34:59,833 --> 00:35:00,912
Oh, 100.

539
00:35:00,953 --> 00:35:02,952
He's had idol play,
he's done all that, so...

540
00:35:02,993 --> 00:35:06,592
Yeah, he's got claims, that's for sure.

541
00:35:08,193 --> 00:35:09,392
So...

542
00:35:12,233 --> 00:35:13,233
Yep.

543
00:35:22,713 --> 00:35:25,312
Tonight at tribal council,
there's really not many options.

544
00:35:25,353 --> 00:35:27,072
It's basically Chrissy or Josh.

545
00:35:27,113 --> 00:35:29,152
I've told Josh I'm voting Chrissy

546
00:35:29,193 --> 00:35:31,712
but... I've thought
about it for a long time.

547
00:35:31,753 --> 00:35:33,432
I predicted that this would happen

548
00:35:33,473 --> 00:35:36,872
and I knew I'd have to
go for Josh eventually.

549
00:35:36,913 --> 00:35:38,472
I'm gonna tell Chrissy that as much.

550
00:35:38,513 --> 00:35:41,392
Alright, elephant in the room. Let's go.

551
00:35:46,873 --> 00:35:48,112
I'm writing Josh.

552
00:35:50,233 --> 00:35:54,792
One of the most important
moves I've made in this whole game

553
00:35:54,833 --> 00:35:58,552
didn't last one tribal, it's
lasted for about five weeks,

554
00:35:58,593 --> 00:36:01,272
and that was the decision
to push Josh forward

555
00:36:01,313 --> 00:36:02,672
as the leader of our alliance.

556
00:36:02,713 --> 00:36:04,832
This was my design the whole time.

557
00:36:04,873 --> 00:36:08,632
I knew to get to the end, I had
to have a shield in front of me

558
00:36:08,673 --> 00:36:09,752
when we got to the four.

559
00:36:09,793 --> 00:36:13,032
After five weeks of
putting Josh forward,

560
00:36:13,073 --> 00:36:16,912
at the final hour, the
perceived biggest threat is Josh.

561
00:36:16,953 --> 00:36:18,592
And that's all I needed.

562
00:36:18,633 --> 00:36:20,032
I just think...

563
00:36:21,473 --> 00:36:23,912
..he's a bigger risk and...

564
00:36:23,953 --> 00:36:26,712
..he's a big threat
and he'll probably win.

565
00:36:26,753 --> 00:36:30,312
He does have a lot of things
that he's done in his resume.

566
00:36:30,353 --> 00:36:32,712
Why would I take him? Honestly?

567
00:36:32,753 --> 00:36:36,672
He's better at... The jury likes
him more than they like me.

568
00:36:38,793 --> 00:36:40,312
He's played better.

569
00:36:46,833 --> 00:36:48,912
I've got a massive decision to make.

570
00:36:50,553 --> 00:36:52,632
Mark will not be voting for me.

571
00:36:52,673 --> 00:36:54,432
He definitely wants Josh to go.

572
00:36:54,473 --> 00:36:57,432
Your vote will probably be the decider.

573
00:36:59,073 --> 00:37:02,152
The thought of voting
for Josh breaks my heart.

574
00:37:02,193 --> 00:37:04,912
I don't know how I'm meant to do that.

575
00:37:04,953 --> 00:37:06,832
Goes against everything I stand for.

576
00:37:11,433 --> 00:37:13,592
- So you're not sure at this point.
- No.

577
00:37:13,633 --> 00:37:15,072
- Or you're not...
- I don't even know.

578
00:37:16,953 --> 00:37:18,672
Yi-yi-yi.

579
00:37:18,713 --> 00:37:23,192
Who I want by my side in the
final three and who I should have...

580
00:37:24,233 --> 00:37:26,752
..in my final three are
two totally different things.

581
00:37:26,793 --> 00:37:28,672
I should have...

582
00:37:28,713 --> 00:37:31,192
..Mark and Shay.

583
00:37:31,233 --> 00:37:32,672
I want...

584
00:37:34,153 --> 00:37:35,712
..I think Josh.

585
00:37:35,753 --> 00:37:38,752
But I think all bets are off.

586
00:37:38,793 --> 00:37:40,952
- Like all...
- All alliances are gone.

587
00:37:40,993 --> 00:37:44,472
Exactly. All conversations
are basically dead and untrue

588
00:37:44,513 --> 00:37:46,912
and all that matters is who
people want to sit next to.

589
00:37:49,113 --> 00:37:50,352
I need to switch on.

590
00:37:50,393 --> 00:37:53,312
This is gonna be one of
the biggest nights of my life.

591
00:37:54,473 --> 00:37:59,032
But... for the entire time I've
been on the Survivor journey,

592
00:37:59,073 --> 00:38:02,192
I have absolutely
battled, day in, day out,

593
00:38:02,233 --> 00:38:03,752
with head versus heart.

594
00:38:05,113 --> 00:38:06,912
Those two are my best friends.

595
00:38:08,073 --> 00:38:10,752
So, yeah, I don't know what to do.

596
00:38:10,793 --> 00:38:13,152
We absolutely made...

597
00:38:13,193 --> 00:38:16,832
Absolutely made
our tribe a little family.

598
00:38:20,633 --> 00:38:22,672
Can just about say...

599
00:38:22,713 --> 00:38:25,152
..that blood is not thicker than water

600
00:38:25,193 --> 00:38:27,552
'cause none of these
guys are related to me

601
00:38:27,593 --> 00:38:29,032
and they'll be in my life...

602
00:38:30,553 --> 00:38:31,872
..forever.

603
00:39:18,545 --> 00:39:20,184
We'll now bring in our jury.

604
00:39:22,625 --> 00:39:24,784
Oh, damn.

605
00:39:24,825 --> 00:39:26,264
Khanh.

606
00:39:26,305 --> 00:39:28,424
Mel. Jesse.

607
00:39:28,465 --> 00:39:30,224
Michelle. Jordan.

608
00:39:31,465 --> 00:39:34,144
- Sam.
- Hey.

609
00:39:34,185 --> 00:39:36,944
David. Jordie.

610
00:39:36,985 --> 00:39:40,544
KJ, voted out at
the last tribal council.

611
00:39:46,145 --> 00:39:47,384
Alright.

612
00:39:47,425 --> 00:39:50,744
Before we get started, I
wanna get the jury up to speed.

613
00:39:50,785 --> 00:39:54,304
So today was the final
immunity challenge,

614
00:39:54,345 --> 00:39:57,424
which means tomorrow,
at the final tribal council,

615
00:39:57,465 --> 00:40:00,304
there won't be two,
there will be three people

616
00:40:00,345 --> 00:40:03,304
pleading their case for the $500,000.

617
00:40:05,425 --> 00:40:09,784
So, Shay, no-one wanted
to go up against you today

618
00:40:09,825 --> 00:40:13,024
and I think that necklace
around your neck proves why.

619
