00:40:13,065 --> 00:40:14,864
Yeah. Yeah, it was a tough one.

620
00:40:15,985 --> 00:40:19,224
But, um, everyone put in a
solid effort, it was nice to see.

621
00:40:20,545 --> 00:40:23,824
Chrissy, you stayed up
there for a good 1.5 hours.

622
00:40:23,865 --> 00:40:27,544
Yeah, I did. 1.5 hours,
it was pretty full-on.

623
00:40:27,585 --> 00:40:31,584
I think the phone call
prior bought me some time.

624
00:40:31,625 --> 00:40:33,864
That was pretty...

625
00:40:33,905 --> 00:40:36,864
..pretty good
timing, actually, yeah,

626
00:40:36,905 --> 00:40:40,424
to hear from the rug rats
just before we went out there.

627
00:40:40,465 --> 00:40:42,304
What about for you, Mark?

628
00:40:47,105 --> 00:40:48,584
I think, um...

629
00:40:50,705 --> 00:40:54,984
When I heard Harry's
voice, he'd grown up a bit and...

630
00:40:56,465 --> 00:40:58,144
..that was... It was...

631
00:40:58,185 --> 00:41:00,904
Oh, like, we've been
gone eight weeks from him

632
00:41:00,945 --> 00:41:03,864
and, um, it was great to
hear from him.

633
00:41:03,905 --> 00:41:07,744
And he was OK, but... it's just a
reminder of why we're out here.

634
00:41:09,745 --> 00:41:12,864
Everyone has left a lot behind...

635
00:41:14,025 --> 00:41:17,144
..and we have a lot to
play for and a job to do so...

636
00:41:17,185 --> 00:41:18,664
..that's what we're gonna do.

637
00:41:20,265 --> 00:41:25,704
So, Josh, everyone today
predicted that Shay would win.

638
00:41:25,745 --> 00:41:29,824
Do you think everyone's able to
predict what's gonna happen tonight?

639
00:41:29,865 --> 00:41:31,144
Oh, you never know.

640
00:41:31,185 --> 00:41:34,504
It's the final tribal, people might
throw some curve balls in there but,

641
00:41:34,545 --> 00:41:39,264
um... I think it's one or two
of us are on the block tonight.

642
00:41:39,305 --> 00:41:41,664
And, uh, we'll wait
and see what happens.

643
00:41:43,185 --> 00:41:47,264
So, Mark, the moment you walked
into tribal, you looked quite concerned.

644
00:41:47,305 --> 00:41:51,184
If you are being targeted tonight,
what can you do to protect yourself?

645
00:41:53,225 --> 00:41:56,144
It's pretty hard because
a 30-minute scramble

646
00:41:56,185 --> 00:41:58,224
is not gonna be what protects you.

647
00:41:58,265 --> 00:42:02,664
It's the six weeks of game play
that we've had leading up to that point

648
00:42:02,705 --> 00:42:05,664
which is gonna be the
deciding factor for people.

649
00:42:05,705 --> 00:42:07,504
They're gonna look at
what's in their interests

650
00:42:07,545 --> 00:42:10,424
and they're gonna probably
vote in accordance with that.

651
00:42:11,465 --> 00:42:13,984
Well, Chrissy voted for you last night.

652
00:42:15,505 --> 00:42:19,224
Are you concerned she could
do the same again tonight?

653
00:42:19,265 --> 00:42:21,544
There's just not many options, so...

654
00:42:21,585 --> 00:42:24,424
..I understand copping a vote. Yeah.

655
00:42:28,345 --> 00:42:29,984
So, Chrissy...

656
00:42:30,025 --> 00:42:33,064
..can't vote for Shay, obviously
you can't vote for yourself.

657
00:42:33,105 --> 00:42:37,984
The only two people you can
vote for tonight are Josh and Mark

658
00:42:38,025 --> 00:42:41,944
and you've described both of
them as family, in this game.

659
00:42:41,985 --> 00:42:43,664
It's the worst predicament to be in.

660
00:42:43,705 --> 00:42:47,664
And Shay knows, like, when she
won today, of course I'm happy for her

661
00:42:47,705 --> 00:42:50,984
but I was gutted inside 'cause
I knew it was only inevitable.

662
00:42:51,025 --> 00:42:53,664
It's, uh, not the position
I wanted to be in.

663
00:42:53,705 --> 00:42:57,024
I said on day two,
"Alright, him and him."

664
00:42:57,065 --> 00:43:01,184
I don't know how to say,
without swearing, how bad it is.

665
00:43:04,225 --> 00:43:06,824
So, Shay, it is interesting tonight.

666
00:43:06,865 --> 00:43:11,264
With you safe, the alliance
of Chrissy, Josh and Mark,

667
00:43:11,305 --> 00:43:13,264
which has been tight since day one,

668
00:43:13,305 --> 00:43:14,744
will have to turn on itself.

669
00:43:14,785 --> 00:43:16,464
That is a fact.

670
00:43:16,505 --> 00:43:18,304
It sucks I have to come between them

671
00:43:18,345 --> 00:43:20,184
but at least it gets
my foot in the door.

672
00:43:20,225 --> 00:43:23,784
I think the necklace obviously
brought me some time, twice,

673
00:43:23,825 --> 00:43:26,344
and now I'm just lucky
enough to be able to sit back

674
00:43:26,385 --> 00:43:28,864
and watch it implode a little bit.

675
00:43:43,745 --> 00:43:47,184
But it's down to each person
to play their role with their vote.

676
00:43:47,225 --> 00:43:49,864
So it's a gamble. It's a massive gamble.

677
00:43:53,145 --> 00:43:56,064
Josh, do you think your
relationship with Chrissy

678
00:43:56,105 --> 00:43:57,624
is enough to protect you tonight?

679
00:43:59,185 --> 00:44:02,624
I have, uh, all my fingers
and toes crossed, mate,

680
00:44:02,665 --> 00:44:04,384
like I've done my
pitch to the two girls,

681
00:44:04,425 --> 00:44:07,704
and me and Mark have shook hands
and said, "Mate, it's been a pleasure,

682
00:44:07,745 --> 00:44:11,944
"but, you know, we've gotta go
for each other tonight, pretty much."

683
00:44:11,985 --> 00:44:15,904
And, you know, I'm relying heavily
on my relationship with Chrissy,

684
00:44:15,945 --> 00:44:18,744
so... fingers crossed, man.

685
00:44:20,145 --> 00:44:22,384
Alright, well, I think
we should find out

686
00:44:22,425 --> 00:44:24,864
exactly how this is gonna play out.

687
00:44:24,905 --> 00:44:26,864
It is time to vote.

688
00:44:26,905 --> 00:44:28,344
Josh, you're up.

689
00:45:00,025 --> 00:45:01,944
Fingers crossed. Let's
see what happens tonight.

690
00:45:01,985 --> 00:45:02,985
It's been an honour.

691
00:45:25,345 --> 00:45:26,944
Well, here we are.

692
00:45:26,985 --> 00:45:28,784
Gotta write one or the other.

693
00:45:54,985 --> 00:45:56,744
I'll go count the votes.

694
00:46:04,985 --> 00:46:06,624
I'll read the votes.

695
00:46:08,945 --> 00:46:10,824
First vote...

696
00:46:10,865 --> 00:46:12,464
..Josh.

697
00:46:17,545 --> 00:46:20,944
Chrissy. That's one vote
Josh, one vote Chrissy.

698
00:46:29,065 --> 00:46:32,744
Josh. Two votes Josh,
one vote Chrissy...

699
00:46:34,745 --> 00:46:36,464
..one vote left.

700
00:46:40,305 --> 00:46:43,904
20th person voted out and
final member of our jury...

701
00:46:43,945 --> 00:46:45,264
..Josh.

702
00:46:47,785 --> 00:46:49,424
You need to bring me your torch.

703
00:47:12,185 --> 00:47:14,144
Josh, the tribe has spoken.

704
00:47:14,185 --> 00:47:15,624
They have, mate.

705
00:47:22,345 --> 00:47:24,384
- Cheers, guys. Thanks, mate.
- Well done, mate.

706
00:47:24,425 --> 00:47:26,264
- Cheers, brother.
- Cheers.

707
00:47:35,345 --> 00:47:37,224
Well, congratulations,

708
00:47:37,265 --> 00:47:41,224
you three have gone as far
as you can go in this game.

709
00:47:41,265 --> 00:47:44,864
Tomorrow night, the
power shifts to the jury.

710
00:47:44,905 --> 00:47:49,624
So I suggest go back to
camp, get a good night's sleep

711
00:47:49,665 --> 00:47:51,864
and think about how you're
gonna convince THEM

712
00:47:51,905 --> 00:47:55,064
that you deserve to win this game.

713
00:47:55,105 --> 00:47:59,104
Grab your torches. Head
back to camp. Goodnight.

714
00:48:30,792 --> 00:48:32,611
Oh.

715
00:48:34,942 --> 00:48:36,814
Oi.

716
00:48:39,496 --> 00:48:42,131
- Are you serious?
- Keep telling ya, just hang them up.

717
00:48:42,131 --> 00:48:44,737
They were wet, Mark!

718
00:48:44,737 --> 00:48:47,498
Oh. 47 days.

719
00:48:48,915 --> 00:48:51,754
We'll go for our last
little morning stroll?

720
00:48:51,795 --> 00:48:53,434
- Yeah, let's do it.
- Do it.

721
00:48:53,475 --> 00:48:55,554
- Go this way?
- Yeah. Let's go.

722
00:48:56,955 --> 00:48:59,554
This is too surreal to take in.

723
00:48:59,595 --> 00:49:01,714
I just wasn't expecting to get this far

724
00:49:01,755 --> 00:49:04,954
and to get to the final
three in a game like this,

725
00:49:04,995 --> 00:49:07,754
it's the world's greatest
game and I'm proud I got here

726
00:49:07,795 --> 00:49:09,354
and I think Sam will be proud of me too

727
00:49:09,395 --> 00:49:11,234
because she's part
of the reason I'm here.

728
00:49:12,955 --> 00:49:14,554
Nearly home.

729
00:49:18,395 --> 00:49:20,194
I think, looking back at the game,

730
00:49:20,235 --> 00:49:22,754
this has been a lot
about confronting fear.

731
00:49:22,795 --> 00:49:26,834
I spent a long time putting myself
in situations that were horrendous.

732
00:49:26,875 --> 00:49:30,354
They tested me in every
way - physically, emotionally.

733
00:49:32,035 --> 00:49:34,834
- Family's gonna be so proud.
- Yeah.

734
00:49:36,515 --> 00:49:39,074
- Yep.
- Kids are gonna be so proud.

735
00:49:40,555 --> 00:49:43,874
Being out here for
weeks, whenever I woke up,

736
00:49:43,915 --> 00:49:47,474
I thought a lot about the
time I'd spent away, fighting.

737
00:49:48,635 --> 00:49:51,754
It was the first time I was
involved in combat as a young guy.

738
00:49:51,795 --> 00:49:54,834
And I was on a river
that was just like the one

739
00:49:54,875 --> 00:49:57,034
we were sleeping next to.

740
00:49:57,075 --> 00:50:00,554
And in the early morning, in the
dawn, we had to cross this river

741
00:50:00,595 --> 00:50:04,354
and, um, I came up against a cornfield

742
00:50:04,395 --> 00:50:09,594
and we got stuck there for -
in a battle - for about 12 hours.

743
00:50:15,115 --> 00:50:16,674
It was super rough.

744
00:50:21,115 --> 00:50:23,074
I mean, I was only 27.

745
00:50:25,515 --> 00:50:28,274
But one of my soldiers was killed.

746
00:50:46,315 --> 00:50:49,754
Yeah, it's funny 'cause I never
thought about it and then...

747
00:50:49,795 --> 00:50:52,994
..when I was here, every
morning, I had to think about it.

748
00:50:54,315 --> 00:50:57,834
Maybe now when you see creeks like
this, you'll have Survivor memories,

749
00:50:57,875 --> 00:50:59,314
not those memories.

750
00:50:59,355 --> 00:51:01,394
Yeah. Hope so. Better.

751
00:51:01,435 --> 00:51:05,554
Let's do that. About laughing.
About Juicy Dave stories.

752
00:51:08,795 --> 00:51:11,954
I think after this, I'm
gonna see it differently.

753
00:51:11,995 --> 00:51:16,674
I'm not gonna see that same
river that I fought in, I'm gonna see...

754
00:51:17,875 --> 00:51:19,354
..um...

755
00:51:20,835 --> 00:51:22,594
..a camp site where I have mates.

756
00:51:29,915 --> 00:51:32,194
Well, it's been a ride.

757
00:51:32,235 --> 00:51:33,914
- It's been a ride.
- Hasn't it?

758
00:51:33,955 --> 00:51:35,554
- Sure has.
- Been a ride.

759
00:51:35,595 --> 00:51:37,354
Yeah.

760
00:51:37,395 --> 00:51:41,074
To come out and compete in the
game, it's blood, sweat and tears

761
00:51:41,115 --> 00:51:43,114
to try and get to the end.

762
00:51:43,155 --> 00:51:46,474
It's... I feel a real
mixed bag of emotions,

763
00:51:46,515 --> 00:51:50,114
and I think being
here is a sense of relief

764
00:51:50,155 --> 00:51:54,114
and also, a sense of anticipation
because I know tonight,

765
00:51:54,155 --> 00:51:56,234
I'm gonna have to make
the speech of my life.

766
00:52:01,915 --> 00:52:03,954
- Oh.
- What the?

767
00:52:05,515 --> 00:52:07,514
- Avocado!
- Oh, champagne!

768
00:52:07,555 --> 00:52:09,914
- There's champagne there.
- Oh.

769
00:52:09,955 --> 00:52:13,474
I have played such a massive game

770
00:52:13,515 --> 00:52:15,554
compared to what I
thought and when I started.

771
00:52:15,595 --> 00:52:17,234
"Congratulations."

772
00:52:17,275 --> 00:52:19,314
"Celebrate a game
well played with this feast

773
00:52:19,355 --> 00:52:21,114
"fit for the final three."

774
00:52:22,195 --> 00:52:24,074
Originally, I was doing this for myself

775
00:52:24,115 --> 00:52:25,914
but now I feel like I'm doing it

776
00:52:25,955 --> 00:52:28,554
for a whole generation of younger girls

777
00:52:28,595 --> 00:52:31,954
who are maybe scared to lift weights
and they were scared to be strong,

778
00:52:31,995 --> 00:52:35,874
but this will show them that we
are more resilient than we realise.

779
00:52:35,915 --> 00:52:41,674
And all it takes is sticking strong
to yourself and backing yourself.

780
00:52:42,835 --> 00:52:45,554
Cheers, 21 fallen men.

781
00:52:45,595 --> 00:52:47,674
And here we are.

782
00:52:47,715 --> 00:52:49,954
- We've lost a lot of good people.
- We lost some good people!

783
00:52:49,995 --> 00:52:51,834
We lost some good people.

784
00:52:51,875 --> 00:52:55,394
I was a massive fish out
of water coming in here.

785
00:52:55,435 --> 00:52:57,834
Now, here I am,

786
00:52:57,875 --> 00:52:59,714
final three, baby.

787
00:52:59,755 --> 00:53:00,954
Who would have thunk it?

788
00:53:01,995 --> 00:53:04,834
This game puts you into an immediate

789
00:53:04,875 --> 00:53:07,434
state of the opposite
to how you live your life.

790
00:53:07,475 --> 00:53:08,834
Yep.

791
00:53:08,875 --> 00:53:10,194
I've stayed true to myself.

792
00:53:10,235 --> 00:53:13,434
I've been truthful, reliable,
caring, social butterfly.

793
00:53:13,475 --> 00:53:16,994
I need to really tell Khanh
how good he looks tonight.

794
00:53:17,995 --> 00:53:20,514
Like, drop GQ.

795
00:53:20,555 --> 00:53:23,634
And I definitely had
the social connections

796
00:53:23,675 --> 00:53:25,754
for people to just forget about my name.

797
00:53:25,795 --> 00:53:28,354
Like, my name never came up.

798
00:53:28,395 --> 00:53:30,394
Week one, once.

799
00:53:31,475 --> 00:53:33,834
Isn't that in itself a strategy?

800
00:53:33,875 --> 00:53:35,834
35, 40, 45...

801
00:53:35,875 --> 00:53:37,714
47.

802
00:53:37,755 --> 00:53:39,154
That's a lot of days.

803
00:53:39,195 --> 00:53:42,674
This is it. Now we're gonna
play ball for the last quarter.

804
00:53:42,715 --> 00:53:45,314
It's time now to pitch
for my life to that jury.

805
00:53:45,355 --> 00:53:48,234
You know, I've gotta preach
to them why I deserve to win.

806
00:54:49,062 --> 00:54:50,910
And then there were three.

807
00:54:50,910 --> 00:54:53,092
Then there were three.

808
00:54:53,769 --> 00:54:55,728
I'll now bring in the
members of our jury.

809
00:54:57,689 --> 00:54:59,728
Khanh. Mel.

810
00:54:59,769 --> 00:55:01,608
Jesse. Michelle.

811
00:55:01,649 --> 00:55:03,928
Jordan. Sam.

812
00:55:03,969 --> 00:55:06,448
David. Jordie.

813
00:55:06,489 --> 00:55:08,008
KJ.

814
00:55:08,049 --> 00:55:11,808
And Josh, voted out
at the last tribal council.

815
00:55:16,489 --> 00:55:23,208
So... here we are, day 47,
in your final tribal council.

816
00:55:23,249 --> 00:55:28,168
The three of you have gone as
far as you can go in this game.

817
00:55:28,209 --> 00:55:31,648
And tonight, the power
now shifts to the jury -

818
00:55:31,689 --> 00:55:34,208
10 people you've had
a hand in voting out,

819
00:55:34,249 --> 00:55:35,968
either directly or indirectly,

820
00:55:36,009 --> 00:55:39,888
will now decide which of you three
deserves the title of Sole Survivor

821
00:55:39,929 --> 00:55:42,208
and the $500,000 that goes with it.

822
00:55:43,249 --> 00:55:44,968
This is how tonight's gonna work -

823
00:55:45,009 --> 00:55:47,848
you'll each make an opening statement.

824
00:55:47,889 --> 00:55:50,168
This is your chance
to pitch to the jury

825
00:55:50,209 --> 00:55:53,688
why you deserve to win this game.

826
00:55:53,729 --> 00:55:56,768
Then the jury will address you.

827
00:55:56,809 --> 00:56:00,488
They'll ask you questions
and you'll answer them.

828
00:56:00,529 --> 00:56:04,008
Then they'll have a chance to respond
to your answers in an open forum.

829
00:56:05,169 --> 00:56:07,808
Once everyone's said their piece,

830
00:56:07,849 --> 00:56:09,208
the jury will go up to vote

831
00:56:09,249 --> 00:56:15,248
to decide who wins Australian
Survivor Blood v. Water.

832
00:56:18,929 --> 00:56:21,008
Mark, would you like to kick it off?

833
00:56:21,049 --> 00:56:24,608
Just like that? I'd love to, Jonathan.

834
00:56:25,689 --> 00:56:30,328
When I walked onto the
sands of Samoa four years ago,

835
00:56:30,369 --> 00:56:33,888
I came to play the
game of Survivor and...

836
00:56:33,929 --> 00:56:37,248
..I met the love of my life, Samantha.

837
00:56:38,529 --> 00:56:41,488
And it's been a huge part of
my life, it's given me everything.

838
00:56:41,529 --> 00:56:43,968
So we didn't want to be the
couple that had a second chance,

839
00:56:44,009 --> 00:56:46,008
came back and blew it.

840
00:56:47,489 --> 00:56:52,128
I know we all came here to play
in these battles and to fight it out,

841
00:56:52,169 --> 00:56:54,488
but I came to win the war as well.

842
00:56:55,769 --> 00:56:58,848
To do that, you need a strategy
and the strategy I came up with,

843
00:56:58,889 --> 00:57:00,168
it was to win.

844
00:57:01,689 --> 00:57:05,048
Sounds simple but very,
very difficult to execute.

845
00:57:07,409 --> 00:57:10,568
So the first move was
really to go after Andy.

846
00:57:12,449 --> 00:57:15,008
Andy was a returning
player, he was a big threat

847
00:57:15,049 --> 00:57:17,928
and I could have run on
his coat-tails for a long time

848
00:57:17,969 --> 00:57:20,048
but I decided not to.

849
00:57:20,089 --> 00:57:21,928
I worked tightly with Nina

850
00:57:21,969 --> 00:57:24,888
and decided to cut him down
as early as we could in the game.

851
00:57:26,369 --> 00:57:28,528
The next move was the tribe swap.

852
00:57:30,009 --> 00:57:32,808
So when that came, I had
the really fortunate position

853
00:57:32,849 --> 00:57:36,848
to being able to choose between
the new blue tribe or the new red tribe.

854
00:57:36,889 --> 00:57:38,968
And I could have taken the safe option,

855
00:57:39,009 --> 00:57:42,208
gone back to my old blue
tribe, Sammy was now there.

856
00:57:42,249 --> 00:57:43,968
But I didn't, I chose
the riskier option -

857
00:57:44,009 --> 00:57:46,488
red 2.0, we formed a new majority.

858
00:57:46,529 --> 00:57:49,128
We were able to pull off
some pretty cool early moves.

859
00:57:49,169 --> 00:57:51,928
Went straight after the queen, Sandra.

860
00:57:51,969 --> 00:57:53,888
'Cause we knew she was a huge threat.

861
00:57:55,169 --> 00:57:56,848
And then, after we'd gone to the merge,

862
00:57:56,889 --> 00:58:00,648
we had been planning to go after Khanh.

863
00:58:00,689 --> 00:58:03,728
Because you were such a good player
and you had an idol for so long too,

864
00:58:03,769 --> 00:58:05,568
I think the record - 21 days.

865
00:58:07,849 --> 00:58:11,048
The next move was a
real dilemma for Sam and I.

866
00:58:12,769 --> 00:58:17,128
We had to make a choice
between Jordan and Josh

867
00:58:17,169 --> 00:58:18,768
or Jordie and Jesse.

868
00:58:18,809 --> 00:58:20,448
And...

869
00:58:20,489 --> 00:58:23,808
..we made the tough
choice to go after you, Jesse,

870
00:58:23,849 --> 00:58:25,768
because you two are like yin and yang.

871
00:58:25,809 --> 00:58:28,448
You've got, like,
cool-headed, hot-headed.

872
00:58:28,489 --> 00:58:32,168
You're complementary game
players, right, both incredible threats?

873
00:58:32,209 --> 00:58:36,928
And so it was a really tough move
but it was a move we wanted to make.

874
00:58:36,969 --> 00:58:41,248
We were managing a lot of different
parts, including the second idol,

875
00:58:41,289 --> 00:58:45,088
which Jesse had given it to
Sam and it was now a new threat.

876
00:58:45,129 --> 00:58:48,208
That really set up
the final move for me.

877
00:58:49,969 --> 00:58:53,288
For about 30-plus days,
I'd been tight with Josh

878
00:58:53,329 --> 00:58:57,288
and, mate, I had been pushing
you as a leader of our team.

879
00:58:58,449 --> 00:59:02,408
What I was trying to do was make you
a relatively higher threat than I was.

880
00:59:02,449 --> 00:59:06,128
And in the final vote,
the votes landed on Josh.

881
00:59:06,169 --> 00:59:09,728
I'm sure it still stings
but you are my mate.

882
00:59:11,849 --> 00:59:13,488
They were the major moves that I made.

883
00:59:13,529 --> 00:59:17,808
I feel like I have outwitted,
outplayed and outlasted.

884
00:59:19,329 --> 00:59:22,408
When you go up tonight
to vote, respectfully,

885
00:59:22,449 --> 00:59:25,328
I just ask you to think
about considering me

886
00:59:25,369 --> 00:59:30,008
to represent all of you as
this season's Sole Survivor.

887
00:59:34,569 --> 00:59:36,248
Alright.

888
00:59:36,289 --> 00:59:38,528
Nicely said.

889
00:59:38,569 --> 00:59:41,328
Shay, what would you
like to say to the jury?

890
00:59:43,529 --> 00:59:45,448
Here we go.

891
00:59:45,489 --> 00:59:48,528
So... to me...

892
00:59:48,569 --> 00:59:51,728
..the essence of a survivor is to fight.

893
00:59:52,929 --> 00:59:56,528
To actually survive and have
to be at the bottom at some point

894
00:59:56,569 --> 00:59:57,928
and to work their way up.

895
00:59:57,969 --> 00:59:59,928
And I had to make sure the tribe knew,

896
00:59:59,969 --> 01:00:03,568
"Hey, Shay is a physical strength,
she's gonna help us get to rewards."

897
01:00:03,609 --> 01:00:05,968
And I sure did. I tried
as hard as I could

898
01:00:06,009 --> 01:00:08,808
so we did get to a fair few
rewards and immunity wins.

899
01:00:09,889 --> 01:00:11,408
Then merge happened.

900
01:00:11,449 --> 01:00:13,328
That was a huge, joyful moment.

901
01:00:13,369 --> 01:00:16,528
You know, day 32 came
and that was the day when

902
01:00:16,569 --> 01:00:19,608
I knew it was me or Jordie.

903
01:00:19,649 --> 01:00:21,688
Whoever wasn't wearing
the necklace was going

904
01:00:21,729 --> 01:00:23,808
and basically woke up in purgatory.

905
01:00:23,849 --> 01:00:27,368
So to go through that
was... Sure, it was painful

906
01:00:27,409 --> 01:00:29,688
but fought my way back into the game.

907
01:00:31,369 --> 01:00:32,848
I had to fight my way through

908
01:00:32,889 --> 01:00:36,208
and use my physical
strength against all odds.

909
01:00:36,249 --> 01:00:39,928
I ended up with four necklaces,

910
01:00:39,969 --> 01:00:42,568
if you include the one that
Khanh and I got before merge,

911
01:00:42,609 --> 01:00:44,728
which is the most in the game.

912
01:00:44,769 --> 01:00:47,488
I've shown myself that
I am a physical threat.

913
01:00:47,529 --> 01:00:50,317
I'm an absolute beast and could
have gone for an extra half an hour,

914
01:00:50,322 --> 01:00:51,568
hour, in that final challenge.

915
01:00:51,609 --> 01:00:53,688
This whole time, I've
been at the bottom,

916
01:00:53,729 --> 01:00:55,088
actually fighting for my life.

917
01:00:55,129 --> 01:00:57,928
That is why I'm
deserving of Sole Survivor.

918
01:01:01,689 --> 01:01:03,728
Nicely done. Chrissy.

919
01:01:05,249 --> 01:01:08,168
- You're up.
- Alrighty.

920
01:01:08,209 --> 01:01:09,568
Thank you, Jonathan.

921
01:01:10,769 --> 01:01:14,208
The last 47 days have been
the hardest 47 days of my life.

922
01:01:15,649 --> 01:01:20,008
But if you think for one minute
that I left my three babies at home

923
01:01:20,049 --> 01:01:22,688
with no idea where I was
going, what I was doing,

924
01:01:22,729 --> 01:01:24,568
or how long I was gonna be,

925
01:01:24,609 --> 01:01:26,648
you are sorely mistaken.

926
01:01:28,169 --> 01:01:30,848
I'm not here as an accident.

927
01:01:31,969 --> 01:01:35,008
I made my way here on purpose. And...

928
01:01:35,049 --> 01:01:36,968
..I guess let's start at the beginning.

929
01:01:38,129 --> 01:01:41,208
So coming into this, I had one intention

930
01:01:41,249 --> 01:01:43,568
and it was to play a social game.

931
01:01:43,609 --> 01:01:45,688
I've been social my whole life.

932
01:01:45,729 --> 01:01:48,448
I definitely wasn't gonna
be a physical threat.

933
01:01:48,489 --> 01:01:51,888
So I had to align myself
with the best in the business

934
01:01:51,929 --> 01:01:53,688
and I pinpointed them straightaway.

935
01:01:55,369 --> 01:01:57,088
Started my socialising

936
01:01:57,129 --> 01:02:00,328
and started to meet you
guys on a little deeper level.

937
01:02:00,369 --> 01:02:03,688
I have attended more
tribal councils than all of you,

938
01:02:03,729 --> 01:02:05,928
I've been to 19 in total.

939
01:02:05,969 --> 01:02:08,288
And Briana wrote my
name down on the fifth day

940
01:02:08,329 --> 01:02:10,768
and it didn't get written
down again until the 41st day.

941
01:02:12,089 --> 01:02:16,888
My loyalty to you guys, Jesse
especially, shouldn't go unnoticed

942
01:02:16,929 --> 01:02:19,048
and I will remind you...

943
01:02:19,089 --> 01:02:22,128
..I went against my blood and...

944
01:02:22,169 --> 01:02:25,968
..to prove my loyalty to my alliance
with Jordie over the other side,

945
01:02:26,009 --> 01:02:28,888
I went against Croc,

946
01:02:28,929 --> 01:02:31,208
I didn't go with what he wanted to do

947
01:02:31,249 --> 01:02:32,528
and I didn't write your name down.

948
01:02:32,569 --> 01:02:34,368
'Cause I needed to look
Jordie in the eyes and say,

949
01:02:34,409 --> 01:02:35,888
"You've still got my back over there."

950
01:02:37,209 --> 01:02:39,648
With that, ramifications,
Croc ended up going home

951
01:02:39,689 --> 01:02:41,728
and it was at Benny's hand.

952
01:02:41,769 --> 01:02:45,128
So there's no way that
was gonna go down lightly

953
01:02:45,169 --> 01:02:46,928
and I needed to take
my revenge on Benny.

954
01:02:48,289 --> 01:02:50,528
And then...

955
01:02:50,569 --> 01:02:52,608
..there was my number one, Joshie.

956
01:02:54,049 --> 01:02:55,928
What a team we made.

957
01:03:00,569 --> 01:03:03,248
After 46 days,

958
01:03:03,289 --> 01:03:07,928
I've realised that blood
absolutely isn't thicker than water.

959
01:03:09,329 --> 01:03:11,568
And you will be my family,
even if you don't wanna be,

960
01:03:11,609 --> 01:03:13,768
I know you will be my family after this.

961
01:03:13,809 --> 01:03:16,528
But you taught me to
respect the big moves

962
01:03:16,569 --> 01:03:18,928
for the days leading into last night.

963
01:03:20,489 --> 01:03:22,128
And you were my big move.

964
01:03:24,489 --> 01:03:27,648
So I hope you can see...

965
01:03:27,689 --> 01:03:29,488
..why that went down last night.

966
01:03:32,529 --> 01:03:36,448
In saying that, other people on this
jury taught me some hell stuff too.

967
01:03:36,489 --> 01:03:39,328
Jordie, you friggin' taught
me how to laugh again, man.

968
01:03:39,369 --> 01:03:43,208
And in here, we are out the
back of nowhere with nothing left,

969
01:03:43,249 --> 01:03:46,328
and humour is absolutely key.

970
01:03:46,369 --> 01:03:49,608
KJ, you reminded me why we're
here, we're doing it for the kids.

971
01:03:49,649 --> 01:03:52,528
Every day, you'd say they'd be so proud.

972
01:03:52,569 --> 01:03:54,528
I doubted it so much.

973
01:03:54,569 --> 01:03:59,128
If I can take a tiny bit
of each of you with me

974
01:03:59,169 --> 01:04:03,088
to possibly represent
you, as the Sole Survivor,

975
01:04:03,129 --> 01:04:05,128
my job here is done.

976
01:04:09,409 --> 01:04:10,648
Thanks.

977
01:04:13,209 --> 01:04:17,048
Alright, jury, you've heard
three very good pitches...

978
01:04:18,929 --> 01:04:22,328
..it's now your turn to ask questions.

979
01:04:24,209 --> 01:04:29,048
You're looking for information
to make a $500,000 decision.

980
01:04:48,273 --> 01:04:52,562
Alright, jury, you've heard
three very good pitches.

981
01:04:54,151 --> 01:04:56,670
It's now your turn to ask questions,

982
01:04:56,711 --> 01:05:00,870
looking for information to
make a $500,000 decision.

983
01:05:02,551 --> 01:05:04,270
Alright, Khanh?

984
01:05:04,311 --> 01:05:06,590
Would you like to start us off?

985
01:05:06,631 --> 01:05:08,390
Hi, guys. Firstly, congratulations.

986
01:05:08,431 --> 01:05:10,430
You guys, you got to the end.

987
01:05:10,471 --> 01:05:13,990
There's a lot of us that would
have loved to be there, so great job.

988
01:05:14,031 --> 01:05:16,550
You played all very
different games, obviously.

989
01:05:16,591 --> 01:05:19,510
Chrissy, I love you. I don't
have any questions for you.

990
01:05:19,551 --> 01:05:21,150
I love you, Khanh.

991
01:05:21,191 --> 01:05:24,110
Um, Mark, you...

992
01:05:24,151 --> 01:05:26,310
..said it yourself you played
hard from the beginning,

993
01:05:26,351 --> 01:05:29,550
you got Andy out, you didn't make
any excuses about being a threat,

994
01:05:29,591 --> 01:05:30,950
that was known.

995
01:05:30,991 --> 01:05:34,550
I think that you were willing to
make sacrifices, that being Sam,

996
01:05:34,591 --> 01:05:35,830
to get there.

997
01:05:35,871 --> 01:05:38,070
But what I wanna know
was, was that hard?

998
01:05:38,111 --> 01:05:42,670
Because I think naturally, you would
want to preserve your wife, right?

999
01:05:44,191 --> 01:05:45,870
That is a really good one.

1000
01:05:45,911 --> 01:05:49,390
When Sam and I sat down to
play the game, we basically said,

1001
01:05:49,431 --> 01:05:53,150
"We've got two chances to get to
the end, we're both the same person,

1002
01:05:53,191 --> 01:05:55,470
"if one of us wins, we both win."

1003
01:05:55,511 --> 01:05:57,790
There was a point where we had two idols

1004
01:05:57,831 --> 01:06:01,590
and I had the chance to
save Sam and I didn't do it...

1005
01:06:03,111 --> 01:06:05,990
..however, it was a decision we had made

1006
01:06:06,031 --> 01:06:09,310
in the cold light of day
before we got to tribal council.

1007
01:06:09,351 --> 01:06:10,910
That we're not playing an idol.

1008
01:06:10,951 --> 01:06:13,950
The other person will
go back with two idols.

1009
01:06:13,991 --> 01:06:16,190
It was hard but that's what happened.

1010
01:06:17,351 --> 01:06:19,350
OK, well, that's where I
wanna pick up, you know,

1011
01:06:19,391 --> 01:06:22,230
because you sent Jesse over here

1012
01:06:22,271 --> 01:06:26,510
and then made ME feel
responsible for Jesse being there.

1013
01:06:27,551 --> 01:06:31,430
Tell me why those actions
were necessary to your game.

1014
01:06:32,951 --> 01:06:35,150
Um, Jesse and Jordie,

1015
01:06:35,191 --> 01:06:38,070
I don't think anyone was on
the receiving end of our moves

1016
01:06:38,111 --> 01:06:39,830
as much as you both.

1017
01:06:39,871 --> 01:06:44,510
The other part about lying about
the second idol, that was very difficult

1018
01:06:44,551 --> 01:06:46,670
but very necessary.

1019
01:06:46,711 --> 01:06:50,230
The fallout to that was making
you look like you're a bit crazy.

1020
01:06:50,271 --> 01:06:53,310
And I knew eventually,
you would be vindicated.

1021
01:06:53,351 --> 01:06:54,870
And you were.

1022
01:06:54,911 --> 01:06:56,990
And, um, I do apologise for it.

1023
01:06:58,431 --> 01:07:01,830
Because of that decision, I was
able to get more steps in the game.

1024
01:07:01,871 --> 01:07:04,630
To be honest, I didn't
care if it was me or Sam.

1025
01:07:04,671 --> 01:07:06,830
It ended up being me.

1026
01:07:06,871 --> 01:07:08,830
That's how it unfolded.

1027
01:07:12,511 --> 01:07:13,670
KJ.

1028
01:07:15,031 --> 01:07:16,710
What have you got?

1029
01:07:16,751 --> 01:07:18,150
Oh, Chrissy.

1030
01:07:18,191 --> 01:07:23,550
You are literally the right mix of
fierceness and tenderness out here

1031
01:07:23,591 --> 01:07:25,710
and I know that you would do anything

1032
01:07:25,751 --> 01:07:27,510
for the people that you love.

1033
01:07:27,551 --> 01:07:31,030
But do you think within
the game of Survivor,

1034
01:07:31,071 --> 01:07:33,230
that clouded your judgement at times?

1035
01:07:33,271 --> 01:07:36,950
And do you think maybe
putting those that you love,

1036
01:07:36,991 --> 01:07:39,790
such as Josh or Jordan or Mark,

1037
01:07:39,831 --> 01:07:43,150
ahead of your own game may
have jeopardised it in any way?

1038
01:07:46,391 --> 01:07:47,830
Um...

1039
01:07:47,871 --> 01:07:49,390
..I think last night, I showed

1040
01:07:49,431 --> 01:07:52,590
that I didn't put all the people
that I love ahead of myself.

1041
01:07:54,551 --> 01:07:57,350
And I'm gonna have to
deal with that later on.

1042
01:07:58,471 --> 01:08:00,750
I got a friendly reminder
from a 7-year-old

1043
01:08:00,791 --> 01:08:06,030
that I was out here to
be loyal to me first and...

1044
01:08:06,071 --> 01:08:07,430
..if I hadn't have got that phone call,

1045
01:08:07,471 --> 01:08:10,110
I don't know if I'd be answering
like this, but absolutely not.

1046
01:08:10,151 --> 01:08:11,670
I'm here for myself

1047
01:08:11,711 --> 01:08:14,630
and I think that's why I'm sitting
here in a good chance tonight.

1048
01:08:14,671 --> 01:08:16,590
Yep. Good answer. Thank you.

1049
01:08:18,031 --> 01:08:19,310
Alright, Michelle.

1050
01:08:20,631 --> 01:08:24,510
Shay, um, on a scale from zero to 10,

1051
01:08:24,551 --> 01:08:28,750
with 10 being the ultimate
game player of Survivor,

1052
01:08:28,791 --> 01:08:30,910
where would you rate your game?

1053
01:08:32,551 --> 01:08:34,070
I wanna give it an eight.

1054
01:08:35,711 --> 01:08:37,390
And I know that people are gonna say,

1055
01:08:37,431 --> 01:08:39,590
"Oh, you didn't orchestrate
these massive blindsides,"

1056
01:08:39,631 --> 01:08:42,910
but I made it to this final-three
spot, I fought from the bottom.

1057
01:08:42,951 --> 01:08:45,790
It isn't comfortable and
easy to make moves

1058
01:08:45,831 --> 01:08:48,790
from the position that I was in.

1059
01:08:48,831 --> 01:08:50,670
And you don't really have the numbers

1060
01:08:50,711 --> 01:08:53,990
and so it's a lot easier for
someone sitting in the majority to go,

1061
01:08:54,031 --> 01:08:56,070
"Alright, let's blindside this person,"

1062
01:08:56,111 --> 01:08:58,830
and so I'm actually gonna
give myself an extra half a point.

1063
01:08:58,871 --> 01:09:00,270
I'm gonna go up to 8.5.

1064
01:09:02,071 --> 01:09:04,310
All of you guys, obviously,
wanted to be sitting here right now,

1065
01:09:04,351 --> 01:09:05,910
and I did something right.

1066
01:09:15,271 --> 01:09:16,750
Alright, Josh.

1067
01:09:18,671 --> 01:09:21,550
What question do you have?

1068
01:09:21,591 --> 01:09:22,830
Chrissy...

1069
01:09:24,231 --> 01:09:27,310
..mate, we had it from the start.

1070
01:09:27,351 --> 01:09:30,830
The bond that we built, you're
calling me family, you know,

1071
01:09:30,871 --> 01:09:32,830
and we said we were
gonna look out for each other

1072
01:09:32,871 --> 01:09:34,030
the whole way through,

1073
01:09:34,071 --> 01:09:37,390
the whole game, you pitched
loyalty, family, you're talking about,

1074
01:09:37,431 --> 01:09:40,990
you know, "My new incoming
baby, we're family together."

1075
01:09:42,471 --> 01:09:43,830
You just threw me under.

1076
01:09:44,911 --> 01:09:48,510
And I suppose my question
is just you know, why?

1077
01:09:51,071 --> 01:09:53,870
I've been looking into your
blue eyes the whole time.

1078
01:09:53,911 --> 01:09:56,630
You were absolutely my number one.

1079
01:09:56,671 --> 01:10:00,510
And my social cues picked up
that you had changed yesterday,

1080
01:10:00,551 --> 01:10:03,270
and for the first time
ever, we talked strat.

1081
01:10:03,311 --> 01:10:06,230
And I didn't wanna talk strat with
you, I just wanted to talk to you.

1082
01:10:11,231 --> 01:10:12,870
You were different.

1083
01:10:12,911 --> 01:10:16,790
And I knew you were coming
for me so I had to be so brave.

1084
01:10:18,031 --> 01:10:20,150
And that's something...

1085
01:10:20,191 --> 01:10:22,830
..that I will never forget,
writing your name down.

1086
01:10:24,191 --> 01:10:26,630
OK. Um, Marky.

1087
01:10:28,191 --> 01:10:30,110
That day after the challenge
when we got back to camp,

1088
01:10:30,151 --> 01:10:33,030
I said, "Bro, I've us." We
could have sent Chrissy home...

1089
01:10:33,071 --> 01:10:36,190
You know, we shook on it,
we said, "Great, right. Let's go."

1090
01:10:36,231 --> 01:10:40,190
My question is at what point
did you then go away from that

1091
01:10:40,231 --> 01:10:43,270
and change your vote to me, you know?

1092
01:10:43,311 --> 01:10:46,950
Why did you take that option
when I was willing to just back you

1093
01:10:46,991 --> 01:10:49,270
and let's go one more together
and pitch next to you, man?

1094
01:10:49,311 --> 01:10:53,110
Yep. I knew at some point I was
gonna have to make a play on you.

1095
01:10:53,151 --> 01:10:56,310
And I knew when you came up to
me, I felt like your pitch was gonna be,

1096
01:10:56,351 --> 01:10:57,750
"Let's go Chrissy."

1097
01:10:57,791 --> 01:11:02,590
And I knew at that point,
for the first time in 46 days,

1098
01:11:02,631 --> 01:11:04,630
I was gonna look you in the
face and lie to you and say,

1099
01:11:04,671 --> 01:11:06,310
"Of course, mate, I'll do it with ya."

1100
01:11:06,351 --> 01:11:09,190
And I had no intention
of following through.

1101
01:11:11,551 --> 01:11:13,670
And as heartbreaking as that was,

1102
01:11:13,711 --> 01:11:17,030
it was a move I-I had to
make at that late stage.

1103
01:11:18,511 --> 01:11:20,030
Part of the reason was,

1104
01:11:20,071 --> 01:11:22,750
when I'd spoken to Harry
that day at the challenge,

1105
01:11:22,791 --> 01:11:25,710
I realised I had a choice to
make, it was gonna be either

1106
01:11:25,751 --> 01:11:29,950
going after and supporting my
family or having you there at the end

1107
01:11:29,991 --> 01:11:32,590
and I chose my family.
And I hope you understand.

1108
01:11:36,151 --> 01:11:37,630
Sam.

1109
01:11:38,991 --> 01:11:41,110
- You're up.
- OK.

1110
01:11:43,751 --> 01:11:46,390
On this jury stands...

1111
01:11:46,431 --> 01:11:48,190
..well, sits...

1112
01:11:48,231 --> 01:11:51,190
..some... players who love this game,

1113
01:11:51,231 --> 01:11:53,630
who, like, genuinely love this game,

1114
01:11:53,671 --> 01:11:57,030
but for a whole range of
reasons, we now sit on the bench

1115
01:11:57,071 --> 01:11:59,270
and have the most important
decision ahead of us.

1116
01:12:01,591 --> 01:12:05,510
And whilst there probably
is a degree of bias,

1117
01:12:05,551 --> 01:12:08,390
I actually take this
role really seriously.

1118
01:12:08,431 --> 01:12:13,350
Chrissy, what does this mean to you,
coming into it, to go for this title

1119
01:12:13,391 --> 01:12:17,870
and what does it mean now to be
on, potentially, the precipice of it?

1120
01:12:19,311 --> 01:12:21,910
What does winning Sole Survivor
and taking the title mean to me?

1121
01:12:23,271 --> 01:12:27,110
It will far outsee anything that I
even thought I was capable of.

1122
01:12:27,151 --> 01:12:29,430
I came on here, this
is Croc's bucket list.

1123
01:12:29,471 --> 01:12:31,030
I came on here with...

1124
01:12:32,751 --> 01:12:35,870
..nearly no idea what I
was getting myself into

1125
01:12:35,911 --> 01:12:39,310
and every day, I learnt
off the best in the business.

1126
01:12:39,351 --> 01:12:40,590
What does it mean?

1127
01:12:40,631 --> 01:12:42,550
It means that I absolutely
have smashed it

1128
01:12:42,591 --> 01:12:44,590
far further than I thought I ever could.

1129
01:12:47,871 --> 01:12:49,270
Alright, Jesse.

1130
01:12:50,631 --> 01:12:52,550
What would you like to ask?

1131
01:12:52,591 --> 01:12:53,670
Um...

1132
01:12:54,831 --> 01:12:56,710
..Marky.

1133
01:12:56,751 --> 01:12:59,910
Me and my brother, um, you
know, we were fully committed

1134
01:12:59,951 --> 01:13:01,230
to you and Sammy

1135
01:13:01,271 --> 01:13:05,030
and you were able to
build a lot of trust there,

1136
01:13:05,071 --> 01:13:07,670
uh, which really led to my blindside.

1137
01:13:07,711 --> 01:13:10,790
That was completely unsuspecting.

1138
01:13:10,831 --> 01:13:12,190
I didn't think that was coming.

1139
01:13:14,071 --> 01:13:17,190
You came in here as an ex-SAS soldier,

1140
01:13:17,231 --> 01:13:21,350
115 kilo, you're 6'3",
you're a returning player

1141
01:13:21,391 --> 01:13:24,390
AND you performed the
first blindside of the game,

1142
01:13:24,431 --> 01:13:25,790
removing Andy.

1143
01:13:26,871 --> 01:13:29,670
Yet somehow, you
were still underestimated.

1144
01:13:29,711 --> 01:13:32,590
I think people don't see how
massive a game you played.

1145
01:13:32,631 --> 01:13:35,950
So could you just expand
a little bit more for me

1146
01:13:35,991 --> 01:13:39,870
about how managing your threat
level throughout the entire game

1147
01:13:39,911 --> 01:13:43,230
has allowed you to sit
in that position right now?

1148
01:13:43,271 --> 01:13:47,430
Very... very good question.
And, uh, well considered.

1149
01:13:47,471 --> 01:13:51,110
I think one of the ways I did it
was try and be as social as possible

1150
01:13:51,151 --> 01:13:52,830
and build tight links with people.

1151
01:13:52,871 --> 01:13:54,390
You bring a lot of trust in with that.

1152
01:13:54,431 --> 01:13:58,150
I formed genuine connections
with just about everyone here.

1153
01:13:58,191 --> 01:14:01,870
Also, really trying to lower
my physical threat profile,

1154
01:14:01,911 --> 01:14:03,870
so keeping myself low.

1155
01:14:03,911 --> 01:14:06,150
I was on my back as much as I could be.

1156
01:14:06,191 --> 01:14:09,390
I was in the water with just my head
sticking out as much as I could be.

1157
01:14:09,431 --> 01:14:13,430
And then, the time I was
tagged later as a threat,

1158
01:14:13,471 --> 01:14:15,270
I can't remember who did
it, but they basically said -

1159
01:14:15,311 --> 01:14:16,990
oh, it was you, Jordie?

1160
01:14:17,031 --> 01:14:20,310
You basically said, "Yeah,
Mark and Sam, they're threats."

1161
01:14:20,351 --> 01:14:22,150
I was like, "Yeah, absolutely, we are."

1162
01:14:22,191 --> 01:14:25,590
And I think just being
open like that is disarming

1163
01:14:25,631 --> 01:14:26,870
'cause people connect the dots,

1164
01:14:26,911 --> 01:14:29,110
like, "I thought he might be
threatening. He's admitting to it.

1165
01:14:29,151 --> 01:14:31,110
"OK, no worries, I know
what I'm dealing with."

1166
01:14:31,151 --> 01:14:34,550
And it worked because
I didn't get my first vote

1167
01:14:34,591 --> 01:14:37,270
until we were 31 days in.

1168
01:14:37,311 --> 01:14:40,710
And that was the longest stretch
of time for anyone in this game.

1169
01:14:40,751 --> 01:14:41,950
And so I'm really proud of that.

1170
01:14:43,671 --> 01:14:46,670
And I really thought
about everything I did.

1171
01:14:46,711 --> 01:14:49,270
And everything I did was deliberate

1172
01:14:49,311 --> 01:14:50,870
and aimed at that one strategy.

1173
01:14:52,151 --> 01:14:53,590
Which was to win.

1174
01:14:58,871 --> 01:15:00,470
Perfectly answered.

1175
01:15:00,511 --> 01:15:02,390
And, you know, full respect.

1176
01:15:02,431 --> 01:15:04,750
You know, game respect
game, and to be honest,

1177
01:15:04,791 --> 01:15:06,350
we still look up to you as a role model

1178
01:15:06,391 --> 01:15:08,550
and someone we wanna be more like.

1179
01:15:08,591 --> 01:15:10,510
- So I appreciate that.
- Thank you, mate.

1180
01:15:12,511 --> 01:15:16,590
Alright, jury, you should have
all the information you need now

1181
01:15:16,631 --> 01:15:20,950
to decide who you think
deserves the title of Sole Survivor

1182
01:15:20,991 --> 01:15:23,350
and the $500,000 that goes with it.

1183
01:15:26,751 --> 01:15:30,430
Remember, tonight, you
are voting for a winner.

1184
01:15:31,831 --> 01:15:35,910
For the last time, it is time to vote.

1185
01:15:50,039 --> 01:15:54,158
Alright, jury, you should have
all the information you need now

1186
01:15:54,199 --> 01:15:58,518
to decide who you think
deserves the title of Sole Survivor

1187
01:15:58,559 --> 01:16:01,038
and the $500,00 that goes with it.

1188
01:16:03,199 --> 01:16:05,998
Remember, tonight, you
are voting for a winner.

1189
01:16:07,799 --> 01:16:09,158
For the last time...

1190
01:16:10,679 --> 01:16:12,198
..it is...

1191
01:16:13,439 --> 01:16:15,118
..time to vote. Khanh...

1192
01:16:16,239 --> 01:16:17,798
..you're up.

1193
01:16:28,359 --> 01:16:32,718
I'm voting for you tonight because
you have the right to represent us.

1194
01:16:58,879 --> 01:17:02,478
Well played. You played
the most rounded game.

1195
01:17:04,079 --> 01:17:05,718
Got nothing but respect for ya.

1196
01:17:16,359 --> 01:17:18,838
You are not just my soul mate,

1197
01:17:18,879 --> 01:17:21,678
but you are my Sole
Survivor of this game.

1198
01:17:21,719 --> 01:17:24,838
I genuinely believe you
have played the best game

1199
01:17:24,879 --> 01:17:27,598
and on top of it, it's been a privilege

1200
01:17:27,639 --> 01:17:30,678
to have played twice
with you on Survivor.

1201
01:17:30,719 --> 01:17:32,678
So... my vote's for you.

1202
01:17:49,479 --> 01:17:53,558
Just so much respect for
you as a person on Survivor

1203
01:17:53,599 --> 01:17:57,078
and even more respect for
you as a person who's survived.

1204
01:17:57,119 --> 01:17:58,998
And it's an honour to write
down your name tonight.

1205
01:18:19,319 --> 01:18:21,158
I'll go count the votes.

1206
01:18:40,639 --> 01:18:42,518
Well, there's no doubt this has been

1207
01:18:42,559 --> 01:18:45,838
an incredible season of Blood v. Water.

1208
01:18:47,359 --> 01:18:50,798
The only thing left to
do now is read the votes.

1209
01:18:50,839 --> 01:18:52,318
But...

1210
01:18:53,359 --> 01:18:59,318
..a moment like this really should be
shared with people you love the most.

1211
01:19:01,399 --> 01:19:03,078
Mark, are you ready
to see your little one?

1212
01:19:03,119 --> 01:19:05,078
Yeah. Course, Jonathan.

1213
01:19:11,319 --> 01:19:12,718
Harry!

1214
01:19:12,759 --> 01:19:14,118
Love you.

1215
01:19:14,159 --> 01:19:16,278
Harry!

1216
01:19:16,319 --> 01:19:18,438
What are you doing? Hello.

1217
01:19:18,479 --> 01:19:21,278
Sam, did you wanna
come over and say hello?

1218
01:19:24,759 --> 01:19:28,398
Harry just wants to
say, "I love you, Daddy.

1219
01:19:28,439 --> 01:19:30,278
"I love you, Mummy."

1220
01:19:30,319 --> 01:19:32,518
- Look, it's Mummy.
- Hello!

1221
01:19:34,559 --> 01:19:37,158
- Hello, darling.
- OK, so who's taking care of Harry?

1222
01:19:37,199 --> 01:19:39,678
- My mum, Christine.
- Christine.

1223
01:19:39,719 --> 01:19:41,558
So, Christine,

1224
01:19:41,599 --> 01:19:45,318
are you surprised that Mark
has got this far in the game?

1225
01:19:47,359 --> 01:19:50,358
Well, Mark promised me
he'd only be going a week.

1226
01:19:50,399 --> 01:19:52,638
One week, Mark.

1227
01:19:53,839 --> 01:19:57,358
And look how long - nine
weeks I've had this little boy.

1228
01:19:57,399 --> 01:20:00,638
Amazing. No, I'm not
surprised he's done so well.

1229
01:20:00,679 --> 01:20:03,878
He's a champion. A real champion.

1230
01:20:05,239 --> 01:20:07,598
That was the answer you
were hoping for, right, Mark?

1231
01:20:07,639 --> 01:20:12,118
I was hoping... Yeah, and
it's so great to see Harry.

1232
01:20:12,159 --> 01:20:15,518
We've been apart from
him for so long and, um...

1233
01:20:15,559 --> 01:20:17,238
..it's been the hardest run.

1234
01:20:17,279 --> 01:20:20,598
Really, it's the hardest thing we've
done and we just wanna come home.

1235
01:20:24,119 --> 01:20:26,878
Well, Mark, we've got some
more surprises for you tonight.

1236
01:20:27,999 --> 01:20:29,358
Come on in!

1237
01:20:31,599 --> 01:20:34,598
Oh, no way.

1238
01:20:34,639 --> 01:20:36,038
I didn't recognise you.

1239
01:20:36,079 --> 01:20:38,438
- Where's Mark? Where's Mark?
- You've lost so much weight!

1240
01:20:41,759 --> 01:20:43,678
Hi. How are you?

1241
01:20:45,639 --> 01:20:47,438
Mark, you wanna bring your family over?

1242
01:20:47,479 --> 01:20:49,518
Come on. Come on over.

1243
01:20:49,559 --> 01:20:51,758
Come over.

1244
01:20:51,799 --> 01:20:54,958
- Can you introduce us?
- Everyone, this is my dad, Robert.

1245
01:20:54,999 --> 01:20:56,358
- Hello.
- Hello, everybody.

1246
01:20:56,399 --> 01:20:59,078
- And this is my stepmum, Jen.
- Hello.

1247
01:20:59,119 --> 01:21:00,598
- So, Robert...
- Yes.

1248
01:21:00,639 --> 01:21:04,198
..Mark has said that he's out
here, playing this game for his son.

1249
01:21:04,239 --> 01:21:08,678
What's it like seeing your son
so close to realising a dream?

1250
01:21:08,719 --> 01:21:12,158
Oh, we thought he'd last five
minutes, so it's a shock, yeah.

1251
01:21:12,199 --> 01:21:13,878
OK.

1252
01:21:15,119 --> 01:21:16,678
Alright, Shay,

1253
01:21:16,719 --> 01:21:19,318
are you ready to see
some familiar faces?

1254
01:21:19,359 --> 01:21:21,638
- Yes.
- Come on in!

1255
01:21:23,959 --> 01:21:25,798
Welcome!

1256
01:21:25,839 --> 01:21:28,558
Hello, gorgeous girl.

1257
01:21:31,679 --> 01:21:33,998
- You look beautiful.
- I can't believe you guys came.

1258
01:21:34,039 --> 01:21:36,558
What a surprise.

1259
01:21:36,599 --> 01:21:37,878
Hello.

1260
01:21:40,119 --> 01:21:42,718
Mwah. You smell so good.

1261
01:21:42,759 --> 01:21:45,398
- Don't smell me.
- Come here.

1262
01:21:45,439 --> 01:21:47,358
Shay, bring 'em all over.

1263
01:21:47,399 --> 01:21:49,118
OK, come. Come and join.

1264
01:21:49,159 --> 01:21:52,758
Obviously, we know who Ben is.

1265
01:21:52,799 --> 01:21:55,478
Can you introduce us to everyone else?

1266
01:21:55,519 --> 01:21:57,478
This is my mum, Anne.

1267
01:21:57,519 --> 01:21:59,878
She's dyed her hair
extra pink for this moment.

1268
01:21:59,919 --> 01:22:01,878
Fantastic.

1269
01:22:01,919 --> 01:22:04,678
And my dad, Jean-Marc.

1270
01:22:04,719 --> 01:22:07,958
Jean-Marc, how proud are
you of your daughter right now?

1271
01:22:07,999 --> 01:22:09,958
Oh, absolutely.

1272
01:22:09,999 --> 01:22:13,038
There's no words that can
describe how proud I am.

1273
01:22:13,079 --> 01:22:16,718
Um, with Shayelle, she's tenacious.

1274
01:22:16,759 --> 01:22:22,558
And... she'll conquer whatever
she can that's in front of her.

1275
01:22:22,599 --> 01:22:26,518
Well, I can tell you that
the ballet paid off here.

1276
01:22:26,559 --> 01:22:29,158
Definitely did.

1277
01:22:30,959 --> 01:22:35,118
Alright, Chrissy, I know
that you're missing your kids.

1278
01:22:35,159 --> 01:22:38,158
- Are you ready to see them?
- Yeah, absolutely.

1279
01:22:38,199 --> 01:22:39,558
Come on in.

1280
01:22:42,199 --> 01:22:43,798
Shut up.

1281
01:22:43,839 --> 01:22:45,878
Come here.

1282
01:23:08,479 --> 01:23:10,398
Oh, that's cute!

1283
01:23:10,439 --> 01:23:15,478
Look how tall you are! What the heck?

1284
01:23:18,519 --> 01:23:20,878
- I wish... I wanna...
- Who's that?

1285
01:23:21,959 --> 01:23:24,238
- Jonathan.
- Jonathan.

1286
01:23:25,279 --> 01:23:28,078
Alright, Chrissy, we know who Croc is,

1287
01:23:28,119 --> 01:23:30,678
but can you introduce
us to the rest of the crew?

1288
01:23:30,719 --> 01:23:33,758
Yeah, this is my
little tribe. This is Lulu.

1289
01:23:33,799 --> 01:23:36,278
She knew your name,
that's so cute.

1290
01:23:36,319 --> 01:23:39,838
Uh, this is Mia-Moana and Essie-bear.

1291
01:23:39,879 --> 01:23:41,238
These are my babies.

1292
01:23:41,279 --> 01:23:44,158
So, Croc, when you conned Chrissy

1293
01:23:44,199 --> 01:23:46,878
into coming out here to play this game,

1294
01:23:46,919 --> 01:23:49,838
did you have any idea that
she would make it this far?

1295
01:23:49,879 --> 01:23:51,718
Absolutely not.

1296
01:23:51,759 --> 01:23:54,038
Not until about, I reckon a week in

1297
01:23:54,079 --> 01:23:56,878
and seeing her every
day grow in confidence

1298
01:23:56,919 --> 01:23:59,318
and being able to play with
her and be on the same tribe

1299
01:23:59,359 --> 01:24:01,278
and see how she interacted with everyone

1300
01:24:01,319 --> 01:24:03,638
and how much everyone
loved her and be really proud.

1301
01:24:03,679 --> 01:24:05,558
Like, all of us are so proud of her.

1302
01:24:06,999 --> 01:24:08,998
So, Lulu...

1303
01:24:09,039 --> 01:24:12,918
..what do you think about your
mum sleeping in the dirt for 47 days?

1304
01:24:12,959 --> 01:24:15,838
Um, I feel sad for her.

1305
01:24:15,879 --> 01:24:17,638
Oh, you feel sad for her?

1306
01:24:17,679 --> 01:24:20,198
It's pretty bad, Lulu.

1307
01:24:20,239 --> 01:24:21,558
I didn't like it.

1308
01:24:22,959 --> 01:24:25,558
Alright, Chrissy,
before I get to the votes,

1309
01:24:25,599 --> 01:24:27,558
what's going through
your head right now?

1310
01:24:27,599 --> 01:24:29,278
Oh, it's a lot, you know?

1311
01:24:29,319 --> 01:24:31,278
We just did the best we could do.

1312
01:24:31,319 --> 01:24:34,198
I did the most I could do
with the information that I had.

1313
01:24:34,239 --> 01:24:38,158
Had Croc in my corner, had
these guys by my side, so...

1314
01:24:38,199 --> 01:24:41,038
- Yeah, it is... It is what it is.
- It is what it is.

1315
01:24:41,079 --> 01:24:43,598
It is what it is.

1316
01:24:43,639 --> 01:24:45,478
Mark, what's going
through your head right now?

1317
01:24:45,519 --> 01:24:47,638
Oh, it's pretty surreal.

1318
01:24:47,679 --> 01:24:49,678
I actually wasn't expecting
to have family here.

1319
01:24:49,719 --> 01:24:51,478
They've come a long way from WA,

1320
01:24:51,519 --> 01:24:54,518
so it's pretty special
to have them all here.

1321
01:24:54,559 --> 01:24:56,798
It's what we were playing for.

1322
01:24:56,839 --> 01:25:00,038
Shay, what would it mean
to you to win this game?

1323
01:25:00,079 --> 01:25:02,118
Oh... everything.

1324
01:25:02,159 --> 01:25:04,758
It would mean the respect of the jury,

1325
01:25:04,799 --> 01:25:07,838
it would mean all
the fight was worth it.

1326
01:25:07,879 --> 01:25:11,878
Yeah, I'm
speechless. It was so tough.

1327
01:25:11,919 --> 01:25:13,918
It was so much tougher than I expected.

1328
01:25:13,959 --> 01:25:18,078
Um, so to be able to take that
title away is just tremendous.

1329
01:25:18,119 --> 01:25:19,798
It's massive.

1330
01:25:19,839 --> 01:25:22,558
Alright, let's get to it.

1331
01:25:23,999 --> 01:25:27,238
Remember, these votes are for a winner.

1332
01:25:28,359 --> 01:25:29,798
I'm gonna read the votes.

1333
01:25:32,759 --> 01:25:34,278
First vote...

1334
01:26:10,679 --> 01:26:12,358
That's four votes Mark.

1335
01:26:17,599 --> 01:26:19,118
That's five votes Mark.

1336
01:26:22,039 --> 01:26:25,598
Winner of Australian
Survivor Blood v. Water...

1337
01:26:33,079 --> 01:26:34,998
Sorry, mate, I don't smell great.

1338
01:26:37,239 --> 01:26:39,438
- Well done.
- Thanks, mate. I'm sorry, brother.

1339
01:26:39,479 --> 01:26:41,318
All good.

1340
01:26:41,359 --> 01:26:43,278
Thank you so much. I'm pumped.

1341
01:26:44,439 --> 01:26:46,678
This is my beautiful KJ.

1342
01:26:46,719 --> 01:26:48,758
Can you say hi, KJ?

1343
01:26:48,799 --> 01:26:50,238
Good man.

1344
01:26:52,119 --> 01:26:54,918
Congratulations, you
are $500,000 richer.

1345
01:26:54,959 --> 01:26:57,678
- Wow. Wow.
- Sole Survivor.

1346
01:26:57,719 --> 01:27:00,038
- I don't believe it.
- Blood v. Water.

1347
01:27:07,119 --> 01:27:09,638
You deserve it, mate. You deserve it.

1348
01:27:11,679 --> 01:27:14,718
Well done, mate. You played
an absolute cracker of a game.

1349
01:27:14,759 --> 01:27:16,478
You dominated challenges,

1350
01:27:16,519 --> 01:27:18,518
you played a really nice social game

1351
01:27:18,559 --> 01:27:22,158
and you played a
kick-ass strategic game.

1352
01:27:22,199 --> 01:27:25,158
How you managed to make
people not believe you had two idols

1353
01:27:25,199 --> 01:27:27,078
I still have no idea.

1354
01:27:27,119 --> 01:27:30,238
You outwitted, you
outplayed and you outlasted.

1355
01:27:30,279 --> 01:27:33,078
And that's the definition
of a Sole Survivor.

1356
01:27:33,119 --> 01:27:35,958
Tonight just shows what happens
when you bring knives to a gunfight.

1357
01:27:35,999 --> 01:27:38,758
Mission accomplished, soldier.

1358
01:27:38,799 --> 01:27:40,958
You owe me that steak, big man.

1359
01:27:43,039 --> 01:27:45,278
I could have written
this down hours ago.

1360
01:27:45,319 --> 01:27:48,398
So much respect for you
as a person on Survivor

1361
01:27:48,439 --> 01:27:51,638
and even more respect for
you as a person who's survived,

1362
01:27:51,679 --> 01:27:53,918
and it's an honour to write
down your name tonight.

1363
01:27:53,959 --> 01:27:55,398
Congratulations, and it was a pleasure

1364
01:27:55,439 --> 01:27:57,838
rolling through to the
end with you, mate.



## S10E24

1
00:00:00,000 --> 00:00:04,162
WWW.MY-SUBS.CO

1
00:00:01,000 --> 00:00:02,280
(HAUNTING MUSIC)

2
00:00:02,280 --> 00:00:04,240
JONATHAN: Samoa.

3
00:00:04,240 --> 00:00:06,800
A remote paradise

4
00:00:06,800 --> 00:00:09,880
as beautiful as it is dangerous.

5
00:00:09,880 --> 00:00:13,200
This season saw the game return

6
00:00:13,200 --> 00:00:15,040
to where it all began.

7
00:00:16,040 --> 00:00:20,200
As two primal opposing
forces collided.

8
00:00:20,200 --> 00:00:22,480
Heroes v Villains.

9
00:00:22,480 --> 00:00:23,680
Get it, get it, get it!

10
00:00:23,680 --> 00:00:26,160
(SURVIVORS SHOUT)

11
00:00:27,160 --> 00:00:28,520
Here to outwit...

12
00:00:28,520 --> 00:00:30,440
Sign them to me!

13
00:00:30,440 --> 00:00:32,400
Another one. Another.

14
00:00:32,400 --> 00:00:33,600
..outplay...

15
00:00:33,600 --> 00:00:38,120
Go, Liz!
Yes, yes, yes, yes, yes, yes!

16
00:00:38,120 --> 00:00:39,840
..and outlast.

17
00:00:39,840 --> 00:00:43,000
Matt wins individual immunity.
Yes!

18
00:00:43,000 --> 00:00:44,360
A hidden immunity idol.

19
00:00:44,360 --> 00:00:46,640
It's in my arse crack right now.
Yeah, it is too.

20
00:00:46,640 --> 00:00:49,680
It was most certainly not an idol,
I found out.

21
00:00:49,680 --> 00:00:51,480
This day's the worst.

22
00:00:51,480 --> 00:00:53,920
For 46 days...
(LIZ CHEERS)

23
00:00:53,920 --> 00:00:56,800
You bloody turn on me,
I'll turn on you.

24
00:00:56,800 --> 00:00:59,760
I want to move forward
with you guys as a double agent.

25
00:01:01,440 --> 00:01:03,600
Feeling a little bit evil,
but it's good fun.

26
00:01:03,600 --> 00:01:05,840
Through the most loyal alliances...

27
00:01:06,880 --> 00:01:07,880
Yes.
Yeah.

28
00:01:07,880 --> 00:01:09,880
LIZ: The Spice Girls!

29
00:01:09,880 --> 00:01:12,800
You can't take the villain
out of the Shiz.

30
00:01:12,800 --> 00:01:16,400
GEORGE: When did the Spice Girls
become the Shiz?

31
00:01:16,400 --> 00:01:18,440
(DISSONANT CHORDS)
(CLOCK TICKS)

32
00:01:18,440 --> 00:01:19,840
(NECK CRACKS)

33
00:01:19,840 --> 00:01:23,040
..and spectacular blindsides...

34
00:01:23,040 --> 00:01:25,520
You're a dead duck
unless you save Steve.

35
00:01:25,520 --> 00:01:27,600
(DRAMATIC MUSIC)
Whoa!

36
00:01:27,600 --> 00:01:29,480
(WHISPERS)

37
00:01:29,480 --> 00:01:31,240
GERRY: Going back there,

38
00:01:31,240 --> 00:01:35,560
I've been working with George
and learning from him.

39
00:01:36,560 --> 00:01:38,760
Shonee.
No way.

40
00:01:38,760 --> 00:01:41,440
I feel awful. (SNIFFLES)

41
00:01:41,440 --> 00:01:45,600
Now that I've voted off Shonee,
I can wear her clothes.

42
00:01:45,600 --> 00:01:46,840
One by one...

43
00:01:46,840 --> 00:01:48,400
(WHISPERS)

44
00:01:48,400 --> 00:01:50,400
I'll buy you a case of beer
if I'm wrong.

45
00:01:50,400 --> 00:01:51,760
Oh!
Sam.

46
00:01:52,760 --> 00:01:55,400
Hayley.
Did not see that coming.

47
00:01:55,400 --> 00:01:56,800
..they were voted out.

48
00:01:56,800 --> 00:01:58,440
I'm playing this game so good!

49
00:01:58,440 --> 00:02:00,960
No-one's resume
comes anywhere near me!

50
00:02:00,960 --> 00:02:02,280
The tribe has spoken.

51
00:02:03,920 --> 00:02:06,800
Now, with the end near,

52
00:02:06,800 --> 00:02:09,080
just four remain.

53
00:02:10,080 --> 00:02:11,840
Gerry.

54
00:02:11,840 --> 00:02:13,560
Matt.

55
00:02:13,560 --> 00:02:15,480
Liz.

56
00:02:15,480 --> 00:02:17,520
And George.

57
00:02:18,640 --> 00:02:22,240
Two heroes, two villains.

58
00:02:22,240 --> 00:02:27,400
One will be crowned...Sole Survivor.

59
00:02:31,680 --> 00:02:33,360
(BIRDSONG)

60
00:02:37,880 --> 00:02:39,960
(PEACEFUL MUSIC)

61
00:02:39,960 --> 00:02:41,480
LIZ: I'm so happy.

62
00:02:41,480 --> 00:02:42,960
GEORGE: I'm happy as well.

63
00:02:42,960 --> 00:02:43,960
Yeah.

64
00:02:43,960 --> 00:02:46,240
We've literally made it
to the last point of the game.

65
00:02:46,240 --> 00:02:49,000
Yay!
We've made it to day 46!

66
00:02:50,040 --> 00:02:54,400
GERRY: Coming into Survivor,
I did not know what to expect.

67
00:02:54,400 --> 00:02:57,440
But here we are - endgame.

68
00:02:59,000 --> 00:03:03,760
Right from the start, I was prepared
to fly to the end of the Earth

69
00:03:03,760 --> 00:03:05,640
for my Hero tribe.

70
00:03:05,640 --> 00:03:08,640
But when the original Hero tribe

71
00:03:08,640 --> 00:03:11,040
sent me to the Villains' side,

72
00:03:11,040 --> 00:03:13,280
that flicked a switch.

73
00:03:14,920 --> 00:03:17,200
I became the Heroes' scorn.

74
00:03:17,200 --> 00:03:19,160
(DRAMATIC MUSIC)

75
00:03:19,160 --> 00:03:21,200
And one by one,

76
00:03:21,200 --> 00:03:24,840
I slowly took out
the people that wronged me.

77
00:03:28,280 --> 00:03:29,400
Bang, bang, bang!

78
00:03:32,640 --> 00:03:37,800
I have been so underestimated
in this game.

79
00:03:37,800 --> 00:03:41,920
And now I'm here to take it out.

80
00:03:45,960 --> 00:03:48,640
(THUNDER RUMBLES)

81
00:03:48,640 --> 00:03:50,160
(RAIN POURS)

82
00:03:55,680 --> 00:03:59,760
GEORGE: I came in here
with the biggest target on my back.

83
00:03:59,760 --> 00:04:01,240
But look at me now!

84
00:04:03,280 --> 00:04:06,560
I didn't come here
to decrease my threat level.

85
00:04:07,560 --> 00:04:09,200
I ramped it up.

86
00:04:10,720 --> 00:04:14,160
I've proven why I'm one of
the legends of the game.

87
00:04:14,160 --> 00:04:16,800
But my work's not finished.

88
00:04:16,800 --> 00:04:19,000
I've got the final
Immunity Challenge

89
00:04:19,000 --> 00:04:22,720
standing before me
and tomorrow's final Tribal Council.

90
00:04:22,720 --> 00:04:24,880
(DRAMATIC CHORAL MUSIC)

91
00:04:24,880 --> 00:04:27,840
If I can present my case
to the jury,

92
00:04:27,840 --> 00:04:31,360
Heroes v Villains will be
the coronation of the King!

93
00:04:31,360 --> 00:04:35,120
Nobody deserves that crown
more than me.

94
00:04:35,120 --> 00:04:38,200
(EVIL LAUGHTER ECHOES)

95
00:04:40,960 --> 00:04:42,640
(INTENSE MUSIC)

96
00:04:44,520 --> 00:04:49,720
It's crazy to think I've outlasted
20 other players out here.

97
00:04:49,720 --> 00:04:52,280
I'm humbled
to have made it this far.

98
00:04:53,280 --> 00:04:56,320
But I know today's gonna be one of
the biggest and toughest challenges

99
00:04:56,320 --> 00:04:57,480
of my life,

100
00:04:57,480 --> 00:05:00,200
because right now,
the stakes are high.

101
00:05:00,200 --> 00:05:02,320
They're higher than
they've ever been in this game.

102
00:05:03,320 --> 00:05:08,480
Today, I need to win that necklace.
Today, I need to win that challenge.

103
00:05:10,360 --> 00:05:13,040
I've won three Immunity Challenges

104
00:05:13,040 --> 00:05:15,200
and I could easily win another one.

105
00:05:15,200 --> 00:05:18,160
I just can't let Liz win it...

106
00:05:19,560 --> 00:05:21,440
..'cause it could wreck
everything for me.

107
00:05:22,840 --> 00:05:24,440
(INTENSE MUSIC)

108
00:05:26,400 --> 00:05:27,880
LIZ: It's very clear -

109
00:05:27,880 --> 00:05:31,960
Matt, Gerry and George
have an unbreakable bond.

110
00:05:31,960 --> 00:05:34,720
If I don't win
individual immunity...

111
00:05:36,080 --> 00:05:38,160
..I'm out of here.

112
00:05:39,440 --> 00:05:41,120
Being an Olympian,

113
00:05:41,120 --> 00:05:45,360
my whole life has been about
pushing my body, pushing my mind,

114
00:05:45,360 --> 00:05:48,040
getting in the zone,
dealing with failure.

115
00:05:49,040 --> 00:05:50,200
But...

116
00:05:51,200 --> 00:05:53,760
..losing today is not an option.

117
00:05:53,760 --> 00:05:58,840
Everything I've done in the last
46 days comes down to this moment.

118
00:06:00,840 --> 00:06:02,840
I'm ready to get it done.

119
00:06:08,320 --> 00:06:10,720
(HAUNTING VOCAL MUSIC)

120
00:06:15,560 --> 00:06:18,360
KRISTIE: Lee, you've got to let me
have this one.

121
00:06:20,640 --> 00:06:25,240
(SIGHS) If you let me have
this immunity, I will take you.

122
00:06:25,240 --> 00:06:27,800
(TEARY) I just want
to get to the end!

123
00:06:27,800 --> 00:06:28,920
(SOBS)

124
00:06:40,400 --> 00:06:41,400
Oh!

125
00:06:41,400 --> 00:06:44,600
JONATHAN: Every wave now
just cuts to the bone.

126
00:06:44,600 --> 00:06:47,200
(HAUNTING MUSIC CONTINUES)

127
00:06:59,160 --> 00:07:01,360
(DRAMATIC MUSIC)

128
00:07:30,520 --> 00:07:35,520
Well, congratulations.
You've made it to day 46.

129
00:07:35,520 --> 00:07:40,200
You have outlasted 20 other heroes
and villains to make it here

130
00:07:40,200 --> 00:07:43,600
right where our first hero was born
eight seasons ago.

131
00:07:43,600 --> 00:07:44,600
Well done.

132
00:07:44,600 --> 00:07:47,280
Thank you so much.
That's great. Thanks.

133
00:07:47,280 --> 00:07:50,360
Alright, are you ready to get
to your final Immunity Challenge?

134
00:07:50,360 --> 00:07:52,360
Yes!
Let's go.

135
00:07:52,360 --> 00:07:54,600
For the last time,

136
00:07:54,600 --> 00:07:57,120
immunity is back up for grabs.

137
00:08:03,400 --> 00:08:05,000
For today's challenge...

138
00:08:07,000 --> 00:08:09,080
..you're gonna balance
on a narrow perch

139
00:08:09,080 --> 00:08:11,960
while holding onto a handle
behind your head.

140
00:08:13,080 --> 00:08:15,880
At various intervals,
I'm gonna turn a crank...

141
00:08:15,880 --> 00:08:18,560
(GEARS CREAK)

142
00:08:18,560 --> 00:08:21,280
..forcing spikes into your back,

143
00:08:21,280 --> 00:08:25,200
making it more difficult
to hold that position.

144
00:08:25,200 --> 00:08:29,080
If at any point you step off,
let go of the handle,

145
00:08:29,080 --> 00:08:31,240
you're out of the challenge.

146
00:08:32,600 --> 00:08:34,320
Last person still standing

147
00:08:34,320 --> 00:08:35,880
wins immunity

148
00:08:35,880 --> 00:08:40,120
and a guaranteed spot
at that final Tribal Council,

149
00:08:40,120 --> 00:08:42,640
where you will have a chance
to pitch to the jury

150
00:08:42,640 --> 00:08:44,960
why you deserve the title
of Sole Survivor

151
00:08:44,960 --> 00:08:47,080
and the half-million dollars
that goes with it.

152
00:08:49,320 --> 00:08:54,840
Now, this is a tough challenge
and there's a lot on the line, so...

153
00:08:55,840 --> 00:08:59,600
..we figured you might need
a little extra motivation today.

154
00:08:59,600 --> 00:09:00,840
(GASPS)

155
00:09:00,840 --> 00:09:02,280
Oh, my God, stop.

156
00:09:04,000 --> 00:09:06,080
George, are you ready for some love?

157
00:09:06,080 --> 00:09:07,640
I'm ready for some love.
Stop.

158
00:09:07,640 --> 00:09:09,920
Bring it on.
Alright. Come on in!

159
00:09:13,360 --> 00:09:16,760
It's Cara! Yes!

160
00:09:16,760 --> 00:09:18,960
Cara!
(CARA CHUCKLES)

161
00:09:18,960 --> 00:09:20,480
Mate!

162
00:09:20,480 --> 00:09:22,920
Cara! I've made it!

163
00:09:22,920 --> 00:09:24,480
(BOTH SOB)

164
00:09:24,480 --> 00:09:26,040
(EMOTIONAL MUSIC)

165
00:09:26,040 --> 00:09:27,600
Look at you.
(GEORGE SOBS)

166
00:09:27,600 --> 00:09:29,200
(CARA SPEAKS INDISTINCTLY)

167
00:09:29,200 --> 00:09:30,680
..before you fall over.
Oh!

168
00:09:30,680 --> 00:09:32,440
So happy to see you!

169
00:09:36,920 --> 00:09:38,280
Oh, grey!
(LAUGHS)

170
00:09:38,280 --> 00:09:41,800
Oh, my God! Hello!

171
00:09:41,800 --> 00:09:44,360
Fancy seeing you here.
Fancy seeing me here.

172
00:09:44,360 --> 00:09:46,240
Hi. Hello.
MATT: Nice to meet you.

173
00:09:46,240 --> 00:09:48,760
(LAUGHS) Sorry. Hello!

174
00:09:48,760 --> 00:09:51,280
Hi, Cara. So great to see you again.

175
00:09:51,280 --> 00:09:54,560
So, George came into this game
as a villain.

176
00:09:54,560 --> 00:09:56,640
What's your take on that?
Do you know what?

177
00:09:56,640 --> 00:09:58,960
He's learnt from the last game,
I think.

178
00:09:58,960 --> 00:10:02,400
And he's come in...
And I think he's a hero.

179
00:10:03,640 --> 00:10:07,880
Alright, Liz, who are you hoping
you're gonna see today?

180
00:10:07,880 --> 00:10:09,280
(CARA CHUCKLES)

181
00:10:10,720 --> 00:10:12,560
Daniel.

182
00:10:12,560 --> 00:10:14,920
Let's see if we can deliver.
Come on in!

183
00:10:16,880 --> 00:10:18,280
Oh, my God.

184
00:10:18,280 --> 00:10:20,120
(SOBS)

185
00:10:21,120 --> 00:10:23,960
There he is!
GEORGE: Yes!

186
00:10:23,960 --> 00:10:26,520
(SOBS)
(OTHERS APPLAUD)

187
00:10:27,920 --> 00:10:30,560
Oh, my God! (SOBS)

188
00:10:32,200 --> 00:10:33,800
This is unreal.
(SOBS)

189
00:10:34,800 --> 00:10:36,680
(SOBS)

190
00:10:38,480 --> 00:10:39,760
(SOBS)

191
00:10:39,760 --> 00:10:40,760
(KISSES)

192
00:10:48,120 --> 00:10:49,320
DANIEL:

193
00:10:49,320 --> 00:10:51,000
Yeah.

194
00:10:51,000 --> 00:10:52,240
I know.

195
00:10:55,480 --> 00:10:59,440
Oh, my God!
And I missed your smell. (LAUGHS)

196
00:10:59,440 --> 00:11:01,200
Ohh!

197
00:11:01,200 --> 00:11:03,720
This is Daniel.
(SPEAKS INDISTINCTLY)

198
00:11:03,720 --> 00:11:06,320
Come stand with me here.
MATT: Come in the middle.

199
00:11:06,320 --> 00:11:07,800
Come on the mat, mate. (LAUGHS)

200
00:11:07,800 --> 00:11:09,280
Welcome.

201
00:11:09,280 --> 00:11:11,120
Liz, how much have you missed Daniel?

202
00:11:11,120 --> 00:11:15,000
Oh, my God, I can't even put it into
words how much I've missed him.

203
00:11:15,000 --> 00:11:16,200
(SOBS)

204
00:11:16,200 --> 00:11:17,880
Daniel, how much have you missed Liz?

205
00:11:17,880 --> 00:11:20,400
A lot. A lot. I'm very proud.

206
00:11:21,600 --> 00:11:24,760
So, are you surprised
that she's made it this far?

207
00:11:24,760 --> 00:11:27,280
Not at all. Two-time Olympian, mate.

208
00:11:27,280 --> 00:11:29,280
It was what I was expecting.

209
00:11:30,280 --> 00:11:33,360
Alright, Gerry, who do you hope
we have hiding back there?

210
00:11:33,360 --> 00:11:35,600
Well, of course, my fiancee, Pam.

211
00:11:36,680 --> 00:11:38,320
Come on in!

212
00:11:42,480 --> 00:11:44,000
There she is.

213
00:11:44,000 --> 00:11:46,800
Oh, look at her. (SOBS)

214
00:11:50,800 --> 00:11:52,400
PAM: Oh, my God!

215
00:11:58,720 --> 00:12:01,520
PAM:

216
00:12:01,520 --> 00:12:03,040
GERRY:

217
00:12:08,480 --> 00:12:09,680
(LAUGHS)

218
00:12:09,680 --> 00:12:11,120
Papa Smurf.

219
00:12:11,120 --> 00:12:12,600
(SNIFFLES)

220
00:12:12,600 --> 00:12:14,040
You be careful.

221
00:12:14,040 --> 00:12:15,720
(SNORTS) Ahh.

222
00:12:15,720 --> 00:12:19,160
Hello.
Hello! Happy to meet you.

223
00:12:19,160 --> 00:12:21,280
Join us, join us. We'll make room.

224
00:12:21,280 --> 00:12:24,200
Look how beautiful she is.
(LAUGHS)

225
00:12:24,200 --> 00:12:28,880
So, Pam, is he normally
that affectionate?

226
00:12:28,880 --> 00:12:30,160
Always.
Always?

227
00:12:30,160 --> 00:12:31,200
Always.

228
00:12:31,200 --> 00:12:33,640
So he's a keeper.
Very much so.

229
00:12:34,640 --> 00:12:37,600
I'm not always a mongrel.
(LAUGHS)

230
00:12:38,840 --> 00:12:40,360
Alright, Matt.

231
00:12:41,360 --> 00:12:43,680
So, as I understand it,

232
00:12:43,680 --> 00:12:45,280
before you came out here,

233
00:12:45,280 --> 00:12:47,480
you found out that your wife
was pregnant, right?

234
00:12:47,480 --> 00:12:48,480
That's correct.

235
00:12:48,480 --> 00:12:51,480
It must have been tough being away
from her for so long.

236
00:12:51,480 --> 00:12:53,800
It's the hardest thing
I've ever done.

237
00:12:53,800 --> 00:12:55,080
Come on in!
Whoo!

238
00:12:55,080 --> 00:12:57,080
Whoo!
Come on, Kirstie!

239
00:13:02,440 --> 00:13:04,360
(LAUGHS)

240
00:13:04,360 --> 00:13:06,440
Darling, you look like a caveman!

241
00:13:06,440 --> 00:13:08,440
(LAUGHS)

242
00:13:10,000 --> 00:13:12,800
I've missed you, my love!
I've missed you too.

243
00:13:16,080 --> 00:13:17,080
(LAUGHS)

244
00:13:18,400 --> 00:13:19,400
Yeah.

245
00:13:24,200 --> 00:13:26,800
Are you OK?
Yep. Yep.

246
00:13:31,920 --> 00:13:32,920
(LAUGHS)

247
00:13:33,920 --> 00:13:35,360
Oh, darling.

248
00:13:36,360 --> 00:13:38,760
Well, Kirstie, first,
congratulations on the new bub.

249
00:13:38,760 --> 00:13:40,320
Thank you. (LAUGHS)

250
00:13:40,320 --> 00:13:42,880
And Matt's been playing this game
as a hero.

251
00:13:42,880 --> 00:13:45,720
Is that true to who he is back home?

252
00:13:45,720 --> 00:13:47,560
(LAUGHS) I think so.

253
00:13:47,560 --> 00:13:51,240
I don't think you could say
he's a villain. (LAUGHS)

254
00:13:51,240 --> 00:13:53,040
Wait and see.

255
00:13:53,040 --> 00:13:55,080
(BOTH LAUGH)

256
00:13:55,080 --> 00:13:59,160
Alright, loved ones, we're very happy
that all of you could come out

257
00:13:59,160 --> 00:14:00,600
and lend your support,

258
00:14:00,600 --> 00:14:02,760
but you're gonna be cheering
from the bench today.

259
00:14:02,760 --> 00:14:04,920
I'm gonna give everyone a minute
to catch up

260
00:14:04,920 --> 00:14:09,760
and then, Matt, George, Gerry
and Liz, we're gonna get to it.

261
00:14:09,760 --> 00:14:11,880
It's gonna be good!

262
00:14:11,880 --> 00:14:14,080
(LAUGHS)
I've lost so much weight.

263
00:14:14,080 --> 00:14:16,080
DANIEL: I've missed you so much.
LIZ: I've missed you.

264
00:14:16,080 --> 00:14:17,560
This is the most I've missed you.

265
00:14:17,560 --> 00:14:19,520
Can't believe
how much I've missed this.

266
00:14:19,520 --> 00:14:22,120
(WIND AND SURF ROAR)

267
00:14:26,960 --> 00:14:29,920
(HAUNTING VOCAL MUSIC)

268
00:14:37,160 --> 00:14:40,720
Alright, everyone,
take your positions.

269
00:14:42,520 --> 00:14:44,480
Feet on the perches.

270
00:14:45,480 --> 00:14:47,080
Hands on the handle.

271
00:14:49,200 --> 00:14:51,920
(TENSE MUSIC)

272
00:14:53,120 --> 00:14:54,760
For immunity...

273
00:14:56,480 --> 00:14:58,560
..this challenge is now on.

274
00:14:59,960 --> 00:15:01,680
(SUSPENSEFUL MUSIC)

275
00:15:03,760 --> 00:15:05,200
This is it.

276
00:15:05,200 --> 00:15:08,080
All the chips pushed in on this one.

277
00:15:09,080 --> 00:15:13,120
The only guarantee that you'll be
there at that final Tribal...

278
00:15:14,120 --> 00:15:16,160
..and have a chance
to pitch your case

279
00:15:16,160 --> 00:15:18,480
is to win this challenge.

280
00:15:18,480 --> 00:15:20,040
That easy.

281
00:15:20,040 --> 00:15:21,960
It's that easy.

282
00:15:29,680 --> 00:15:32,120
Nah. No good for the shoulders.

283
00:15:32,120 --> 00:15:34,760
I think this one's gonna be
a grind, people.

284
00:15:37,040 --> 00:15:39,640
You just need to keep
both feet on that perch.

285
00:15:40,640 --> 00:15:44,440
You need to keep your hands
on that handle at all times,

286
00:15:44,440 --> 00:15:46,320
even when you're readjusting.

287
00:15:46,320 --> 00:15:52,200
You step off, take your hand off the
handle, you're out of the challenge.

288
00:15:57,320 --> 00:15:58,920
I mean, there is
the little complication

289
00:15:58,920 --> 00:16:00,440
of the spikes in your back, but...

290
00:16:04,400 --> 00:16:07,280
Can't wait for you
to backstab us, JLP.

291
00:16:07,280 --> 00:16:08,880
(LAUGHS HEARTILY)

292
00:16:09,920 --> 00:16:12,440
(TENSE MUSIC)

293
00:16:13,600 --> 00:16:18,520
Tonight's Tribal Council is
the last chance to make a big move.

294
00:16:18,520 --> 00:16:21,280
How nice would it be
to be immune from that?

295
00:16:22,840 --> 00:16:26,200
Matt, how much do you think
you need that necklace tonight?

296
00:16:26,200 --> 00:16:28,280
Oh, look, I really, really want it.

297
00:16:28,280 --> 00:16:30,520
I'm gonna be up here
until I can't be anymore.

298
00:16:34,880 --> 00:16:36,600
Yeah.
I think so.

299
00:16:40,320 --> 00:16:42,120
That swell is kicking up now!

300
00:16:43,160 --> 00:16:44,960
Those waves are gonna start smashing.

301
00:16:48,640 --> 00:16:51,520
Alright, might be time
to turn up the heat a little bit.

302
00:16:51,520 --> 00:16:54,560
GEORGE: Ooh, let's see what happens.
Here we go.

303
00:16:54,560 --> 00:16:56,960
Let's see what happens.

304
00:16:56,960 --> 00:16:58,640
(GEARS GRIND)

305
00:16:58,640 --> 00:17:01,040
First crank.

306
00:17:03,160 --> 00:17:07,600
GEORGE: Ohhhhh!
MATT: A little bit of a massage.

307
00:17:15,040 --> 00:17:17,040
LIZ: Oh, that's nothing.

308
00:17:18,920 --> 00:17:20,320
Give it another spin.

309
00:17:20,320 --> 00:17:21,800
You want another spin?
Yeah.

310
00:17:23,800 --> 00:17:27,440
We've got to go Tribal Council.
We don't have time.

311
00:17:27,440 --> 00:17:29,120
(LAUGHS HEARTILY)

312
00:17:30,280 --> 00:17:33,200
Alright. You got it, Liz.
Oh!

313
00:17:34,720 --> 00:17:36,400
Whatever Liz wants...

314
00:17:38,040 --> 00:17:40,080
..Liz gets.

315
00:17:42,200 --> 00:17:45,320
That's 12cm of spike right there.

316
00:17:49,120 --> 00:17:50,960
There we go.

317
00:17:50,960 --> 00:17:52,240
Bloody hell.

318
00:17:53,840 --> 00:17:55,080
GEORGE: God...

319
00:17:57,080 --> 00:17:58,960
God help us.

320
00:18:04,440 --> 00:18:06,960
(THUNDER RUMBLES)

321
00:18:06,960 --> 00:18:08,520
(SUSPENSEFUL MUSIC)

322
00:18:20,760 --> 00:18:23,240
(TRIBAL MUSIC)

323
00:18:27,160 --> 00:18:29,400
Ah, here comes the rain.

324
00:18:29,400 --> 00:18:33,200
Whoo!

325
00:18:33,200 --> 00:18:35,840
(CARA LAUGHS)
You got this, darling.

326
00:18:35,840 --> 00:18:39,880
Two OG Heroes and two OG Villains.

327
00:18:39,880 --> 00:18:42,440
Nice even battle.

328
00:18:42,440 --> 00:18:45,400
Not only are you battling each other
and battling the pain,

329
00:18:45,400 --> 00:18:48,520
you're also battling the elements.

330
00:18:48,520 --> 00:18:50,720
Everything's wet now.

331
00:18:51,720 --> 00:18:54,080
Gonna make it harder
to hang onto that handle,

332
00:18:54,080 --> 00:18:57,520
keep your feet on that perch.

333
00:18:59,040 --> 00:19:02,240
One lapse in concentration...

334
00:19:02,240 --> 00:19:04,520
And it's head first into the rocks.

335
00:19:04,520 --> 00:19:06,720
No shot at immunity.

336
00:19:16,320 --> 00:19:19,640
Alright, you've been up there
for one hour.

337
00:19:19,640 --> 00:19:21,240
Come on, guys. You look good.

338
00:19:21,240 --> 00:19:24,320
PAM: Come on, Gerry!
KIRSTIE: You got this, darling.

339
00:19:24,320 --> 00:19:25,880
Come on, Lizard!

340
00:19:25,880 --> 00:19:27,920
Let's give it another crank.

341
00:19:35,920 --> 00:19:38,960
16cm of spike.

342
00:19:43,400 --> 00:19:45,800
There's lots of movement now.

343
00:19:47,040 --> 00:19:50,160
Every time you turn around trying
to find something comfortable,

344
00:19:50,160 --> 00:19:52,800
you keep bumping
into those pesky spikes.

345
00:19:53,960 --> 00:19:57,200
Gerry looks really uncomfortable.

346
00:19:57,200 --> 00:19:59,360
Looks like he's in pain.

347
00:19:59,360 --> 00:20:02,120
Soaked by the waves.

348
00:20:02,120 --> 00:20:04,400
Fatigue really kicking in.

349
00:20:08,320 --> 00:20:10,680
Bugger it.
Gerry drops!

350
00:20:10,680 --> 00:20:12,840
Oh, Gerry!
GEORGE: Oh, Gerry, you OK?

351
00:20:12,840 --> 00:20:14,480
Yeah.
You alright, mate?

352
00:20:14,480 --> 00:20:16,920
Big effort, Gerry.
Careful, Gerry, careful.

353
00:20:16,920 --> 00:20:18,960
Gerry's had enough.
Careful.

354
00:20:18,960 --> 00:20:20,480
Steps out.
MATT: Well done, Gerry.

355
00:20:20,480 --> 00:20:24,040
Do you need a hand?
It was a big effort, Gerry.

356
00:20:28,360 --> 00:20:30,320
Oh, God, I feel so bad for him.

357
00:20:30,320 --> 00:20:32,000
He did amazing!

358
00:20:32,000 --> 00:20:34,760
After an hour and five minutes,

359
00:20:34,760 --> 00:20:37,200
