00:14:24,460 --> 00:14:26,980
She's the reason why I kept pushing.

233
00:14:26,980 --> 00:14:29,900
She's the reason why I was
so cutthroat in this game.

234
00:14:29,900 --> 00:14:34,100
She's literally the reason
why I'm here. Yeah.

235
00:14:34,100 --> 00:14:36,700
He's done so well.
I'm so, so proud of him.

236
00:14:36,700 --> 00:14:39,220
Well, Feras has made no secret
that he's playing this game

237
00:14:39,220 --> 00:14:40,580
for his community.

238
00:14:40,580 --> 00:14:42,340
Do you think he makes
a good role model?

239
00:14:42,340 --> 00:14:43,660
Definitely.
Yeah.

240
00:14:43,660 --> 00:14:45,980
I can wholeheartedly say that.

241
00:14:45,980 --> 00:14:49,300
Alright, loved ones, clearly
everyone is happy to see you.

242
00:14:49,300 --> 00:14:51,420
And we're happy that you've come
here to support them,

243
00:14:51,420 --> 00:14:53,980
but you're going to be doing it
from the bench today.

244
00:14:53,980 --> 00:14:56,500
I'm going to give everyone
a minute to catch up.

245
00:14:56,500 --> 00:14:58,460
And then, Caroline, Feras and Mark,

246
00:14:58,460 --> 00:15:00,300
we're going to get to it.

247
00:15:00,300 --> 00:15:01,740
Love you.

248
00:15:01,740 --> 00:15:03,180
Good luck.

249
00:15:07,900 --> 00:15:09,020
Really?

250
00:15:24,620 --> 00:15:28,100
Alright, everyone,
take up your positions.

251
00:15:34,340 --> 00:15:35,700
You can do this.

252
00:15:35,700 --> 00:15:37,700
They're not...they're not big pegs,
hey?

253
00:15:40,300 --> 00:15:42,740
Alright, everyone is in position.

254
00:15:44,860 --> 00:15:46,500
And for final immunity...

255
00:15:47,900 --> 00:15:49,660
..this challenge is now on.

256
00:15:52,940 --> 00:15:56,900
If you only win one challenge
this season, this is it.

257
00:15:59,980 --> 00:16:03,780
This is the one where you want
to push in all your chips.

258
00:16:03,780 --> 00:16:06,260
Could be a half-million-dollar
challenge.

259
00:16:09,740 --> 00:16:11,380
No pressure.

260
00:16:15,300 --> 00:16:16,860
I'm already bloody sweating.

261
00:16:16,860 --> 00:16:18,620
Uh-oh.

262
00:16:22,540 --> 00:16:24,780
It's boiling.
(SIGHS)

263
00:16:24,780 --> 00:16:27,020
Yeah, the fire would make it
so much worse.

264
00:16:29,820 --> 00:16:31,660
It's only gonna get worse.

265
00:16:32,700 --> 00:16:34,460
(LAUGHS)

266
00:16:49,500 --> 00:16:51,740
(VOCALISING)

267
00:16:58,740 --> 00:17:00,820
(WHEELS CREAK)

268
00:17:02,860 --> 00:17:06,220
Alright, you have been up there
for 10 minutes.

269
00:17:08,340 --> 00:17:12,260
This first set of pegs
are the easy ones.

270
00:17:12,260 --> 00:17:14,700
That's the warm up.

271
00:17:14,700 --> 00:17:17,740
Get you used to things
before we move on.

272
00:17:19,900 --> 00:17:22,700
You need to stand on the pegs
below you, but you can hold

273
00:17:22,700 --> 00:17:24,740
any of the four that are above you.

274
00:17:25,700 --> 00:17:27,500
You can do this.

275
00:17:27,500 --> 00:17:28,940
At regular intervals,

276
00:17:28,940 --> 00:17:33,020
the wheel will turn, forcing you
onto narrower pegs.

277
00:17:35,500 --> 00:17:37,820
Those pegs are going to start
grinding into the soles

278
00:17:37,820 --> 00:17:39,140
of your feet.

279
00:17:41,620 --> 00:17:44,180
FERAS: Luckily, my best friend's
a podiatrist.

280
00:17:44,180 --> 00:17:46,220
(LAUGHTER)

281
00:17:46,220 --> 00:17:47,700
How's everyone feeling?

282
00:17:48,700 --> 00:17:49,860
Good.

283
00:17:49,860 --> 00:17:51,140
Cushy.

284
00:17:51,140 --> 00:17:52,820
What about for you, Feras?

285
00:17:52,820 --> 00:17:54,140
You're a little heavier.

286
00:17:54,140 --> 00:17:55,220
You reckon?

287
00:17:55,220 --> 00:17:57,060
Yeah, this is the 'Feras' wheel!

288
00:17:57,060 --> 00:17:58,580
(LAUGHTER)

289
00:17:58,580 --> 00:17:59,700
(LAUGHS)

290
00:18:00,940 --> 00:18:02,780
We've had so much fun, Marky Mark.

291
00:18:02,780 --> 00:18:04,460
We have.
Yeah.

292
00:18:04,460 --> 00:18:06,140
We've been together since day one.

293
00:18:06,140 --> 00:18:07,220
Wow.

294
00:18:10,780 --> 00:18:12,060
A lot has happened. (LAUGHS)

295
00:18:13,940 --> 00:18:17,260
I've hated him. I've loved him.
I've hated him.

296
00:18:17,260 --> 00:18:18,780
He's tried to vote me off.

297
00:18:18,780 --> 00:18:19,780
(LAUGHTER)

298
00:18:21,220 --> 00:18:23,860
And I think I wrote
both your names down.

299
00:18:23,860 --> 00:18:25,180
(LAUGHTER)

300
00:18:25,180 --> 00:18:26,460
Sorry, guys!

301
00:18:26,460 --> 00:18:28,660
I haven't actually voted for you,
Feras.

302
00:18:28,660 --> 00:18:30,700
Well, hopefully,
tonight's not the night.

303
00:18:30,700 --> 00:18:32,420
(LAUGHTER)

304
00:18:43,860 --> 00:18:45,500
Alright,

305
00:18:45,500 --> 00:18:47,340
you've been up there for 40 minutes.

306
00:18:49,900 --> 00:18:52,580
How hot is that, Marky?
(BLEEP)...hot.

307
00:18:54,980 --> 00:18:56,740
Shall we turn up the heat?

308
00:18:56,740 --> 00:18:57,940
Yeah.
Sure.

309
00:18:57,940 --> 00:18:59,300
Yep.

310
00:18:59,300 --> 00:19:02,380
In a moment, I'm gonna rotate
these wheels, and you'll need

311
00:19:02,380 --> 00:19:06,140
to take up position
on the next set of pegs.

312
00:19:06,140 --> 00:19:08,860
But it is a live transition,

313
00:19:08,860 --> 00:19:12,260
so if you fall while I'm rotating,

314
00:19:12,260 --> 00:19:14,220
you are out of the challenge.

315
00:19:18,460 --> 00:19:19,460
Here we go.

316
00:19:21,500 --> 00:19:22,860
(LEVER CREAKS)

317
00:19:22,860 --> 00:19:25,780
(WHEELS CREAK)

318
00:19:44,300 --> 00:19:46,260
Ooh, that's good.

319
00:19:46,260 --> 00:19:48,180
Everyone in the second position.

320
00:19:50,780 --> 00:19:55,060
Those pegs are 10mm smaller
than the previous ones.

321
00:19:57,580 --> 00:19:59,980
You've got fewer hand positions now.

322
00:20:02,340 --> 00:20:03,540
Careful, babe.

323
00:20:03,540 --> 00:20:05,860
Definitely looks a little more
awkward.

324
00:20:09,740 --> 00:20:14,020
So, Feras, as the only Rebel left,

325
00:20:14,020 --> 00:20:16,620
do you think you need to win
this one today?

326
00:20:16,620 --> 00:20:19,060
Yeah. No, it's essential
that I win this.

327
00:20:20,140 --> 00:20:22,780
What about you, Mark?
Do you think Feras needs to win it?

328
00:20:23,820 --> 00:20:25,140
Well, I want to win it.

329
00:20:27,180 --> 00:20:29,500
And I've had a taste of it
and I want it again.

330
00:20:31,620 --> 00:20:33,100
Tastes pretty good, right?

331
00:20:33,100 --> 00:20:35,420
It's real good.
Tastes very good.

332
00:20:38,980 --> 00:20:40,780
So, Feras, what do you think's
going to get you today?

333
00:20:40,780 --> 00:20:42,860
Is it going to be the boredom of
being up there,

334
00:20:42,860 --> 00:20:46,140
or is it going to be those pegs
grinding into your feet?

335
00:20:47,580 --> 00:20:48,860
I can deal with pain.

336
00:20:48,860 --> 00:20:50,900
I've popped out a shoulder,
I've broken a shoulder.

337
00:20:50,900 --> 00:20:52,100
I'm fine with pain.

338
00:20:54,340 --> 00:20:57,420
Caroline, it sounds like
you have a fight on your hands.

339
00:20:57,420 --> 00:20:59,300
I've given birth to three children.

340
00:20:59,300 --> 00:21:01,540
Nice!
(LAUGHTER)

341
00:21:01,540 --> 00:21:02,700
Labour can be long.

342
00:21:04,180 --> 00:21:05,940
Never underestimate a woman.

343
00:21:05,940 --> 00:21:07,300
Yeah.

344
00:21:07,300 --> 00:21:10,980
That's why she's a Titan.

345
00:21:32,100 --> 00:21:33,940
You've been up there for one hour.

346
00:21:34,940 --> 00:21:36,260
You're doing amazing.
Yeah.

347
00:21:36,260 --> 00:21:38,060
You got it, darling.

348
00:21:38,060 --> 00:21:41,140
Lots of shifting around from Feras
and Mark.

349
00:21:43,060 --> 00:21:44,500
Meanwhile...

350
00:21:45,620 --> 00:21:47,780
..Caroline's in the zone.

351
00:21:47,780 --> 00:21:49,820
Locked and loaded.

352
00:21:53,780 --> 00:21:56,300
Is this position just too easy?

353
00:21:58,260 --> 00:22:00,220
Do what you need to do.

354
00:22:02,580 --> 00:22:04,220
Alright, let's go.

355
00:22:27,060 --> 00:22:28,420
Oh.

356
00:22:37,620 --> 00:22:40,060
Lots of shifting around
from everyone.

357
00:22:42,940 --> 00:22:44,260
You've got this.

358
00:22:51,460 --> 00:22:54,580
Mark, is it getting a little more
difficult to find something
comfortable?

359
00:22:54,580 --> 00:22:55,580
Yeah.

360
00:22:58,260 --> 00:23:02,020
It is those narrow pegs
that will get you in the end.

361
00:23:04,340 --> 00:23:06,540
They're only going to get worse.

362
00:23:20,860 --> 00:23:23,220
(SPEAKS QUIETLY TO HIMSELF)

363
00:23:35,540 --> 00:23:39,740
(FERAS CONTINUES RECITAL)

364
00:23:57,500 --> 00:24:00,900
OK. You have been up there for
an hour and a half.

365
00:24:02,220 --> 00:24:03,980
You guys look solid.
Yeah, you guys look good.

366
00:24:03,980 --> 00:24:06,140
Yeah, you look good.
You're doing amazing.

367
00:24:11,260 --> 00:24:13,860
Alright, shall we make it
a little more interesting?

368
00:24:39,860 --> 00:24:41,620
Alright.

369
00:24:42,900 --> 00:24:45,420
Those pegs are a lot sharper.

370
00:24:47,180 --> 00:24:49,060
30mm each.

371
00:24:52,860 --> 00:24:56,500
Now your hand positions
are very awkward.

372
00:24:57,540 --> 00:24:59,540
Everyone dancing around now.

373
00:25:00,660 --> 00:25:02,060
How are you going down there?

374
00:25:02,060 --> 00:25:03,820
Good.
Good?
Yeah.

375
00:25:24,380 --> 00:25:28,700
Night's falling, which means
the Tribal is just around the corner.

376
00:25:36,940 --> 00:25:38,980
(GRIMACES)

377
00:25:39,980 --> 00:25:41,820
Mark in pain now.

378
00:25:43,820 --> 00:25:45,180
(WHIMPERS)

379
00:25:45,180 --> 00:25:48,940
But we have seen that he has
a high pain tolerance.

380
00:25:50,220 --> 00:25:51,820
Argh-argh-argh.

381
00:25:52,900 --> 00:25:55,420
There's just no comfortable position
anymore.

382
00:25:55,420 --> 00:25:56,660
Everything is on fire.

383
00:25:56,660 --> 00:25:58,060
Wah.

384
00:25:58,060 --> 00:26:01,940
Your hands, your shoulders,
your back, your legs, your feet.

385
00:26:09,900 --> 00:26:11,340
(GRIMACES AND GROANS)

386
00:26:15,540 --> 00:26:16,780
Lots of movement from Mark.

387
00:26:17,780 --> 00:26:19,340
Grimacing now.

388
00:26:19,340 --> 00:26:21,060
Stay focused, darl. You got it.

389
00:26:22,820 --> 00:26:24,260
Argh.

390
00:26:24,260 --> 00:26:27,340
One minute everything's fine,
and then the pain from those pegs

391
00:26:27,340 --> 00:26:29,340
just catches up with you

392
00:26:29,340 --> 00:26:32,260
and every part of your foot
is on fire.

393
00:26:33,860 --> 00:26:35,100
(WHIMPERS)

394
00:26:40,780 --> 00:26:41,780
Come on.

395
00:26:43,180 --> 00:26:44,500
It won't hurt tomorrow, darl.

396
00:26:44,500 --> 00:26:46,060
It won't hurt tomorrow.

397
00:26:49,180 --> 00:26:51,580
(SOBS SOFTLY)
It's OK.

398
00:26:54,620 --> 00:26:56,020
Just breathe.

399
00:26:58,020 --> 00:27:00,860
Argh!
It's OK, it's OK.

400
00:27:04,180 --> 00:27:05,540
I'm Jonathan.

401
00:27:08,140 --> 00:27:09,460
Oh, yah-yah-yah.

402
00:27:09,460 --> 00:27:11,580
Not yet, not yet, not yet.

403
00:27:11,580 --> 00:27:12,980
I just like your name, that's all.

404
00:27:14,060 --> 00:27:15,380
Jonathan LaPaglia.

405
00:27:15,380 --> 00:27:17,980
Just testing out my name.
Yep.

406
00:27:22,620 --> 00:27:23,900
Oww!

407
00:27:25,140 --> 00:27:27,140
Deep breathing, darl.

408
00:27:27,140 --> 00:27:28,980
Mark just keeps fighting.

409
00:27:28,980 --> 00:27:30,860
(CRIES OUT IN PAIN)

410
00:27:32,740 --> 00:27:34,020
Keep breathing.

411
00:27:38,980 --> 00:27:40,580
No regrets, Mikey.

412
00:27:41,860 --> 00:27:45,380
Mark looking over at Feras
and Caroline now...

413
00:27:46,620 --> 00:27:49,620
..wondering just how much
they have in the tank.

414
00:28:02,180 --> 00:28:04,980
After two hours and 15 minutes...

415
00:28:04,980 --> 00:28:06,860
(APPLAUSE)

416
00:28:06,860 --> 00:28:08,740
..and a hell of a fight...

417
00:28:10,460 --> 00:28:12,580
..Mark can no longer stand the pain.

418
00:28:12,580 --> 00:28:15,460
He steps out.
He is out of the challenge.

419
00:28:17,380 --> 00:28:19,300
Love you, Marky Mark!

420
00:28:19,300 --> 00:28:20,660
FERAS: Mark, keep your head up, bro.

421
00:28:22,340 --> 00:28:23,700
(SOBS)

422
00:28:23,700 --> 00:28:26,260
It's OK, babe. It's OK, darling.

423
00:28:26,260 --> 00:28:28,540
You did so good. You did so good.

424
00:28:28,540 --> 00:28:31,260
No one can ever say you didn't try.

425
00:28:32,260 --> 00:28:33,660
It's OK.
Thanks, babe.

426
00:28:33,660 --> 00:28:35,180
I love you so much.
I love you, too.

427
00:28:35,180 --> 00:28:36,220
I love you so much.

428
00:28:41,620 --> 00:28:44,180
It's not over yet. OK?
Yeah.

429
00:28:44,180 --> 00:28:45,420
OK. Let's go.

430
00:28:50,300 --> 00:28:51,940
And now we have a showdown...

431
00:28:53,020 --> 00:28:56,300
..between Feras and Caroline,

432
00:28:56,300 --> 00:29:00,300
battling it out
for that final necklace

433
00:29:00,300 --> 00:29:04,060
and that guarantee to be at
that final Tribal Council.

434
00:29:06,140 --> 00:29:09,100
I've always fallen short
from that necklace.

435
00:29:09,100 --> 00:29:10,820
I'm wearing that necklace tonight.

436
00:29:10,820 --> 00:29:12,780
I'm not... I'm not stepping down.

437
00:29:14,780 --> 00:29:16,940
Alright, shall we turn this
all the way up?

438
00:29:16,940 --> 00:29:17,940
Yep.
Yep.

439
00:29:17,940 --> 00:29:19,460
Here we go.

440
00:29:24,420 --> 00:29:25,780
Just get in the zone.

441
00:29:27,660 --> 00:29:30,020
You got it, babe. You can do this.
Come on, guys.

442
00:29:53,260 --> 00:29:56,500
Now, suddenly, it is a lot harder.

443
00:29:56,500 --> 00:29:57,820
All your weight...

444
00:29:59,380 --> 00:30:04,380
..going through that single
pointy peg.

445
00:30:08,020 --> 00:30:09,980
Caroline looks solid.
She does.

446
00:30:09,980 --> 00:30:11,460
She looks super solid.

447
00:30:11,460 --> 00:30:13,060
She looks very strong.

448
00:30:14,900 --> 00:30:16,580
I know Feras is in pain.

449
00:30:16,580 --> 00:30:17,900
I know his face.

450
00:30:21,940 --> 00:30:23,420
No, he's in a lot of pain..

451
00:30:31,020 --> 00:30:32,660
Nice work, Caroline.

452
00:30:55,940 --> 00:30:57,660
Lots of movement now.

453
00:30:59,660 --> 00:31:02,620
Caroline skipping around
down the end there.

454
00:31:08,780 --> 00:31:10,100
Looking good, sweetheart.

455
00:31:13,660 --> 00:31:14,780
(GROANS SOFTLY)

456
00:31:16,580 --> 00:31:19,860
That final position sure is awkward.

457
00:31:25,580 --> 00:31:26,780
Oh.

458
00:31:26,780 --> 00:31:30,220
Big slip from Caroline,
but she saves herself.

459
00:31:30,220 --> 00:31:31,380
Nicely done.

460
00:31:32,580 --> 00:31:35,340
Great recovery.
Awesome work.

461
00:31:35,340 --> 00:31:39,060
Caroline finds something extra
in that tank.

462
00:31:41,460 --> 00:31:42,460
Settles back in.

463
00:31:42,460 --> 00:31:44,780
She's going to give Feras
a run for his money.

464
00:31:50,220 --> 00:31:55,900
Feras looking pretty cool, but how
much of that is his best game face?

465
00:32:03,060 --> 00:32:05,060
Caroline clearly in pain now.

466
00:32:06,180 --> 00:32:07,660
Really struggling.

467
00:32:08,860 --> 00:32:09,860
Argh!

468
00:32:09,860 --> 00:32:11,820
You can do this.

469
00:32:11,820 --> 00:32:13,180
Oh!

470
00:32:16,140 --> 00:32:17,980
You want that final necklace...

471
00:32:19,380 --> 00:32:21,220
..you're going to have to dig.

472
00:32:25,700 --> 00:32:28,900
That necklace is the only guarantee
that you'll be there

473
00:32:28,900 --> 00:32:30,180
in front of the jury.

474
00:32:48,340 --> 00:32:49,780
OK, Jonathan.

475
00:32:49,780 --> 00:32:51,580
That's it?
Yep.

476
00:32:53,860 --> 00:32:55,940
After over two and a half hours...

477
00:32:57,180 --> 00:32:58,860
..Caroline...

478
00:32:59,860 --> 00:33:01,540
..has had enough.

479
00:33:01,540 --> 00:33:02,580
(GROANS)

480
00:33:03,620 --> 00:33:04,700
Well done.

481
00:33:05,860 --> 00:33:07,420
What a performance!

482
00:33:07,420 --> 00:33:09,500
Feras wins final immunity.

483
00:33:16,700 --> 00:33:19,660
My God. It was so painful.

484
00:33:20,660 --> 00:33:22,420
I'm so proud of you.

485
00:33:22,420 --> 00:33:23,900
You've done so well.

486
00:33:23,900 --> 00:33:25,500
I never doubted you, babe.

487
00:33:38,780 --> 00:33:40,620
Feras, come on over.

488
00:33:40,620 --> 00:33:43,300
Never thought I'd hear that name!
(CHUCKLES)

489
00:33:44,940 --> 00:33:48,460
Final immunity is yours.

490
00:33:48,460 --> 00:33:51,940
Guaranteed a one-in-two shot
at winning the title

491
00:33:51,940 --> 00:33:54,020
and the half a million dollars
that goes with it.

492
00:33:55,300 --> 00:33:57,420
You still have a big decision
to make.

493
00:33:57,420 --> 00:33:59,460
Which of these two is going
to sit next to you

494
00:33:59,460 --> 00:34:01,260
at the final Tribal Council?

495
00:34:01,260 --> 00:34:04,220
And which of these two is going
to become our final jury member?

496
00:34:04,220 --> 00:34:05,780
That's a lot to think about.

497
00:34:05,780 --> 00:34:07,500
It is.
It is indeed.

498
00:34:07,500 --> 00:34:09,980
I'm going to give you all a chance
to say goodbye,

499
00:34:09,980 --> 00:34:12,060
and then I will see you at Tribal.

500
00:34:12,060 --> 00:34:14,540
Thank you so much.
Well done.

501
00:34:14,540 --> 00:34:16,980
Well done, everyone.
Well done, mate.

502
00:34:16,980 --> 00:34:18,140
I love you.

503
00:34:18,140 --> 00:34:19,180
I love you. I love you.

504
00:34:19,180 --> 00:34:20,660
I'm going to see you tomorrow.
Yeah.

505
00:34:22,700 --> 00:34:24,260
(ALL SAY THEIR GOODBYES)

506
00:34:24,260 --> 00:34:26,580
I can't wait to see you.
Yeah, we'll see you tomorrow.

507
00:34:26,580 --> 00:34:29,580
Bye, guys. Nice meeting you all.

508
00:34:29,580 --> 00:34:31,060
Bye.
Yeah.

509
00:34:32,820 --> 00:34:34,620
MARK: I'm not ready to leave.

510
00:34:34,620 --> 00:34:38,380
I haven't wasted 46 days out here
to just give up

511
00:34:38,380 --> 00:34:40,220
right at the final stage.

512
00:34:40,220 --> 00:34:41,780
I'm not afraid of Feras.

513
00:34:41,780 --> 00:34:43,740
I need to get in his head,

514
00:34:43,740 --> 00:34:46,980
to influence him
to keep me around in this game.

515
00:34:46,980 --> 00:34:49,340
So it's not over yet.

516
00:35:24,380 --> 00:35:27,420
Wow, look at this. So small.

517
00:35:27,420 --> 00:35:28,700
Nice.

518
00:35:30,300 --> 00:35:31,420
Thanks, bro.

519
00:35:37,180 --> 00:35:39,180
We'll now bring in the members
of our jury.

520
00:35:39,180 --> 00:35:40,820
Aileen.

521
00:35:40,820 --> 00:35:42,020
Jaden.

522
00:35:42,020 --> 00:35:43,100
Valeria.

523
00:35:43,100 --> 00:35:44,500
Alex.

524
00:35:44,500 --> 00:35:45,500
Rianna.

525
00:35:45,500 --> 00:35:46,780
Kitty.

526
00:35:46,780 --> 00:35:48,180
Kirby.

527
00:35:48,180 --> 00:35:51,180
And...
(RAYMOND LAUGHS HYSTERICALLY)

528
00:35:54,140 --> 00:35:56,940
..and Raymond, voted out at the last
Tribal Council.

529
00:35:56,940 --> 00:35:58,540
(LAUGHS)

530
00:36:02,780 --> 00:36:08,180
So, Feras, you win your first
individual immunity,

531
00:36:08,180 --> 00:36:11,780
and it felt like it was just when
you needed it the most.

532
00:36:11,780 --> 00:36:13,340
Is that a fair assessment?

533
00:36:13,340 --> 00:36:17,980
Yeah. I was at my absolute lowest
yesterday.

534
00:36:17,980 --> 00:36:20,300
Coming so close to winning
that challenge

535
00:36:20,300 --> 00:36:23,460
and losing one of my best friends.

536
00:36:23,460 --> 00:36:26,660
So today my back was against
the wall

537
00:36:26,660 --> 00:36:30,060
and my beautiful wife was there
to support me.

538
00:36:30,060 --> 00:36:32,620
And, um, it's what got me
through it.

539
00:36:34,060 --> 00:36:35,820
So if you didn't win today,

540
00:36:35,820 --> 00:36:38,820
you're pretty sure you wouldn't
have been here tomorrow.

541
00:36:38,820 --> 00:36:40,340
Yeah.

542
00:36:40,340 --> 00:36:41,820
Almost certain.

543
00:36:42,980 --> 00:36:46,180
Mark, you took that challenge
to the raggedy edge.

544
00:36:46,180 --> 00:36:49,260
It felt like you were fighting
for your life in the game.

545
00:36:49,260 --> 00:36:53,300
Yeah, Jonathan, I went in there
just totally focused,

546
00:36:53,300 --> 00:36:55,140
trying to go for the win.

547
00:36:55,140 --> 00:36:56,900
I couldn't do it.

548
00:36:56,900 --> 00:36:58,620
Um, so it's disappointing.

549
00:36:58,620 --> 00:37:00,580
And I've got to hand it to
the big man today.

550
00:37:00,580 --> 00:37:02,180
He was unstoppable.

551
00:37:02,180 --> 00:37:04,580
I seriously take my hat off to you,
mate. It was impressive.

552
00:37:04,580 --> 00:37:06,860
Thank you so much, Mark.
I agree.

553
00:37:09,980 --> 00:37:14,020
So, Feras, your vote is
the only one that counts.

554
00:37:14,020 --> 00:37:15,420
You hold all the power.

555
00:37:16,620 --> 00:37:19,220
And given the decision
you need to make tonight,

556
00:37:19,220 --> 00:37:21,460
how daunting is that,
knowing what's at stake?

557
00:37:22,580 --> 00:37:24,420
Yeah, it's extremely hard.

558
00:37:24,420 --> 00:37:28,540
I am literally the reason why
one of these two people

559
00:37:28,540 --> 00:37:30,540
aren't going to be moving forward.

560
00:37:34,140 --> 00:37:37,260
Caroline, is part of you relieved
that you don't have to make

561
00:37:37,260 --> 00:37:39,140
that decision tonight?

562
00:37:39,140 --> 00:37:40,700
Oh.

563
00:37:40,700 --> 00:37:43,420
I, um, I came so close today.

564
00:37:43,420 --> 00:37:44,860
So, so close.

565
00:37:44,860 --> 00:37:46,460
Like, the closest I've ever been.

566
00:37:46,460 --> 00:37:50,940
And it was, like,
the most brutal challenge.

567
00:37:50,940 --> 00:37:54,940
So, no, I wish that I was
in Feras's position,

568
00:37:54,940 --> 00:37:57,140
and I wish that I did have
the necklace.

569
00:37:59,100 --> 00:38:03,020
And, Caroline, why should Feras
take you to the end?

570
00:38:04,540 --> 00:38:07,820
Feras should take me to the end
because

571
00:38:07,820 --> 00:38:11,380
I can definitely hold my own
at tomorrow night's Tribal Council,

572
00:38:11,380 --> 00:38:14,180
and I would love to give Feras
a run for his money.

573
00:38:19,740 --> 00:38:20,900
Mark, same question.

574
00:38:20,900 --> 00:38:22,860
Why should Feras take you tomorrow?

575
00:38:23,860 --> 00:38:26,020
Feras has the choice right now.

576
00:38:26,020 --> 00:38:30,140
He can anticipate what I would bring
to a final Tribal.

577
00:38:30,140 --> 00:38:32,420
I'd put the gloves on
and we'd go at it.

578
00:38:34,060 --> 00:38:37,340
Um, I think the only thing
that Feras has to consider

579
00:38:37,340 --> 00:38:40,420
is that Caroline is really clever.

580
00:38:41,740 --> 00:38:45,540
I'm not sure that he knows what
sort of fire Caroline will bring

581
00:38:45,540 --> 00:38:47,100
to a final Tribal Council.

582
00:38:51,500 --> 00:38:53,940
Wow, Feras,
you have a lot to consider.

583
00:38:55,460 --> 00:38:58,420
You will decide who will be joining
that jury.

584
00:39:00,260 --> 00:39:01,700
Alright, it is...

585
00:39:02,940 --> 00:39:03,980
..time to vote.

586
00:39:23,060 --> 00:39:25,460
It is time to vote.

587
00:39:25,460 --> 00:39:27,060
Feras, you're up.

588
00:40:11,500 --> 00:40:13,060
I'll go collect the vote.

589
00:40:33,100 --> 00:40:35,380
Alright, I'll read the vote.

590
00:40:51,260 --> 00:40:53,060
22nd person voted out...

591
00:40:54,060 --> 00:40:56,420
..final member of our jury.

592
00:40:56,420 --> 00:40:57,660
Mark.

593
00:41:03,180 --> 00:41:04,940
You need to bring me your torch.

594
00:41:09,460 --> 00:41:12,820
Well played.
Thank you so much. You did amazing.

595
00:41:12,820 --> 00:41:15,180
Do your best.
Yeah.

596
00:41:24,020 --> 00:41:26,300
Mark, the tribe has spoken.

597
00:41:28,660 --> 00:41:30,620
Thanks, JLP. That was awesome.

598
00:41:30,620 --> 00:41:31,980
Well done.
Thank you.

599
00:41:31,980 --> 00:41:35,100
Alright.
You two, all the best.

600
00:41:35,100 --> 00:41:38,580
It's been a pleasure to be with you
on this massive journey.

601
00:41:38,580 --> 00:41:40,220
I think my life has changed forever.

602
00:41:40,220 --> 00:41:42,580
So, thank you. See you soon.

603
00:41:54,180 --> 00:41:57,260
Congratulations, Caroline and Feras.

604
00:41:57,260 --> 00:41:58,780
You are the final two.

605
00:41:58,780 --> 00:42:01,340
You have gone as far as you can go
in this game.

606
00:42:02,620 --> 00:42:05,500
And tomorrow night
the power shifts to the jury.

607
00:42:05,500 --> 00:42:08,940
So I suggest go home, get some sleep,

608
00:42:08,940 --> 00:42:11,460
and think about how you're going
to convince them

609
00:42:11,460 --> 00:42:14,500
that you deserve the title of
Sole Survivor.

610
00:42:14,500 --> 00:42:16,620
Grab your torches, head back to camp.

611
00:42:16,620 --> 00:42:17,660
Good luck.

612
00:42:17,660 --> 00:42:19,500
Thank you so much, JLP.

613
00:42:42,620 --> 00:42:44,460
Last day in Samoa.

614
00:42:44,460 --> 00:42:46,700
Last day in Paradise, baby.

615
00:42:46,700 --> 00:42:48,220
Oh.

616
00:42:48,220 --> 00:42:49,820
It's day 47...

617
00:42:51,980 --> 00:42:57,380
..and I don't think it has sunken in
yet that I'm part of the final two.

618
00:42:59,660 --> 00:43:00,980
(LAUGHS)

619
00:43:02,100 --> 00:43:03,380
Oh, my God.

620
00:43:03,380 --> 00:43:06,820
Yeah, I know. We can finally
get out of here.

621
00:43:06,820 --> 00:43:11,340
Last night, I sent Mark packing
to the jury

622
00:43:11,340 --> 00:43:15,540
because I felt like Caroline
would be easier to beat.

623
00:43:16,980 --> 00:43:20,460
But now I'm worried that Mark
could definitely

624
00:43:20,460 --> 00:43:23,060
be turning the jury against me.

625
00:43:23,060 --> 00:43:26,900
So I just hope that I made
the right decision.

626
00:43:29,420 --> 00:43:31,940
Have we...
Have we done our last notch?

627
00:43:31,940 --> 00:43:34,900
No. Let's do that.
Yeah. Where's the machete?

628
00:43:34,900 --> 00:43:39,940
Coming into this experience,
I wanted to be a very savage Feras.

629
00:43:39,940 --> 00:43:41,260
Let's do it together.

630
00:43:41,260 --> 00:43:44,300
In the beginning,
I was a very ruthless player.

631
00:43:44,300 --> 00:43:49,820
But as the days went on, it has
really humbled me, this experience.

632
00:43:49,820 --> 00:43:51,420
Hold it...
Yeah.

633
00:43:51,420 --> 00:43:52,820
..and I'll help you out here.

634
00:43:52,820 --> 00:43:54,340
There we go.

635
00:43:54,340 --> 00:43:55,580
OK, let's go.

636
00:44:00,940 --> 00:44:03,340
Yes.
That is day 47, baby.

637
00:44:03,340 --> 00:44:06,300
47!
All done.

638
00:44:06,300 --> 00:44:08,460
Wow.

639
00:44:08,460 --> 00:44:10,540
Nah, that's crazy.

640
00:44:10,540 --> 00:44:13,420
I have grown significantly.

641
00:44:13,420 --> 00:44:18,500
I have become so much more patient,
so much more determined

642
00:44:18,500 --> 00:44:21,260
and more emotionally intelligent.

643
00:44:21,260 --> 00:44:25,700
And I think I'm going to be taking
that to the outside world.

644
00:44:25,700 --> 00:44:31,060
I think it's only fitting that
a final Titan and a final Rebel,

645
00:44:31,060 --> 00:44:33,380
you couldn't have picked it
any better, could you?

646
00:44:33,380 --> 00:44:35,540
And, you know, I think we...

647
00:44:35,540 --> 00:44:39,500
We started to realise we might have
a mix of both, you and I.

648
00:44:39,500 --> 00:44:40,540
Yeah.

649
00:44:40,540 --> 00:44:42,900
I've seen a bit of fire
in your eyes.

650
00:44:42,900 --> 00:44:46,580
Yeah. I imagine that not a lot of
people on day one thought

651
00:44:46,580 --> 00:44:48,260
that I'd still be standing here.

652
00:44:48,260 --> 00:44:50,460
That's the best part about it -

653
00:44:50,460 --> 00:44:52,300
proved a lot of people wrong.

654
00:44:53,420 --> 00:44:55,860
Oh, well, we both did that.

655
00:44:55,860 --> 00:44:57,180
Hell, yeah, we did.

656
00:44:58,260 --> 00:45:01,140
There's a huge weight
on my shoulders.

657
00:45:02,620 --> 00:45:05,140
I'm doing this for my religion.

658
00:45:05,140 --> 00:45:07,220
I am doing this for my wife.

659
00:45:08,820 --> 00:45:12,300
I'm doing this for Western Sydney.

660
00:45:12,300 --> 00:45:16,740
It would mean the absolute world,
not only to win the money,

661
00:45:16,740 --> 00:45:22,300
but to be the first Middle Eastern
man to win Australian Survivor.

662
00:45:31,380 --> 00:45:34,700
Ohh!
Oh, look at that!

663
00:45:34,700 --> 00:45:37,620
Feras! Feras!
Wow!

664
00:45:37,620 --> 00:45:40,060
Coffee, milk, butter.

665
00:45:40,060 --> 00:45:41,820
Oh, look at all that.

666
00:45:41,820 --> 00:45:45,020
Coming into this game, as a midwife,

667
00:45:45,020 --> 00:45:47,900
I was completely different from
the rest of the tribe.

668
00:45:47,900 --> 00:45:49,620
"Congratulations.

669
00:45:49,620 --> 00:45:51,340
"You've made it to the final two.

670
00:45:51,340 --> 00:45:55,500
"Enjoy your well-earned day 47
Survivor breakfast."

671
00:45:55,500 --> 00:45:57,220
Yes!

672
00:45:57,220 --> 00:46:00,940
I have been up against
the strongest, the toughest,

673
00:46:00,940 --> 00:46:04,420
the most strategic players

674
00:46:04,420 --> 00:46:06,380
and yet I'm still here.

675
00:46:06,380 --> 00:46:08,340
Cheers, my darling.

676
00:46:08,340 --> 00:46:10,140
Day 47.

677
00:46:10,140 --> 00:46:11,460
Wow.

678
00:46:11,460 --> 00:46:15,020
I've proved you don't have
to beat them with this strength.

679
00:46:15,020 --> 00:46:17,300
You've got to beat them
with this strength.

680
00:46:17,300 --> 00:46:18,980
Shut...up!

681
00:46:18,980 --> 00:46:21,180
It's got chocolate in it, Feras!

682
00:46:21,180 --> 00:46:24,100
And that strength, determination
and strategy

683
00:46:24,100 --> 00:46:26,820
is absolutely what makes me a Titan.

684
00:46:26,820 --> 00:46:29,180
I actually feel myself coming alive
again.

685
00:46:29,180 --> 00:46:32,100
I'm worried about that!
(CHUCKLES)

686
00:46:32,100 --> 00:46:35,500
This tribe might have thought that
I was just the momma of the camp...

687
00:46:37,220 --> 00:46:39,900
..but I was controlling the votes,

688
00:46:39,900 --> 00:46:42,620
while making it feel like it was
a real collaboration...

689
00:46:43,780 --> 00:46:46,540
Oh, smell those onions!

690
00:46:46,540 --> 00:46:48,260
..and they all didn't know it.

691
00:46:48,260 --> 00:46:50,580
They thought I was just bringing
the momma.

692
00:46:51,620 --> 00:46:54,260
I was being a bit more than
the momma, alright.

693
00:46:56,740 --> 00:46:58,660
Breakfast with a view.

694
00:46:58,660 --> 00:47:01,500
Oh...wow.

695
00:47:02,500 --> 00:47:04,820
Look at that.
Cheers, sweetheart.

696
00:47:06,860 --> 00:47:09,220
This is what I've been waiting for.

697
00:47:09,220 --> 00:47:12,500
I had the image in my head
that I was going to make it here.

698
00:47:12,500 --> 00:47:17,420
I just kept focusing on that
the whole way through.

699
00:47:17,420 --> 00:47:20,660
Today is like the crowning moment,

700
00:47:20,660 --> 00:47:26,580
in terms of a birth and the head
coming through before the body.

701
00:47:26,580 --> 00:47:31,620
You know, this is my crowning moment
in my journey here on Survivor

702
00:47:31,620 --> 00:47:33,300
because I'm so close.

703
00:47:35,180 --> 00:47:40,780
I'm so close and I've just got
those last final pushes to go,

704
00:47:40,780 --> 00:47:45,260
and I will have birthed
what will be the biggest journey

705
00:47:45,260 --> 00:47:49,460
of my life, other than giving birth
to my own three children.

706
00:47:49,460 --> 00:47:50,900
How crazy is that?

707
00:48:08,740 --> 00:48:12,900
Feras is underestimating me
in taking me to the end.

708
00:48:12,900 --> 00:48:16,100
He doesn't know my game pre-merge
at all.

709
00:48:17,100 --> 00:48:19,780
He has no idea what I'm capable of.

710
00:48:20,740 --> 00:48:24,580
We're just going to have to duke
it out at this final Tribal Council,

711
00:48:24,580 --> 00:48:27,620
this final culmination of
this battle

712
00:48:27,620 --> 00:48:30,260
that's been going on between
the Titans and the Rebels.

713
00:48:32,180 --> 00:48:34,580
I'm gonna come out swinging tonight.

714
00:49:02,780 --> 00:49:04,020
Hey, JLP.

715
00:49:04,020 --> 00:49:05,140
Evening.

716
00:49:09,020 --> 00:49:10,420
(SIGHS)

717
00:49:14,140 --> 00:49:16,060
We'll now bring in the members
of our jury.

718
00:49:16,060 --> 00:49:20,900
Aileen, Jaden, Valeria, Alex,

719
00:49:20,900 --> 00:49:23,500
Rianna, Kitty,

720
00:49:23,500 --> 00:49:25,900
Kirby, Raymond

721
00:49:25,900 --> 00:49:28,820
and Mark, voted out at the last
Tribal Council.

722
00:49:28,820 --> 00:49:30,620
Hey, Marky.

723
00:49:30,620 --> 00:49:32,300
Looking good.

724
00:49:37,780 --> 00:49:39,980
So here we are,

725
00:49:39,980 --> 00:49:41,500
day 47,

726
00:49:41,500 --> 00:49:43,940
your final Tribal Council.

727
00:49:43,940 --> 00:49:47,100
You two have gone as far
as you can go in this game.

728
00:49:47,100 --> 00:49:50,100
And tonight the power shifts
to the jury.

729
00:49:51,380 --> 00:49:54,420
Nine people you've had a hand
in voting out,

730
00:49:54,420 --> 00:49:56,100
either directly or indirectly,

731
00:49:56,100 --> 00:49:57,980
will now decide which of you two

732
00:49:57,980 --> 00:50:00,820
deserves the title
of Sole Survivor

733
00:50:00,820 --> 00:50:04,700
and the half a million dollars
that goes with it.

734
00:50:04,700 --> 00:50:06,900
This is how it's going to work.

735
00:50:06,900 --> 00:50:09,180
You'll each make
an opening statement.

736
00:50:09,180 --> 00:50:11,540
This is your chance
to convince the jury

737
00:50:11,540 --> 00:50:14,700
why you think you deserve
to win this game.

738
00:50:14,700 --> 00:50:16,500
Then the jury will address you.

739
00:50:16,500 --> 00:50:19,580
They'll ask you questions,
you'll answer them,

740
00:50:19,580 --> 00:50:21,900
and they'll respond
in an open forum.

741
00:50:21,900 --> 00:50:23,580
It might get a little ugly.

742
00:50:26,540 --> 00:50:28,900
Once everyone's had their say,

743
00:50:28,900 --> 00:50:30,540
the jury will then go to vote

744
00:50:30,540 --> 00:50:33,220
to decide who wins this game.

745
00:50:33,220 --> 00:50:34,780
OK.

746
00:50:37,220 --> 00:50:39,300
So, Caroline.

747
00:50:39,300 --> 00:50:40,780
Would you like to kick us off?

748
00:50:40,780 --> 00:50:43,820
I would love to kick us off.

749
00:50:48,900 --> 00:50:50,420
Coming into this game,

750
00:50:50,420 --> 00:50:54,540
I knew that I was going to have
a target on my back from day one.

751
00:50:54,540 --> 00:50:56,900
I was the oldest member
of the tribe

752
00:50:56,900 --> 00:50:59,060
on a tribe of beasts.

753
00:51:00,340 --> 00:51:02,300
Everyone was so strong,

754
00:51:02,300 --> 00:51:06,460
so I had to create a role
for myself.

755
00:51:06,460 --> 00:51:07,700
And even though

756
00:51:07,700 --> 00:51:10,540
there's a whole generation
difference between us,

757
00:51:10,540 --> 00:51:13,860
I felt like I formed
incredible bonds and relationships.

758
00:51:13,860 --> 00:51:16,700
And that's what helped me
through the game.

759
00:51:18,900 --> 00:51:22,100
Kitty, on day dot,

760
00:51:22,100 --> 00:51:23,940
like, we established a bond
straightaway.

761
00:51:23,940 --> 00:51:25,300
She was my number one.

762
00:51:25,300 --> 00:51:27,660
And, Mark, you were my number two.

763
00:51:27,660 --> 00:51:32,540
And together with Eden,
we formed the Middle-Aged Mafia.

764
00:51:32,540 --> 00:51:34,860
We pulled in Val, Viola.

765
00:51:35,980 --> 00:51:40,300
From there, we went into Tribe Swap,

766
00:51:40,300 --> 00:51:41,740
but at this point,

767
00:51:41,740 --> 00:51:45,180
I found out that
Viola was working against me

768
00:51:45,180 --> 00:51:47,740
and so I had to vote Viola out.

769
00:51:49,420 --> 00:51:51,300
And although it was a big move,

770
00:51:51,300 --> 00:51:52,980
I knew it was the right move

771
00:51:52,980 --> 00:51:55,380
because we wanted
to keep you to ourselves, Mark,

772
00:51:55,380 --> 00:51:57,100
moving forward.

773
00:51:57,100 --> 00:52:03,500
After merge, I think this is really
where I came into my own.

774
00:52:03,500 --> 00:52:07,780
I had to really work
those relationships and bonds

775
00:52:07,780 --> 00:52:10,860
and just get myself
another step ahead.

776
00:52:12,300 --> 00:52:16,220
I am a person that is very loyal.

777
00:52:16,220 --> 00:52:20,380
I never, ever voted
for any of my alliance,

778
00:52:20,380 --> 00:52:24,820
and out of the 18 Tribal Councils
that I've attended,

779
00:52:24,820 --> 00:52:26,300
there were only two of them

780
00:52:26,300 --> 00:52:28,900
where I didn't know
where the vote was going.

781
00:52:28,900 --> 00:52:33,540
And that was obviously you,
Kitty and Eden.

782
00:52:33,540 --> 00:52:37,100
And when my back
was against the wall,

783
00:52:37,100 --> 00:52:40,220
I beat Raymond
in the Firemaking Challenge.

784
00:52:40,220 --> 00:52:43,820
And that's why
I'm in this position right now.

785
00:52:43,820 --> 00:52:45,940
I absolutely deserve to be here

786
00:52:45,940 --> 00:52:49,020
and to take that title
of Sole Survivor.

787
00:52:55,740 --> 00:52:57,580
Nicely said. Feras.

788
00:52:59,340 --> 00:53:00,860
Ah.

789
00:53:00,860 --> 00:53:02,660
Wow, um...

790
00:53:05,900 --> 00:53:07,180
Um...

791
00:53:10,580 --> 00:53:15,300
I came in this game
with an aim.

792
00:53:15,300 --> 00:53:18,980
To uphold my values as a person...

793
00:53:20,900 --> 00:53:23,380
..as a Muslim,
as a Middle Eastern man.

794
00:53:25,180 --> 00:53:30,700
I had a very, very specific
game plan that I wanted to play.

795
00:53:31,940 --> 00:53:35,540
And I want to have
a bit of fun with it as well.

796
00:53:36,940 --> 00:53:38,540
And I most certainly did.

797
00:53:40,820 --> 00:53:45,100
I immediately recognised
that there were four alphas

798
00:53:45,100 --> 00:53:47,620
in the tribe.

799
00:53:47,620 --> 00:53:51,220
That is when
the alliances of misfits

800
00:53:51,220 --> 00:53:52,500
came together.

801
00:53:52,500 --> 00:53:57,380
Specifically Aileen,
Raymond and Garrick.

802
00:53:57,380 --> 00:54:01,100
These were my rocks
throughout the game.

803
00:54:02,580 --> 00:54:04,460
I never turned on these people.

804
00:54:06,340 --> 00:54:08,220
I had my back against the wall

805
00:54:08,220 --> 00:54:10,780
in a minority
on the new Titans tribe,

806
00:54:10,780 --> 00:54:14,060
but I still stuck by
Aileen and Raymond.

807
00:54:15,740 --> 00:54:18,420
Now was the time to be strategic.

808
00:54:18,420 --> 00:54:22,460
And that was when
that huge move came.

809
00:54:22,460 --> 00:54:27,420
We flushed out Winna's idol
and we got out Charles.

810
00:54:27,420 --> 00:54:30,500
We managed to turn
that Tribal Council around.

811
00:54:31,820 --> 00:54:35,580
One of the last strategic moves
that I had to make

812
00:54:35,580 --> 00:54:38,740
was literally the hardest move

813
00:54:38,740 --> 00:54:41,500
and that was choosing
not to save Kirby.

814
00:54:41,500 --> 00:54:43,860
Kirby and I
were each other's shields

815
00:54:43,860 --> 00:54:46,340
the entire time,
and we both recognised that

816
00:54:46,340 --> 00:54:48,900
'cause if Kirby went,
I was next in line

817
00:54:48,900 --> 00:54:50,020
and vice versa.

818
00:54:51,860 --> 00:54:53,220
But then after Alex

819
00:54:53,220 --> 00:54:56,300
did the whole spiel
at the Tribal Council,

820
00:54:56,300 --> 00:55:00,460
I realised maybe it's time
to just put my shield down

821
00:55:00,460 --> 00:55:05,020
and to show everyone
that I'm a big player as well.

822
00:55:06,860 --> 00:55:08,780
And up until that point,

823
00:55:08,780 --> 00:55:11,900
I haven't won
a single immunity challenge.

824
00:55:11,900 --> 00:55:14,660
And at that moment,
I had to back myself.

825
00:55:15,940 --> 00:55:20,380
I was prepared to either win
at that last challenge

826
00:55:20,380 --> 00:55:24,540
and make it here,
or to lose and go home.

827
00:55:24,540 --> 00:55:25,940
And I literally said,

828
00:55:25,940 --> 00:55:28,740
"You're going to have to pull me out
in a stretcher

829
00:55:28,740 --> 00:55:30,540
"because I am not stepping down."

830
00:55:33,900 --> 00:55:36,540
And then lastly
came the social part of the game,

831
00:55:36,540 --> 00:55:37,900
the fun part.

832
00:55:40,180 --> 00:55:43,540
I just really hope
you will understand that

833
00:55:43,540 --> 00:55:46,460
there is a game aspect
and a relationship aspect

834
00:55:46,460 --> 00:55:50,340
that I did want to genuinely build
with you guys.

835
00:55:50,340 --> 00:55:53,780
And although this is
the last Tribal Council

836
00:55:53,780 --> 00:55:55,660
that we spend together,

837
00:55:55,660 --> 00:55:59,820
I think it's the beginning
of a bunch of new friendships.

838
00:56:02,500 --> 00:56:03,980
Alright, well...

839
00:56:03,980 --> 00:56:08,660
Jury, you've heard
two very compelling pitches.

840
00:56:08,660 --> 00:56:11,900
Now it's your turn
to ask the questions.

841
00:56:38,060 --> 00:56:39,500
Alright, well...

842
00:56:39,500 --> 00:56:43,420
Jury, you've heard
two very compelling pitches.

843
00:56:43,420 --> 00:56:46,820
Now it's your turn
to ask the questions.

844
00:56:46,820 --> 00:56:49,300
Mark, you want to start off?

845
00:56:49,300 --> 00:56:50,380
Yeah.

846
00:56:53,140 --> 00:56:55,260
Just last night, I was sitting
right next to you both,

847
00:56:55,260 --> 00:56:57,540
and I was preparing my own pitch.

848
00:56:58,980 --> 00:57:00,820
I'm going to give you some advice.

849
00:57:00,820 --> 00:57:02,980
You need to be honest.

850
00:57:02,980 --> 00:57:06,620
You need to fess up
when you have not been amazing.

851
00:57:06,620 --> 00:57:10,500
That's OK.
And also, just don't overreach.

852
00:57:10,500 --> 00:57:14,540
Um, just be clear and honest
and that will be your best shot.

853
00:57:14,540 --> 00:57:16,380
Thanks, Mark.

854
00:57:16,380 --> 00:57:17,860
So my question is to you, Caroline.

855
00:57:17,860 --> 00:57:19,980
Sure.

856
00:57:19,980 --> 00:57:23,180
In many parts of this game,
I was in trouble.

857
00:57:23,180 --> 00:57:26,500
I was in danger,
and I got myself out of a hole.

858
00:57:26,500 --> 00:57:29,020
When were you most in trouble
in this game,

859
00:57:29,020 --> 00:57:30,780
and how did you get yourself
out of it?

860
00:57:34,540 --> 00:57:38,220
So when I was most in trouble
in this game

861
00:57:38,220 --> 00:57:41,260
was when viola
was working against me.

862
00:57:41,260 --> 00:57:44,980
I got a sense during the end
of that scramble

863
00:57:44,980 --> 00:57:48,020
that you were having
a lot of discussions.

864
00:57:49,820 --> 00:57:51,380
And Kitty can attest to this.

865
00:57:51,380 --> 00:57:53,940
I needed to protect myself.

866
00:57:53,940 --> 00:57:58,540
And so I changed the votes
and that's why Viola went home.

867
00:58:00,460 --> 00:58:01,540
OK. Thank you.

868
00:58:03,420 --> 00:58:04,580
OK.

869
00:58:04,580 --> 00:58:06,460
Aileen, what would you like to ask?

870
00:58:07,780 --> 00:58:09,340
Feras.

871
00:58:09,340 --> 00:58:13,220
I really, really enjoyed working
in an alliance with you.

872
00:58:13,220 --> 00:58:16,140
However, I do feel like
your biggest flaw in this game

873
00:58:16,140 --> 00:58:18,740
was not listening to me

874
00:58:18,740 --> 00:58:23,100
or not listening
to a lot of your alliance members.

875
00:58:23,100 --> 00:58:26,100
For example, the first time
you played your idol incorrectly,

876
00:58:26,100 --> 00:58:28,740
when I told you you didn't
need to play it,

877
00:58:28,740 --> 00:58:31,060
and the second time
was not playing it for Garrick.

878
00:58:31,060 --> 00:58:32,140
Yeah.

879
00:58:32,140 --> 00:58:33,540
So my question to you is,

880
00:58:33,540 --> 00:58:39,340
what was a big game-altering move
that you did on your own?

881
00:58:39,340 --> 00:58:44,900
Ah, look, firstly,
it's so much harder for...

882
00:58:46,380 --> 00:58:48,500
..someone to make decisions
with idols.

883
00:58:48,500 --> 00:58:54,300
And although I did have you
in my ear, I was just so afraid,

884
00:58:54,300 --> 00:58:56,780
I guess, of playing it wrong.

885
00:58:58,020 --> 00:59:01,260
For me, my strategic move

886
00:59:01,260 --> 00:59:04,540
was where I chose to go
on the idol hunt,

887
00:59:04,540 --> 00:59:07,260
not a feast and some socialising.

888
00:59:07,260 --> 00:59:09,180
And I found this idol.

889
00:59:11,060 --> 00:59:14,220
And I said,
"Alex, you hold on to it."

890
00:59:14,220 --> 00:59:19,260
And that's when I shifted the target
from myself onto Alex,

891
00:59:19,260 --> 00:59:23,700
because Kirby was so obsessed
with Alex's idol,

892
00:59:23,700 --> 00:59:27,900
and I wanted to be
on the right side of Kirby.

893
00:59:30,660 --> 00:59:32,060
So is that your big move?

894
00:59:33,900 --> 00:59:35,060
Yes.

895
00:59:42,740 --> 00:59:44,140
Alright, Rianna.

896
00:59:45,220 --> 00:59:48,060
My question is actually going to
go to Caroline.

897
00:59:48,060 --> 00:59:50,260
So you kind of just said before,

898
00:59:50,260 --> 00:59:53,060
like, you're a very loyal
and trustworthy player,

899
00:59:53,060 --> 00:59:56,380
and it's something you've kind of
framed your game around.

900
00:59:56,380 --> 00:59:58,740
So I'm kind of just wanting
to know why,

901
00:59:58,740 --> 01:00:02,140
like, when we were working together,
you still didn't really include me,

902
01:00:02,140 --> 01:00:05,660
like, in the plans or, like, tell me
a fake name a bunch of times,

903
01:00:05,660 --> 01:00:07,900
which I knew you guys were lying
to me about...

904
01:00:07,900 --> 01:00:10,660
Twice...
Um... Twice is too many.

905
01:00:10,660 --> 01:00:12,180
I guess it was working out

906
01:00:12,180 --> 01:00:14,340
what that threat level was
and making sure

907
01:00:14,340 --> 01:00:16,900
that I was keeping myself safe.
Yeah.

908
01:00:16,900 --> 01:00:18,540
And I apologise for that.

909
01:00:23,820 --> 01:00:26,780
So you're happy to go against
your own morals of the game

910
01:00:26,780 --> 01:00:27,940
to get to the end?

911
01:00:31,620 --> 01:00:33,660
Um... I'm... I...

912
01:00:38,340 --> 01:00:40,500
There's no way that I've got
through this game

913
01:00:40,500 --> 01:00:43,540
playing a completely loyal
and honest game.

914
01:00:46,020 --> 01:00:47,300
I have lied.

915
01:00:47,300 --> 01:00:48,380
I have deceived.

916
01:00:50,180 --> 01:00:54,300
But I am an extremely loyal person.

917
01:00:54,300 --> 01:00:57,100
And those people that were
in my alliance,

918
01:00:57,100 --> 01:00:58,900
they definitely knew that.

919
01:01:00,580 --> 01:01:03,420
OK. Thank you for your answer.
No worries.

920
01:01:04,620 --> 01:01:06,900
Valeria, would you like to ask
something?

921
01:01:06,900 --> 01:01:09,620
Yes. Feras...

922
01:01:11,380 --> 01:01:15,460
How many votes do you think
you're going to get tonight?

923
01:01:16,580 --> 01:01:17,780
Um...

924
01:01:17,780 --> 01:01:20,980
I think what I learned in this game

925
01:01:20,980 --> 01:01:26,340
that you can never predict
and always expect the unexpected.

926
01:01:27,980 --> 01:01:31,100
To me, that's a really difficult
question.

927
01:01:35,700 --> 01:01:37,300
I hope it is the majority.

928
01:01:40,260 --> 01:01:42,820
Thank you. And I guess also to
Caroline.

929
01:01:44,380 --> 01:01:47,340
Oh, Val, that's an amazing question.

930
01:01:47,340 --> 01:01:49,780
And I can't count on any votes,

931
01:01:49,780 --> 01:01:55,100
but I have adored getting to know
each and every one of you.

932
01:01:55,100 --> 01:01:58,020
And I am so passionate about
this game

933
01:01:58,020 --> 01:02:00,780
that I want you guys
to make your decision

934
01:02:00,780 --> 01:02:03,500
based on everything
that you've heard.

935
01:02:05,340 --> 01:02:08,980
Just being here is like
beyond my wildest dreams.

936
01:02:15,580 --> 01:02:17,780
I think it's gonna be very hard
for the jury.

937
01:02:17,780 --> 01:02:20,740
I still haven't made a decision...

938
01:02:20,740 --> 01:02:22,180
..about tonight.

939
01:02:22,180 --> 01:02:23,900
Sorry. What did you say?

940
01:02:23,900 --> 01:02:26,420
It's gonna be very hard
for the jury.

941
01:02:26,420 --> 01:02:28,460
It's a lot of beautiful words,

942
01:02:28,460 --> 01:02:31,780
but I feel like it's just not
getting to the bottom,

943
01:02:31,780 --> 01:02:33,780
to the nitty and gritty of things.

944
01:02:35,500 --> 01:02:36,980
I mean, did everyone...?

945
01:02:43,420 --> 01:02:44,900
I feel like every jury member,

946
01:02:44,900 --> 01:02:48,460
including myself,
has a bit of a sour taste.

947
01:03:10,140 --> 01:03:12,580
I think it's gonna be very hard
for the jury.

948
01:03:12,580 --> 01:03:14,580
I still haven't made a decision.

949
01:03:20,660 --> 01:03:22,100
It's a lot of beautiful words.

950
01:03:23,700 --> 01:03:26,540
But I feel like it's just not
getting to the bottom,

951
01:03:26,540 --> 01:03:28,540
to the nitty and gritty of things.

952
01:03:32,140 --> 01:03:34,140
It's like, see, Feras,

953
01:03:34,140 --> 01:03:39,220
I feel like it's not enough to call
a game a very strategic game,

954
01:03:39,220 --> 01:03:43,900
when I personally haven't seen
a very strategic move.

955
01:03:47,300 --> 01:03:48,900
Same with Caroline.

956
01:03:51,580 --> 01:03:54,780
After a few things happened
during the game...

957
01:03:57,940 --> 01:04:00,860
..it doesn't make us feel that

958
01:04:00,860 --> 01:04:04,260
it was a great social game play
by Caroline.

959
01:04:08,340 --> 01:04:11,860
We want the truth and we want
the ego down

960
01:04:11,860 --> 01:04:14,540
and kind of show
this is how it happened.

961
01:04:14,540 --> 01:04:16,020
And here I am.

962
01:04:22,460 --> 01:04:25,620
I own up to not playing
the best social game.

963
01:04:30,140 --> 01:04:34,420
But I tell you what, on that last
challenge yesterday, I was...

964
01:04:34,420 --> 01:04:37,180
I was there with him, I beat Mark,

965
01:04:37,180 --> 01:04:43,740
I have fought and grinded so hard
every single day I was out here.

966
01:04:43,740 --> 01:04:46,500
So I know I've given everything.

967
01:04:46,500 --> 01:04:51,220
And if you've got further questions,
I'm very happy to answer them.

968
01:04:55,140 --> 01:04:57,820
Alright. Alex, what have you got?

969
01:04:57,820 --> 01:05:02,340
Um, Caroline,
when I exited the game,

970
01:05:02,340 --> 01:05:06,300
I challenged you that you hadn't
done enough to win.

971
01:05:06,300 --> 01:05:08,820
Yeah.
And I want to know,

972
01:05:08,820 --> 01:05:12,660
from when I left, how do you think
you went after that?

973
01:05:12,660 --> 01:05:16,260
I think I went extremely well,
actually.

974
01:05:16,260 --> 01:05:20,180
Every day, I felt like there was
a different move in the plans.

975
01:05:20,180 --> 01:05:24,740
And all I needed to do was just try
and get myself another further day

976
01:05:24,740 --> 01:05:27,780
in the game
so that it wasn't me voted out.

977
01:05:27,780 --> 01:05:30,220
And I guess that's
where I worked myself.

978
01:05:33,420 --> 01:05:38,260
I'm not sure if that answers
the question of what move you made.

979
01:05:38,260 --> 01:05:42,140
Um, I guess I found that idol,

980
01:05:42,140 --> 01:05:45,020
and on the night
that Kitty went home,

981
01:05:45,020 --> 01:05:47,140
I had talked to everybody

982
01:05:47,140 --> 01:05:50,180
and all the votes were going
on Mark.

983
01:05:50,180 --> 01:05:52,820
And I put a vote on Feras,

984
01:05:52,820 --> 01:05:55,380
hoping that I could save Mark,

985
01:05:55,380 --> 01:05:59,220
flush Feras's idol,
and send Feras to the jury.

986
01:05:59,220 --> 01:06:01,940
I thought, "This is my opportunity.

987
01:06:01,940 --> 01:06:05,180
"I'm going to take it, and I'm
better to have gone and tried

988
01:06:05,180 --> 01:06:07,060
"and lost than to have
never tried at all."

989
01:06:07,060 --> 01:06:08,460
So that was my move.

990
01:06:14,500 --> 01:06:17,140
It sounds like your big move
was playing an idol wrong,

991
01:06:17,140 --> 01:06:19,500
judging from what you just said.

992
01:06:25,580 --> 01:06:28,060
Kirby, what's your question?

993
01:06:31,300 --> 01:06:33,020
Um, mine's to Feras.

994
01:06:35,420 --> 01:06:38,020
I was always taking you
if Ri wasn't in.

995
01:06:38,020 --> 01:06:39,940
Yeah.
And I told you that.

996
01:06:39,940 --> 01:06:41,540
Yeah, of course.

997
01:06:41,540 --> 01:06:44,020
I wasn't scared to stand next
to anyone.
Yeah.

998
01:06:44,020 --> 01:06:47,620
And you also said that you weren't
scared to stand next to me.

999
01:06:47,620 --> 01:06:50,380
Of course.
But you chose not to.

1000
01:06:50,380 --> 01:06:51,900
Yes.

1001
01:06:51,900 --> 01:06:55,340
So were you scared to stand with me
at the end?

1002
01:06:57,180 --> 01:06:58,740
Um...

1003
01:06:58,740 --> 01:07:00,220
Well...

1004
01:07:04,620 --> 01:07:07,020
Look, it was less about being scared

1005
01:07:07,020 --> 01:07:11,580
and more about understanding
that without you sitting here,

1006
01:07:11,580 --> 01:07:14,780
I had a better chance
to win Sole Survivor.

1007
01:07:14,780 --> 01:07:17,020
That's what it was.

1008
01:07:17,020 --> 01:07:21,460
Do you think you played
with the courage that you voiced?

1009
01:07:21,460 --> 01:07:26,260
It took a lot of courage to
stand there

1010
01:07:26,260 --> 01:07:29,380
and have an idol in my hands,

1011
01:07:29,380 --> 01:07:33,740
and although it went against
every aspect of who I am,

1012
01:07:33,740 --> 01:07:37,940
it was courageous for me to put
the game first,

1013
01:07:37,940 --> 01:07:42,020
to put down my shield of Kirby,

1014
01:07:42,020 --> 01:07:45,020
and to be prepared to take all
the hits.

1015
01:07:46,820 --> 01:07:51,980
For me, that was the most courageous
moment of the game in my eyes.

1016
01:07:54,380 --> 01:07:55,780
Do you know what?

1017
01:07:57,220 --> 01:08:02,060
I think it's extremely hard,
especially in such a fluid season

1018
01:08:02,060 --> 01:08:05,380
where everybody was working
with everybody

1019
01:08:05,380 --> 01:08:09,180
to, literally, be like,
this was purely from me.

1020
01:08:10,180 --> 01:08:13,540
But something
that I could definitely claim

1021
01:08:13,540 --> 01:08:16,180
is bluffing my idol.

1022
01:08:17,860 --> 01:08:21,420
I've proved that it's not just
finding an idol and playing it,

1023
01:08:21,420 --> 01:08:23,700
and you're safe for one
Tribal Council.

1024
01:08:23,700 --> 01:08:28,860
The confusion of my idol was,
in itself, a huge strategic move.

1025
01:08:30,300 --> 01:08:33,300
And that got me out of a lot of
possible votes

1026
01:08:33,300 --> 01:08:35,380
where my name could have been
written down.

1027
01:08:35,380 --> 01:08:38,940
Now, this idol that I held,

1028
01:08:38,940 --> 01:08:43,140
I had for 31 days,
and I also used that

1029
01:08:43,140 --> 01:08:48,220
on the last time
we could use an idol.

1030
01:08:48,220 --> 01:08:51,020
I wrapped up the idol
and I gave it to Ray,

1031
01:08:51,020 --> 01:08:54,380
and I said, "Let's plant this idol
in front of Mark,

1032
01:08:54,380 --> 01:08:56,060
"in front of Caroline

1033
01:08:56,060 --> 01:08:58,820
"so that they can see you
holding an idol."

1034
01:08:58,820 --> 01:09:00,940
And so not only I'm gonna be safe,

1035
01:09:00,940 --> 01:09:04,140
but you're also going to be safe.

1036
01:09:04,140 --> 01:09:06,420
I wanted Ray next to me.

1037
01:09:06,420 --> 01:09:09,660
That was your idea?
Yes, it was my idea.

1038
01:09:10,940 --> 01:09:12,580
It was definitely his idea.

1039
01:09:12,580 --> 01:09:15,900
And, yeah, it was pulled off.
Brilliant.

1040
01:09:15,900 --> 01:09:20,500
I am extremely confident in
how I've played this game.

1041
01:09:20,500 --> 01:09:22,100
I took out Charles.

1042
01:09:22,100 --> 01:09:23,580
I took out Winna.

1043
01:09:23,580 --> 01:09:26,340
I'm the one who sent Kirby
to the jury.

1044
01:09:26,340 --> 01:09:28,420
I've been at the bottom
so many times.

1045
01:09:28,420 --> 01:09:31,060
I've been at the top.
I've been in the middle.

1046
01:09:31,060 --> 01:09:33,380
And I knew when to set
the game aside

1047
01:09:33,380 --> 01:09:36,460
and when to just bring out Feras.

1048
01:09:37,780 --> 01:09:41,580
I always told myself,
leave emotions out of the game.

1049
01:09:43,220 --> 01:09:45,900
I was such a cutthroat player
in the beginning,

1050
01:09:45,900 --> 01:09:47,420
and I evolved

1051
01:09:47,420 --> 01:09:49,580
because I genuinely made some
friendships out here.

1052
01:09:51,860 --> 01:09:56,540
I did my best to represent
my culture, my religion,

1053
01:09:56,540 --> 01:10:00,020
my family, everything.

1054
01:10:00,020 --> 01:10:03,940
And this is a chance for me
to prove to my parents

1055
01:10:03,940 --> 01:10:06,700
that there are
so many different ways

1056
01:10:06,700 --> 01:10:09,580
you can make it in a place
like Australia.

1057
01:10:09,580 --> 01:10:13,060
You don't need to be a doctor
or an engineer or a bloody lawyer.

1058
01:10:13,060 --> 01:10:15,300
You can go on a TV show,

1059
01:10:15,300 --> 01:10:20,980
have a laugh and, um, literally
lose a bunch of challenges

1060
01:10:20,980 --> 01:10:25,900
and also win $500,000,
which is insane to me.

1061
01:10:27,340 --> 01:10:30,780
And although the title of
Sole Survivor

1062
01:10:30,780 --> 01:10:32,980
would make me so proud

1063
01:10:32,980 --> 01:10:34,260
to represent my community

1064
01:10:34,260 --> 01:10:38,300
as the first Middle Eastern man
to win Survivor...

1065
01:10:40,220 --> 01:10:46,300
..winning the $500,000 for me
is genuinely life-changing.

1066
01:10:50,500 --> 01:10:54,340
Alright, jury you should
have all the information you need now

1067
01:10:54,340 --> 01:10:56,980
to decide who you think deserves
the title of Sole Survivor

1068
01:10:56,980 --> 01:11:00,300
and the half million dollars
that goes with it.

1069
01:11:00,300 --> 01:11:04,220
Remember, tonight you are voting
for a winner.

1070
01:11:07,940 --> 01:11:09,140
So, for the last time...

1071
01:11:10,860 --> 01:11:12,660
..it is time to vote.

1072
01:11:31,700 --> 01:11:33,860
Alright, for the last time...

1073
01:11:35,260 --> 01:11:37,060
..it is time to vote.

1074
01:11:37,060 --> 01:11:38,660
Aileen, you're up.

1075
01:11:57,460 --> 01:12:00,100
Ha-ha-ha.

1076
01:12:24,660 --> 01:12:26,580
This is not an easy decision.

1077
01:12:29,580 --> 01:12:31,580
You both took every opportunity
that you had.

1078
01:12:31,580 --> 01:12:36,100
You have both played with
an incredible amount of courage.

1079
01:12:36,100 --> 01:12:38,660
Congratulations to whoever wins.

1080
01:13:34,020 --> 01:13:36,540
Alright, I'll go count the votes.

1081
01:13:39,740 --> 01:13:41,020
Holy shit.

1082
01:14:05,380 --> 01:14:09,860
Well, there is no doubt
this has been an incredible season.

1083
01:14:09,860 --> 01:14:13,300
The only thing left to do
is read these votes.

1084
01:14:13,300 --> 01:14:16,180
But a moment like this really
should be shared

1085
01:14:16,180 --> 01:14:18,540
with the people you love the most.

1086
01:14:20,260 --> 01:14:21,860
So, come on in!

1087
01:14:28,340 --> 01:14:29,860
Hi, guys.

1088
01:14:34,660 --> 01:14:37,020
Hey, you got me.

1089
01:14:39,300 --> 01:14:42,020
How are you?
I'm all over the shop, yeah.

1090
01:14:45,660 --> 01:14:47,500
I told you I was punching, Kirby.

1091
01:14:47,500 --> 01:14:50,660
Punching way above my weight.
I didn't want to say anything.

1092
01:14:52,620 --> 01:14:54,020
You are not.

1093
01:14:54,020 --> 01:14:56,500
Iman...
Yeah.

1094
01:14:56,500 --> 01:14:58,220
So Feras has a 50-50 chance

1095
01:14:58,220 --> 01:15:00,660
of taking home
a half million dollars.

1096
01:15:00,660 --> 01:15:03,580
What would that mean for you two?

1097
01:15:03,580 --> 01:15:05,260
Wow, well...

1098
01:15:05,260 --> 01:15:06,580
Everything.

1099
01:15:06,580 --> 01:15:08,060
Our future.

1100
01:15:08,060 --> 01:15:09,980
Starting a family together.

1101
01:15:09,980 --> 01:15:12,340
Everything, really.
It'll mean a lot.

1102
01:15:12,340 --> 01:15:14,700
It'll be life-changing.
Truly.

1103
01:15:15,980 --> 01:15:19,660
Murray, how proud are you
of Caroline right now?

1104
01:15:19,660 --> 01:15:21,660
Um, Jonathan, incredibly,

1105
01:15:21,660 --> 01:15:24,940
you know, when she took
this on at the beginning,

1106
01:15:24,940 --> 01:15:29,620
I knew that she was going to give it
her best shot.

1107
01:15:29,620 --> 01:15:33,980
But to get to where she is now
is just quite unbelievable.

1108
01:15:33,980 --> 01:15:35,660
I mean, I'm really in awe.

1109
01:15:37,940 --> 01:15:39,340
Alright, let's get to it.

1110
01:15:39,340 --> 01:15:41,660
Remember, these votes are for
a winner.

1111
01:15:43,220 --> 01:15:45,740
I'm going to read the votes.

1112
01:15:47,860 --> 01:15:49,140
First vote...

1113
01:15:50,420 --> 01:15:51,620
..Feras.

1114
01:15:59,780 --> 01:16:01,060
Feras.

1115
01:16:02,860 --> 01:16:04,820
That's two votes, Feras.

1116
01:16:09,620 --> 01:16:10,700
Feras.

1117
01:16:10,700 --> 01:16:12,700
That's three votes, Feras.

1118
01:16:20,980 --> 01:16:22,780
Feras.

1119
01:16:22,780 --> 01:16:24,100
That's four votes, Feras.

1120
01:16:31,180 --> 01:16:35,260
Winner of Australian Survivor,
Titans v Rebels...

1121
01:16:35,260 --> 01:16:36,900
..Feras.

1122
01:16:36,900 --> 01:16:39,540
(CHEERING)

1123
01:17:02,820 --> 01:17:03,980
Feras...

1124
01:17:03,980 --> 01:17:05,420
Here's your cheque.

1125
01:17:05,420 --> 01:17:06,940
Congratulations.

1126
01:17:06,940 --> 01:17:10,940
You are Sole Survivor,
Titans v Rebels.

1127
01:17:10,940 --> 01:17:12,180
Well done.

1128
01:17:12,180 --> 01:17:14,540
(CHEERING)

1129
01:17:18,180 --> 01:17:20,140
I am absolutely over the moon.

1130
01:17:20,140 --> 01:17:22,900
I did not for a million years think

1131
01:17:22,900 --> 01:17:25,460
that I could even make it
on Survivor,

1132
01:17:25,460 --> 01:17:26,980
let alone win the bloody game.

1133
01:17:26,980 --> 01:17:30,540
(CHEERING)

1134
01:17:30,540 --> 01:17:32,100
I'm literally still shaking.

1135
01:17:33,460 --> 01:17:36,500
I've been wanting to write your name
down this entire game

1136
01:17:36,500 --> 01:17:38,060
and it was to vote you out.

1137
01:17:38,060 --> 01:17:39,620
But now look at me.

1138
01:17:39,620 --> 01:17:41,180
I'm writing your name down

1139
01:17:41,180 --> 01:17:43,460
to be the Sole Survivor.

1140
01:17:43,460 --> 01:17:45,300
I know I grilled you a bit tonight,

1141
01:17:45,300 --> 01:17:47,980
but I think you are
a deserving winner.

1142
01:17:47,980 --> 01:17:52,900
To be the first Aussie Arab
to win Survivor

1143
01:17:52,900 --> 01:17:55,500
is such a huge flex.

1144
01:17:55,500 --> 01:17:57,660
And to show off my culture

1145
01:17:57,660 --> 01:18:02,020
and to show everyone
where I come from in my community

1146
01:18:02,020 --> 01:18:05,860
is such a huge achievement
and I'm so proud of myself.

1147
01:18:05,860 --> 01:18:08,020
You're an inspirational person,
mate.

1148
01:18:08,020 --> 01:18:09,540
South West Sydney, baby.

1149
01:18:09,540 --> 01:18:11,660
I think that this money
will be truly life-changing

1150
01:18:11,660 --> 01:18:13,180
for you and your family.

1151
01:18:13,180 --> 01:18:17,140
I'm looking forward to you using
1/5000th of your winnings

1152
01:18:17,140 --> 01:18:18,180
to buy me lunch.

1153
01:18:18,180 --> 01:18:21,780
I had no doubt in my mind that
a Rebel could take it home.

1154
01:18:21,780 --> 01:18:25,740
I was creative,
I messed with people's minds.

1155
01:18:25,740 --> 01:18:30,100
I made some really cool alliances
and even better rivals.

1156
01:18:30,100 --> 01:18:33,100
You managed to paranoid absolutely
everyone,

1157
01:18:33,100 --> 01:18:35,740
to hold yourself in the game
for at least, I'd say,

1158
01:18:35,740 --> 01:18:39,940
probably eight, nine Tribal Councils
is pretty impressive.

1159
01:18:39,940 --> 01:18:42,140
You had an amazing social game,

1160
01:18:42,140 --> 01:18:44,340
you were loyal to your alliance

1161
01:18:44,340 --> 01:18:47,500
and you were creative
when it came to the idol.

1162
01:18:47,500 --> 01:18:50,660
You deserve this 500,000, Feras.

1163
01:18:50,660 --> 01:18:53,540
You fooled me when you bluffed me
with the idol.

1164
01:18:53,540 --> 01:18:55,700
You took me on and you won.

1165
01:18:55,700 --> 01:18:57,500
And for that reason,
you are getting my vote.

1166
01:19:04,580 --> 01:19:06,580
Captions by Red Bee Media



## S12E24

﻿1
00:00:00,000 --> 00:00:00,400
¡Nos vemos mañana a las 6:30!

2
00:00:00,960 --> 00:00:05,160
JONATHAN LAPAGLIA: Esta temporada...

3
00:00:05,160 --> 00:00:07,160
...una rivalidad ancestral...

4
00:00:07,160 --> 00:00:08,400
(GRITA)

5
00:00:08,400 --> 00:00:09,640
¡Vamos, cerebros!

6
00:00:09,640 --> 00:00:11,520...
 se reavivó.

7
00:00:11,520 --> 00:00:12,880
No. No, eso va aquí.
¡Nash!

8
00:00:12,880 --> 00:00:14,000
¡Basta, Nash!

9
00:00:14,000 --> 00:00:15,040
Pero Brawn...

10
00:00:15,040 --> 00:00:17,240
No voy a caer sin luchar.

11
00:00:17,240 --> 00:00:19,320
¡Tirad!...
 y su fuerza bruta...

12
00:00:19,320 --> 00:00:20,640
(GRITANDO)

13
00:00:20,640 --> 00:00:23,280
Os quiero, chicos.
Hasta que la muerte nos separe.

14
00:00:23,280 --> 00:00:25,520...
 no eran rivales...
¡Escuadrón de bombas!

15
00:00:25,520 --> 00:00:27,720
...para el salvajemente combustible...

16
00:00:27,720 --> 00:00:29,640
Soy la mantis religiosa.

17
00:00:29,640 --> 00:00:30,960
..Tribu Cerebro...

18
00:00:30,960 --> 00:00:32,600
Mi plan es comérmelos vivos poco a poco.

19
00:00:32,600 --> 00:00:35,840...
 que se vieron impulsados
por una volatilidad extrema.

20
00:00:35,840 --> 00:00:38,280
Quiero el cuerpo de AJ bajo tierra.

21
00:00:38,280 --> 00:00:40,560
Si me jodes,
iré a buscarte.

22
00:00:40,560 --> 00:00:43,200
¿Alguien está pensando en
tomarme por sorpresa?

23
00:00:43,200 --> 00:00:44,920
Eso es cosa de Shakespeare.

24
00:00:44,920 --> 00:00:46,280
Movimientos salvajes...

25
00:00:46,280 --> 00:00:47,280
Max.

26
00:00:47,280 --> 00:00:48,360...
 los vi prosperar.

27
00:00:48,360 --> 00:00:50,040
El nombre que se me ocurrió
fue Los graduados.

28
00:00:50,040 --> 00:00:51,840
Solo vamos a causar
caos absoluto.

29
00:00:51,840 --> 00:00:53,920
Y, uno por uno...

30
00:00:53,920 --> 00:00:55,040
(APLAUSOS)

31
00:00:55,040 --> 00:00:57,600
Me fracturé el dedo y
me sacaron del partido.

32
00:00:57,600 --> 00:00:59,680...
 las esperanzas de los Brawns se hicieron añicos...

33
00:00:59,680 --> 00:01:01,680
¡Aaah!
(GRUÑIDOS)

34
00:01:01,680 --> 00:01:03,680...
 hasta que los Cerebros...
¡Adiós!

35
00:01:07,480 --> 00:01:09,720...
 tuvieron que volverse finalmente unos contra otros.

36
00:01:09,720 --> 00:01:11,120
Zara.

37
00:01:11,120 --> 00:01:13,320
Debería haber escuchado a Myles.

38
00:01:14,640 --> 00:01:18,080
Ahora, el enfrentamiento final de los tres

39
00:01:18,080 --> 00:01:20,400
será una batalla de cerebros.

40
00:01:21,600 --> 00:01:22,960
Myles...

41
00:01:22,960 --> 00:01:24,280
¡Pie de oro, nena!

42
00:01:24,280 --> 00:01:25,280
¡Sí!

43
00:01:25,280 --> 00:01:26,760...
 el superfanático del baile en barra...

44
00:01:26,760 --> 00:01:28,080
¡Ohh!

45
00:01:28,080 --> 00:01:29,440...
 que luchó desde abajo...

46
00:01:29,440 --> 00:01:31,000
AJ y yo
somos los mayores psicópatas.

47
00:01:31,000 --> 00:01:32,720...
 y tenía un deseo por los ídolos.

48
00:01:32,720 --> 00:01:34,880
¡Oye! Tengo el ídolo.
¡Vamos, capullos!

49
00:01:34,880 --> 00:01:36,600
La gente me ha subestimado.

50
00:01:36,600 --> 00:01:37,760
Voy a jugar a este fútbol.

51
00:01:37,760 --> 00:01:40,520
Porque no tengo miedo de hacer grandes
movimientos y todo el mundo puede verlo.

52
00:01:40,520 --> 00:01:41,600
¡Guau!

53
00:01:44,560 --> 00:01:45,840
Kaelan...

54
00:01:45,840 --> 00:01:47,400
¡Wa-hey!
Señor, que aproveche.

55
00:01:47,400 --> 00:01:49,560...
 el sociable estudiante de doctorado...

56
00:01:49,560 --> 00:01:50,920
Bueno, podemos hacer chupitos con el...

57
00:01:50,920 --> 00:01:52,240
Sí, podemos hacer un shotski
con esto.

58
00:01:52,240 --> 00:01:54,400...
 con sed de cocos...

59
00:01:56,280 --> 00:01:58,040
Ahí lo tienes.
¡Sí!

60
00:01:58,040 --> 00:01:59,680...
 y collares de inmunidad.

61
00:02:00,960 --> 00:02:03,720
¡Kaelan establece un nuevo récord!

62
00:02:03,720 --> 00:02:07,520
Todo mi plan consistía en restar importancia
a mi juego físico y luego volverme loco.

63
00:02:07,520 --> 00:02:09,160
Me estoy volviendo loco y me encanta.

64
00:02:09,160 --> 00:02:10,480
(Risas)

65
00:02:11,880 --> 00:02:13,240
Y AJ...

66
00:02:13,240 --> 00:02:14,640
Estos son mis rehenes.

67
00:02:14,640 --> 00:02:16,720
... el comodín del póquer...

68
00:02:16,720 --> 00:02:18,480
Podéis tirar o...

69
00:02:18,480 --> 00:02:22,080...
 voy a caminar sobre la tabla
cada inmunidad tribal.

70
00:02:22,080 --> 00:02:23,280
¿Y nosotros qué?

71
00:02:23,280 --> 00:02:25,600...
 empeñados en crear confusión...

72
00:02:25,600 --> 00:02:26,840
¿Qué demonios, tío?

73
00:02:28,360 --> 00:02:29,680...
 y caos.

74
00:02:31,160 --> 00:02:32,360
¡Me has quemado!

75
00:02:32,360 --> 00:02:34,080
Lo controlo todo.

76
00:02:34,080 --> 00:02:35,320
Tienes los ojos más bonitos.

77
00:02:35,320 --> 00:02:36,800
No creo que pueda
perder este juego nunca más.

78
00:02:36,800 --> 00:02:37,800
Hecho.

79
00:02:37,800 --> 00:02:39,880
Esto va a ser
una apisonadora.

80
00:02:39,880 --> 00:02:42,240
Cuando la alianza más cercana del juego...

81
00:02:43,400 --> 00:02:45,160...
 finalmente se rompa...

82
00:02:46,240 --> 00:02:49,160...
 ¿quién será el Único Superviviente?

83
00:03:15,880 --> 00:03:17,080
Enhorabuena, Kaelan.

84
00:03:18,520 --> 00:03:20,320
Sí. Los tres finalistas.

85
00:03:23,360 --> 00:03:24,360
Sí.

86
00:03:24,360 --> 00:03:26,160
¿Cuál era tu objetivo
cuando viniste aquí?

87
00:03:26,160 --> 00:03:29,040
¿Tenías un objetivo específico,
como «quiero dejar claro esto»?

88
00:03:29,040 --> 00:03:30,160
Oh, ganar.

89
00:03:31,320 --> 00:03:33,560
No vine a perder.
Yo legítimamente...

90
00:03:33,560 --> 00:03:36,480
Es decir, yo no... No esperaba
ni siquiera acercarme a ganar.

91
00:03:36,480 --> 00:03:38,240
¿Sí? ¿Cuál era tu objetivo?
Bueno, porque yo...

92
00:03:38,240 --> 00:03:39,480
Mi objetivo era fusionar.

93
00:03:39,480 --> 00:03:43,160
Porque sabía que, como, lo haría,
cuando se me dieran oportunidades,

94
00:03:43,160 --> 00:03:45,360
como, hacer alguna tontería.
Sí.

95
00:03:47,800 --> 00:03:50,840
Bueno, buena suerte
en el desafío de hoy.

96
00:03:50,840 --> 00:03:53,080
Te voy a derrotar.
(RISAS)

97
00:03:53,080 --> 00:03:55,080
El entusiasta del desafío
está siendo derrotado

98
00:03:55,080 --> 00:03:56,480
por la Rata de la selva.

99
00:03:56,480 --> 00:03:58,240
Has estado muy entusiasmado últimamente.

100
00:03:58,240 --> 00:04:00,800
Sí. Los dos últimos
desafíos. Así que ha ido aumentando.

101
00:04:00,800 --> 00:04:02,040
Sí.

102
00:04:02,040 --> 00:04:04,000
Muy bien.

103
00:04:09,680 --> 00:04:11,480
KAELAN: Perder hoy
no es una opción.

104
00:04:14,120 --> 00:04:16,880
He batido el récord
de más victorias individuales en inmunidad

105
00:04:16,880 --> 00:04:18,600
en la historia de Survivor.

106
00:04:20,160 --> 00:04:23,200
Pero, eh, desafío de inmunidad final...

107
00:04:23,200 --> 00:04:25,520
...ese... ese es el que,
ese es el que tienes que ganar.

108
00:04:26,560 --> 00:04:29,960
Soy una persona
física y mentalmente fuerte.

109
00:04:31,440 --> 00:04:32,920
No me dejaré perder.

110
00:04:34,680 --> 00:04:36,640
Pero si gano
ese collar de inmunidad final,

111
00:04:36,640 --> 00:04:38,680
entonces preveo una decisión difícil.

112
00:04:39,680 --> 00:04:42,800
¿A quién llevo
al Consejo Tribal final?

113
00:04:42,800 --> 00:04:45,320
He pasado por muchas cosas
con Myles y AJ

114
00:04:45,320 --> 00:04:48,160
y no son solo...
han sido jugadores de juego

115
00:04:48,160 --> 00:04:50,200
que han sido muy cercanos
y fuertes conmigo,

116
00:04:50,200 --> 00:04:53,600
pero son dos de
mis mejores amigos en la vida.

117
00:04:53,600 --> 00:04:55,520
Y AJ es mi mejor
amigo en el mundo,

118
00:04:55,520 --> 00:04:57,360
y ha hecho todo lo posible
para ayudarme en este juego.

119
00:04:57,360 --> 00:04:59,200
Le soy leal.

120
00:04:59,200 --> 00:05:01,840
Así que, como ser humano, tengo que pensar:

121
00:05:01,840 --> 00:05:03,640
«¿A quién tiene sentido llevarse?».

122
00:05:08,360 --> 00:05:10,720
AJ: Es una locura
que la tribu de los cerebros

123
00:05:10,720 --> 00:05:14,400
tuviera los cuatro últimos puestos, y ahora
los tres últimos puestos, en el juego.

124
00:05:15,640 --> 00:05:18,800
Sinceramente, lo atribuyo a mí,
esta temporada.

125
00:05:20,200 --> 00:05:22,360
Lancé desafíos, tomé rehenes,

126
00:05:22,360 --> 00:05:24,680
Hice que otras tribus
lanzaran desafíos.

127
00:05:24,680 --> 00:05:26,760
Atacé a la gente por sorpresa.

128
00:05:26,760 --> 00:05:29,280
He creado el caos
en múltiples Consejos Tribales.

129
00:05:29,280 --> 00:05:31,160
He mentido, he engañado.

130
00:05:32,880 --> 00:05:37,400
Controlé este juego durante todo el
post-merge, cada voto.

131
00:05:38,440 --> 00:05:40,400
Si llego a los dos últimos,
voy a ganar este juego.

132
00:05:40,400 --> 00:05:42,040
Solo tengo que llegar.

133
00:05:43,840 --> 00:05:47,000
Pero no tengo
un músculo Brawny en mí.

134
00:05:48,040 --> 00:05:50,400
Pero realmente no importa.

135
00:05:50,400 --> 00:05:53,160
Como jugador de póquer, estoy feliz de ir
al desafío final de inmunidad

136
00:05:53,160 --> 00:05:55,720
y apostar todo mi dinero por Kaelan.

137
00:05:59,240 --> 00:06:01,000
Kaelan es un tipo leal.

138
00:06:03,800 --> 00:06:06,040
Así que solo necesito que gane
la inmunidad final

139
00:06:06,040 --> 00:06:07,600
o necesito ganar
la inmunidad final...

140
00:06:08,840 --> 00:06:10,800...
 y 500.000 son míos.

141
00:06:19,280 --> 00:06:23,120
No puedo creerlo.
Este es el sueño de todo fan de Survivor.

142
00:06:23,120 --> 00:06:25,240
He llegado a la final de tres.

143
00:06:27,120 --> 00:06:32,000
Pero sé que si no gano este
desafío final, estoy en problemas.

144
00:06:32,000 --> 00:06:35,880
Si AJ gana ese desafío final,
no me llevará a la final de dos.

145
00:06:35,880 --> 00:06:39,880
Y para ser honesto, creo que Kaelan
no quiere traicionar a AJ.

146
00:06:39,880 --> 00:06:44,160
Es leal a AJ, con quien ha jugado
durante todo el juego.

147
00:06:45,480 --> 00:06:47,600
Pero yo soy la Rata de la Selva.

148
00:06:47,600 --> 00:06:49,760
Las ratas son supervivientes.

149
00:06:49,760 --> 00:06:53,640
He estado luchando desde abajo
todo el juego.

150
00:06:53,640 --> 00:06:57,360
No me rindo bajo presión.
Necesito ganar.

151
00:06:57,360 --> 00:06:59,320
Esto es una cuestión de vida o muerte para mí.

152
00:06:59,320 --> 00:07:01,320
Y, por eso, estoy entusiasmado,

153
00:07:01,320 --> 00:07:05,520
y estoy dispuesto a luchar por mi vida
para ganar este juego.

154
00:07:41,640 --> 00:07:43,160
Pasa.

155
00:07:44,680 --> 00:07:46,200
Buenos días.
¿Qué es...

156
00:07:46,200 --> 00:07:47,560
¿Qué demonios?

157
00:07:47,560 --> 00:07:48,640
Oh-ho-ho-ho.

158
00:07:48,640 --> 00:07:50,320
Oh, sí.

159
00:07:54,040 --> 00:07:55,600
Emocionado.

160
00:07:56,720 --> 00:07:59,000
Nervioso.
Muy bien.

161
00:07:59,000 --> 00:08:03,400
Enhorabuena.
Has llegado al día 46.

162
00:08:03,400 --> 00:08:05,840
Como tres cerebros originales,
es el poder de la mente

163
00:08:05,840 --> 00:08:07,560
lo que os ha traído hasta aquí.

164
00:08:07,560 --> 00:08:08,680
Sí.
Y eso es exactamente

165
00:08:08,680 --> 00:08:11,080
lo que vas a tener que
sacar hoy.

166
00:08:11,080 --> 00:08:13,160
¿Estás listo para llegar a
tu desafío de inmunidad final?

167
00:08:13,160 --> 00:08:15,120
¡Sí!
¡Muy bien, vamos, Myles!

168
00:08:15,120 --> 00:08:16,640
(MYLES SE RÍE)

169
00:08:22,400 --> 00:08:26,240
Por última vez,
la inmunidad vuelve a estar en juego.

170
00:08:27,720 --> 00:08:29,240
Para el desafío de hoy,

171
00:08:29,240 --> 00:08:32,040
vas a pararte sobre estacas estrechas

172
00:08:32,040 --> 00:08:34,920
con nada más que bambú para agarrarte.

173
00:08:38,040 --> 00:08:41,640
A intervalos regulares,
pasará a clavijas más estrechas,

174
00:08:41,640 --> 00:08:43,720
lo que lo hace más difícil.

175
00:08:43,720 --> 00:08:46,320
Si, en cualquier momento,
te bajas o te caes,

176
00:08:46,320 --> 00:08:47,760
, quedas fuera del desafío.

177
00:08:47,760 --> 00:08:50,520
La última persona que quede en pie
gana la inmunidad

178
00:08:50,520 --> 00:08:54,080
y un puesto garantizado
en la última Tribal,

179
00:08:54,080 --> 00:08:56,400
donde tendrás la oportunidad
de presentarte ante el jurado

180
00:08:56,400 --> 00:08:58,920
por qué mereces
el título de Único superviviente

181
00:08:58,920 --> 00:09:01,240
y el medio millón de dólares
que lo acompaña.

182
00:09:01,240 --> 00:09:03,640
Además, podrás decidir

183
00:09:03,640 --> 00:09:05,960
quién se sentará a tu lado
en la última Tribal.

184
00:09:08,040 --> 00:09:10,520
Ahora bien, hay mucho
en juego en este desafío,

185
00:09:10,520 --> 00:09:12,240
y es claramente un reto difícil.

186
00:09:12,240 --> 00:09:14,240
Así que pensé que, ya sabes,

187
00:09:14,240 --> 00:09:16,280
Quizá necesites
un poco de apoyo desde casa.

188
00:09:16,280 --> 00:09:17,280
Sí.

189
00:09:17,280 --> 00:09:19,640
Myles, veamos a quién tenemos para ti.

190
00:09:19,640 --> 00:09:20,880
¡Pasa!

191
00:09:22,800 --> 00:09:24,640
¡Oh, es Olly!

192
00:09:24,640 --> 00:09:26,120
¡Ja, ja, ja!

193
00:09:26,120 --> 00:09:28,840
¡Myles!
¡Oh, Dios mío!

194
00:09:31,120 --> 00:09:32,520
¡Estamos en Samoa!

195
00:09:32,520 --> 00:09:34,600
¿Qué demonios es esa barba, Myles?

196
00:09:34,600 --> 00:09:35,760
¡Oh!

197
00:09:35,760 --> 00:09:37,960
(Risas)

198
00:09:37,960 --> 00:09:39,600
Mierda, Myles.
¡Sí!

199
00:09:39,600 --> 00:09:42,280
Necesitas unas malditas tartas y cerveza
en cuanto aterrices.

200
00:09:42,280 --> 00:09:44,200
¡Lo sé! ¡Estoy tan delgado!

201
00:09:44,200 --> 00:09:46,200
¡Oh, me alegro mucho de verte!
¿Cómo estás?

202
00:09:46,200 --> 00:09:48,560
Eh, este es Kaelan. Este es AJ.

203
00:09:48,560 --> 00:09:49,880
Chicos, este es Olly.
Encantado de conoceros.

204
00:09:49,880 --> 00:09:51,000
Sí.
¿Cómo estamos?

205
00:09:51,000 --> 00:09:53,720
Así que este es Olly, supongo.

206
00:09:53,720 --> 00:09:55,640
Sí, este es Olly.
Este es mi mejor amigo.

207
00:09:55,640 --> 00:09:57,840
Somos amigos
desde que éramos bebés.

208
00:09:57,840 --> 00:09:59,560
También es la persona a la que le envío

209
00:09:59,560 --> 00:10:02,520
todos los mensajes de texto de ideas de
Supervivientes a altas horas de la noche

210
00:10:02,520 --> 00:10:04,400
cuando los he estado viendo.
Vale.

211
00:10:04,400 --> 00:10:07,120
Olly, quiero decir, para ser honesto,
Myles ha...

212
00:10:07,120 --> 00:10:08,680
Ha conseguido
un par de grandes movimientos.

213
00:10:08,680 --> 00:10:10,880
¿Te sorprende?
Para nada.

214
00:10:10,880 --> 00:10:14,000
Entró diciendo que quería hacer
algo grande.

215
00:10:14,000 --> 00:10:16,040
Ahora tengo un apodo.
¿Ah, sí?

216
00:10:16,040 --> 00:10:17,080
Sí, sí. Todo el mundo...

217
00:10:17,080 --> 00:10:18,920
La Rata de la Selva.
La Rata de la Selva.

218
00:10:18,920 --> 00:10:20,560
(RISAS)

219
00:10:20,560 --> 00:10:21,800
Genial.
Sí.

220
00:10:21,800 --> 00:10:23,960
Bueno, bienvenido.
Gracias.

221
